e.en: We took the ferry to {raasay} for a hiking weekend.
e.zh: 我们乘渡轮去拉塞岛过了个徒步的周末。

e.en: The distillery on {raasay} produces a peaty single malt.
e.zh: 拉塞岛上的酒厂酿造一种泥煤味的单一麦芽威士忌。

rabat.t: n. 拉巴特（摩洛哥首都）

e.en: {rabat} is the capital city of Morocco.
e.zh: 拉巴特是摩洛哥的首都。

e.en: We spent three days exploring the medina in {rabat}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览拉巴特的老城区。

rabbet.t:
n. 企口，槽口
v. 开槽

e.en: The carpenter cut a {rabbet} along the edge of the board.
e.zh: 木匠沿着木板边缘开了一个企口槽。

e.en: A clean {rabbet} joint makes the cabinet much stronger.
e.zh: 干净的企口接合让柜子坚固得多。

e.en: He restrung his old tennis {racquet} before the match.
e.zh: 比赛前他给旧网球拍重新绑了线。

e.en: She swung the {racquet} and won the final point.
e.zh: 她挥拍击球，赢下了最后一分。

e.en: We play {racquetball} at the gym every Tuesday evening.
e.zh: 我们每周二晚上在健身房打壁球。

e.en: {Racquetball} is a fast-paced sport that builds great reflexes.
e.zh: 短拍壁球是一项快节奏运动，能锻炼反应力。

racy.t: adj. 有点黄色的；活泼有趣的

e.en: The novel contains some {racy} scenes unsuitable for children.
e.zh: 这部小说有些少儿不宜的香艳情节。

e.en: Her {racy} red sports car turned heads everywhere.
e.zh: 她那辆惹眼的红色跑车走到哪里都引人注目。

e.en: That new skateboard trick was totally {rad}, dude!
e.zh: 那个新滑板动作真是太酷了，老兄！

e.en: My little brother thinks dinosaurs are super {rad}.
e.zh: 我弟弟觉得恐龙超级酷。

e.en: The plane disappeared from {radar} just before midnight.
e.zh: 那架飞机在午夜前从雷达上消失了。

e.en: This indie band is finally on my {radar} now.
e.zh: 这支独立乐队终于进入我的视野了。

e.en: Modern weather {radars} can detect storms hundreds of miles away.
e.zh: 现代气象雷达能探测到数百英里外的风暴。

e.en: Police {radars} clocked the car at 95 mph.
e.zh: 警方雷达测得那辆车时速为95英里。

e.en: The city has a {radial} road pattern from the center.
e.zh: 这座城市的道路从中心向外呈放射状分布。

e.en: He bought four new {radial} tires for the truck.
e.zh: 他给卡车买了四条新的子午线轮胎。

e.en: The petals spread {radially} from the flower's golden center.
e.zh: 花瓣从金色的花心向四周辐射展开。

e.en: Cracks spread {radially} outward from the impact point.
e.zh: 裂纹从撞击点向四周辐射状蔓延。

e.en: One full circle equals two pi {radian} units.
e.zh: 一个完整的圆等于二派弧度。

e.en: The professor explained how to convert degrees to {radian}.
e.zh: 教授讲解了如何把角度换算成弧度。

e.en: Her face had a warm {radiance} after the good news.
e.zh: 听到好消息后，她的脸上洋溢着温暖的光彩。

e.en: The morning sun's {radiance} filled the entire kitchen.
e.zh: 清晨阳光的光辉洒满了整个厨房。

radiant.t: adj. 光芒四射的；容光焕发的

e.en: The bride looked absolutely {radiant} on her wedding day.
e.zh: 新娘在婚礼当天看起来光彩照人。

e.en: The fireplace gave off a {radiant} heat all evening.
e.zh: 壁炉整晚都散发着辐射热。

radiantly.t: adv. 灿烂地；容光焕发地

e.en: She smiled {radiantly} when her son walked across the stage.
e.zh: 当儿子走上舞台时，她笑得灿烂无比。

e.en: The ornaments shone {radiantly} on the Christmas tree.
e.zh: 装饰品在圣诞树上闪耀着耀眼的光芒。

radiate.t: v. 辐射；散发（光、热、情绪）

e.en: Confidence seemed to {radiate} from her every word.
e.zh: 她的每句话似乎都散发着自信。

e.en: Heat continues to {radiate} from the pavement after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后路面仍持续散发着热量。

e.en: The campfire {radiated} warmth across the entire campsite.
e.zh: 营火向整个营地散发着温暖。

e.en: Joy {radiated} from his face when he saw her.
e.zh: 当他看到她时，脸上洋溢着喜悦。

e.en: The new manager {radiates} calm even during a crisis.
e.zh: 新经理即使在危机中也散发出沉稳气场。

e.en: Pain {radiates} down my left leg when I sit.
e.zh: 我坐着时左腿会有放射性的疼痛。

e.en: She walked in {radiating} confidence after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后她走进来时浑身散发着自信。

e.en: Heat was {radiating} off the engine after the long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶后引擎正在散发热量。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients' {radiation} exposure during cancer treatment.
e.zh: 医生在癌症治疗期间监测患者的辐射剂量。

e.en: Sunscreen helps protect your skin from UV {radiation}.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受紫外线辐射。

e.en: Different {radiations} have varying effects on living tissue.
e.zh: 不同的辐射对活体组织有不同的影响。

e.en: Scientists study cosmic {radiations} reaching Earth's atmosphere.
e.zh: 科学家研究到达地球大气层的宇宙辐射。

e.en: The blanket reduces {radiative} heat loss during cold nights.
e.zh: 这条毯子能减少寒夜中的辐射热损失。

e.en: Climate models account for {radiative} forcing from greenhouse gases.
e.zh: 气候模型会考虑温室气体的辐射强迫作用。

e.en: The {radiator} in my bedroom keeps clanking all night.
e.zh: 我卧室的暖气片整夜都在叮当作响。

e.en: The car's {radiator} overheated halfway up the mountain.
e.zh: 汽车的散热器在上山途中过热了。

radiators.t: n. 散热器；暖气片（复数）

e.en: Old buildings often have cast iron {radiators} in every room.
e.zh: 老建筑里每个房间常常都有铸铁暖气片。

e.en: The plumber bled the {radiators} to remove trapped air.
e.zh: 水管工给暖气片放气，排出里面的空气。

radical.t:
adj. 激进的；根本的
n. 激进分子；自由基

e.en: The company announced a {radical} change to its remote work policy.
e.zh: 公司宣布对其远程办公政策进行彻底改革。

e.en: He was once a {radical} student activist in college.
e.zh: 他曾是大学里激进的学生活动家。

e.en: Online forums sometimes fuel political {radicalism} among young users.
e.zh: 网络论坛有时会助长年轻用户的政治激进主义。

e.en: His {radicalism} alienated even his closest political allies.
e.zh: 他的激进主张甚至疏远了最亲密的政治盟友。

e.en: Researchers study the {radicalization} of users on social media.
e.zh: 研究人员研究社交媒体上用户的激进化过程。

e.en: Schools work to prevent the {radicalization} of vulnerable teens.
e.zh: 学校致力于防止易受影响的青少年走向极端化。

e.en: Extremist videos can quickly {radicalize} isolated young viewers.
e.zh: 极端主义视频会迅速使孤立的年轻观众走向极端。

e.en: The war began to {radicalize} many previously moderate citizens.
e.zh: 战争开始让许多原本温和的公民变得激进。

e.en: He was {radicalized} by online communities during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间他被网络社群激进化了。

e.en: Many soldiers returned home {radicalized} by their wartime experiences.
e.zh: 许多士兵因战时经历变得激进，然后回到家乡。

e.en: Smartphones have {radically} changed how we communicate daily.
e.zh: 智能手机彻底改变了我们日常沟通的方式。

e.en: Her opinion differs {radically} from her parents' views.
e.zh: 她的观点与父母的看法截然不同。

radicals.t: n. 激进分子；自由基（复数）

e.en: Antioxidants help neutralize free {radicals} in the body.
e.zh: 抗氧化剂有助于中和体内的自由基。

e.en: Political {radicals} organized a protest outside the capitol building.
e.zh: 政治激进分子在国会大厦外组织了抗议活动。

e.en: I added some {radicchio} to the salad for a bitter kick.
e.zh: 我在沙拉里加了一些菊苣，增添苦味。

e.en: Grilled {radicchio} pairs beautifully with balsamic vinegar.
e.zh: 烤紫菊苣配香醋味道极佳。

radio.t:
n. 收音机；广播
v. 用无线电联系

e.en: I always listen to the {radio} during my morning commute.
e.zh: 我早上通勤时总是听收音机。

e.en: The pilot tried to {radio} the control tower for instructions.
e.zh: 飞行员试图用无线电联系塔台请求指示。

e.en: Workers wear protective suits when handling {radioactive} materials.
e.zh: 工人在处理放射性材料时穿着防护服。

e.en: The abandoned site remains {radioactive} decades after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生几十年后，这个废弃场地仍有放射性。

e.en: The soil samples were {radioactively} contaminated near the old plant.
e.zh: 老电厂附近的土壤样本受到了放射性污染。

e.en: Some isotopes decay {radioactively} over thousands of years.
e.zh: 有些同位素会在数千年间放射性衰变。

e.en: Marie Curie's research on {radioactivity} earned her two Nobel Prizes.
e.zh: 居里夫人的放射性研究为她赢得了两次诺贝尔奖。

e.en: Scientists detected unusual {radioactivity} levels near the reactor.
e.zh: 科学家在反应堆附近检测到异常的放射性水平。

radiocarbon.t: n. 放射性碳（用于测年）

e.en: Archaeologists used {radiocarbon} dating to age the wooden artifact.
e.zh: 考古学家用放射性碳测年法测定了那件木制文物的年代。

e.en: {Radiocarbon} analysis revealed the bones were 5,000 years old.
e.zh: 放射性碳分析显示这些骨头有五千年历史。

radioes.t: n. 收音机（非标准复数，应为 radios）

e.en: The shop sells vintage {radioes} from the nineteen-fifties.
e.zh: 这家店出售上世纪五十年代的复古收音机。

e.en: Several {radioes} crackled to life across the rescue site.
e.zh: 救援现场几台无线电同时噼啪作响开始工作。

radiogram.t: n. 无线电报；X 光片

e.en: The captain received an urgent {radiogram} about the approaching storm.
e.zh: 船长收到一份关于风暴逼近的紧急无线电报。

e.en: My grandfather still keeps an old wooden {radiogram} in the hallway.
e.zh: 我祖父走廊上还放着一台老式木壳收音电唱机。

e.en: The dentist took a {radiograph} of my lower molar.
e.zh: 牙医给我的下臼齿拍了一张X光片。

e.en: A clear {radiograph} helped diagnose the hairline fracture quickly.
e.zh: 一张清晰的X光片帮助迅速确诊了这处细微骨折。

e.en: The {radiographer} positioned my arm carefully before the X-ray.
e.zh: 放射技师在拍X光前小心地摆好我的手臂。

e.en: She trained for three years to become a hospital {radiographer}.
e.zh: 她接受了三年培训才成为医院放射技师。

e.en: {Radiographic} images confirmed the surgeon's diagnosis of the injury.
e.zh: 放射影像证实了外科医生对该伤情的诊断。

e.en: The clinic upgraded to digital {radiographic} equipment last year.
e.zh: 这家诊所去年升级到了数字化放射设备。

e.en: The tumor was {radiographically} visible on the latest scan.
e.zh: 那个肿瘤在最近的扫描中通过放射影像清晰可见。

e.en: Bone fractures can be confirmed {radiographically} within minutes.
e.zh: 骨折可以在几分钟内通过放射影像确诊。

radiography.t: n. X 光射线照相术

e.en: The clinic uses digital {radiography} to detect bone fractures quickly.
e.zh: 诊所使用数字放射成像技术快速检测骨折。

e.en: Industrial {radiography} can reveal hidden cracks in welded pipes.
e.zh: 工业射线照相术可揭示焊接管道中的隐蔽裂纹。

e.en: Doctors used {radioimmunoassay} to measure hormone levels in the blood.
e.zh: 医生用放射免疫分析法测量血液中的激素水平。

e.en: The lab developed a sensitive {radioimmunoassay} for early cancer detection.
e.zh: 实验室开发了一种灵敏的放射免疫分析法用于癌症早期检测。

e.en: Scientists injected a {radioisotope} to track blood flow in the brain.
e.zh: 科学家注射了放射性同位素来追踪大脑的血流。

e.en: This {radioisotope} has a half-life of just six hours.
e.zh: 这种放射性同位素的半衰期只有六小时。

radiological.t: adj. 放射学的；放射性的

e.en: The hospital expanded its {radiological} services last year.
e.zh: 医院去年扩大了放射科的服务范围。

e.en: Authorities warned of a possible {radiological} threat near the plant.
e.zh: 当局警告核电厂附近可能存在辐射威胁。

e.en: The {radiologist} reviewed the MRI scan and noted a small tumor.
e.zh: 放射科医生查看了核磁共振扫描,发现了一个小肿瘤。

e.en: She trained for years to become a pediatric {radiologist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年培训成为一名儿科放射科医生。

e.en: Please report to the {radiology} department on the second floor.
e.zh: 请到二楼的放射科报到。

e.en: Advances in {radiology} have transformed modern cancer treatment.
e.zh: 放射学的进步彻底改变了现代癌症治疗。

e.en: The {rabbi} led the congregation in prayer on Friday evening.
e.zh: 拉比在周五晚上带领会众祈祷。

e.en: She asked the {rabbi} for guidance about the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 她向拉比请教关于婚礼仪式的事。

rabbinate.t: n. 拉比的职位或任期

e.en: He entered the {rabbinate} after a decade of religious study.
e.zh: 经过十年的宗教学习,他进入了拉比职位。

e.en: The {rabbinate} issued a statement on the new dietary law.
e.zh: 拉比委员会就新的饮食法发表了声明。

rabbinic.t: adj. 拉比的；犹太教法学的

e.en: The book explores {rabbinic} interpretations of the Torah.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了拉比对《妥拉》的诠释。

e.en: She is pursuing a degree in {rabbinic} literature.
e.zh: 她正在攻读拉比文学的学位。

rabbinical.t: adj. 拉比的；与拉比有关的

e.en: He attended a {rabbinical} school in Jerusalem for five years.
e.zh: 他在耶路撒冷的一所拉比学院学习了五年。

e.en: The {rabbinical} council met to discuss community matters.
e.zh: 拉比委员会开会讨论社区事务。

rabbit.t:
n. 兔子
v. 捕兔；唠叨

e.en: A wild {rabbit} hopped across the garden path.
e.zh: 一只野兔从花园小径上蹦过。

e.en: My daughter wants a pet {rabbit} for her birthday.
e.zh: 我女儿想要一只宠物兔作为生日礼物。

e.en: {rabbits} keep eating the lettuce in our vegetable garden.
e.zh: 兔子们一直在啃我们菜园里的生菜。

e.en: The pet store had a litter of fluffy white {rabbits}.
e.zh: 宠物店里有一窝毛茸茸的白兔。

e.en: A noisy {rabble} gathered outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一群吵闹的人聚集在法院门外。

e.en: The politician dismissed his critics as a mere {rabble}.
e.zh: 那位政客把批评他的人贬为一群乌合之众。

e.en: Students still read {rabelais} for his outrageous humor.
e.zh: 学生们仍因拉伯雷出格的幽默而读他的作品。

e.en: {rabelais} satirized the church and society of his time.
e.zh: 拉伯雷讽刺了他那个时代的教会和社会。

rabid.t:
adj. 狂热的；偏激的
adj. 患狂犬病的

e.en: He is a {rabid} fan of the local football team.
e.zh: 他是当地足球队的狂热球迷。

e.en: A {rabid} fox was spotted near the hiking trail.
e.zh: 在徒步小径附近发现了一只患狂犬病的狐狸。

e.en: He {rabidly} defended his favorite author online.
e.zh: 他在网上狂热地为自己最喜欢的作家辩护。

e.en: The blog {rabidly} attacks every government policy.
e.zh: 那个博客对每一项政府政策都进行猛烈抨击。

e.en: All our pets are vaccinated against {rabies} every year.
e.zh: 我们家所有的宠物每年都接种狂犬病疫苗。

e.en: If a stray dog bites you, get a {rabies} shot immediately.
e.zh: 如果被流浪狗咬了,立即去打狂犬病疫苗。

rac.t: n. 缩写，常指英国皇家汽车俱乐部

e.en: He called the {rac} when his car broke down on the motorway.
e.zh: 车在高速公路上抛锚时他打电话给了 RAC 救援。

e.en: The {rac} sent a mechanic within thirty minutes.
e.zh: RAC 在三十分钟内派来了一位修车师傅。

e.en: A {raccoon} knocked over our trash can again last night.
e.zh: 一只浣熊昨晚又把我们的垃圾桶打翻了。

e.en: The {raccoon} stared at us from the top of the fence.
e.zh: 那只浣熊从围栏顶上盯着我们看。

race.t:
n. 赛跑；竞赛；种族
v. 赛跑；疾驰

e.en: She won the 100-meter {race} by a tenth of a second.
e.zh: 她以零点一秒的优势赢得了百米赛跑。

e.en: We had to {race} to catch the last train home.
e.zh: 我们不得不飞奔去赶最后一班回家的火车。

e.en: He dreams of driving a Formula One {racecar} someday.
e.zh: 他梦想有一天能驾驶一辆一级方程式赛车。

e.en: The {racecar} skidded around the corner at top speed.
e.zh: 那辆赛车以最高速度漂过弯道。

e.en: Thousands gathered at the {racecourse} for the derby.
e.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在赛马场观看德比赛。

e.en: The {racecourse} is muddy after last night's heavy rain.
e.zh: 昨晚下了大雨,赛马场满是泥泞。

raced.t: v. race 的过去式；赛跑过；疾驰

e.en: She {raced} downstairs when she heard the doorbell.
e.zh: 听到门铃她飞奔下楼。

e.en: He {raced} motorcycles professionally for over a decade.
e.zh: 他从事职业摩托车赛事超过十年。

e.en: Every {racegoer} wore an elegant hat to Royal Ascot.
e.zh: 每位观赛者都戴着雅致的帽子去阿斯科特赛马会。

e.en: The lifelong {racegoer} never missed the Cheltenham Festival.
e.zh: 这位终生赛马迷从不错过切尔滕纳姆赛马节。

e.en: The retired {racehorse} now lives peacefully on a farm.
e.zh: 那匹退役的赛马如今在农场上安享晚年。

e.en: Training a champion {racehorse} takes years of patience.
e.zh: 训练一匹冠军赛马需要多年的耐心。

racer.t: n. 赛车手；赛跑者；比赛用车

e.en: The young {racer} broke the track record on her debut.
e.zh: 那位年轻赛车手在首秀中就打破了赛道纪录。

e.en: He bought a sleek {racer} bike for the weekend tournament.
e.zh: 他为周末的比赛买了一辆流线型的赛车自行车。

races.t:
n. 比赛（复数）
v. 赛跑（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {races} sailboats on the lake every summer weekend.
e.zh: 每个夏天的周末她都在湖上参加帆船比赛。

e.en: The festival celebrates traditions from many different {races}.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝来自许多不同种族的传统。

e.en: Crowds cheered as the horses thundered around the {racetrack}.
e.zh: 马儿在赛道上飞驰时,人群欢呼起来。

e.en: The new {racetrack} opens to the public next month.
e.zh: 新的赛道下个月将对公众开放。

e.en: The local {raceway} hosts stock car events every Saturday.
e.zh: 当地赛车场每周六都举办改装车比赛。

e.en: Electricians ran the cables through a metal {raceway}.
e.zh: 电工把电缆穿过金属线槽。

rachmaninov.t: n. 拉赫玛尼诺夫（俄国作曲家）

e.en: She played a {rachmaninov} prelude at the recital last night.
e.zh: 她在昨晚的独奏会上演奏了一首拉赫玛尼诺夫的前奏曲。

e.en: {rachmaninov} composed some of the most demanding piano works.
e.zh: 拉赫玛尼诺夫创作了一些最具挑战性的钢琴作品。

e.en: The school launched a program to address {racial} inequality.
e.zh: 学校启动了一个项目以应对种族不平等问题。

e.en: The film explores {racial} tensions in 1960s America.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了 1960 年代美国的种族紧张关系。

e.en: The author wrote extensively about the dangers of {racialism}.
e.zh: 这位作者写了大量文章揭示种族主义的危险。

e.en: Modern democracies have laws against open {racialism}.
e.zh: 现代民主国家有法律禁止公开的种族主义。

racialist.t:
n. 种族主义者
adj. 种族主义的

e.en: The party was condemned for its {racialist} policies.
e.zh: 该政党因其种族主义政策而受到谴责。

e.en: He resigned after making {racialist} remarks on air.
e.zh: 他在节目中发表种族主义言论后辞职了。

racialized.t: adj. 被种族化的；带种族色彩的

e.en: The report examines how poverty is often {racialized} in cities.
e.zh: 报告探讨了城市中贫困如何常被种族化。

e.en: {racialized} communities face barriers in accessing healthcare.
e.zh: 被种族化的群体在获得医疗服务方面面临障碍。

e.en: The neighborhood is becoming more {racially} diverse each year.
e.zh: 这个社区每年都变得种族上更加多元。

e.en: He was fired for making {racially} offensive comments.
e.zh: 他因发表种族冒犯性言论而被解雇。

e.en: {racine} wrote some of the greatest French tragedies.
e.zh: 拉辛创作了一些最伟大的法国悲剧。

e.en: Students study {racine} alongside Corneille in literature class.
e.zh: 学生们在文学课上同时学习拉辛和高乃依。

racing.t:
n. 赛车；赛马
adj. 比赛的

e.en: My heart was {racing} before I went on stage.
e.zh: 上台前我的心跳得飞快。

e.en: He has been a {racing} commentator for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他担任赛车评论员已超过二十年。

e.en: The magazine covers all major motor {racings} of the season.
e.zh: 这本杂志报道本赛季所有主要的赛车比赛。

e.en: Different horse {racings} attract very different crowds.
e.zh: 不同的赛马比赛吸引着非常不同的人群。

racism.t: n. 种族主义；种族歧视

e.en: The company introduced training to combat workplace {racism}.
e.zh: 公司推出了培训以打击职场种族主义。

e.en: She gave a powerful speech about confronting everyday {racism}.
e.zh: 她做了一场关于直面日常种族主义的有力演讲。

racist.t:
n. 种族主义者
adj. 种族主义的

e.en: His {racist} comments sparked outrage on social media.
e.zh: 他的种族主义言论在社交媒体上引发了愤怒。

e.en: The country has strict laws against {racist} hate speech.
e.zh: 该国有严格的法律禁止种族主义仇恨言论。

e.en: The protest aimed to expose {racists} in positions of power.
e.zh: 这场抗议旨在揭露身居要职的种族主义者。

e.en: Online platforms have started banning known {racists}.
e.zh: 网络平台已开始封禁已知的种族主义者。

rack.t:
n. 架子；行李架
v. 折磨；使痛苦

e.en: Please hang your coat on the {rack} by the door.
e.zh: 请把外套挂在门边的衣架上。

e.en: The shelves {rack} up dust if you don't clean them weekly.
e.zh: 如果不每周清理，架子上就会积满灰尘。

racket.t: n. 球拍；喧闹；非法勾当

e.en: The kids next door are making a terrible {racket}.
e.zh: 隔壁的小孩正在制造可怕的噪音。

e.en: Police uncovered a credit card fraud {racket} last week.
e.zh: 警方上周破获了一个信用卡诈骗团伙。

racketeer.t: n. 诈骗者；敲诈勒索者

e.en: The {racketeer} was finally arrested after years of investigation.
e.zh: 那名敲诈犯在多年调查后终于被捕。

e.en: Federal agents tracked the {racketeer} across three states.
e.zh: 联邦探员追踪那名诈骗犯穿越了三个州。

racketeering.t: n. 敲诈勒索；有组织犯罪

e.en: He was convicted on charges of {racketeering} and fraud.
e.zh: 他因敲诈勒索和欺诈罪被判有罪。

e.en: The mob boss faces a long sentence for {racketeering}.
e.zh: 那名黑帮老大因敲诈勒索面临长期监禁。

rackets.t: n. 球拍（复数）；非法勾当

e.en: She bought two new tennis {rackets} for the tournament.
e.zh: 她为比赛买了两支新网球拍。

e.en: The FBI shut down several illegal gambling {rackets}.
e.zh: 联邦调查局取缔了几个非法赌博团伙。

racking.t: adj. 极痛苦的；折磨人的

e.en: I've been {racking} my brain trying to remember her name.
e.zh: 我一直在绞尽脑汁想记起她的名字。

e.en: The decision was a {racking} one for the whole family.
e.zh: 这个决定让全家人都备受煎熬。

racks.t:
n. 架子（复数）
v. 折磨（第三人称单数）

e.en: The store {racks} are full of summer dresses now.
e.zh: 商店的货架上现在挂满了夏装。

e.en: He installed two bike {racks} in the garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里装了两个自行车架。

e.en: We melted {raclette} cheese over potatoes for dinner.
e.zh: 我们把瑞士干酪融化在土豆上当晚餐。

e.en: The Swiss restaurant is famous for its traditional {raclette}.
e.zh: 那家瑞士餐厅以传统的烤奶酪料理闻名。

e.en: Her grandfather was a brilliant {raconteur} at family gatherings.
e.zh: 她的祖父在家庭聚会上是个出色的故事家。

e.en: The host is a witty {raconteur} who keeps guests laughing.
e.zh: 主持人是个机智的健谈者，总让宾客们笑声不断。

e.en: A {racoon} knocked over our trash can again last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一只浣熊又把我们的垃圾桶打翻了。

e.en: The {racoon} stared at us from behind the fence.
e.zh: 那只浣熊从篱笆后面盯着我们看。

e.en: The ship's {radioman} sent a distress signal during the storm.
e.zh: 船上的无线电员在风暴中发出了求救信号。

e.en: As a wartime {radioman}, he relayed messages between bomber crews.
e.zh: 作为战时无线电员,他在轰炸机机组间传递信息。

e.en: The satellite's {radiometer} measures heat radiating from the ocean surface.
e.zh: 卫星上的辐射计测量从海面散发的热辐射。

e.en: A small toy {radiometer} spun faster under the desk lamp.
e.zh: 一个小玩具辐射计在台灯下转得更快了。

radiometric.t: adj. 辐射测量的；放射性测定的

e.en: Geologists used {radiometric} dating to determine the rock's age.
e.zh: 地质学家用放射性测年法确定了这块岩石的年龄。

e.en: The {radiometric} survey mapped uranium deposits across the region.
e.zh: 放射性测量勘察绘制了该地区的铀矿分布图。

e.en: A small dose of {radionuclide} helps doctors image the thyroid.
e.zh: 少量放射性核素可帮助医生对甲状腺进行成像。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {radionuclide} as it moved through groundwater.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了放射性核素在地下水中的迁移。

e.en: She finished six weeks of {radiotherapy} after her surgery.
e.zh: 她在手术后完成了六周的放射治疗。

e.en: Modern {radiotherapy} targets tumors while sparing healthy tissue.
e.zh: 现代放射治疗能精准打击肿瘤同时保护健康组织。

radish.t: n. 小红萝卜；樱桃萝卜

e.en: I added a sliced {radish} to the salad for crunch.
e.zh: 我在沙拉里加了切片萝卜来增加爽脆口感。

e.en: Each {radish} from the garden was bright red and peppery.
e.zh: 花园里的每个萝卜都鲜红且带辛辣味。

e.en: Marie Curie discovered {radium} while working with uranium ore.
e.zh: 居里夫人在研究铀矿时发现了镭。

e.en: Old watch dials painted with {radium} still glow faintly today.
e.zh: 过去用镭涂料绘制的旧表盘至今仍微微发光。

e.en: The museum displays several rare {radiums} behind thick lead glass.
e.zh: 博物馆在厚铅玻璃后展出了几种稀有的镭样本。

e.en: Different {radiums} were once tested in early luminous paints.
e.zh: 早期的夜光涂料中曾试验过不同的镭样品。

radius.t:
n. 半径；范围
n. 桡骨

e.en: Most customers live within a five-mile {radius} of the store.
e.zh: 大多数顾客住在商店五英里半径范围内。

e.en: Measure the {radius} of the circle before calculating its area.
e.zh: 在计算圆面积之前先测量它的半径。

e.en: Mr. {Radley} kept his curtains drawn and rarely left the house.
e.zh: 拉德利先生总是拉着窗帘,几乎不出门。

e.en: The children whispered about the mysterious {Radley} place next door.
e.zh: 孩子们悄悄议论着隔壁那座神秘的拉德利家。

e.en: We drove through {Radnor} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们在去海边的途中经过了拉德诺。

e.en: The hills around {Radnor} are popular with weekend hikers.
e.zh: 拉德诺周边的山丘很受周末徒步者欢迎。

e.en: Many basements should be tested for {radon} every few years.
e.zh: 许多地下室应每隔几年检测一次氡气。

e.en: Long-term {radon} exposure can significantly increase lung cancer risk.
e.zh: 长期暴露于氡气会显著增加患肺癌的风险。

e.en: The gallery features a striking portrait by Henry {Raeburn}.
e.zh: 画廊里展出着亨利·雷伯恩的一幅醒目的肖像画。

e.en: {Raeburn} captured Edinburgh society with confident, fluid brushwork.
e.zh: 雷伯恩以自信流畅的笔触描绘了爱丁堡的上流社会。

raf.t: n. 英国皇家空军（Royal Air Force 缩写）

e.en: His grandfather flew Spitfires for the {RAF} during the war.
e.zh: 他的祖父在战争期间为皇家空军驾驶喷火战斗机。

e.en: The {RAF} held a ceremony at the airbase this morning.
e.zh: 皇家空军今早在空军基地举行了一场仪式。

raff.t: n. 下流人；乌合之众（罕用）

e.en: The pub attracted the usual {raff} after the football match.
e.zh: 足球比赛结束后,酒吧又吸引了一群乌合之众。

e.en: He dismissed the crowd as nothing but unruly {raff}.
e.zh: 他把那群人贬为不过是吵闹的下等之辈。

e.en: Detective {Rafferty} took the lead on the missing person case.
e.zh: 拉弗蒂侦探接手了这宗失踪人口案。

e.en: Mrs. {Rafferty} runs the bakery on the corner of Main Street.
e.zh: 拉弗蒂太太经营着主街拐角处的那家面包店。

raffia.t: n. 酒椰；酒椰叶纤维（编织用）

e.en: She wove a sun hat from soft, golden {raffia}.
e.zh: 她用柔软的金色酒椰叶编织了一顶太阳帽。

e.en: The gift was tied with a length of natural {raffia}.
e.zh: 那份礼物用一段天然酒椰纤维系着。

raffish.t: adj. 放荡不羁的；不修边幅却有魅力的

e.en: He had a {raffish} charm that women found hard to resist.
e.zh: 他身上有一种放浪不羁的魅力,女人们难以抗拒。

e.en: The bar's {raffish} crowd lingered until well past midnight.
e.zh: 酒吧里那帮玩世不恭的客人一直待到午夜过后。

raffle.t:
n. 抽奖活动
v. 以抽奖方式出售

e.en: I won a toaster in the office Christmas {raffle}.
e.zh: 我在办公室圣诞抽奖中赢得了一台烤面包机。

e.en: The school will {raffle} a bicycle to raise funds.
e.zh: 学校将抽奖赠送一辆自行车来筹款。

raft.t:
n. 木筏；橡皮艇
n. 大量

e.en: They built a small {raft} from logs and rope.
e.zh: 他们用原木和绳索搭了一只小木筏。

e.en: The new policy introduced a {raft} of unexpected changes.
e.zh: 新政策带来了一系列意想不到的变化。

e.en: A bat was hanging from the wooden {rafter} above us.
e.zh: 一只蝙蝠倒挂在我们头顶的木椽上。

e.en: The experienced {rafter} guided us through the rapids safely.
e.zh: 那位经验丰富的漂流者带我们安全穿过了急流。

e.en: The crowd cheered until the noise rang in the {rafters}.
e.zh: 观众欢呼到声音在屋椽间回荡。

e.en: Strings of dried herbs hung from the kitchen {rafters}.
e.zh: 一串串干香草从厨房的屋椽上垂下来。

rafting.t: n. 漂流运动；乘筏漂流

e.en: We went whitewater {rafting} on the Colorado River last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在科罗拉多河漂流。

e.en: {Rafting} down the gorge was the highlight of the trip.
e.zh: 乘筏漂过峡谷是这次旅行的亮点。

rag.t:
n. 抹布；破布
n. 低俗小报

e.en: He wiped the grease off his hands with an old {rag}.
e.zh: 他用一块旧抹布擦掉手上的油污。

e.en: That tabloid is just a gossip {rag} nobody trusts.
e.zh: 那份小报不过是没人相信的八卦烂报纸。

raga.t: n. 拉格（印度古典音乐调式）

e.en: The sitarist opened the concert with a slow evening {raga}.
e.zh: 西塔琴手以一首舒缓的晚间拉格开启了音乐会。

e.en: Each {raga} evokes a specific mood and time of day.
e.zh: 每首拉格都唤起特定的情绪和一天中的时段。

ragamuffin.t: n. 衣衫褴褛的孩子；流浪儿

e.en: A little {ragamuffin} ran past clutching a stolen apple.
e.zh: 一个衣衫褴褛的小孩抓着偷来的苹果跑了过去。

e.en: She fed the hungry {ragamuffin} a bowl of warm soup.
e.zh: 她给那个饥饿的小流浪儿盛了一碗热汤。

e.en: His proposal was a {ragbag} of half-formed ideas.
e.zh: 他的提案是一堆半成形想法的大杂烩。

e.en: The drawer held a {ragbag} of old buttons and ribbons.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞着一堆旧纽扣和缎带。

rage.t:
n. 盛怒；狂怒
v. 发怒；肆虐

e.en: He could barely contain his {rage} after losing the contract.
e.zh: 丢掉合同后,他几乎压不住怒火。

e.en: Cold brew coffee is all the {rage} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天冷萃咖啡风靡一时。

rages.t: v./n. rage 的第三人称单数或复数

e.en: The wildfire still {rages} across the dry hillsides.
e.zh: 野火仍在干燥的山坡上肆虐。

e.en: Debate {rages} online over the new privacy law.
e.zh: 网上对这项新隐私法的争论激烈不休。

ragged.t:
adj. 衣衫褴褛的；破烂的
adj. 参差不齐的

e.en: The boy wore a {ragged} jacket two sizes too big.
e.zh: 那男孩穿着一件大了两号的破旧夹克。

e.en: After the marathon his breathing was {ragged} and slow.
e.zh: 跑完马拉松后,他的呼吸断断续续而缓慢。

raggedly.t: adv. 破烂地；参差不齐地

e.en: He breathed {raggedly} as he climbed the last few steps.
e.zh: 他爬最后几级台阶时呼吸急促不匀。

e.en: The torn flag fluttered {raggedly} in the cold wind.
e.zh: 那面破旗在寒风中参差不齐地飘动。

raggedy.t: adj. 破旧的；衣衫褴褛的

e.en: She still keeps her {raggedy} childhood teddy bear on the shelf.
e.zh: 她至今把童年那只破旧的泰迪熊放在架子上。

e.en: He shuffled in wearing a {raggedy} pair of slippers.
e.zh: 他趿拉着一双破破烂烂的拖鞋走了进来。

ragging.t: v. 戏弄；捉弄（rag 的动名词）

e.en: His teammates kept {ragging} him about the missed penalty.
e.zh: 队友们一直拿他罚失的点球开玩笑取笑他。

e.en: Stop {ragging} on your little brother all the time.
e.zh: 别老是欺负你的小弟弟。

e.en: He pulled on a {raggy} old sweater before going outside.
e.zh: 出门前他套上一件破破烂烂的旧毛衣。

e.en: The cat curled up on a {raggy} blanket in the corner.
e.zh: 那只猫蜷缩在角落里一条破毯子上。

e.en: A {raging} storm knocked out power across the entire town.
e.zh: 一场猛烈的风暴使全镇都断了电。

e.en: She woke up with a {raging} fever and sore throat.
e.zh: 她醒来时高烧不退、嗓子疼。

e.en: He bought a navy {raglan} sweater for the autumn weather.
e.zh: 他买了件深蓝色插肩袖毛衣应付秋天的天气。

e.en: The coat's {raglan} sleeves give it a relaxed, sporty look.
e.zh: 这件外套的插肩袖让它看起来休闲又有运动感。

ragout.t: n. 蔬菜炖肉（法式料理）

e.en: She simmered a hearty beef {ragout} for several hours.
e.zh: 她把一锅丰盛的炖牛肉慢炖了好几个小时。

e.en: The chef's lamb {ragout} is the restaurant's signature dish.
e.zh: 主厨的炖羊肉是这家餐厅的招牌菜。

rags.t: n. 破衣烂衫（rag 的复数）

e.en: The homeless man was dressed in dirty, torn {rags}.
e.zh: 那个流浪汉穿着又脏又破的烂衣服。

e.en: She rose from {rags} to riches through sheer determination.
e.zh: 她凭着一股决心从一贫如洗变得富有起来。

ragtag.t: adj. 杂乱的；乌合之众的

e.en: A {ragtag} group of volunteers showed up to help clean.
e.zh: 一群杂七杂八的志愿者前来帮忙清扫。

e.en: Their {ragtag} band of rebels somehow defeated the empire.
e.zh: 他们这支乌合之众般的反抗军竟然打败了帝国。

ragtime.t: n. 拉格泰姆（一种爵士前身音乐）

e.en: The pianist played a lively {ragtime} tune from 1905.
e.zh: 钢琴师弹奏了一首1905年的轻快拉格泰姆曲子。

e.en: Scott Joplin made {ragtime} popular across America.
e.zh: 斯科特·乔普林让拉格泰姆风靡全美国。

e.en: He drove a cherry-red {ragtop} convertible down the coast.
e.zh: 他开着一辆樱桃红的软顶敞篷车沿海岸行驶。

e.en: On sunny days she always lowers the {ragtop}.
e.zh: 晴天她总会把软顶车篷放下来。

e.en: My allergies flare up whenever {ragweed} starts blooming in August.
e.zh: 每到八月豚草开花,我的过敏就会发作。

e.en: Tall {ragweed} grew along the edge of the field.
e.zh: 高高的豚草沿着田边长着。

e.en: Farmers pull {ragwort} out because it can poison grazing horses.
e.zh: 农民会拔掉千里光,因为它会毒害吃草的马匹。

e.en: Yellow {ragwort} flowers covered the abandoned roadside lot.
e.zh: 黄色的千里光花布满了那块废弃的路边空地。

e.en: The students shouted '{rah}, rah!' as their team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时,学生们高喊着"加油,加油!"。

e.en: He's not really the {rah}-rah, school-spirit type.
e.zh: 他可不是那种为母校狂热加油的人。

rai.t: n. 莱伊（北非流行音乐）

e.en: He loves listening to Algerian {rai} music on weekends.
e.zh: 他喜欢周末听阿尔及利亚的拉伊音乐。

e.en: The festival featured a famous {rai} singer from Oran.
e.zh: 音乐节请来了一位来自奥兰的著名拉伊歌手。

raid.t:
n. 突袭；突击检查
v. 袭击

e.en: Police conducted a {raid} on the suspected drug house.
e.zh: 警方对涉嫌毒品的房屋进行了突击搜查。

e.en: Our guild planned a midnight {raid} on the dragon's lair.
e.zh: 我们公会计划在午夜突袭巨龙的巢穴。

raided.t: v. 突袭（raid 的过去式）

e.en: Officers {raided} the warehouse before sunrise yesterday.
e.zh: 警员昨天日出前突袭了那间仓库。

e.en: My kids {raided} the fridge after soccer practice.
e.zh: 我的孩子们足球训练后把冰箱翻了个底朝天。

e.en: The lone {raider} escaped with several rare artifacts.
e.zh: 那名独行劫匪带着几件稀有文物逃走了。

e.en: A corporate {raider} tried to take over the company.
e.zh: 一名企业狙击手试图收购这家公司。

raiding.t:
v. 突袭（进行时）
adj. 袭击的

e.en: Bears keep {raiding} the campsite for food at night.
e.zh: 熊不断在夜里闯进营地找食物。

e.en: Hackers were {raiding} customer databases for months.
e.zh: 黑客已经入侵客户数据库好几个月了。

raids.t:
n. 突袭（复数）
v. 袭击（第三人称）

e.en: Air {raids} forced the city into nightly blackouts.
e.zh: 空袭迫使该市每晚实施灯火管制。

e.en: The team runs end-game {raids} every Friday night.
e.zh: 这个团队每周五晚上都会打终局副本。

rail.t:
n. 铁轨；栏杆
v. 抱怨

e.en: Hold the {rail} tightly when walking down icy stairs.
e.zh: 走结冰的楼梯时要紧握扶手。

e.en: We traveled across Europe by {rail} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐火车游遍了欧洲。

e.en: A single {railcar} can hold roughly 100 tons of grain.
e.zh: 一节铁路车厢大约能装一百吨粮食。

e.en: The old {railcar} was converted into a roadside diner.
e.zh: 那节旧车厢被改造成了路边餐馆。

e.en: Students get cheaper fares with a young person's {railcard}.
e.zh: 学生持青年铁路卡可以买到更便宜的车票。

e.en: Don't forget your {railcard} or they'll charge full price.
e.zh: 别忘了带铁路优惠卡,否则会按全价收费。

e.en: The senator {railed} against rising healthcare costs.
e.zh: 那位参议员猛烈抨击不断上涨的医疗费用。

e.en: Critics {railed} at the studio's controversial casting choice.
e.zh: 评论家们对该公司有争议的选角痛加批评。

e.en: Supplies were stockpiled at the {railhead} before transport.
e.zh: 物资在运输前都囤积在铁路终点站。

e.en: The town grew rapidly after becoming a major {railhead}.
e.zh: 该镇成为重要铁路终点站后迅速发展起来。

e.en: She leaned against the balcony {railing} to watch fireworks.
e.zh: 她靠在阳台栏杆上看烟花。

e.en: Please don't sit on the {railing} near the cliff.
e.zh: 请不要坐在悬崖边的栏杆上。

e.en: His good-natured {raillery} kept the dinner table laughing.
e.zh: 他善意的打趣让整桌人笑个不停。

e.en: She tolerated the gentle {raillery} from her older brothers.
e.zh: 她对哥哥们温和的玩笑话不以为意。

railroad.t:
n. 铁路（美）
v. 强行通过

e.en: The {railroad} connects rural towns to the major ports.
e.zh: 这条铁路把乡村小镇与各大港口连接起来。

e.en: Don't let them {railroad} you into signing that contract.
e.zh: 别让他们逼你仓促签下那份合同。

e.en: American {railroads} expanded rapidly during the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 十九世纪美国铁路网迅速扩张。

e.en: Several private {railroads} merged into one national system.
e.zh: 几家私营铁路公司合并成了一个国家铁路系统。

e.en: Workers replaced the rusty {rails} along the old track.
e.zh: 工人们更换了旧线路上锈蚀的铁轨。

e.en: His career went off the {rails} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后他的事业就一蹶不振。

e.en: The new {railway} cuts travel time between cities in half.
e.zh: 新铁路把城市之间的通行时间缩短了一半。

e.en: He works as an engineer for the national {railway}.
e.zh: 他在国家铁路公司当工程师。

e.en: My grandfather was a {railwayman} for over forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父当了四十多年的铁路工人。

e.en: The retired {railwayman} still missed the smell of diesel.
e.zh: 那位退休的铁路工人还是怀念柴油的味道。

e.en: Japan's {railways} are famous for their punctuality and cleanliness.
e.zh: 日本的铁路以准时和整洁闻名于世。

e.en: The government invested billions in upgrading regional {railways}.
e.zh: 政府投入数十亿升级各地区的铁路系统。

e.en: The queen wore fine {raiment} woven from imported silk.
e.zh: 女王身着用进口丝绸织成的华美衣袍。

e.en: Pilgrims arrived in simple {raiment} despite the cold weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气寒冷,朝圣者仍只穿着简朴的衣装。

e.en: Heavy {rain} flooded the streets near our apartment.
e.zh: 大雨把我们公寓附近的街道淹了。

e.en: Don't forget an umbrella; {rain} is forecast tonight.
e.zh: 别忘了带伞,预报今晚有雨。

e.en: A bright {rainbow} appeared after the afternoon shower.
e.zh: 午后阵雨过后出现了一道明亮的彩虹。

e.en: The cake was decorated with {rainbow} sprinkles and candles.
e.zh: 蛋糕上撒满了彩虹糖珠还插了蜡烛。

e.en: Double {rainbows} are rare but absolutely stunning to see.
e.zh: 双彩虹很少见,但看到时真的令人惊艳。

e.en: The prism scattered sunlight into tiny {rainbows} on the wall.
e.zh: 棱镜把阳光散射成墙上一道道小彩虹。

e.en: Put on your yellow {raincoat} before heading to school.
e.zh: 上学前把你的黄色雨衣穿上。

e.en: Her waterproof {raincoat} kept her dry during the storm.
e.zh: 她的防水雨衣让她在暴风雨中保持干爽。

e.en: The kids hung their wet {raincoats} by the front door.
e.zh: 孩子们把湿雨衣挂在了前门旁边。

e.en: Hikers should pack lightweight {raincoats} for unpredictable weather.
e.zh: 徒步者应该准备轻便雨衣以应对多变的天气。

e.en: A single {raindrop} landed on the page she was reading.
e.zh: 一滴雨落在她正读的书页上。

e.en: Each {raindrop} reflected the streetlights like tiny diamonds.
e.zh: 每一滴雨都像小钻石一样映着街灯。

e.en: It {rained} all weekend and ruined our camping trip.
e.zh: 整个周末都在下雨,把我们的露营毁了。

e.en: Compliments {rained} down on the chef after the meal.
e.zh: 那顿饭后,赞美如潮般涌向厨师。

e.en: Annual {rainfall} has decreased significantly over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里年降雨量大幅下降。

e.en: Heavy {rainfall} caused landslides in the mountain villages.
e.zh: 强降雨在山区村庄引发了山体滑坡。

e.en: Sudden {rainfalls} in spring can damage young rice seedlings.
e.zh: 春季的突降暴雨可能损害稻苗。

e.en: Record {rainfalls} this year overwhelmed the city's drainage system.
e.zh: 今年破纪录的降雨让该市的排水系统不堪重负。

e.en: The Amazon {rainforest} is home to millions of species.
e.zh: 亚马逊雨林是数百万物种的家园。

e.en: Deforestation continues to threaten the world's largest {rainforest}.
e.zh: 森林砍伐持续威胁着世界上最大的雨林。

e.en: Tropical {rainforests} produce a huge share of Earth's oxygen.
e.zh: 热带雨林产生了地球大量的氧气。

e.en: Many medicines originate from plants found in {rainforests}.
e.zh: 许多药物源自雨林中的植物。

e.en: It's {raining} again, so we'll order food in.
e.zh: 又下雨了,我们叫外卖吧。

e.en: Investors saw money {raining} down after the IPO succeeded.
e.zh: IPO成功后,投资者眼看着钱财滚滚而来。

e.en: After three {rainless} months, the reservoir levels grew critical.
e.zh: 经过三个月无雨,水库水位降到了危险线。

e.en: Farmers worried as the {rainless} summer dragged on.
e.zh: 无雨的夏天迟迟不结束,农民们忧心忡忡。

rainmaker.t: n. 业绩明星；呼风唤雨者

e.en: The new partner is a real {rainmaker} for the firm.
e.zh: 这位新合伙人确实能为公司招揽大客户。

e.en: Tribal legend tells of a {rainmaker} who ended the drought.
e.zh: 部落传说讲述了一位结束旱灾的祈雨者。

e.en: Tonight's baseball game was declared a {rainout} after lightning struck.
e.zh: 今晚的棒球赛因雷击宣布因雨取消。

e.en: Tickets will be honored at the makeup game following the {rainout}.
e.zh: 因雨取消后,原票可在补赛时使用。

rains.t:
v. 下雨（第三人称）
n. 雨季

e.en: The monsoon {rains} arrive every June without fail.
e.zh: 季风雨每年六月都会准时到来。

e.en: Whenever it {rains}, the basement starts to leak again.
e.zh: 每次下雨,地下室就又开始漏水。

e.en: A sudden {rainstorm} forced us to cancel the picnic.
e.zh: 突如其来的暴雨让我们不得不取消野餐。

e.en: The {rainstorm} knocked out power across half the city.
e.zh: 那场暴雨让全市一半地区断了电。

e.en: Tropical {rainstorms} often hit the coast in late summer.
e.zh: 夏末沿海地区常有热带暴雨袭来。

e.en: Frequent {rainstorms} delayed construction on the new bridge.
e.zh: 频繁的暴雨让新桥的施工一再延期。

e.en: We collect {rainwater} in barrels to water the garden.
e.zh: 我们用桶接雨水来浇花园。

e.en: Stagnant {rainwater} in old tires breeds mosquitoes quickly.
e.zh: 旧轮胎里积存的雨水很容易孳生蚊子。

e.en: She always saves a little money for a {rainy} day.
e.zh: 她总会存点钱以备不时之需。

e.en: The {rainy} season usually lasts from June through September.
e.zh: 雨季通常从六月持续到九月。

raise.t:
v. 提高；抚养
n. 加薪

e.en: Please {raise} your hand if you have a question.
e.zh: 如果有问题请举手。

e.en: My boss promised me a {raise} after the project launches.
e.zh: 我老板答应项目上线后给我加薪。

raised.t:
v. 提高；举起（过去式）
adj. 凸起的

e.en: She {raised} three children while working two jobs.
e.zh: 她一边打两份工一边把三个孩子拉扯大。

e.en: The charity {raised} over a million dollars last weekend.
e.zh: 慈善机构上周末筹到了超过一百万美元。

e.en: The school held a fund {raiser} to buy new computers.
e.zh: 学校举办了一场募捐活动来买新电脑。

e.en: He's a successful cattle {raiser} in rural Texas.
e.zh: 他是德州乡下一位成功的养牛户。

raises.t:
v. 提高（第三人称）
n. 加薪（复数）

e.en: This research {raises} important questions about online privacy.
e.zh: 这项研究提出了关于网络隐私的重要问题。

e.en: The company gives annual {raises} based on performance reviews.
e.zh: 公司根据绩效考核每年给员工加薪。

e.en: My grandmother bakes the best {raisin} cookies in town.
e.zh: 我奶奶烤的葡萄干饼干是镇上最好吃的。

e.en: He picked every {raisin} out of his oatmeal.
e.zh: 他把燕麦粥里的葡萄干一颗颗都挑了出来。

e.en: {Raising} a puppy requires patience and consistent training.
e.zh: 养小狗需要耐心和持之以恒的训练。

e.en: The startup is {raising} another round of funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在进行新一轮融资。

e.en: Helping refugees became her {raison} d'être after the war.
e.zh: 战后帮助难民成了她生活的意义。

e.en: Coffee is the {raison} d'être of every Monday morning.
e.zh: 咖啡是每个周一早晨存在的全部理由。

e.en: Cool {raita} balances the heat of spicy curry beautifully.
e.zh: 清凉的酸奶酱能很好地中和辛辣咖喱。

e.en: She made cucumber {raita} to serve with the biryani.
e.zh: 她做了黄瓜酸奶酱来搭配印度香饭。

raj.t: n. (印度)统治时期，尤指英国殖民统治

e.en: India gained independence from the British {raj} in 1947.
e.zh: 印度于1947年脱离英国统治获得独立。

e.en: Many old buildings still reflect the architecture of the {raj}.
e.zh: 许多老建筑仍带有英属时期的建筑风格。

raja.t: n. 印度王公、土邦君主

e.en: The local {raja} ruled the kingdom for over thirty years.
e.zh: 那位当地的王公统治这个王国超过三十年。

e.en: Tourists visited the palace once owned by a wealthy {raja}.
e.zh: 游客们参观了曾属于一位富有王公的宫殿。

rajah.t: n. 印度王公（raja 的旧拼写）

e.en: The {rajah} ruled the small kingdom for over forty years.
e.zh: 那位王公统治这个小王国超过四十年。

e.en: Tourists visited the palace once owned by a wealthy {rajah}.
e.zh: 游客们参观了一位富有王公曾拥有的宫殿。

rajasthan.t: n. 拉贾斯坦邦（印度西北部）

e.en: We rode camels through the deserts of {Rajasthan} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们在拉贾斯坦邦的沙漠里骑骆驼。

e.en: {Rajasthan} is famous for its colorful palaces and forts.
e.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦以色彩斑斓的宫殿和城堡而闻名。

rake.t:
n. 耙子
v. 耙拢、搜罗

e.en: He used a {rake} to clear leaves from the lawn.
e.zh: 他用耙子把草坪上的落叶清理干净。

e.en: Top streamers {rake} in millions of dollars each year.
e.zh: 顶级主播每年能赚取数百万美元。

raked.t: v. 用耙子耙（rake 的过去式）

e.en: She {raked} the fallen leaves into a neat pile.
e.zh: 她把落叶耙成了一堆整齐的小山。

e.en: The new app {raked} in users within its first week.
e.zh: 这款新应用在第一周就收割了大量用户。

raki.t: n. 拉克酒（土耳其茴香烈酒）

e.en: We sipped {raki} with seafood at a Turkish restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在土耳其餐厅一边吃海鲜一边喝拉克酒。

e.en: {Raki} turns cloudy white when you add cold water.
e.zh: 加入冷水后,拉克酒会变成乳白色。

raking.t: v. 耙、搜集（rake 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {raking} leaves in the backyard.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在后院耙树叶。

e.en: That YouTuber is {raking} in cash from sponsorships.
e.zh: 那个油管博主靠赞助赚得盆满钵满。

rakish.t: adj. 放荡不羁的；(帽子)歪戴的、俏皮的

e.en: He wore his hat at a {rakish} angle.
e.zh: 他把帽子戴得歪歪斜斜,显得很潇洒。

e.en: The actor had a charming, {rakish} smile on screen.
e.zh: 那位演员在镜头前露出迷人而放浪的笑容。

e.en: His scarf was tied {rakishly} around his neck.
e.zh: 他的围巾潇洒不羁地系在脖子上。

e.en: She wore the beret {rakishly} tilted to one side.
e.zh: 她把贝雷帽俏皮地歪戴在一边。

raleigh.t: n. 罗利市（美国北卡州首府）；人名

e.en: They moved to {Raleigh} for a tech job last year.
e.zh: 去年他们为了一份科技公司的工作搬去了罗利。

e.en: {Raleigh} is the capital of North Carolina.
e.zh: 罗利是北卡罗来纳州的首府。

rallied.t: v. 集结、振作（rally 的过去式）

e.en: Fans {rallied} behind the team after the tough loss.
e.zh: 惨败之后,球迷们依然团结支持球队。

e.en: Stocks {rallied} sharply after the central bank's announcement.
e.zh: 央行宣布消息后,股市大幅反弹。

rallies.t:
n. 集会、拉力赛
v. 集结（rally 单三）

e.en: The candidate held campaign {rallies} in three states.
e.zh: 那位候选人在三个州举行了竞选集会。

e.en: The market often {rallies} after good earnings reports.
e.zh: 市场往往在财报亮眼后出现反弹。

rally.t:
n. 集会；拉力赛
v. 集结、振作、反弹

e.en: Thousands joined the climate {rally} downtown on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六数千人参加了市中心的气候集会。

e.en: The team needed to {rally} in the final quarter.
e.zh: 球队需要在最后一节奋起反击。

rallying.t:
v. 召集、动员
adj. 鼓舞人心的

e.en: The coach gave a {rallying} speech before the final.
e.zh: 教练在决赛前发表了一段振奋人心的演讲。

e.en: Tech stocks were {rallying} all morning on positive news.
e.zh: 受利好消息影响,科技股整个上午都在反弹。

e.en: {Ralph} forgot his keys at the office again.
e.zh: 拉尔夫又把钥匙落在办公室了。

e.en: My friend {Ralph} just adopted a rescue dog.
e.zh: 我朋友拉尔夫刚领养了一只救援犬。

ram.t:
n. 公羊；撞击装置
v. 猛撞

e.en: My laptop only has eight gigabytes of {RAM}.
e.zh: 我的笔记本只有八GB的内存。

e.en: The {ram} charged at the fence in the field.
e.zh: 那只公羊朝田里的栅栏冲了过去。

e.en: Children in India love stories about Lord {Rama}.
e.zh: 印度的孩子们都喜欢罗摩神的故事。

e.en: The festival of Diwali celebrates {Rama}'s return home.
e.zh: 排灯节是为了庆祝罗摩归来的节日。

ramada.t: n. 凉棚；华美达(酒店品牌)

e.en: We booked a room at the {Ramada} near the airport.
e.zh: 我们在机场附近的华美达酒店订了房间。

e.en: The {Ramada} chain has hotels all over the world.
e.zh: 华美达连锁酒店在世界各地都有分店。

e.en: Muslims fast from dawn to sunset during {Ramadan}.
e.zh: 斋月期间,穆斯林从黎明到日落都要禁食。

e.en: My coworker invited me to break fast during {Ramadan}.
e.zh: 我同事邀请我在斋月期间一起开斋。

e.en: Birds darted through the dense {ramage} of the old oak.
e.zh: 鸟儿在老橡树茂密的枝叶间穿梭。

e.en: Sunlight filtered through the {ramage} above the trail.
e.zh: 阳光透过小径上方的树枝洒下来。

raman.t: n. 拉曼（人名，如拉曼散射）

e.en: Scientists use {Raman} spectroscopy to identify chemical compounds.
e.zh: 科学家用拉曼光谱来鉴定化学物质。

e.en: The lab just bought a new {Raman} microscope.
e.zh: 实验室刚购置了一台新的拉曼显微镜。

rambert.t: n. 兰伯特（姓氏；兰伯特舞蹈团）

e.en: {Rambert} dance company is touring Europe this autumn.
e.zh: 兰伯特舞蹈团今年秋天将在欧洲巡演。

e.en: She trained with {Rambert} before joining the national ballet.
e.zh: 加入国家芭蕾舞团前,她曾在兰伯特受训。

ramble.t:
v. 漫步；漫谈、唠叨
n. 漫步

e.en: Let's go for a long {ramble} through the countryside.
e.zh: 我们去乡间长途漫步一下吧。

e.en: My grandfather tends to {ramble} when telling old stories.
e.zh: 我爷爷讲老故事时总爱东拉西扯。

e.en: The {rambler} reached the summit just before sunset.
e.zh: 那位徒步者在日落前到达了山顶。

e.en: He's a real {rambler} who never gets to the point.
e.zh: 他真是个话痨,从不切入正题。

rambling.t: adj. (讲话)散漫的；(建筑)杂乱蔓延的

e.en: She gave a {rambling} answer that confused everyone.
e.zh: 她给出了一个杂乱无章的回答,把大家都搞糊涂了。

e.en: They bought a {rambling} old farmhouse in the countryside.
e.zh: 他们在乡下买了一栋蜿蜒错落的老农舍。

rambo.t: n. 兰博（电影人物，硬汉代名词）

e.en: He went full {Rambo} mode during the paintball match.
e.zh: 在彩弹比赛中他完全进入了兰博模式。

e.en: The old {Rambo} films defined eighties action cinema.
e.zh: 老版《兰博》系列电影定义了八十年代的动作片。

rambunctious.t: adj. 喧闹的、难以管束的

e.en: The {rambunctious} puppy knocked over the coffee table.
e.zh: 那只调皮的小狗把茶几给撞翻了。

e.en: A class of {rambunctious} kids exhausted the substitute teacher.
e.zh: 一班吵闹的孩子让代课老师筋疲力尽。

ramekin.t: n. 小烤盅（单人份陶瓷烤碗）

e.en: Pour the custard into a small {ramekin} before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前把蛋奶液倒进一个小烤盅里。

e.en: Each guest got a {ramekin} of melted butter for dipping.
e.zh: 每位客人都拿到一小盅融化黄油用来蘸食。

e.en: This shirt is made from a cotton and {ramie} blend.
e.zh: 这件衬衫是棉和苎麻的混纺面料。

e.en: {Ramie} fibers are stronger than cotton when wet.
e.zh: 苎麻纤维在潮湿状态下比棉花更结实。

e.en: The new policy has serious legal {ramification} for small businesses.
e.zh: 这项新政策对小企业有严重的法律影响。

e.en: Engineers studied every {ramification} of changing the database structure.
e.zh: 工程师研究了改动数据库结构带来的每一个后果。

e.en: The roots {ramify} extensively beneath the forest floor.
e.zh: 树根在森林地表下广泛地分叉延伸。

e.en: Small bugs can {ramify} into major system failures later.
e.zh: 小漏洞日后可能演变成严重的系统故障。

e.en: The missile uses a {ramjet} engine for sustained high speed.
e.zh: 该导弹使用冲压发动机以维持高速飞行。

e.en: A {ramjet} only works once the aircraft is moving fast.
e.zh: 冲压发动机只有在飞行器高速飞行时才能工作。

rammed.t: v. 猛撞、夯实（ram 的过去式）

e.en: A truck {rammed} into the barrier on the highway.
e.zh: 一辆卡车撞上了高速公路的护栏。

e.en: The bar was absolutely {rammed} on Friday night.
e.zh: 周五晚上那家酒吧挤得水泄不通。

ramp.t:
n. 坡道、斜坡
v. 加大、增强

e.en: The wheelchair {ramp} makes the building accessible to everyone.
e.zh: 这条轮椅坡道让大楼对所有人都无障碍。

e.en: We need to {ramp} up production before the holidays.
e.zh: 我们需要在假期前提高产量。

rampage.t:
n. 横冲直撞、暴怒
v. 狂暴乱闯

e.en: The elephant went on a {rampage} through the village.
e.zh: 那头大象在村子里横冲直撞起来。

e.en: Hackers went on a {rampage} attacking dozens of banks.
e.zh: 黑客肆意攻击了数十家银行。

rampaging.t: v. 横冲直撞（rampage 的现在分词）

e.en: A {rampaging} bull caused chaos in the market square.
e.zh: 一头狂奔的公牛在市场广场上闹得一团糟。

e.en: {Rampaging} fans broke windows after the team's loss.
e.zh: 球队输球后,愤怒的球迷打破了窗户。

e.en: Online scams are {rampant} during the holiday shopping season.
e.zh: 假日购物季期间,网络诈骗十分猖獗。

e.en: Misinformation is {rampant} on social media platforms today.
e.zh: 如今社交媒体平台上虚假信息泛滥成灾。

e.en: Weeds grew {rampantly} across the abandoned garden.
e.zh: 杂草在那座荒废的花园里疯狂蔓延。

e.en: Counterfeit goods are sold {rampantly} on some shopping apps.
e.zh: 在一些购物应用上,假货公然泛滥销售。

e.en: Soldiers patrolled the stone {rampart} surrounding the old city.
e.zh: 士兵们在环绕古城的石头城墙上巡逻。

e.en: Tourists climbed the medieval {rampart} for a panoramic view.
e.zh: 游客们登上中世纪的城墙俯瞰全景。

ramped.t: v. 增强、加大（ramp 的过去式）

e.en: The factory {ramped} up output to meet holiday demand.
e.zh: 工厂提高了产量以满足节日的需求。

e.en: She {ramped} her training before the marathon next month.
e.zh: 下个月马拉松前她加大了训练强度。

ramps.t: n. 坡道（ramp 的复数）；野韭葱

e.en: The mall added wheelchair {ramps} at all main entrances.
e.zh: 商场在所有主入口都增设了轮椅坡道。

e.en: Skaters were testing the new {ramps} at the park.
e.zh: 滑板爱好者们在公园里试用新建的滑板坡道。

rampton.t: n. 兰普顿（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: {Rampton} Hospital is a high-security psychiatric facility in England.
e.zh: 兰普顿医院是英国一所高度戒备的精神病院。

e.en: The documentary featured former patients of {Rampton} Hospital.
e.zh: 那部纪录片采访了兰普顿医院的前患者。

ramrod.t:
n. 通条、推弹杆
adj. 笔直的

e.en: He stood {ramrod} straight throughout the entire ceremony.
e.zh: 整个仪式上他都站得笔挺如杆。

e.en: The soldier cleaned his rifle with a {ramrod}.
e.zh: 那名士兵用通条清理他的步枪。

e.en: The search engine uses a neural {ranker} to sort results.
e.zh: 搜索引擎使用神经排序模型对结果排序。

e.en: He's a top {ranker} on the chess leaderboard this season.
e.zh: 他是本赛季国际象棋排行榜上的顶级选手。

ranking.t:
n. 排名、排行
adj. 高级的

e.en: The team climbed to second place in the global {ranking}.
e.zh: 该队在全球排行榜上升至第二名。

e.en: His {ranking} dropped after losing three matches in a row.
e.zh: 连输三场后,他的排名下滑了。

e.en: The latest college {rankings} were published this morning.
e.zh: 最新的大学排名今早已经公布。

e.en: Tennis {rankings} update every Monday after the tournaments.
e.zh: 网球排名在每周一比赛结束后更新。

e.en: His unfair criticism still {rankle}s years later.
e.zh: 他不公正的批评多年后仍让人耿耿于怀。

e.en: That sarcastic comment continues to {rankle} her.
e.zh: 那句讽刺的话一直让她心里不痛快。

ranks.t:
n. 队列、行列
v. 排名（ rank 的单三）

e.en: She quickly rose through the {ranks} of the company.
e.zh: 她在公司里迅速晋升。

e.en: This phone {ranks} among the best cameras of the year.
e.zh: 这款手机的相机跻身年度最佳之列。

e.en: Burglars {ransack} the apartment looking for valuables.
e.zh: 窃贼把公寓翻得乱七八糟,寻找值钱的东西。

e.en: I had to {ransack} my drawers to find my passport.
e.zh: 我得把抽屉翻个底朝天才找到护照。

e.en: Thieves {ransacked} the office and stole several laptops.
e.zh: 窃贼洗劫了办公室,偷走了几台笔记本电脑。

e.en: She {ransacked} her closet looking for the lost earring.
e.zh: 她翻遍了衣柜寻找丢失的耳环。

ransom.t:
n. 赎金
v. 赎回

e.en: The kidnappers demanded a million-dollar {ransom} for his release.
e.zh: 绑匪索要一百万美元赎金以换取他的释放。

e.en: Hackers held the company's data for {ransom}.
e.zh: 黑客劫持了公司的数据来索要赎金。

rant.t:
v. 大声抱怨、咆哮
n. 长篇怒骂

e.en: He went on a long {rant} about traffic on the way home.
e.zh: 他在回家路上对交通问题大发牢骚。

e.en: Her viral {rant} about bad customer service got millions of views.
e.zh: 她吐槽糟糕客户服务的视频获得了数百万次观看。

e.en: The comment section was full of angry {ranter}s.
e.zh: 评论区里满是愤怒发牢骚的人。

e.en: He's known online as a fierce political {ranter}.
e.zh: 他在网上以激烈的政治抨击者形象出名。

ranting.t: v./n. 激烈抱怨、大声叫骂

e.en: He spent the whole evening {ranting} about his coworkers.
e.zh: 他整晚都在抱怨他的同事。

e.en: Her {ranting} on the podcast made the episode go viral.
e.zh: 她在播客上的吐槽让那一集广为流传。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed the swelling under her tongue as a {ranula}.
e.zh: 牙医诊断她舌下的肿块是舌下囊肿。

e.en: A {ranula} usually requires minor surgery to remove.
e.zh: 舌下囊肿通常需要小手术切除。

rap.t:
n. 说唱（音乐）
v. 轻敲

e.en: He's been writing {rap} lyrics since he was twelve.
e.zh: 他从十二岁起就一直在写说唱歌词。

e.en: I heard a soft {rap} on the door late last night.
e.zh: 昨晚深夜我听到门上传来轻轻的敲击声。

rapacious.t: adj. 贪婪的、掠夺成性的

e.en: Critics called the company {rapacious} for raising rents so quickly.
e.zh: 批评者称该公司涨租太快,贪婪成性。

e.en: The novel features a {rapacious} villain who exploits the poor.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一个剥削穷人的贪婪反派。

e.en: The {rapacity} of the corporation shocked even its investors.
e.zh: 这家公司的贪婪程度连投资者都感到震惊。

e.en: History remembers the king for his cruelty and {rapacity}.
e.zh: 历史铭记那位国王的残忍与贪婪。

rape.t:
n./v. 强奸
n. 油菜

e.en: The country passed stricter laws to punish {rape} offenders.
e.zh: 该国通过了更严厉的法律来惩处强奸犯。

e.en: Yellow {rape} flowers covered the fields each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天田野里开满了黄色的油菜花。

e.en: The invading soldiers {raped} and looted the village.
e.zh: 入侵的士兵在村里强奸抢劫。

e.en: Critics said developers had {raped} the once-pristine coastline.
e.zh: 批评者说开发商已经摧残了曾经原始的海岸线。

raper.t: n. 强奸者（罕用，多作 rapist）

e.en: The court sentenced the {raper} to twenty years in prison.
e.zh: 法庭判处这名强奸犯二十年监禁。

e.en: Witnesses helped police identify the {raper} from a lineup.
e.zh: 目击者帮助警方在列队中认出了强奸犯。

rapes.t:
v. 强奸（单三）
n. 油菜

e.en: The report tracked unreported {rapes} across the district.
e.zh: 该报告追踪了全区未报案的强奸案件。

e.en: In May, the field of {rapes} turns bright yellow.
e.zh: 五月时，整片油菜田变成亮黄色。

e.en: Farmers harvest {rapeseed} to make cooking oil.
e.zh: 农民收获油菜籽用来榨食用油。

e.en: The tractor moved slowly through the {rapeseed} field.
e.zh: 拖拉机缓缓穿过那片油菜田。

e.en: Tourists lined up to see {Raphael}'s frescoes in the Vatican.
e.zh: 游客排队参观梵蒂冈里拉斐尔的壁画。

e.en: My nephew {Raphael} just started kindergarten this week.
e.zh: 我侄子拉斐尔这周刚上幼儿园。

e.en: The anatomy textbook labeled the {raphe} along the midline.
e.zh: 解剖学教材在中线上标注了缝。

e.en: Neurons in the {raphe} nuclei release serotonin.
e.zh: 中缝核中的神经元会释放血清素。

e.en: The startup saw {rapid} growth in its first year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在第一年实现了快速增长。

e.en: Doctors warned about the {rapid} spread of the virus.
e.zh: 医生警告该病毒正在迅速传播。

e.en: Investors were stunned by the {rapidity} of the market crash.
e.zh: 投资者对市场崩盘的速度感到震惊。

e.en: The disease spread with alarming {rapidity} through the city.
e.zh: 这种疾病以惊人的速度在城里蔓延。

e.en: AI tools are evolving {rapidly} this year.
e.zh: 今年人工智能工具正在迅速发展。

e.en: The temperature dropped {rapidly} after sunset.
e.zh: 日落之后气温迅速下降。

e.en: They rafted down the roaring {rapids} of the canyon.
e.zh: 他们顺着峡谷里咆哮的急流漂流而下。

e.en: Kayakers train for years before tackling these {rapids}.
e.zh: 皮划艇手要训练多年才敢挑战这些急流。

e.en: The fencer drew his slender {rapier} and bowed.
e.zh: 击剑手抽出细长的轻剑，鞠了一躬。

e.en: Her {rapier} wit silenced everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 她犀利如剑的机智让餐桌上所有人哑口无言。

e.en: The novel condemns soldiers {raping} civilians during the war.
e.zh: 小说谴责士兵在战争中强奸平民。

e.en: Activists accused the company of {raping} the rainforest for profit.
e.zh: 活动人士指责该公司为利润肆意破坏雨林。

e.en: DNA evidence finally identified the serial {rapist}.
e.zh: DNA 证据最终查出了这名连环强奸犯。

e.en: The convicted {rapist} was denied parole again.
e.zh: 这名已定罪的强奸犯再次被拒绝假释。

e.en: She {rapped} on the door three times before entering.
e.zh: 她敲了三下门才走进去。

e.en: The teenager {rapped} the entire verse from memory.
e.zh: 那个青少年凭记忆把整段说唱都背了出来。

e.en: Climbers learn to {rappel} safely down steep cliffs.
e.zh: 攀岩者要学会安全地从陡峭悬崖上速降。

e.en: The instructor showed us how to {rappel} using one rope.
e.zh: 教练向我们演示如何用一根绳子速降。

e.en: The young {rapper} sold out his first arena tour.
e.zh: 这位年轻说唱歌手的首次体育馆巡演门票售罄。

e.en: Her favorite {rapper} just dropped a surprise album.
e.zh: 她最喜欢的说唱歌手刚刚突然发布了一张专辑。

rapping.t: v. 说唱；敲击（现在分词）

e.en: He started {rapping} freestyle over the beat.
e.zh: 他开始即兴跟着节拍说唱。

e.en: Someone was {rapping} loudly on the front door.
e.zh: 有人在大门上用力敲着。

e.en: A good therapist builds {rapport} with patients quickly.
e.zh: 优秀的治疗师能很快与患者建立融洽关系。

e.en: The two leaders developed a strong {rapport} over dinner.
e.zh: 两位领导人在晚餐中建立了深厚的默契。

e.en: The UN {rapporteur} issued a damning report on the abuses.
e.zh: 联合国特别报告员就这些侵权行为发布了严厉报告。

e.en: The committee appointed a new {rapporteur} for the inquiry.
e.zh: 委员会为这次调查任命了新的报告员。

e.en: Diplomats spend years building {rapports} across borders.
e.zh: 外交官要花数年时间建立跨国的友好关系。

e.en: Strong {rapports} with clients drive long-term business success.
e.zh: 与客户的良好关系是企业长期成功的关键。

e.en: The summit signaled a {rapprochement} between the two nations.
e.zh: 这次峰会标志着两国之间的关系和解。

e.en: Years of quiet diplomacy led to the unexpected {rapprochement}.
e.zh: 多年的低调外交带来了这次意外的和解。

e.en: He {raps} on the window whenever he forgets his keys.
e.zh: 他每次忘带钥匙就会敲窗户。

e.en: Her viral {raps} attract millions of views on TikTok.
e.zh: 她爆红的说唱在 TikTok 上吸引了数百万次观看。

e.en: The old man called the boys cheeky little {rapscallion}s.
e.zh: 老人把那些男孩叫做调皮的小淘气鬼。

e.en: That charming {rapscallion} talked his way out of trouble again.
e.zh: 那个迷人的小坏蛋又用嘴皮子摆脱了麻烦。

rapt.t: adj. 入神的、全神贯注的

e.en: The children listened with {rapt} attention to the story.
e.zh: 孩子们全神贯注地听着故事。

e.en: She watched the magician with a {rapt} expression.
e.zh: 她带着入迷的表情看着魔术师。

e.en: The audience listened {raptly} as the violinist played.
e.zh: 观众入神地聆听着小提琴家的演奏。

e.en: He stared {raptly} at the painting for nearly an hour.
e.zh: 他出神地盯着那幅画看了将近一个小时。

e.en: A {raptor} circled high above the open meadow.
e.zh: 一只猛禽在开阔的草地上空盘旋。

e.en: The film's animatronic {raptor} still terrifies viewers today.
e.zh: 电影里的机械迅猛龙至今仍让观众胆寒。

e.en: She gazed at the sunset in pure {rapture}.
e.zh: 她带着纯粹的欣喜凝视着日落。

e.en: Fans screamed in {rapture} when the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时，歌迷狂喜地尖叫。

e.en: Critics went into {raptures} over the new restaurant's menu.
e.zh: 评论家对这家新餐厅的菜单赞不绝口。

e.en: The little girl was in {raptures} about her birthday gift.
e.zh: 小女孩对自己的生日礼物欣喜若狂。

e.en: The pianist received a {rapturous} ovation from the crowd.
e.zh: 钢琴家获得了观众狂热的掌声。

e.en: Her debut novel earned {rapturous} reviews from major newspapers.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说赢得了各大报纸的热烈好评。

rams.t:
n. 公羊（ram 的复数）
v. 猛撞（rams 第三人称单数）

e.en: Two {rams} locked horns in the rocky pasture.
e.zh: 两只公羊在乱石牧场上犄角顶在了一起。

e.en: The Los Angeles {Rams} won the championship that year.
e.zh: 洛杉矶公羊队那一年赢得了总冠军。

ramsbottom.t: n. 拉姆斯博顿（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: We took the steam train to {Ramsbottom} for the day.
e.zh: 我们坐蒸汽火车去拉姆斯巴顿玩了一天。

e.en: {Ramsbottom} is a charming market town near Manchester.
e.zh: 拉姆斯巴顿是曼彻斯特附近一座迷人的集镇。

e.en: Chef Gordon {Ramsey} yelled at the contestants again.
e.zh: 戈登·拉姆齐主厨又对参赛选手大吼起来。

e.en: My neighbor {Ramsey} just bought a new electric car.
e.zh: 我邻居拉姆齐刚买了一辆新的电动车。

ramsgate.t: n. 拉姆斯盖特（英国港口城市）

e.en: We spent the weekend at the seaside in {Ramsgate}.
e.zh: 我们在拉姆斯盖特的海边度过了周末。

e.en: {Ramsgate} has a lovely Royal Harbour worth visiting.
e.zh: 拉姆斯盖特有一个值得一去的皇家港口。

ramshackle.t: adj. 摇摇欲坠的；破旧的

e.en: They lived in a {ramshackle} cabin near the lake.
e.zh: 他们住在湖边一间摇摇欲坠的小木屋里。

e.en: The startup had a {ramshackle} office in an old warehouse.
e.zh: 这家创业公司在一个旧仓库里有间破破烂烂的办公室。

ran.t: v. 跑；运行（run 的过去式）

e.en: She {ran} five miles before breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 今天早餐前她跑了五英里。

e.en: He {ran} the company successfully for over a decade.
e.zh: 他成功地经营了这家公司十多年。

e.en: The biologist studied a {Rana} species native to wetlands.
e.zh: 那位生物学家研究了一种湿地原生的蛙属物种。

e.en: My classmate {Rana} just moved here from Pakistan.
e.zh: 我同学拉娜刚从巴基斯坦搬到这里。

ranch.t:
n. 大牧场
v. 经营牧场

e.en: They bought a small cattle {ranch} out in Montana.
e.zh: 他们在蒙大拿州买了一个小型养牛牧场。

e.en: I always order extra {ranch} dressing with my fries.
e.zh: 我点薯条时总会多加一份牧场酱。

e.en: The {rancher} rode out to check on the cattle at dawn.
e.zh: 牧场主黎明时骑马出去查看牛群。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {rancher} in rural Texas.
e.zh: 她的祖父是德州乡下的一位牧场主。

e.en: The band played a lively {ranchera} at the wedding.
e.zh: 乐队在婚礼上演奏了一首欢快的墨西哥牧场歌曲。

e.en: She grew up listening to her mother sing {ranchera} songs.
e.zh: 她从小听母亲唱墨西哥牧场民谣长大。

rancheria.t: n. 美洲印第安人小聚居地

e.en: The small {rancheria} sits at the edge of the valley.
e.zh: 那个小型印第安村落坐落在山谷边缘。

e.en: Tribal members gathered at the {rancheria} for the annual festival.
e.zh: 部落成员聚集在保留地参加年度节日。

e.en: The old {ranchero} taught his sons how to break horses.
e.zh: 老牧场主教他的儿子们如何驯马。

e.en: Every {ranchero} in the region attended the cattle auction.
e.zh: 该地区的每位牧场主都参加了牲畜拍卖会。

e.en: They bought a small {ranchette} outside of town to retire on.
e.zh: 他们在城外买了一座小牧场用来养老。

e.en: The {ranchette} has just enough land for a few horses.
e.zh: 这座小牧场刚好够养几匹马。

e.en: Cattle {ranching} has been the family business for generations.
e.zh: 养牛业是家族世代经营的生意。

e.en: He left his city job to try {ranching} in Montana.
e.zh: 他辞掉城市工作,去蒙大拿尝试经营牧场。

e.en: The {rancho} sat quietly under the desert sun.
e.zh: 那座牧场静静地坐落在沙漠的阳光下。

e.en: They spent the weekend at his uncle's {rancho} in California.
e.zh: 他们在加州他叔叔的牧场度过了周末。

rancid.t: adj. (油脂) 变质的；酸臭的

e.en: The butter had gone {rancid} in the back of the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱深处的黄油已经变质了。

e.en: A {rancid} smell came from the forgotten lunch bag.
e.zh: 被遗忘的午餐袋里散发出一股酸臭味。

e.en: She spoke about her ex-boss without any {rancor}.
e.zh: 她谈起前老板时毫无怨恨之意。

e.en: Years of {rancor} had poisoned the family relationship.
e.zh: 多年的怨恨已经毒化了这段家庭关系。

rancorous.t: adj. 怀恨的；充满敌意的

e.en: The divorce became unusually {rancorous} in the final months.
e.zh: 这场离婚在最后几个月变得异常充满敌意。

e.en: Their {rancorous} debate dominated the evening news.
e.zh: 他们针锋相对的辩论占据了晚间新闻。

rancour.t: n. 深仇；积怨（英式拼写）

e.en: He left the company without any {rancour} toward his colleagues.
e.zh: 他离开公司时对同事没有任何怨恨。

e.en: Old political {rancour} still divides the small town.
e.zh: 陈年的政治积怨仍然分裂着这个小镇。

rand.t: n. 兰特（南非货币）；兰德（姓氏）

e.en: The South African {rand} weakened against the dollar this week.
e.zh: 南非兰特本周兑美元走软。

e.en: He paid for the meal in {rand} during his Cape Town trip.
e.zh: 他在开普敦旅行时用兰特付了餐费。

random.t:
adj. 随机的；任意的
n. 随意

e.en: The app picks a {random} song from your library each morning.
e.zh: 这款应用每天早上从你的曲库随机挑一首歌。

e.en: A {random} stranger helped me carry the boxes upstairs.
e.zh: 一个陌生人随手帮我把箱子搬上了楼。

e.en: You can {randomise} the playlist with a single tap.
e.zh: 你只需轻点一下就能随机播放歌单。

e.en: We {randomise} the questions so every student sees a different order.
e.zh: 我们打乱题目顺序,让每位学生看到不同的排列。

randomised.t: adj. 随机化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The study used a {randomised} group of two thousand participants.
e.zh: 该研究采用了两千名参与者的随机分组。

e.en: She {randomised} the seating so guests would meet new people.
e.zh: 她随机安排座位,让客人们能认识新朋友。

e.en: Proper {randomization} is essential for a fair clinical trial.
e.zh: 适当的随机化对于公平的临床试验至关重要。

e.en: The game uses {randomization} to keep each playthrough unique.
e.zh: 这款游戏利用随机化让每次游玩都独一无二。

e.en: Click this button to {randomize} the order of the slides.
e.zh: 点击这个按钮可以随机打乱幻灯片的顺序。

e.en: Researchers {randomize} subjects to avoid selection bias.
e.zh: 研究人员随机分配受试者以避免选择偏差。

randomized.t: adj. 随机化的；随机分组的

e.en: The {randomized} controlled trial showed clear benefits of the drug.
e.zh: 这项随机对照试验显示出该药物的明显益处。

e.en: He {randomized} the password generator for stronger security.
e.zh: 他让密码生成器随机化以提升安全性。

e.en: My phone {randomly} restarted in the middle of a call.
e.zh: 我的手机在通话中莫名其妙地重启了。

e.en: Winners are selected {randomly} from all valid entries.
e.zh: 获奖者将从所有有效参与者中随机抽取。

e.en: There's a certain charm in the {randomness} of city life.
e.zh: 城市生活的随机性自有一种魅力。

e.en: The algorithm relies on true {randomness} for encryption.
e.zh: 该算法依赖真正的随机性来进行加密。

randy.t:
adj. 好色的；欲火中烧的
n. 兰迪（人名）

e.en: After a few drinks, he became a bit {randy} and flirty.
e.zh: 喝了几杯后,他变得有点色心荡漾、爱调情。

e.en: The young goats were {randy} during the spring season.
e.zh: 年幼的山羊在春季显得情欲旺盛。

rang.t: v. 响；打电话（ring 的过去式）

e.en: The phone {rang} just as I was sitting down to dinner.
e.zh: 我刚坐下吃晚饭,电话就响了。

e.en: She {rang} the doorbell three times before anyone answered.
e.zh: 她按了三次门铃才有人应门。

range.t:
n. 范围；山脉
v. 排列；涵盖

e.en: The laptops {range} in price from five hundred to two thousand dollars.
e.zh: 这些笔记本电脑的价格从五百美元到两千美元不等。

e.en: He drove out to the shooting {range} on Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他周六上午开车去了射击场。

ranged.t: v. 延伸；排列（range 的过去式）

e.en: The discussion {ranged} from politics to science fiction.
e.zh: 讨论的话题从政治一直谈到科幻小说。

e.en: Prices {ranged} widely depending on the seller.
e.zh: 价格因卖家不同而差异很大。

e.en: Golfers often use a laser {rangefinder} to measure distance to the hole.
e.zh: 高尔夫球手常用激光测距仪测量到球洞的距离。

e.en: The hunter checked his {rangefinder} before taking the shot.
e.zh: 猎人在开枪前检查了他的测距仪。

e.en: Cattle graze freely across the open {rangeland}.
e.zh: 牛群在开阔的牧场上自由吃草。

e.en: Drought has damaged much of the western {rangeland} this year.
e.zh: 今年的干旱已破坏了西部大片放牧地。

e.en: A park {ranger} warned us about bears on the trail.
e.zh: 一位公园护林员警告我们小路上有熊出没。

e.en: The {ranger} guided the school group through the forest.
e.zh: 那位护林员带领学生团队穿过森林。

rangers.t: n. 护林员；游骑兵（球队名）

e.en: Park {rangers} closed the trail after the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,公园护林员关闭了那条小径。

e.en: The {rangers} won the championship in overtime last night.
e.zh: 游骑兵队昨晚在加时赛中赢得了冠军。

ranges.t:
n. 范围（range 复数）
v. 涵盖（第三人称单数）

e.en: The mountain {ranges} stretch all the way to the coast.
e.zh: 那些山脉一直延伸到海岸边。

e.en: This model {ranges} between affordable and premium tiers.
e.zh: 这款型号介于平价和高端档次之间。

ranging.t: v. 涵盖；分布于（range 现在分词）

e.en: We sell items {ranging} from cheap snacks to luxury chocolates.
e.zh: 我们销售的商品从廉价零食到奢华巧克力应有尽有。

e.en: Her interests, {ranging} from coding to ballet, surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她的兴趣从编程到芭蕾,让所有人都感到惊讶。

rangoon.t: n. 仰光（缅甸旧都旧称）

e.en: The flight to {Rangoon} takes about three hours from Bangkok.
e.zh: 从曼谷飞往仰光的航班大约需要三小时。

e.en: We ordered crab {rangoon} as an appetizer at the restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在餐厅点了蟹肉奶酪角作为开胃菜。

rangy.t: adj. 瘦长的；四肢修长的

e.en: The {rangy} basketball player towered over his teammates.
e.zh: 那位身材瘦高的篮球运动员比队友高出一大截。

e.en: A {rangy} dog chased the rabbit across the field.
e.zh: 一只瘦长的狗在田野上追着兔子跑。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {ranitidine} to ease his stomach acid.
e.zh: 医生开了雷尼替丁来缓解他的胃酸。

e.en: Many {ranitidine} products were recalled due to safety concerns.
e.zh: 许多雷尼替丁产品因安全问题被召回。

rank.t:
n. 等级；军衔
v. 排名；位列

e.en: He was promoted to the {rank} of captain last month.
e.zh: 他上个月晋升为上尉军衔。

e.en: This university {rank}s among the top ten in the country.
e.zh: 这所大学跻身全国前十名。

ranked.t:
v. 排名；位列（rank 过去式）
adj. 有排名的

e.en: Her startup is {ranked} number one for customer satisfaction.
e.zh: 她的初创公司在客户满意度方面排名第一。

e.en: The team {ranked} third in the regional tournament.
e.zh: 该队在地区锦标赛中排名第三。

rapturously.t: adv. 狂喜地；欣喜若狂地

e.en: The fans cheered {rapturously} as the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时，球迷们欢呼雀跃。

e.en: Critics wrote {rapturously} about the film's stunning cinematography.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部电影令人惊艳的摄影。

rare.t:
adj. 稀有的；罕见的
adj. (牛排) 三分熟的

e.en: Finding such a {rare} bug in production is unusual.
e.zh: 在生产环境中遇到这么罕见的 bug 并不常见。

e.en: He ordered his steak {rare} with a side of fries.
e.zh: 他点了一份三分熟的牛排配薯条。

e.en: The pub serves traditional Welsh {rarebit} on toasted bread.
e.zh: 那家酒馆用烤面包供应传统的威尔士芝士吐司。

e.en: She melted cheddar and ale to make {rarebit} for lunch.
e.zh: 她把切达奶酪和啤酒融化做成芝士吐司当午餐。

e.en: Sound waves consist of compression and {rarefaction} cycles.
e.zh: 声波由压缩和稀疏的循环组成。

e.en: At high altitude, the {rarefaction} of air makes breathing harder.
e.zh: 在高海拔地区，空气的稀薄使呼吸更困难。

rarefied.t:
adj. 稀薄的（空气）
adj. 高深的；小众的

e.en: Few people enter the {rarefied} world of elite venture capital.
e.zh: 很少有人能进入顶级风险投资那个高深的圈子。

e.en: Climbers struggled in the {rarefied} air near the summit.
e.zh: 登山者在接近峰顶的稀薄空气中艰难前行。

e.en: Heating the gas will {rarefy} it and reduce its density.
e.zh: 加热气体会使它变稀薄，降低密度。

e.en: Academic jargon can {rarefy} discussions and exclude general readers.
e.zh: 学术术语会让讨论变得高深，把普通读者拒之门外。

e.en: He {rarely} checks email after work hours.
e.zh: 他下班后很少查看邮件。

e.en: Such generous offers {rarely} come around twice.
e.zh: 这样慷慨的提议很少会出现第二次。

e.en: She moved in the {rarified} circles of the art world.
e.zh: 她活跃在艺术界那种高深的小圈子里。

e.en: Mountaineers acclimate slowly to the {rarified} air at altitude.
e.zh: 登山者要慢慢适应高海拔的稀薄空气。

rarities.t: n. 珍品；稀有之物（复数）

e.en: The museum displays botanical {rarities} from across the tropics.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自热带各地的珍稀植物。

e.en: Vinyl collectors hunt for {rarities} at weekend record fairs.
e.zh: 黑胶收藏家会在周末的唱片展上寻觅稀有版本。

e.en: A sunny day in November is a real {rarity} here.
e.zh: 在这里十一月有个晴天真是稀罕事。

e.en: The coin's {rarity} drove its auction price sky-high.
e.zh: 这枚硬币的稀有性把拍卖价推向了天价。

rasa.t: n. 白板（tabula rasa 中的一部分）

e.en: Each new project feels like a tabula {rasa} to me.
e.zh: 每个新项目对我来说都像一张白板。

e.en: The chatbot framework {Rasa} is popular among open-source developers.
e.zh: 聊天机器人框架 Rasa 在开源开发者中很受欢迎。

e.en: The harlequin {rasbora} is a popular freshwater aquarium fish.
e.zh: 小丑波鱼是一种很受欢迎的淡水观赏鱼。

e.en: A school of {rasbora} darted between the aquarium plants.
e.zh: 一群波鱼在水草之间穿梭游动。

e.en: That little {rascal} hid my glasses again this morning.
e.zh: 那个小淘气今天早上又把我的眼镜藏起来了。

e.en: The puppy is a lovable {rascal} who chews everything.
e.zh: 那只小狗是个惹人喜爱的小坏蛋，什么都啃。

e.en: His {rascally} grin told us he had something planned.
e.zh: 他那调皮的笑容告诉我们他在打什么主意。

e.en: The novel features a {rascally} thief with a heart of gold.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一个调皮却善良的盗贼形象。

rash.t:
n. 皮疹
adj. 轻率的；鲁莽的

e.en: Don't make a {rash} decision you might regret later.
e.zh: 不要做出以后可能后悔的草率决定。

e.en: A red {rash} appeared on his arm after the hike.
e.zh: 远足后他手臂上出现了红色的疹子。

e.en: He fried a {rasher} of bacon for breakfast.
e.zh: 他煎了一片培根当早餐。

e.en: The full English came with two {rasher}s and beans.
e.zh: 全套英式早餐配有两片培根和豆子。

e.en: He spoke {rashly} and immediately regretted his words.
e.zh: 他口无遮拦地说了话，立刻就后悔了。

e.en: Investors who act {rashly} often lose money in volatile markets.
e.zh: 草率行事的投资者在动荡市场中常常会亏钱。

e.en: Her {rashness} in signing the contract cost the company millions.
e.zh: 她在合同上的草率让公司损失了数百万。

e.en: The general's {rashness} in battle ultimately led to defeat.
e.zh: 将军在战场上的鲁莽最终导致了失败。

rasp.t:
n. 粗锉刀
v. 发出刺耳声

e.en: You can hear the {rasp} in his voice after singing.
e.zh: 唱完歌后能听到他声音里那种沙哑。

e.en: He used a metal {rasp} to smooth the rough wood.
e.zh: 他用金属粗锉把粗糙的木料磨平。

e.en: We picked fresh {raspberries} from the garden this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我们从花园里摘了新鲜的覆盆子。

e.en: She topped the cheesecake with a handful of {raspberries}.
e.zh: 她在芝士蛋糕上撒了一把覆盆子。

e.en: She picked a fresh {raspberry} from the bush in the garden.
e.zh: 她从园子里的灌木上摘了一颗新鲜的覆盆子。

e.en: The kid blew a {raspberry} at his older sister.
e.zh: 那小孩冲他姐姐吐了个鬼脸吐舌头。

e.en: He spoke in a {rasping} voice after hours of shouting.
e.zh: 他喊了几个小时后说话的声音变得沙哑刺耳。

e.en: The {rasping} sound of the saw filled the workshop.
e.zh: 锯子刺耳的摩擦声充满了整个工坊。

rasputin.t: n. 拉斯普京（俄国历史人物）

e.en: The novel portrays {Rasputin} as a manipulative court mystic.
e.zh: 小说把拉斯普京描绘成一个善于操纵宫廷的神秘主义者。

e.en: Boney M's song about {Rasputin} became a global hit.
e.zh: Boney M那首关于拉斯普京的歌成为了全球热门。

raspy.t: adj. (嗓音) 沙哑的；刺耳的

e.en: Her {raspy} voice gave the song a bluesy feel.
e.zh: 她沙哑的嗓音给这首歌带来了蓝调的味道。

e.en: He had a {raspy} cough that wouldn't go away.
e.zh: 他一直有种刺耳的咳嗽,怎么也好不了。

e.en: The party held a massive {rassemblement} in central Paris.
e.zh: 该党在巴黎市中心举行了一场大规模集会。

e.en: Police estimated the {rassemblement} drew over fifty thousand people.
e.zh: 警方估计这场集会吸引了五万多人参加。

rasta.t: n. 拉斯塔教徒（Rastafarian 简称）

e.en: He wore his hair in long {rasta} dreadlocks.
e.zh: 他把头发编成长长的拉斯塔脏辫。

e.en: The cafe played reggae and had a chill {rasta} vibe.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆放着雷鬼音乐,带着一股慵懒的拉斯塔风。

e.en: Bob Marley spread {Rastafarian} beliefs through his music worldwide.
e.zh: 鲍勃·马利通过音乐把拉斯特法里教信仰传播到全世界。

e.en: The {Rastafarian} community gathered to celebrate the holy day.
e.zh: 拉斯特法里教信众聚在一起庆祝这个圣日。

e.en: Photoshop edits images at the pixel level using {raster} graphics.
e.zh: Photoshop使用栅格图像在像素层面编辑图片。

e.en: Avoid {raster} files when you need to scale logos infinitely.
e.zh: 如果要无限放大徽标,就不要用栅格图像文件。

rat.t:
n. 老鼠
v. 告密；出卖

e.en: A {rat} scurried across the alley behind the restaurant.
e.zh: 一只老鼠从餐馆后面的小巷里飞快窜过。

e.en: Don't be a {rat} and tell the boss everything.
e.zh: 别当告密的小人,把什么都告诉老板。

rata.t: n. 按比例（pro rata 中）

e.en: Bonuses are paid pro {rata} based on months worked.
e.zh: 奖金按工作月数按比例发放。

e.en: The crimson {rata} tree blooms across New Zealand forests.
e.zh: 那种深红色的拉塔树盛开在新西兰的森林里。

ratatouille.t: n. 普罗旺斯蔬菜杂烩

e.en: She made {ratatouille} with zucchini, eggplant, and fresh tomatoes.
e.zh: 她用西葫芦、茄子和新鲜番茄做了一道普罗旺斯杂烩。

e.en: The Pixar film {Ratatouille} made everyone want to cook.
e.zh: 皮克斯的电影《料理鼠王》让所有人都想下厨。

ratchet.t:
n. 棘轮
v. 逐步上升或下降

e.en: Use a {ratchet} to tighten the bolts more efficiently.
e.zh: 用棘轮扳手能更高效地拧紧螺栓。

e.en: Both sides continue to {ratchet} up the trade tensions.
e.zh: 双方继续步步加剧贸易紧张局势。

ratcheting.t: v. 逐步升级（ratchet 的进行式）

e.en: Inflation kept {ratcheting} up despite the central bank's efforts.
e.zh: 尽管央行采取了措施,通胀仍在不断攀升。

e.en: He was {ratcheting} the strap tighter around the cargo.
e.zh: 他正一档档地把绑带勒紧在货物上。

rate.t:
n. 比率；速率；价格
v. 评分；评价

e.en: Please {rate} your experience on a scale of one to five.
e.zh: 请按1到5分给您的体验打分。

e.en: The unemployment {rate} dropped to its lowest level in years.
e.zh: 失业率降到了多年来的最低水平。

rateable.t: adj. 可估价的；应纳税的

e.en: The property's {rateable} value determines how much council tax applies.
e.zh: 该房产的应税估值决定了要缴多少市政税。

e.en: Only {rateable} business premises receive the new tax relief.
e.zh: 只有应税的商业用房才能享受这项新税收减免。

e.en: This restaurant is {rated} the best in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 这家餐厅被评为这一带最好的。

e.en: The film is {rated} PG-13 for mild violence.
e.zh: 该影片因轻度暴力被评为PG-13级。

e.en: Every local {ratepayer} can vote in the council elections.
e.zh: 每位当地纳税人都可以在市议会选举中投票。

e.en: The new policy will save the average {ratepayer} hundreds annually.
e.zh: 新政策将为普通纳税人每年节省数百元。

e.en: Each essay was scored by two independent {rater} judges.
e.zh: 每篇作文都由两位独立的评分员打分。

e.en: The {rater} marked her presentation as outstanding.
e.zh: 评分员把她的演示评为优秀。

e.en: Mortgage {rates} have risen sharply over the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年里,房贷利率大幅上升。

e.en: The hotel offers special weekend {rates} for couples.
e.zh: 这家酒店为情侣提供特价周末房价。

e.en: I'd {rather} stay home and watch a movie tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里看部电影。

e.en: The result was {rather} disappointing compared to last quarter.
e.zh: 与上个季度相比,结果相当令人失望。

e.en: Don't go down that {rathole} during the technical meeting.
e.zh: 在技术会议上别钻进那种没意义的细节里。

e.en: His apartment was a total {rathole} after the party.
e.zh: 派对之后他的公寓简直成了个肮脏的鼠窝。

e.en: The treaty awaits {ratification} by both countries' parliaments.
e.zh: 该条约正等待两国议会的批准。

e.en: Senate {ratification} of the agreement took nearly a year.
e.zh: 参议院批准这项协议花了将近一年时间。

e.en: France was the first {ratifier} of the climate accord.
e.zh: 法国是该气候协定的首个批准国。

e.en: Each {ratifier} must implement the treaty's provisions domestically.
e.zh: 每个批准国都必须在国内落实条约的各项条款。

e.en: Congress will {ratify} the trade deal next month.
e.zh: 国会将于下月批准这项贸易协议。

e.en: The board voted to {ratify} the new CEO's appointment.
e.zh: 董事会投票通过了对新任CEO的任命。

e.en: The app has a five-star {rating} on the App Store.
e.zh: 这款应用在App Store上获得了五星评分。

e.en: Her credit {rating} improved after she paid off the loan.
e.zh: 她还清贷款后,信用评级有所提升。

e.en: The show's {ratings} dropped after the lead actor left.
e.zh: 主演离开后,这部剧的收视率下滑了。

e.en: Customer {ratings} heavily influence how products rank on Amazon.
e.zh: 顾客评分很大程度上影响着商品在亚马逊上的排名。

e.en: The recipe calls for a two-to-one {ratio} of flour to sugar.
e.zh: 这个食谱要求面粉和糖按2比1的比例混合。

e.en: Investors closely watch the company's debt-to-equity {ratio}.
e.zh: 投资者密切关注该公司的负债权益比。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes solves cases through careful {ratiocination} and observation.
e.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯靠缜密的推理和观察破案。

e.en: The philosopher's {ratiocination} led to a surprising conclusion.
e.zh: 那位哲学家的推理得出了一个出人意料的结论。

e.en: His tweet got {ratioes} from thousands of angry replies.
e.zh: 他的推文被成千上万条愤怒的回复给比下去了。

e.en: That bad take {ratioes} the original post into oblivion.
e.zh: 那条糟糕的评论让原帖被回复淹没得无人问津。

ration.t:
n. 配给量
v. 定量供应

e.en: Soldiers received a daily {ration} of food and water.
e.zh: 士兵们每天领取一份食物和水的配给。

e.en: We had to {ration} fuel during the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途自驾期间我们不得不省着用油。

e.en: Try to make a {rational} decision instead of an emotional one.
e.zh: 尽量做出理性的决定,而不是凭情绪行事。

e.en: There must be a {rational} explanation for the strange noise.
e.zh: 那个怪声一定有个合理的解释。

rationale.t: n. 根本原因，理论依据

e.en: Please explain the {rationale} behind this policy change.
e.zh: 请说明这项政策变动背后的理由。

e.en: His {rationale} for quitting the job actually made sense.
e.zh: 他辞职的理由其实说得通。

e.en: The company announced a major {rationalisation} of its supply chain.
e.zh: 该公司宣布对其供应链进行大规模整合优化。

e.en: His excuse sounded like pure {rationalisation} of bad behavior.
e.zh: 他的借口听起来纯粹是为不良行为找理由。

rationalise.t: v. 使合理化（英式拼写）

e.en: Don't try to {rationalise} skipping the gym every day.
e.zh: 别为天天不去健身房找各种合理化的借口。

e.en: The firm plans to {rationalise} its overseas operations next year.
e.zh: 该公司计划明年对其海外业务进行精简整合。

rationalised.t: v. 使合理化（过去式，英式）

e.en: She {rationalised} the expensive purchase as an investment in herself.
e.zh: 她把这笔昂贵的消费合理化为对自己的投资。

e.en: Management {rationalised} the workflow to cut costs significantly.
e.zh: 管理层精简了工作流程以大幅削减成本。

e.en: Enlightenment {rationalism} challenged centuries of religious authority.
e.zh: 启蒙时代的理性主义挑战了几个世纪以来的宗教权威。

e.en: His worldview blends scientific {rationalism} with personal spirituality.
e.zh: 他的世界观把科学理性主义与个人灵性结合起来。

e.en: As a {rationalist}, she rarely accepts claims without solid evidence.
e.zh: 作为一名理性主义者,她很少接受没有确凿证据的说法。

e.en: The {rationalist} tradition emphasizes reason over religious revelation.
e.zh: 理性主义传统强调理性而非宗教启示。

e.en: His {rationalistic} approach left no room for intuition or feeling.
e.zh: 他那种纯理性主义的做法给直觉和情感留不下任何空间。

e.en: The essay offered a {rationalistic} critique of religious dogma.
e.zh: 这篇文章对宗教教条提出了理性主义式的批评。

e.en: Economists often assume perfect {rationality} in market participants.
e.zh: 经济学家常常假设市场参与者具有完全的理性。

e.en: Stress can seriously undermine your {rationality} when making decisions.
e.zh: 压力会严重削弱你做决策时的理性。

e.en: His apology felt more like a {rationalization} than a confession.
e.zh: 他的道歉感觉更像是在自我辩解,而不是认错。

e.en: The factory's {rationalization} led to higher output and fewer workers.
e.zh: 工厂的合理化改造带来了更高产出和更少员工。

rationalize.t: v. 使合理化；自圆其说

e.en: It's easy to {rationalize} eating dessert after a hard workout.
e.zh: 剧烈运动后吃甜点很容易给自己找合理化的借口。

e.en: The company hired consultants to {rationalize} its bloated org chart.
e.zh: 该公司聘请顾问来精简其臃肿的组织架构。

e.en: He {rationalized} the lie by telling himself it protected her.
e.zh: 他自我辩解说撒这个谎是为了保护她。

e.en: The team {rationalized} their workflow and shipped features faster.
e.zh: 团队优化了工作流程,功能上线速度更快了。

e.en: It's hard to think {rationally} when you're really angry.
e.zh: 人在非常生气时很难理性思考。

e.en: She approached the problem {rationally} and found a clean solution.
e.zh: 她理性地分析这个问题,找到了一个简洁的解决方案。

e.en: During the war, sugar and butter were strictly {rationed}.
e.zh: 战争期间,糖和黄油都被严格定量配给。

e.en: She {rationed} her phone battery until she found a charger.
e.zh: 她省着用手机电量,直到找到充电器为止。

rationing.t:
n. 定量配给
v. 配给（现分）

e.en: Water {rationing} was introduced during the severe drought.
e.zh: 严重干旱期间实行了用水定量供应。

e.en: The hospital is {rationing} beds because of the patient surge.
e.zh: 由于病人激增,医院正在限量分配床位。

e.en: The hikers carried enough {rations} for a week in the mountains.
e.zh: 那群徒步者带了够在山里吃一周的干粮。

e.en: Soldiers complained about the bland taste of military {rations}.
e.zh: 士兵们抱怨军用口粮味道寡淡。

rats.t:
n. 老鼠（复数）
int. 糟糕

e.en: The old warehouse was overrun with {rats} and pigeons.
e.zh: 那座旧仓库里到处是老鼠和鸽子。

e.en: Oh {rats}, I forgot to bring my umbrella today.
e.zh: 哎呀真糟糕,我今天忘带伞了。

e.en: The patio had four {rattan} chairs around a glass table.
e.zh: 露台上一张玻璃桌周围摆着四把藤椅。

e.en: Skilled artisans weave {rattan} into beautiful baskets and furniture.
e.zh: 熟练的工匠把藤条编织成精美的篮子和家具。

rattle.t:
v. 发出咔嗒声
n. 拨浪鼓

e.en: The strong wind made the windows {rattle} all night.
e.zh: 大风吹得窗户整晚咯吱作响。

e.en: The baby giggled while shaking her colorful plastic {rattle}.
e.zh: 宝宝一边咯咯笑一边摇着她那只彩色塑料拨浪鼓。

rattled.t:
adj. 慌乱的，紧张的
v. 咔嗒响（过去式）

e.en: She was clearly {rattled} by the unexpected interview question.
e.zh: 那个出乎意料的面试问题显然让她乱了方寸。

e.en: The truck {rattled} down the bumpy country road.
e.zh: 卡车在颠簸的乡村小路上一路咯噔咯噔地开过。

e.en: A {rattler} coiled near the trail and hissed loudly.
e.zh: 一条响尾蛇盘在小径旁，发出嘶嘶声。

e.en: The old subway car was a noisy {rattler} on the tracks.
e.zh: 那节旧地铁车厢在轨道上吵得叮当响。

rattles.t:
v. 咔嗒作响（三单）
n. 拨浪鼓（复数）

e.en: The window {rattles} whenever a truck drives past.
e.zh: 每当卡车驶过，窗户就会咯咯作响。

e.en: The baby shook two colorful {rattles} in her tiny hands.
e.zh: 宝宝在小手里摇着两个彩色拨浪鼓。

e.en: A {rattlesnake} warned us with its tail before slithering away.
e.zh: 一条响尾蛇用尾巴警告我们后便溜走了。

e.en: Hikers should learn to recognize {rattlesnake} sounds in the desert.
e.zh: 徒步者应学会辨认沙漠中响尾蛇的声音。

rattletrap.t: n. 破旧车辆，破烂东西

e.en: He drove a {rattletrap} truck that barely made it uphill.
e.zh: 他开着一辆破烂卡车，勉强爬上坡。

e.en: That {rattletrap} bicycle has been in the garage for years.
e.zh: 那辆破自行车已经在车库里放了好多年。

rattling.t:
v. 咔嗒作响（现分）
adj. 极好的

e.en: The {rattling} pipes kept everyone awake all night.
e.zh: 咯咯作响的管道让大家整夜无法入睡。

e.en: She told a {rattling} good story at dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚晚餐时她讲了一个非常精彩的故事。

e.en: He showed up wearing a {ratty} old sweater and jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一件破旧毛衣和牛仔裤就来了。

e.en: The hotel room had {ratty} carpet and peeling wallpaper.
e.zh: 酒店房间地毯破烂，墙纸也在剥落。

e.en: The bar erupted in {raucous} cheers when the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时，酒吧里爆发出喧闹的欢呼声。

e.en: A {raucous} crowd gathered outside the concert hall.
e.zh: 一群人在音乐厅外吵吵嚷嚷地聚集着。

e.en: The audience laughed {raucously} at the comedian's jokes.
e.zh: 观众对喜剧演员的笑话哄堂大笑。

e.en: Crows cawed {raucously} from the tall pine trees.
e.zh: 乌鸦在高大的松树上聒噪地叫着。

e.en: The film leans into {raunch} for cheap laughs.
e.zh: 这部电影靠粗俗笑料来博取廉价的笑声。

e.en: His comedy mixes clever wordplay with pure {raunch}.
e.zh: 他的喜剧把巧妙的文字游戏和纯粹的低俗混在一起。

e.en: She danced {raunchily} on stage to shock the audience.
e.zh: 她在台上跳得十分挑逗，想让观众震惊。

e.en: The host joked {raunchily} throughout the late-night show.
e.zh: 主持人在深夜节目中一直开着低俗玩笑。

e.en: The comedian's {raunchy} jokes made some viewers uncomfortable.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的下流笑话让一些观众感到不适。

e.en: Critics called the music video too {raunchy} for daytime TV.
e.zh: 评论家认为这支音乐录像太露骨，不适合白天播出。

ravage.t:
v. 蹂躏，毁坏
n. 破坏

e.en: Wildfires continue to {ravage} towns along the coast.
e.zh: 野火继续摧毁沿海的城镇。

e.en: Time will eventually {ravage} even the strongest stone walls.
e.zh: 时间终将摧毁连最坚固的石墙。

e.en: The hurricane {ravaged} entire neighborhoods overnight.
e.zh: 飓风一夜之间摧毁了整片社区。

e.en: Years of drought have {ravaged} the country's farmland.
e.zh: 多年干旱已使该国的农田饱受摧残。

e.en: The painting shows the {ravages} of war on a small village.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了战争对一个小村庄的摧残。

e.en: Sunscreen helps protect skin from the {ravages} of UV light.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受紫外线的伤害。

e.en: Locusts are {ravaging} crops across the entire region.
e.zh: 蝗虫正在整个地区肆虐庄稼。

e.en: A {ravaging} storm tore roofs off dozens of homes.
e.zh: 一场肆虐的风暴掀翻了数十户人家的屋顶。

rave.t:
v. 狂热赞扬；胡言乱语
n. 锐舞派对

e.en: Critics {rave} about the new restaurant downtown.
e.zh: 评论家们对市中心新开的那家餐厅赞不绝口。

e.en: They danced all night at an underground {rave} in Berlin.
e.zh: 他们在柏林的一场地下锐舞派对上跳了一整晚。

e.en: The cheap sweater began to {ravel} at the sleeves.
e.zh: 那件廉价毛衣的袖口开始脱线。

e.en: Try not to {ravel} the thread while sewing the hem.
e.zh: 缝下摆时尽量别把线弄散。

e.en: The bottom of her scarf had slowly {raveled} over winter.
e.zh: 她围巾的底部在整个冬天慢慢脱了线。

e.en: Detectives finally {raveled} the mystery after months of work.
e.zh: 侦探们经过几个月的工作终于解开了谜团。

raven.t:
n. 渡鸦
adj. 乌黑的

e.en: A black {raven} perched on the fence and watched us.
e.zh: 一只黑色渡鸦停在栅栏上盯着我们。

e.en: She has long, {raven} hair that shines in the sunlight.
e.zh: 她有一头乌黑的长发，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

ravening.t: adj. 贪婪的，凶猛觅食的

e.en: A {ravening} pack of wolves circled the abandoned barn.
e.zh: 一群饿狼围着那座废弃的谷仓打转。

e.en: The travelers feared the {ravening} beasts of the forest.
e.zh: 旅人们害怕森林里那些贪婪凶猛的野兽。

ravenna.t: n. 拉文纳（意大利城市）

e.en: We toured the famous mosaics in {Ravenna} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了拉文纳著名的马赛克镶嵌画。

e.en: {Ravenna} was once the capital of the Western Roman Empire.
e.zh: 拉文纳曾是西罗马帝国的首都。

e.en: After the long hike, we were absolutely {ravenous}.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后，我们饿得不行。

e.en: The puppy has a {ravenous} appetite for treats.
e.zh: 那只小狗对零食有着永远填不满的胃口。

ravenously.t: adv. 贪婪地；狼吞虎咽地

e.en: The kids ate {ravenously} after their soccer practice.
e.zh: 孩子们足球训练完之后吃得狼吞虎咽。

e.en: He read {ravenously}, finishing three novels in one week.
e.zh: 他如饥似渴地阅读，一周读完了三本小说。

e.en: As a teenage {raver}, she traveled across Europe for parties.
e.zh: 少女时代她是个锐舞迷，跑遍欧洲参加派对。

e.en: The veteran {raver} still dances until sunrise every weekend.
e.zh: 那位老牌锐舞客每个周末仍然跳舞到日出。

e.en: A narrow river runs through the bottom of the {ravine}.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的河流穿过峡谷的谷底。

e.en: Hikers must cross a deep {ravine} to reach the summit.
e.zh: 徒步者必须穿过一条深谷才能登顶。

raving.t:
adj. 疯狂的
n. 胡言乱语

e.en: She came back from Tokyo {raving} about the food.
e.zh: 她从东京回来后对那里的食物赞不绝口。

e.en: He stood on the corner shouting like a {raving} lunatic.
e.zh: 他站在街角像个疯子一样大喊大叫。

e.en: We ordered cheese {ravioli} with brown butter and sage.
e.zh: 我们点了配焦化黄油和鼠尾草的奶酪意式饺。

e.en: Homemade {ravioli} takes patience but tastes incredible.
e.zh: 自制意式方饺需要耐心，但味道好得不得了。

e.en: The sunset over the canyon will {ravish} any photographer.
e.zh: 峡谷上空的落日会让任何摄影师为之倾倒。

e.en: Her piano performance can {ravish} even the toughest critics.
e.zh: 她的钢琴演奏连最严苛的评论家都会被打动。

e.en: The audience was {ravished} by the soprano's final aria.
e.zh: 观众被女高音最后的咏叹调彻底征服了。

e.en: He stood {ravished} before the painting for nearly an hour.
e.zh: 他在那幅画前如痴如醉地站了将近一个小时。

ravishes.t: v. 使陶醉（ravish 第三人称单数）

e.en: Her singing {ravishes} every audience that hears it.
e.zh: 她的歌声让每一位听众都为之倾倒。

e.en: The mountain view {ravishes} visitors at every turn.
e.zh: 山景在每一个转弯处都让游客陶醉。

ravishing.t: adj. 极美的；令人陶醉的

e.en: She looked absolutely {ravishing} in the red silk dress.
e.zh: 她穿着那条红色丝绸裙子，美得令人惊艳。

e.en: The garden offered a {ravishing} view of the valley below.
e.zh: 花园里可以俯瞰山谷，景色美不胜收。

ravishingly.t: adv. 令人陶醉地；极美地
