e.en: The bride looked {ravishingly} beautiful walking down the aisle.
e.zh: 新娘走过红毯时美得令人屏息。

e.en: The cliffs glowed {ravishingly} at sunset over the ocean.
e.zh: 夕阳下，海边的悬崖美得令人惊艳。

raw.t: adj. 生的；未加工的；原始的

e.en: Sushi is made with carefully prepared {raw} fish.
e.zh: 寿司是用精心处理过的生鱼制作的。

e.en: Her song captures the {raw} emotion of heartbreak.
e.zh: 她的歌捕捉到了心碎那种最原始的情感。

e.en: The {rawboned} cowboy looked tougher than the desert itself.
e.zh: 那个瘦骨嶙峋的牛仔看起来比沙漠还坚韧。

e.en: A {rawboned} stray dog wandered into our backyard.
e.zh: 一只瘦骨嶙峋的流浪狗溜进了我们的后院。

e.en: The puppy chewed happily on a {rawhide} bone all afternoon.
e.zh: 小狗整个下午都在开心地啃着一根生牛皮骨头。

e.en: He braided a long {rawhide} rope for the horses.
e.zh: 他给马编织了一根长长的生牛皮绳。

e.en: The {rawness} of her grief was hard to witness.
e.zh: 她那份未加修饰的悲伤让人难以直视。

e.en: I felt the {rawness} in my throat after shouting all day.
e.zh: 喊了一整天之后，我感觉嗓子又疼又火辣。

ray.t:
n. 光线；射线
n. 鳐鱼

e.en: A single {ray} of sunlight broke through the clouds.
e.zh: 一缕阳光穿透了云层。

e.en: We saw a giant {ray} glide past the boat in Bali.
e.zh: 我们在巴厘岛看到一只巨大的鳐鱼从船边游过。

e.en: The {rayer} gun in the cartoon shoots glowing beams.
e.zh: 动画里那把射线枪能发出发光的光束。

e.en: He sketched a tiny {rayer} weapon for the sci-fi prop.
e.zh: 他为那件科幻道具画了一把小型射线武器。

rayleigh.t: n. 瑞利（物理学家/地名）

e.en: {Rayleigh} scattering explains why the sky appears blue.
e.zh: 瑞利散射解释了为什么天空看起来是蓝色的。

e.en: Lord {Rayleigh} won the Nobel Prize for discovering argon.
e.zh: 瑞利勋爵因发现氩气而获得了诺贝尔奖。

e.en: This blouse is made of soft {rayon} that breathes well.
e.zh: 这件衬衫用柔软透气的人造丝制成。

e.en: {Rayon} wrinkles easily but feels cool in summer heat.
e.zh: 人造丝容易起皱，但在夏天穿着凉爽。

rays.t: n. 光线；射线（ray 的复数）

e.en: Sun {rays} warmed the kitchen floor in the early morning.
e.zh: 清晨的阳光把厨房地板晒得暖洋洋的。

e.en: X-{rays} revealed a small fracture in his left wrist.
e.zh: X光显示他左手腕有一处小骨折。

raytheon.t: n. 雷神公司（美国防务企业）

e.en: {Raytheon} won a major defense contract from the Pentagon.
e.zh: 雷神公司从五角大楼拿到了一份重要的国防合同。

e.en: My uncle worked as an engineer at {Raytheon} for decades.
e.zh: 我叔叔在雷神公司当了几十年的工程师。

raze.t: v. 夷为平地；彻底摧毁

e.en: The city plans to {raze} the abandoned factory next month.
e.zh: 市政府计划下个月拆除那座废弃的工厂。

e.en: Developers want to {raze} the old theater and build condos.
e.zh: 开发商想拆掉那座老剧院，建造公寓楼。

razing.t: v. 夷平（raze 的现在分词）

e.en: Crews began {razing} the burned-out building this morning.
e.zh: 工人们今早开始拆除那座被烧毁的建筑。

e.en: Locals protested the {razing} of the historic neighborhood.
e.zh: 当地居民抗议拆除这个历史街区。

e.en: He shaved with a brand-new {razor} this morning.
e.zh: 他今早用一把全新的剃须刀刮了胡子。

e.en: The chef's knife was as sharp as a {razor}.
e.zh: 那位厨师的刀像剃刀一样锋利。

razorback.t: n. 背脊突起的野猪/鲸

e.en: A wild {razorback} hog crossed the road in front of us.
e.zh: 一头野生的脊背猪从我们前面穿过马路。

e.en: Arkansas fans cheered loudly for the {razorback} football team.
e.zh: 阿肯色州球迷为野猪队橄榄球队大声欢呼。

e.en: A {razorbill} dove gracefully into the cold North Atlantic.
e.zh: 一只刀嘴海雀优雅地扎进了寒冷的北大西洋。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {razorbill} nesting on the steep cliffs.
e.zh: 观鸟者在陡峭悬崖上发现了一只筑巢的刀嘴海雀。

e.en: The barber {razored} the back of his neck very carefully.
e.zh: 理发师非常仔细地用剃刀修了他的后颈。

e.en: She wore her hair in a sharp, {razored} bob.
e.zh: 她剪了一头利落的剃刀波波头。

e.en: Disposable {razors} are cheap but bad for the environment.
e.zh: 一次性剃须刀很便宜，但对环境不好。

e.en: He keeps his straight {razors} sharpened on a leather strop.
e.zh: 他用皮带把直柄剃刀磨得很锋利。

e.en: His teammates love to {razz} him about his terrible singing.
e.zh: 队友们爱拿他糟糕的歌喉打趣他。

e.en: Don't {razz} your little brother about his missing tooth.
e.zh: 别拿你弟弟掉的那颗牙取笑他。

e.en: The opening ceremony had all the {razzmatazz} of a Vegas show.
e.zh: 开幕式拥有拉斯维加斯演出般的浮华喧闹。

e.en: Beneath the {razzmatazz}, the product itself was disappointing.
e.zh: 在花哨噱头之下,产品本身令人失望。

rbi.t: n. 棒球打点（run batted in）

e.en: He drove in the winning run for his hundredth {RBI} of the season.
e.zh: 他打回制胜分,完成本赛季第一百个打点。

e.en: She leads the league in {RBIs} this year.
e.zh: 她今年在联盟打点榜上排名第一。

rbs.t: n. 苏格兰皇家银行（缩写）

e.en: The Royal Bank of Scotland, known as {RBS}, was bailed out in 2008.
e.zh: 苏格兰皇家银行,简称RBS,于2008年获得救助。

e.en: He worked at {RBS} for over a decade before retiring.
e.zh: 他在RBS工作了十多年才退休。

e.en: Plug the red {RCA} cable into the audio input.
e.zh: 把红色的RCA线插入音频输入口。

e.en: Older TVs use {RCA} jacks for video and audio.
e.zh: 旧电视机使用RCA插孔来连接视频和音频。

e.en: The bridge was built using reinforced cement concrete, or {RCC}.
e.zh: 这座桥采用钢筋混凝土即RCC建造。

e.en: {RCC} structures last longer than plain concrete ones.
e.zh: 钢筋混凝土结构比素混凝土更耐用。

e.en: Install an {RCD} to protect the bathroom circuit.
e.zh: 在浴室电路上安装漏电保护器以确保安全。

e.en: The {RCD} tripped the moment water touched the wire.
e.zh: 水一接触电线,漏电保护器立刻跳闸。

rcn.t: n. 加拿大皇家海军（缩写）

e.en: {RCN} provides cable internet across several US cities.
e.zh: RCN在美国多个城市提供有线网络服务。

e.en: He switched from Comcast to {RCN} last month.
e.zh: 他上个月把康卡斯特换成了RCN。

rdc.t: n. 区域配送中心（缩写）

e.en: The retailer ships goods through its regional {RDC} in Ohio.
e.zh: 零售商通过其位于俄亥俄州的区域配送中心发货。

e.en: Each {RDC} handles deliveries for nearby stores.
e.zh: 每个区域配送中心负责附近门店的配送。

e.en: We host the database on Amazon {RDS} for easier scaling.
e.zh: 我们把数据库托管在亚马逊RDS上以便扩展。

e.en: The car radio supports {RDS} for station information display.
e.zh: 这台车载收音机支持RDS以显示电台信息。

e.en: Is this diamond {real} or just a clever fake?
e.zh: 这颗钻石是真的还是高仿的?

e.en: He has a {real} talent for solving puzzles.
e.zh: 他在解谜方面真的很有天赋。

realign.t: v. 重新调整；重新结盟

e.en: The mechanic had to {realign} the car's front wheels.
e.zh: 技工不得不重新调整汽车前轮。

e.en: The party tried to {realign} itself with younger voters.
e.zh: 该党试图重新争取年轻选民的支持。

realignment.t: n. 重新调整；重新组合

e.en: The election caused a major political {realignment}.
e.zh: 这次选举引发了一次重大的政治重组。

e.en: A simple {realignment} of the printer fixed the problem.
e.zh: 重新校准打印机就解决了问题。

realisable.t: adj. 可实现的；可变现的

e.en: That dream is {realisable} with hard work and patience.
e.zh: 那个梦想通过努力和耐心是可以实现的。

e.en: The company listed its {realisable} assets in the report.
e.zh: 公司在报告中列出了可变现资产。

e.en: The {realisation} that he was wrong came too late.
e.zh: 他意识到自己错了,但为时已晚。

e.en: The project's {realisation} took nearly five years.
e.zh: 该项目的实现花了将近五年时间。

e.en: Therapy led to several painful {realisations} about his childhood.
e.zh: 治疗让他对童年有了几个痛苦的领悟。

e.en: The novel sparked many {realisations} among its readers.
e.zh: 这部小说引发读者诸多顿悟。

e.en: I didn't {realise} the meeting had been cancelled.
e.zh: 我没意识到会议已经被取消了。

e.en: She worked hard to {realise} her childhood dream.
e.zh: 她努力实现儿时的梦想。

realised.t: v. 意识到；实现（过去式）

e.en: He suddenly {realised} he had left his keys inside.
e.zh: 他突然意识到把钥匙落在屋里了。

e.en: The team finally {realised} their long-held ambition.
e.zh: 团队终于实现了长期以来的抱负。

realises.t: v. 意识到；实现（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {realises} now that the warning signs were obvious.
e.zh: 她现在意识到那些警告信号其实很明显。

e.en: The novel {realises} its theme through subtle imagery.
e.zh: 这本小说通过细腻的意象呈现其主题。

realising.t: v. 意识到；实现（进行时）

e.en: Without {realising} it, he had walked for hours.
e.zh: 他不知不觉已经走了好几个小时。

e.en: She is slowly {realising} her potential as a leader.
e.zh: 她正慢慢发挥自己作为领导者的潜力。

realism.t: n. 现实主义；写实风格

e.en: The film's gritty {realism} made viewers uncomfortable.
e.zh: 这部电影的粗粝写实让观众感到不适。

e.en: We need more {realism} about the project's timeline.
e.zh: 我们对项目时间线需要更现实的态度。

e.en: Different schools of {realisms} shaped twentieth-century literature.
e.zh: 不同的现实主义流派塑造了二十世纪文学。

e.en: The exhibit compared the {realisms} of various painters.
e.zh: 展览比较了多位画家的现实主义风格。

realist.t: n. 现实主义者；务实者

e.en: She's a {realist} who never sets unattainable goals.
e.zh: 她是个现实主义者,从不设定无法实现的目标。

e.en: The painter was a {realist} known for everyday scenes.
e.zh: 这位画家是位以日常场景著称的写实主义者。

e.en: Let's set a {realistic} deadline for the project.
e.zh: 我们给项目定一个切合实际的截止日期吧。

e.en: The graphics in this game look incredibly {realistic}.
e.zh: 这款游戏的画面看起来非常逼真。

e.en: {Realistically}, we can't finish this by Friday.
e.zh: 实事求是地说,我们周五前完成不了。

e.en: The artist drew the horse {realistically} in pencil.
e.zh: 艺术家用铅笔逼真地画出了那匹马。

e.en: True {realists} accept that change is often slow.
e.zh: 真正的现实主义者承认改变往往是缓慢的。

e.en: The {realists} in the cabinet rejected the bold plan.
e.zh: 内阁中的现实派否决了那个大胆的计划。

e.en: Young entrepreneurs must face the harsh {realities} of business.
e.zh: 年轻创业者必须面对商业的残酷现实。

e.en: Virtual {realities} are transforming how we play games.
e.zh: 虚拟现实正在改变我们玩游戏的方式。

e.en: In {reality}, the job is harder than it looks.
e.zh: 实际上,这份工作比看起来要难得多。

e.en: She's hooked on watching {reality} TV every night.
e.zh: 她每晚都迷上看真人秀节目。

realizable.t: adj. 可实现的；可变现的

e.en: With proper funding, the goal becomes fully {realizable}.
e.zh: 有了充足资金,这个目标就完全可以实现。

e.en: The startup listed its {realizable} value to investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司向投资者列出了可变现价值。

e.en: The sudden {realization} hit her on the train home.
e.zh: 在回家的火车上她猛然顿悟。

e.en: The {realization} of the plan required massive investment.
e.zh: 该计划的实现需要巨额投资。

e.en: His diary records all the {realizations} from that summer.
e.zh: 他的日记记录了那个夏天的所有领悟。

e.en: Therapy brought several uncomfortable {realizations} to light.
e.zh: 治疗让几个令人不安的领悟浮现出来。

e.en: Did you {realize} the store closes at nine?
e.zh: 你知道这家店九点关门吗?

e.en: He worked tirelessly to {realize} his startup vision.
e.zh: 他不懈努力以实现自己的创业愿景。

realized.t: v. 意识到；实现（过去式）

e.en: She {realized} too late that the email was a scam.
e.zh: 她太晚才意识到那封邮件是诈骗。

e.en: The architect finally {realized} her dream museum design.
e.zh: 建筑师终于实现了她梦想中的博物馆设计。

realizes.t: v. 意识到；实现（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {realizes} now how much his parents sacrificed.
e.zh: 他现在意识到父母牺牲了多少。

e.en: The new policy {realizes} long-promised reforms.
e.zh: 新政策实现了长期承诺的改革。

realizing.t: v. 意识到；实现（进行时）

e.en: Without {realizing} it, she had become the leader.
e.zh: 她不知不觉已经成为了领导者。

e.en: He spent years {realizing} his dream of opening a bakery.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间实现开面包店的梦想。

reallocate.t: v. 重新分配（资源、资金）

e.en: The manager had to {reallocate} resources to urgent tasks.
e.zh: 经理不得不把资源重新分配给紧急任务。

e.en: We should {reallocate} the budget toward marketing.
e.zh: 我们应该把预算重新分配到营销上。

e.en: The {reallocation} of staff caused some confusion at first.
e.zh: 人员的重新分配起初引起了一些混乱。

e.en: Budget {reallocation} helped fund the new research lab.
e.zh: 预算的重新分配帮助资助了新研究室。

e.en: That movie was {really} good — you should watch it.
e.zh: 那部电影真的很好看,你应该去看看。

e.en: Do you {really} think we can finish on time?
e.zh: 你真的觉得我们能按时完成吗?

e.en: Quantum physics belongs to the {realm} of advanced science.
e.zh: 量子物理属于高级科学的领域。

e.en: The wizard ruled a magical {realm} beyond the mountains.
e.zh: 巫师统治着群山之外的魔法王国。

e.en: AI is opening new {realms} of creative possibility.
e.zh: 人工智能正在开辟创造性可能的新领域。

e.en: The fantasy series spans seven different {realms}.
e.zh: 这部奇幻系列横跨七个不同的国度。

e.en: The documentary's {realness} moved many viewers to tears.
e.zh: 这部纪录片的真实感让许多观众落泪。

e.en: I appreciate her {realness} in a world full of fakes.
e.zh: 我欣赏她在充满虚伪世界中的真实。

realpolitik.t: n. 现实政治（以利益为导向的政治策略）

e.en: His foreign policy was driven by cold {realpolitik}.
e.zh: 他的外交政策由冷酷的现实政治驱动。

e.en: Diplomats often practice {realpolitik} over moral idealism.
e.zh: 外交官常常奉行现实政治而非道德理想主义。

e.en: Our {realtor} found us a great house downtown.
e.zh: 我们的房产经纪人在市中心给我们找到一套好房。

e.en: The {realtor} scheduled three open houses this weekend.
e.zh: 房产经纪人这个周末安排了三场看房活动。

e.en: She works for a small {realty} firm in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 她在布鲁克林一家小型房地产公司工作。

e.en: The {realty} market has cooled significantly this year.
e.zh: 今年房地产市场明显降温。

ream.t:
n. 令（纸张单位，500张）
v. 铰孔；扩孔

e.en: Please order another {ream} of printer paper.
e.zh: 请再订一令打印纸。

e.en: He produced a {ream} of paperwork for the audit.
e.zh: 他为审计准备了一大堆文件。

e.en: The dentist used a tiny {reamer} during the root canal.
e.zh: 牙医在根管治疗中使用了一根细小的扩孔器。

e.en: He cleaned the orange juicer's {reamer} after use.
e.zh: 使用后他清洗了榨汁器的旋转头。

e.en: {Reaming} the pipe ensures a smooth, burr-free edge.
e.zh: 扩孔可以让管口光滑无毛刺。

e.en: The mechanic was {reaming} the cylinder to fit a new piston.
e.zh: 技工正在扩孔气缸以装入新活塞。

e.en: A {reanalysis} of the data revealed an overlooked pattern.
e.zh: 对数据的重新分析揭示了一个被忽略的模式。

e.en: The journal published a {reanalysis} of the original study.
e.zh: 期刊发表了对原研究的再分析。

e.en: Coffee can {reanimate} even the most exhausted student.
e.zh: 咖啡能让最疲惫的学生重新提起精神。

e.en: The wizard tried to {reanimate} the fallen warrior.
e.zh: 巫师试图复活倒下的战士。

e.en: The horror film centers on the {reanimation} of corpses.
e.zh: 这部恐怖片围绕着尸体的复活展开。

e.en: Scientists doubt the {reanimation} of frozen tissue is possible.
e.zh: 科学家怀疑冷冻组织的复活是否可能。

e.en: Investors hope to {reap} big rewards next year.
e.zh: 投资者希望明年获得丰厚回报。

e.en: Farmers {reap} the wheat in late summer.
e.zh: 农民在夏末收割小麦。

e.en: She {reaped} the benefits of years of hard work.
e.zh: 她收获了多年努力的成果。

e.en: The villagers {reaped} their crops before the storm hit.
e.zh: 村民们在暴风雨来临前收割了庄稼。

e.en: The {reaper} cuts wheat faster than ten workers combined.
e.zh: 这台收割机比十个工人加起来还快。

e.en: In old paintings, the grim {reaper} carries a long scythe.
e.zh: 在古画中，死神手持一把长长的镰刀。

e.en: Farmers are {reaping} the wheat before the storm arrives.
e.zh: 农民们在暴风雨来临前忙着收割小麦。

e.en: The startup is finally {reaping} the rewards of years of effort.
e.zh: 这家初创公司终于开始收获多年努力的成果。

reappear.t: v. 再次出现；重新露面

e.en: The missing files will {reappear} after you restart the app.
e.zh: 重启应用后，丢失的文件就会重新出现。

e.en: Old fashion trends often {reappear} every twenty years.
e.zh: 旧的时尚潮流往往每二十年就会再度流行。

e.en: Fans cheered the {reappearance} of their favorite character.
e.zh: 粉丝们为他们最爱的角色重新登场而欢呼。

e.en: The comet's {reappearance} excited astronomers worldwide.
e.zh: 这颗彗星的再次出现让全球天文学家兴奋不已。

reapplication.t: n. 再次申请；再次涂抹

e.en: Sunscreen needs {reapplication} every two hours at the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩上防晒霜每两小时需要重新涂抹一次。

e.en: Her visa {reapplication} was approved within a week.
e.zh: 她的签证重新申请在一周内就获批了。

reapply.t: v. 再次申请；再次涂抹

e.en: You can {reapply} for the scholarship next semester.
e.zh: 你下学期可以重新申请这个奖学金。

e.en: Remember to {reapply} sunscreen after swimming.
e.zh: 游泳后记得重新涂抹防晒霜。

e.en: The board voted to {reappoint} her as CEO for another term.
e.zh: 董事会投票决定再次任命她担任首席执行官。

e.en: The president may {reappoint} the judge next year.
e.zh: 总统明年可能会再次任命这位法官。

e.en: His {reappointment} to the committee surprised many critics.
e.zh: 他再次被任命进入委员会让许多批评者感到意外。

e.en: The professor is hoping for {reappointment} next fall.
e.zh: 这位教授希望明年秋季能获得续聘。

e.en: He passed the {REA} exam to become a registered architect.
e.zh: 他通过了REA考试,成为注册建筑师。

e.en: The {REA} brought electricity to rural America in the 1930s.
e.zh: 农村电气化管理局在1930年代把电力带到了美国乡村。

e.en: The kidneys {reabsorb} most of the water filtered each day.
e.zh: 肾脏会重新吸收每天滤出的大部分水分。

e.en: Smaller firms struggle to {reabsorb} laid-off workers quickly.
e.zh: 小公司很难迅速重新吸纳被裁的员工。

e.en: Sodium {reabsorption} occurs mainly in the kidney tubules.
e.zh: 钠的重吸收主要发生在肾小管中。

e.en: The drug blocks the {reabsorption} of serotonin in the brain.
e.zh: 这种药物会阻断大脑中血清素的再摄取。

reach.t:
v. 到达；够到；联系到
n. 范围；触及

e.en: Can you {reach} the top shelf without a stool?
e.zh: 不用凳子你能够到最高那层架子吗?

e.en: The campaign aims to {reach} younger voters online.
e.zh: 这场活动旨在通过网络触达年轻选民。

reachable.t: adj. 可到达的；可联系到的

e.en: The server is no longer {reachable} from outside the office.
e.zh: 这台服务器从办公室外部已无法访问。

e.en: Set a {reachable} goal before the end of the quarter.
e.zh: 在季度结束前设定一个可实现的目标。

reached.t: v. 到达（reach 的过去式）

e.en: They finally {reached} an agreement after six hours of talks.
e.zh: 经过六小时的谈判,他们终于达成了协议。

e.en: The hikers {reached} the summit just before sunset.
e.zh: 徒步者在日落前刚好到达山顶。

reaches.t: v. 到达（reach 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The river {reaches} its widest point near the delta.
e.zh: 这条河在三角洲附近达到最宽处。

e.en: Her podcast {reaches} listeners in over forty countries.
e.zh: 她的播客触达四十多个国家的听众。

reaching.t: v. 伸手去拿；触及（reach 的现在分词）

e.en: He hurt his shoulder {reaching} for a book on the top shelf.
e.zh: 他伸手去拿最上层的书时弄伤了肩膀。

e.en: The startup is {reaching} new users through TikTok ads.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正通过抖音广告触达新用户。

reacquaint.t: v. 使重新熟悉；再认识

e.en: The reunion helped me {reacquaint} myself with old classmates.
e.zh: 这次聚会让我得以重新与老同学熟络起来。

e.en: Take a weekend to {reacquaint} yourself with the codebase.
e.zh: 花一个周末让自己重新熟悉这套代码。

reacquire.t: v. 重新取得；再次收购

e.en: The company plans to {reacquire} shares from public investors.
e.zh: 公司计划从公众投资者手中回购股份。

e.en: The GPS took a moment to {reacquire} the signal in the tunnel.
e.zh: GPS在隧道里花了一会儿才重新捕获信号。

e.en: How did your parents {react} when you told them the news?
e.zh: 你告诉父母这个消息时,他们是怎么反应的?

e.en: Sodium and water {react} violently when combined.
e.zh: 钠和水混合时会发生剧烈反应。

e.en: Capacitive {reactance} decreases as the frequency rises.
e.zh: 容抗会随着频率的升高而减小。

e.en: Psychological {reactance} explains why people resist being told what to do.
e.zh: 心理抗拒理论解释了为什么人会反感被命令。

e.en: The slowest {reactant} controls the overall reaction rate.
e.zh: 反应速率由最慢的反应物所决定。

e.en: Add the second {reactant} only after the mixture cools.
e.zh: 等混合物冷却后再加入第二种反应物。

reacted.t: v. 作出反应（react 的过去式）

e.en: She {reacted} calmly to the surprise announcement.
e.zh: 面对突如其来的公告,她反应得很冷静。

e.en: The crowd {reacted} angrily to the referee's decision.
e.zh: 观众对裁判的判罚反应愤怒。

reacting.t: v. 正在反应（react 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {reacting} emotionally and look at the data.
e.zh: 别再情绪化地反应,看看数据吧。

e.en: The chemicals are still {reacting} inside the sealed flask.
e.zh: 密封烧瓶里的化学物质仍在持续反应。

e.en: His first {reaction} was to laugh at the awkward question.
e.zh: 他对这个尴尬的问题第一反应是笑出来。

e.en: The chemical {reaction} produced a bright orange flame.
e.zh: 这次化学反应产生了明亮的橙色火焰。

reactionary.t:
adj. 反动的；守旧的
n. 反动派

e.en: The new law was criticized as a {reactionary} step backward.
e.zh: 这条新法律被批评为开历史倒车的保守之举。

e.en: He holds {reactionary} views on women's education.
e.zh: 他对女性教育持极为保守反动的观点。

e.en: Fans posted their {reactions} to the finale online.
e.zh: 粉丝们纷纷在网上发布对大结局的反应。

e.en: Some {reactions} release energy in the form of heat.
e.zh: 有些反应会以热量的形式释放能量。

reactivate.t: v. 重新激活；恢复使用

e.en: Log in within thirty days to {reactivate} your account.
e.zh: 请在三十天内登录以重新激活你的账户。

e.en: The team hopes to {reactivate} the dormant project next quarter.
e.zh: 团队希望在下季度重启这个搁置的项目。

e.en: Click the link in the email to confirm your {reactivation}.
e.zh: 点击邮件中的链接以确认重新激活。

e.en: Stress can trigger the {reactivation} of the herpes virus.
e.zh: 压力可能导致疱疹病毒重新活化。

reactive.t: adj. 反应的；被动响应的

e.en: Our team is too {reactive} and rarely plans ahead.
e.zh: 我们团队过于被动应对,很少提前规划。

e.en: Sodium is highly {reactive} and must be stored in oil.
e.zh: 钠的化学活性很强,必须储存在油中。

e.en: Fluorine has the highest {reactivity} of all the halogens.
e.zh: 在所有卤素中,氟的反应活性最高。

e.en: React's {reactivity} model rerenders components on state change.
e.zh: React的响应式模型会在状态变化时重新渲染组件。

e.en: The nuclear {reactor} was shut down for routine maintenance.
e.zh: 这座核反应堆已停机进行例行维护。

e.en: Engineers monitor the {reactor} core temperature around the clock.
e.zh: 工程师全天候监控反应堆堆芯的温度。

reacts.t: v. 作出反应（react 的三单）

e.en: The app {reacts} instantly when you swipe across the screen.
e.zh: 在屏幕上滑动时,应用会即时作出反应。

e.en: Iron {reacts} with oxygen to form rust over time.
e.zh: 铁与氧气长时间反应会生成铁锈。

read.t:
v. 阅读；读取
n. 一次阅读

e.en: I {read} two chapters of the novel before bed.
e.zh: 我睡前读了这本小说的两章。

e.en: Please {read} the terms carefully before clicking accept.
e.zh: 请在点击同意之前仔细阅读条款。

e.en: Adding more whitespace greatly improved the code's {readability}.
e.zh: 多加些空白行让代码的可读性提升了不少。

e.en: The article scored well on standard {readability} tests.
e.zh: 这篇文章在常用可读性测试中得分不错。

e.en: Use a larger font to make the slides more {readable}.
e.zh: 用大一点的字体让幻灯片更易读。

e.en: His handwriting is barely {readable} on this old letter.
e.zh: 在这封旧信上,他的字迹几乎难以辨认。

readdress.t: v. 重新处理；改投地址

e.en: We need to {readdress} the package after the customer moved.
e.zh: 客户搬家后,我们得重新填写包裹的地址。

e.en: The committee will {readdress} the issue at next month's meeting.
e.zh: 委员会将在下月会议上重新讨论该议题。

e.en: Every {reader} brings a different perspective to the same book.
e.zh: 每位读者对同一本书都会带来不同的视角。

e.en: My e-{reader} holds hundreds of novels in one device.
e.zh: 我的电子阅读器一台就能装下数百本小说。

e.en: Loyal {readers} supported the magazine through hard times.
e.zh: 忠实读者在困难时期一直支持着这本杂志。

e.en: The author thanked her {readers} in the closing chapter.
e.zh: 作者在最后一章向她的读者们表达了感谢。

e.en: The newspaper's {readership} has doubled since going digital.
e.zh: 自从转向数字版以来,这份报纸的读者数翻了一番。

e.en: She built a loyal {readership} through her weekly newsletter.
e.zh: 她通过每周通讯积累了一批忠实读者。

e.en: Spare parts are {readily} available at any hardware store.
e.zh: 备用零件在任何五金店都能轻易买到。

e.en: He {readily} agreed to help us move on Saturday.
e.zh: 他爽快地答应周六帮我们搬家。

e.en: The drill tested the team's combat {readiness}.
e.zh: 这次演习检验了部队的作战准备状态。

e.en: Her {readiness} to learn impressed the new manager.
e.zh: 她那份乐于学习的态度让新经理印象深刻。

reading.t:
n. 阅读；读数
v. 读（read 的现在分词）

e.en: I love {reading} mystery novels on rainy weekends.
e.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的周末读侦探小说。

e.en: The thermometer's {reading} dropped overnight to below zero.
e.zh: 温度计的读数一夜之间降到了零度以下。

e.en: The sensor's {readings} fluctuate when the battery is low.
e.zh: 电池电量低时,传感器的读数会出现波动。

e.en: This week's assigned {readings} include three short essays.
e.zh: 本周布置的阅读材料包括三篇短文。

e.en: You may need to {readjust} the seat after a tall driver uses it.
e.zh: 高个子司机用过后,你可能得重新调整一下座椅。

e.en: It took weeks to {readjust} to life back home.
e.zh: 花了好几周才重新适应回到家里的生活。

e.en: Returning soldiers often face a difficult {readjustment} to civilian life.
e.zh: 退伍士兵往往面临回归平民生活的艰难调适。

e.en: A small {readjustment} to the budget kept the project on track.
e.zh: 对预算稍作调整就让项目重回正轨。

e.en: The hospital tries to reduce thirty-day {readmission} rates.
e.zh: 医院致力于降低三十天再入院率。

e.en: Her {readmission} to the program required a new application.
e.zh: 她要重新加入该项目就得提交新的申请。

e.en: Doctors had to {readmit} the patient after symptoms returned.
e.zh: 症状再次出现后,医生不得不让病人再次住院。

e.en: The college agreed to {readmit} students who took a gap year.
e.zh: 学校同意让休学一年的学生重新入学。

readout.t: n. 读数显示；数据输出

e.en: The digital {readout} showed her heart rate at ninety beats per minute.
e.zh: 数字显示屏上显示她的心率为每分钟九十次。

e.en: After the meeting, the press received a brief {readout}.
e.zh: 会议结束后,媒体收到了一份简短的会谈纪要。

reads.t:
v. 阅读（read 的三单）
n. 阅读量

e.en: My grandmother {reads} the newspaper every morning with coffee.
e.zh: 我奶奶每天早上一边喝咖啡一边读报。

e.en: The sign {reads} 'No entry after midnight.'
e.zh: 牌子上写着“午夜后禁止进入”。

e.en: Dinner is {ready}, so come to the table.
e.zh: 晚饭做好了,快来餐桌吧。

e.en: I'm not {ready} to make that decision yet.
e.zh: 我还没准备好做那个决定。

e.en: He bought a {readymade} suit for the interview.
e.zh: 他买了一套成品西装去面试。

e.en: The app offers {readymade} templates for quick designs.
e.zh: 该应用提供现成模板,方便快速设计。

e.en: The CEO {reaffirmed} the company's commitment to privacy.
e.zh: 首席执行官重申了公司对隐私的承诺。

e.en: Both leaders {reaffirm} their support for the treaty.
e.zh: 两位领导人重申支持该条约。

e.en: His speech was a {reaffirmation} of democratic values.
e.zh: 他的演讲是对民主价值观的再次确认。

e.en: The vote served as a {reaffirmation} of public trust.
e.zh: 这次投票表明了公众信任的再次确认。

e.en: {Reagan} served as president throughout the 1980s.
e.zh: 里根在整个八十年代担任总统。

e.en: Historians still debate {Reagan}'s economic legacy today.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在讨论里根的经济遗产。

e.en: His speech had a distinctly {Reaganesque} tone of optimism.
e.zh: 他的演讲带有明显里根式的乐观语调。

e.en: Critics called the tax plan strikingly {Reaganesque}.
e.zh: 评论家称这项税收方案极具里根风格。

reaganite.t:
n. 里根支持者
adj. 里根派的

e.en: She is a lifelong {Reaganite} who admires small government.
e.zh: 她是终身的里根派,推崇小政府。

e.en: The senator's policies remain firmly {Reaganite}.
e.zh: 这位参议员的政策仍然坚定地走里根路线。

e.en: The chemist added a {reagent} to test the solution.
e.zh: 化学家加入试剂来测试溶液。

e.en: This {reagent} reacts strongly with copper ions.
e.zh: 这种试剂与铜离子反应强烈。

reapportionment.t: n. 重新分配（尤指议席、名额）

e.en: The {reapportionment} of seats follows each national census.
e.zh: 每次全国人口普查后都会重新分配席位。

e.en: Budget {reapportionment} sparked heated debate in the council.
e.zh: 预算的重新分配在理事会中引发了激烈争论。

e.en: Recent events forced a {reappraisal} of company strategy.
e.zh: 最近的事件迫使公司重新评估其战略。

e.en: The artist's work is undergoing critical {reappraisal} today.
e.zh: 这位艺术家的作品如今正受到重新审视。

e.en: Managers should {reappraise} priorities at the start of each quarter.
e.zh: 管理者应在每季度开始时重新评估各项优先事项。

e.en: Historians continue to {reappraise} events from the last century.
e.zh: 历史学家持续在重新审视上个世纪的种种事件。

e.en: The {reappropriation} of funds helped save the public library.
e.zh: 资金的重新调配挽救了这家公立图书馆。

e.en: The building's {reappropriation} as a museum delighted residents.
e.zh: 这栋建筑被改作博物馆使用让居民们十分高兴。

reaps.t: v. 收获；获得（reap 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Whoever invests early often {reaps} the biggest rewards.
e.zh: 谁先投资，谁通常就能获得最大的回报。

e.en: The farmer {reaps} his corn before the first frost.
e.zh: 这位农民赶在初霜来临前收割玉米。

rear.t:
n. 后部；后方
v. 抚养；饲养

e.en: Please exit through the {rear} door of the building.
e.zh: 请从建筑物的后门离开。

e.en: They chose to {rear} their children in a small town.
e.zh: 他们选择在一个小镇上抚养孩子。

rearguard.t: n. 后卫部队；殿后部队

e.en: The {rearguard} held off enemies while the army retreated.
e.zh: 后卫部队在主力撤退时挡住了敌人的进攻。

e.en: Critics fought a {rearguard} action against the new policy.
e.zh: 批评者们对这项新政策展开了一场后卫式的抵抗。

rearing.t:
n. 抚养；饲养
v. (马) 用后腿直立

e.en: {Rearing} children in the city has unique challenges.
e.zh: 在城市里养育孩子有其独特的挑战。

e.en: The horse was {rearing} up on its hind legs in fear.
e.zh: 那匹马受惊地用后腿直立起来。

rearm.t: v. 重新武装；重整军备

e.en: The country decided to {rearm} after years of disarmament.
e.zh: 该国在多年裁军之后决定重新武装。

e.en: Soldiers had to {rearm} quickly before the next attack.
e.zh: 士兵们必须在下次攻击前迅速重新装备武器。

rearmament.t: n. 重新武装；军备重建

e.en: Neighboring countries worry about the rapid {rearmament} program.
e.zh: 邻国对这项快速重整军备的计划感到担忧。

e.en: The treaty banned any further {rearmament} in the region.
e.zh: 该条约禁止该地区进行任何进一步的重整军备。

e.en: Passengers in the {rearmost} carriage felt the bumps most.
e.zh: 最后一节车厢里的乘客感到颠簸最为明显。

e.en: She always picks the {rearmost} seat on the bus.
e.zh: 她在公交车上总是挑最后一排的座位。

rearrange.t: v. 重新安排；重新排列

e.en: Let me {rearrange} the furniture to make the room feel bigger.
e.zh: 让我重新摆放家具，让房间感觉更宽敞。

e.en: We may need to {rearrange} the meeting to next Tuesday.
e.zh: 我们可能需要把会议改到下周二。

rearranged.t: v. 重新安排（rearrange 的过去式）

e.en: She {rearranged} her closet by color last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末按颜色重新整理了衣柜。

e.en: The team {rearranged} the schedule after the storm warning.
e.zh: 团队在暴风雨预警后重新安排了日程。

rearrangement.t: n. 重新排列；重新安排

e.en: A simple {rearrangement} of icons made the app easier to use.
e.zh: 图标的简单重新排列让这款应用更易使用。

e.en: The office {rearrangement} improved teamwork and communication.
e.zh: 办公室的重新布置改善了团队合作与沟通。

rearranges.t: v. 重新排列（第三人称单数）

e.en: He constantly {rearranges} his desktop icons for productivity.
e.zh: 他不断地重新整理桌面图标以提高效率。

e.en: The algorithm {rearranges} search results based on relevance.
e.zh: 该算法会根据相关性重新排列搜索结果。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {rearranging} books on the shelves.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在重新整理书架上的书。

e.en: The manager kept {rearranging} the project timeline.
e.zh: 经理不断地在调整项目的时间表。

e.en: Police obtained a warrant for the suspect's {rearrest}.
e.zh: 警方获得了对嫌疑人重新逮捕的搜查令。

e.en: His {rearrest} came just hours after his release.
e.zh: 他在获释仅几个小时后就被再次逮捕。

rears.t:
n. 后部（复数）
v. 抚养；饲养

e.en: Anxiety often {rears} its head before big presentations.
e.zh: 在重要演讲前焦虑常常会冒出头来。

e.en: She {rears} chickens and goats on her small farm.
e.zh: 她在自己的小农场上饲养鸡和山羊。

rearticulate.t: v. 重新表述；再次阐明

e.en: The professor tried to {rearticulate} the theory in simpler words.
e.zh: 这位教授试图用更简单的话重新表述这一理论。

e.en: Leaders must {rearticulate} the mission as the company grows.
e.zh: 随着公司发展，领导者必须重新阐述其使命。

rearview.t: adj. 后视的（如后视镜 rearview mirror）

e.en: Always check your {rearview} mirror before changing lanes.
e.zh: 变道前一定要查看后视镜。

e.en: A small charm dangled from the {rearview} mirror.
e.zh: 一个小挂件挂在后视镜上摇摇晃晃。

e.en: The troops moved in a {rearward} direction to regroup.
e.zh: 部队向后方移动以便重新集结。

e.en: He glanced {rearward} to check if anyone was following.
e.zh: 他向后瞥了一眼，看看是否有人跟踪。

reason.t:
n. 原因；理由
v. 推理；思考

e.en: There is no good {reason} to skip breakfast every day.
e.zh: 没有什么好理由每天都不吃早餐。

e.en: Children gradually learn to {reason} through complex problems.
e.zh: 孩子们逐渐学会推理解决复杂的问题。

reasonable.t: adj. 合理的；通情达理的

e.en: The hotel offered a {reasonable} price for downtown.
e.zh: 这家酒店在市中心来说价格还算合理。

e.en: It seems {reasonable} to ask for a refund in this case.
e.zh: 在这种情况下要求退款似乎是合理的。

e.en: The judge praised the {reasonableness} of her response.
e.zh: 法官称赞了她回应的合情合理。

e.en: Many doubted the {reasonableness} of charging such a fee.
e.zh: 许多人怀疑收取这样一笔费用是否合理。

e.en: The new laptop is {reasonably} priced for its specs.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本以其配置而言价格还算合理。

e.en: You can {reasonably} expect a reply within two business days.
e.zh: 你可以合理地预期在两个工作日内收到回复。

reasoned.t: adj. 经过推理的；有理有据的

e.en: She gave a {reasoned} argument against the proposal.
e.zh: 她针对这项提案给出了一番有理有据的论证。

e.en: He {reasoned} that staying home would be the safest choice.
e.zh: 他推断认为待在家里会是最安全的选择。

reasoner.t: n. 推理者；讲道理的人

e.en: A clear {reasoner} can explain difficult ideas to anyone.
e.zh: 一个思路清晰的推理者能向任何人解释复杂的想法。

e.en: The AI system acts as a logical {reasoner} for the team.
e.zh: 这个人工智能系统为团队充当逻辑推理工具。

e.en: Please walk me through your {reasoning} step by step.
e.zh: 请一步一步地向我说明你的推理过程。

e.en: Modern AI models show surprising {reasoning} abilities on math.
e.zh: 现代人工智能模型在数学上展现出惊人的推理能力。

e.en: The textbook compares the {reasonings} of two famous philosophers.
e.zh: 教科书比较了两位著名哲学家的推理思路。

e.en: Different {reasonings} led the judges to similar conclusions.
e.zh: 不同的推理路径让法官们得出了相似的结论。

reasons.t:
n. 原因（复数）
v. 推理

e.en: There are several {reasons} why remote work boosts productivity.
e.zh: 远程办公提升生产力有好几个原因。

e.en: She {reasons} carefully before making any major purchase.
e.zh: 她在做任何重大购买前都会仔细思考权衡。

reassemble.t: v. 重新组装；重新集合

e.en: After cleaning, you must {reassemble} the camera carefully.
e.zh: 清洁完后，你必须小心地重新组装相机。

e.en: The team will {reassemble} in the lobby after lunch.
e.zh: 团队午餐后将在大厅重新集合。

e.en: The engine {reassembly} took the mechanic four full hours.
e.zh: 重新组装发动机花了机械师整整四个小时。

e.en: Careful labeling makes {reassembly} of the parts much easier.
e.zh: 仔细贴标签会让零件的重新组装变得容易得多。

e.en: The CEO had to {reassert} her authority after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后首席执行官不得不重新确立自己的权威。

e.en: He used the meeting to {reassert} his commitment to the project.
e.zh: 他利用这次会议重申了对项目的承诺。

e.en: The speech was a strong {reassertion} of national values.
e.zh: 这次演讲是对国家价值观的有力重申。

e.en: Her {reassertion} of the rules silenced the noisy classroom.
e.zh: 她重新强调规则后，吵闹的教室安静了下来。

e.en: Let's {reassess} the budget after the first quarter results.
e.zh: 我们等第一季度业绩出来后再重新评估预算吧。

e.en: The pandemic forced many people to {reassess} their priorities.
e.zh: 疫情迫使许多人重新审视自己的人生优先事项。

e.en: The crisis triggered a complete {reassessment} of safety procedures.
e.zh: 这次危机引发了对安全流程的全面重新评估。

e.en: A property {reassessment} could raise your annual taxes.
e.zh: 房产重新估值可能会让你每年的税款上涨。

reassign.t: v. 重新分配；重新指派

e.en: The manager will {reassign} this task to someone with more experience.
e.zh: 经理会把这项任务重新分配给更有经验的人。

e.en: You can {reassign} tickets in the project tracker with one click.
e.zh: 你可以在项目跟踪工具中一键重新分派工单。

reassignment.t: n. 重新分配；重新指派

e.en: His {reassignment} to the Tokyo office surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他被调任到东京办公室让大家都很意外。

e.en: The case {reassignment} delayed the trial by several weeks.
e.zh: 案件的重新分派让审判推迟了好几周。

reassume.t: v. 重新承担；再次担任

e.en: She will {reassume} her duties as director next month.
e.zh: 她下个月将重新担任主任的职务。

e.en: After the break, the actor {reassume} his role on stage.
e.zh: 休息过后，这位演员将重新登台扮演他的角色。

e.en: The doctor's {reassurance} helped calm the worried parents.
e.zh: 医生的安慰让焦急的家长们平静了下来。

e.en: Customers seek {reassurance} that their data is secure.
e.zh: 顾客希望得到保证，确认他们的数据是安全的。

e.en: Despite many {reassurances}, investors remained nervous about the deal.
e.zh: 尽管得到多次保证，投资者对这笔交易仍感到不安。

e.en: The CEO offered repeated {reassurances} about job security.
e.zh: 首席执行官就工作稳定问题做出了反复的保证。

e.en: Let me {reassure} you that your flight is still on time.
e.zh: 我向你保证，你的航班仍然准点。

e.en: Teachers often {reassure} students before a big exam.
e.zh: 老师们经常在大考前安抚学生的情绪。

reassured.t:
adj. 感到安心的
v. 使放心（过去式）

e.en: The doctor {reassured} the nervous patient before the surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术前安抚了紧张的病人。

e.en: I felt {reassured} after hearing the test results.
e.zh: 听到检查结果后我安心了不少。

reassures.t: v. 使放心（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {reassures} users that their data stays private.
e.zh: 该应用向用户保证他们的数据会保持私密。

e.en: A warm hug always {reassures} a crying child.
e.zh: 一个温暖的拥抱总能安慰哭泣的孩子。

reassuring.t: adj. 令人安心的；让人放心的

e.en: Her calm voice was {reassuring} during the turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机颠簸时她平静的声音让人安心。

e.en: It's {reassuring} to know the backup runs every night.
e.zh: 知道每晚都会自动备份让人很放心。

e.en: He smiled {reassuringly} as the kid stepped onto the stage.
e.zh: 孩子走上舞台时他安抚地笑了笑。

e.en: The server responded {reassuringly} fast under heavy load.
e.zh: 在高负载下服务器响应快得让人安心。

reawaken.t: v. 重新唤醒；再度激发

e.en: Travel can {reawaken} your sense of curiosity.
e.zh: 旅行能重新唤醒你的好奇心。

e.en: The old song helped {reawaken} memories of her childhood.
e.zh: 那首老歌唤起了她童年的回忆。

reawakening.t: n. 重新觉醒；再次兴起

e.en: The city is experiencing a cultural {reawakening} after the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情过后这座城市正经历文化上的复苏。

e.en: Reading her old journal felt like {reawakening} a forgotten self.
e.zh: 翻看旧日记仿佛唤醒了一个被遗忘的自己。

rebalancing.t: n. 再平衡（尤指投资组合）

e.en: The fund manager is {rebalancing} the portfolio this quarter.
e.zh: 基金经理本季度正在重新调整投资组合。

e.en: Working from home meant {rebalancing} my daily routine.
e.zh: 在家办公意味着要重新调整每天的作息。

rebarbative.t: adj. 令人厌恶的；惹人生厌的

e.en: The novel's {rebarbative} prose discouraged most casual readers.
e.zh: 这本小说艰涩的文字让多数普通读者望而却步。

e.en: He had a {rebarbative} manner that put new colleagues off.
e.zh: 他那令人反感的态度让新同事敬而远之。

rebate.t:
n. 返利；回扣
v. 返还（部分款项）

e.en: You can claim a {rebate} after submitting the receipt online.
e.zh: 在网上提交收据后即可申请退款。

e.en: The store offers a $50 {rebate} on selected appliances.
e.zh: 该店对部分家电提供五十美元的现金返还。

rebbe.t: n. 犹太教拉比；宗教导师

e.en: The young {rebbe} led prayers at the small synagogue.
e.zh: 年轻的犹太教师在小会堂带领祷告。

e.en: Families traveled far to seek the {rebbe}'s blessing.
e.zh: 许多家庭远道而来寻求拉比的祝福。

rebel.t:
n. 反叛者；造反者
v. 反抗；叛变

e.en: As a teenager she liked to {rebel} against every rule.
e.zh: 她少年时喜欢反抗每一条规矩。

e.en: The {rebel} leader called for immediate negotiations.
e.zh: 叛军领袖呼吁立即开始谈判。

e.en: The students {rebelled} when the cafeteria raised prices.
e.zh: 食堂涨价后学生们群起反抗。

e.en: My stomach {rebelled} after that spicy meal.
e.zh: 吃了那顿辣的之后我的胃开始抗议。

e.en: Teens often go through a phase of {rebelling} against parents.
e.zh: 青少年常会经历一段反抗父母的阶段。

e.en: The province is openly {rebelling} against central authority.
e.zh: 该省正公开反抗中央政府的权威。

e.en: The {rebellion} was crushed within a few weeks.
e.zh: 这场叛乱在几周内就被镇压了。

e.en: Dyeing her hair pink was a small act of {rebellion}.
e.zh: 把头发染成粉色是她的一种小小叛逆。

e.en: History books rarely mention these forgotten peasant {rebellions}.
e.zh: 历史书很少提到这些被遗忘的农民起义。

e.en: A series of {rebellions} weakened the empire's borders.
e.zh: 一连串的叛乱削弱了帝国的边境防线。

e.en: She had a {rebellious} streak even as a child.
e.zh: 她从小就有一股叛逆劲。

e.en: The band's {rebellious} lyrics resonated with young listeners.
e.zh: 乐队叛逆的歌词引起年轻听众的共鸣。

e.en: He stared {rebelliously} at the teacher and refused to apologize.
e.zh: 他叛逆地盯着老师拒绝道歉。

e.en: She {rebelliously} wore sneakers to the formal dinner.
e.zh: 她叛逆地穿着运动鞋去参加正式晚宴。

e.en: His {rebelliousness} masked a deep need for approval.
e.zh: 他的叛逆其实掩盖着对认可的渴望。

e.en: Teen {rebelliousness} is a normal part of growing up.
e.zh: 青春期的叛逆是成长中正常的一部分。

rebels.t:
n. 反叛者（复数）
v. 反抗（第三人称单数）

e.en: The {rebels} captured the radio station before dawn.
e.zh: 叛军在黎明前夺取了广播电台。

e.en: My cat {rebels} whenever I try to give her medicine.
e.zh: 每次我喂猫吃药她都会反抗。

e.en: The neighborhood is enjoying a {rebirth} after years of decline.
e.zh: 这个街区在多年衰落后正迎来新生。

e.en: Buddhists believe in cycles of death and {rebirth}.
e.zh: 佛教徒相信生死轮回。

reboot.t:
v. 重启（设备、系统）
n. 重启；重启版

e.en: Try to {reboot} your router if the WiFi keeps dropping.
e.zh: 如果WiFi老是断,试试重启路由器。

e.en: The studio announced a {reboot} of the classic franchise.
e.zh: 制片厂宣布将重启那部经典系列电影。

e.en: After the retreat she felt completely {reborn}.
e.zh: 参加完静修后她感觉脱胎换骨。

e.en: The old factory was {reborn} as a modern art museum.
e.zh: 那座旧工厂被改造成了现代艺术博物馆。

rebound.t:
v. 反弹；回升
n. 反弹；篮板球

e.en: Stock prices are expected to {rebound} next quarter.
e.zh: 预计下季度股价会反弹。

e.en: He grabbed the {rebound} and scored an easy layup.
e.zh: 他抢到篮板后轻松上篮得分。

rebounding.t:
v. 反弹；回升（进行时）
n. 抢篮板

e.en: Tourism is finally {rebounding} after the long lockdown.
e.zh: 漫长的封锁过后旅游业终于开始回暖。

e.en: She is great at {rebounding} under the basket.
e.zh: 她在篮下抢篮板很厉害。

rebounds.t:
n. 反弹；篮板（复数）
v. 反弹（第三人称单数）

e.en: He averaged twelve {rebounds} per game last season.
e.zh: 上赛季他场均抢到十二个篮板。

e.en: The economy usually {rebounds} after a short recession.
e.zh: 经济通常会在短暂衰退后反弹。

rebroadcast.t:
v. 重播
n. 重播节目

e.en: The network plans to {rebroadcast} the finale on Sunday.
e.zh: 电视台计划周日重播大结局。

e.en: You can watch the {rebroadcast} on the streaming app.
e.zh: 你可以在流媒体应用上看重播。

rebuff.t:
v. 断然拒绝；回绝
n. 回绝

e.en: She tried to chat with him but received a cold {rebuff}.
e.zh: 她想和他聊天却被冷冷地拒绝了。

e.en: The company chose to {rebuff} the takeover offer.
e.zh: 公司决定拒绝这项收购提议。

e.en: It will take years to {rebuild} the damaged neighborhood.
e.zh: 重建受损的街区需要好几年时间。

e.en: After the breakup he tried to {rebuild} his confidence.
e.zh: 分手后他努力重建自信。

e.en: He's known as a skilled engine {rebuilder} in town.
e.zh: 他在镇上以擅长翻修发动机闻名。

e.en: The coach is a true {rebuilder} of struggling teams.
e.zh: 这位教练是重振低迷球队的高手。

rebuilding.t:
v. 重建（进行时）
n. 重建工作

e.en: The team is in a {rebuilding} phase this year.
e.zh: 球队今年正处于重建阶段。

e.en: They spent two years {rebuilding} the old farmhouse.
e.zh: 他们花了两年重建那栋老农舍。

rebuilds.t:
v. 重建（第三人称单数）
n. 重建（复数）

e.en: The CI pipeline {rebuilds} the project on every push.
e.zh: 每次推送代码后CI流水线都会重新构建项目。

e.en: After each loss the coach quietly {rebuilds} morale.
e.zh: 每次失利后教练都默默重建士气。

rebuilt.t:
v. 重建（过去式/分词）
adj. 翻新的

e.en: The bridge was {rebuilt} stronger than before.
e.zh: 这座桥重建得比以前更坚固。

e.en: She {rebuilt} her career after moving to a new city.
e.zh: 搬到新城市后她重新打造了自己的事业。

rebuke.t:
v. 斥责；指责
n. 斥责

e.en: The manager issued a sharp {rebuke} for the missed deadline.
e.zh: 经理因错过截止日期而严厉训斥了员工。

e.en: Critics quickly began to {rebuke} the new policy.
e.zh: 评论人士很快开始抨击这项新政策。

e.en: The judge {rebuked} the lawyer for interrupting witnesses.
e.zh: 法官斥责律师打断证人发言。

e.en: She {rebuked} him gently for forgetting their anniversary.
e.zh: 她温和地责怪他忘记了纪念日。

rebukes.t:
v. 斥责（第三人称单数）
n. 斥责（复数）

e.en: The report contains several stinging {rebukes} of management.
e.zh: 报告中包含数处对管理层的尖锐批评。

e.en: He calmly {rebukes} anyone who jumps the line.
e.zh: 他会冷静地训斥任何插队的人。

e.en: She spent ten minutes {rebuking} the kids for the mess.
e.zh: 她花了十分钟责备孩子们把家里弄得一团糟。

e.en: The editorial is openly {rebuking} the mayor's decision.
e.zh: 这篇社论公开抨击市长的决定。

e.en: The ancient remains were given a proper {reburial} ceremony.
e.zh: 古代遗骸被重新举行了正式的安葬仪式。

e.en: Family members attended the {reburial} at the new cemetery.
e.zh: 家属们出席了在新墓地举行的迁葬仪式。

e.en: Officials decided to {rebury} the soldiers with full honors.
e.zh: 官员决定以最高礼遇重新安葬这些士兵。

e.en: The dog kept trying to {rebury} the bone in the garden.
e.zh: 那只狗一直想把骨头重新埋回花园里。

e.en: The party invitation was a clever picture {rebus}.
e.zh: 派对请帖是个巧妙的看图猜字谜。

e.en: Kids love solving a {rebus} on the back of cereal boxes.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢解麦片盒背面的字谜画。

e.en: The defense will {rebut} those claims in court tomorrow.
e.zh: 辩方明天将在法庭上反驳这些指控。

e.en: It's hard to {rebut} an argument backed by solid data.
e.zh: 要反驳有可靠数据支撑的论点很难。

rebuttable.t: adj. 可反驳的；可推翻的

e.en: The law creates a {rebuttable} presumption of innocence.
e.zh: 该法律设立了一种可被推翻的无罪推定。

e.en: His theory is {rebuttable} but worth taking seriously.
e.zh: 他的理论虽可被反驳,但值得认真对待。

e.en: Her {rebuttal} to the criticism was clear and well-sourced.
e.zh: 她对那些批评的反驳清晰且有据可查。

e.en: The debate ended with a sharp closing {rebuttal}.
e.zh: 辩论以一段犀利的结尾反驳收场。

rec.t:
n. 娱乐（recreation 的缩写）
n. 推荐（recommendation 的缩写）

e.en: We played basketball at the campus {rec} center after class.
e.zh: 下课后我们去校园活动中心打篮球。

e.en: Got any restaurant {rec} for downtown tonight?
e.zh: 今晚市中心有什么餐厅推荐吗?

e.en: The committee was frustrated by his constant {recalcitrance}.
e.zh: 委员会对他一贯的不合作感到很无奈。

e.en: The puppy's {recalcitrance} made training painfully slow.
e.zh: 小狗的倔强让训练进展异常缓慢。

e.en: The {recalcitrant} student refused to apologize to the teacher.
e.zh: 那个倔强的学生拒绝向老师道歉。

e.en: My laptop has been {recalcitrant} since the last update.
e.zh: 我的笔记本自从上次更新后就一直不听使唤。

e.en: Please {recalculate} the total after applying the discount.
e.zh: 请在使用折扣后重新计算总额。

e.en: The GPS will {recalculate} the route if you miss the turn.
e.zh: 如果你错过路口,GPS会重新规划路线。

e.en: A quick {recalculation} showed the budget was off by thousands.
e.zh: 重新核算后发现预算少算了好几千。

e.en: The tax {recalculation} resulted in a small refund.
e.zh: 重新核算税款后她拿到了一笔小额退税。

e.en: The sensor needs a {recalibration} every six months.
e.zh: 这个传感器每六个月需要重新校准一次。

e.en: The team is doing a strategic {recalibration} after the loss.
e.zh: 球队在失利后正在进行战略上的重新调整。

recall.t:
v. 召回；回想起
n. 召回；回忆

e.en: I can't {recall} where I parked the car this morning.
e.zh: 我想不起来今早把车停哪儿了。

e.en: The carmaker issued a {recall} due to faulty airbags.
e.zh: 汽车制造商因安全气囊故障发出了召回通知。

e.en: She suddenly {recalled} his name halfway through dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭吃到一半她突然想起了他的名字。

e.en: The company {recalled} thousands of contaminated products.
e.zh: 公司召回了数千件受污染的产品。

e.en: She kept {recalling} the awkward moment from yesterday's meeting.
e.zh: 她不停地回想起昨天会议上那个尴尬的瞬间。

e.en: Toyota is {recalling} thousands of cars over a brake defect.
e.zh: 丰田因刹车缺陷召回数千辆汽车。

recalls.t:
v. 召回（第三人称单数）
n. 召回（复数）

e.en: He {recalls} every detail of his first day at school.
e.zh: 他清楚记得上学第一天的每个细节。

e.en: The agency issued three product {recalls} this month.
e.zh: 该机构本月发布了三起产品召回通知。

recant.t: v. 撤回声明；公开放弃

e.en: The witness refused to {recant} her earlier testimony.
e.zh: 那位证人拒绝撤回她之前的证词。

e.en: Under pressure, the scientist had to {recant} his theory.
e.zh: 在压力之下,这位科学家不得不公开放弃自己的理论。

recantation.t: n. 公开撤回；放弃声明

e.en: The newspaper printed a full {recantation} of the false story.
e.zh: 该报刊登了对这则假新闻的完整撤回声明。

e.en: His public {recantation} surprised everyone in the community.
e.zh: 他公开撤回声明的举动让圈内所有人都很意外。

recap.t:
n. 回顾；总结
v. 概述；重述要点

e.en: Let me give you a quick {recap} of last week's episode.
e.zh: 我来给你简单回顾一下上周那集的内容。

e.en: The coach asked players to {recap} the new strategy.
e.zh: 教练让球员们复述一遍新战术。

e.en: The bank's {recapitalization} plan reassured nervous investors.
e.zh: 该银行的资本重组方案让紧张的投资者松了口气。

e.en: Analysts expect a major {recapitalization} of the airline soon.
e.zh: 分析师预计这家航空公司很快会进行大规模资本重组。

recapitalize.t: v. 重新注资；调整资本结构

e.en: The government had to {recapitalize} several struggling banks.
e.zh: 政府不得不向几家陷入困境的银行注资重组。

e.en: Founders chose to {recapitalize} the startup before going public.
e.zh: 创始人们决定在上市前对初创公司进行资本重组。

e.en: Let me {recapitulate} the main points before we vote.
e.zh: 在投票之前让我把要点再概括一下。

e.en: The professor will {recapitulate} the key concepts next class.
e.zh: 教授下节课会把关键概念再回顾一遍。

e.en: Her closing speech was a clear {recapitulation} of the argument.
e.zh: 她的结束陈词清晰地概括了整个论点。

e.en: The report ends with a brief {recapitulation} of findings.
e.zh: 报告以对研究结果的简要概括作为结尾。

recapture.t:
v. 夺回；重温
n. 再捕获

e.en: The film tries to {recapture} the magic of the original.
e.zh: 这部电影试图重现原作的魅力。

e.en: Soldiers fought for days to {recapture} the small town.
e.zh: 士兵们激战数日才重新夺回这座小镇。

recast.t: v. 重新塑造；改写；重新分配角色

e.en: The director decided to {recast} the lead role last minute.
e.zh: 导演在最后关头决定重新选角主角。

e.en: The author {recast} the novel as a young adult story.
e.zh: 作者把这部小说改写成了青少年题材作品。

e.en: News of the {recasting} disappointed many loyal fans.
e.zh: 重新选角的消息让许多忠实粉丝感到失望。

e.en: He is {recasting} the proposal to appeal to investors.
e.zh: 他正在重新调整提案以吸引投资者。

e.en: The team did a quick {recce} of the venue beforehand.
e.zh: 团队事先对场地做了一次快速踩点。

e.en: Let's {recce} the trail before bringing the whole group.
e.zh: 我们先去踩一下这条路线,再带大家来。

recede.t: v. 后退；减弱；（发际线）后移

e.en: The floodwaters began to {recede} after three days of rain.
e.zh: 连续下了三天雨之后,洪水开始消退。

e.en: His hairline started to {recede} in his early thirties.
e.zh: 他三十出头时发际线就开始后移了。

receding.t: adj. 逐渐后退的；（发际线）后移的

e.en: He worries about his {receding} hairline more than anything.
e.zh: 他最担心的就是自己日渐后退的发际线。

e.en: The boat sailed toward the {receding} shoreline at dusk.
e.zh: 小船在黄昏中驶向渐渐远去的海岸线。

receipt.t:
n. 收据；收到
v. 开收据

e.en: Please keep the {receipt} in case you want a refund.
e.zh: 请保留好收据,以备日后退款使用。

e.en: We confirm {receipt} of your application by email.
e.zh: 我们已通过邮件确认收到您的申请。

receipts.t: n. 收据（复数）；收入总额

e.en: I save all my {receipts} for tax season every year.
e.zh: 我每年都把所有收据存起来,以便报税时用。

e.en: Box office {receipts} for the film exceeded all expectations.
e.zh: 这部电影的票房收入远超所有人的预期。

receivable.t:
adj. 应收的
n. 应收账款

e.en: The accounts {receivable} balance grew sharply this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度应收账款余额大幅增长。

e.en: That invoice is still {receivable} and overdue by weeks.
e.zh: 那张发票仍未收回,而且已经逾期好几周了。

e.en: You will {receive} a confirmation email within five minutes.
e.zh: 您将在五分钟内收到一封确认邮件。

e.en: Frontline workers should {receive} better pay and recognition.
e.zh: 一线工作人员理应获得更好的薪酬和认可。

e.en: I {received} your message but haven't had time to reply.
e.zh: 我收到你的消息了,只是还没空回复。

e.en: The film {received} mostly positive reviews from critics.
e.zh: 这部电影获得了影评人大多数的正面评价。

receiver.t: n. 接收器；听筒；接收方

e.en: Pick up the {receiver} and dial nine for an outside line.
e.zh: 拿起话筒,拨九就可以拨打外线。

e.en: The wide {receiver} caught the pass and scored easily.
e.zh: 那位外接手接到传球后轻松达阵得分。

receivers.t: n. 接收器（复数）；接收方

e.en: All wireless {receivers} in the room lost signal at once.
e.zh: 房间里所有无线接收器同时失去了信号。

e.en: The team's {receivers} struggled to hold onto the ball today.
e.zh: 球队的接球手们今天接球总是脱手。

receivership.t: n. 破产管理；接管状态

e.en: The struggling retailer was placed into {receivership} last month.
e.zh: 这家苦苦支撑的零售商上月被接管清算。

e.en: Creditors hope {receivership} will recover at least some debts.
e.zh: 债权人希望接管程序至少能追回部分欠款。

receives.t: v. 接收（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our team {receives} hundreds of support tickets every day.
e.zh: 我们团队每天都会收到几百张客服工单。

e.en: The charity {receives} most of its funding from donors.
e.zh: 该慈善机构的大部分资金来自捐助者。

receiving.t:
v. 正在接收
n. 收受

e.en: I'm not {receiving} any notifications on my new phone.
e.zh: 我的新手机收不到任何通知。

e.en: Thanks for {receiving} us so warmly at the airport.
e.zh: 谢谢你们在机场如此热情地接待我们。

e.en: The algorithm weighs {recency} more heavily than total likes.
e.zh: 该算法对发布时间新近程度的权重比总点赞数更高。

e.en: Memory tests can be biased by the {recency} effect.
e.zh: 记忆测试结果可能受到近因效应的影响。

recent.t: adj. 最近的；新近发生的

e.en: Have you read any {recent} news about the merger?
e.zh: 你看过最近关于这次并购的新闻吗?

e.en: A {recent} study found coffee may improve focus slightly.
e.zh: 最近一项研究发现咖啡可能会略微提升注意力。

e.en: I've been sleeping really badly {recently} because of stress.
e.zh: 最近因为压力大,我睡眠特别差。

e.en: She {recently} moved to Berlin for a new job.
e.zh: 她最近为了一份新工作搬到了柏林。

e.en: Please drop your used cups in the {receptacle} by the door.
e.zh: 请把用过的杯子扔进门边的容器里。

e.en: Plug the cable into the wall {receptacle} on your left.
e.zh: 把线插到您左边墙上的插座里。

reception.t: n. 接待；前台；（信号）接收

e.en: Check in at the front {reception} when you arrive.
e.zh: 到达后请在前台办理登记。

e.en: The new album got a warm {reception} from fans worldwide.
e.zh: 这张新专辑受到了全球粉丝的热烈欢迎。

e.en: The {receptionist} smiled and handed me a visitor badge.
e.zh: 前台微笑着递给我一张访客证。

e.en: Ask the {receptionist} to call a taxi for you.
e.zh: 让前台帮你叫一辆出租车吧。

e.en: The hotel hired three new {receptionists} for the busy season.
e.zh: 酒店为旺季新招了三名前台接待员。

e.en: Friendly {receptionists} can really shape a guest's first impression.
e.zh: 友善的前台往往能塑造客人的第一印象。

e.en: The embassy hosts formal {receptions} every Friday evening.
e.zh: 大使馆每周五晚上都会举办正式招待会。

e.en: Both wedding {receptions} were held in the same garden.
e.zh: 两场婚礼酒会都是在同一个花园举办的。

receptive.t: adj. 乐于接受的；善于倾听的

e.en: My boss is usually {receptive} to new ideas from interns.
e.zh: 我老板通常很乐意听取实习生提出的新想法。

e.en: Try presenting the plan when she's in a {receptive} mood.
e.zh: 等她心情比较开放时再向她介绍这个方案吧。

e.en: His {receptiveness} to feedback is what makes him a great leader.
e.zh: 他对反馈的开放态度正是他成为优秀领导者的关键。

e.en: The market's {receptiveness} to electric cars keeps growing.
e.zh: 市场对电动汽车的接受度持续提升。

e.en: Her unusual {receptivity} to criticism impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 她对批评异乎寻常的接受度让整个团队都很佩服。

e.en: Cultural {receptivity} varies a lot between different regions.
e.zh: 不同地区的文化接受度差异很大。

e.en: This drug binds to a specific {receptor} on nerve cells.
e.zh: 这种药物会与神经细胞上的特定受体结合。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new pain {receptor} in the skin.
e.zh: 科学家在皮肤中发现了一种新的痛觉受体。

recertification.t: n. 重新认证；资格复审

e.en: Nurses must complete {recertification} every two years.
e.zh: 护士每两年必须完成一次资格再认证。

e.en: His pilot's license is up for {recertification} next month.
e.zh: 他的飞行执照下个月就要重新认证了。

recess.t:
n. 休会；课间休息
v. 暂停

e.en: The kids ran outside excitedly when {recess} started.
e.zh: 课间休息一开始,孩子们就兴奋地跑到了外面。

e.en: Congress will {recess} for two weeks during the holidays.
e.zh: 国会将在假期期间休会两周。

e.en: The kitchen has soft {recessed} lighting in the ceiling.
e.zh: 厨房的天花板上装着柔和的嵌入式灯。

e.en: His phone fits neatly into the {recessed} dashboard slot.
e.zh: 他的手机正好嵌进仪表盘上的凹槽里。

e.en: Strange memories surfaced from the deep {recesses} of his mind.
e.zh: 奇怪的记忆从他内心深处浮现出来。

e.en: Bats were sleeping in the dark {recesses} of the cave.
e.zh: 蝙蝠们正在洞穴深处的黑暗角落里睡觉。

e.en: Many companies froze hiring during the last {recession}.
e.zh: 上一次经济衰退期间许多公司都停止了招聘。

e.en: Economists warn another {recession} could begin next year.
e.zh: 经济学家警告说明年可能会再次出现经济衰退。

recessional.t: adj. 经济衰退的；退场的

e.en: The organist played a joyful {recessional} after the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼结束后,管风琴师演奏了一首欢快的退场曲。

e.en: Guests stood quietly during the church's solemn {recessional}.
e.zh: 宾客们在教堂庄严的退场仪式中安静地站立着。

recessionary.t: adj. 经济衰退的；引发衰退的

e.en: Investors are bracing for {recessionary} pressures in the market.
e.zh: 投资者正在为市场上的衰退压力做好准备。

e.en: Tech layoffs are a classic {recessionary} warning sign.
e.zh: 科技行业裁员是典型的经济衰退预警信号。

e.en: Past {recessions} have always been followed by strong recoveries.
e.zh: 以往的经济衰退之后总会迎来强劲的复苏。

e.en: Young workers have already lived through two {recessions}.
e.zh: 年轻打工人已经经历过两次经济衰退了。

recessive.t: adj. 隐性的（基因）；后退的

e.en: Blue eyes are caused by a {recessive} gene in humans.
e.zh: 蓝眼睛是由人类的一种隐性基因决定的。

e.en: The trait only appears when both parents carry the {recessive} allele.
e.zh: 只有父母都携带隐性等位基因时,这种性状才会显现。

e.en: I need a quiet weekend to {recharge} after this project.
e.zh: 做完这个项目后,我需要一个安静的周末好好充电。

e.en: Don't forget to {recharge} your phone before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前别忘了给手机充电。

e.en: These {rechargeable} batteries last for hundreds of cycles.
e.zh: 这些可充电电池能反复使用几百次。

e.en: Buy a {rechargeable} toothbrush instead of disposable ones.
e.zh: 建议买可充电牙刷,而不是一次性的。

recharged.t: v. 已充电；恢复精力（过去式）

e.en: She came back from vacation feeling totally {recharged}.
e.zh: 她度假回来感觉整个人都满血复活了。

e.en: I {recharged} my headphones overnight before the flight.
e.zh: 上飞机前我把耳机充了一整晚的电。

e.en: I left my phone {recharger} at the hotel by mistake.
e.zh: 我不小心把手机充电器落在酒店里了。

e.en: This universal {recharger} works with most laptop brands.
e.zh: 这款通用充电器适用于大多数品牌的笔记本电脑。

recharges.t: v. 充电（第三人称单数）

e.en: The phone {recharges} fully in about an hour.
e.zh: 这部手机大约一小时就能充满电。

e.en: A weekend hike {recharges} her energy for the work week.
e.zh: 周末徒步让她为工作周重新充满能量。

recharging.t: v. 正在充电；恢复精力

e.en: I'm {recharging} my laptop before the flight.
e.zh: 我在登机前给笔记本电脑充电。

e.en: A quiet vacation is great for {recharging} your mind.
e.zh: 安静的假期非常适合让大脑重新充电。

e.en: Please {recheck} your answers before submitting the form.
e.zh: 请在提交表格前再核对一遍答案。

e.en: The doctor scheduled a {recheck} for next month.
e.zh: 医生安排了下个月的复查。

recherche.t: adj. 精致罕见的；考究的

e.en: The menu featured {recherche} dishes from obscure regional cuisines.
e.zh: 菜单上有一些来自偏门地方菜系的精致罕见菜肴。

e.en: Her taste in jazz is famously {recherche}.
e.zh: 她对爵士乐的品味以小众讲究而闻名。

rechristen.t: v. 重新命名；再次受洗

e.en: The new owners plan to {rechristen} the old hotel next spring.
e.zh: 新业主计划明年春天为这家老酒店重新命名。

e.en: Fans began to {rechristen} the team after its dramatic rebrand.
e.zh: 在球队戏剧性地换标后,球迷们开始给它取新名字。

e.en: The program aims to reduce {recidivism} among young offenders.
e.zh: 该项目旨在降低青少年罪犯的重新犯罪率。

e.en: High {recidivism} rates suggest the prison system needs reform.
e.zh: 高再犯率表明监狱制度需要改革。

recognised.t: v. 认出；承认（recognise 的过去式）

e.en: She is widely {recognised} as a leading climate scientist.
e.zh: 她被公认为顶尖的气候科学家。

e.en: He {recognised} his old teacher in the crowded café.
e.zh: 他在拥挤的咖啡馆里认出了自己的老师。

recognises.t: v. 认出；承认（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {recognises} your face and unlocks instantly.
e.zh: 这款应用能识别你的面部并立即解锁。

e.en: Everyone {recognises} the importance of regular exercise.
e.zh: 人人都意识到定期锻炼的重要性。

recognising.t: v. 认出；承认（现在分词）

e.en: {Recognising} the danger, she stepped back from the edge.
e.zh: 意识到危险后，她从边缘退了回来。

e.en: The software is good at {recognising} handwritten digits.
e.zh: 这款软件擅长识别手写数字。

e.en: Facial {recognition} unlocks my phone in a second.
e.zh: 人脸识别一秒就能解锁我的手机。

e.en: She finally received {recognition} for her years of research.
e.zh: 她多年的研究终于获得了认可。

e.en: The festival handed out several {recognitions} to indie filmmakers.
e.zh: 电影节向独立电影人颁发了多项荣誉。

e.en: His career is full of awards and public {recognitions}.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯中获得过众多奖项和公众认可。

recognizable.t: adj. 可辨认的；易识别的

e.en: The brand's red logo is instantly {recognizable} worldwide.
e.zh: 该品牌的红色标志在全球一眼就能认出。

e.en: After the renovation, the old café was barely {recognizable}.
e.zh: 翻修之后，那家老咖啡馆几乎认不出来了。

e.en: The song is {recognizably} inspired by 80s synth-pop.
e.zh: 这首歌明显受到了80年代电子流行乐的启发。

e.en: His new style is still {recognizably} his own.
e.zh: 他的新风格仍然带有鲜明的个人印记。

e.en: The judge released him on his own {recognizance}.
e.zh: 法官准许他以个人担保的方式获释。

e.en: She signed a {recognizance} promising to appear in court.
e.zh: 她签署了具结书，承诺按时出庭。

e.en: I almost didn't {recognize} her in the photo.
e.zh: 我在照片里差点没认出她。

e.en: Companies must {recognize} the value of their employees.
e.zh: 公司必须重视员工的价值。

recognized.t:
adj. 公认的
v. 认出（过去式）

e.en: He is {recognized} as one of the top engineers in the field.
e.zh: 他被公认为该领域的顶尖工程师之一。

e.en: She instantly {recognized} the song from her childhood.
e.zh: 她一下子就认出了那首儿时的歌曲。

recognizes.t: v. 认出；承认（第三人称单数）

e.en: My phone {recognizes} my voice even in a noisy room.
e.zh: 即使在嘈杂的房间里，我的手机也能识别我的声音。

e.en: The new policy {recognizes} remote workers as full employees.
e.zh: 新政策将远程员工视为正式员工。

recognizing.t: v. 认出；承认（现在分词）

e.en: {Recognizing} a scam email can save you a lot of trouble.
e.zh: 识别诈骗邮件能为你省去不少麻烦。

e.en: The award ceremony focused on {recognizing} young talent.
e.zh: 颁奖典礼着重表彰年轻人才。

recoil.t:
v. 退缩；（枪）后坐
n. 后坐力

e.en: Many people {recoil} at the sight of spiders.
e.zh: 很多人一看到蜘蛛就吓得后退。

e.en: The rifle's {recoil} bruised his shoulder badly.
e.zh: 步枪的后坐力把他的肩膀撞得淤青。

e.en: Soldiers fired the {recoilless} rifle from the rooftop.
e.zh: 士兵们在屋顶上发射了无后坐力炮。

e.en: The factory specializes in {recoilless} weapon systems.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门生产无后坐力武器系统。

e.en: I can't {recollect} where I left my keys.
e.zh: 我想不起来钥匙放哪儿了。

e.en: Try to {recollect} exactly what he said at the meeting.
e.zh: 试着回忆一下他在会上到底说了什么。

e.en: She {recollected} her grandmother's stories with a smile.
e.zh: 她带着微笑回忆起祖母讲的故事。

e.en: He {recollected} the events of that night in vivid detail.
e.zh: 他生动地回想起那晚发生的种种细节。

e.en: She sat by the window, {recollecting} her college days.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边，回想起大学时光。

e.en: He paused, {recollecting} the name of his old neighbor.
e.zh: 他停顿了一下，努力回忆老邻居的名字。

e.en: I have no {recollection} of meeting him before.
e.zh: 我完全不记得以前见过他。

e.en: Her {recollection} of the accident was surprisingly clear.
e.zh: 她对那场事故的记忆出奇地清晰。

e.en: His memoir is full of warm {recollections} of childhood summers.
e.zh: 他的回忆录里满是儿时夏天的温馨记忆。

e.en: Her {recollections} of the war differ from the official record.
e.zh: 她对那场战争的回忆与官方记录有出入。

recollects.t: v. 回忆（第三人称单数）

e.en: He fondly {recollects} the summers spent at his grandparents' farm.
e.zh: 他深情地回忆起在祖父母农场度过的那些夏天。

e.en: She {recollects} every detail of their first conversation.
e.zh: 她记得他们第一次交谈的每一个细节。

e.en: Wolves' {recolonization} of the park surprised the rangers.
e.zh: 狼群重新定居公园让护林员们大吃一惊。

e.en: The study tracks the {recolonization} of forests after wildfires.
e.zh: 该研究追踪森林在野火过后的重新定居过程。

e.en: Native plants are starting to {recolonize} the burned hillside.
e.zh: 本地植物开始重新在烧过的山坡上生长。

e.en: Beavers have begun to {recolonize} rivers across the country.
e.zh: 河狸已开始在全国各地的河流中重新定居。

recombinant.t:
adj. 基因重组的
n. 重组体

e.en: The vaccine uses {recombinant} DNA technology to trigger immunity.
e.zh: 该疫苗利用重组DNA技术来激发免疫反应。

e.en: Scientists produce insulin from {recombinant} bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家用重组细菌生产胰岛素。

e.en: Genetic {recombination} creates diversity among offspring.
e.zh: 基因重组造就了后代之间的多样性。

e.en: The virus evolves rapidly through frequent {recombination}.
e.zh: 该病毒通过频繁的基因重组迅速演化。

e.en: DJs {recombine} familiar samples to create fresh tracks.
e.zh: DJ们把熟悉的采样重新组合，做出全新的曲子。

e.en: Chromosomes {recombine} during cell division to mix genes.
e.zh: 染色体在细胞分裂时重组以混合基因。

e.en: Talks will {recommence} after the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 谈判将在假期周末后重新开始。

e.en: Construction is expected to {recommence} next month.
e.zh: 工程预计下个月恢复施工。

e.en: I'd {recommend} this restaurant to anyone visiting Tokyo.
e.zh: 我会向所有来东京的人推荐这家餐厅。

e.en: Doctors {recommend} drinking plenty of water every day.
e.zh: 医生建议每天多喝水。

recommendable.t: adj. 可推荐的；值得推荐的

e.en: The hotel was clean, friendly, and highly {recommendable}.
e.zh: 这家酒店干净又热情，非常值得推荐。

e.en: Few places in town are as {recommendable} as this bakery.
e.zh: 镇上没几家店像这间面包房这样值得推荐。

e.en: On my friend's {recommendation}, I tried the new ramen shop.
e.zh: 在朋友的推荐下，我去试了那家新拉面店。

e.en: The doctor's {recommendation} was to rest for a week.
e.zh: 医生的建议是休息一周。

e.en: Netflix's {recommendations} usually match my taste pretty well.
e.zh: Netflix的推荐内容通常很合我的口味。

e.en: The report includes several {recommendations} for improving safety.
e.zh: 报告中包含了若干提升安全性的建议。

recommended.t:
adj. 推荐的
v. 推荐（过去式）

e.en: The doctor {recommended} more sleep and less caffeine.
e.zh: 医生建议多睡觉、少喝咖啡。

e.en: This book is highly {recommended} for first-time programmers.
e.zh: 这本书非常推荐给编程新手阅读。

e.en: I'm {recommending} this app to everyone I know.
e.zh: 我正在向所有认识的人推荐这款应用。

e.en: The teacher is {recommending} extra reading for advanced students.
e.zh: 老师在为优秀学生推荐课外阅读材料。

recommends.t: v. 推荐（第三人称单数）

e.en: The chef {recommends} the seasonal tasting menu.
e.zh: 主厨推荐当季的品鉴套餐。

e.en: The algorithm {recommends} videos based on what you've watched.
e.zh: 算法会根据你看过的内容推荐视频。

recommit.t: v. 重新提交；再次承诺

e.en: The team decided to {recommit} to the original deadline.
e.zh: 团队决定重新承诺按原定截止日期完成。

e.en: After the retreat, leaders chose to {recommit} to the mission.
e.zh: 团建结束后，领导层选择重新投身于这项使命。

recommitment.t: n. 再次承诺；重新委托

e.en: The CEO announced a {recommitment} to clean energy goals.
e.zh: 首席执行官宣布将再次致力于清洁能源目标。

e.en: Their {recommitment} to the project surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他们对该项目的重新投入让所有人都感到意外。

recompense.t:
v. 补偿；报酬
n. 赔偿

e.en: The airline offered vouchers as {recompense} for the delay.
e.zh: 航空公司提供代金券作为延误的补偿。

e.en: She worked overtime with little {recompense}.
e.zh: 她经常加班，却几乎得不到补偿。

e.en: He paused to {recompose} himself before the speech.
e.zh: 演讲前他停下来重新整理了一下情绪。

e.en: The artist had to {recompose} the photo after cropping.
e.zh: 裁剪之后，摄影师不得不重新构图。

e.en: Body {recomposition} means losing fat while gaining muscle.
e.zh: 身体重塑指的是在减脂的同时增肌。

e.en: The album's {recomposition} took the producer six months.
e.zh: 这张专辑的重新编曲花了制作人六个月。

e.en: The team did some {recon} before the big presentation.
e.zh: 团队在大型演示前做了一些前期侦察。

e.en: Soldiers ran a quick {recon} of the abandoned village.
e.zh: 士兵们对那座废弃村庄进行了快速侦查。

e.en: The paper proposes a {reconceptualization} of urban poverty.
e.zh: 这篇论文提出了对城市贫困问题的重新概念化。

e.en: His talk pushed for a {reconceptualization} of leadership.
e.zh: 他的演讲呼吁重新定义领导力的概念。

reconcilable.t: adj. 可调和的；可和解的

e.en: The two accounts are not easily {reconcilable}.
e.zh: 这两份说法很难调和一致。

e.en: Their differences proved {reconcilable} after a long talk.
e.zh: 经过长谈，他们的分歧最终得以化解。

e.en: It's hard to {reconcile} his words with his actions.
e.zh: 很难把他说的话和做的事联系起来。

e.en: The couple decided to {reconcile} after months apart.
e.zh: 分开几个月后，这对夫妇决定和好。

reconciled.t:
adj. 和解的
v. 调和（过去式）

e.en: She finally {reconciled} with her brother after years of silence.
e.zh: 沉默多年后，她终于和哥哥和解了。

e.en: The accountant {reconciled} the books before the audit.
e.zh: 会计在审计前核对了账目。

reconciles.t: v. 调和；使和解（第三人称单数）

e.en: This software automatically {reconciles} bank statements with invoices.
e.zh: 这款软件会自动核对银行对账单和发票。

e.en: Her theory {reconciles} two seemingly contradictory findings.
e.zh: 她的理论调和了两个看似矛盾的研究发现。

e.en: The {reconciliation} between the two friends took several months.
e.zh: 两位朋友之间的和解花了几个月时间。

e.en: Monthly bank {reconciliation} helps catch accounting errors early.
e.zh: 每月的银行对账有助于尽早发现账目错误。

e.en: The accountant performs daily {reconciliations} of the company's accounts.
e.zh: 会计每天对公司账目进行核对。

e.en: Several {reconciliations} between estranged family members happened at the reunion.
e.zh: 聚会上,几对疏远的家人重归于好。

e.en: She is {reconciling} the invoice totals with the bank statements.
e.zh: 她正在核对发票总额与银行对账单。

e.en: The couple are slowly {reconciling} after months of separation.
e.zh: 这对夫妇在分居数月后正慢慢和好。

e.en: The professor's lecture was full of {recondite} mathematical concepts.
e.zh: 教授的讲座里满是深奥的数学概念。

e.en: He has a fondness for {recondite} topics that few people understand.
e.zh: 他偏爱那些少有人懂的冷僻话题。

e.en: The shop will {recondition} old laptops and resell them online.
e.zh: 这家店会翻新旧笔记本电脑然后在网上转售。

e.en: You can {recondition} a car battery to extend its life.
e.zh: 你可以修复汽车电池以延长其使用寿命。

e.en: I bought a {reconditioned} iPhone for half the original price.
e.zh: 我以原价一半的钱买了一部翻新版苹果手机。

e.en: The mechanic {reconditioned} the engine before selling the car.
e.zh: 修理工在卖车前对发动机进行了翻新。

e.en: The judge described him as a hardened {recidivist}.
e.zh: 法官形容他是一个屡教不改的惯犯。

e.en: Most of the inmates are {recidivist} offenders with long records.
e.zh: 大多数囚犯都是有长期前科的惯犯。

recipe.t:
n. 食谱；配方
n. 秘诀

e.en: This {recipe} only takes twenty minutes to make.
e.zh: 这道食谱只需要二十分钟就能做好。

e.en: Working without sleep is a {recipe} for disaster.
e.zh: 不睡觉地工作是自找麻烦的方法。

e.en: She saves all her favorite {recipes} on her phone.
e.zh: 她把所有喜欢的食谱都存在手机里。

e.en: The blog shares simple weeknight dinner {recipes}.
e.zh: 这个博客分享简单的工作日晚餐食谱。

e.en: Make sure the email {recipient} address is correct.
e.zh: 请确认邮件收件人的地址正确无误。

e.en: She was the youngest {recipient} of the science award.
e.zh: 她是这项科学奖项最年轻的获奖者。

recipients.t: n. 接收者；收件人（复数）

e.en: All scholarship {recipients} will be notified by email.
e.zh: 所有奖学金获得者都将通过电子邮件收到通知。

e.en: The message was sent to over a thousand {recipients}.
e.zh: 这条消息被发送给了一千多名收件人。

reciprocal.t:
adj. 相互的；互惠的
n. 倒数

e.en: The two countries signed a {reciprocal} trade agreement.
e.zh: 两国签署了一项互惠贸易协定。

e.en: Friendship requires {reciprocal} trust and respect.
e.zh: 友谊需要相互的信任与尊重。

e.en: The two universities {reciprocally} recognize each other's degrees.
e.zh: 两所大学相互承认彼此的学位。

e.en: Members of the club support one another {reciprocally}.
e.zh: 俱乐部成员之间相互支持。

e.en: She didn't {reciprocate} his romantic feelings.
e.zh: 她没有回应他的爱意。

e.en: If someone helps you, try to {reciprocate} the favor.
e.zh: 如果有人帮了你,试着回报这份人情。

e.en: He smiled, and she {reciprocated} with a small wave.
e.zh: 他微笑了一下,她也回以轻轻的一挥手。

e.en: Her kindness was warmly {reciprocated} by the whole team.
e.zh: 她的善意得到了整个团队的热情回报。

reciprocating.t:
v. 回报（进行时）
adj. 往复的

e.en: The engine uses a {reciprocating} piston to generate power.
e.zh: 这台发动机利用往复式活塞来产生动力。

e.en: He thanked her without {reciprocating} the compliment.
e.zh: 他向她道了谢,但没有回赞她。

e.en: Healthy relationships are built on {reciprocation} of effort.
e.zh: 健康的关系建立在彼此付出与回报之上。

e.en: She gave a gift with no expectation of {reciprocation}.
e.zh: 她送出礼物时并不指望对方回礼。

e.en: International trade often relies on the principle of {reciprocity}.
e.zh: 国际贸易常常依赖于互惠原则。

e.en: Friendships thrive on {reciprocity} and shared trust.
e.zh: 友谊在相互回馈和共同信任中才能长久。

e.en: The air conditioner can {recirculate} cabin air on hot days.
e.zh: 空调在炎热的日子里可以让车内空气循环使用。

e.en: Old rumors tend to {recirculate} on social media.
e.zh: 老掉牙的谣言总是在社交媒体上反复流传。

e.en: The water is filtered and then {recirculated} through the system.
e.zh: 水经过过滤后,再次在系统中循环使用。

e.en: That outdated meme has been {recirculated} online for years.
e.zh: 那个过时的梗已经在网上反复流传了好多年。

e.en: The fan is quietly {recirculating} warm air in the room.
e.zh: 风扇正在房间里静静地让暖空气循环流动。

e.en: News outlets keep {recirculating} the same few photos.
e.zh: 新闻媒体不停地重复使用那几张相同的照片。

e.en: Press this button to enable cabin air {recirculation}.
e.zh: 按下这个按钮就能开启车内空气循环。

e.en: Poor {recirculation} of coolant caused the engine to overheat.
e.zh: 冷却液循环不畅导致发动机过热。

e.en: The buyer demanded {recision} of the unfair contract.
e.zh: 买方要求撤销这份不公平的合同。

e.en: The court ordered the {recision} of the disputed sale.
e.zh: 法院下令撤销这笔有争议的交易。

recital.t:
n. 独奏会；朗诵会
n. 详述

e.en: Her piano {recital} drew a packed audience last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚的钢琴独奏会吸引了满座的观众。

e.en: The speech became a long {recital} of past grievances.
e.zh: 那篇讲话变成了一长串对过往不满的列举。

e.en: The students gave a {recitation} of the famous poem.
e.zh: 学生们朗诵了那首著名的诗。

e.en: His reply was a tired {recitation} of company policy.
e.zh: 他的回答只是疲惫地把公司规定背了一遍。

e.en: Weekly poetry {recitations} are part of the curriculum.
e.zh: 每周的诗歌朗诵是课程的一部分。

e.en: Her {recitations} of the law impressed the entire jury.
e.zh: 她对法律条文的复述令整个陪审团印象深刻。

e.en: The opera opens with a slow, mournful {recitative}.
e.zh: 这部歌剧以一段缓慢哀伤的宣叙调开场。

e.en: Mozart's {recitative} sections move the plot quickly forward.
e.zh: 莫扎特的宣叙调段落让剧情迅速推进。

e.en: Can you {recite} the entire poem from memory?
e.zh: 你能凭记忆把整首诗背出来吗?

e.en: He had to {recite} his ID number to the agent.
e.zh: 他不得不把身份证号码报给客服人员。

e.en: She {recited} her wedding vows with a trembling voice.
e.zh: 她用颤抖的声音念出了结婚誓词。

e.en: The child proudly {recited} the multiplication tables.
e.zh: 那孩子自豪地把乘法表背了一遍。

recites.t: v. 背诵（第三人称单数）

e.en: Every morning he {recites} a short prayer before breakfast.
e.zh: 每天早上他都会在早饭前念一段简短的祷文。

e.en: She {recites} her shopping list aloud to remember it.
e.zh: 她大声念出购物清单以便记住。

e.en: The actor was {reciting} Shakespeare in the empty theater.
e.zh: 那位演员在空荡的剧院里朗诵莎士比亚的台词。

e.en: Stop {reciting} excuses and just admit the mistake.
e.zh: 别再一直找借口了,直接承认错误吧。

reckless.t: adj. 鲁莽的；不顾后果的

e.en: He was fined for {reckless} driving on the highway.
e.zh: 他因在高速公路上鲁莽驾驶被罚款。

e.en: Investing all your savings in one stock is {reckless}.
e.zh: 把全部积蓄投到一只股票上是非常鲁莽的。

recklessly.t: adv. 鲁莽地；不顾后果地

e.en: She spent money {recklessly} during her first month abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外的第一个月里毫无节制地花钱。

e.en: The driver swerved {recklessly} between lanes at high speed.
e.zh: 司机以高速在车道间鲁莽地变道。

e.en: His {recklessness} on the road eventually cost him his license.
e.zh: 他在路上的鲁莽行为最终让他丢了驾照。

e.en: The report blamed the accident on managerial {recklessness}.
e.zh: 报告将事故归咎于管理层的轻率行事。

reckon.t:
v. 认为；估计
v. 计算

e.en: I {reckon} we'll get there before sunset.
e.zh: 我估计我们会在日落前到达那里。

e.en: You have to {reckon} with rising costs when budgeting.
e.zh: 做预算时,你必须把不断上涨的成本考虑进去。

e.en: By my {reckoning}, the project is two weeks behind schedule.
e.zh: 按我的估算,这个项目落后了两周进度。

e.en: The company faces a financial {reckoning} after years of losses.
e.zh: 在连年亏损之后,公司面临着一次财务上的清算。

reckonned.t: v. reckon 的非标准拼写

e.en: He {reckonned} the bill came to about fifty dollars.
e.zh: 他估算账单大约是五十美元。

e.en: She {reckonned} without the heavy traffic on the bridge.
e.zh: 她没把大桥上的拥堵交通考虑进去。

reckonning.t: v. reckoning 的非标准拼写

e.en: He sat at the table {reckonning} the month's expenses.
e.zh: 他坐在桌前算着这个月的开支。

e.en: Without {reckonning} the tax, the price seems quite low.
e.zh: 如果不把税算进去,这个价格看起来相当便宜。

reckons.t: v. 认为；估计（第三人称单数）

e.en: My dad {reckons} the storm will hit by midnight.
e.zh: 我爸觉得暴风雨在午夜前就会来临。

e.en: She {reckons} herself among the best players on the team.
e.zh: 她自认为是队里最好的球员之一。

reclaim.t:
v. 取回；找回
v. 开垦（土地）

e.en: You can {reclaim} your lost luggage at counter three.
e.zh: 你可以到三号柜台领回丢失的行李。

e.en: The community is working to {reclaim} the abandoned park.
e.zh: 社区正在努力重新利用这座废弃的公园。

reclaimed.t:
v. 取回（过去式）
adj. 再生的

e.en: The table is built from {reclaimed} barn wood.
e.zh: 这张桌子是用回收的旧谷仓木料制成的。

e.en: She finally {reclaimed} the deposit from her old landlord.
e.zh: 她终于从前房东那里要回了押金。

e.en: They are {reclaiming} farmland from the encroaching desert.
e.zh: 他们正在从不断蔓延的沙漠中开垦回农田。

e.en: She is slowly {reclaiming} her confidence after the setback.
e.zh: 经历挫折之后,她正在慢慢找回自信。

reclaims.t: v. 取回（第三人称单数）

e.en: The author {reclaims} the slur as a badge of pride.
e.zh: 这位作家把那个侮辱性词语重新赋予自豪的含义。

e.en: She quietly {reclaims} her time by turning off notifications.
e.zh: 她通过关闭通知,悄悄地把时间夺了回来。

e.en: The land {reclamation} project will take several years to finish.
e.zh: 这项土地开垦工程需要几年才能完成。

e.en: They run a furniture {reclamation} business near the harbor.
e.zh: 他们在港口附近经营一家旧家具回收公司。

e.en: The {reclassification} of the document made it public at last.
e.zh: 该文件的重新分类终于使其得以公开。

e.en: Drivers worry about the {reclassification} of their employment status.
e.zh: 司机们担心自己的雇佣身份被重新归类。

e.en: The agency may {reclassify} the species as endangered.
e.zh: 该机构可能会把这一物种重新归类为濒危。

e.en: Companies sometimes {reclassify} workers as independent contractors.
e.zh: 公司有时会把员工重新归类为独立承包人。

e.en: You can {recline} your seat once we reach cruising altitude.
e.zh: 飞机到达巡航高度后,你就可以把座椅放倒了。

e.en: She likes to {recline} on the couch after a long day.
e.zh: 她喜欢在忙碌一天后斜躺在沙发上。

e.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his favorite leather {recliner}.
e.zh: 爷爷在他最爱的皮制躺椅上睡着了。

e.en: They bought a massage {recliner} for the living room.
e.zh: 他们给客厅买了一把按摩躺椅。

reclining.t:
v. 斜躺（进行时）
adj. 可斜倚的

e.en: The cat was {reclining} lazily on the warm windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫懒洋洋地斜躺在温暖的窗台上。

e.en: All the seats in this theater are fully {reclining}.
e.zh: 这家影院的所有座椅都可以完全后仰。

e.en: After fame faded, the singer became a quiet {recluse}.
e.zh: 名气褪去之后,这位歌手成了一个安静的隐居者。

e.en: The old {recluse} hadn't left his cabin in years.
e.zh: 那位年迈的隐士已经多年没离开过他的小屋。

e.en: The mountain village is home to several elderly {recluses}.
e.zh: 那座山村里住着几位年迈的隐士。

e.en: Famous {recluses} often refuse interviews and avoid public events.
e.zh: 著名的隐居者通常拒绝采访，回避公开活动。

e.en: The author became {reclusive} after his novel went viral.
e.zh: 小说爆红后，那位作者变得深居简出。

e.en: She lives a {reclusive} life in a cabin upstate.
e.zh: 她在州北部的小木屋里过着隐居生活。

recode.t: v. 重新编码；改写代码

e.en: We had to {recode} the entire module after the API changed.
e.zh: 接口变更后，我们不得不重写整个模块。

e.en: Researchers {recode} survey responses into numeric categories.
e.zh: 研究人员把问卷答案重新编码为数字类别。

recognisable.t: adj. 可识别的；可辨认的

e.en: Her voice is instantly {recognisable} on the radio.
e.zh: 她的声音在电台里一听就能辨出。

e.en: The logo is {recognisable} even from across the street.
e.zh: 那个标志即使从街对面也清晰可辨。

e.en: The remake is {recognisably} based on the original film.
e.zh: 这部翻拍片明显改编自原作。

e.en: His handwriting is {recognisably} different from his brother's.
e.zh: 他的笔迹与他哥哥的明显不同。

recognise.t: v. 识别；认出（英式拼写）

e.en: I didn't {recognise} you with the new haircut.
e.zh: 你换了发型，我都没认出你来。

e.en: The court refused to {recognise} the foreign marriage.
e.zh: 法院拒绝承认这桩外国婚姻。

e.en: The dashboard widgets are fully {reconfigurable} to suit each user.
e.zh: 仪表盘的小部件可完全自定义以适应每位用户。

e.en: FPGAs are {reconfigurable} chips used in many modern devices.
e.zh: FPGA 是用于许多现代设备的可重新配置芯片。

reconfiguration.t: n. 重新配置；重新设置

e.en: The network outage forced a complete {reconfiguration} of the servers.
e.zh: 网络中断迫使服务器进行了彻底的重新配置。

e.en: After the merger, a major team {reconfiguration} was announced.
e.zh: 合并之后,公司宣布了一次重大的团队重组。

reconfigure.t: v. 重新配置（系统、设备）

e.en: You may need to {reconfigure} your router after the firmware update.
e.zh: 固件更新后你可能需要重新配置路由器。

e.en: Let me {reconfigure} the layout to fit smaller screens.
e.zh: 让我重新调整布局以适配较小的屏幕。

reconfigured.t: v. 重新配置（reconfigure 的过去式）

e.en: The IT team {reconfigured} the firewall to block suspicious traffic.
e.zh: IT 团队重新配置了防火墙以阻止可疑流量。

e.en: We {reconfigured} the office to support hybrid work.
e.zh: 我们重新布置了办公室以支持混合办公。

reconfirm.t: v. 再次确认；重新确认

e.en: Please {reconfirm} your flight twenty-four hours before departure.
e.zh: 请在起飞前二十四小时再次确认您的航班。

e.en: Can you {reconfirm} the meeting time by email?
e.zh: 你能通过邮件再确认一下会议时间吗?

e.en: The hotel sent a {reconfirmation} of my booking yesterday.
e.zh: 酒店昨天发来了我的预订再次确认函。

e.en: We need {reconfirmation} from the client before proceeding.
e.zh: 我们需要客户再次确认后才能继续。

e.en: The drone was sent on a {reconnaissance} mission over the border.
e.zh: 这架无人机被派往边境执行侦察任务。

e.en: They did some {reconnaissance} of the venue before the event.
e.zh: 他们在活动前对场地进行了实地察看。

reconnect.t: v. 重新连接（网络、设备）

e.en: Try to {reconnect} to the Wi-Fi if the page won't load.
e.zh: 如果页面加载不出来,试着重新连接 Wi-Fi。

e.en: The app helped me {reconnect} with old high school friends.
e.zh: 这款应用帮我重新联系上了高中时的老朋友。

e.en: The {reconnection} fee for the internet service was waived.
e.zh: 网络服务的重新接通费被免除了。

e.en: Their {reconnection} after years apart felt surprisingly natural.
e.zh: 分别多年后,他们的重逢感觉出乎意料地自然。

e.en: Scouts were sent ahead to {reconnoiter} the enemy positions.
e.zh: 侦察兵被派往前方侦察敌军阵地。

e.en: Let's {reconnoiter} the trail before bringing the whole group.
e.zh: 我们先去探一下这条小路,然后再带整队人来。

reconnoitre.t: v. 侦察；勘察（英式拼写）

e.en: The patrol left at dawn to {reconnoitre} the valley.
e.zh: 巡逻队黎明出发去侦察山谷。

e.en: We sent a small team to {reconnoitre} the campsite.
e.zh: 我们派了一支小队去察看营地。

e.en: The general vowed to {reconquer} the lost territory within a year.
e.zh: 将军誓言要在一年内重新夺回失地。

e.en: The brand hopes to {reconquer} younger consumers with this redesign.
e.zh: 该品牌希望借这次改版重新赢回年轻消费者。

e.en: I'd urge you to {reconsider} before quitting your job.
e.zh: 我劝你在辞职前再考虑一下。

e.en: The board will {reconsider} the proposal at next month's meeting.
e.zh: 董事会将在下月的会议上重新考虑这项提案。

e.en: She filed a motion for {reconsideration} of the court's decision.
e.zh: 她提交了请求法院重新考虑判决的动议。

e.en: On {reconsideration}, I think we should accept the offer.
e.zh: 再三考虑后,我觉得我们应该接受这个提议。

reconsidered.t: v. 重新考虑（reconsider 的过去式）

e.en: After hearing her arguments, he {reconsidered} his position.
e.zh: 听了她的论点后,他重新考虑了自己的立场。

e.en: The committee {reconsidered} the application and approved it.
e.zh: 委员会重新审议了申请并予以批准。

e.en: I'm {reconsidering} whether to move to Shanghai for the new job.
e.zh: 我在重新考虑是否要为新工作搬去上海。

e.en: The company is {reconsidering} its return-to-office policy.
e.zh: 公司正在重新考虑其重返办公室的政策。

reconsiders.t: v. 重新考虑（第三人称单数）

e.en: He often {reconsiders} his choices late at night.
e.zh: 他常在深夜重新审视自己的选择。

e.en: If the manager {reconsiders}, we might still get the budget.
e.zh: 如果经理重新考虑,我们也许还能拿到预算。

reconstitute.t: v. 重组；复原；（加水）还原

e.en: Add water to {reconstitute} the powdered milk before drinking.
e.zh: 喝之前加水将奶粉冲调还原。

e.en: The team plans to {reconstitute} the original product line.
e.zh: 团队计划重组原来的产品线。

e.en: The juice is made from {reconstituted} concentrate, not fresh fruit.
e.zh: 这种果汁是用浓缩液还原制成的,而非鲜果榨取。

e.en: The committee was {reconstituted} with new members last week.
e.zh: 该委员会上周由新成员重新组建。

e.en: The vaccine requires careful {reconstitution} with sterile water.
e.zh: 这种疫苗需要用无菌水仔细稀释还原。

e.en: The company announced the {reconstitution} of its leadership team.
e.zh: 公司宣布对其领导团队进行重组。

reconstruct.t: v. 重建；还原（场景、数据）

e.en: Detectives tried to {reconstruct} the events of that night.
e.zh: 侦探们试图还原那晚发生的事件。

e.en: Engineers will {reconstruct} the bridge after the flood damage.
e.zh: 工程师将在洪灾过后重建这座桥。

reconstructed.t: v. 重建（reconstruct 的过去式）

e.en: The museum {reconstructed} the ancient temple from old photographs.
e.zh: 博物馆根据旧照片重建了那座古庙。

e.en: Police {reconstructed} the crime scene to find new clues.
e.zh: 警方重建了犯罪现场以寻找新线索。

e.en: The post-war {reconstruction} took nearly two decades to complete.
e.zh: 战后重建花了将近二十年才完成。

e.en: She had facial {reconstruction} surgery after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她做了面部重建手术。

e.en: The historian took a {reconstructionist} approach to the medieval text.
e.zh: 这位历史学家对这部中世纪文本采取了重构主义的方法。

e.en: He's a {reconstructionist} who tries to recreate ancient cooking methods.
e.zh: 他是一位致力于重现古代烹饪方法的复原主义者。

e.en: The exhibit features digital {reconstructions} of lost Roman buildings.
e.zh: 展览展示了已消失罗马建筑的数字复原图。

e.en: Several {reconstructions} of the dinosaur's appearance have been proposed.
e.zh: 关于这种恐龙外形的几种复原方案已被提出。

e.en: He underwent {reconstructive} surgery after the car accident.
e.zh: 车祸后他接受了重建手术。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {reconstructive} dentistry for trauma patients.
e.zh: 该诊所专攻为创伤患者提供口腔重建治疗。

e.en: The exhibit's {recontextualization} of colonial art sparked heated debate.
e.zh: 展览对殖民艺术的重新语境化引发了激烈争论。

e.en: Memes thrive on the {recontextualization} of familiar images.
e.zh: 表情包靠的就是把熟悉图像重新放进新语境。

e.en: The committee will {reconvene} after the lunch break.
e.zh: 委员会将在午休后重新召开会议。

e.en: Let's {reconvene} tomorrow once everyone has reviewed the report.
e.zh: 等大家都看过报告后,我们明天再聚起来讨论。

e.en: The factory's {reconversion} from military to civilian use took years.
e.zh: 这家工厂从军用转为民用花了好几年时间。

e.en: Currency {reconversion} fees can eat into your travel budget.
e.zh: 货币换回的手续费可能会蚕食你的旅行预算。

e.en: You can {reconvert} the PDF back into an editable Word file.
e.zh: 你可以把这份 PDF 再转换回可编辑的 Word 文件。

e.en: The owner plans to {reconvert} the loft into office space.
e.zh: 业主打算把这间阁楼再改造成办公空间。

e.en: Please {recopy} the notes more neatly before submitting them.
e.zh: 请把笔记重新誊写得更工整些再交上来。

e.en: I had to {recopy} the file because the first one was corrupted.
e.zh: 我不得不重新复制这个文件,因为第一份损坏了。

record.t:
v. 记录；录制
n. 记录；唱片

e.en: She set a new world {record} in the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中创造了新的世界纪录。

e.en: Tap the red button to {record} a voice memo.
e.zh: 点一下红色按钮就能录一段语音备忘。

recordable.t: adj. 可记录的；可录制的

e.en: Make sure you buy {recordable} discs, not read-only ones.
e.zh: 记得买可刻录的光盘,不要买只读的。

e.en: The webinar is {recordable} so people can watch it later.
e.zh: 这场网络研讨会可以录制,方便大家之后回看。

recorded.t: adj. 已录制的；记录在案的

e.en: The album was {recorded} in a small studio in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 这张专辑是在布鲁克林一间小型录音室录制的。

e.en: All customer calls are {recorded} for quality assurance.
e.zh: 所有客户来电均被录音以确保服务质量。

e.en: She used a digital {recorder} to capture the interview.
e.zh: 她用数字录音机录下了这次采访。

e.en: Every kid in my class learned to play the {recorder}.
e.zh: 我班里的每个孩子都学过吹竖笛。

recording.t:
n. 录音；录像
v. 正在录制

e.en: The {recording} of last night's concert is already online.
e.zh: 昨晚音乐会的录音已经上传到网上了。

e.en: He's {recording} a podcast about Chinese history.
e.zh: 他正在录制一档关于中国历史的播客。

e.en: All meeting {recordings} are saved to the shared drive.
e.zh: 所有会议录像都保存在共享网盘里。

e.en: Her early {recordings} from the 1970s are now collector's items.
e.zh: 她在七十年代的早期录音如今成了收藏品。

e.en: The film's sound {recordist} won an award for her work.
e.zh: 这部电影的录音师凭其作品获得了奖项。

e.en: As a field {recordist}, he travels the world capturing animal sounds.
e.zh: 作为一名外景录音师,他周游世界采集动物的声音。

records.t:
n. 记录（复数）
v. 记录（第三人称单数）

e.en: The hospital keeps medical {records} for at least seven years.
e.zh: 医院保存病历至少七年。

e.en: He still buys vinyl {records} from the shop downtown.
e.zh: 他仍会去市中心的店里买黑胶唱片。

e.en: She loved to {recount} stories from her childhood in Beijing.
e.zh: 她喜欢讲述自己在北京童年的故事。

e.en: The losing candidate demanded a {recount} of the votes.
e.zh: 落选的候选人要求重新计票。

recounted.t: v. 叙述（recount 的过去式）

e.en: He {recounted} the entire incident to the police officer.
e.zh: 他向警官详细讲述了整起事件。

e.en: The ballots were {recounted} three times before the result was certified.
e.zh: 选票在结果公布前被重新清点了三次。

recounting.t: v. 正在叙述；重新计数

e.en: She spent the evening {recounting} her travels through Yunnan.
e.zh: 她整晚都在讲述自己在云南的旅行经历。

e.en: The {recounting} of the votes confirmed the original result.
e.zh: 重新计票确认了原本的结果。

recounts.t:
n. 重新计数
v. 叙述；重新计数

e.en: The book {recounts} the rise of the smartphone industry.
e.zh: 这本书讲述了智能手机行业的崛起。

e.en: Two {recounts} were ordered after the close election.
e.zh: 在这场胶着的选举后,有两次重新计票被下令进行。

e.en: It will take years to {recoup} the cost of the renovation.
e.zh: 要好几年才能收回这次装修的成本。

e.en: He hopes to {recoup} his losses in the next quarter.
e.zh: 他希望在下个季度弥补他的亏损。

e.en: The contract allows {recoupment} of bonuses paid based on faulty data.
e.zh: 合同允许追回基于错误数据发放的奖金。
