e.en: They sued the bank seeking {recoupment} of hidden fees.
e.zh: 他们起诉银行，要求追回隐藏的费用。

e.en: Customers have legal {recourse} if the product is defective.
e.zh: 如果产品有缺陷，顾客可以诉诸法律途径。

e.en: She solved the problem without {recourse} to outside help.
e.zh: 她没有借助外援就解决了问题。

e.en: The treaty outlines several {recourses} available to member states.
e.zh: 该条约列出了成员国可采取的几种救济途径。

e.en: When negotiations fail, diplomatic {recourses} become limited.
e.zh: 谈判破裂时，外交手段就变得有限了。

e.en: It took her months to {recover} from the surgery.
e.zh: 她花了几个月才从手术中康复。

e.en: Police managed to {recover} the stolen laptop within hours.
e.zh: 警方在几小时内成功找回了被盗的笔记本电脑。

e.en: Engineers tested the drive's data {recoverability} after a crash.
e.zh: 工程师测试了硬盘崩溃后的数据可恢复性。

e.en: The {recoverability} of the loan depends on the borrower's assets.
e.zh: 贷款能否收回取决于借款人的资产。

recoverable.t: adj. 可恢复的；可追回的

e.en: Most files on the disk are still {recoverable}.
e.zh: 磁盘上的大部分文件仍然可以恢复。

e.en: Legal fees are {recoverable} if you win the case.
e.zh: 如果胜诉，律师费是可以追回的。

recovered.t: v. 恢复；康复（recover 的过去式）

e.en: He fully {recovered} from the flu within a week.
e.zh: 他一周之内就从流感中完全康复了。

e.en: Divers {recovered} the wreckage from the ocean floor.
e.zh: 潜水员从海底打捞出了残骸。

e.en: Hospital data shows faster {recoveries} with the new treatment.
e.zh: 医院数据显示新疗法能让患者更快康复。

e.en: Recent economic {recoveries} have been uneven across regions.
e.zh: 近期各地区的经济复苏并不均衡。

e.en: She is still {recovering} from a knee injury.
e.zh: 她还在从膝盖伤势中恢复。

e.en: The startup is slowly {recovering} from last year's losses.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在慢慢从去年的亏损中恢复。

recovers.t: v. 恢复；找回（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app automatically {recovers} unsaved drafts after a crash.
e.zh: 应用崩溃后会自动恢复未保存的草稿。

e.en: He always {recovers} quickly from minor setbacks.
e.zh: 他总能很快从小挫折中振作起来。

recovery.t: n. 恢复；康复；找回（数据）

e.en: Her {recovery} after the accident surprised the doctors.
e.zh: 她事故后的康复速度让医生们都很惊讶。

e.en: Click here to start the password {recovery} process.
e.zh: 点击这里开始密码找回流程。

e.en: The film tried to {recreate} 1920s New York in detail.
e.zh: 这部电影力求细致地重现二十年代的纽约。

e.en: Can you {recreate} that bug on a different browser?
e.zh: 你能在另一个浏览器上重现那个 bug 吗？

recreation.t:
n. 娱乐；消遣
n. 重现；再创造

e.en: Hiking is his favorite form of weekend {recreation}.
e.zh: 徒步是他最喜欢的周末休闲方式。

e.en: The museum's {recreation} of the medieval village is impressive.
e.zh: 博物馆对中世纪村庄的复原令人印象深刻。

e.en: Several states have legalized {recreational} marijuana use.
e.zh: 多个州已将娱乐用大麻合法化。

e.en: The park offers many {recreational} activities for families.
e.zh: 公园为家庭提供了许多休闲活动。

e.en: The book describes the {recreations} of ancient Roman youth.
e.zh: 这本书描述了古罗马青年的各种娱乐活动。

e.en: Her digital {recreations} of lost paintings went viral online.
e.zh: 她对失传画作的数字复原在网上爆红。

e.en: The meeting ended in bitter {recrimination} between the partners.
e.zh: 会议在合伙人之间激烈的相互指责中结束。

e.en: Let's discuss the issue without {recrimination}.
e.zh: 我们就事论事，不要相互指责。

recross.t: v. 再次穿过；再次交叉

e.en: The defense attorney chose to {recross} the witness briefly.
e.zh: 辩护律师选择对证人进行简短的再交叉询问。

e.en: Migrating birds {recross} the equator twice every year.
e.zh: 候鸟每年要两次重新越过赤道。

e.en: Doctors warned of a possible {recrudescence} of the virus.
e.zh: 医生警告这种病毒可能会卷土重来。

e.en: The region saw a {recrudescence} of ethnic tensions last year.
e.zh: 该地区去年再次出现了民族紧张局势。

recruit.t:
v. 招募；招聘
n. 新兵；新成员

e.en: The startup is trying to {recruit} senior engineers from rivals.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正试图从竞争对手那里挖资深工程师。

e.en: Every new {recruit} attends a two-week training program.
e.zh: 每位新兵都要参加为期两周的训练。

e.en: She was {recruited} straight out of college by Google.
e.zh: 她大学毕业就被谷歌招走了。

e.en: The coach {recruited} three star players this season.
e.zh: 教练这个赛季招募了三名明星球员。

e.en: A LinkedIn {recruiter} messaged me about a backend role.
e.zh: 一位领英猎头给我发消息推荐一个后端职位。

e.en: The military {recruiter} visited several local high schools.
e.zh: 军队招募官走访了几所当地高中。

recruiting.t:
v. 招聘中
n. 招募工作

e.en: Our team is actively {recruiting} for two product designers.
e.zh: 我们团队正在积极招聘两名产品设计师。

e.en: College {recruiting} season starts right after the playoffs.
e.zh: 大学招生季就在季后赛之后开始。

e.en: The company outsourced its {recruitment} to a specialized agency.
e.zh: 公司把招聘工作外包给了一家专业机构。

e.en: Online platforms have transformed {recruitment} in tech.
e.zh: 在线平台彻底改变了科技行业的招聘方式。

e.en: Several {recruitments} were paused due to the hiring freeze.
e.zh: 由于冻结招聘，多个招聘流程被暂停。

e.en: The agency handles thousands of {recruitments} every year.
e.zh: 这家机构每年要处理数千次招聘。

recruits.t:
n. 新兵；新成员（复数）
v. 招募

e.en: The drill sergeant shouted at the new {recruits}.
e.zh: 教官对着新兵们大声训话。

e.en: The firm {recruits} interns from top business schools each summer.
e.zh: 该公司每年夏天从顶尖商学院招实习生。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {rectal} exam to check for bleeding.
e.zh: 医生要求做直肠检查以排查出血。

e.en: A {rectal} thermometer gives the most accurate readings in infants.
e.zh: 直肠体温计对婴儿来说读数最准确。

e.en: Draw a {rectangle} with sides of five and ten centimeters.
e.zh: 画一个边长为五厘米和十厘米的长方形。

e.en: The phone screen is a near-perfect {rectangle}.
e.zh: 手机屏幕几乎是个完美的长方形。

e.en: They placed a {rectangular} rug in the middle of the room.
e.zh: 他们在房间中央铺了一块长方形地毯。

e.en: Most office buildings have a simple {rectangular} footprint.
e.zh: 大多数办公楼的占地都是简单的矩形。

e.en: The audit demanded immediate {rectification} of the accounting errors.
e.zh: 审计要求立即纠正这些会计错误。

e.en: {Rectification} converts alternating current into direct current.
e.zh: 整流是将交流电转换为直流电的过程。

e.en: The power supply uses a bridge {rectifier} to convert AC to DC.
e.zh: 电源使用桥式整流器将交流电转换为直流电。

e.en: A faulty {rectifier} can damage the battery over time.
e.zh: 整流器故障时间长了会损坏电池。

e.en: We will {rectify} the billing error in your next statement.
e.zh: 我们会在您下期账单中纠正这个计费错误。

e.en: It's hard to {rectify} a mistake once it's gone public.
e.zh: 错误一旦公开，就很难再纠正。

rectilinear.t: adj. 直线的；由直线构成的

e.en: Modernist architecture often favors clean {rectilinear} forms.
e.zh: 现代主义建筑通常偏爱简洁的直线形体。

e.en: The robot moves along a strict {rectilinear} path.
e.zh: 机器人严格沿直线路径移动。

e.en: The judge was known for her unwavering moral {rectitude}.
e.zh: 这位法官以坚定的道德正直著称。

e.en: He spoke with the {rectitude} of someone who never doubts himself.
e.zh: 他说话带着一种从不自我怀疑的正直感。

e.en: The illustration appears on the {recto} of page twelve.
e.zh: 插图位于第十二页的正面。

e.en: Editors usually start a new chapter on the {recto}.
e.zh: 编辑通常把新章节安排在右页起始。

e.en: The {rector} delivered a moving sermon on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 教区长在周日上午做了一场感人的布道。

e.en: The university {rector} announced sweeping reforms today.
e.zh: 大学校长今天宣布了大规模改革。

e.en: The old {rectory} next to the church has been restored.
e.zh: 教堂旁边那座旧牧师住宅已被修复。

e.en: She grew up in a quiet country {rectory}.
e.zh: 她在一座宁静的乡村牧师宅里长大。

e.en: The {rectum} is the final section of the large intestine.
e.zh: 直肠是大肠的最后一段。

e.en: Doctors examine the {rectum} during a routine colonoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在常规肠镜检查中会检查直肠。

e.en: Crunches mainly target the {rectus} abdominis muscle.
e.zh: 卷腹主要锻炼腹直肌。

e.en: The {rectus} femoris helps you straighten your knee.
e.zh: 股直肌帮助你伸直膝盖。

e.en: He rides a {recumbent} bike to ease his back pain.
e.zh: 他骑躺式自行车来缓解背痛。

e.en: A {recumbent} statue of the saint lay before the altar.
e.zh: 圣徒的卧像就摆在祭坛前。

e.en: She took two weeks off to {recuperate} after surgery.
e.zh: 她请了两周假，术后好好休养。

e.en: Athletes need time to {recuperate} between intense training sessions.
e.zh: 运动员在高强度训练之间需要时间恢复。

e.en: He fully {recuperated} at his parents' house in the countryside.
e.zh: 他在乡下父母家完全康复了。

e.en: The team {recuperated} over the weekend before the finals.
e.zh: 球队在决赛前的周末好好休整了一番。

recuperates.t: v. 康复（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {recuperates} faster when she gets enough sleep.
e.zh: 睡眠充足时她恢复得更快。

e.en: The patient slowly {recuperates} from the long illness.
e.zh: 病人正慢慢从这场久病中康复。

e.en: He's {recuperating} at home after a successful operation.
e.zh: 手术成功后，他正在家中休养。

e.en: The economy is still {recuperating} from the pandemic shock.
e.zh: 经济仍在从疫情冲击中恢复。

e.en: Her {recuperation} took longer than the doctors predicted.
e.zh: 她的康复时间比医生预计的要长。

e.en: Sleep is essential for muscle {recuperation} after exercise.
e.zh: 运动后睡眠对肌肉恢复至关重要。

e.en: The clinic specializes in post-surgery {recuperations}.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门负责术后康复。

e.en: Long {recuperations} can take a toll on a patient's mental health.
e.zh: 漫长的康复期会影响病人的心理健康。

recuperative.t: adj. 有恢复力的；助康复的

e.en: The hot springs are famous for their {recuperative} powers.
e.zh: 这些温泉以其疗养功效而闻名。

e.en: A short nap has surprising {recuperative} effects.
e.zh: 短暂的小睡有惊人的恢复效果。

e.en: The same error tends to {recur} every Monday morning.
e.zh: 同样的错误每周一早上都容易再次出现。

e.en: Doctors worry the cancer might {recur} within five years.
e.zh: 医生担心癌症可能在五年内复发。

e.en: Regular checkups reduce the risk of {recurrence}.
e.zh: 定期检查可以降低复发的风险。

e.en: The {recurrence} of the bug suggests a deeper design flaw.
e.zh: 这个 bug 的反复出现说明设计上有更深层的问题。

recurrent.t: adj. 反复出现的；复发的

e.en: She suffers from {recurrent} migraines every few weeks.
e.zh: 她每隔几周就会偏头痛发作。

e.en: Climate change is a {recurrent} theme in his novels.
e.zh: 气候变化是他小说中反复出现的主题。

e.en: The server crashes {recurrently} during peak traffic hours.
e.zh: 服务器在高峰时段会反复宕机。

e.en: This motif appears {recurrently} throughout the symphony.
e.zh: 这一主题在整部交响曲中反复出现。

recurring.t: adj. 反复出现的；循环的

e.en: She has a {recurring} dream about flying over the city.
e.zh: 她反复做着一个飞越城市的梦。

e.en: Cancel your {recurring} subscription before the next billing cycle.
e.zh: 在下一个账单周期前取消你的定期订阅。

e.en: The function uses {recursion} to traverse the tree.
e.zh: 该函数使用递归来遍历树。

e.en: Infinite {recursion} crashed the program with a stack overflow.
e.zh: 无限递归导致程序栈溢出而崩溃。

e.en: Write a {recursive} function to compute the factorial.
e.zh: 写一个递归函数来计算阶乘。

e.en: The folder shows a {recursive} listing of all subdirectories.
e.zh: 该文件夹会递归列出所有子目录。

e.en: The script {recursively} deletes every file in the folder.
e.zh: 该脚本会递归删除文件夹中的每个文件。

e.en: Search {recursively} through the project for matching patterns.
e.zh: 在整个项目中递归搜索匹配的模式。

e.en: The judge announced his {recusal} from the high-profile case.
e.zh: 法官宣布回避这宗备受关注的案件。

e.en: Her {recusal} avoided any appearance of conflict of interest.
e.zh: 她的回避避免了利益冲突的嫌疑。

recusant.t:
n. 拒不服从者
adj. 抗拒的

e.en: The {recusant} minority refused to attend the official church.
e.zh: 那一小撮拒从者拒绝参加官方教会。

e.en: History books describe him as a stubborn {recusant}.
e.zh: 史书把他描述为一个固执的拒从者。

redevelop.t: v. 重新开发（土地、地区）

e.en: The city plans to {redevelop} the old waterfront area.
e.zh: 市政府打算重新开发旧码头区。

e.en: Investors hope to {redevelop} the abandoned factory into lofts.
e.zh: 投资者希望把废弃的工厂改造成公寓楼。

redevelopment.t: n. 重新开发；旧区改造

e.en: The downtown {redevelopment} project will take five years.
e.zh: 市中心的重建项目将耗时五年。

e.en: Residents oppose the {redevelopment} of their neighborhood.
e.zh: 居民反对对他们社区进行重新开发。

e.en: We caught the train to {Redfern} for the football match.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去雷德芬看足球比赛。

e.en: {Redfern} is a vibrant inner suburb of Sydney.
e.zh: 雷德芬是悉尼一个充满活力的内城区。

redfish.t: n. 红鱼（多种红色海鱼的统称）

e.en: He grilled a fresh {redfish} fillet for dinner.
e.zh: 他烤了一块新鲜的红鱼片当晚餐。

e.en: Anglers love fishing for {redfish} in the Gulf shallows.
e.zh: 垂钓者喜欢在墨西哥湾浅水区钓红鱼。

e.en: The {redhead} in the front row asked the best question.
e.zh: 前排那位红发女子提了最好的问题。

e.en: Her daughter is a freckled {redhead} like her grandmother.
e.zh: 她女儿和外婆一样，是个有雀斑的红发女孩。

redial.t:
v. 重拨（电话号码）
n. 重拨键

e.en: Press this button to {redial} the last number you called.
e.zh: 按这个按钮可以重拨上一个电话号码。

e.en: I had to {redial} three times before the call connected.
e.zh: 我重拨了三次电话才接通。

redid.t: v. redo 的过去式；重做

e.en: She {redid} her resume after getting feedback from a mentor.
e.zh: 在导师给她反馈后，她重新做了简历。

e.en: We {redid} the kitchen tiles because the grout was uneven.
e.zh: 因为填缝不均匀，我们重做了厨房瓷砖。

redirect.t:
v. 重定向；改变方向
n. 重定向（网页跳转）

e.en: Old links automatically {redirect} users to the new website.
e.zh: 旧链接会自动把用户重定向到新网站。

e.en: The teacher tried to {redirect} the kids' attention to the lesson.
e.zh: 老师试图把孩子们的注意力引回到课堂上。

redirected.t: v. redirect 的过去式；被重定向

e.en: The flight was {redirected} to Denver due to bad weather.
e.zh: 由于天气恶劣，航班被改飞丹佛。

e.en: Funds were {redirected} from marketing to product development.
e.zh: 资金从市场部转拨到了产品研发部门。

e.en: The browser showed a {redirection} error after I clicked the link.
e.zh: 我点击链接后浏览器显示了重定向错误。

e.en: Therapy gave her a healthy {redirection} of energy.
e.zh: 心理治疗让她以健康的方式重新引导精力。

e.en: Many adults {rediscover} their love of reading during quiet weekends.
e.zh: 许多成年人会在安静的周末重新爱上阅读。

e.en: Travel helped him {rediscover} a sense of curiosity about the world.
e.zh: 旅行让他重新找回了对世界的好奇心。

rediscovered.t: v. rediscover 的过去式；被重新发现

e.en: Researchers {rediscovered} a species thought to be extinct.
e.zh: 研究人员重新发现了一种被认为已灭绝的物种。

e.en: She {rediscovered} old photos while cleaning the attic.
e.zh: 她在打扫阁楼时重新发现了旧照片。

e.en: He's {rediscovering} hobbies he gave up in his twenties.
e.zh: 他正在重新拾起二十多岁时放弃的爱好。

e.en: The band is {rediscovering} their original sound on this album.
e.zh: 乐队在这张专辑里正重新找回他们最初的音乐风格。

rediscovers.t: v. rediscover 的第三人称单数

e.en: Each generation {rediscovers} the classics in its own way.
e.zh: 每一代人都会以自己的方式重新发现经典。

e.en: In the film, the hero {rediscovers} his hometown after years away.
e.zh: 片中主角在阔别多年后重新认识了他的家乡。

e.en: The {rediscovery} of the manuscript shocked literary scholars.
e.zh: 这份手稿的重新发现震惊了文学界。

e.en: Her trip became a {rediscovery} of childhood memories.
e.zh: 她的旅程成为了一次对童年记忆的重新发掘。

redistribute.t: v. 重新分配（财富、资源）

e.en: The new policy aims to {redistribute} wealth more fairly.
e.zh: 新政策旨在更公平地重新分配财富。

e.en: Please {redistribute} these flyers to the other classrooms.
e.zh: 请把这些传单重新分发到其他教室。

e.en: Tax reform led to a major {redistribution} of income.
e.zh: 税制改革带来了收入的大规模再分配。

e.en: The {redistribution} of resources helped poorer regions.
e.zh: 资源的重新分配帮助了较贫困的地区。

e.en: Critics question the {redistributional} effects of the new tax.
e.zh: 批评者质疑新税收的再分配效应。

e.en: The bill has clear {redistributional} goals across income groups.
e.zh: 该法案在不同收入群体间有明确的再分配目标。

redistributive.t: adj. 再分配的（财富、资源）

e.en: Sweden is known for its {redistributive} social policies.
e.zh: 瑞典以其再分配性的社会政策而闻名。

e.en: The economist proposed more {redistributive} taxation measures.
e.zh: 这位经济学家提议采取更具再分配性的税收措施。

e.en: The court ruled the state's {redistricting} map unconstitutional.
e.zh: 法院裁定该州的选区重划地图违宪。

e.en: {Redistricting} happens every ten years after the census.
e.zh: 每十年人口普查之后都会进行选区重划。

e.en: The siblings had to {redivide} the inheritance fairly.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹们不得不公平地重新分配遗产。

e.en: Let's {redivide} the teams to make the game more balanced.
e.zh: 我们重新分组吧，让比赛更平衡些。

redline.t:
v. 划红线拒绝（贷款、服务）
n. 红线区

e.en: The lawyer sent back a {redline} version of the contract.
e.zh: 律师寄回了一份带修订标记的合同。

e.en: Don't {redline} the engine or you'll damage it.
e.zh: 别把发动机转速拉到红线，会损坏的。

e.en: The setting sun glowed {redly} on the canyon walls.
e.zh: 夕阳红彤彤地照在峡谷的岩壁上。

e.en: The coals burned {redly} in the fireplace all night.
e.zh: 煤炭在壁炉里通红地烧了一整夜。

e.en: Don {Redman} was a pioneering jazz arranger and bandleader.
e.zh: 唐·雷德曼是爵士乐编曲和乐队指挥的先驱。

e.en: The novel's protagonist meets a character named {Redman}.
e.zh: 小说主角遇到了一个叫雷德曼的人物。

e.en: Microsoft's headquarters is in {Redmond}, Washington.
e.zh: 微软的总部位于华盛顿州雷德蒙德。

e.en: She moved to {Redmond} for a software engineering job.
e.zh: 她为了一份软件工程师的工作搬到了雷德蒙德。

redneck.t: n. 美国乡下白人（贬义）

e.en: The comedian joked about his {redneck} relatives back home.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员拿他老家的乡巴佬亲戚开玩笑。

e.en: He drives a pickup truck and proudly calls himself a {redneck}.
e.zh: 他开着皮卡车，自豪地自称是个乡巴佬。

e.en: The cream reduced the {redness} on her cheeks overnight.
e.zh: 这款面霜一夜之间就减轻了她脸颊的泛红。

e.en: A persistent {redness} on the skin can signal an allergy.
e.zh: 皮肤持续发红可能是过敏的信号。

e.en: I had to {redo} the entire spreadsheet after the file crashed.
e.zh: 文件崩溃后，我不得不重做整张电子表格。

e.en: Press Ctrl+Y to {redo} an action you just undid.
e.zh: 按Ctrl+Y可以重做你刚撤销的操作。

redoes.t: v. redo 的第三人称单数

e.en: She always {redoes} her makeup before an evening meeting.
e.zh: 她总是在晚间会议前重新化一次妆。

e.en: He {redoes} the dishes whenever his roommate washes them poorly.
e.zh: 每当室友洗碗洗得不干净，他就会重洗一遍。

e.en: We're {redoing} the bathroom this summer with new tiles.
e.zh: 今年夏天我们要用新瓷砖重新装修浴室。

e.en: She spent the weekend {redoing} her portfolio website.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在重新制作自己的作品集网站。

e.en: The kitchen filled with the warm {redolence} of fresh bread.
e.zh: 厨房里充满了新鲜面包温暖的香气。

e.en: A {redolence} of pine and woodsmoke hung in the cabin.
e.zh: 小屋里弥漫着松木和柴烟的气味。

redolent.t: adj. 散发着…气味的；令人想起…的

e.en: The garden was {redolent} of jasmine after the summer rain.
e.zh: 夏雨过后，花园里弥漫着茉莉花的香气。

e.en: His memoir is {redolent} of small-town life in the 1950s.
e.zh: 他的回忆录散发着上世纪五十年代小镇生活的气息。

e.en: The kitchen has been completely {redone} with modern appliances.
e.zh: 厨房已经用现代电器彻底翻新过了。

e.en: The report needs to be {redone} before tomorrow's meeting.
e.zh: 这份报告必须在明天会议前重做。

e.en: We must {redouble} our efforts to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 我们必须加倍努力才能赶上截止日期。

e.en: The setback only made the team {redouble} their commitment.
e.zh: 这次挫折反而让团队加倍投入。

redoubled.t: v. redouble 的过去式；加倍的

e.en: After the criticism, she {redoubled} her training every morning.
e.zh: 在受到批评后，她每天早上加倍训练。

e.en: The company {redoubled} its marketing efforts in Asia.
e.zh: 公司加倍加大了在亚洲的营销力度。

e.en: The soldiers defended the hilltop {redoubt} for three days.
e.zh: 士兵们在山顶的堡垒坚守了三天。

e.en: The university remains a {redoubt} of liberal thought.
e.zh: 这所大学仍是自由思想的堡垒。

redoubtable.t: adj. 令人敬畏的；可怕的

e.en: She faced a {redoubtable} opponent in the final round.
e.zh: 她在决赛中遇到了一位令人敬畏的对手。

e.en: The {redoubtable} judge has ruled on hundreds of cases.
e.zh: 这位令人敬畏的法官审理过数百起案件。

e.en: His generosity will {redound} to his lasting reputation.
e.zh: 他的慷慨将为他赢得长久的声誉。

e.en: Such achievements {redound} to the credit of the whole team.
e.zh: 这样的成就为整个团队增添了荣誉。

e.en: Batteries store energy through controlled {redox} reactions.
e.zh: 电池通过受控的氧化还原反应来储存能量。

e.en: The chemistry exam covered acid-base and {redox} chemistry.
e.zh: 化学考试涵盖了酸碱反应和氧化还原反应。

e.en: The {Redpath} Museum at McGill houses fascinating fossils.
e.zh: 麦吉尔大学的雷德帕斯博物馆收藏着引人入胜的化石。

e.en: Professor {Redpath} delivered the keynote at the conference.
e.zh: 雷德帕斯教授在会议上发表了主旨演讲。

redraft.t:
v. 重新起草
n. 修改稿

e.en: The editor asked her to {redraft} the opening chapter.
e.zh: 编辑请她重新起草开篇章节。

e.en: The committee will {redraft} the proposal after the feedback.
e.zh: 委员会会在收到反馈后重新起草提案。

e.en: Designers had to {redraw} the map to include the new borders.
e.zh: 设计师必须重新绘制地图以包含新边界。

e.en: The illustrator chose to {redraw} the character's face.
e.zh: 插画师决定重新绘制这个角色的脸。

redrawing.t: v. redraw 的进行式；重绘

e.en: The artist is {redrawing} the panels for the comic's reissue.
e.zh: 画家正在为漫画再版重新绘制分镜。

e.en: Streaming services are {redrawing} the entertainment landscape.
e.zh: 流媒体服务正在重塑娱乐行业的格局。

redress.t:
v. 纠正；补救
n. 赔偿；补救

e.en: Victims are seeking legal {redress} for the company's negligence.
e.zh: 受害者正寻求对公司过失的法律救济。

e.en: The new policy aims to {redress} long-standing inequalities.
e.zh: 新政策旨在纠正长期存在的不平等现象。

reds.t:
n. red 的复数；红色
 n. 红军/共产党人（口语）

e.en: The autumn leaves showed deep {reds} and oranges everywhere.
e.zh: 秋叶到处呈现出深红色和橙色。

e.en: This wine shop stocks {reds} from across France.
e.zh: 这家酒铺备有来自法国各地的红葡萄酒。

e.en: A {redshank} waded through the shallow marsh water.
e.zh: 一只红脚鹬在浅浅的沼泽水中涉行。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {redshank} along the muddy shoreline.
e.zh: 观鸟者在泥泞的岸边发现了一只红脚鹬。

e.en: Astronomers measure {redshift} to estimate how far galaxies are.
e.zh: 天文学家通过测量红移来估算星系的距离。

e.en: The galaxy's high {redshift} suggests it is incredibly distant.
e.zh: 该星系的高红移表明它距离极其遥远。

e.en: Light from distant stars appears {redshifted} as space expands.
e.zh: 随着空间膨胀,远星的光看起来发生了红移。

e.en: The spectrum of the quasar is heavily {redshifted}.
e.zh: 那颗类星体的光谱发生了严重的红移。

redshirt.t: n. 红衫球员（大学体育延期参赛的运动员）

e.en: The coach decided to {redshirt} the freshman quarterback this season.
e.zh: 教练决定让这位大一四分卫本赛季保留学籍不出战。

e.en: He spent his {redshirt} year in the weight room.
e.zh: 他保留学籍的那一年都泡在举重房里。

redskin.t: n. 印第安人（冒犯用语）

e.en: The term {redskin} is now widely considered offensive.
e.zh: 如今“红皮人”这个词被普遍认为带有冒犯性。

e.en: The team dropped the name {redskin} after years of protest.
e.zh: 经过多年抗议,该队弃用了“红皮人”这个名字。

e.en: A {redstart} flashed its bright tail among the branches.
e.zh: 一只红尾鸲在枝头闪现出鲜艳的尾羽。

e.en: The American {redstart} migrates thousands of miles each year.
e.zh: 美洲红尾鸲每年迁徙数千英里。

reduce.t:
v. 减少；降低
v. 简化；归纳

e.en: Try to {reduce} sugar in your daily diet.
e.zh: 试着减少日常饮食中的糖分。

e.en: This setting will {reduce} the file size significantly.
e.zh: 这个设置会显著减小文件体积。

e.en: All summer dresses are {reduced} by fifty percent.
e.zh: 所有夏季连衣裙一律打五折。

e.en: The new engine {reduced} fuel consumption noticeably.
e.zh: 新引擎明显降低了油耗。

reducer.t:
n. 还原剂
n. 缩减器

e.en: Redux uses a {reducer} to handle state changes.
e.zh: Redux 使用 reducer 来处理状态变化。

e.en: A noise {reducer} can clean up old recordings.
e.zh: 降噪器可以净化旧的录音。

reduces.t: v. 减少（reduce 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Walking daily {reduces} the risk of heart disease.
e.zh: 每天步行可以降低患心脏病的风险。

e.en: This filter {reduces} background noise during video calls.
e.zh: 这款滤镜能在视频通话时降低背景噪音。

reducible.t: adj. 可简化的；可归约的

e.en: Human consciousness may not be {reducible} to mere chemistry.
e.zh: 人类意识或许无法简化为单纯的化学反应。

e.en: The fraction is {reducible} to its simplest form.
e.zh: 这个分数可以约分到最简形式。

reducing.t:
v. 减少（现在分词）
n. 减肥

e.en: The company is {reducing} costs by going remote.
e.zh: 公司正通过远程办公来削减开支。

e.en: She is {reducing} the sauce on low heat.
e.zh: 她正用小火收酱汁。

e.en: This drug inhibits the {reductase} enzyme to lower cholesterol.
e.zh: 这种药物抑制还原酶以降低胆固醇。

e.en: Researchers studied how {reductase} converts the compound in cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了还原酶如何在细胞中转化该化合物。

reduction.t:
n. 减少；降低
n. 折扣；削减幅度

e.en: The store offered a thirty percent {reduction} on laptops.
e.zh: 这家店笔记本电脑打七折优惠。

e.en: We need a serious {reduction} in carbon emissions.
e.zh: 我们需要大幅减少碳排放。

e.en: Critics warned against the {reductionism} of his theory.
e.zh: 批评者警告说他的理论过于还原论。

e.en: Pure {reductionism} struggles to explain complex social behavior.
e.zh: 纯粹的还原论难以解释复杂的社会行为。

reductionist.t:
n. 还原论者
adj. 还原论的

e.en: His {reductionist} view ignored cultural and historical factors.
e.zh: 他还原论式的观点忽视了文化和历史因素。

e.en: That explanation feels overly {reductionist} to me.
e.zh: 那个解释在我看来过于还原论了。

e.en: The model is too {reductionistic} to capture real human emotions.
e.zh: 这个模型过于还原论,无法捕捉真实的人类情感。

e.en: Avoid {reductionistic} thinking when analyzing complex systems.
e.zh: 分析复杂系统时要避免还原论式的思维。

reductions.t: n. 削减；降低（reduction 的复数）

e.en: The budget includes major {reductions} in defense spending.
e.zh: 该预算大幅削减了国防开支。

e.en: Customers love the seasonal {reductions} at this department store.
e.zh: 顾客们喜欢这家百货店的换季减价。

reductive.t: adj. 过度简化的；还原的

e.en: Calling him just lucky is a {reductive} take.
e.zh: 说他只是运气好是一种过于简化的看法。

e.en: The article gave a {reductive} summary of the conflict.
e.zh: 这篇文章对冲突做了过于简化的总结。

reductivist.t:
n. 简约主义者
adj. 简约主义的

e.en: His {reductivist} approach stripped the painting to bare geometry.
e.zh: 他极简主义的手法把这幅画简化为纯粹的几何图形。

e.en: Critics dismissed her {reductivist} reading of the novel.
e.zh: 评论家不认同她对这部小说极简化的解读。

redundancies.t: n. 冗余；裁员（redundancy 的复数）

e.en: The company announced {redundancies} across its London offices.
e.zh: 该公司宣布在伦敦各办公室进行裁员。

e.en: The editor removed several {redundancies} from the draft.
e.zh: 编辑删去了草稿中的几处冗余内容。

redundancy.t:
n. 冗余；多余
n. 裁员

e.en: The server cluster has built-in {redundancy} for safety.
e.zh: 服务器集群内置了冗余以保障安全。

e.en: He was offered {redundancy} after twenty years of service.
e.zh: 在工作二十年后,他被提出了裁员补偿方案。

redundant.t:
adj. 多余的；累赘的
adj. 被裁员的

e.en: Hundreds of workers were made {redundant} last month.
e.zh: 上个月数百名工人被裁员。

e.en: This sentence is {redundant} and should be deleted.
e.zh: 这句话是多余的,应该删掉。

e.en: The data is stored {redundantly} across three servers.
e.zh: 数据在三台服务器上冗余存储。

e.en: He explained the rule {redundantly}, repeating each step twice.
e.zh: 他啰嗦地讲解了规则,每一步都重复两遍。

e.en: Some languages {reduplicate} syllables to indicate plural meaning.
e.zh: 有些语言通过重复音节来表示复数。

e.en: Children often {reduplicate} sounds when learning to talk.
e.zh: 孩子学说话时常常会重复发音。

e.en: Collectors prize early American {redware} from colonial Pennsylvania.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视来自殖民地宾夕法尼亚的早期美国红陶器。

e.en: The museum displayed antique {redware} bowls and jugs.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古董红陶碗和水壶。

e.en: A {redwing} sang loudly from the cattails by the pond.
e.zh: 一只红翅鸫在池塘边的香蒲丛中高声鸣唱。

e.en: The {redwing} migrates to Britain every winter.
e.zh: 红翅鸫每年冬天都会迁徙到英国。

e.en: The {redwood} forests of California attract millions of visitors.
e.zh: 加州的红杉林每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: That ancient {redwood} is over two thousand years old.
e.zh: 那棵古老的红杉树已有两千多年的历史。

e.en: He laced up his new {reebok} sneakers before the run.
e.zh: 跑步前他系好了新的锐步运动鞋鞋带。

e.en: {Reebok} released a retro collection inspired by the nineties.
e.zh: 锐步推出了一个以九十年代为灵感的复古系列。

reed.t:
n. 芦苇
n. 簧片（乐器）

e.en: A clarinet player must replace the {reed} regularly.
e.zh: 单簧管演奏者必须定期更换簧片。

e.en: A single {reed} swayed at the edge of the pond.
e.zh: 一根芦苇在池塘边随风摇曳。

e.en: The frogs hid among the tall {reeds} by the water.
e.zh: 青蛙藏身于水边高高的芦苇丛中。

e.en: Saxophonists keep spare {reeds} in their cases.
e.zh: 萨克斯演奏者会在乐器盒里备有多余的簧片。

reedy.t:
adj. 芦苇丛生的
adj. (声音) 尖细的

e.en: He spoke in a thin, {reedy} voice that carried far.
e.zh: 他用细而尖的嗓音说话,声音传得很远。

e.en: The river had a {reedy} marsh on either side.
e.zh: 河两岸是长满芦苇的沼泽。

reef.t:
n. 礁；暗礁
v. 收帆

e.en: Divers explored the colorful coral {reef} off the coast.
e.zh: 潜水员们探索了海岸边五彩斑斓的珊瑚礁。

e.en: Climate change is killing the Great Barrier {Reef}.
e.zh: 气候变化正在毁掉大堡礁。

reefer.t:
n. 大麻烟卷
n. 冷藏车

e.en: The cargo was shipped overseas in a refrigerated {reefer}.
e.zh: 货物用冷藏集装箱运往海外。

e.en: He wore a navy {reefer} jacket against the cold wind.
e.zh: 他穿了件深蓝色的双排扣短大衣抵御寒风。

reek.t:
v. 发出恶臭
n. 臭味

e.en: The old fridge began to {reek} of spoiled milk.
e.zh: 那台旧冰箱开始散发出馊牛奶的恶臭。

e.en: His clothes {reek} of cigarette smoke.
e.zh: 他的衣服上一股浓烈的烟味。

e.en: He came home {reeking} of garlic and beer.
e.zh: 他回家时浑身散发着大蒜和啤酒的味道。

e.en: The alley was {reeking} of garbage in the summer heat.
e.zh: 夏日酷暑中小巷里散发着垃圾的恶臭。

reel.t:
n. 卷盘；短视频
v. 卷绕；踉跄

e.en: She watched a funny {reel} on Instagram during lunch.
e.zh: 午饭时她看了一段 Instagram 上的搞笑短视频。

e.en: The fisherman slowly turned the {reel} to land the bass.
e.zh: 渔夫慢慢摇动卷线轮,把那条鲈鱼拉上来。

e.en: The senator is running for {reelection} this November.
e.zh: 这位参议员将于今年十一月竞选连任。

e.en: His chances of {reelection} look slim after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后,他连任的希望看起来很渺茫。

reeling.t:
v. 眩晕；踉跄
v. 卷绕（现在分词）

e.en: The whole town is still {reeling} from the storm.
e.zh: 整个小镇仍未从这场风暴中缓过神来。

e.en: He was {reeling} after taking that punch to the jaw.
e.zh: 下巴挨了那一拳后,他踉跄了几步。

reenact.t: v. 重新扮演；重新颁布

e.en: Volunteers will {reenact} the famous battle next weekend.
e.zh: 志愿者将在下周末重演这场著名的战役。

e.en: The detectives asked the witness to {reenact} the incident.
e.zh: 侦探让目击者重新演示一遍案发经过。

e.en: The group {reenacted} a Civil War battle in period uniforms.
e.zh: 这群人身穿当年的军服重演了一场南北战争战役。

e.en: She {reenacted} the funny scene from the movie at dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐时把电影里那段搞笑情节又演了一遍。

e.en: Hobbyists were {reenacting} medieval sword fights in the park.
e.zh: 爱好者们正在公园里重演中世纪的剑斗场面。

e.en: She kept {reenacting} the argument in her head.
e.zh: 她不断在脑海里重演那场争吵。

reenacts.t: v. 重演（第三人称单数）

e.en: The film {reenacts} key moments of the moon landing.
e.zh: 这部影片再现了登月的关键时刻。

e.en: Every July the village {reenacts} its founding ceremony.
e.zh: 每年七月,这个村庄都会重演其建村仪式。

e.en: The firm is {reengineering} its entire supply chain process.
e.zh: 公司正在对其整个供应链流程进行再造。

e.en: Business {reengineering} can dramatically improve company efficiency.
e.zh: 业务流程再造可以显著提升公司效率。

e.en: You'll need to {reenter} your password after the timeout.
e.zh: 超时后你需要重新输入密码。

e.en: The capsule will {reenter} Earth's atmosphere at dawn.
e.zh: 返回舱将在黎明时分重返地球大气层。

e.en: The two countries hope to {reestablish} diplomatic relations soon.
e.zh: 两国希望尽快恢复外交关系。

e.en: She worked hard to {reestablish} trust with her team.
e.zh: 她努力重新建立与团队之间的信任。

e.en: The treaty led to the {reestablishment} of trade between them.
e.zh: 该条约促成了双方贸易的重新建立。

e.en: Locals welcomed the {reestablishment} of bus service to the village.
e.zh: 当地人欢迎通往村里的公交服务恢复运营。

e.en: You should {reevaluate} your priorities after such a setback.
e.zh: 经历这样的挫折后,你应该重新审视自己的优先事项。

e.en: The committee will {reevaluate} the proposal next month.
e.zh: 委员会将于下个月重新评估该提案。

reeve.t:
n. 地方长官（古）
v. 穿绳

e.en: In medieval England, the {reeve} managed the lord's estate.
e.zh: 在中世纪的英格兰,执事负责管理领主的庄园。

e.en: The village {reeve} settled disputes among the tenants.
e.zh: 村里的执事调解佃户之间的纠纷。

reeves.t: n. 里夫斯（姓氏）；地方官（复数）

e.en: Keanu {Reeves} starred in several iconic action films.
e.zh: 基努·里维斯主演了多部经典动作片。

e.en: The {Reeves} family hosted dinner for the neighbors.
e.zh: 里夫斯一家请邻居们来吃晚饭。

e.en: We need to {reexamine} the data before publishing.
e.zh: 我们需要在发表前重新审视这些数据。

e.en: The court agreed to {reexamine} the witness tomorrow.
e.zh: 法庭同意明天重新讯问这位证人。

recuse.t: v. (法官等) 回避、自行退出

e.en: The judge chose to {recuse} herself from the trial.
e.zh: 法官选择回避这场审判。

e.en: Board members must {recuse} themselves from votes involving family.
e.zh: 董事会成员必须在涉及亲属的投票中回避。

recyclability.t: n. 可回收利用的性质

e.en: The packaging was redesigned to improve its {recyclability}.
e.zh: 包装经过重新设计以提高可回收性。

e.en: Engineers test the {recyclability} of every new battery model.
e.zh: 工程师测试每款新电池的可回收性。

e.en: Please rinse {recyclable} bottles before tossing them in the bin.
e.zh: 请在扔进回收桶前冲洗可回收的瓶子。

e.en: The cup is fully {recyclable} and biodegradable.
e.zh: 这种杯子完全可回收并且可生物降解。

e.en: We {recycle} paper, glass, and plastic at home.
e.zh: 我们在家回收纸张、玻璃和塑料。

e.en: Designers often {recycle} ideas from past collections.
e.zh: 设计师经常重新利用过往系列的灵感。

recycled.t: adj. 回收再利用的、再生的

e.en: This jacket is made from {recycled} ocean plastic.
e.zh: 这件夹克由回收的海洋塑料制成。

e.en: The studio {recycled} the old set for a new film.
e.zh: 工作室把旧布景重新用于一部新电影。

e.en: The local {recycler} pays cash for aluminum cans.
e.zh: 当地的回收商按现金价收购铝罐。

e.en: She works as a {recycler} at the city waste plant.
e.zh: 她在市废料厂当回收员。

recycles.t: v. 回收（recycle 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The factory {recycles} thousands of tons of metal each year.
e.zh: 这家工厂每年回收数千吨金属。

e.en: My grandma {recycles} every glass jar she finds.
e.zh: 我奶奶把找到的每个玻璃罐都回收利用。

recycling.t:
n. 回收利用
v. 正在回收

e.en: Drop your bottles into the {recycling} bin by the door.
e.zh: 把瓶子扔进门口的回收箱里。

e.en: The city expanded its {recycling} program last year.
e.zh: 该市去年扩大了回收计划。

e.en: Annual {recyclings} of electronics have doubled in five years.
e.zh: 电子产品的年度回收量在五年内翻了一番。

e.en: Different {recyclings} of the same melody appear in his albums.
e.zh: 同一段旋律的不同再利用版本出现在他的专辑中。

red.t:
adj. 红色的
n. 红色

e.en: She wore a bright {red} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿着鲜红色的连衣裙参加婚礼。

e.en: The traffic light turned {red} just as we approached.
e.zh: 我们刚靠近,交通灯就变红了。

redacted.t: adj. (敏感信息) 已编辑删除的

e.en: The leaked document had several names {redacted} in black.
e.zh: 泄露的文件上有几个名字被涂黑删除。

e.en: Lawyers {redacted} sensitive details before publishing the report.
e.zh: 律师在发布报告前删去了敏感细节。

redaction.t: n. 删节、涂黑（敏感内容）

e.en: The {redaction} of names protects witness identities.
e.zh: 对姓名的涂黑处理保护了证人的身份。

e.en: Heavy {redaction} made the report nearly impossible to read.
e.zh: 大量删节让这份报告几乎无法阅读。

redbird.t: n. 红雀（北美红色鸟类）

e.en: A {redbird} landed on the snowy fence this morning.
e.zh: 今早一只红雀落在了被雪覆盖的篱笆上。

e.en: Cardinals fans cheered as the {redbird} mascot ran past.
e.zh: 红雀队球迷为跑过的红鸟吉祥物欢呼。

e.en: The hunter trained his {redbone} hound to track raccoons.
e.zh: 那位猎人训练他的红骨猎犬追踪浣熊。

e.en: Their {redbone} coonhound won several regional shows.
e.zh: 他们的红骨浣熊犬赢得了几场地区赛。

redbrick.t: adj. 红砖建造的；(英国) 新兴大学的

e.en: He studied physics at a famous {redbrick} university.
e.zh: 他在一所著名的红砖大学攻读物理学。

e.en: The old {redbrick} factory was turned into lofts.
e.zh: 那座老红砖工厂被改造成了公寓。

redbridge.t: n. 红桥区（伦敦行政区）

e.en: She grew up in {Redbridge}, a borough in east London.
e.zh: 她在东伦敦的红桥区长大。

e.en: The {Redbridge} council announced new housing plans yesterday.
e.zh: 红桥区议会昨天公布了新的住房计划。

e.en: The {redbud} tree blooms with pink flowers each spring.
e.zh: 紫荆树每年春天开出粉色花朵。

e.en: She planted a young {redbud} beside the front porch.
e.zh: 她在前廊旁种了一棵小紫荆树。

e.en: Melville's {Redburn} draws on his own seafaring youth.
e.zh: 梅尔维尔的《雷德本》取材于他年轻时的航海经历。

e.en: We read {Redburn} for an American literature seminar.
e.zh: 我们在美国文学课上读了《雷德本》。

e.en: The steelworks in {Redcar} closed after decades of production.
e.zh: 雷德卡的钢铁厂在生产数十年后关闭了。

e.en: They spent the weekend at the beach in {Redcar}.
e.zh: 他们在雷德卡的海滩度过了周末。

e.en: He bought a small house in {Redcliffe} near the bay.
e.zh: 他在海湾附近的雷德克里夫买了一栋小房子。

e.en: The {Redcliffe} jetty is popular with local fishermen.
e.zh: 雷德克里夫码头深受当地渔民喜爱。

redcoat.t: n. 红衫军（旧时英国士兵）

e.en: A British {redcoat} stood guard outside the colonial fort.
e.zh: 一名英国红衣士兵在殖民地堡垒外站岗。

e.en: The museum displays an original {redcoat} uniform from 1776.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一套1776年的红衣军原版军服。

e.en: She served lamb with a tangy {redcurrant} sauce.
e.zh: 她用酸甜的红醋栗酱配羊肉。

e.en: Birds quickly stripped every {redcurrant} from the bush.
e.zh: 鸟儿很快把灌木上的红醋栗全吃光了。

e.en: Salmon dig a {redd} in the gravel to lay eggs.
e.zh: 鲑鱼在砾石中挖出产卵巢来产卵。

e.en: Biologists counted each {redd} along the riverbed.
e.zh: 生物学家清点了河床上每一个鲑鱼产卵巢。

e.en: Her cheeks {redden} whenever she gets a compliment.
e.zh: 每当有人夸她,她的脸颊就会发红。

e.en: Maple leaves {redden} dramatically in late October.
e.zh: 枫叶在十月底会变得火红。

e.en: His face {reddened} with embarrassment at the question.
e.zh: 听到这个问题,他的脸尴尬得通红。

e.en: The sky {reddened} as the sun dipped below the horizon.
e.zh: 太阳沉到地平线下,天空变得通红。

reddening.t:
n. 发红
v. 正在变红

e.en: I noticed a {reddening} patch of skin on his arm.
e.zh: 我注意到他手臂上有一块发红的皮肤。

e.en: The {reddening} sky warned of an approaching storm.
e.zh: 渐红的天空预示着暴风雨的来临。

e.en: We stopped for lunch in {Redding} on the way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在雷丁停下来吃午饭。

e.en: Otis {Redding} remains one of soul music's greatest voices.
e.zh: 奥蒂斯·雷丁仍是灵魂乐最伟大的歌手之一。

e.en: The puppy has a soft {reddish} brown coat.
e.zh: 那只小狗有一身柔软的红棕色毛。

e.en: Mars glowed with a faint {reddish} tint that night.
e.zh: 那晚火星泛着淡淡的红色光芒。

e.en: My cousin commutes from {Redditch} to Birmingham daily.
e.zh: 我表弟每天从雷迪奇通勤到伯明翰。

e.en: {Redditch} was historically famous for making needles.
e.zh: 雷迪奇历来以制造缝纫针闻名。

e.en: Helen {Reddy} sang the feminist anthem 'I Am Woman'.
e.zh: 海伦·雷迪演唱了女权主义颂歌《我是女人》。

e.en: Mr. {Reddy} runs the corner bookshop on Main Street.
e.zh: 雷迪先生经营着主街拐角的那家书店。

e.en: We plan to {redecorate} the living room next month.
e.zh: 我们打算下个月重新装修客厅。

e.en: She loves to {redecorate} her bedroom every spring.
e.zh: 她喜欢每年春天重新布置自己的卧室。

e.en: The cafe closed briefly for a complete {redecoration}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆短暂关闭以进行全面重新装修。

e.en: Her latest {redecoration} gave the office a modern feel.
e.zh: 她最近的重新装修让办公室焕然一新。

e.en: You can {redeem} these points for a free coffee.
e.zh: 你可以用这些积分兑换一杯免费咖啡。

e.en: He hopes to {redeem} himself with a strong performance.
e.zh: 他希望通过出色的表现来挽回自己的声誉。

redeemable.t: adj. 可兑换的、可赎回的

e.en: This voucher is {redeemable} at any partner store.
e.zh: 此优惠券可在任何合作门店兑换。

e.en: The coupon is {redeemable} only until the end of June.
e.zh: 这张优惠券仅在六月底前可兑换。

redeemed.t: adj. 已兑换的；已被救赎的

e.en: She {redeemed} her miles for a flight to Tokyo.
e.zh: 她用积分兑换了一张飞往东京的机票。

e.en: His final goal {redeemed} an otherwise disappointing match.
e.zh: 他最后的进球挽回了一场原本令人失望的比赛。

e.en: Many fans saw the new coach as a potential {redeemer}.
e.zh: 许多球迷把新教练视为有望救世的人物。

e.en: The statue of Christ the {Redeemer} overlooks Rio de Janeiro.
e.zh: 救世基督像俯瞰着里约热内卢。

redeeming.t: adj. 弥补缺点的；可取的

e.en: The film's only {redeeming} feature is its soundtrack.
e.zh: 这部电影唯一的可取之处是它的配乐。

e.en: Honesty is one of his most {redeeming} qualities.
e.zh: 诚实是他最值得称道的品质之一。

e.en: Streaming services {redefine} how we watch television today.
e.zh: 流媒体服务重新定义了我们看电视的方式。

e.en: She wants to {redefine} success on her own terms.
e.zh: 她想按照自己的标准重新定义成功。

e.en: The iPhone {redefined} what a mobile phone could be.
e.zh: iPhone重新定义了手机的可能性。

e.en: Working from home has {redefined} our daily routines.
e.zh: 居家办公重新定义了我们的日常生活。

e.en: Electric cars are {redefining} the auto industry worldwide.
e.zh: 电动汽车正在重新定义全球汽车行业。

e.en: She is {redefining} her role within the company.
e.zh: 她正在重新定义自己在公司中的角色。

e.en: Remote work demands a {redefinition} of office culture.
e.zh: 远程办公要求对办公室文化重新定义。

e.en: The textbook offers a {redefinition} of basic economic terms.
e.zh: 这本教科书对基本经济术语作了重新定义。

e.en: The film tells a powerful story of guilt and {redemption}.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于罪与救赎的动人故事。

e.en: Use this code at checkout for instant point {redemption}.
e.zh: 在结账时使用此代码即可立即兑换积分。

e.en: The novel ends on a quietly {redemptive} note.
e.zh: 这部小说以一种平静的救赎意味结尾。

e.en: His charity work had a {redemptive} effect on his image.
e.zh: 他的慈善工作对他的形象起到了挽回作用。

e.en: We need to {redeploy} the server after fixing the bug.
e.zh: 修复这个 bug 后我们需要重新部署服务器。

e.en: The army will {redeploy} troops to the eastern border.
e.zh: 军队将把部队重新部署到东部边境。

e.en: The {redeployment} of troops took several weeks to complete.
e.zh: 军队的重新部署花了几周才完成。

e.en: Staff {redeployment} helped the company avoid layoffs.
e.zh: 员工的重新调配帮助公司避免了裁员。

redeposit.t: v. 重新存入、再次沉积

e.en: You can {redeposit} the check if it bounced the first time.
e.zh: 如果支票第一次被退回，你可以重新存入。

e.en: The river will {redeposit} sediment further downstream.
e.zh: 河流会把沉积物重新沉积到下游。

e.en: The biologist published a {redescription} of the rare species.
e.zh: 这位生物学家发表了对该稀有物种的重新描述。

e.en: His paper offers a {redescription} of the historical event.
e.zh: 他的论文对这一历史事件作了重新表述。

e.en: The team plans to {redesign} the app's homepage next quarter.
e.zh: 团队计划下季度重新设计应用的首页。

e.en: The website {redesign} made navigation much easier.
e.zh: 网站的重新设计让导航变得简单多了。

redesignate.t: v. 重新命名、重新指定

e.en: The city will {redesignate} this area as a historic district.
e.zh: 市政府将把这片区域重新指定为历史街区。

e.en: They voted to {redesignate} the building for public use.
e.zh: 他们投票将该建筑重新指定为公共用途。

e.en: Apple {redesigned} the iPhone with a sleeker frame this year.
e.zh: 苹果今年把iPhone重新设计成更纤薄的边框。

e.en: The {redesigned} dashboard is much easier to read.
e.zh: 重新设计后的仪表盘更易于阅读。

ref.t:
n. 引用；参考（reference 的缩写）
v. 裁判执法

e.en: The {ref} blew the whistle to end the match.
e.zh: 裁判吹响哨声结束了比赛。

e.en: Players argued with the {ref} over the penalty call.
e.zh: 球员们就那次判罚与裁判争论。

e.en: Designers often {refashion} old denim into trendy jackets.
e.zh: 设计师常把旧牛仔布改造成时髦夹克。

e.en: The author tried to {refashion} the classic story for kids.
e.zh: 作者尝试把这个经典故事改写成儿童版。

e.en: She is {refashioning} her grandmother's dress for the wedding.
e.zh: 她正在把奶奶的旧裙子改造成婚礼礼服。

e.en: The startup is {refashioning} email for the mobile age.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在为移动时代重塑电子邮件。

e.en: Students gathered in the {refectory} for lunch.
e.zh: 学生们聚在食堂吃午餐。

e.en: The monastery's {refectory} dates back to the 1400s.
e.zh: 修道院的食堂可追溯到十五世纪。

refer.t:
v. 提到；参考
v. 转介；指代

e.en: Please {refer} to page twelve for the diagram.
e.zh: 请参阅第十二页的图示。

e.en: The doctor will {refer} you to a specialist.
e.zh: 医生会把你转诊给专科医生。

referable.t: adj. 可归因于的；可参照的

e.en: His symptoms are {referable} to a recent infection.
e.zh: 他的症状可归因于近期的一次感染。

e.en: Only complex cases are {referable} to the senior surgeon.
e.zh: 只有复杂病例才能转交给资深外科医生。

referee.t:
n. 裁判员
v. 当裁判

e.en: The {referee} showed the striker a yellow card.
e.zh: 裁判向那名前锋出示了黄牌。

e.en: She agreed to {referee} the journal submission this week.
e.zh: 她同意本周审阅这篇期刊投稿。

refereed.t:
adj. 经同行评审的
v. 执法（过去式）

e.en: He {refereed} three matches over the weekend.
e.zh: 他在周末执法了三场比赛。

e.en: The paper appeared in a {refereed} academic journal.
e.zh: 这篇论文发表在一份同行评审的学术期刊上。

refereeing.t:
n. 裁判执法
v. 担任裁判

e.en: {Refereeing} youth soccer requires patience and clear rules.
e.zh: 执法青少年足球比赛需要耐心和明确的规则。

e.en: She enjoys {refereeing} debates between her two kids.
e.zh: 她喜欢在两个孩子的争论中当裁判。

e.en: The {referees} reviewed the goal on video replay.
e.zh: 裁判们通过录像回放审核了那粒进球。

e.en: Please list three {referees} on your job application.
e.zh: 请在求职申请上列出三位推荐人。

reference.t:
n. 参考；引用
v. 引用；提及

e.en: Could you write me a {reference} for the job?
e.zh: 你能为我这份工作写一封推荐信吗?

e.en: The article makes a clever {reference} to Shakespeare.
e.zh: 这篇文章巧妙地引用了莎士比亚。

referenced.t:
adj. 被引用的
v. 引用（过去式）

e.en: Every claim in the report is carefully {referenced}.
e.zh: 报告中的每项论断都附有出处。

e.en: The song {referenced} a 90s cartoon many viewers loved.
e.zh: 这首歌提到了一部许多观众喜爱的九十年代动画。

e.en: Please email three professional {references} with your resume.
e.zh: 请随简历附上三位职场推荐人的联系方式。

e.en: The book includes plenty of pop culture {references}.
e.zh: 这本书里有许多流行文化的梗。

e.en: She kept {referencing} the original study in her talk.
e.zh: 她在演讲中不断引用那项原始研究。

e.en: Proper {referencing} is essential in academic writing.
e.zh: 在学术写作中,规范的引用至关重要。

referenda.t: n. 全民公投（referendum 的复数）

e.en: Several {referenda} on climate policy passed last year.
e.zh: 去年通过了好几项关于气候政策的全民公投。

e.en: Local {referenda} let voters decide on school funding.
e.zh: 地方公投让选民来决定学校经费问题。

referendum.t: n. 全民公投；全民投票

e.en: Voters approved the new constitution in a national {referendum}.
e.zh: 选民在全国公投中通过了新宪法。

e.en: The mayor called the election a {referendum} on housing.
e.zh: 市长将这次选举称为一次关于住房问题的公投。

e.en: The pronoun's {referent} is unclear in this sentence.
e.zh: 这个句子里代词指代的对象不清楚。

e.en: Each symbol on the map has a real-world {referent}.
e.zh: 地图上每个符号都对应现实中的一个事物。

e.en: The novel is dense with {referential} jokes about the 80s.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了关于八十年代的梗。

e.en: His art style is highly {referential} to Japanese anime.
e.zh: 他的艺术风格大量借鉴了日本动漫。

e.en: My doctor gave me a {referral} to a cardiologist.
e.zh: 我的医生给我开了转诊心脏科的单子。

e.en: The app rewards users for each successful {referral}.
e.zh: 这款应用每成功推荐一位用户都会给予奖励。

e.en: My friend {referred} me to her hairstylist.
e.zh: 我朋友把她的发型师介绍给了我。

e.en: The professor {referred} to a recent study on memory.
e.zh: 教授提到了一项关于记忆的最新研究。

referring.t: v. 提及；指代（现在分词）

e.en: Are you {referring} to the email I sent yesterday?
e.zh: 你是在说我昨天发的那封邮件吗?

e.en: The teacher kept {referring} to examples from the textbook.
e.zh: 老师不断引用课本上的例子。

refers.t: v. 提到；指代（第三人称单数）

e.en: This term {refers} to data stored in the cloud.
e.zh: 这个术语指的是存储在云端的数据。

e.en: He often {refers} to his grandmother's old recipes.
e.zh: 他常常提到他奶奶的旧食谱。

refil.t: n./v. 再次装满（refill 的异拼）

e.en: The barista offered a free {refil} of coffee.
e.zh: 咖啡师提供免费续杯咖啡。

e.en: Please grab a {refil} of water from the cooler.
e.zh: 请从饮水机那边再接一杯水。

refill.t:
v. 再次装满
n. 续杯；替换装

e.en: Can I get a {refill} on my iced tea?
e.zh: 我的冰红茶可以续杯吗?

e.en: The pharmacy will {refill} your prescription tomorrow.
e.zh: 药房明天会给你续配处方药。

refillable.t: adj. 可再次装填的；可续杯的

e.en: I bought a {refillable} water bottle to save plastic.
e.zh: 我买了一个可重复装水的水瓶以减少塑料。

e.en: The store sells {refillable} ink cartridges for printers.
e.zh: 这家店出售可再填充的打印机墨盒。

e.en: Many homeowners {refinance} when interest rates drop.
e.zh: 利率下降时许多业主会选择再融资。

e.en: They plan to {refinance} the loan to lower payments.
e.zh: 他们打算给贷款再融资以降低月供。

e.en: {Refinancing} her mortgage saved her two hundred dollars monthly.
e.zh: 为房贷再融资让她每月节省了两百美元。

e.en: The company is {refinancing} its debt at a better rate.
e.zh: 公司正以更优利率为债务进行再融资。

refine.t:
v. 改进；优化
v. 提炼；精炼

e.en: We need to {refine} the design before the launch.
e.zh: 我们需要在发布前完善这个设计。

e.en: The chef worked hard to {refine} her signature sauce.
e.zh: 这位厨师努力改良了她的招牌酱汁。

e.en: She has a {refined} taste in classical music.
e.zh: 她在古典音乐方面有着高雅的品味。

e.en: The team {refined} the algorithm to run twice as fast.
e.zh: 团队优化了算法,使其运行速度翻倍。

refinement.t:
n. 改良；优化
n. 优雅；精致

e.en: The new model is a major {refinement} over the last one.
e.zh: 新款相比上一款是一次重大改进。

e.en: Her writing has a quiet {refinement} that readers love.
e.zh: 她的文笔有一种含蓄的优雅,深受读者喜爱。

e.en: The oil {refiner} reported record profits this quarter.
e.zh: 这家炼油公司本季度公布了创纪录的利润。

e.en: He works as a sugar {refiner} on the coast.
e.zh: 他在海边从事炼糖工作。

e.en: Several oil {refineries} shut down due to the storm.
e.zh: 几家炼油厂因这场风暴而停工。

e.en: The country has plans to build two new {refineries}.
e.zh: 该国计划新建两座炼油厂。

e.en: Smoke from the {refinery} drifts over the city at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时炼油厂的烟雾飘过城市上空。

e.en: The {refinery} processes crude oil into gasoline and diesel.
e.zh: 这家炼油厂把原油加工成汽油和柴油。

refining.t:
n. 提炼；精炼
v. 改进

e.en: He spent months {refining} his startup pitch.
e.zh: 他花了几个月时间打磨自己的创业演讲。

e.en: {Refining} crude oil produces fuels and many chemicals.
e.zh: 炼制原油可产出燃料和多种化工产品。

refinish.t: v. 重新打磨；翻新表面

e.en: We plan to {refinish} the hardwood floors next month.
e.zh: 我们打算下个月重新打磨硬木地板。

e.en: He hired a pro to {refinish} the antique table.
e.zh: 他请了专业师傅重新翻新那张古董桌子。

refinished.t:
adj. 翻新过的
v. 翻新（过去式）

e.en: The carpenter {refinished} the staircase with a darker stain.
e.zh: 木匠用更深的着色剂重新翻新了楼梯。

e.en: Their {refinished} kitchen cabinets look brand new.
e.zh: 他们重新翻新过的厨柜看起来焕然一新。

refit.t:
v. 翻新；整修
n. 整修

e.en: The shipyard will {refit} the ferry with cleaner engines.
e.zh: 船厂将为这艘渡轮换装更清洁的发动机。

e.en: After the {refit}, the cafe reopened with new decor.
e.zh: 重新装修后,这家咖啡馆以新装修开业。

e.en: The navy is {refitting} the destroyer with modern radar.
e.zh: 海军正在为这艘驱逐舰加装现代化雷达。

e.en: {Refitting} the office took longer than expected.
e.zh: 重新整修办公室比预期花了更长时间。

refix.t: v. 重新固定；重新安装

e.en: The plumber came back to {refix} the leaky pipe.
e.zh: 水管工又来一次,重新修好那根漏水的管子。

e.en: We had to {refix} the shelf after it fell down.
e.zh: 架子掉下来后,我们不得不重新把它装好。

e.en: Economists debated whether {reflation} would boost the recovery.
e.zh: 经济学家们争论再通胀政策是否能促进复苏。

e.en: The central bank's {reflation} policy lifted stock prices.
e.zh: 央行的再通胀政策推高了股价。

reflect.t:
v. 反映；体现
v. 反射；思考

e.en: Take a moment to {reflect} on what went wrong.
e.zh: 花点时间反思一下哪里出了问题。

e.en: Mirrors {reflect} light back into the dim hallway.
e.zh: 镜子把光线反射回昏暗的走廊。

e.en: White surfaces have higher {reflectance} than dark ones.
e.zh: 白色表面的反射率比深色表面更高。

e.en: Engineers measured the panel's {reflectance} under sunlight.
e.zh: 工程师测量了面板在阳光下的反射率。

reflected.t:
adj. 被反射的
v. 反映（过去式）

e.en: The mountains were beautifully {reflected} in the still lake.
e.zh: 群山美丽地倒映在平静的湖面上。

e.en: His tired face {reflected} the stress of a long week.
e.zh: 他疲惫的脸上写满了一周的压力。

reflecting.t: v. 反射；反映；思考（现在分词）

e.en: She sat by the window, {reflecting} on her career.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边,思考着自己的职业生涯。

e.en: The puddle was {reflecting} the neon signs above.
e.zh: 水洼倒映着上方的霓虹灯招牌。

reflection.t:
n. 倒影；反射
n. 反思；体现

e.en: She caught her {reflection} in the shop window.
e.zh: 她在橱窗里瞥见了自己的倒影。

e.en: After some {reflection}, he decided to take the job.
e.zh: 经过一番思考,他决定接下这份工作。

e.en: The lake's surface shimmered with {reflections} of the trees.
e.zh: 湖面闪烁着树木的倒影。

e.en: Her memoir shares honest {reflections} on motherhood.
e.zh: 她的回忆录分享了关于为人母亲的真实感悟。

reflective.t:
adj. 反光的
adj. 善于反思的

e.en: Cyclists should wear {reflective} gear at night.
e.zh: 骑车人在夜间应穿戴反光装备。

e.en: He's in a {reflective} mood after his birthday.
e.zh: 他过完生日后心情很沉静、爱思考。

e.en: She gazed {reflectively} out at the rainy garden.
e.zh: 她若有所思地望着雨中的花园。

e.en: He spoke {reflectively} about the lessons of the year.
e.zh: 他若有所思地谈起这一年的经验教训。

e.en: The essay shows a quiet {reflectiveness} about growing up online.
e.zh: 这篇文章流露出对在网络中长大的静静反思。

e.en: Her writing is praised for its depth and {reflectiveness}.
e.zh: 她的写作因深度和反思性而受到赞扬。

e.en: Snow has high {reflectivity}, which keeps the air cool.
e.zh: 雪的反射率很高,因此能保持空气凉爽。

e.en: Engineers measured the {reflectivity} of the new solar panel coating.
e.zh: 工程师测量了新型太阳能板涂层的反射率。

e.en: My bike has a red {reflector} on the back fender.
e.zh: 我的自行车后挡泥板上有一个红色反光片。

e.en: The telescope uses a curved {reflector} to focus light.
e.zh: 这台望远镜使用弯曲反射镜来聚焦光线。

reflects.t: v. 反映；反射（reflect 第三人称单数）

e.en: The lake {reflects} the mountains perfectly on a calm morning.
e.zh: 在宁静的清晨,湖面把群山完美地映照出来。

e.en: This price increase {reflects} rising shipping costs.
e.zh: 这次涨价反映了运输成本的上升。

reflex.t:
n. 反射；本能反应
adj. 反射的

e.en: The doctor tapped my knee to test my {reflex}.
e.zh: 医生敲了敲我的膝盖来测试我的反射。

e.en: Checking my phone has become a {reflex} I can't break.
e.zh: 看手机已经成了我戒不掉的本能反应。

reflexion.t: n. 反射；深思（reflection 的旧式拼写）

e.en: After long {reflexion}, she decided to leave the company.
e.zh: 经过长时间的反思,她决定离开公司。

e.en: The book invites quiet {reflexion} on what really matters.
e.zh: 这本书引导读者静静思考真正重要的事情。

reflexive.t: adj. 反身的（语法）；条件反射的

e.en: Pulling your hand from a hot stove is a {reflexive} action.
e.zh: 从热炉子上把手缩回是一种本能动作。

e.en: In Spanish, "lavarse" is a {reflexive} verb meaning to wash oneself.
e.zh: 在西班牙语中,“lavarse”是表示洗自己的反身动词。

e.en: He {reflexively} apologized when someone bumped into him.
e.zh: 有人撞到他时,他下意识地道歉。

e.en: She {reflexively} reached for her phone the moment it buzzed.
e.zh: 手机一震动,她就本能地伸手去拿。

e.en: Good researchers practice {reflexivity} about their own biases.
e.zh: 优秀的研究者会反思自己的偏见。

e.en: The theory emphasizes {reflexivity} between markets and beliefs.
e.zh: 该理论强调市场与信念之间的相互影响。

e.en: She booked a foot {reflexology} session after her long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,她预约了一次足部反射疗法。

e.en: Some practitioners claim {reflexology} can relieve everyday stress.
e.zh: 一些治疗师声称反射疗法可以缓解日常压力。

refloat.t: v. 使（搁浅船只）重新浮起

e.en: Tugboats worked all night to {refloat} the stranded cargo ship.
e.zh: 拖船彻夜工作,试图让搁浅的货船重新浮起。

e.en: The team hopes to {refloat} the failing startup with new funding.
e.zh: 团队希望用新资金让这家陷入困境的创业公司重新启动。

reflux.t:
n. 反流；胃酸倒流
v. 回流

e.en: Spicy food gives me painful acid {reflux} at night.
e.zh: 辛辣食物让我晚上胃酸反流难受。

e.en: The chemist heated the mixture under {reflux} for two hours.
e.zh: 化学家把混合物回流加热了两个小时。

refocus.t: v. 重新聚焦；重新关注

e.en: After the break, I tried to {refocus} on my essay.
e.zh: 休息后,我试着重新专注于写论文。

e.en: The company will {refocus} its strategy on mobile users.
e.zh: 公司将把战略重点重新放在移动端用户上。

e.en: He needs to {refocuse} his energy on what really matters.
e.zh: 他需要把精力重新放在真正重要的事情上。

e.en: The team will {refocuse} the product around younger customers.
e.zh: 团队会让产品重新围绕年轻用户来设计。

refocusing.t: v. 重新聚焦；重新定位

e.en: She is {refocusing} her career on climate research.
e.zh: 她正把职业方向重新转向气候研究。

e.en: The startup is {refocusing} after losing its biggest client.
e.zh: 失去最大客户后,这家初创公司正在重新调整方向。

e.en: Please {refold} the map before putting it back in the glove box.
e.zh: 请把地图重新折好再放回杂物箱。

e.en: I had to {refold} all the shirts the kids messed up.
e.zh: 我得把孩子们弄乱的衬衫全部重新叠好。

e.en: Volunteers are working to {reforest} the burned hillside.
e.zh: 志愿者正在努力让被烧毁的山坡重新长出树林。

e.en: The government plans to {reforest} thousands of hectares this decade.
e.zh: 政府计划在这十年内重新造林数千公顷。

reforestation.t: n. 重新造林；森林再生

e.en: The {reforestation} project planted a million trees last year.
e.zh: 该再造林项目去年种下了一百万棵树。

e.en: Many companies fund {reforestation} to offset their carbon emissions.
e.zh: 许多公司资助再造林项目以抵消碳排放。

reform.t:
n. 改革；改良
v. 改革；改造

e.en: The new mayor promised to {reform} the city's housing policy.
e.zh: 新市长承诺改革该市的住房政策。

e.en: Education {reform} has been debated for decades.
e.zh: 教育改革已经被讨论了几十年。

reformat.t: v. 重新格式化（磁盘、文件）

e.en: I had to {reformat} the document before sending it to the client.
e.zh: 在发给客户之前,我得把文档重新排版。

e.en: You may need to {reformat} the USB drive before using it.
e.zh: 使用前你可能需要先格式化这个U盘。

reformation.t:
n. 改革；改造
（Reformation）宗教改革

e.en: The party underwent a complete {reformation} after the election loss.
e.zh: 该党在选举失败后进行了彻底的重组。

e.en: History class covered the Protestant {Reformation} this week.
e.zh: 这周的历史课讲到了新教改革。

reformatory.t:
n. 少年教养院
adj. 改良的

e.en: In the 1800s, troubled boys were sent to a {reformatory}.
e.zh: 在19世纪,问题少年会被送到教养院。

e.en: The old {reformatory} building now houses a small museum.
e.zh: 那座旧教养院的建筑现在改成了一座小博物馆。

reformed.t: adj. 改革后的；改过自新的

e.en: He's a {reformed} smoker who hasn't touched a cigarette in years.
e.zh: 他已经戒了烟,好几年都没碰过香烟了。

e.en: The committee {reformed} the rules to be fairer to newcomers.
e.zh: 委员会修改了规则,让新人更公平。

e.en: She built her career as a tireless education {reformer}.
e.zh: 她以不知疲倦的教育改革者身份建立了自己的事业。

e.en: The young {reformer} pushed the council to update outdated laws.
e.zh: 这位年轻的改革者推动议会更新过时的法律。

e.en: The minister is {reforming} the country's tax system this year.
e.zh: 部长今年正在改革国家的税收制度。

e.en: They are {reforming} the band for a one-night reunion show.
e.zh: 他们正在重组乐队,办一场一次性的重聚演出。

e.en: Critics accused the party of empty {reformism} without real change.
e.zh: 批评者指责该党只是空谈改革,没有真正的变革。

e.en: His brand of cautious {reformism} appeals to moderate voters.
e.zh: 他那种谨慎的改良主义吸引了温和派选民。

reformist.t:
n. 改良主义者
adj. 改良主义的

e.en: The {reformist} candidate won by promising clean government.
e.zh: 这位改革派候选人凭借廉洁政府的承诺赢得了选举。

e.en: She belongs to the {reformist} wing of the party.
e.zh: 她属于该党的改革派。

reforms.t: n./v. 改革（reform 的复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: The new healthcare {reforms} take effect next January.
e.zh: 新的医疗改革将于明年一月生效。

e.en: He {reforms} every system he touches at the company.
e.zh: 他在公司接手的每个系统都会被他改革一遍。

reformulate.t: v. 重新表述；重新制定

e.en: The chemists had to {reformulate} the shampoo without sulfates.
e.zh: 化学家不得不重新配制不含硫酸盐的洗发水。

e.en: Let me {reformulate} the question in simpler terms.
e.zh: 让我用更简单的话重新表达这个问题。

reformulated.t: v. 重新表述；重新配制

e.en: The brand {reformulated} its sunscreen to feel less greasy.
e.zh: 该品牌重新调整了防晒霜的配方,让它不那么油腻。

e.en: She {reformulated} her argument after the professor's feedback.
e.zh: 听了教授的反馈后,她重新组织了自己的论点。

reformulation.t: n. 重新表述；重新制定

e.en: The {reformulation} of the drink reduced its sugar by half.
e.zh: 这款饮料的重新配方让糖分减少了一半。

e.en: His {reformulation} of the theory made it much easier to apply.
e.zh: 他对该理论的重新表述让它更容易应用。

refound.t: v. 重新创立；重新建立

e.en: The exiles returned to {refound} their old village by the river.
e.zh: 流亡者回来重建他们位于河边的旧村庄。

e.en: After bankruptcy, he hopes to {refound} the studio with new partners.
e.zh: 破产之后,他希望与新伙伴重新创立工作室。

e.en: Glass prisms {refract} sunlight into a rainbow of colors.
e.zh: 玻璃棱镜会把阳光折射成一道彩虹般的颜色。

e.en: Water droplets {refract} light, which is why rainbows form.
e.zh: 水滴会折射光线,这就是彩虹形成的原因。

refracted.t:
adj. 经折射的
v. 折射

e.en: The straw looks bent because light is {refracted} by the water.
e.zh: 吸管看起来是弯的,因为光线被水折射了。

e.en: Her experiences are {refracted} through the lens of her childhood.
e.zh: 她的经历都通过童年的视角折射出来。

e.en: A {refracting} telescope uses lenses instead of mirrors.
e.zh: 折射式望远镜用的是透镜,而不是反射镜。

e.en: The crystal hangs in the window, {refracting} morning light.
e.zh: 水晶挂在窗边,折射着清晨的阳光。

e.en: The {refraction} of light in water makes objects look closer.
e.zh: 水中光的折射会让物体看起来更近。

e.en: My eye doctor measured the {refraction} of my eyes today.
e.zh: 我的眼科医生今天测了我的眼睛屈光度。

refractive.t: adj. 折射的；有折射力的

e.en: Diamonds have a very high {refractive} index, which gives them sparkle.
e.zh: 钻石的折射率非常高,所以才那么闪亮。

e.en: He had laser {refractive} surgery to correct his nearsightedness.
e.zh: 他做了激光屈光手术来矫正近视。

refractor.t: n. 折射望远镜；折射体

e.en: Beginners often start astronomy with a small {refractor} telescope.
e.zh: 天文初学者常常从一台小型折射望远镜入门。

e.en: The antique {refractor} still produces beautifully sharp images.
e.zh: 那台老式折射望远镜成像依然非常清晰。

refractory.t:
adj. 难处理的；耐火的
n. 耐火材料

e.en: His asthma is {refractory} to most standard inhaler treatments.
e.zh: 他的哮喘对大多数常规吸入治疗都没有反应。

e.en: The kiln is lined with {refractory} bricks that resist extreme heat.
e.zh: 窑炉内壁铺着耐高温的耐火砖。

refrain.t:
v. 克制；抑制
n. 副歌

e.en: Please {refrain} from using your phone during the performance.
e.zh: 演出期间请勿使用手机。

e.en: The song's catchy {refrain} got stuck in my head all day.
e.zh: 那首歌朗朗上口的副歌在我脑子里转了一整天。

refrains.t: v. 克制；抑制（第三人称单数）

e.en: She politely {refrains} from commenting on her coworkers' politics.
e.zh: 她礼貌地避免对同事的政治观点发表评论。

e.en: The choir sang two cheerful {refrains} between the verses.
e.zh: 合唱团在主歌之间唱了两段欢快的副歌。

reframing.t: v. 重新表述；重新审视

e.en: Therapy taught me the value of {reframing} negative thoughts.
e.zh: 心理咨询让我体会到重新审视负面想法的价值。

e.en: She is {reframing} the failure as a useful learning experience.
e.zh: 她正把这次失败重新看作一次宝贵的学习经历。

refresh.t: v. 刷新（页面）；使恢复精神

e.en: Try to {refresh} the page if the video doesn't load.
e.zh: 如果视频加载不出来,试着刷新一下页面。

e.en: A short walk outside can {refresh} your mind during work.
e.zh: 工作间隙到外面走一小会儿可以让头脑清醒。

refreshed.t: adj. 恢复精神的；焕然一新的

e.en: I felt completely {refreshed} after a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 美美睡了一觉后,我感觉精神完全恢复了。

e.en: She {refreshed} her inbox to check for new messages.
e.zh: 她刷新了一下收件箱,看看有没有新邮件。

refresher.t: n. 复习课；提神的东西

e.en: The team took a quick {refresher} course on workplace safety.
e.zh: 团队上了一节简短的工作场所安全复习课。

e.en: I need a {refresher} on French grammar before my trip to Paris.
e.zh: 去巴黎之前,我需要把法语语法复习一下。

refreshes.t: v. 刷新；使恢复精神（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app automatically {refreshes} the news feed every minute.
e.zh: 这款应用每分钟会自动刷新新闻信息流。

e.en: A cold lemonade really {refreshes} you on a hot afternoon.
e.zh: 在炎热的下午,一杯冰柠檬水真能让人神清气爽。

refreshing.t: adj. 清新的；令人耳目一新的

e.en: It's {refreshing} to hear honest feedback for a change.
e.zh: 难得听到坦诚的反馈,真让人觉得耳目一新。

e.en: Nothing beats a {refreshing} swim on a hot day.
e.zh: 炎热的日子里,没有什么比一场清爽的游泳更舒服了。

e.en: The new manager is {refreshingly} direct with the team.
e.zh: 新经理对团队的态度直率得让人耳目一新。

e.en: Her debut novel is {refreshingly} free of clichés.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说难得地没有陈词滥调。

e.en: After the hike, a cold drink was a welcome {refreshment}.
e.zh: 徒步之后,一杯冷饮真是难得的解渴享受。

e.en: Light {refreshment} will be served after the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座结束后将提供简单的茶点。

e.en: Free {refreshments} are available in the lobby during the break.
e.zh: 中场休息时大厅提供免费茶点。

e.en: We brought {refreshments} for the kids' soccer game.
e.zh: 我们为孩子们的足球比赛带了点心和饮料。

refrigerant.t:
n. 制冷剂
adj. 冷却的

e.en: The technician checked the {refrigerant} levels in the air conditioner.
e.zh: 技术员检查了空调里的制冷剂含量。

e.en: Older fridges used a {refrigerant} that harmed the ozone layer.
e.zh: 老式冰箱使用的制冷剂会破坏臭氧层。

e.en: Please {refrigerate} the leftovers within two hours.
e.zh: 请在两小时内把剩菜放进冰箱冷藏。

e.en: You don't need to {refrigerate} unopened soy sauce.
e.zh: 未开封的酱油不需要冷藏。

refrigerated.t:
adj. 冷藏的
v. 冷藏（refrigerate 的过去式）

e.en: The vaccines must be kept {refrigerated} during transport.
e.zh: 疫苗在运输过程中必须保持冷藏。

e.en: She grabbed a {refrigerated} sandwich from the convenience store.
e.zh: 她从便利店拿了一个冷藏三明治。

e.en: Modern {refrigeration} changed how we store food at home.
e.zh: 现代制冷技术改变了我们在家储存食物的方式。

e.en: The truck broke down and lost {refrigeration} for hours.
e.zh: 卡车坏了,制冷功能停了好几个小时。

e.en: There's leftover pizza in the {refrigerator} if you're hungry.
e.zh: 如果你饿了,冰箱里还有剩披萨。

e.en: Our new {refrigerator} is much quieter than the old one.
e.zh: 我们的新冰箱比旧的安静多了。

e.en: Smart {refrigerators} can now track expiration dates automatically.
e.zh: 智能冰箱现在可以自动记录食物的保质期。

e.en: The store offers free delivery on all {refrigerators} this week.
e.zh: 本周所有冰箱在该店都享受免费配送。

e.en: We stopped to {refuel} the car before the long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶前我们停下来给车加油。

e.en: Snacks help me {refuel} after an intense workout.
e.zh: 剧烈运动后吃点零食能帮我恢复体力。

e.en: The plane is {refueling} at the gate before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机正在登机口加油,准备起飞。

e.en: A quick coffee break is my way of {refueling} mid-afternoon.
e.zh: 喝杯咖啡是我下午补充精力的方式。

e.en: The fighter jet performed mid-air {refuelling} during the mission.
e.zh: 战斗机在任务中进行了空中加油。

e.en: They paused for {refuelling} halfway through the road trip.
e.zh: 他们在公路旅行途中停下来加油。

e.en: The hikers took {refuge} in a cabin during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中,徒步者躲进了一间小木屋。

e.en: Books are my {refuge} from a stressful week.
e.zh: 书是我从忙碌一周中逃离的避风港。

e.en: The {refugee} family finally received permission to settle here.
e.zh: 这个难民家庭终于获准在这里定居。

e.en: She volunteers at a {refugee} center every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在难民中心做志愿者。

e.en: Thousands of {refugees} crossed the border seeking safety.
e.zh: 成千上万的难民越过边境寻求安全。

e.en: The charity provides housing and food for {refugees}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为难民提供住所和食物。

e.en: Wildlife {refuges} protect endangered species from human activity.
e.zh: 野生动物保护区保护濒危物种免受人类活动的影响。

e.en: Mountain {refuges} offer climbers a place to rest overnight.
e.zh: 山间避难小屋为登山者提供过夜休息的地方。

refulgent.t: adj. 灿烂的；光辉的（文学用语）

e.en: The {refulgent} sunrise lit up the entire valley.
e.zh: 灿烂的日出照亮了整个山谷。

e.en: She wore a {refulgent} gown that caught everyone's eye.
e.zh: 她穿着一件光彩夺目的礼服,吸引了所有人的目光。

refund.t:
n. 退款
v. 退还（款项）

e.en: I requested a {refund} after the package arrived damaged.
e.zh: 包裹送到时已损坏,我申请了退款。

e.en: The airline issued a full {refund} for the cancelled flight.
e.zh: 航空公司为取消的航班全额退款。

e.en: This ticket is {refundable} up to 24 hours before departure.
e.zh: 这张票在起飞前24小时内可以退款。

e.en: The deposit is not {refundable} once the booking is confirmed.
e.zh: 预订一旦确认,押金概不退还。

refunds.t:
n. 退款（复数）
v. 退款

e.en: The store processes {refunds} within five business days.
e.zh: 商店会在五个工作日内处理退款。

e.en: She always {refunds} customers who aren't satisfied with the service.
e.zh: 对服务不满意的顾客她都会退款。

e.en: They plan to {refurbish} the old library next summer.
e.zh: 他们计划明年夏天翻新这座旧图书馆。

e.en: The company will {refurbish} returned phones and resell them cheaper.
e.zh: 公司会把退回的手机翻新后以更低价格转售。

e.en: I bought a {refurbished} laptop for half the original price.
e.zh: 我以原价的一半买了一台翻新笔记本。

e.en: The hotel reopened after being completely {refurbished}.
e.zh: 酒店在彻底翻新后重新开业。

refurbishes.t: v. 翻新（第三人称单数）

e.en: This shop {refurbishes} vintage cameras and sells them online.
e.zh: 这家店翻新老式相机并在网上出售。

e.en: The city {refurbishes} its public parks every few years.
e.zh: 市政府每隔几年就会翻新公共公园。

e.en: They're {refurbishing} the kitchen before putting the house on sale.
e.zh: 他们在卖房之前先翻新厨房。

e.en: The team is {refurbishing} old bicycles for charity donations.
e.zh: 团队正在翻新旧自行车以捐赠给慈善机构。

e.en: The cafe closed for a month-long {refurbishment}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆因为为期一个月的翻新而停业。

e.en: The stadium's {refurbishment} cost over fifty million dollars.
e.zh: 体育场的翻新工程耗资超过五千万美元。

e.en: Several {refurbishments} have modernized the historic theater.
e.zh: 多次翻新让这座历史悠久的剧院焕然一新。

e.en: The hotel chain announced major {refurbishments} across its properties.
e.zh: 该酒店集团宣布将对旗下物业进行大规模翻新。

e.en: We decided to {refurnish} the living room with modern pieces.
e.zh: 我们决定用现代家具重新布置客厅。

e.en: After the move, they had to completely {refurnish} the apartment.
e.zh: 搬家后,他们不得不重新置办公寓里的全部家具。

e.en: His {refusal} to apologize made the situation worse.
e.zh: 他拒绝道歉让情况变得更糟。

e.en: The bank's {refusal} of her loan application was disappointing.
e.zh: 银行拒绝她的贷款申请让她很失望。

e.en: After several {refusals}, she finally got an interview.
e.zh: 被拒绝多次后,她终于得到了一次面试机会。

e.en: The committee documented all {refusals} for legal review.
e.zh: 委员会记录了所有拒绝的情况以备法律审查。

refuse.t:
v. 拒绝
n. 垃圾；废物

e.en: I {refuse} to work weekends without extra pay.
e.zh: 没有额外报酬,我拒绝周末加班。

e.en: Please put the kitchen {refuse} in the green bin.
e.zh: 请把厨房垃圾放进绿色垃圾桶。

e.en: She {refused} the job offer because the salary was too low.
e.zh: 她拒绝了那份工作,因为工资太低。

e.en: The bouncer {refused} entry to anyone without ID.
e.zh: 保安拒绝任何没有身份证件的人进入。

e.en: He became a {refusenik} after objecting to the new policy.
e.zh: 他因反对新政策而成了拒不服从者。

e.en: The lone {refusenik} on the team blocked the unanimous vote.
e.zh: 团队中那个唯一的反对者阻止了一致投票。

refuses.t: v. 拒绝（第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat {refuses} to eat anything but tuna.
e.zh: 我的猫除了金枪鱼什么都不肯吃。

e.en: The app {refuses} to open after the latest update.
e.zh: 最新更新后,这个应用怎么都打不开。

e.en: She kept {refusing} his calls all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末她一直拒接他的电话。

e.en: The printer is {refusing} to recognize the new ink cartridge.
e.zh: 打印机一直识别不出新装的墨盒。

e.en: His essay offered a clear {refutation} of the popular theory.
e.zh: 他的文章对那个流行理论进行了明确的反驳。

e.en: The scientist published a detailed {refutation} of the study's claims.
e.zh: 科学家发表了一篇详细反驳该研究结论的文章。

e.en: It's hard to {refute} evidence captured on video.
e.zh: 视频里录下来的证据很难反驳。

e.en: The lawyer tried to {refute} every point the witness made.
e.zh: 律师试图反驳证人提出的每一个观点。

e.en: Recent studies have {refuted} that long-held assumption.
e.zh: 近期的研究推翻了那个长期以来的假设。

e.en: She {refuted} the rumor with a public statement.
e.zh: 她发表公开声明反驳了那个谣言。

refutes.t: v. 驳斥（第三人称单数）

e.en: This data clearly {refutes} the company's earlier claims.
e.zh: 这些数据明确反驳了该公司先前的说法。

e.en: His new book {refutes} several common myths about sleep.
e.zh: 他的新书反驳了几个关于睡眠的常见误解。

e.en: She spent the meeting {refuting} every objection raised.
e.zh: 整个会议她都在反驳别人提出的每一个反对意见。

e.en: The researcher published a paper {refuting} earlier findings.
e.zh: 研究员发表了一篇论文,反驳了早先的研究结论。

reg.t: n. 注册号；法规（regulation/registration 的缩写）

e.en: Can you read me the car's {reg} number?
e.zh: 你能把这辆车的车牌号念给我听吗?

e.en: I checked the vehicle {reg} before signing the rental papers.
e.zh: 签租车合同前,我核对了车辆的注册号。

e.en: It took months for him to {regain} his strength after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他花了好几个月才恢复体力。

e.en: The team hopes to {regain} the championship title this year.
e.zh: 球队希望今年能重新夺回冠军头衔。

e.en: She slowly {regained} consciousness in the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院里慢慢恢复了意识。

e.en: The company {regained} customer trust after the public apology.
e.zh: 公司公开道歉后重新赢得了顾客的信任。

e.en: He's slowly {regaining} confidence after the failed project.
e.zh: 项目失败后,他正慢慢恢复自信。

e.en: The currency is {regaining} value against the dollar this month.
e.zh: 本月该货币兑美元的汇率正在回升。

regains.t: v. 重新获得（第三人称单数）

e.en: The patient usually {regains} mobility within a few weeks.
e.zh: 病人通常在几周内就能恢复活动能力。

e.en: Each time she falls, she {regains} her balance quickly.
e.zh: 每次摔倒后,她都能很快恢复平衡。

regal.t: adj. 帝王的；庄严华贵的

e.en: She walked into the room with a {regal} air.
e.zh: 她带着一种王者风范走进了房间。

e.en: The old hotel still has a {regal} charm about it.
e.zh: 这家老酒店至今仍透着一股皇家气派。

regale.t: v. 盛情款待；讲故事取悦

e.en: Grandpa loves to {regale} us with stories from his youth.
e.zh: 爷爷喜欢用他年轻时的故事逗我们开心。

e.en: The host will {regale} guests with wine and live music.
e.zh: 主人将用美酒和现场音乐款待客人。

regalia.t: n. 王权标志；盛装礼服

e.en: The graduates wore full academic {regalia} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 毕业生们身着完整的学位礼服参加典礼。

e.en: The king appeared in royal {regalia} at the coronation.
e.zh: 国王在加冕典礼上身着皇室盛装出现。

e.en: There was a quiet {regality} in the way she spoke.
e.zh: 她说话的方式中透着一种内敛的高贵气质。

e.en: The palace's {regality} impressed every visitor who walked through.
e.zh: 宫殿的恢宏气派让每一位走进来的游客都赞叹不已。

e.en: She entered the ballroom {regally}, head held high.
e.zh: 她仪态万方地走进舞厅,昂首挺胸。

e.en: The old cat sat {regally} on the velvet cushion.
e.zh: 那只老猫端庄地坐在天鹅绒垫子上。

regard.t:
v. 看待；认为
n. 尊重；问候

e.en: Many fans {regard} her as the best player of the decade.
e.zh: 许多粉丝认为她是十年来最棒的球员。

e.en: Please send my warm {regard} to your parents.
e.zh: 请代我向你父母致以亲切的问候。

e.en: She is widely {regarded} as an expert in her field.
e.zh: 她被普遍认为是该领域的专家。

e.en: The novel is {regarded} as a classic of modern literature.
e.zh: 这部小说被视为现代文学的经典之作。

e.en: I have a quick question {regarding} your last email.
e.zh: 关于你上一封邮件,我有个小问题。

e.en: The policy {regarding} remote work has changed this year.
e.zh: 今年关于远程办公的政策有所变化。

e.en: We're going hiking tomorrow {regardless} of the weather.
e.zh: 不管天气如何,我们明天都要去远足。

e.en: She decided to apply {regardless} of the low acceptance rate.
e.zh: 尽管录取率很低,她还是决定申请。

regards.t:
n. 问候；致意
v. 看待

e.en: Please give my {regards} to your parents tonight.
e.zh: 请今晚代我向你父母问好。

e.en: She signed the email with "Best {regards}, Anna."
e.zh: 她在邮件末尾署名为"此致敬礼,安娜"。

e.en: The annual {regatta} drew sailors from across the coast.
e.zh: 一年一度的帆船赛吸引了沿海各地的水手。

e.en: We watched the {regatta} from a hilltop café.
e.zh: 我们在山顶咖啡馆观看帆船比赛。

regency.t: n. 摄政时期；摄政统治

e.en: The novel is set during the English {regency} period.
e.zh: 这部小说以英国摄政时期为背景。

e.en: A {regency} was established until the prince came of age.
e.zh: 在王子成年前设立了摄政机构。

regenerate.t: v. 再生；重新生成（数据、页面）

e.en: Some lizards can {regenerate} a lost tail completely.
e.zh: 有些蜥蜴能够完全再生失去的尾巴。

e.en: The mayor hopes to {regenerate} the old industrial district.
e.zh: 市长希望振兴这片老工业区。

regenerated.t: v. 再生（过去式）；已重新生成

e.en: The forest slowly {regenerated} after the wildfire.
e.zh: 森林在大火过后慢慢恢复了生机。

e.en: Scientists {regenerated} damaged tissue using stem cells.
e.zh: 科学家利用干细胞再生了受损组织。

regenerating.t: v. 正在再生；重新生成中

e.en: The skin is {regenerating} faster than expected.
e.zh: 皮肤的再生速度比预期要快。

e.en: They are {regenerating} the riverside with new parks.
e.zh: 他们正用新公园来振兴河滨地区。

e.en: Cell {regeneration} slows as we get older.
e.zh: 细胞再生会随着年龄增长而变慢。

e.en: The neighborhood underwent major urban {regeneration}.
e.zh: 这片街区经历了大规模的城市更新。

e.en: {Regenerative} farming improves soil health over time.
e.zh: 再生农业能逐步改善土壤健康。

e.en: The car uses {regenerative} braking to save energy.
e.zh: 这辆车使用再生制动来节省能源。

regensburg.t: n. 雷根斯堡（德国城市）

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring medieval {Regensburg} in Bavaria.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览巴伐利亚的中世纪小城雷根斯堡。

e.en: {Regensburg} sits on the Danube and has Roman roots.
e.zh: 雷根斯堡位于多瑙河畔,有着罗马时代的渊源。

e.en: The queen mother served as {regent} for her young son.
e.zh: 太后为年幼的儿子担任摄政。

e.en: A {regent} ruled the kingdom during the king's illness.
e.zh: 国王患病期间由摄政者治理王国。

regents.t: n. 摄政者们；理事会成员

e.en: The university's board of {regents} approved the budget.
e.zh: 大学董事会批准了这份预算。

e.en: Two {regents} governed jointly until the heir matured.
e.zh: 两位摄政者共同执政,直到继承人长大。

e.en: He grew up listening to classic {reggae} from Jamaica.
e.zh: 他从小听着牙买加的经典雷鬼音乐长大。

e.en: The café plays mellow {reggae} on Sunday afternoons.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆周日下午会放轻柔的雷鬼乐。

e.en: The festival featured several different {reggaes} from across the islands.
e.zh: 音乐节上演了来自各岛屿的几种雷鬼风格。

e.en: His playlist mixes Jamaican {reggaes} with modern dub tracks.
e.zh: 他的播放列表把牙买加雷鬼曲混搭了现代电子音乐。

e.en: The play ends with the {regicide} of the old king.
e.zh: 戏剧以老国王被弑而落幕。

e.en: History remembers that revolution for its shocking {regicide}.
e.zh: 历史因那场令人震惊的弑君事件而铭记那次革命。

regime.t:
n. 政权；制度
n. 养生法

e.en: The new {regime} promised sweeping economic reforms.
e.zh: 新政权承诺进行全面的经济改革。

e.en: She follows a strict workout {regime} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨都遵循严格的健身方案。

regimen.t: n. 养生法；饮食/锻炼方案

e.en: The doctor prescribed a daily exercise {regimen}.
e.zh: 医生开了一份每日锻炼方案。

e.en: His skincare {regimen} only takes five minutes.
e.zh: 他的护肤流程只需要五分钟。

regiment.t:
n. (军) 团
v. 严格管制

e.en: The {regiment} marched through the city at dawn.
e.zh: 这个团在黎明时分穿过了城市。

e.en: Don't try to {regiment} every minute of the kids' day.
e.zh: 别想把孩子们一天的每一分钟都安排得死死的。

e.en: He wore his {regimental} tie to the reunion dinner.
e.zh: 他戴着团徽领带参加了聚会晚宴。

e.en: The museum displays {regimental} flags from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了那场战争中的军团军旗。

regimentation.t: n. 严格编制；严格管控

e.en: Students complained about the strict {regimentation} of the boarding school.
e.zh: 学生们抱怨寄宿学校管得太死板。

e.en: He left the army to escape its constant {regimentation}.
e.zh: 他离开军队是为了摆脱那种没完没了的严格管束。

e.en: Life in the academy was highly {regimented} and predictable.
e.zh: 学院里的生活非常严格刻板,毫无变化。

e.en: She prefers a {regimented} schedule with clear daily goals.
e.zh: 她喜欢有明确每日目标的严格作息表。

e.en: Authoritarian {regimes} often suppress independent journalism.
e.zh: 威权政权常常压制独立新闻业。

e.en: Different training {regimes} suit different types of athletes.
e.zh: 不同的训练方案适合不同类型的运动员。

regina.t: n. 里贾纳（加拿大城市）；女名

e.en: We flew to {Regina}, the capital of Saskatchewan.
e.zh: 我们飞往萨斯喀彻温省的省会里贾纳。

e.en: My aunt {Regina} bakes the best apple pie in town.
e.zh: 我的姑妈丽贾娜做的苹果派全镇最好吃。

e.en: This wine comes from a small {region} in Tuscany.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒产自托斯卡纳的一个小产区。

e.en: Pain in the lower back {region} can have many causes.
e.zh: 下背部区域疼痛可能有多种原因。

e.en: The store stocks many {regional} cheeses and wines.
e.zh: 这家店有很多地方特产的奶酪和葡萄酒。

e.en: She won a {regional} singing competition last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末赢得了一场地区性的歌唱比赛。

regionalism.t: n. 地方主义；地方特色

e.en: Strong {regionalism} shapes politics in this country.
e.zh: 强烈的地方主义影响着这个国家的政治。

e.en: The novel captures the {regionalism} of the rural South.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉了南方乡村的地域特色。

e.en: He's a {regionalist} painter known for prairie landscapes.
e.zh: 他是一位以草原风景著称的地域主义画家。

e.en: The {regionalist} party gained seats in the local election.
e.zh: 地方主义政党在地方选举中赢得了席位。

e.en: The {regionalization} of healthcare improved access in rural areas.
e.zh: 医疗服务的区域化提高了农村地区的就医便利。

e.en: Critics argue {regionalization} weakens central government oversight.
e.zh: 批评者认为区域化削弱了中央政府的监督。

e.en: The company plans to {regionalize} its supply chain next year.
e.zh: 公司计划明年把供应链区域化。

e.en: Officials want to {regionalize} emergency services for faster response.
e.zh: 官员们希望将应急服务区域化以加快响应速度。

e.en: The bank {regionalized} its operations to serve local markets better.
e.zh: 该银行将业务区域化,以更好地服务本地市场。

e.en: Spain has a highly {regionalized} system of government.
e.zh: 西班牙拥有高度地方分权的政府体制。

regionally.t: adv. 按地区地；区域性地

e.en: The dish is {regionally} popular but unknown abroad.
e.zh: 这道菜在当地很有名,但在国外鲜为人知。

e.en: Prices vary {regionally} depending on supply and demand.
e.zh: 价格因供求关系在各地区有所不同。

e.en: Several {regions} in the country face severe drought.
e.zh: 该国有几个地区正面临严重的旱情。

e.en: Cold {regions} require special tires in winter.
e.zh: 寒冷地区在冬天需要使用特种轮胎。

e.en: He studied at {Regis} University in Denver.
e.zh: 他曾就读于丹佛的瑞吉斯大学。

e.en: My grandfather {Regis} taught me how to fish.
e.zh: 我的祖父雷吉斯教会了我钓鱼。

register.t:
v. 注册；登记
n. 登记表；寄存器

e.en: You need to {register} before you can post comments.
e.zh: 你需要先注册才能发表评论。

e.en: Please pay at the front {register} near the door.
e.zh: 请到门口附近的收银台付款。

e.en: I {registered} for the marathon a month in advance.
e.zh: 我提前一个月报名了马拉松比赛。

e.en: She is a {registered} nurse at the children's hospital.
e.zh: 她是儿童医院的一名注册护士。

e.en: Thousands are {registering} to vote ahead of the deadline.
e.zh: 成千上万的人正赶在截止日期前进行选民登记。

e.en: The thermometer is {registering} above forty degrees today.
e.zh: 温度计今天显示超过四十度。

registers.t:
v. 注册（第三人称）
n. 寄存器

e.en: He {registers} every guest who enters the building.
e.zh: 每位进入大楼的来客他都会登记。

e.en: All the cash {registers} were busy on Black Friday.
e.zh: 黑色星期五那天所有的收银机都忙个不停。

e.en: Each {registrant} will receive a confirmation email shortly.
e.zh: 每位报名者很快都会收到一封确认邮件。

e.en: The {registrant} must provide a valid government ID.
e.zh: 注册人必须出示有效的政府身份证件。

e.en: Contact the {registrar} to update your home address.
e.zh: 请联系教务处更新你的家庭地址。

e.en: The domain {registrar} renewed our website automatically.
e.zh: 域名注册商自动为我们的网站续费了。

e.en: Online {registration} closes at midnight on Friday.
e.zh: 在线报名将于周五午夜截止。

e.en: He showed his car {registration} to the officer.
e.zh: 他向警官出示了汽车的行驶证。

e.en: Course {registrations} doubled compared to last semester.
e.zh: 课程报名人数比上学期翻了一番。

e.en: All vehicle {registrations} must be renewed yearly.
e.zh: 所有车辆登记都必须每年更新一次。

e.en: The couple set up a wedding {registry} online.
e.zh: 这对新人在网上建立了一个婚礼礼物清单。

e.en: Their company appears in the public business {registry}.
e.zh: 他们的公司在公开的工商登记簿上有记录。

e.en: He holds the {Regius} chair of medicine at the university.
e.zh: 他在该大学担任钦定医学讲座教授。

e.en: The {Regius} professorship was founded by royal charter.
e.zh: 这个钦定教授席位是依王室特许令而设立的。

e.en: Queen Elizabeth was a queen {regnant}, not a consort.
e.zh: 伊丽莎白女王是执政女王,而不是配偶王后。

e.en: The {regnant} ideology of the era favored free markets.
e.zh: 那个时代盛行的意识形态倾向于自由市场。

e.en: Astronauts collected lunar {regolith} samples for analysis.
e.zh: 宇航员采集了月球表土样本以便分析。

e.en: Mars is covered in a layer of red {regolith}.
e.zh: 火星表面覆盖着一层红色的风化层土壤。

regrade.t: v. 重新评级；重新分等

e.en: The teacher agreed to {regrade} my final essay.
e.zh: 老师同意重新评阅我的期末论文。

e.en: Workers will {regrade} the slope to prevent erosion.
e.zh: 工人们将重新平整斜坡以防止侵蚀。

e.en: The professor is {regrading} the exam after a complaint.
e.zh: 教授在收到投诉后正在重新批阅试卷。

e.en: The city is {regrading} the road for better drainage.
e.zh: 市政府正在重新平整道路以改善排水。

e.en: Without practice, students often {regress} over the summer.
e.zh: 如果不练习,学生在暑假里常常会退步。

e.en: His symptoms began to {regress} after the new treatment.
e.zh: 他接受新疗法后症状开始减退。

e.en: Therapy helped him work through a childhood {regression}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他克服了童年时期的心理倒退。

e.en: The team ran a {regression} on the sales data.
e.zh: 团队对销售数据做了一次回归分析。

e.en: Critics call the new tax unfairly {regressive}.
e.zh: 批评者称这项新税不公平地具有累退性。

e.en: The policy feels like a {regressive} step for women's rights.
e.zh: 这项政策对女性权利来说像是一种倒退。

regret.t:
v. 后悔，遗憾
n. 悔意

e.en: I really {regret} not calling my grandmother more often.
e.zh: 我真的很后悔没有多打电话给奶奶。

e.en: She felt deep {regret} after sending that angry message.
e.zh: 她发完那条愤怒的信息后非常后悔。

e.en: She gave a {regretful} smile when declining the invitation.
e.zh: 她婉拒邀请时露出一丝歉意的微笑。

e.en: He sounded {regretful} about missing his daughter's recital.
e.zh: 他对错过女儿的演出语气中满是遗憾。

e.en: {Regretfully}, we cannot offer you a refund at this time.
e.zh: 很遗憾，我们目前无法为您提供退款。

e.en: She {regretfully} declined the job offer in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她遗憾地谢绝了那份东京的工作邀请。

regrets.t:
n. 遗憾，歉意
v. 后悔（三单）

e.en: He has no {regrets} about leaving his corporate job.
e.zh: 他对辞掉公司工作毫无悔意。

e.en: She sent her {regrets} and skipped the wedding.
e.zh: 她致以歉意，没去参加婚礼。

regrettable.t: adj. 令人遗憾的，可惜的

e.en: The leak of customer data was a {regrettable} incident.
e.zh: 客户数据泄露是一起令人遗憾的事件。

e.en: His harsh comment was a {regrettable} slip of the tongue.
e.zh: 他那句尖刻的话是一次令人遗憾的失言。

regrettably.t: adv. 遗憾地，令人惋惜地

e.en: {Regrettably}, the concert has been cancelled due to weather.
e.zh: 很遗憾，音乐会因天气原因取消了。

e.en: The bug, {regrettably}, made it into the production release.
e.zh: 很不幸，那个 bug 还是混进了正式版本。

e.en: He {regretted} sending that angry email the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上他就后悔发了那封愤怒的邮件。

e.en: She never {regretted} her decision to study abroad.
e.zh: 她从未后悔过出国留学的决定。

e.en: I'm already {regretting} eating that third slice of cake.
e.zh: 我已经开始后悔吃下第三块蛋糕了。

e.en: He spent years {regretting} not calling his old friend.
e.zh: 多年来他一直为没给老朋友打电话而懊悔。

regroup.t: v. 重新集合，重整旗鼓

e.en: Let's take a break and {regroup} after lunch.
e.zh: 我们先休息一下，午饭后再重新整理思路。

e.en: The team needs to {regroup} after losing the playoff game.
e.zh: 球队在季后赛输球后需要重新调整。

regrouping.t:
v. 重整（ing 形式）
n. 重新集结

e.en: The startup is {regrouping} after losing its biggest client.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在失去最大客户后正在重新整顿。

e.en: After the setback, the candidate is quietly {regrouping}.
e.zh: 经历挫折后，这位候选人正悄悄重整旗鼓。

e.en: Lizards can {regrow} their tails after losing them.
e.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴掉了之后还能重新长出来。

e.en: It takes years for a clear-cut forest to {regrow}.
e.zh: 被砍伐的森林要花数年才能重新长起来。

e.en: The {regrowth} of hair after chemo can take months.
e.zh: 化疗后头发重新长出来可能需要数月时间。

e.en: Foresters are tracking {regrowth} in the burned area.
e.zh: 林业人员正在追踪火灾区域的植被恢复情况。

regular.t:
adj. 常规的，定期的
n. 常客

e.en: I go to the gym on a {regular} basis.
e.zh: 我定期去健身房锻炼。

e.en: He's a {regular} at the coffee shop near my office.
e.zh: 他是我办公室附近那家咖啡店的常客。

regularise.t: v. 使规范化（英式拼写）

e.en: The government plans to {regularise} the status of migrant workers.
e.zh: 政府计划让外来务工人员的身份合法化。

e.en: They want to {regularise} the messy approval process.
e.zh: 他们想把混乱的审批流程规范化。

e.en: He visits his grandmother with surprising {regularity}.
e.zh: 他探望奶奶的频率出奇地有规律。

e.en: The {regularity} of her heartbeat reassured the doctor.
e.zh: 她心跳的规律性让医生放下心来。

regularization.t: n. 规范化；（机器学习）正则化

e.en: We added {regularization} to prevent the model from overfitting.
e.zh: 我们加入了正则化以防止模型过拟合。

e.en: The bill calls for the {regularization} of undocumented residents.
e.zh: 该法案呼吁让无证居民身份合法化。

e.en: The new policy will {regularize} freelance workers' tax filings.
e.zh: 新政策将使自由职业者的报税流程规范化。

e.en: Dropout helps {regularize} deep neural networks during training.
e.zh: Dropout 有助于在训练中正则化深度神经网络。

regularized.t:
v. 规范化（过去式）
adj. 已正则化的

e.en: The {regularized} model performed better on unseen test data.
e.zh: 经过正则化的模型在新测试数据上表现更好。

e.en: Authorities {regularized} thousands of informal street vendors last year.
e.zh: 当局去年让数千名无照流动摊贩合法化。

e.en: She {regularly} updates her blog every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 她每周日晚上都会定期更新博客。

e.en: You should back up your files {regularly}.
e.zh: 你应该定期备份你的文件。

e.en: Governments worldwide are racing to {regulate} artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 世界各国政府正在竞相对人工智能进行监管。

e.en: Sweating helps the body {regulate} its temperature.
e.zh: 出汗有助于身体调节体温。

regulated.t:
adj. 受监管的
v. 监管（过去式）

e.en: Banking is one of the most heavily {regulated} industries.
e.zh: 银行业是受监管最严格的行业之一。

e.en: The thermostat keeps the room temperature carefully {regulated}.
e.zh: 恒温器把室内温度调控得恰到好处。

e.en: The FDA {regulates} the safety of food and drugs.
e.zh: FDA 负责监管食品和药品的安全。

e.en: This hormone {regulates} blood sugar levels in the body.
e.zh: 这种激素负责调节体内的血糖水平。

regulating.t: v. 监管，调节（ing 形式）

e.en: Lawmakers are {regulating} crypto exchanges more strictly this year.
e.zh: 立法者今年正更严格地监管加密货币交易所。

e.en: The liver plays a key role in {regulating} metabolism.
e.zh: 肝脏在调节新陈代谢方面起着关键作用。

regulation.t:
n. 法规，规定
n. 调节

e.en: The new {regulation} takes effect at the start of January.
e.zh: 新规将于一月初正式生效。

e.en: There's an ongoing debate about AI {regulation} in Europe.
e.zh: 关于欧洲人工智能监管的辩论仍在继续。
