e.en: The factory must comply with strict environmental {regulations}.
e.zh: 这家工厂必须遵守严格的环保法规。

e.en: New privacy {regulations} will affect how apps collect data.
e.zh: 新的隐私法规将影响应用收集数据的方式。

e.en: The agency plays a {regulative} role in financial markets.
e.zh: 该机构在金融市场中发挥着监管作用。

e.en: Kant described certain ideas as {regulative} principles of reason.
e.zh: 康德把某些观念描述为理性的调节性原则。

e.en: The financial {regulator} fined the bank ten million dollars.
e.zh: 金融监管机构对该银行处以一千万美元罚款。

e.en: Insulin acts as a {regulator} of blood sugar levels.
e.zh: 胰岛素在血糖水平中起到调节作用。

e.en: European {regulators} are investigating the tech giant for antitrust violations.
e.zh: 欧洲监管机构正在调查这家科技巨头的反垄断行为。

e.en: {Regulators} approved the merger after months of review.
e.zh: 经过数月审查，监管机构批准了这桩合并案。

e.en: The drug still needs {regulatory} approval before going to market.
e.zh: 该药物上市前仍需通过监管部门的审批。

e.en: Startups often struggle to navigate complex {regulatory} requirements.
e.zh: 初创公司往往难以应对复杂的监管要求。

regurgitate.t:
v. 反刍，反胃
v. 机械复述

e.en: Don't just {regurgitate} the textbook in your essay.
e.zh: 别在文章里照搬课本上的内容。

e.en: Pigeons {regurgitate} food to feed their young.
e.zh: 鸽子会把食物反刍出来喂养幼鸟。

e.en: The chatbot simply {regurgitated} answers it found online.
e.zh: 那个聊天机器人只是把网上的答案原样吐了出来。

e.en: The seabird {regurgitated} fish into its chick's mouth.
e.zh: 那只海鸟把鱼反刍到雏鸟的嘴里。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with mild acid {regurgitation}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她有轻度胃酸反流。

e.en: His essay was pure {regurgitation} of the lecture notes.
e.zh: 他的文章纯粹是把讲义内容照搬了一遍。

rehab.t:
n. 戒瘾康复
v. 翻新（房屋）

e.en: The singer entered {rehab} after struggling with addiction for years.
e.zh: 这位歌手在与毒瘾抗争多年后进入了戒瘾康复中心。

e.en: He's doing knee {rehab} three times a week.
e.zh: 他每周做三次膝盖康复训练。

e.en: They {rehabbed} the old warehouse into trendy loft apartments.
e.zh: 他们把那座旧仓库改造成了时尚的 loft 公寓。

e.en: The pitcher {rehabbed} his shoulder all winter long.
e.zh: 这位投手整个冬天都在做肩膀的康复训练。

rehabilitate.t:
v. 使康复；改造
v. 翻新

e.en: The program aims to {rehabilitate} young offenders through education.
e.zh: 该项目旨在通过教育帮助青少年罪犯重新融入社会。

e.en: Volunteers help {rehabilitate} injured wildlife before releasing them.
e.zh: 志愿者们帮助受伤野生动物康复后再放归自然。

e.en: The injured eagle was {rehabilitated} and released into the wild.
e.zh: 那只受伤的鹰康复后被放归野外。

e.en: His reputation was slowly {rehabilitated} after the scandal faded.
e.zh: 丑闻平息后，他的名声慢慢得到了恢复。

e.en: After surgery, he began months of physical {rehabilitation}.
e.zh: 手术后，他开始了数月的物理康复治疗。

e.en: The prison focuses on {rehabilitation} rather than pure punishment.
e.zh: 这所监狱注重改造而非单纯的惩罚。

e.en: The clinic has overseen thousands of successful {rehabilitations}.
e.zh: 这家诊所已成功完成数千例康复治疗。

e.en: Several historical {rehabilitations} were announced after the regime fell.
e.zh: 政权倒台后，多起历史性平反案被相继宣布。

e.en: The hospital offers excellent {rehabilitative} care for stroke patients.
e.zh: 这家医院为中风患者提供出色的康复护理。

e.en: Prisons should invest more in {rehabilitative} programs.
e.zh: 监狱应在改造类项目上加大投入。

e.en: The wildlife {rehabilitator} nursed the injured owl back to health.
e.zh: 那位野生动物救助员把受伤的猫头鹰悉心养回了健康。

e.en: She trained as a vocal {rehabilitator} for injured singers.
e.zh: 她受训成为专为受伤歌手做嗓音康复的治疗师。

rehash.t:
v. 翻新炒冷饭
n. 老调重弹

e.en: The sequel is just a {rehash} of the original movie.
e.zh: 这部续集不过是原作的炒冷饭。

e.en: Let's not {rehash} the same argument again tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们就别再重复同样的争论了。

rehashing.t: v. 重弹老调（ing 形式）

e.en: He keeps {rehashing} old stories at every family dinner.
e.zh: 每次家庭聚餐他都反复讲那些老故事。

e.en: The article is just {rehashing} last week's news.
e.zh: 这篇文章只是把上周的新闻又翻炒了一遍。

e.en: The court agreed to {rehear} the case next month.
e.zh: 法院同意下个月重新审理此案。

e.en: I'd love to {rehear} that song from my childhood.
e.zh: 我很想再听一遍童年时听过的那首歌。

e.en: The defense team requested a {rehearing} after new evidence emerged.
e.zh: 出现新证据后，辩护团队申请了重审。

e.en: The appeals court denied the petition for {rehearing}.
e.zh: 上诉法院驳回了重新审理的申请。

e.en: The band has a final {rehearsal} the night before the show.
e.zh: 乐队在演出前一晚有最后一次彩排。

e.en: Wedding {rehearsal} starts at six tomorrow evening.
e.zh: 婚礼彩排明天傍晚六点开始。

e.en: The actors spent weeks in intensive {rehearsals} before opening night.
e.zh: 演员们在首演前进行了数周的密集排练。

e.en: Choir {rehearsals} are held every Wednesday at seven.
e.zh: 合唱团每周三晚上七点排练。

e.en: We need to {rehearse} the speech a few more times.
e.zh: 我们得把这段演讲再多排练几遍。

e.en: The cast will {rehearse} the final scene tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 剧组明早将排练最后一场戏。

rehearsed.t:
v. 排练（过去式）
adj. 演练过的

e.en: His apology sounded too {rehearsed} to feel sincere.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来太刻意，不像真心的。

e.en: They {rehearsed} the dance routine until midnight.
e.zh: 他们把那段舞蹈一直排到了半夜。

e.en: Just {reheat} the leftovers in the microwave for two minutes.
e.zh: 把剩饭放微波炉里热两分钟就行。

e.en: Don't {reheat} rice more than once for safety reasons.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑，米饭不要反复加热。

e.en: I {reheated} yesterday's pasta for a quick lunch.
e.zh: 我把昨天的意面热了热当作简单的午餐。

e.en: {Reheated} pizza tastes surprisingly good in an air fryer.
e.zh: 用空气炸锅热过的披萨味道意外地好。

reheating.t:
v. 重新加热
n. 再加热

e.en: {Reheating} soup on the stove gives better flavor than the microwave.
e.zh: 用炉子热汤比微波炉味道更好。

e.en: She's {reheating} the curry from last night's dinner.
e.zh: 她在热昨晚剩下的咖喱。

e.en: The company decided to {rehire} the engineer it laid off last year.
e.zh: 公司决定重新聘用去年裁掉的那位工程师。

e.en: After budget cuts ended, the school began to {rehire} teachers.
e.zh: 预算削减结束后,学校开始重新聘请教师。

e.en: The city pledged to {rehouse} families displaced by the fire.
e.zh: 市政府承诺为火灾中流离失所的家庭重新安置住房。

e.en: Charities worked to {rehouse} refugees in safer neighborhoods.
e.zh: 慈善机构努力将难民重新安置到更安全的社区。

e.en: The council launched a {rehousing} program for flood victims.
e.zh: 市议会为洪灾受害者启动了重新安置住房计划。

e.en: Tenants are awaiting {rehousing} after the building was condemned.
e.zh: 大楼被判定危房后,租户正在等待重新安置。

rehydrate.t: v. 补充水分；使再水合

e.en: Drink water after exercise to {rehydrate} your body.
e.zh: 运动后喝水以补充身体水分。

e.en: You can {rehydrate} dried mushrooms by soaking them in warm water.
e.zh: 你可以把干蘑菇泡在温水里使其复水。

rehydrated.t: adj. 已重新吸水的；已补水的

e.en: After the hike she felt much better once {rehydrated}.
e.zh: 徒步之后,补充水分后她感觉好多了。

e.en: The chef used {rehydrated} tomatoes in the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 厨师在意面酱里用了泡发后的番茄。

e.en: Doctors recommend {rehydration} salts for treating mild dehydration.
e.zh: 医生建议用补液盐治疗轻度脱水。

e.en: Proper {rehydration} is essential after a long run.
e.zh: 长跑后充分补水非常重要。

reich.t: n. (德语) 帝国，特指德意志帝国

e.en: Historians still study the rise and fall of the Third {Reich}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在研究第三帝国的兴衰。

e.en: The book traces propaganda used by the {Reich} during the war.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了帝国在战争期间使用的宣传手段。

reichstag.t: n. (德国) 国会；国会大厦

e.en: Tourists climbed the glass dome of the {Reichstag} in Berlin.
e.zh: 游客们登上了柏林国会大厦的玻璃穹顶。

e.en: The {Reichstag} fire became a turning point in German history.
e.zh: 国会纵火案成为德国历史的转折点。

e.en: Critics warned against the {reification} of abstract economic models.
e.zh: 批评者警告不要把抽象的经济模型当作实体看待。

e.en: The essay explores the {reification} of social categories like race.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨了种族等社会类别的物化现象。

reified.t: adj. 被具体化的；物化的

e.en: The theory {reified} consumers into mere statistics.
e.zh: 该理论把消费者物化成了单纯的统计数字。

e.en: Stereotypes can become {reified} through repeated media portrayal.
e.zh: 刻板印象会因媒体反复呈现而被固化为现实。

reify.t: v. 使具体化；将抽象概念物化

e.en: Be careful not to {reify} concepts that are merely useful metaphors.
e.zh: 小心不要把仅仅是有用比喻的概念实体化。

e.en: Surveys can unintentionally {reify} the categories they measure.
e.zh: 调查可能在无意中将所测量的类别物化。

e.en: The train from London to {Reigate} takes about forty minutes.
e.zh: 从伦敦到雷盖特的火车大约需要四十分钟。

e.en: They moved to {Reigate} for the quieter suburban life.
e.zh: 他们搬到雷盖特,过更安静的郊区生活。

reign.t:
n. 统治 (时期)
v. 统治；盛行

e.en: Queen Victoria's {reign} lasted more than sixty years.
e.zh: 维多利亚女王的统治持续了六十多年。

e.en: During his {reign} as champion, he never lost a match.
e.zh: 在他作为冠军称霸期间,他从未输过一场比赛。

e.en: Silence {reigned} in the courtroom as the verdict was read.
e.zh: 宣读判决时,法庭里一片寂静。

e.en: She {reigned} as world champion for three straight years.
e.zh: 她连续三年蝉联世界冠军。

reigning.t: adj. 在位的；现任的（冠军等）

e.en: The {reigning} champion will defend her title this weekend.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军将在本周末捍卫她的头衔。

e.en: He is widely seen as the {reigning} king of late-night TV.
e.zh: 他被普遍视为深夜电视节目的现任王者。

reignite.t: v. 重新点燃；再次激起

e.en: The new evidence could {reignite} the debate over gun control.
e.zh: 新证据可能重新点燃关于枪支管制的辩论。

e.en: A surprise message from her ex helped {reignite} old feelings.
e.zh: 前任的一条意外消息让旧日情感重新燃起。

reigns.t:
v. 统治；盛行 (第三人称单数)
n. 统治 (复数)

e.en: Confusion still {reigns} after the sudden change in policy.
e.zh: 政策突变之后,混乱仍然笼罩着一切。

e.en: The longest of all British {reigns} was Queen Elizabeth II's.
e.zh: 英国历史上在位时间最长的是伊丽莎白二世女王。

reiki.t: n. 灵气疗法（日式能量疗法）

e.en: She offers {reiki} sessions to help clients relax and de-stress.
e.zh: 她提供灵气疗愈,帮助客户放松减压。

e.en: Some hospitals now include {reiki} in their wellness programs.
e.zh: 一些医院现在把灵气疗法纳入健康项目中。

e.en: The company will {reimburse} you for travel expenses within two weeks.
e.zh: 公司将在两周内报销你的差旅费。

e.en: Please keep all receipts so we can {reimburse} you correctly.
e.zh: 请保留所有收据,以便我们正确报销给你。

e.en: Submit the form online to request {reimbursement} for your purchase.
e.zh: 在网上提交表格以申请购买款项的报销。

e.en: Insurance offers {reimbursement} for most prescription medications.
e.zh: 保险为大多数处方药提供报销。

e.en: Lawmakers debated the {reimportation} of cheaper drugs from Canada.
e.zh: 立法者就从加拿大重新进口廉价药品展开辩论。

e.en: The treaty places limits on the {reimportation} of used vehicles.
e.zh: 该条约对二手车辆的再进口设有限制。

reimpose.t: v. 重新实施；再次强加

e.en: The government may {reimpose} travel restrictions if cases rise.
e.zh: 如果病例上升,政府可能会重新实施出行限制。

e.en: Officials threatened to {reimpose} sanctions on the regime.
e.zh: 官员们威胁要对该政权重新实施制裁。

reimposition.t: n. 重新实施；再次征收

e.en: The {reimposition} of tariffs angered the country's trading partners.
e.zh: 重新征收关税激怒了该国的贸易伙伴。

e.en: Businesses warned against the {reimposition} of strict lockdowns.
e.zh: 企业警告不要重新实施严格的封锁措施。

e.en: The cathedral in {Reims} is famous for its stunning stained glass.
e.zh: 兰斯大教堂以其令人惊叹的彩色玻璃而闻名。

e.en: French kings were traditionally crowned in {Reims}.
e.zh: 法国国王传统上在兰斯加冕。

rein.t:
n. 缰绳；控制
v. 勒住；控制

e.en: The board tried to {rein} in the CEO's spending.
e.zh: 董事会试图遏制首席执行官的开支。

e.en: She gently pulled the {rein} to slow the horse.
e.zh: 她轻轻拉了一下缰绳让马放慢速度。

e.en: Some believe the soul will {reincarnate} into a new body after death.
e.zh: 有些人相信死后灵魂会转世到新的身体里。

e.en: The director hoped to {reincarnate} the franchise for a new generation.
e.zh: 导演希望为新一代观众重塑这个系列电影。

e.en: In the novel, the hero is {reincarnated} as a powerful dragon.
e.zh: 在小说中,主角转世成了一条强大的龙。

e.en: The old factory has been {reincarnated} as a trendy art gallery.
e.zh: 那座旧工厂已被改造重生为时尚的艺术画廊。

e.en: Buddhism teaches the cycle of {reincarnation} based on karma.
e.zh: 佛教讲述基于业力的轮回循环。

e.en: Fans called the young guitarist a {reincarnation} of Hendrix.
e.zh: 乐迷们称这位年轻吉他手是亨德里克斯的转世。

reincorporate.t: v. 重新并入；再次纳入

e.en: The startup chose to {reincorporate} in Delaware for tax benefits.
e.zh: 这家初创公司选择在特拉华州重新注册以获得税收优惠。

e.en: The coach plans to {reincorporate} the injured player into the lineup.
e.zh: 教练计划让受伤的球员重新回到首发阵容。

reincorporation.t: n. 重新并入；再次组建

e.en: The {reincorporation} of the company in Singapore took several months.
e.zh: 该公司在新加坡重新注册花了几个月时间。

e.en: Therapists discussed the {reincorporation} of the patient into society.
e.zh: 治疗师讨论了让患者重新融入社会的过程。

e.en: In Lapland, you can ride a sled pulled by {reindeer}.
e.zh: 在拉普兰,你可以乘坐由驯鹿拉的雪橇。

e.en: Children left carrots for Santa's {reindeer} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 孩子们在平安夜为圣诞老人的驯鹿留下了胡萝卜。

reinforce.t: v. 加强；强化（观点、结构）

e.en: Steel beams were added to {reinforce} the old bridge.
e.zh: 加装了钢梁来加固这座旧桥。

e.en: Praise from teachers can {reinforce} good study habits.
e.zh: 老师的表扬能强化良好的学习习惯。

e.en: The bunker was built with {reinforced} concrete walls.
e.zh: 这座掩体由钢筋混凝土墙建成。

e.en: Her latest results {reinforced} my confidence in her abilities.
e.zh: 她最新的成绩进一步增强了我对她能力的信心。

e.en: Positive {reinforcement} works better than punishment for most kids.
e.zh: 对大多数孩子来说,正向强化比惩罚更有效。

e.en: The wall needs additional {reinforcement} before the next earthquake.
e.zh: 在下次地震之前,这堵墙需要额外加固。

e.en: The general radioed for {reinforcements} as the battle intensified.
e.zh: 战斗加剧时,将军用无线电请求增援。

e.en: We're swamped with orders—can you send some {reinforcements}?
e.zh: 订单把我们淹没了,你能派点支援人手过来吗?

e.en: For many dogs, food is the most powerful {reinforcer} during training.
e.zh: 对许多狗来说,食物是训练中最有效的强化物。

e.en: Social praise can be a stronger {reinforcer} than money for some employees.
e.zh: 对一些员工来说,社交赞美比金钱更能强化行为。

reinforces.t: v. 加强；强化 (第三人称单数)

e.en: This new study {reinforces} the link between sleep and memory.
e.zh: 这项新研究进一步证实了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。

e.en: The thick padding {reinforces} the helmet against sharp impacts.
e.zh: 厚厚的衬垫加强了头盔对尖锐冲击的防护。

reinforcing.t:
v. 加强；强化 (动名词/现在分词)
adj. 起加强作用的

e.en: Workers are {reinforcing} the dam ahead of the storm season.
e.zh: 工人们正在风暴季来临前加固大坝。

e.en: Repeating myths in the media risks {reinforcing} dangerous stereotypes.
e.zh: 在媒体上重复传言有强化危险刻板印象的风险。

reinsert.t: v. 重新插入；再次放入

e.en: Carefully {reinsert} the SIM card into the slot until it clicks.
e.zh: 小心地将 SIM 卡重新插入卡槽,直到发出咔哒声。

e.en: The editor decided to {reinsert} the deleted paragraph in the final draft.
e.zh: 编辑决定在终稿中重新插入被删掉的段落。

reinsertion.t: n. 重新插入；再次嵌入

e.en: The surgery involved the {reinsertion} of the tendon into the bone.
e.zh: 手术包括将肌腱重新固定到骨骼上。

e.en: The {reinsertion} of the controversial scene sparked online debate.
e.zh: 重新加入那段争议场景引发了网上的热议。

reinstall.t: v. 重新安装（软件、系统）

e.en: Try to {reinstall} the app if it keeps crashing on your phone.
e.zh: 如果应用在手机上一直崩溃,试着重新安装它。

e.en: The technician will {reinstall} Windows on the laptop tomorrow.
e.zh: 技术员明天会在这台笔记本上重新安装 Windows。

e.en: A clean {reinstallation} of the software fixed all the bugs.
e.zh: 重新干净地安装该软件后,所有错误都修好了。

e.en: The {reinstallation} of the heating system took two days.
e.zh: 重新安装供暖系统花了两天时间。

e.en: The court ordered the company to {reinstate} the dismissed employee.
e.zh: 法院命令该公司恢复被解雇员工的职位。

e.en: Officials may {reinstate} mask requirements if infections rise again.
e.zh: 如果感染人数再度上升,官员可能会重新实施口罩规定。

e.en: The union demanded the immediate {reinstatement} of the fired workers.
e.zh: 工会要求立即恢复被解雇工人的工作。

e.en: His {reinstatement} as captain delighted the team's fans.
e.zh: 他重新担任队长让球队球迷十分高兴。

e.en: The {reinstitution} of the death penalty sparked widespread protests.
e.zh: 恢复死刑引发了大规模抗议。

e.en: Many welcomed the {reinstitution} of weekly community meetings.
e.zh: 许多人欢迎恢复每周的社区会议。

e.en: Insurers buy {reinsurance} to protect themselves from massive disaster claims.
e.zh: 保险公司购买再保险以防范巨灾理赔的风险。

e.en: Climate change is reshaping the global {reinsurance} market.
e.zh: 气候变化正在重塑全球再保险市场。

e.en: Programs help former prisoners {reintegrate} into society after release.
e.zh: 项目帮助前囚犯在释放后重新融入社会。

e.en: It can be hard for soldiers to {reintegrate} into civilian life.
e.zh: 士兵们重新适应平民生活可能很困难。

e.en: The charity supports the {reintegration} of refugees through job training.
e.zh: 该慈善机构通过职业培训支持难民的重新融入。

e.en: Her therapist focused on her {reintegration} into family routines.
e.zh: 她的治疗师专注于让她重新融入家庭日常生活。

e.en: Each generation tends to {reinterpret} classic novels in its own way.
e.zh: 每一代人都倾向于以自己的方式重新诠释经典小说。

e.en: The judge may {reinterpret} the law in light of new evidence.
e.zh: 法官可能会根据新证据重新解释这条法律。

e.en: The film offers a bold {reinterpretation} of the Shakespeare classic.
e.zh: 这部电影对莎士比亚经典作品做了大胆的重新诠释。

e.en: Her {reinterpretation} of the data led to a different conclusion.
e.zh: 她对数据的重新解读得出了不同的结论。

e.en: Scientists plan to {reintroduce} wolves to the national park.
e.zh: 科学家计划将狼重新引入国家公园。

e.en: The company will {reintroduce} the classic flavor next month.
e.zh: 公司下个月将重新推出那款经典口味。

e.en: The senator {reintroduced} the bill after last year's defeat.
e.zh: 参议员在去年被否决后重新提出了该法案。

e.en: The brand {reintroduced} its retro logo to attract older fans.
e.zh: 该品牌重新启用复古标志以吸引老粉丝。

e.en: The {reintroduction} of beavers has restored the wetland.
e.zh: 海狸的重新引入让湿地得以恢复。

e.en: Fans cheered the {reintroduction} of the limited-edition sneakers.
e.zh: 粉丝为限量版球鞋的重新发售而欢呼。

reinvent.t: v. 重新发明、彻底革新

e.en: Startups try to {reinvent} the way we order food online.
e.zh: 创业公司试图重新定义我们网上点餐的方式。

e.en: You don't need to {reinvent} the wheel for this project.
e.zh: 这个项目你不必重复造轮子。

e.en: The director {reinvented} herself as a comedy writer.
e.zh: 那位导演把自己重新塑造成了喜剧编剧。

e.en: Streaming services have {reinvented} how we watch television.
e.zh: 流媒体服务彻底改变了我们看电视的方式。

e.en: The album marked a bold {reinvention} of her sound.
e.zh: 这张专辑标志着她音乐风格的大胆革新。

e.en: Silicon Valley loves a good personal {reinvention} story.
e.zh: 硅谷喜欢精彩的个人重塑故事。

e.en: Most founders {reinvest} early profits back into the business.
e.zh: 多数创始人会把早期利润再投入到公司。

e.en: The fund will {reinvest} dividends automatically each quarter.
e.zh: 该基金将每季度自动再投资分红。

e.en: She {reinvested} the bonus into index funds last year.
e.zh: 她去年把奖金重新投入到了指数基金。

e.en: The startup {reinvested} every dollar into hiring engineers.
e.zh: 那家初创公司把每一分钱都重新用于招聘工程师。

e.en: Police agreed to {reinvestigate} the cold case after new evidence.
e.zh: 警方在出现新证据后同意重新调查这桩悬案。

e.en: Auditors plan to {reinvestigate} last quarter's suspicious transactions.
e.zh: 审计员计划重新调查上季度的可疑交易。

e.en: Steady {reinvestment} of dividends compounds wealth over time.
e.zh: 持续将分红再投资能让财富随时间复利增长。

e.en: The city announced major {reinvestment} in public transit.
e.zh: 市政府宣布对公共交通进行大规模再投资。

e.en: A short walk can {reinvigorate} you during a long workday.
e.zh: 短暂散步能在漫长工作日里让你重新焕发活力。

e.en: The new coach hopes to {reinvigorate} the struggling team.
e.zh: 新教练希望让低迷的球队重振士气。

reinvigorated.t:
adj. 焕发活力的
v. reinvigorate 的过去式

e.en: The vacation left her feeling completely {reinvigorated}.
e.zh: 那次度假让她感到精神焕发。

e.en: Fresh leadership {reinvigorated} the once-stagnant department.
e.zh: 新的领导让一度停滞的部门重新焕发生机。

e.en: The festival brought a welcome {reinvigoration} to the small town.
e.zh: 那场节庆让这个小镇迎来了一次振兴。

e.en: Investors are betting on the {reinvigoration} of the chip industry.
e.zh: 投资者押注芯片行业的复兴。

e.en: The label will {reissue} the album on vinyl this fall.
e.zh: 唱片公司今秋将以黑胶形式重新发行这张专辑。

e.en: You can request a {reissue} of your driver's license online.
e.zh: 你可以在网上申请补办驾照。

e.en: The publisher {reissued} the novel with a new introduction.
e.zh: 出版社重新发行了这本小说,并附上新序言。

e.en: The bank {reissued} her card after the security breach.
e.zh: 银行在安全事故后给她重新发了一张卡。

reissues.t:
n. 再版作品
v. 再版（第三人称单数）

e.en: Collectors hunt for limited vinyl {reissues} of rare jazz records.
e.zh: 藏家热衷于寻找稀有爵士唱片的限量黑胶再版。

e.en: The studio {reissues} classic films every few years.
e.zh: 该制片厂每隔几年就会重新发行经典影片。

e.en: Nintendo is {reissuing} several retro games for its new console.
e.zh: 任天堂正在为新主机重新发行几款复古游戏。

e.en: The DMV is {reissuing} licenses with updated security features.
e.zh: 车管所正在重新签发带有新防伪功能的驾照。

e.en: Let me {reiterate} that all data stays on your device.
e.zh: 我再强调一次,所有数据都保存在你的设备上。

e.en: The CEO will {reiterate} the company's growth targets tomorrow.
e.zh: 首席执行官明天会重申公司的增长目标。

e.en: She {reiterated} her commitment to climate action in the speech.
e.zh: 她在演讲中重申了对气候行动的承诺。

e.en: The teacher {reiterated} the deadline for the final project.
e.zh: 老师再次强调了期末项目的截止日期。

e.en: His speech was just a {reiteration} of last year's promises.
e.zh: 他的演讲只是对去年承诺的重复。

e.en: The memo offered a clear {reiteration} of company policy.
e.zh: 这份备忘录清晰地重申了公司政策。

reject.t:
v. 拒绝、驳回
n. 次品、被淘汰者

e.en: The app will {reject} passwords shorter than eight characters.
e.zh: 该应用会拒绝少于八位的密码。

e.en: Voters could {reject} the proposal in next month's referendum.
e.zh: 选民可能会在下月公投中否决该提案。

rejected.t:
adj. 被拒绝的
v. reject 的过去式

e.en: My credit card was {rejected} at the checkout this morning.
e.zh: 今早我的信用卡在结账时被拒了。

e.en: The journal {rejected} her paper after a lengthy review.
e.zh: 该期刊在长时间审稿后拒绝了她的论文。

e.en: He's known as a serial {rejecter} of dating app matches.
e.zh: 他以频繁拒绝交友软件配对而出名。

e.en: The spam filter acts as a {rejecter} of suspicious emails.
e.zh: 垃圾邮件过滤器充当可疑邮件的拦截者。

e.en: The server keeps {rejecting} my login attempts for some reason.
e.zh: 服务器不知为何一直拒绝我的登录请求。

e.en: She's {rejecting} most job offers until she finds the right fit.
e.zh: 她在找到合适的工作前会拒绝大多数录用通知。

e.en: Every writer has to learn to handle {rejection} from publishers.
e.zh: 每位作家都得学会面对出版社的拒绝。

e.en: Doctors monitor for organ {rejection} after a transplant.
e.zh: 医生在器官移植后会监测排异反应。

rejectionist.t: n. 拒绝妥协者（尤指政治立场）

e.en: The {rejectionist} faction refused to attend the peace talks.
e.zh: 那个拒绝派系拒绝出席和谈。

e.en: Critics labeled the senator a {rejectionist} on every climate bill.
e.zh: 评论人士称那位参议员对每项气候法案都持反对立场。

e.en: She framed her {rejections} as motivation to keep submitting.
e.zh: 她把那些拒信当作继续投稿的动力。

e.en: The startup faced dozens of {rejections} before landing funding.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在获得融资前被拒了几十次。

rejects.t:
n. 次品、废品
v. reject 的第三人称单数

e.en: The factory sells its {rejects} at a steep discount online.
e.zh: 这家工厂在网上以大幅折扣出售残次品。

e.en: She always {rejects} calls from unknown numbers.
e.zh: 她总是拒接陌生号码的来电。

e.en: We need to {rejig} the schedule to fit the new client.
e.zh: 我们得重新调整日程以配合新客户。

e.en: The coach decided to {rejig} the lineup before the playoffs.
e.zh: 教练决定在季后赛前调整阵容。

e.en: Engineers had to {rejigger} the pipeline after the outage.
e.zh: 工程师不得不在故障后重新调整数据管道。

e.en: Let's {rejigger} the layout so the sidebar fits on mobile.
e.zh: 我们重新调整一下布局,让侧边栏在手机上也能显示。

e.en: Fans will {rejoice} when the band announces its tour dates.
e.zh: 乐队公布巡演日期时粉丝们会欣喜若狂。

e.en: Coffee lovers {rejoice} every time a new café opens nearby.
e.zh: 每当附近开新咖啡馆,咖啡爱好者都会欢欣鼓舞。

rejoicing.t:
n. 欢庆
v. rejoice 的现在分词

e.en: There was much {rejoicing} when the team finally won the cup.
e.zh: 球队终于夺冠时,大家都欢欣雀跃。

e.en: The crowd was {rejoicing} as fireworks lit up the sky.
e.zh: 烟花照亮夜空时人群一片欢腾。

e.en: She decided to {rejoin} the gym after a long break.
e.zh: 在长时间休息后,她决定重新加入健身房。

e.en: He hopes to {rejoin} his old team next season.
e.zh: 他希望下个赛季能重返老东家。

e.en: Her sharp {rejoinder} silenced the heckler instantly.
e.zh: 她犀利的反驳让起哄者立刻闭嘴。

e.en: The article offered a measured {rejoinder} to recent criticism.
e.zh: 那篇文章对近期的批评做出了有节制的回应。

e.en: She {rejoined} the workforce after taking parental leave.
e.zh: 她在休完育儿假后重返职场。

e.en: The actor {rejoined} the cast for the show's final season.
e.zh: 那位演员重新加入了剧集的最终季演出。

e.en: He's seriously considering {rejoining} the company next year.
e.zh: 他正认真考虑明年回到公司。

e.en: Many veterans struggle with {rejoining} civilian life.
e.zh: 许多退伍军人在重返平民生活时都很挣扎。

rejoins.t: v. rejoin 的第三人称单数

e.en: The midfielder {rejoins} the squad after recovering from injury.
e.zh: 那名中场在伤愈后重返球队。

e.en: She {rejoins} the meeting once her connection is stable.
e.zh: 她网络稳定后会重新加入会议。

rejuvenate.t: v. 使恢复活力、返老还童

e.en: A weekend off can {rejuvenate} even the most exhausted parent.
e.zh: 一个周末的休息能让最疲惫的父母重新焕发活力。

e.en: The new menu aims to {rejuvenate} the aging restaurant chain.
e.zh: 新菜单旨在让这家老化的连锁餐厅重焕生机。

rejuvenated.t:
adj. 焕发活力的
v. rejuvenate 的过去式

e.en: She felt completely {rejuvenated} after a week at the beach.
e.zh: 在海边住了一周后,她感觉整个人都焕然一新。

e.en: The remodel {rejuvenated} the once-tired downtown plaza.
e.zh: 翻新工程让一度老旧的市中心广场焕发新生。

e.en: Nothing beats a {rejuvenating} hot shower after a long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,没什么比一个让人焕然一新的热水澡更棒了。

e.en: The spa is famous for its {rejuvenating} herbal treatments.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心以其令人焕发活力的草药护理而闻名。

relegated.t: v. 降级；贬至（relegate 的过去式）

e.en: The team was {relegated} to the second division after losing.
e.zh: 输球之后该队被降到了乙级联赛。

e.en: Old phones are usually {relegated} to a drawer somewhere.
e.zh: 旧手机通常被随手放到某个抽屉里。

relegates.t: v. 降级；贬至（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new policy {relegates} interns to support roles only.
e.zh: 新政策把实习生限定在仅做辅助工作。

e.en: This ranking {relegates} their movie to the bottom ten.
e.zh: 这个榜单把他们的电影排到了倒数十名。

relegating.t: v. 降级；贬至（现在分词）

e.en: The coach was criticized for {relegating} his star player to the bench.
e.zh: 教练因将明星球员雪藏在替补席上而受到批评。

e.en: The redesign risks {relegating} accessibility to an afterthought.
e.zh: 这次重新设计有可能把无障碍功能沦为事后考虑。

e.en: The club is fighting to avoid {relegation} this season.
e.zh: 该俱乐部本赛季正在为保级而战。

e.en: Her {relegation} to a junior role hurt her morale.
e.zh: 被调到初级岗位让她的士气大受打击。

e.en: The rain refused to {relent} all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末雨都没有停下来的意思。

e.en: After hours of begging, her parents finally {relent}.
e.zh: 哀求几个小时后，她的父母终于松口了。

relenting.t: v. 心软；让步（现在分词）

e.en: The storm showed no sign of {relenting} by midnight.
e.zh: 到午夜时风暴丝毫没有减弱的迹象。

e.en: Without {relenting}, she pushed through the final mile.
e.zh: 她毫不松懈地坚持跑完了最后一英里。

e.en: The startup faced {relentless} pressure from competitors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司面临着竞争对手无情的压力。

e.en: Her {relentless} optimism kept the team going.
e.zh: 她始终如一的乐观让团队坚持了下来。

e.en: He worked {relentlessly} to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 他不知疲倦地工作以按时完成项目。

e.en: The media pursued the celebrity {relentlessly} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发后媒体对这位明星穷追不舍。

e.en: Her {relentlessness} eventually wore down every objection.
e.zh: 她那种不屈不挠最终瓦解了所有反对意见。

e.en: The team's {relentlessness} earned them a championship title.
e.zh: 球队的坚韧不拔为他们赢得了冠军头衔。

e.en: I don't see the {relevance} of that question to our topic.
e.zh: 我看不出这个问题与我们的话题有什么关联。

e.en: The algorithm ranks search results by {relevance}.
e.zh: 该算法按相关性对搜索结果进行排序。

e.en: The professor compared the {relevances} of two competing theories.
e.zh: 教授比较了两种相互竞争理论的相关性。

e.en: Search results are ranked by their {relevances} to the query.
e.zh: 搜索结果按与查询的相关程度进行排序。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {relevancy} of that piece of evidence.
e.zh: 律师质疑那份证据的相关性。

e.en: Ad targeting depends on the {relevancy} of user interests.
e.zh: 广告投放取决于用户兴趣的相关程度。

e.en: Please attach all {relevant} documents to your application.
e.zh: 请将所有相关文件附在申请中。

e.en: Her experience is highly {relevant} to this role.
e.zh: 她的经验与这个职位高度相关。

e.en: He spoke {relevantly} about the issues facing students today.
e.zh: 他切题地谈到了当今学生面临的问题。

e.en: More {relevantly}, the new law affects small businesses directly.
e.zh: 更切题的是,新法律直接影响小企业。

e.en: The car is famous for its {reliability} on long trips.
e.zh: 这款车以长途行驶的可靠性而闻名。

e.en: Researchers tested the {reliability} of the survey questions.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了问卷问题的可靠性。

e.en: She is a {reliable} friend who always shows up.
e.zh: 她是个可靠的朋友,总是会出现。

e.en: We need a {reliable} internet connection for the meeting.
e.zh: 我们开会需要稳定可靠的网络连接。

e.en: The app {reliably} syncs data across all your devices.
e.zh: 该应用能可靠地在所有设备间同步数据。

e.en: Trains here run {reliably} on schedule every day.
e.zh: 这里的火车每天都准时可靠地运行。

e.en: Our {reliance} on smartphones keeps growing year after year.
e.zh: 我们对智能手机的依赖逐年加深。

e.en: The country's heavy {reliance} on oil exports is risky.
e.zh: 该国对石油出口的严重依赖很危险。

e.en: Many startups are {reliant} on venture capital funding.
e.zh: 许多初创公司依赖风险投资融资。

e.en: Rural areas remain {reliant} on diesel generators for power.
e.zh: 农村地区仍然依赖柴油发电机供电。

e.en: This typewriter is a {relic} from my grandmother's office.
e.zh: 这台打字机是我祖母办公室留下的旧物。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a sacred {relic} in the temple ruins.
e.zh: 考古学家在寺庙遗址中发现了一件神圣遗物。

e.en: The museum displays ancient {relics} from the Tang dynasty.
e.zh: 博物馆展出唐代的古代文物。

e.en: Floppy disks are {relics} of early computing days.
e.zh: 软盘是早期计算时代的遗物。

e.en: This species is a {relict} from the last ice age.
e.zh: 这个物种是上一个冰河时代的孑遗。

e.en: The lake is a {relict} of a vast ancient sea.
e.zh: 这个湖是远古海洋的遗存。

relied.t: v. 依赖；信赖（rely 的过去式）

e.en: She {relied} on coffee to get through long shifts.
e.zh: 她靠咖啡撑过漫长的轮班。

e.en: Early sailors {relied} on stars to navigate the ocean.
e.zh: 早期水手依靠星辰在海上导航。

relief.t:
n. 缓解；宽慰
n. 救济；援助

e.en: It was a huge {relief} to finally finish the exam.
e.zh: 终于考完试真是松了一大口气。

e.en: The charity sent {relief} supplies to the flood victims.
e.zh: 慈善机构向洪灾灾民发送了救援物资。

relies.t: v. 依赖；信赖（第三人称单数）

e.en: The team {relies} on its captain during tight games.
e.zh: 球队在比分胶着时依靠队长发挥。

e.en: This recipe {relies} on fresh herbs for its flavor.
e.zh: 这道菜的风味依赖新鲜的香草。

e.en: A warm bath can {relieve} sore muscles after exercise.
e.zh: 温水浴可以缓解运动后的肌肉酸痛。

e.en: Hiring more staff would {relieve} pressure on the team.
e.zh: 多招些员工可以减轻团队的压力。

relieved.t:
adj. 宽慰的
v. 缓解（过去式）

e.en: I felt {relieved} when the test results came back normal.
e.zh: 检查结果正常时,我感到如释重负。

e.en: The medication {relieved} her headache within minutes.
e.zh: 这药几分钟内就缓解了她的头痛。

reliever.t: n. 缓解物；（棒球）后援投手

e.en: Yoga is a great stress {reliever} after a busy day.
e.zh: 瑜伽是繁忙一天后绝佳的解压方式。

e.en: The pitcher brought in a {reliever} in the eighth inning.
e.zh: 投手在第八局换上了一名救援投手。

relieves.t: v. 缓解；减轻（第三人称单数）

e.en: This cream {relieves} itching almost instantly.
e.zh: 这款乳霜几乎立即缓解瘙痒。

e.en: Listening to music {relieves} her anxiety before exams.
e.zh: 听音乐能缓解她考试前的焦虑。

relieving.t: v. 缓解；减轻（现在分词）

e.en: Stretching is great for {relieving} tension in your back.
e.zh: 拉伸非常有助于缓解背部的紧张。

e.en: The new highway is {relieving} traffic congestion downtown.
e.zh: 新公路正在缓解市中心的交通拥堵。

e.en: The wind blew out the candle, so I had to {relight} it.
e.zh: 风把蜡烛吹灭了,我只好重新点燃它。

e.en: A short trip can {relight} your passion for travel.
e.zh: 一次短途旅行可以重新点燃你对旅行的热情。

e.en: She studies the history of {religion} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究宗教的历史。

e.en: For him, football is practically a {religion}.
e.zh: 对他来说,足球简直就是一种信仰。

e.en: The author writes critically about extreme {religionist} movements.
e.zh: 作者批判性地撰写关于极端宗教主义运动的文章。

e.en: He grew up surrounded by devout {religionist} relatives.
e.zh: 他在虔诚的宗教信仰者亲戚环绕下长大。

e.en: India is home to many different {religions} and traditions.
e.zh: 印度有许多不同的宗教和传统。

e.en: World {religions} share many common moral teachings.
e.zh: 世界各大宗教有许多共同的道德教义。

e.en: The survey measured {religiosity} across different age groups.
e.zh: 这项调查测量了不同年龄群体的宗教虔诚度。

e.en: His public {religiosity} surprised many of his old friends.
e.zh: 他在公开场合的宗教虔诚让许多老朋友感到意外。

e.en: They hold {religious} services every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 他们每个星期天早上举行宗教仪式。

e.en: She is {religious} about flossing her teeth every night.
e.zh: 她每晚雷打不动地用牙线清洁牙齿。

religiously.t: adv. 虔诚地；一丝不苟地

e.en: He {religiously} checks his email first thing every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上一起来就雷打不动地查邮件。

e.en: She {religiously} attends yoga class twice a week.
e.zh: 她雷打不动地每周上两次瑜伽课。

e.en: His quiet {religiousness} shaped how he treated others.
e.zh: 他内在的虔诚塑造了他对待他人的方式。

e.en: The study explored {religiousness} among college students today.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了当今大学生的宗教虔诚程度。

reline.t: v. 重新加衬里；重新画线

e.en: The tailor will {reline} my winter coat next week.
e.zh: 裁缝下周会给我的冬大衣换新里子。

e.en: You should {reline} the old kitchen drawers with fresh paper.
e.zh: 你应该给厨房旧抽屉重新铺上新纸。

relinquish.t: v. 放弃；让出（权力、所有权）

e.en: The CEO refused to {relinquish} control of the company.
e.zh: 首席执行官拒绝放弃对公司的控制权。

e.en: She had to {relinquish} her seat to an elderly passenger.
e.zh: 她不得不把座位让给一位年长的乘客。

e.en: The king {relinquished} the throne to his younger brother.
e.zh: 国王把王位让给了他的弟弟。

e.en: He reluctantly {relinquished} the keys to his old car.
e.zh: 他不情愿地交出了旧车的钥匙。

relinquishes.t: v. 放弃；让出（第三人称单数）

e.en: She rarely {relinquishes} the TV remote during movie night.
e.zh: 电影之夜她很少把遥控器让给别人。

e.en: The contract {relinquishes} all rights to the original publisher.
e.zh: 该合同将所有权利让渡给原出版商。

relinquishing.t: v. 放弃；让出（现在分词）

e.en: He had trouble {relinquishing} control of the family business.
e.zh: 他难以放手对家族企业的控制权。

e.en: The team is {relinquishing} their title after five years.
e.zh: 该队五年后正交出他们的冠军头衔。

e.en: Her {relinquishment} of citizenship surprised the entire community.
e.zh: 她放弃国籍让整个社区都感到震惊。

e.en: The contract requires the {relinquishment} of all future claims.
e.zh: 该合同要求放弃所有未来的索赔权。

e.en: The cathedral's gold {reliquary} dates back to the 12th century.
e.zh: 大教堂的金质圣物匣可追溯到十二世纪。

e.en: Tourists gathered to admire the jeweled {reliquary} on display.
e.zh: 游客聚集起来欣赏展出的镶宝石圣物匣。

relish.t:
v. 享受；喜爱
n. 开胃调味酱

e.en: She doesn't {relish} the idea of working weekends.
e.zh: 她并不乐意周末加班的想法。

e.en: He spread sweet pickle {relish} on his hot dog.
e.zh: 他在热狗上抹了甜味腌菜酱。

relit.t: v. 重新点燃（relight 的过去式）

e.en: After the storm passed, we {relit} the campfire.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,我们重新点燃了篝火。

e.en: The chef calmly {relit} the burner and continued cooking.
e.zh: 厨师镇定地重新点燃炉灶继续做菜。

e.en: Old photos help me {relive} my childhood summers.
e.zh: 老照片让我重温童年的夏天。

e.en: Veterans often {relive} difficult memories from their service.
e.zh: 退伍军人常常重新经历服役时的痛苦回忆。

reload.t: v. 重新加载（页面、弹药等）

e.en: Try to {reload} the page if the video won't play.
e.zh: 如果视频无法播放,试着刷新页面。

e.en: The soldier had to {reload} his rifle quickly.
e.zh: 士兵必须迅速给步枪重新装弹。

e.en: The company plans to {relocate} its headquarters to Austin.
e.zh: 公司计划把总部搬到奥斯汀。

e.en: Many families had to {relocate} after the earthquake.
e.zh: 许多家庭在地震后不得不搬迁。

rejuvenation.t: n. 恢复活力；返老还童

e.en: The city's waterfront {rejuvenation} project finally broke ground.
e.zh: 这座城市的滨水复兴项目终于动工了。

e.en: She swears by yoga for skin {rejuvenation} and stress relief.
e.zh: 她坚信瑜伽能让皮肤焕发活力并缓解压力。

rekindle.t: v. 重新点燃（热情、兴趣）

e.en: The reunion helped {rekindle} their long-lost friendship.
e.zh: 那次重聚让他们失联多年的友谊重新点燃。

e.en: A good book can {rekindle} your love of reading.
e.zh: 一本好书能重新点燃你对阅读的热爱。

e.en: The trip {rekindled} her passion for landscape photography.
e.zh: 那次旅行重新点燃了她对风景摄影的热情。

e.en: They {rekindled} their romance after running into each other.
e.zh: 他们偶然重逢后旧情复燃。

e.en: The class is {rekindling} my interest in classical music.
e.zh: 这门课重新点燃了我对古典音乐的兴趣。

e.en: Old photos have a way of {rekindling} forgotten memories.
e.zh: 旧照片总能勾起被遗忘的回忆。

relabel.t: v. 重新贴标签；重新归类

e.en: You can {relabel} any folder by right-clicking its name.
e.zh: 右键点击文件夹名称即可重新命名。

e.en: The brand had to {relabel} every bottle after the recipe change.
e.zh: 配方更改后,该品牌不得不重新贴标每个瓶子。

relapse.t: v./n. 旧病复发；故态复萌

e.en: She worried she might {relapse} during the stressful holidays.
e.zh: 她担心自己会在压力大的假期里旧病复发。

e.en: Support groups help patients avoid a {relapse} after treatment.
e.zh: 互助小组帮助病人避免治疗后复发。

e.en: He {relapsed} once but came back stronger after rehab.
e.zh: 他曾复发过一次,但康复后变得更坚强了。

e.en: The patient {relapsed} just weeks after finishing chemotherapy.
e.zh: 那位患者在化疗结束几周后就复发了。

e.en: The clinic tracks {relapses} to improve its long-term treatment plans.
e.zh: 诊所跟踪复发情况以改进长期治疗方案。

e.en: She {relapses} into old habits whenever work gets stressful.
e.zh: 每当工作压力大,她就会回到旧习惯里。

e.en: She's been diagnosed with {relapsing} multiple sclerosis.
e.zh: 她被诊断患有复发型多发性硬化症。

e.en: He's terrified of {relapsing} after two years of sobriety.
e.zh: 戒酒两年后,他非常害怕再次复发。

relatable.t: adj. 让人有共鸣的；能感同身受的

e.en: Her TikToks are funny because they're so {relatable}.
e.zh: 她的TikTok很有趣,因为内容特别贴近生活。

e.en: The main character feels {relatable} to anyone who's been broke.
e.zh: 对任何穷过的人来说,主角都让人感同身受。

relate.t:
v. 有关联；叙述
v. 产生共鸣

e.en: Many students {relate} to the struggles described in the novel.
e.zh: 许多学生对小说中描写的挣扎感同身受。

e.en: Can you {relate} the symptoms to a specific cause?
e.zh: 你能把这些症状和某个具体原因联系起来吗？

related.t: adj. 相关的；有亲属关系的

e.en: The two crimes appear to be {related}.
e.zh: 这两起案件似乎有关联。

e.en: She is closely {related} to the founder of the company.
e.zh: 她和公司创始人有近亲关系。

e.en: {Relatedly}, the team also updated the privacy policy this week.
e.zh: 与此相关，团队本周还更新了隐私政策。

e.en: {Relatedly}, sleep quality affects memory the next day.
e.zh: 与此相关，睡眠质量会影响第二天的记忆力。

e.en: The study measures genetic {relatedness} between the two species.
e.zh: 该研究测量了两个物种之间的遗传亲缘关系。

e.en: A sense of {relatedness} is key to employee well-being.
e.zh: 归属感是员工幸福感的关键。

e.en: This chapter {relates} the events of the war.
e.zh: 本章讲述了这场战争的经过。

e.en: Her research {relates} climate change to crop yields.
e.zh: 她的研究将气候变化与作物产量联系起来。

relating.t: v. 关于；有关联（进行时）

e.en: He had trouble {relating} to his classmates after moving.
e.zh: 搬家后他很难融入同学之中。

e.en: Documents {relating} to the case were sealed by the court.
e.zh: 与案件有关的文件被法院封存。

relation.t:
n. 关系；关联
n. 亲戚

e.en: There is no clear {relation} between diet and her condition.
e.zh: 饮食与她的病情之间没有明显关系。

e.en: He visited a distant {relation} in Canada.
e.zh: 他去加拿大探望了一位远亲。

relational.t: adj. 关系的；关系型（数据库）

e.en: PostgreSQL is a popular {relational} database.
e.zh: PostgreSQL 是一种流行的关系型数据库。

e.en: Good leaders develop strong {relational} skills with their teams.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会培养与团队良好的人际关系能力。

e.en: Diplomatic {relations} between the two countries have improved.
e.zh: 两国之间的外交关系有所改善。

e.en: The manager handles customer {relations} for the hotel.
e.zh: 这位经理负责酒店的客户关系工作。

e.en: They have been in a {relationship} for three years.
e.zh: 他们已经恋爱三年了。

e.en: There is a strong {relationship} between exercise and mood.
e.zh: 锻炼与情绪之间存在紧密的关系。

e.en: Healthy {relationships} require honest communication.
e.zh: 健康的人际关系需要坦诚的沟通。

e.en: The chart shows {relationships} between variables in the dataset.
e.zh: 图表显示了数据集中各变量之间的关系。

relative.t:
adj. 相对的
n. 亲戚

e.en: My closest {relative} lives just down the street.
e.zh: 我最亲的亲戚就住在街那头。

e.en: Happiness is {relative} to your expectations.
e.zh: 幸福是相对于你的期望而言的。

e.en: The new phone is {relatively} cheap compared to last year's model.
e.zh: 这款新手机与去年的型号相比相对便宜。

e.en: The exam was {relatively} easy for most students.
e.zh: 对大多数学生来说，这次考试相对简单。

e.en: All her {relatives} gathered for the wedding.
e.zh: 她所有的亲戚都聚在一起参加婚礼。

e.en: Pandas are distant {relatives} of bears.
e.zh: 熊猫是熊的远亲。

e.en: Cultural {relativism} argues that morals depend on context.
e.zh: 文化相对主义认为道德取决于具体情境。

e.en: Critics say moral {relativism} undermines universal human rights.
e.zh: 批评者称道德相对主义削弱了普世人权。

e.en: As a {relativist}, she rejects absolute moral rules.
e.zh: 作为一名相对主义者，她拒绝接受绝对的道德准则。

e.en: His {relativist} stance frustrated the more traditional philosophers.
e.zh: 他的相对主义立场让较为传统的哲学家感到沮丧。

relativistic.t: adj. 相对论的；相对主义的

e.en: At {relativistic} speeds, time slows down significantly.
e.zh: 在接近光速时，时间会显著变慢。

e.en: The simulation accounts for {relativistic} effects near black holes.
e.zh: 该模拟考虑了黑洞附近的相对论效应。

e.en: The report compares pay {relativities} across industries.
e.zh: 报告比较了各行业之间的薪酬相对水平。

e.en: Wage {relativities} between sectors have widened over the decade.
e.zh: 过去十年间各行业的工资差距已经扩大。

e.en: Einstein's theory of {relativity} changed modern physics.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了现代物理学。

e.en: GPS satellites must correct for {relativity} to stay accurate.
e.zh: GPS 卫星必须修正相对论效应才能保持精准。

e.en: Some philosophers try to {relativize} every ethical claim.
e.zh: 一些哲学家试图把每一种伦理主张都相对化。

e.en: Don't {relativize} her achievement by comparing it to others.
e.zh: 别拿她和别人比较来淡化她的成就。

e.en: In Texas, a real estate {relator} must be licensed.
e.zh: 在德州，房地产经纪人必须持有执照。

e.en: The {relator} brought the lawsuit on behalf of the state.
e.zh: 该原告代表州政府提起了诉讼。

relaunch.t: v./n. 重新发布；再次推出

e.en: The startup plans to {relaunch} its app next month.
e.zh: 这家初创公司计划下个月重新发布其应用。

e.en: The brand's {relaunch} attracted millions of new customers.
e.zh: 该品牌的重新推出吸引了数百万新客户。

e.en: The website was {relaunched} with a cleaner design.
e.zh: 网站以更简洁的设计重新上线了。

e.en: They {relaunched} the product after fixing the safety issue.
e.zh: 他们解决安全问题后重新推出了该产品。

e.en: I like to {relax} with a book on weekends.
e.zh: 我喜欢周末读本书放松一下。

e.en: The government may {relax} travel restrictions next month.
e.zh: 政府可能会在下月放宽旅行限制。

relaxant.t:
n. 松弛剂
adj. 使松弛的

e.en: The doctor prescribed a muscle {relaxant} for her back pain.
e.zh: 医生为她的背痛开了肌肉松弛剂。

e.en: Chamomile tea acts as a mild {relaxant} before bed.
e.zh: 洋甘菊茶在睡前有温和的放松作用。

e.en: Yoga is a great form of {relaxation} after work.
e.zh: 瑜伽是下班后绝佳的放松方式。

e.en: The {relaxation} of the rules surprised many parents.
e.zh: 规定的放宽让许多家长感到意外。

e.en: She felt {relaxed} after the long hot bath.
e.zh: 洗完热水澡后她感到很放松。

e.en: The cafe has a {relaxed} atmosphere perfect for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆氛围轻松，非常适合学习。

relaxer.t: n. 让人放松的东西；松弛剂

e.en: A warm bath is my favorite {relaxer} after work.
e.zh: 热水澡是我下班后最喜欢的放松方式。

e.en: She used a hair {relaxer} to straighten her curls.
e.zh: 她用直发剂把卷发拉直。

e.en: He {relaxes} by playing video games every evening.
e.zh: 他每天晚上靠打电子游戏放松。

e.en: The medication {relaxes} the muscles around the airway.
e.zh: 这种药物可以放松气道周围的肌肉。

e.en: Listening to jazz is so {relaxing} after a long day.
e.zh: 忙碌一天后听爵士乐很放松。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {relaxing} by the pool.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

relay.t:
v. 转达；转播
n. 接力；继电器

e.en: Please {relay} this message to the team leader.
e.zh: 请把这条消息转告给组长。

e.en: Our school won the 4x100m {relay} race.
e.zh: 我们学校赢得了 4x100 米接力赛。

relays.t: v./n. 转播；接力（复数/三单）

e.en: The reporter {relays} updates from the disaster zone every hour.
e.zh: 记者每小时从灾区传回最新消息。

e.en: The control system has several backup {relays} for safety.
e.zh: 该控制系统配有多个备用继电器以确保安全。

e.en: After the stroke, he had to {relearn} how to walk.
e.zh: 中风之后，他不得不重新学习走路。

e.en: I need to {relearn} French before my trip to Paris.
e.zh: 去巴黎之前我得重新学一下法语。

e.en: {Relearning} old skills can be harder than learning new ones.
e.zh: 重新学习旧技能有时比学新东西更难。

e.en: She is {relearning} the piano after a twenty-year break.
e.zh: 她中断二十年后正在重新学钢琴。

releasable.t: adj. 可发布的；可释放的

e.en: Only the {releasable} portion of the report was shared publicly.
e.zh: 只有报告中可公开的部分被对外发布。

e.en: The wildlife center checks if injured birds are {releasable}.
e.zh: 野生动物中心会检查受伤的鸟类能否放归自然。

e.en: Apple will {release} the new iPhone next week.
e.zh: 苹果将于下周发布新款 iPhone。

e.en: The latest software {release} fixes several bugs.
e.zh: 最新发布的软件版本修复了多个漏洞。

released.t: v. 已发布；已释放（过去式）

e.en: The film was {released} on streaming platforms last Friday.
e.zh: 这部电影上周五在流媒体平台上线。

e.en: Police {released} the suspect due to lack of evidence.
e.zh: 由于证据不足，警方释放了嫌疑人。

releases.t: n./v. 发布；版本（复数/三单）

e.en: Spotify {releases} new playlists every Monday morning.
e.zh: Spotify 每周一早上会上线新的歌单。

e.en: The studio plans three major {releases} this summer.
e.zh: 该工作室计划今夏发行三部重磅作品。

e.en: The band is {releasing} their new album in June.
e.zh: 这支乐队将在六月发行新专辑。

e.en: Factories are {releasing} less carbon since the new rules.
e.zh: 新规出台后，工厂的碳排放有所减少。

relegate.t: v. 降级；贬到（次要位置）

e.en: The boss tried to {relegate} him to filing paperwork.
e.zh: 老板试图把他打发去做文件归档的活。

e.en: Don't {relegate} climate change to a footnote in the report.
e.zh: 不要把气候变化只放在报告的脚注里。

reminding.t: v. 提醒（remind 的现在分词）

e.en: Thanks for {reminding} me about the team lunch.
e.zh: 谢谢你提醒我团队聚餐的事。

e.en: She kept {reminding} the kids to brush their teeth.
e.zh: 她不停地提醒孩子们刷牙。

e.en: This song {reminds} me of my college days.
e.zh: 这首歌让我想起大学时光。

e.en: The app {reminds} you to drink water every hour.
e.zh: 这款应用每小时提醒你喝水。

e.en: Fluoride toothpaste promotes the {remineralization} of weakened enamel.
e.zh: 含氟牙膏可促进受损牙釉质的再矿化。

e.en: This filter adds {remineralization} back to purified drinking water.
e.zh: 这种滤芯能为纯净饮用水重新添加矿物质。

remington.t: n. 雷明顿（姓氏/品牌名）

e.en: My grandfather still owns an old {Remington} typewriter.
e.zh: 我爷爷还留着一台老式雷明顿打字机。

e.en: He hunts deer with a vintage {Remington} rifle.
e.zh: 他用一支古董雷明顿步枪猎鹿。

e.en: Old friends love to {reminisce} about their college years.
e.zh: 老朋友们最爱怀念大学时光。

e.en: We sat by the fire and began to {reminisce}.
e.zh: 我们坐在炉火旁开始追忆往昔。

e.en: They {reminisced} about summers spent at the lake.
e.zh: 他们追忆起在湖边度过的那些夏天。

e.en: Grandma {reminisced} about her wedding day for hours.
e.zh: 奶奶花了好几个小时回忆她的婚礼那天。

e.en: Her memoir is full of warm childhood {reminiscence}.
e.zh: 她的回忆录里满是温馨的童年回忆。

e.en: The photo triggered a sudden {reminiscence} of summer camp.
e.zh: 那张照片让我突然想起了夏令营的时光。

reminiscent.t: adj. 让人想起的；怀旧的

e.en: The cafe's decor is {reminiscent} of old Parisian bistros.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的装潢让人想起老巴黎小酒馆。

e.en: Her painting style is {reminiscent} of early Picasso.
e.zh: 她的画风让人联想到早期的毕加索。

e.en: He smiled {reminiscently} as he flipped through the album.
e.zh: 他翻着相册,带着追忆的神情微笑。

e.en: She spoke {reminiscently} about her first apartment in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她带着怀念的语气谈起在东京的第一间公寓。

e.en: My dad often {reminisces} about his army days.
e.zh: 我爸常常回忆他当兵的日子。

e.en: She {reminisces} fondly whenever old songs come on.
e.zh: 每当老歌响起,她就会满怀深情地追忆往昔。

reminiscing.t: v. 追忆往事（现在分词）

e.en: We sat by the fire, {reminiscing} about our college days.
e.zh: 我们坐在火炉旁，回忆着大学时光。

e.en: Grandma loves {reminiscing} about her trips to Paris.
e.zh: 奶奶喜欢回忆她去巴黎的旅行。

e.en: I would be {remiss} not to thank my team for their hard work.
e.zh: 如果不感谢团队的辛勤付出，我就太失职了。

e.en: The manager was {remiss} in checking the safety reports.
e.zh: 经理在核查安全报告方面有所疏忽。

remission.t: n. 缓解（病情）；免除（债务、刑罚）

e.en: Her cancer has been in {remission} for two years.
e.zh: 她的癌症已经缓解两年了。

e.en: Good behavior earned the prisoner a {remission} of his sentence.
e.zh: 良好的表现让这名囚犯获得减刑。

remit.t:
v. 汇款；免除
n. 职责范围

e.en: Workers abroad {remit} money home every month.
e.zh: 在海外工作的人每月都会汇钱回家。

e.en: Climate policy falls outside the committee's {remit}.
e.zh: 气候政策不在该委员会的职责范围内。

remits.t: v. 汇款；免除（remit 三单）

e.en: He {remits} part of his salary to his parents each month.
e.zh: 他每月把部分工资汇给父母。

e.en: The job {remits} of the two teams clearly overlap.
e.zh: 这两个团队的职责范围明显有重叠。

e.en: Please include your {remittance} with the order form.
e.zh: 请将汇款连同订单一并寄出。

e.en: Migrant workers send billions in {remittance} home each year.
e.zh: 外来务工者每年汇回家乡数十亿元。

e.en: {Remittances} from overseas workers support many rural families.
e.zh: 海外劳工的汇款养活着许多农村家庭。

e.en: The bank charges low fees for international {remittances}.
e.zh: 该银行对国际汇款收取低廉的手续费。

remitted.t: v. 已汇款；已免除（remit 过去式）

e.en: She {remitted} the payment through her mobile banking app.
e.zh: 她通过手机银行 App 完成了汇款。

e.en: His fever finally {remitted} after three days of rest.
e.zh: 休息三天后，他的烧终于退了。

remittent.t: adj. 弛张的（发热时起时伏）

e.en: The patient developed a {remittent} fever that came and went daily.
e.zh: 病人出现了每日反复的弛张热。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {remittent} symptoms over several weeks.
e.zh: 医生对反复出现的症状监测了数周。

remitting.t: v. 汇款；免除（现在分词）

e.en: She is {remitting} funds to her family overseas this week.
e.zh: 她这周正在向海外家人汇款。

e.en: The disease has a {remitting} pattern with calmer phases.
e.zh: 这种疾病呈现缓解与发作交替的模式。

remix.t:
n. 混音版
v. 重新混音

e.en: The DJ played a fresh {remix} of the 90s hit.
e.zh: DJ 播放了那首九十年代金曲的全新混音版。

e.en: Producers love to {remix} old tracks for younger audiences.
e.zh: 制作人喜欢把老歌重新混音给年轻听众听。

e.en: The old wall is a {remnant} of the medieval city.
e.zh: 这堵旧墙是中世纪城池的遗迹。

e.en: She bought a fabric {remnant} on sale to make pillows.
e.zh: 她买了打折的零头布料做抱枕。

e.en: My drum kit came with a brand new {Remo} drumhead.
e.zh: 我的鼓组配了一张全新的 Remo 鼓皮。

e.en: The rapper {Remo} dropped his debut album last Friday.
e.zh: 说唱歌手 Remo 上周五发行了首张专辑。

e.en: They plan to {remodel} the kitchen this summer.
e.zh: 他们打算今年夏天翻新厨房。

e.en: The cafe will {remodel} its interior to feel cozier.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆将重新装修内部，让人感觉更温馨。

remodeled.t: v. 已改造（remodel 过去式）

e.en: The couple {remodeled} their basement into a home gym.
e.zh: 这对夫妻把地下室改造成了家庭健身房。

e.en: The hotel lobby was completely {remodeled} last year.
e.zh: 酒店大堂去年彻底翻新了一遍。

remodeling.t: v. 改造；n. 翻新工程

e.en: Bathroom {remodeling} costs more than most people expect.
e.zh: 浴室翻新的花费比大多数人想象的要高。

e.en: They are {remodeling} the office to fit more desks.
e.zh: 他们正在改造办公室以容纳更多工位。

e.en: The pub was {remodelled} in a modern industrial style.
e.zh: 这家酒吧被改造成了现代工业风。

e.en: She {remodelled} the spare room into a tiny studio.
e.zh: 她把空房间改造成了小工作室。

e.en: The {remodelling} of the high street took nearly a year.
e.zh: 主街的改造工程花了将近一年。

e.en: They are {remodelling} the cafe to add outdoor seating.
e.zh: 他们正在改造咖啡馆，增加户外座位。

e.en: The new CEO hopes to {remold} the company culture.
e.zh: 新任 CEO 希望重塑公司文化。

e.en: She tried to {remold} the clay into a smoother shape.
e.zh: 她试图把黏土重新捏成更光滑的形状。

e.en: His angry {remonstrance} did not change the boss's mind.
e.zh: 他愤怒的抗议并没有让老板改变主意。

e.en: The villagers signed a {remonstrance} against the new highway.
e.zh: 村民们联名签署了一份反对新公路的抗议书。

e.en: Despite repeated {remonstrances}, the policy was pushed through.
e.zh: 尽管屡次抗议，该政策仍被强行推行。

e.en: Her gentle {remonstrances} finally got the children to behave.
e.zh: 她温和的劝告终于让孩子们守规矩了。

e.en: Parents began to {remonstrate} with the school over the new rules.
e.zh: 家长们开始就新规定向校方提出抗议。

e.en: He tried to {remonstrate}, but the referee waved him away.
e.zh: 他想要抗议，但裁判挥手让他走开。

e.en: She {remonstrated} loudly when the cashier overcharged her.
e.zh: 收银员多收了钱，她大声抗议。

e.en: The neighbors {remonstrated} about the late-night noise.
e.zh: 邻居们抱怨深夜的噪音问题。

e.en: He often {remonstrates} with referees during basketball games.
e.zh: 他在篮球比赛中经常和裁判争辩。

e.en: The columnist {remonstrates} against rising rents in the city.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家撰文抗议城市租金上涨。

remonstrating.t: v. 抗议；规劝（现在分词）

e.en: She stood at the gate, {remonstrating} with the security guard.
e.zh: 她站在门口，与保安据理力争。

e.en: He spent an hour {remonstrating} about the poor service.
e.zh: 他花了一小时抱怨糟糕的服务。

remora.t: n. 䲟鱼（吸附在鲨鱼身上的鱼）

e.en: A {remora} clung to the shark's belly as it swam.
e.zh: 一条鮣鱼吸附在鲨鱼腹部随它游动。

e.en: Divers spotted a small {remora} hitching a ride on a turtle.
e.zh: 潜水员看到一条小鮣鱼搭便车附在海龟身上。

e.en: He felt deep {remorse} after lying to his best friend.
e.zh: 对最好的朋友撒谎后，他深感悔恨。

e.en: The driver showed no {remorse} for causing the accident.
e.zh: 那位司机对造成事故毫无悔意。

e.en: She looked {remorseful} as she apologized to her mother.
e.zh: 她向母亲道歉时一脸悔恨。

e.en: The {remorseful} teenager promised never to skip school again.
e.zh: 这名悔过的少年保证再也不逃学了。

e.en: He {remorsefully} admitted that he had taken the money.
e.zh: 他懊悔地承认是自己拿走了那笔钱。

e.en: She glanced {remorsefully} at the broken vase on the floor.
e.zh: 她懊悔地看了一眼地上摔碎的花瓶。

e.en: The hackers launched a {remorseless} attack on the servers.
e.zh: 黑客对服务器发起了无情的攻击。

e.en: He was a {remorseless} negotiator who never backed down.
e.zh: 他是个毫不留情的谈判者，从不退让。

e.en: The summer sun beat down {remorselessly} on the hikers.
e.zh: 夏日的太阳无情地炙烤着徒步的人。

e.en: Inflation rose {remorselessly} throughout the year.
e.zh: 通货膨胀全年无情地持续上升。

e.en: His many {remorses} kept him awake long into the night.
e.zh: 种种悔恨让他久久无法入眠。

e.en: She wrote about the small {remorses} of everyday life.
e.zh: 她写下了日常生活中那些细小的懊悔。

remortgage.t:
v. 再次抵押贷款
n. 再抵押

e.en: They decided to {remortgage} the house to fund renovations.
e.zh: 他们决定把房子重新抵押贷款来支付装修费。

e.en: Falling rates make this a good time to {remortgage}.
e.zh: 利率下降，是重新办理抵押贷款的好时机。

remote.t:
adj. 远程的；偏远的
n. 遥控器

e.en: She works from a {remote} village in the mountains.
e.zh: 她在一个偏远的山村远程办公。

e.en: I lost the TV {remote} between the sofa cushions.
e.zh: 我把电视遥控器丢在沙发缝里了。

e.en: Most of our team works {remotely} from different countries.
e.zh: 我们团队大多数人在不同国家远程办公。

e.en: His story isn't even {remotely} believable.
e.zh: 他的说法一点都不可信。

e.en: The {remoteness} of the cabin made deliveries impossible.
e.zh: 小屋地处偏远，根本无法送货上门。

e.en: She felt a strange {remoteness} from her old friends.
e.zh: 她对昔日好友感到一种奇怪的疏离。

remould.t: v. 重塑；翻新（英式拼写）

e.en: The party tried to {remould} its image before the election.
e.zh: 该党试图在大选前重塑形象。

e.en: He bought a cheap {remould} tyre for the spare wheel.
e.zh: 他买了一条便宜的翻新轮胎做备胎。

e.en: After the fall, she paused before trying to {remount} the horse.
e.zh: 摔下来后，她停顿片刻才再次上马。

e.en: Workers will {remount} the painting after the wall is repaired.
e.zh: 墙修好后，工人会把画重新挂回去。

removable.t: adj. 可移除的；可拆卸的

e.en: This laptop has a {removable} battery for easy replacement.
e.zh: 这款笔记本电脑配有可拆卸电池，方便更换。

e.en: The car seat cover is fully {removable} and washable.
e.zh: 这款汽车座椅套完全可拆卸清洗。

e.en: The {removal} of the old tree took most of the morning.
e.zh: 清除那棵老树花了大半个上午。

e.en: Stain {removal} works best when the spill is fresh.
e.zh: 污渍刚沾上时去除效果最好。

relocated.t: v. 搬迁；迁移（relocate 的过去式）

e.en: She {relocated} to Tokyo for a new job last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天为了新工作搬到了东京。

e.en: The endangered birds were {relocated} to a safer reserve.
e.zh: 濒危鸟类被迁移到一个更安全的保护区。

e.en: The job offer includes a generous {relocation} package.
e.zh: 这份工作邀请包含丰厚的搬迁补贴。

e.en: Office {relocation} took the team three weeks to complete.
e.zh: 办公室搬迁花了团队三周才完成。

e.en: She agreed to help, but with obvious {reluctance}.
e.zh: 她答应帮忙,但显然很不情愿。

e.en: His {reluctance} to speak up cost him the promotion.
e.zh: 他不愿发声让他失去了升职机会。

e.en: He was {reluctant} to share his personal phone number.
e.zh: 他不太愿意分享自己的私人电话号码。

e.en: Many parents are {reluctant} to let kids use social media.
e.zh: 许多家长不愿让孩子使用社交媒体。

e.en: She {reluctantly} agreed to attend the family reunion.
e.zh: 她不情愿地答应参加家庭聚会。

e.en: The child {reluctantly} handed over the toy to her sister.
e.zh: 那孩子勉强把玩具交给了妹妹。

rely.t: v. 依赖；依靠（常与 on 连用）

e.en: You can always {rely} on her to keep a secret.
e.zh: 你总是可以信赖她保守秘密。

e.en: Many remote workers {rely} on stable Wi-Fi connections.
e.zh: 许多远程工作者依赖稳定的无线网络。

relying.t: v. 依赖（rely 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {relying} on scholarships to pay for college.
e.zh: 她靠奖学金来支付大学学费。

e.en: Drivers are {relying} more on GPS than paper maps.
e.zh: 司机越来越依赖GPS而不是纸质地图。

rem.t:
n. 雷姆（辐射剂量单位）
n. 快速眼动（REM 睡眠）

e.en: Most vivid dreams happen during {rem} sleep.
e.zh: 大多数生动的梦发生在快速眼动睡眠期间。

e.en: Designers often use {rem} units for scalable web typography.
e.zh: 设计师常用rem单位来实现可缩放的网页排版。

e.en: Please {remain} seated until the plane comes to a stop.
e.zh: 请保持就座,直到飞机完全停稳。

e.en: Only a few cookies {remain} in the jar.
e.zh: 罐子里只剩下几块饼干了。

e.en: She spent the {remainder} of the afternoon reading quietly.
e.zh: 她安静地读书度过了下午剩下的时间。

e.en: Divide ten by three and the {remainder} is one.
e.zh: 十除以三,余数是一。

remainders.t: n. 剩余部分（remainder 的复数）

e.en: The teacher explained how to handle {remainders} in long division.
e.zh: 老师讲解了长除法中余数的处理方法。

e.en: The bookstore sells {remainders} at half price near the entrance.
e.zh: 书店在入口处半价出售滞销书。

remained.t: v. 保持；留下（remain 的过去式）

e.en: She {remained} calm during the entire interview.
e.zh: 整场面试中她都保持冷静。

e.en: Only a few cookies {remained} after the party.
e.zh: 派对结束后只剩下几块饼干。

e.en: Please finish the {remaining} tasks before lunch.
e.zh: 请在午饭前完成剩下的任务。

e.en: The {remaining} guests left around midnight.
e.zh: 剩下的客人大约在午夜离开。

remains.t:
v. 保持；剩下
n. 遗迹；遗体

e.en: The mystery {remains} unsolved after twenty years.
e.zh: 这个谜团二十年来仍未解开。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered ancient {remains} near the river.
e.zh: 考古学家在河边发现了古代遗骸。

remake.t:
v. 重制；翻拍
n. 翻拍作品

e.en: Hollywood plans to {remake} the classic horror film.
e.zh: 好莱坞打算翻拍那部经典恐怖片。

e.en: The {remake} received better reviews than the original.
e.zh: 翻拍版的评价比原版还要好。

remaking.t: v. 重制；翻拍（remake 的现在分词）

e.en: The studio is {remaking} a popular nineties sitcom.
e.zh: 该制片厂正在翻拍一部九十年代的人气情景喜剧。

e.en: She spent the weekend {remaking} her grandmother's recipe.
e.zh: 她周末都在重做奶奶的拿手菜。

remand.t: v. 还押候审；发回重审

e.en: The judge decided to {remand} the suspect into custody.
e.zh: 法官决定将嫌疑人还押候审。

e.en: The appeals court will {remand} the case for retrial.
e.zh: 上诉法院将把此案发回重审。

e.en: The printer uses {remanufactured} ink cartridges to save money.
e.zh: 这台打印机使用再造墨盒以节省成本。

e.en: Many car parts are {remanufactured} rather than replaced.
e.zh: 许多汽车零件是再造的,而不是直接更换。

remapping.t: n. 重新映射（按键、内存等）

e.en: The app supports {remapping} keyboard shortcuts to your liking.
e.zh: 该应用支持按个人喜好重新映射键盘快捷键。

e.en: Engineers are {remapping} the city's flood-prone zones.
e.zh: 工程师正在重新绘制该市易涝区的地图。

remark.t:
n. 评论；言论
v. 评论；谈及

e.en: Her witty {remark} made everyone burst out laughing.
e.zh: 她那句俏皮话让大家哄堂大笑。

e.en: I'd like to {remark} on how clean the kitchen looks.
e.zh: 我想称赞一下厨房真干净。

remarkable.t: adj. 出色的；了不起的；值得注意的

e.en: She made a {remarkable} recovery after the surgery.
e.zh: 她手术后恢复得非常出色。

e.en: The new phone has {remarkable} battery life.
e.zh: 这款新手机的电池续航非常出色。

e.en: The twins look {remarkably} alike for half-siblings.
e.zh: 作为同父异母的兄妹,这对双胞胎长得出奇地像。

e.en: He performed {remarkably} well under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下表现得格外出色。

remarked.t: v. 评论；谈及（remark 的过去式）

e.en: My boss {remarked} that the report was very thorough.
e.zh: 我老板评论说这份报告非常详尽。

e.en: Several reviewers {remarked} on the film's stunning visuals.
e.zh: 几位影评人都评价了这部电影惊艳的视觉效果。

remarking.t: v. 评论（remark 的现在分词）

e.en: He kept {remarking} on how cold the office was.
e.zh: 他一直在说办公室有多冷。

e.en: Critics are {remarking} on the singer's dramatic comeback.
e.zh: 评论家纷纷评论这位歌手戏剧性的回归。

e.en: The president's opening {remarks} lasted about ten minutes.
e.zh: 总统的开场致辞持续了约十分钟。

e.en: She {remarks} on every typo in my essays.
e.zh: 我作文里的每个错别字她都要点评一下。

e.en: Their {remarriage} surprised everyone in the family.
e.zh: 他们的复婚让家里所有人都很意外。

e.en: She wrote a book about {remarriage} after fifty.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于五十岁后再婚的书。

remarried.t: v. 再婚（remarry 的过去式）

e.en: My aunt {remarried} a kind man last spring.
e.zh: 我姑姑去年春天嫁给了一位善良的男士。

e.en: Many divorced parents have {remarried} by their forties.
e.zh: 许多离异的父母在四十多岁时已经再婚。

e.en: She has no plans to {remarry} after the divorce.
e.zh: 离婚后她没有再婚的打算。

e.en: He decided to {remarry} his ex-wife years later.
e.zh: 几年后他决定与前妻复婚。

remastered.t: adj. 重制的（音频、影像重新制作）

e.en: The studio released a {remastered} version of the album.
e.zh: 唱片公司发行了这张专辑的重制版。

e.en: Fans love the {remastered} graphics in the classic game.
e.zh: 粉丝们很喜欢这款经典游戏重制后的画面。

rematch.t:
n. 复赛；再次对决
v. 重新匹配

e.en: The boxer demanded a {rematch} after losing the title.
e.zh: 那位拳手输掉冠军后要求再赛一场。

e.en: Tonight's game is a {rematch} of last year's final.
e.zh: 今晚的比赛是去年决赛双方的再次较量。

e.en: The museum displays an original {Rembrandt} portrait downstairs.
e.zh: 博物馆楼下展出着一幅伦勃朗的原作肖像。

e.en: Critics call her the {Rembrandt} of modern photography.
e.zh: 评论家称她为现代摄影界的伦勃朗。

e.en: The veteran proudly served in the {REME} for decades.
e.zh: 这位老兵在皇家电气机械工程兵团光荣服役了几十年。

e.en: He trained as a vehicle mechanic with the {REME}.
e.zh: 他在皇家电气机械工程兵团接受车辆机械师培训。

remediable.t: adj. 可补救的；可治疗的

e.en: Fortunately, the leak turned out to be easily {remediable}.
e.zh: 幸运的是,这处漏水很容易修补。

e.en: Most early reading difficulties are {remediable} with proper tutoring.
e.zh: 大多数早期阅读障碍通过适当辅导都是可以纠正的。

remedial.t: adj. 补救的；辅导的（如辅导课程）

e.en: The school offers {remedial} math classes after school.
e.zh: 学校在放学后开设数学补习班。

e.en: The company took {remedial} action to fix the bug.
e.zh: 公司采取了补救措施来修复这个漏洞。

remediate.t: v. 补救；修复（问题、污染等）

e.en: The contractor will {remediate} the mold in the basement.
e.zh: 承包商将清除地下室的霉菌。

e.en: We need to {remediate} the data quality issues quickly.
e.zh: 我们需要尽快修复数据质量问题。

remediation.t: n. 修复；补救（环境、漏洞等）

e.en: Soil {remediation} at the old factory site took years.
e.zh: 那家老厂址的土壤修复花了好几年。

e.en: Students who fail will receive extra {remediation} support.
e.zh: 未通过的学生将获得额外的辅导支持。

remedies.t: n. 疗法；补救措施（复数）

e.en: My grandmother swears by herbal {remedies} for colds.
e.zh: 我奶奶非常推崇用草药偏方治感冒。

e.en: The court considered several {remedies} for the breach.
e.zh: 法院考虑了针对违约行为的几种补救方式。

remedy.t:
n. 疗法；补救办法
v. 补救；纠正

e.en: Honey is a popular home {remedy} for sore throats.
e.zh: 蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的常用家庭偏方。

e.en: The team is working hard to {remedy} the situation.
e.zh: 团队正在努力补救这种局面。

e.en: Please {remember} to lock the door when you leave.
e.zh: 离开时请记得锁门。

e.en: I can still {remember} my first day of school.
e.zh: 我至今还记得上学的第一天。

remembered.t: v. 记得（remember 的过去式）

e.en: She suddenly {remembered} where she had left her keys.
e.zh: 她突然想起钥匙落在哪儿了。

e.en: He'll always be {remembered} as a generous mentor.
e.zh: 人们将永远铭记他是位慷慨的导师。

e.en: My mom is the family's official {rememberer} of birthdays.
e.zh: 我妈妈是家里专门记生日的人。

e.en: As the group's {rememberer}, he tracks every inside joke.
e.zh: 作为团队的“记忆担当”,他记得每一个圈内梗。

remembering.t: v. 记得（remember 的现在分词）

e.en: I have trouble {remembering} names at networking events.
e.zh: 在社交活动上我总是记不住名字。

e.en: She lit a candle, {remembering} her late grandmother.
e.zh: 她点燃一支蜡烛,缅怀已故的祖母。

remembers.t: v. 记得（第三人称单数）

e.en: My dog still {remembers} the trick I taught him.
e.zh: 我家狗还记得我教过它的那个把戏。

e.en: Nobody {remembers} the password to the old account.
e.zh: 没人记得那个旧账号的密码了。

e.en: They held a moment of {remembrance} for the victims.
e.zh: 他们为遇难者默哀致敬。

e.en: She kept the locket as a {remembrance} of her father.
e.zh: 她保留这个吊坠作为对父亲的纪念。

e.en: The old letters are precious {remembrances} of wartime friendships.
e.zh: 那些旧信件是战时友谊的珍贵纪念。

e.en: She shared warm {remembrances} of her childhood summers.
e.zh: 她分享了童年夏天的温馨回忆。

remilitarization.t: n. 重新军事化；重新武装

e.en: The treaty banned the {remilitarization} of the border zone.
e.zh: 该条约禁止边境地区重新军事化。

e.en: Critics warn against the rapid {remilitarization} of the region.
e.zh: 评论人士警告该地区正在迅速重新军事化。

e.en: Please {remind} me to call the dentist tomorrow.
e.zh: 请提醒我明天给牙医打电话。

e.en: These photos {remind} me of our trip to Kyoto.
e.zh: 这些照片让我想起我们的京都之旅。

reminded.t: v. 提醒（remind 的过去式）

e.en: The smell of bread {reminded} him of his childhood.
e.zh: 面包的香味让他想起了童年。

e.en: My phone {reminded} me about the meeting just in time.
e.zh: 我的手机及时提醒了我开会的事。

reminder.t: n. 提醒；提醒事项（App 通知）

e.en: I set a {reminder} on my phone for the deadline.
e.zh: 我在手机上设了截止日期的提醒。

e.en: This scar is a constant {reminder} to be careful.
e.zh: 这道疤时刻提醒我要小心。

reminders.t: n. 提醒事项（复数，如 iOS 提醒事项）

e.en: My calendar app sends daily {reminders} for medication.
e.zh: 我的日历应用每天发送服药提醒。

e.en: Sticky notes serve as gentle {reminders} around the office.
e.zh: 办公室里的便利贴起着温馨提醒的作用。

removals.t: n. 移除；清除（removal 的复数）

e.en: We hired a local {removals} company for the move.
e.zh: 我们请了一家本地搬家公司来搬家。

e.en: Recent app store {removals} have worried small developers.
e.zh: 近期应用商店的下架让小开发者们感到担忧。

remove.t:
v. 移除；删除
v. 脱下（衣物）

e.en: Please {remove} your shoes before entering the house.
e.zh: 进屋前请脱鞋。

e.en: You can {remove} the app by long-pressing its icon.
e.zh: 长按图标即可卸载该应用。

removed.t:
v. 移除（过去式）
adj. 远离的

e.en: The moderator {removed} the offensive comment from the thread.
e.zh: 版主把那条不当评论从帖子里删掉了。

e.en: She felt {removed} from the noise of city life.
e.zh: 她觉得自己远离了城市的喧嚣。

e.en: I used nail polish {remover} to clean off the marker.
e.zh: 我用洗甲水把记号笔的痕迹擦掉了。

e.en: This stain {remover} works wonders on coffee spills.
e.zh: 这款去渍剂对咖啡渍效果惊人。

removes.t: v. 移除（第三人称单数）

e.en: This filter {removes} bacteria and heavy metals from tap water.
e.zh: 这款滤水器能滤掉自来水中的细菌和重金属。

e.en: The new update {removes} several outdated features.
e.zh: 新版本移除了好几个过时的功能。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {removing} weeds from the garden.
e.zh: 他用了一个下午在花园里除草。

e.en: Try {removing} the SIM card and inserting it again.
e.zh: 试试把 SIM 卡取出来再重新插入。

e.en: The company will {remunerate} freelancers within thirty days.
e.zh: 公司将在三十天内向自由职业者支付报酬。

e.en: We aim to {remunerate} interns fairly for their work.
e.zh: 我们希望公平地支付实习生的劳动报酬。

e.en: The job offers competitive {remuneration} and flexible hours.
e.zh: 这份工作薪酬有竞争力，工时也灵活。

e.en: She negotiated higher {remuneration} during the final interview.
e.zh: 她在终面时谈到了更高的薪酬。

remunerative.t: adj. 有报酬的；有利可图的

e.en: Coding turned out to be a highly {remunerative} skill.
e.zh: 编程后来被证明是一项收入非常可观的技能。

e.en: He left teaching for a more {remunerative} career in finance.
e.zh: 他放弃教书，转而从事收入更高的金融工作。

e.en: In Roman legend, {Remus} was killed by his twin brother Romulus.
e.zh: 在罗马传说中，雷穆斯被孪生兄弟罗慕路斯所杀。

e.en: The wizard {Remus} Lupin is a beloved Harry Potter character.
e.zh: 巫师雷穆斯·卢平是《哈利·波特》中深受喜爱的角色。

renaissance.t:
n. 文艺复兴
n. 复兴；再兴起

e.en: The neighborhood is enjoying a cultural {renaissance} after years of decline.
e.zh: 这个街区在多年衰落后正经历文化复兴。

e.en: She studies {renaissance} painting at the university in Florence.
e.zh: 她在佛罗伦萨大学研究文艺复兴时期的绘画。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with chronic {renal} failure last month.
e.zh: 该病人上个月被诊断为慢性肾衰竭。

e.en: Doctors monitor {renal} function with regular blood tests.
e.zh: 医生通过定期血液检查监测肾功能。

e.en: You can {rename} the file by right-clicking on it.
e.zh: 你可以右键点击来重命名这个文件。

e.en: The company plans to {rename} the product before launch.
e.zh: 公司计划在发布前给该产品改名。

e.en: The street was {renamed} after a famous local poet.
e.zh: 这条街以一位当地著名诗人的名字重新命名。

e.en: I {renamed} the folder so it would be easier to find.
e.zh: 我重命名了那个文件夹,这样更容易找到。

renaming.t:
v. 正在重命名
n. 重命名操作

e.en: The team is {renaming} several variables to improve code clarity.
e.zh: 团队正在重命名几个变量以提高代码可读性。

e.en: {Renaming} the brand cost the company millions in marketing.
e.zh: 品牌更名让公司花了数百万的营销费用。

e.en: A {renascent} interest in vinyl records has surprised the music industry.
e.zh: 对黑胶唱片重新兴起的兴趣让音乐界感到意外。

e.en: The town shows a {renascent} spirit after the factory reopened.
e.zh: 工厂重开后,小镇展现出复兴的活力。

e.en: Some politicians want to {renationalise} the railway system.
e.zh: 一些政客想要将铁路系统重新国有化。

e.en: The government may {renationalise} water companies if standards keep slipping.
e.zh: 如果标准持续下滑,政府可能会将自来水公司重新收归国有。

renault.t: n. 雷诺（法国汽车品牌）

e.en: My uncle drives an old {Renault} hatchback from the nineties.
e.zh: 我叔叔开着一辆九十年代的旧雷诺掀背车。

e.en: {Renault} announced a new electric model at the auto show.
e.zh: 雷诺在车展上发布了一款新的电动车型。

e.en: Loud explosions seemed to {rend} the night sky apart.
e.zh: 巨大的爆炸声似乎要把夜空撕裂。

e.en: Grief threatened to {rend} the small community in two.
e.zh: 悲痛几乎要将这个小社区撕成两半。

render.t:
v. 渲染（图形）
v. 使成为；给予

e.en: The graphics card can {render} 3D scenes in real time.
e.zh: 这块显卡可以实时渲染三维场景。

e.en: The new evidence may {render} the original verdict invalid.
e.zh: 新证据可能使原判决失效。

rendered.t: v. 已渲染；已呈现（过去式）

e.en: The injury {rendered} him unable to play for the rest of the season.
e.zh: 这次受伤让他在本赛季剩余比赛中无法上场。

e.en: The artist {rendered} the cityscape in soft watercolors.
e.zh: 画家用柔和的水彩描绘了城市风光。

rendering.t:
n. 渲染（图形处理）
n. 表现；译本

e.en: The architect showed us a 3D {rendering} of the new library.
e.zh: 建筑师向我们展示了新图书馆的三维渲染图。

e.en: Her piano {rendering} of the sonata moved everyone to tears.
e.zh: 她对这首奏鸣曲的演绎让所有人都感动落泪。

e.en: The studio shared early {renderings} of the proposed stadium.
e.zh: 工作室分享了拟建体育场的早期效果图。

e.en: Different {renderings} of the poem reveal each translator's style.
e.zh: 这首诗的不同译本展现了每位译者的风格。

renders.t: v. 渲染（第三人称单数）

e.en: This software {renders} high-resolution images much faster than before.
e.zh: 这款软件渲染高分辨率图像比以前快得多。

e.en: His silence often {renders} meetings awkward and tense.
e.zh: 他的沉默常常让会议变得尴尬而紧张。

rendezvous.t:
n. 约会；会合地点
v. 会合

e.en: We agreed to {rendezvous} at the café near the station.
e.zh: 我们约好在车站附近的咖啡馆碰面。

e.en: The spacecraft completed a successful {rendezvous} with the space station.
e.zh: 航天器与空间站成功完成了对接。

rending.t:
v. 正在撕裂
adj. 令人心碎的

e.en: A heart-{rending} cry came from the next room.
e.zh: 隔壁房间传来一声撕心裂肺的喊叫。

e.en: The wind was {rending} the old sails to shreds.
e.zh: 狂风正把旧船帆撕成碎片。

rendition.t:
n. 演绎；表演
n. 翻译版本

e.en: Her {rendition} of the national anthem brought the crowd to its feet.
e.zh: 她演唱的国歌让观众全体起立。

e.en: The film offers a modern {rendition} of a classic fairy tale.
e.zh: 这部电影是一个经典童话的现代演绎。

rends.t: v. 撕裂（第三人称单数）

e.en: Thunder {rends} the silence of the mountain valley.
e.zh: 雷声划破了山谷的寂静。

e.en: Constant arguing slowly {rends} the family apart.
e.zh: 不断的争吵慢慢地把这个家庭撕裂。

renegade.t:
n. 叛徒；变节者
adj. 背叛的

e.en: A {renegade} programmer leaked the company's source code online.
e.zh: 一名叛逃的程序员将公司源代码泄露到了网上。

e.en: The film follows a {renegade} cop who breaks every rule.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名打破所有规则的叛逆警察。

e.en: The company tried to {renege} on its promise of bonuses.
e.zh: 公司试图违背发放奖金的承诺。

e.en: It's bad business to {renege} on a signed contract.
e.zh: 违反已签订的合同是糟糕的商业行为。

e.en: The union wants to {renegotiate} the contract before it expires.
e.zh: 工会希望在合同到期前重新谈判。

e.en: Both countries agreed to {renegotiate} the trade deal next year.
e.zh: 两国同意明年重新谈判这项贸易协议。

renegotiated.t: v. 已重新谈判（过去式）

e.en: They {renegotiated} the lease and saved hundreds each month.
e.zh: 他们重新谈判了租约,每月省下了几百块。

e.en: The terms were {renegotiated} after both sides reviewed the data.
e.zh: 双方审查数据后重新谈判了条款。

e.en: The {renegotiation} of the deal took several months to complete.
e.zh: 该协议的重新谈判花了好几个月才完成。

e.en: Workers are demanding a {renegotiation} of their pay structure.
e.zh: 工人们要求重新协商他们的薪酬结构。

renew.t:
v. 续订；续期
v. 更新；恢复

e.en: Don't forget to {renew} your driver's license before it expires.
e.zh: 别忘了在驾照到期前去续期。

e.en: A short vacation can {renew} your energy for work.
e.zh: 短暂的假期可以让你重新获得工作的活力。

renewable.t: adj. 可再生的；可续订的

e.en: Solar power is a clean and {renewable} energy source.
e.zh: 太阳能是一种清洁的可再生能源。

e.en: The subscription is {renewable} every twelve months automatically.
e.zh: 该订阅每十二个月自动续订一次。

e.en: The country aims to get half its electricity from {renewables} by 2030.
e.zh: 该国的目标是到2030年一半的电力来自可再生能源。

e.en: Investment in {renewables} has grown rapidly over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年对可再生能源的投资增长迅速。

renewal.t:
n. 续订；续期
n. 更新；复兴

e.en: Your subscription is up for {renewal} next week.
e.zh: 你的订阅下周需要续订。

e.en: The city plans a major urban {renewal} of the waterfront.
e.zh: 市政府计划对滨水区进行大规模的城市更新。

renewed.t:
adj. 重新的；恢复的
v. 已续订

e.en: After the holiday, she felt {renewed} and ready to work.
e.zh: 假期过后,她感到精力恢复,准备投入工作。

e.en: The team showed {renewed} confidence in the second half.
e.zh: 球队在下半场展现出了重燃的信心。

e.en: I'm {renewing} my passport before our trip to Japan.
e.zh: 我正在去日本旅行前续办护照。

e.en: The rain seemed to be {renewing} the tired garden.
e.zh: 雨水似乎让疲惫的花园重新焕发生机。

renews.t: v. 续订（第三人称单数）

e.en: Netflix automatically {renews} your subscription each month.
e.zh: Netflix每个月自动续订你的订阅。

e.en: Morning coffee {renews} her enthusiasm for the day ahead.
e.zh: 早晨的咖啡让她对新的一天重燃热情。

renfrew.t: n. 伦弗鲁（苏格兰地名）

e.en: My grandmother grew up in the small town of {Renfrew}.
e.zh: 我奶奶在伦弗鲁这个小镇长大。

e.en: We visited a historic castle near {Renfrew} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了伦弗鲁附近一座历史悠久的城堡。

e.en: {Renfrewshire} is a council area in the west of Scotland.
e.zh: 伦弗鲁郡是苏格兰西部的一个行政区。

e.en: She works for the {Renfrewshire} council near Glasgow.
e.zh: 她在格拉斯哥附近的伦弗鲁郡议会工作。

e.en: The exchange rate between the dollar and {renminbi} has been stable.
e.zh: 美元与人民币之间的汇率一直保持稳定。

e.en: Many tourists exchange their currency for {renminbi} before visiting China.
e.zh: 许多游客在去中国前会把货币换成人民币。

rennet.t: n. 凝乳酶（用于制作奶酪）

e.en: Traditional cheese-making relies on {rennet} to curdle the milk.
e.zh: 传统的奶酪制作依赖凝乳酶让牛奶凝结。

e.en: Vegetarians often look for cheese made without animal {rennet}.
e.zh: 素食者通常会寻找不含动物凝乳酶的奶酪。

reno.t: n. 里诺（美国内华达州城市）

e.en: We drove through {Reno} on our way to Lake Tahoe.
e.zh: 我们在去太浩湖的路上经过了里诺。

e.en: {Reno} is famous for its casinos and outdoor activities.
e.zh: 里诺以赌场和户外活动而闻名。

e.en: The museum has a beautiful {Renoir} painting of dancers.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了一幅雷诺阿描绘舞者的精美画作。

e.en: {Renoir} is celebrated for his warm, light-filled portraits.
e.zh: 雷诺阿以其温暖、充满光感的肖像画而闻名。

e.en: The senator is seeking {renomination} for a third term.
e.zh: 这位参议员正在寻求第三任期的重新提名。

e.en: Her {renomination} as party leader was widely expected.
e.zh: 她被重新提名为党魁是众人意料之中的事。

renormalization.t: n. 重整化（物理学术语）

e.en: {Renormalization} is a key technique in modern quantum field theory.
e.zh: 重整化是现代量子场论中的一项关键技术。

e.en: Physicists use {renormalization} to handle infinities in their calculations.
e.zh: 物理学家使用重整化来处理计算中出现的无穷大。

renounce.t: v. 放弃、声明断绝（权利、信仰等）

e.en: He chose to {renounce} his citizenship and move abroad.
e.zh: 他选择放弃国籍并移居国外。

e.en: The group asked the leader to publicly {renounce} violence.
e.zh: 该组织要求领导人公开宣布放弃暴力。

e.en: We plan to {renovate} the kitchen later this year.
e.zh: 我们计划今年晚些时候翻新厨房。

e.en: The owners want to {renovate} the old hotel into apartments.
e.zh: 业主想把这家老酒店改造成公寓。

renovated.t:
adj. 翻新过的
v. renovate 的过去式

e.en: They recently {renovated} the bathroom with marble tiles.
e.zh: 他们最近用大理石瓷砖翻新了浴室。

e.en: The newly {renovated} library opens to the public next month.
e.zh: 新装修的图书馆下个月对公众开放。

e.en: The {renovation} of the old theater took two years to finish.
e.zh: 这座老剧院的翻修花了两年才完成。

e.en: We're living with my parents during the kitchen {renovation}.
e.zh: 厨房装修期间我们暂住在父母家。

e.en: She hired a skilled {renovator} to restore the Victorian house.
e.zh: 她聘请了一位技艺精湛的翻修师来修复这栋维多利亚式房屋。

e.en: A good {renovator} respects the original character of the building.
e.zh: 一位优秀的翻新师会尊重建筑原有的特色。

e.en: The chef gained international {renown} for his innovative desserts.
e.zh: 这位厨师因创新的甜品获得了国际声誉。

e.en: The university enjoys great {renown} in scientific research.
e.zh: 这所大学在科研领域享有盛誉。

e.en: She is a {renowned} scientist working on cancer treatments.
e.zh: 她是一位致力于癌症治疗研究的著名科学家。

e.en: The region is {renowned} for its excellent wines and cheeses.
e.zh: 该地区以优质的葡萄酒和奶酪闻名。

e.en: Few cities can match the literary {renowns} of Paris and London.
e.zh: 很少有城市能比得上巴黎和伦敦的文学盛名。

e.en: Her many {renowns} include awards in both science and music.
e.zh: 她的诸多荣誉包括科学和音乐领域的奖项。

rent.t:
n. 租金
v. 租用、出租

e.en: The {rent} for my apartment goes up every year.
e.zh: 我公寓的租金每年都在上涨。

e.en: We decided to {rent} a car for the road trip.
e.zh: 我们决定租一辆车去公路旅行。

e.en: The cottage is fully furnished and {rentable} by the week.
e.zh: 这间小屋家具齐全,可按周出租。

e.en: Most of the office space upstairs is still {rentable}.
e.zh: 楼上大部分办公空间仍可出租。

rental.t:
n. 租金、出租物
adj. 出租的

e.en: We picked up our {rental} car at the airport.
e.zh: 我们在机场取了租来的车。

e.en: Monthly {rental} prices have risen sharply downtown.
e.zh: 市中心的月租价格大幅上涨。

e.en: Vacation {rentals} along the coast book up months in advance.
e.zh: 沿海的度假出租房提前几个月就被订满了。

e.en: The shop offers bike {rentals} by the hour or day.
e.zh: 这家店提供按小时或按天计费的自行车租赁服务。

rented.t:
adj. 租来的
v. rent 的过去式

e.en: We {rented} a small cabin by the lake last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在湖边租了一间小木屋。

e.en: The {rented} apartment came fully furnished and pet-friendly.
e.zh: 那套出租公寓家具齐全，还可以养宠物。

e.en: Every {renter} must sign the lease before moving in.
e.zh: 每位租客在入住前都必须签订租约。

e.en: As a {renter}, you don't pay property taxes directly.
e.zh: 作为租客，你不必直接缴纳房产税。

rentier.t: n. 食利者（靠租金或利息为生的人）

e.en: He lived comfortably as a {rentier} on inherited investments.
e.zh: 他靠继承的投资作为食利者过着舒适生活。

e.en: The economy slowly drifted toward a {rentier} class.
e.zh: 经济正慢慢滑向食利者阶层主导。

renting.t:
v. 租用（rent 的现在分词）
n. 租赁

e.en: We're {renting} a place downtown until the house sells.
e.zh: 在房子卖掉之前我们租住在市中心。

e.en: {Renting} is often cheaper than buying in big cities.
e.zh: 在大城市租房通常比买房便宜。

e.en: Boeing has a major factory in {Renton}, Washington.
e.zh: 波音在华盛顿州伦顿有一座大型工厂。

e.en: She drove from Seattle down to {Renton} for work.
e.zh: 她从西雅图开车到伦顿上班。

rents.t:
n. 租金（复数）
v. rent 的第三人称单数

e.en: Apartment {rents} in the city keep climbing every year.
e.zh: 市区的公寓租金每年都在上涨。

e.en: He {rents} a studio near the university campus.
e.zh: 他在大学校园附近租了一间单间公寓。

e.en: Please {renumber} the chapters after deleting the old one.
e.zh: 删掉旧章节后请重新给章节编号。

e.en: The script will {renumber} the rows automatically.
e.zh: 脚本会自动给这些行重新编号。

e.en: Some monks {renunciate} all worldly possessions when they join.
e.zh: 有些僧侣在出家时会放弃一切世俗财产。

e.en: She chose to {renunciate} her former lavish lifestyle.
e.zh: 她选择放弃以往奢华的生活方式。

renunciation.t: n. 放弃、弃绝（权利、信仰）

e.en: His public {renunciation} of violence surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他公开宣布放弃暴力让所有人都很意外。

e.en: The treaty required formal {renunciation} of nuclear weapons.
e.zh: 该条约要求正式放弃核武器。

e.en: The army's {reoccupation} of the town lasted three months.
e.zh: 军队对该镇的重新占领持续了三个月。

e.en: Local residents protested the {reoccupation} of the building.
e.zh: 当地居民抗议有人重新占用这栋楼。

reoccupy.t: v. 重新占领、再次占用

e.en: Troops moved in to {reoccupy} the abandoned border post.
e.zh: 部队开进重新占领了被遗弃的边境哨所。

e.en: Tenants planned to {reoccupy} the flat after renovations.
e.zh: 装修结束后租户打算重新搬回那套公寓。

e.en: The error may {reoccur} if you don't update the driver.
e.zh: 如果不更新驱动，这个错误可能会再次出现。

e.en: Migraines tend to {reoccur} during stressful weeks.
e.zh: 在压力大的几周里偏头痛常常会复发。

e.en: Doctors are watching closely for any {reoccurrence} of the tumor.
e.zh: 医生正密切关注肿瘤是否再次出现。

e.en: The {reoccurrence} of the bug forced a full rollback.
e.zh: 该错误的再次出现迫使团队全面回滚。

reoccurring.t:
adj. 反复发生的
v. reoccur 的现在分词

e.en: She has a {reoccurring} dream about missing her flight.
e.zh: 她反复做着错过航班的梦。

e.en: The team fixed a {reoccurring} crash in the latest update.
e.zh: 团队在最新版本中修复了一个反复出现的崩溃。

reopen.t: v. 重新打开、重启（如 issue、店铺）

e.en: Schools will {reopen} on Monday after the long break.
e.zh: 学校将在长假结束后于周一重新开学。

e.en: Police decided to {reopen} the cold case last week.
e.zh: 警方上周决定重新调查这宗悬案。

reopened.t:
adj. 已重新开启的
v. reopen 的过去式

e.en: The cafe finally {reopened} after months of renovation.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆经过几个月装修后终于重新营业。

e.en: He {reopened} the conversation with a careful apology.
e.zh: 他用一句小心的道歉重新开启了那段对话。

reopening.t:
n. 重新开张
v. reopen 的现在分词

e.en: The museum's {reopening} drew huge crowds on the first day.
e.zh: 博物馆重新开放首日吸引了大批人潮。

e.en: They are {reopening} the investigation due to new evidence.
e.zh: 由于出现新证据，他们正在重启调查。

reorder.t:
v. 重新排序、再次订购
n. 续订单

e.en: You can drag the items to {reorder} your playlist.
e.zh: 你可以拖动项目来重新排列播放列表。

e.en: We need to {reorder} more printer ink before Friday.
e.zh: 我们得在周五前再订一些打印机墨盒。

reordering.t:
n. 重新排序
v. reorder 的现在分词

e.en: {Reordering} the columns made the spreadsheet much easier to read.
e.zh: 重新排列各列让电子表格读起来清楚多了。

e.en: The manager is {reordering} supplies for next month.
e.zh: 经理正在为下个月重新订购物资。

reorganisation.t: n. 重组、改组（英式拼写）

e.en: The company announced a major {reorganisation} of its sales team.
e.zh: 公司宣布对销售团队进行重大重组。

e.en: After the {reorganisation}, several departments were merged.
e.zh: 重组之后，好几个部门被合并了。

reorganise.t: v. 重组、重新整理（英式拼写）

e.en: We need to {reorganise} the warehouse to fit new stock.
e.zh: 我们需要重新整理仓库以容纳新货。

e.en: Management plans to {reorganise} the entire support team.
e.zh: 管理层计划对整个支持团队进行重组。

reorganised.t:
adj. 已重组的
v. reorganise 的过去式

e.en: She {reorganised} her closet by color and season.
e.zh: 她按颜色和季节重新整理了衣柜。

e.en: The newly {reorganised} team works far more efficiently.
e.zh: 新近重组后的团队效率高了许多。

reorganises.t: v. reorganise 的第三人称单数

e.en: Every January, he {reorganises} his desk and digital files.
e.zh: 每年一月，他都会重新整理桌面和电子文件。

e.en: The app automatically {reorganises} photos by location.
e.zh: 这款应用会按位置自动重新整理照片。

e.en: The startup is {reorganising} after losing two key investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在失去两位重要投资者后正在重组。

e.en: She spent the weekend {reorganising} the kitchen cabinets.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在重新整理厨房橱柜。

reorganization.t: n. 重组、改组、重新整理

e.en: The {reorganization} eliminated several middle-management positions.
e.zh: 这次重组裁掉了好几个中层管理职位。

e.en: Employees were anxious during the company's quiet {reorganization}.
e.zh: 在公司悄然重组期间员工都忐忑不安。

e.en: Let's {reorganize} the meeting agenda before Monday morning.
e.zh: 我们在周一早上之前重新调整会议议程吧。

e.en: He hired a coach to help {reorganize} his small business.
e.zh: 他请了一位顾问帮忙重组自己的小公司。

reorganized.t:
adj. 已重组的
v. reorganize 的过去式

e.en: The library {reorganized} its shelves using a new system.
e.zh: 图书馆用新的方式重新整理了书架。

e.en: After being {reorganized}, the kitchen feels twice as big.
e.zh: 重新整理之后，厨房感觉宽敞了一倍。

reorganizes.t: v. reorganize 的第三人称单数

e.en: He constantly {reorganizes} his tools to suit each project.
e.zh: 他经常根据每个项目重新整理自己的工具。

e.en: The CEO {reorganizes} the leadership team every two years.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官每两年就会调整一次领导团队。

e.en: I'm {reorganizing} my schedule to make time for exercise.
e.zh: 我正在重新安排日程，好挤出时间锻炼。

e.en: The hospital is {reorganizing} its emergency department this year.
e.zh: 医院今年正在对急诊科进行重组。

reorient.t: v. 重新定向；重新调整方向

e.en: The training helped staff {reorient} toward customer needs.
e.zh: 这次培训帮助员工重新关注客户需求。

e.en: After the layoff, he had to {reorient} his career.
e.zh: 被裁员后，他不得不重新调整职业方向。

e.en: The course aims to {reorientate} students toward practical skills.
e.zh: 该课程旨在让学生重新转向实用技能。

e.en: She took a year off to {reorientate} her life.
e.zh: 她休了一年假来重新调整自己的人生方向。

reorientation.t: n. 重新定向；方向调整

e.en: The company underwent a strategic {reorientation} toward green energy.
e.zh: 公司进行了一次面向绿色能源的战略转向。

e.en: Moving abroad required a complete {reorientation} of daily habits.
e.zh: 搬到国外需要彻底重新调整日常习惯。

rep.t:
n. 代表（representative 的缩写）
n. 一组（健身中 repetition）

e.en: A sales {rep} called me about renewing the contract.
e.zh: 一位销售代表打电话来谈续签合同的事。

e.en: He finished the last {rep} with shaking arms.
e.zh: 他颤抖着手臂完成了最后一组动作。

repack.t: v. 重新打包；重新包装

e.en: You'll need to {repack} your suitcase to fit the souvenirs.
e.zh: 你得重新整理行李箱才能装下纪念品。

e.en: Workers {repack} damaged boxes before sending them out again.
e.zh: 工人会把破损的箱子重新打包后再发出。

repackage.t: v. 重新包装；改头换面推出

e.en: Studios often {repackage} old films as anniversary editions.
e.zh: 电影公司常把老片重新包装成周年纪念版发行。

e.en: They plan to {repackage} the product for younger buyers.
e.zh: 他们打算把产品重新包装以面向年轻买家。

e.en: The album was {repackaged} with three bonus tracks.
e.zh: 这张专辑重新包装后加入了三首附赠歌曲。

e.en: She {repackaged} the gift to make it look prettier.
e.zh: 她把礼物重新包装得更好看了。

repackaging.t: n. 重新包装；v. 重新打包

e.en: The brand is {repackaging} its snacks with eco-friendly materials.
e.zh: 该品牌正在用环保材料重新包装零食。

e.en: {Repackaging} old content rarely fools loyal fans.
e.zh: 把旧内容重新包装很难骗过忠实粉丝。

repaid.t: v. repay 的过去式；已偿还

e.en: She {repaid} the loan two years ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 她提前两年还清了贷款。

e.en: His kindness was {repaid} with a heartfelt thank-you note.
e.zh: 他的善意得到了一封真诚感谢信的回报。

repaint.t: v. 重新粉刷；重新上漆
