e.en: We plan to {repaint} the bedroom a soft gray.
e.zh: 我们打算把卧室重新刷成柔和的灰色。

e.en: It's time to {repaint} the front door before winter.
e.zh: 该在冬天来临前重新粉刷大门了。

repaints.t: v. repaint 的第三人称单数形式

e.en: He {repaints} his garage door every couple of years.
e.zh: 他每隔几年就会重新粉刷一次车库门。

e.en: The artist often {repaints} sections she isn't happy with.
e.zh: 这位画家常常重画她不满意的部分。

repair.t:
v. 修理；修复
n. 维修

e.en: The mechanic can {repair} your bike by tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 机修工明天下午之前能把你的自行车修好。

e.en: Apologies alone won't {repair} a damaged friendship.
e.zh: 仅靠道歉无法修复受损的友谊。

repairable.t: adj. 可修理的；可修复的

e.en: Luckily the cracked screen is easily {repairable}.
e.zh: 幸运的是这块碎屏很容易修。

e.en: Most modern laptops are barely {repairable} by users.
e.zh: 大多数现代笔记本电脑用户几乎无法自行维修。

repaired.t: v. repair 的过去式；已修好

e.en: The plumber {repaired} the leaky faucet in ten minutes.
e.zh: 水管工十分钟内就修好了漏水的水龙头。

e.en: Their relationship was slowly {repaired} after months of therapy.
e.zh: 经过几个月的咨询，他们的关系慢慢得到了修复。

e.en: A skilled watch {repairer} fixed my grandfather's old timepiece.
e.zh: 一位手艺高超的钟表修理师修好了爷爷的老怀表。

e.en: The shoe {repairer} downstairs has been in business for decades.
e.zh: 楼下那位修鞋师傅已经经营了几十年。

e.en: He spent the morning {repairing} the broken garden fence.
e.zh: 他花了一上午时间修补坏掉的花园栅栏。

e.en: {Repairing} trust takes much longer than breaking it.
e.zh: 重建信任所需的时间远比破坏它要长。

e.en: The {repairman} arrived early to fix our washing machine.
e.zh: 维修工提早到了，来修我们的洗衣机。

e.en: Our regular {repairman} knows every quirk of the building.
e.zh: 我们的固定维修工了解这栋楼的每一处毛病。

repairs.t: n. 维修工作；v. 修理

e.en: The landlord covers all major {repairs} on the apartment.
e.zh: 房东负责公寓所有大型维修费用。

e.en: He {repairs} vintage radios as a weekend hobby.
e.zh: 他周末爱好是修理古董收音机。

reparable.t: adj. 可弥补的；可修复的

e.en: Fortunately, the engine damage is fully {reparable}.
e.zh: 幸运的是发动机损伤完全可以修复。

e.en: The harm to her reputation may not be easily {reparable}.
e.zh: 她声誉所受的损害可能难以挽回。

e.en: The company offered {reparation} to families affected by the spill.
e.zh: 该公司向受泄漏事故影响的家庭提供了赔偿。

e.en: Activists continue to demand {reparation} for historical injustices.
e.zh: 活动人士仍在要求对历史上的不公进行赔偿。

e.en: The serum has strong {reparative} effects on damaged skin.
e.zh: 这款精华对受损皮肤有很强的修复作用。

e.en: The school introduced {reparative} programs instead of strict punishment.
e.zh: 学校引入了修复性项目而非严厉惩罚。

repartee.t: n. 机智的应答；妙语对答

e.en: Their witty {repartee} kept everyone laughing through dinner.
e.zh: 他们机智的对答让大家整顿饭都在笑。

e.en: She is famous for her sharp {repartee} on talk shows.
e.zh: 她以在脱口秀上的犀利妙语而闻名。

e.en: We enjoyed a simple {repast} of bread and cheese.
e.zh: 我们享用了一顿简单的面包奶酪餐。

e.en: The hotel served a lavish {repast} after the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式结束后酒店端上了一顿丰盛的大餐。

e.en: The government agreed to {repatriate} the stolen artifacts.
e.zh: 政府同意将这些被盗文物送回原国。

e.en: Many companies want to {repatriate} profits held overseas.
e.zh: 许多公司希望把存放海外的利润调回国内。

repatriated.t: v. repatriate 的过去式；已被遣返

e.en: The refugees were finally {repatriated} after years abroad.
e.zh: 难民们在海外多年后终于被遣返回国。

e.en: The museum {repatriated} the bronze statue last month.
e.zh: 博物馆上个月把那尊青铜像归还了原属国。

e.en: The {repatriation} of the soldiers took several weeks.
e.zh: 士兵们的遣返花了好几周时间。

e.en: Activists demanded the {repatriation} of looted cultural treasures.
e.zh: 活动人士要求归还被掠夺的文化珍宝。

e.en: I'll {repay} the loan as soon as I get paid.
e.zh: 我一发工资就把贷款还上。

e.en: How can I ever {repay} your kindness?
e.zh: 我该怎样报答你的善意呢?

repayable.t: adj. 应偿还的；可偿还的

e.en: The loan is {repayable} over five years at low interest.
e.zh: 这笔贷款分五年低息偿还。

e.en: Student grants are not {repayable} after graduation.
e.zh: 学生助学金毕业后无需偿还。

e.en: She is slowly {repaying} her student debt each month.
e.zh: 她每个月慢慢偿还自己的学生贷款。

e.en: He spent years {repaying} the favor with loyal service.
e.zh: 他用多年的忠诚服务来报答这份恩情。

e.en: Your first {repayment} is due next Friday.
e.zh: 你的首期还款将在下周五到期。

e.en: They negotiated a longer {repayment} schedule with the bank.
e.zh: 他们与银行协商了更长的还款期限。

repays.t: v. repay 的第三人称单数；偿还

e.en: This stock {repays} patient investors with steady dividends.
e.zh: 这只股票以稳定分红回报有耐心的投资者。

e.en: He always {repays} his debts on time.
e.zh: 他总是按时还清欠款。

repeal.t:
v. 废除（法律）
n. 废除；撤销

e.en: Lawmakers voted to {repeal} the outdated tax law.
e.zh: 议员们投票废除了那项过时的税法。

e.en: The {repeal} of the ban surprised many citizens.
e.zh: 该禁令的废除让许多市民感到意外。

repeat.t:
v. 重复；重做
n. 重复

e.en: Could you {repeat} the question, please?
e.zh: 请你再说一遍问题好吗?

e.en: Don't {repeat} the same mistake twice.
e.zh: 不要再犯同样的错误。

e.en: Scientists test {repeatability} by running the experiment multiple times.
e.zh: 科学家通过多次重复实验来检验可重复性。

e.en: The lab improved {repeatability} by automating each step.
e.zh: 实验室通过自动化每个步骤提高了可重复性。

repeatable.t: adj. 可重复的；可再现的

e.en: We need a {repeatable} process for onboarding new hires.
e.zh: 我们需要一个可复制的新员工入职流程。

e.en: His success was no fluke — it's clearly {repeatable}.
e.zh: 他的成功并非侥幸,显然是可以复制的。

e.en: She has {repeated} the same story all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚都在重复讲同一个故事。

e.en: Despite {repeated} warnings, he kept driving too fast.
e.zh: 尽管多次警告,他还是开得太快。

e.en: The app {repeatedly} crashes when I open large files.
e.zh: 打开大文件时,这个应用反复崩溃。

e.en: She has {repeatedly} asked for a quieter workspace.
e.zh: 她已经多次要求换个更安静的工位。

repeater.t:
n. 中继器（网络设备）
n. 重复者

e.en: Install a Wi-Fi {repeater} to extend the signal upstairs.
e.zh: 装一个 Wi-Fi 中继器把信号扩展到楼上。

e.en: He's a {repeater} who always books the same hotel.
e.zh: 他是个常客,每次都订同一家酒店。

repeating.t: v. 重复中；adj. 反复的

e.en: Stop {repeating} yourself — I heard you the first time.
e.zh: 别再重复了,我第一次就听到了。

e.en: The wallpaper has a {repeating} floral pattern.
e.zh: 墙纸上是不断重复的花卉图案。

repeats.t: v. repeat 的第三人称单数；重复

e.en: History often {repeats} itself in surprising ways.
e.zh: 历史常以令人意外的方式重演。

e.en: The channel mostly airs {repeats} after midnight.
e.zh: 这个频道午夜之后大多播的是重播节目。

e.en: This spray will {repel} mosquitoes for several hours.
e.zh: 这种喷雾可以驱蚊好几个小时。

e.en: Magnets with the same pole {repel} each other.
e.zh: 同极的磁铁会相互排斥。

repellant.t:
n. 驱虫剂（同 repellent）
adj. 排斥的

e.en: Don't forget to pack insect {repellant} for the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时别忘了带驱虫剂。

e.en: The fabric has a water-{repellant} coating.
e.zh: 这种面料带有防水涂层。

e.en: Many natural {repellants} use citronella or eucalyptus oil.
e.zh: 许多天然驱虫剂使用香茅或桉树油。

e.en: The store sells various bug {repellants} for travelers.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种供旅行者使用的驱虫剂。

repelled.t: v. repel 的过去式；击退了

e.en: The defenders {repelled} every attack on the city walls.
e.zh: 守军击退了对城墙的每一次进攻。

e.en: She was {repelled} by the smell of stale smoke.
e.zh: 她被那股陈烟味熏得很反感。

e.en: This jacket is treated for excellent water {repellency}.
e.zh: 这件外套经过处理,具有出色的防水性能。

e.en: The coating loses {repellency} after many washes.
e.zh: 多次洗涤后,涂层的防水性会下降。

repellent.t:
n. 驱虫剂；防水剂
adj. 令人反感的

e.en: Apply insect {repellent} before walking into the woods.
e.zh: 进入树林前先涂上驱虫剂。

e.en: Most cats find the smell of citrus {repellent}.
e.zh: 大多数猫都讨厌柑橘的气味。

repelling.t: v. 排斥中；adj. 令人反感的

e.en: The coating is great at {repelling} stains and spills.
e.zh: 这种涂层在防止污渍和泼溅方面效果很好。

e.en: Her cold tone was clearly {repelling} potential customers.
e.zh: 她冰冷的语气显然把潜在客户都吓跑了。

repels.t: v. repel 的第三人称单数；排斥

e.en: This case {repels} fingerprints and dust effectively.
e.zh: 这款手机壳能有效防指纹和灰尘。

e.en: His arrogant attitude {repels} everyone he meets.
e.zh: 他傲慢的态度让遇到的每个人都反感。

e.en: He came to {repent} the harsh words he said.
e.zh: 他开始为自己说过的难听话感到悔恨。

e.en: The preacher urged the crowd to {repent} their sins.
e.zh: 牧师劝告众人为罪过悔改。

e.en: His tearful {repentance} seemed sincere to the judge.
e.zh: 他含泪的悔过在法官看来很真诚。

e.en: True {repentance} requires changing one's behavior.
e.zh: 真正的悔改需要改变自己的行为。

e.en: A {reporter} from the local paper interviewed the mayor.
e.zh: 当地报社的一名记者采访了市长。

e.en: She trained as a war {reporter} in her twenties.
e.zh: 她二十多岁时受训成为一名战地记者。

e.en: {Reporters} crowded around the courthouse waiting for a statement.
e.zh: 记者们挤在法院门口等候声明。

e.en: The senator refused to take questions from {reporters} today.
e.zh: 参议员今天拒绝回答记者的提问。

reporting.t:
n. 报道；报告
v. 报告（现在分词）

e.en: The newspaper is famous for its fearless {reporting}.
e.zh: 这家报纸以无畏的报道而著称。

e.en: She is {reporting} live from the disaster zone.
e.zh: 她正在灾区现场进行直播报道。

e.en: Different {reportings} of the incident don't fully match.
e.zh: 对这起事件的不同报道并不完全一致。

e.en: The agency compared {reportings} from several news outlets.
e.zh: 该机构对比了多家新闻媒体的报道内容。

e.en: His {reportorial} style is sharp and refreshingly direct.
e.zh: 他的新闻报道风格犀利而难得地直率。

e.en: The book reads with strong {reportorial} clarity.
e.zh: 这本书读起来有着鲜明的新闻报道式的清晰感。

reports.t:
n. 报告；报道（复数）
v. 报告（第三人称）

e.en: Quarterly {reports} are due at the end of next week.
e.zh: 季度报告须在下周末前提交。

e.en: She {reports} directly to the chief technology officer.
e.zh: 她直接向首席技术官汇报。

repose.t:
n. 休息；安宁
v. 躺卧；休息

e.en: The cat lay in peaceful {repose} on the sunny windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫安详地躺在阳光下的窗台上休息。

e.en: After the long hike, she sought a quiet place to {repose}.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后,她想找个安静的地方歇歇。

e.en: He {reposed} on the sofa after the exhausting drive home.
e.zh: 开车回家累坏了,他在沙发上躺着歇息。

e.en: The villagers {reposed} their trust in the new mayor.
e.zh: 村民们把信任寄托在新市长身上。

e.en: Final authority {reposes} in the board of directors.
e.zh: 最终决定权归董事会所有。

e.en: The old dog {reposes} by the fire every evening.
e.zh: 那只老狗每晚都在炉火旁安静地躺着。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {reposing} in a hammock under the trees.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在树下的吊床上休息。

e.en: The trust {reposing} in her was clearly well placed.
e.zh: 对她寄予的信任显然没有放错地方。

reposition.t: v. 重新定位；调整位置

e.en: The brand wants to {reposition} itself as eco-friendly.
e.zh: 该品牌希望将自己重新定位为环保品牌。

e.en: Could you {reposition} the camera a little to the left?
e.zh: 你能把摄像头稍微往左挪一下吗?

repositioning.t: n./v. 重新定位（品牌、产品）

e.en: The company is {repositioning} its products for younger users.
e.zh: 公司正在将产品重新定位以面向更年轻的用户。

e.en: Slight {repositioning} of the antenna improved the signal a lot.
e.zh: 稍微调整一下天线位置,信号就改善了很多。

e.en: All our source code lives in a private GitHub {repository}.
e.zh: 我们所有的源代码都放在一个私有的 GitHub 仓库里。

e.en: The library is a vast {repository} of historical documents.
e.zh: 该图书馆是一座庞大的历史文献宝库。

repossess.t: v. 收回（抵押物）；重新占有

e.en: The bank will {repossess} the car if payments stop.
e.zh: 如果停止还款,银行会收回这辆汽车。

e.en: They threatened to {repossess} the apartment after months of unpaid rent.
e.zh: 在拖欠数月房租后,他们威胁要收回这套公寓。

e.en: Her car was {repossessed} after she missed three payments.
e.zh: 她漏交了三期还款后,汽车被收回了。

e.en: The lender {repossessed} the equipment from the failing factory.
e.zh: 贷款方从这家濒临倒闭的工厂收回了设备。

e.en: He's trying to avoid {repossession} of his family home.
e.zh: 他正努力避免自家房屋被收回。

e.en: {Repossession} rates rose sharply during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间,资产被收回的比例大幅上升。

e.en: You should {repot} the orchid every couple of years.
e.zh: 兰花最好每两年换一次盆。

e.en: It's time to {repot} this plant — the roots are showing.
e.zh: 该给这盆植物换盆了,根都露出来了。

e.en: His tie was made of fine silk {repp} with diagonal ribs.
e.zh: 他的领带是用带斜纹的细丝罗缎做的。

e.en: She chose a heavy {repp} fabric for the dining room curtains.
e.zh: 她为餐厅窗帘选了一种厚实的罗缎面料。

e.en: The judge did not {reprehend} the lawyer for his sharp tone.
e.zh: 法官并没有因为律师语气尖锐而加以斥责。

e.en: Critics {reprehend} the film for its cynical view of love.
e.zh: 评论家批评这部电影对爱情的态度过于愤世嫉俗。

reprehensible.t: adj. 应受谴责的；可耻的

e.en: Lying to the customers is absolutely {reprehensible} behavior.
e.zh: 对客户撒谎是完全应受谴责的行为。

e.en: The CEO called the leak a {reprehensible} breach of trust.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 称这次泄密是应受谴责的失信行为。

e.en: These charts {represent} our sales over the past year.
e.zh: 这些图表展示了我们过去一年的销售情况。

e.en: She was chosen to {represent} her country at the Olympics.
e.zh: 她被选为奥运会上代表自己国家的选手。

representable.t: adj. 可表示的；可代表的

e.en: Every rational number is {representable} as a fraction of integers.
e.zh: 每个有理数都可以表示为整数的分数。

e.en: Not all colors are {representable} on a standard RGB screen.
e.zh: 并非所有颜色都能在标准RGB屏幕上呈现。

e.en: The chart gives a clear visual {representation} of the data.
e.zh: 这张图表清晰地直观呈现了数据。

e.en: Minority groups demand fair {representation} in government.
e.zh: 少数群体要求在政府中获得公平的代表权。

e.en: Her paintings shifted from abstract to {representational} styles.
e.zh: 她的画作从抽象风格转向了写实风格。

e.en: The model uses a {representational} approach to encode meaning.
e.zh: 该模型用一种表征式方法来编码语义。

e.en: Neural networks learn useful {representations} of input data.
e.zh: 神经网络会学习输入数据的有用表征。

e.en: Citizens made formal {representations} to the city council.
e.zh: 市民向市议会正式提出了陈情。

representative.t:
n. 代表；代理人
adj. 有代表性的

e.en: A customer service {representative} will call you back shortly.
e.zh: 客服代表稍后会回电给您。

e.en: This sample is not {representative} of the whole population.
e.zh: 这个样本无法代表整个人群。

e.en: Researchers checked the {representativeness} of the survey sample.
e.zh: 研究人员核查了调查样本的代表性。

e.en: The poll's {representativeness} was questioned by several experts.
e.zh: 几位专家质疑了这次民调的代表性。

e.en: Union {representatives} met with management this morning.
e.zh: 工会代表今早与管理层进行了会谈。

e.en: Sales {representatives} earn commission on every closed deal.
e.zh: 销售代表每成交一单都能拿到提成。

e.en: The lawyer {represented} her client in federal court.
e.zh: 那位律师在联邦法院为她的当事人辩护。

e.en: Each region is {represented} by two senators.
e.zh: 每个地区由两位参议员代表。

e.en: She is {representing} Canada at the Olympic Games.
e.zh: 她正代表加拿大参加奥运会。

e.en: The icon is {representing} the user's online status.
e.zh: 这个图标用来表示用户的在线状态。

represents.t: v. 代表；表示（第三人称）

e.en: The red line {represents} average monthly revenue.
e.zh: 红线代表每月的平均营收。

e.en: This deal {represents} a major win for the company.
e.zh: 这笔交易对公司而言是一次重大胜利。

e.en: She tried to {repress} her laughter during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议中努力憋住笑。

e.en: Authoritarian regimes often {repress} political dissent.
e.zh: 专制政权常常压制政治异见。

repressed.t:
adj. 被压抑的
v. 压抑（过去式）

e.en: He {repressed} the urge to argue with his boss.
e.zh: 他强忍住不和老板争辩的冲动。

e.en: Therapy helped her uncover long-{repressed} childhood memories.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她唤回了被长期压抑的童年记忆。

e.en: The protein {represses} gene expression under stress.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在应激条件下会抑制基因表达。

e.en: He always {represses} his feelings instead of talking.
e.zh: 他总是压抑情绪,而不是说出来。

e.en: {Repressing} your emotions can harm your mental health.
e.zh: 压抑情绪可能会损害心理健康。

e.en: The government was accused of {repressing} free speech.
e.zh: 政府被指控压制言论自由。

e.en: Years of political {repression} sparked widespread protests.
e.zh: 多年的政治压迫引发了大规模抗议。

e.en: Emotional {repression} often leads to anxiety later in life.
e.zh: 情感压抑往往会在日后引发焦虑。

e.en: The history book documents the regime's many {repressions}.
e.zh: 这本历史书记录了该政权的多次镇压行动。

e.en: Childhood {repressions} can resurface during stressful periods.
e.zh: 童年时被压抑的情绪在压力期可能重新浮现。

e.en: Citizens fled the country's {repressive} regime.
e.zh: 民众纷纷逃离这个高压的政权。

e.en: The new law was criticized as overly {repressive}.
e.zh: 新法律被批评过于高压。

e.en: The government acted {repressively} against peaceful protesters.
e.zh: 政府对和平抗议者采取了高压手段。

e.en: He spoke {repressively} to silence the dissenting students.
e.zh: 他用压制性的语气让持异议的学生噤声。

e.en: This protein acts as a {repressor} of gene transcription.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质起到基因转录抑制因子的作用。

e.en: The dictator was remembered as a brutal {repressor}.
e.zh: 那位独裁者被铭记为一名残暴的压迫者。

e.en: The cooler weather brought a welcome {reprieve} from the heatwave.
e.zh: 凉爽的天气让人们从热浪中得到喘息。

e.en: The governor granted the prisoner a last-minute {reprieve}.
e.zh: 州长在最后一刻给了囚犯缓刑。

e.en: The manager issued a formal {reprimand} for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 经理因错过截止日期发出了正式的书面批评。

e.en: Teachers should {reprimand} bullying behavior immediately.
e.zh: 老师应当立刻斥责欺凌行为。

e.en: The publisher decided to {reprint} the popular novel.
e.zh: 出版社决定再版这本畅销小说。

e.en: I bought a cheap {reprint} of the classic textbook.
e.zh: 我买了一本便宜的经典教材重印版。

e.en: The article was {reprinted} in several major newspapers.
e.zh: 这篇文章被多家主流报纸转载。

e.en: Her debut novel has been {reprinted} twelve times.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说已经再版了十二次。

e.en: The publisher is {reprinting} the cookbook due to high demand.
e.zh: 由于需求旺盛,出版社正在重印这本食谱。

e.en: {Reprinting} old comics has become a profitable business.
e.zh: 重印旧漫画已经成了一门赚钱的生意。

reprints.t:
n. 重印本（复数）
v. 重印

e.en: The bookstore sells affordable {reprints} of vintage posters.
e.zh: 这家书店出售价格亲民的复古海报复刻版。

e.en: The textbook {reprints} every two years with minor updates.
e.zh: 这本教科书每两年再版一次,做些小修改。

e.en: Witnesses feared {reprisal} from the gang and stayed silent.
e.zh: 证人害怕黑帮报复,选择了沉默。

e.en: The airstrike was launched in {reprisal} for the bombing.
e.zh: 这次空袭是对那起爆炸事件的报复行动。

e.en: The actress will {reprise} her iconic role next year.
e.zh: 那位女演员明年将再次出演她的经典角色。

e.en: The musical ends with a {reprise} of the opening song.
e.zh: 这部音乐剧以开场曲的重现作为结尾。

repro.t: n. 复现（reproduction 缩写）；复制品

e.en: Please attach a minimal {repro} when filing the bug report.
e.zh: 提交错误报告时请附上最小的复现示例。

e.en: The studio printed a high-quality {repro} of the painting.
e.zh: 工作室印制了这幅画的高质量复制品。

e.en: Her honest work is beyond {reproach}.
e.zh: 她诚实的工作无可指摘。

e.en: He gave his son a stern {reproach} for lying.
e.zh: 他严厉地责备儿子说谎。

e.en: The {repentant} student apologized to the whole class.
e.zh: 那个悔过的学生向全班道了歉。

e.en: He looked genuinely {repentant} after breaking the vase.
e.zh: 打碎花瓶后他看起来确实很懊悔。

repercussion.t: n. 后果，反响（常指负面影响）

e.en: Quitting suddenly could have a serious {repercussion} on your career.
e.zh: 突然辞职可能对你的职业产生严重影响。

e.en: Every policy change has some {repercussion} for ordinary users.
e.zh: 每一项政策变动都会对普通用户产生某种影响。

repertoire.t: n. 全部曲目；（一个人掌握的）全部技能

e.en: The pianist has a huge classical {repertoire}.
e.zh: 这位钢琴家拥有庞大的古典曲目库。

e.en: Add a few jokes to your conversational {repertoire}.
e.zh: 在你的聊天素材里加几个笑话吧。

repertoires.t: n. repertoire 的复数，全部曲目/技能

e.en: Both bands expanded their {repertoires} with original songs.
e.zh: 两支乐队都用原创歌曲扩展了各自的曲目。

e.en: Top chefs constantly refresh their {repertoires} with new dishes.
e.zh: 顶级厨师不断用新菜式更新自己的菜单。

repertories.t: n. repertory 的复数，保留剧目；储藏

e.en: Regional theaters maintain diverse {repertories} year after year.
e.zh: 地方剧院年年保持着多样化的常演剧目。

e.en: The festival showcased the {repertories} of three opera houses.
e.zh: 该节庆展示了三家歌剧院的常演剧目。

repertory.t: n. 保留剧目；剧团常演剧库

e.en: The {repertory} theater stages a different play each week.
e.zh: 这家轮演剧院每周上演不同的剧目。

e.en: That song is now part of her standard {repertory}.
e.zh: 那首歌现在已成为她的常演曲目之一。

e.en: Learning a language takes a lot of {repetition}.
e.zh: 学习一门语言需要大量的重复练习。

e.en: Edit the draft to remove unnecessary {repetition}.
e.zh: 修改草稿,删掉不必要的重复。

repetitions.t: n. repetition 的复数，重复的次数

e.en: Do three sets of ten {repetitions} for each exercise.
e.zh: 每个动作做三组,每组十次。

e.en: The song's catchy {repetitions} make it easy to remember.
e.zh: 这首歌朗朗上口的反复段让人很容易记住。

e.en: His speech grew {repetitious} after the first ten minutes.
e.zh: 他的演讲在前十分钟之后就开始啰嗦重复。

e.en: The plot is too {repetitious} to hold my interest.
e.zh: 剧情太过重复,提不起我的兴趣。

e.en: Factory work can be {repetitive} and exhausting.
e.zh: 工厂里的活儿往往单调重复又累人。

e.en: Typing all day caused a {repetitive} strain injury.
e.zh: 整天打字导致了重复性劳损。

repetitively.t: adv. 重复地，单调反复地

e.en: The child {repetitively} tapped the table during the meeting.
e.zh: 那个孩子在会议中不停地敲着桌子。

e.en: Clicking {repetitively} on the link won't load it faster.
e.zh: 反复点击那个链接并不会让它加载得更快。

e.en: The {repetitiveness} of the job eventually wore him down.
e.zh: 这份工作的单调重复最终把他磨垮了。

e.en: Players complained about the {repetitiveness} of the side quests.
e.zh: 玩家抱怨支线任务太过重复。

rephrase.t: v. 换个说法，重新措辞

e.en: Let me {rephrase} that — I didn't explain it well.
e.zh: 我换种说法吧,刚才没说清楚。

e.en: Try to {rephrase} the question more politely.
e.zh: 试着把这个问题用更礼貌的方式重新表达。

e.en: Don't {repine} over chances you didn't take.
e.zh: 不要为没把握住的机会而懊恼。

e.en: She refused to {repine} about the lost promotion.
e.zh: 她拒绝为错失的晋升而郁郁寡欢。

e.en: I need to {replace} the battery in my laptop.
e.zh: 我得给笔记本电脑换一块电池。

e.en: No app can fully {replace} a real human conversation.
e.zh: 任何应用都无法完全取代真实的人际交流。

replaceable.t: adj. 可替换的，可取代的

e.en: The headphones have a {replaceable} ear cushion.
e.zh: 这副耳机的耳垫是可以更换的。

e.en: No employee should feel easily {replaceable}.
e.zh: 任何员工都不应该觉得自己很容易被替代。

replaced.t: v. replace 的过去式，被替换

e.en: They {replaced} the old router with a faster model.
e.zh: 他们把旧路由器换成了更快的型号。

e.en: Streaming services have largely {replaced} cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务在很大程度上取代了有线电视。

e.en: Order a {replacement} screen if yours is cracked.
e.zh: 如果你的屏幕碎了,就订一块替换屏。

e.en: The team is searching for a {replacement} coach.
e.zh: 球队正在物色新的接任教练。

replacements.t: n. replacement 的复数，替代品

e.en: The store offers free {replacements} for defective products.
e.zh: 该店为有缺陷的产品提供免费更换。

e.en: Several senior staff are training their {replacements} now.
e.zh: 几位资深员工正在培训他们的接任者。

replaces.t: v. replace 的第三人称单数，替换

e.en: This update {replaces} the old payment system entirely.
e.zh: 这次更新彻底取代了旧的支付系统。

e.en: Nothing {replaces} a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 什么都比不上一夜好眠。

replacing.t: v. replace 的现在分词，替换

e.en: I'm {replacing} the broken tile in the bathroom.
e.zh: 我正在更换浴室里那块裂掉的瓷砖。

e.en: AI tools are {replacing} some routine office tasks.
e.zh: AI 工具正在取代一些日常办公工作。

replan.t: v. 重新规划，重做计划

e.en: We had to {replan} the trip after the flight got cancelled.
e.zh: 航班取消后我们不得不重新安排行程。

e.en: The team will {replan} the sprint based on new priorities.
e.zh: 团队将根据新的优先事项重新规划这个迭代。

e.en: Farmers {replant} the field every spring with new crops.
e.zh: 农民每年春天都会在田里重新种植新作物。

e.en: We need to {replant} this rose in a bigger pot.
e.zh: 我们需要把这朵玫瑰移种到更大的花盆里。

replanting.t: v. replant 的现在分词，重新栽种

e.en: The forest service is {replanting} thousands of trees after the fire.
e.zh: 林业部门正在火灾后重新种植成千上万棵树。

e.en: {Replanting} the seedlings too early can damage the roots.
e.zh: 过早重新栽种幼苗会损伤根部。

replay.t:
n. 回放，重播
v. 重新播放

e.en: Let's watch the {replay} to see if the goal was offside.
e.zh: 我们来看回放,看看那个进球是否越位。

e.en: You can {replay} the level as many times as you want.
e.zh: 这一关你想重玩多少次都可以。

e.en: Don't forget to {replenish} the printer with paper before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前别忘了给打印机补充纸张。

e.en: Drinking water helps {replenish} the fluids you lose during exercise.
e.zh: 喝水有助于补充运动时流失的水分。

replenished.t: v. replenish 的过去式，被补满

e.en: The shelves were {replenished} overnight with fresh stock.
e.zh: 货架在夜间补充了新的库存。

e.en: After lunch, she felt fully {replenished} and ready to work.
e.zh: 午饭后她感觉精力恢复,准备好工作了。

e.en: Stock {replenishment} happens automatically when inventory drops below ten.
e.zh: 当库存低于十件时,系统会自动补货。

e.en: The runners stopped at the station for water {replenishment}.
e.zh: 跑者们在补给站停下来补充水分。

e.en: The novel is {replete} with vivid descriptions of city life.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了对城市生活的生动描写。

e.en: After the feast, the guests felt happily {replete}.
e.zh: 宴席之后,客人们都心满意足地饱餐一顿。

replica.t: n. 复制品；（分布式系统）副本

e.en: The museum displays an exact {replica} of the ancient ship.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了那艘古船的精确复制品。

e.en: He bought a cheap {replica} of the famous painting online.
e.zh: 他在网上买了那幅名画的廉价复制品。

replicable.t: adj. 可复制的，可重现的

e.en: The study's results must be {replicable} by other researchers.
e.zh: 这项研究的结果必须能被其他研究人员复现。

e.en: Their success is hardly {replicable} in a smaller market.
e.zh: 他们的成功在较小的市场里几乎无法复制。

e.en: In the film, the detective hunts a rogue {replicant}.
e.zh: 在那部电影里,侦探追捕一个失控的复制人。

e.en: The {replicant} looked completely human at first glance.
e.zh: 那个复制人乍看之下与真人完全无异。

replicas.t: n. replica 的复数，复制品，副本

e.en: The gift shop sells {replicas} of the Eiffel Tower.
e.zh: 礼品店出售埃菲尔铁塔的复制品。

e.en: Several {replicas} of the painting hang in different museums.
e.zh: 这幅画的多件复制品挂在不同的博物馆里。

replicate.t: v. 复制，再现（实验、结果）

e.en: Scientists tried to {replicate} the experiment but got different results.
e.zh: 科学家试图复现该实验,但得到了不同的结果。

e.en: The database will {replicate} your data across multiple servers.
e.zh: 数据库会把你的数据复制到多个服务器上。

replicated.t:
v. replicate 的过去式，已复制
adj. 复制的

e.en: The bug only appeared once and could not be {replicated}.
e.zh: 这个 bug 只出现过一次,无法重现。

e.en: Files are automatically {replicated} to a backup region every hour.
e.zh: 文件每小时会自动备份复制到另一个区域。

e.en: Data {replication} ensures the service stays online during outages.
e.zh: 数据复制可确保服务在故障期间保持在线。

e.en: Other labs failed at the {replication} of the original findings.
e.zh: 其他实验室未能复现原本的研究结果。

e.en: The crew used the {replicator} to make a hot cup of tea.
e.zh: 船员用复制器做了一杯热茶。

e.en: This tool acts as a {replicator} for your settings across devices.
e.zh: 这个工具能在多台设备间复制你的设置。

replied.t: v. reply 的过去式，已回复

e.en: She {replied} to the email within minutes.
e.zh: 她在几分钟内就回复了那封邮件。

e.en: "I'll think about it," he {replied} quietly.
e.zh: “我考虑一下,”他平静地回答道。

replies.t:
n. reply 的复数，回复
v. 第三人称单数

e.en: This tweet got thousands of angry {replies} overnight.
e.zh: 这条推文一夜之间收到了数千条愤怒的回复。

e.en: She rarely {replies} to messages on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末很少回复消息。

reply.t:
v. 回复，答复
n. 回复

e.en: Please {reply} to this message by Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 请在周五下午前回复这条消息。

e.en: I'm still waiting for a {reply} from the support team.
e.zh: 我还在等客服团队的回复。

replying.t: v. reply 的现在分词，回复中

e.en: He spent the morning {replying} to dozens of customer emails.
e.zh: 他整个早上都在回复几十封客户邮件。

e.en: Stop {replying} to spam — it just confirms your address is active.
e.zh: 别回复垃圾邮件,那只会让对方确认你的地址有效。

repo.t: n. 代码仓库（repository 的缩写）

e.en: Clone the {repo} and run npm install to get started.
e.zh: 克隆这个代码仓库,然后运行 npm install 即可开始。

e.en: I just pushed a fix to the main {repo}.
e.zh: 我刚把一个修复推到了主仓库。

repoint.t: v. 重新指向（指针、DNS 等）

e.en: You'll need to {repoint} the DNS record to the new server.
e.zh: 你需要把 DNS 记录指向新的服务器。

e.en: The mason will {repoint} the old brick wall next week.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠下周会重新勾抹这堵旧砖墙的灰缝。

repopulate.t: v. 重新填充（数据、人口）

e.en: Conservationists hope to {repopulate} the forest with native wolves.
e.zh: 环保人士希望让本地狼重新在这片森林中繁衍。

e.en: After the migration, we'll {repopulate} the cache from the database.
e.zh: 迁移之后,我们会从数据库重新填充缓存。

e.en: The {repopulation} of the river with salmon took several years.
e.zh: 让鲑鱼重新在这条河中繁衍花了好几年时间。

e.en: Cache {repopulation} after a restart can take a few minutes.
e.zh: 重启后缓存重新填充可能需要几分钟。

report.t:
n. 报告
v. 汇报，举报

e.en: Please {report} any bugs you find in the new app.
e.zh: 请反馈你在新应用里发现的任何 bug。

e.en: The annual {report} shows record profits this year.
e.zh: 年度报告显示今年利润创下了新高。

reportable.t: adj. 可上报的，值得报道的

e.en: Any data breach is immediately {reportable} to the regulator.
e.zh: 任何数据泄露都必须立即上报监管机构。

e.en: The doctor said the symptoms were not {reportable} as a disease.
e.zh: 医生说这些症状不属于需上报的疾病。

reportage.t: n. 新闻报道，纪实报道

e.en: Her wartime {reportage} won several international awards.
e.zh: 她的战时报道获得了多项国际奖项。

e.en: The magazine is known for its in-depth {reportage} on tech.
e.zh: 这本杂志以深度的科技报道而闻名。

reported.t: v. report 的过去式，据报道的

e.en: Several users {reported} crashes after the latest update.
e.zh: 多名用户反映最新更新后出现了崩溃。

e.en: The {reported} earnings beat analyst expectations this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度公布的财报超出了分析师的预期。

e.en: The CEO is {reportedly} in talks with two major investors.
e.zh: 据报道,这位 CEO 正在与两位大投资者洽谈。

e.en: The new phone {reportedly} ships with a faster chip.
e.zh: 据称这款新手机搭载了更快的芯片。

reseed.t: v. 重新播种；重置随机种子

e.en: We plan to {reseed} the lawn this spring.
e.zh: 我们打算今年春天给草坪重新播种。

e.en: Farmers had to {reseed} the field after the heavy frost.
e.zh: 严重霜冻过后,农民不得不重新播种这片田。

e.en: Critics warn that the policy could lead to school {resegregation}.
e.zh: 批评者警告称,这项政策可能导致学校重新分隔。

e.en: Studies show alarming {resegregation} in many urban districts.
e.zh: 研究显示许多城区出现了令人担忧的重新隔离现象。

e.en: You can {resell} unused gift cards on this app.
e.zh: 你可以在这个应用上转卖没用过的礼品卡。

e.en: Some people buy concert tickets just to {resell} them later.
e.zh: 有些人买演唱会门票就是为了之后转卖。

e.en: He works as an authorized {reseller} for several tech brands.
e.zh: 他是几家科技品牌的授权经销商。

e.en: Avoid buying tickets from unknown {reseller} websites.
e.zh: 不要在不知名的二手票网站上买票。

e.en: The boy bears a striking {resemblance} to his grandfather.
e.zh: 这个男孩和他爷爷长得惊人地像。

e.en: There's little {resemblance} between the book and the movie.
e.zh: 这本书和电影之间几乎没有什么相似之处。

e.en: The twin sisters {resemble} each other in almost every way.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹几乎在每个方面都很像。

e.en: Modern smartphones barely {resemble} the phones of twenty years ago.
e.zh: 现代智能手机和二十年前的手机几乎毫无相似之处。

e.en: The old painting {resembled} a scene from her childhood.
e.zh: 那幅旧画很像她童年时的一个场景。

e.en: His new haircut {resembled} a popular celebrity's style.
e.zh: 他的新发型很像某位人气明星的造型。

e.en: The tower {resembles} a giant chess piece from afar.
e.zh: 远远望去,这座塔像一枚巨大的棋子。

e.en: Her writing style closely {resembles} that of her mentor.
e.zh: 她的写作风格和她的导师非常相似。

resembling.t: v. 像（resemble 的现在分词）

e.en: The cloud was shaped {resembling} a galloping horse.
e.zh: 那朵云的形状像一匹奔跑的马。

e.en: He wore a costume {resembling} a medieval knight.
e.zh: 他穿了一套像中世纪骑士的服装。

resent.t:
v. 怨恨；愤慨
v. 重新发送（re-sent）

e.en: Many employees {resent} being asked to work weekends.
e.zh: 许多员工对被要求周末加班感到不满。

e.en: She began to {resent} how little time they spent together.
e.zh: 她开始对两人相处时间太少感到不满。

resented.t: v. 怨恨（resent 的过去式）

e.en: He always {resented} his brother's success in school.
e.zh: 他一直对哥哥在学校的成功心怀怨恨。

e.en: The staff {resented} the manager's last-minute changes.
e.zh: 员工们对经理最后一刻的改动感到不满。

e.en: She felt {resentful} after being passed over for promotion.
e.zh: 被跳过升职后,她心里很不是滋味。

e.en: Years of unfair treatment made him deeply {resentful}.
e.zh: 多年的不公正待遇让他心怀深深的怨恨。

e.en: He glared {resentfully} at the colleague who got the credit.
e.zh: 他怨恨地瞪着那个抢了功劳的同事。

e.en: She muttered {resentfully} about the unfair workload.
e.zh: 她愤愤不平地嘟囔着工作量不公的事。

resenting.t: v. 怨恨（resent 的现在分词）

e.en: She kept {resenting} her sister for borrowing without asking.
e.zh: 她一直怨恨妹妹不打招呼就借东西。

e.en: Without {resenting} the criticism, he tried to improve.
e.zh: 他没有对批评心怀怨恨,而是努力改进。

e.en: Years of unpaid overtime built up deep {resentment} among staff.
e.zh: 多年无偿加班让员工积累了深深的不满。

e.en: Letting go of {resentment} can be the hardest part of healing.
e.zh: 放下怨恨可能是疗愈过程中最难的一部分。

e.en: He still {resents} how his parents treated him as a child.
e.zh: 他仍然怨恨父母小时候对他的方式。

e.en: She {resents} being interrupted during her morning routine.
e.zh: 她讨厌在晨间例行事务中被打断。

reservation.t:
n. 预订；预约
n. 保留意见

e.en: I made a dinner {reservation} for seven o'clock tonight.
e.zh: 我订了今晚七点的晚餐。

e.en: He accepted the offer without any {reservation}.
e.zh: 他毫无保留地接受了这个提议。

e.en: The friendly {reservationist} helped me change my hotel dates.
e.zh: 那位热情的预订员帮我更改了酒店入住日期。

e.en: She works as a {reservationist} for a major airline.
e.zh: 她在一家大型航空公司当订位员。

reservations.t: n. 预订；保留意见（复数）

e.en: Please make dinner {reservations} at least a week in advance.
e.zh: 请至少提前一周预订晚餐。

e.en: The board had serious {reservations} about the new strategy.
e.zh: 董事会对新战略有严重的保留意见。

reserve.t:
v. 预订；保留
n. 储备；备用

e.en: I'd like to {reserve} a table for four at eight.
e.zh: 我想预订一张八点四人的桌子。

e.en: The wildlife {reserve} protects endangered species year-round.
e.zh: 这个野生动物保护区全年保护濒危物种。

reserved.t:
adj. 已预订的；保留的
adj. 矜持的

e.en: This seat is {reserved} for the bride's family.
e.zh: 这个座位是为新娘家人保留的。

e.en: He's a {reserved} man who rarely speaks in meetings.
e.zh: 他是个内敛的人,在会议上很少发言。

reserves.t:
n. 储备；后备
v. 预订（三单）

e.en: The country's oil {reserves} are running dangerously low.
e.zh: 该国的石油储备正在急剧减少。

e.en: The coach {reserves} the final spot for a rookie player.
e.zh: 教练把最后一个名额留给了一名新秀球员。

reserving.t: v. 预订；保留（现在分词）

e.en: I'm {reserving} a table for two at the new restaurant.
e.zh: 我正在那家新餐厅订两人位。

e.en: She's {reserving} judgment until all the facts come out.
e.zh: 她要等所有事实公布后再下结论。

reservior.t: n. 水库（reservoir 的拼写错误）

e.en: The {reservior} supplies drinking water to the entire city.
e.zh: 这座水库为全市提供饮用水。

e.en: Old books are a {reservior} of forgotten wisdom.
e.zh: 旧书是被遗忘智慧的宝库。

e.en: As a {reservist}, he trains one weekend each month.
e.zh: 作为预备役军人,他每月训练一个周末。

e.en: The army called every {reservist} back to active duty.
e.zh: 军队召回了每一名预备役军人重返现役。

reservoir.t:
n. 水库；蓄水池
n. 储藏；储备

e.en: The {reservoir} is nearly empty after the long drought.
e.zh: 长期干旱后,水库几乎见底了。

e.en: Her mind is a {reservoir} of obscure film trivia.
e.zh: 她的脑子里装满了冷门的电影知识。

reset.t:
v. 重置；复位
n. 重置操作

e.en: Try to {reset} the router if the wifi is slow.
e.zh: 如果网速慢,试着重启一下路由器。

e.en: A weekend off helps me {reset} mentally.
e.zh: 放一个周末假能让我精神上重新归零。

resetting.t: v. 重置（reset 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {resetting} my password because I forgot the old one.
e.zh: 我正在重置密码,因为旧的忘了。

e.en: The factory is {resetting} the machines for a new product line.
e.zh: 工厂正在为新产品线重新调试机器。

e.en: The agency helps refugees {resettle} in safer countries.
e.zh: 该机构帮助难民在更安全的国家重新安置。

e.en: They plan to {resettle} on a quiet farm out west.
e.zh: 他们打算搬到西部一个安静的农场重新安家。

e.en: The government announced a {resettlement} program for displaced families.
e.zh: 政府公布了针对流离失所家庭的安置计划。

e.en: {Resettlement} costs are covered by international aid groups.
e.zh: 安置费用由国际援助组织承担。

e.en: Smartphones continue to {reshape} how we communicate daily.
e.zh: 智能手机持续重塑我们的日常沟通方式。

e.en: The new CEO wants to {reshape} the company's culture.
e.zh: 新任CEO想要重塑公司文化。

reshaped.t: v. 重塑（reshape 的过去式）

e.en: The pandemic {reshaped} the way millions work from home.
e.zh: 疫情重塑了数百万人在家办公的方式。

e.en: She {reshaped} the clay into a small bowl.
e.zh: 她把黏土重新捏成了一个小碗。

reshaping.t: v. 重塑（reshape 的现在分词）

e.en: AI is rapidly {reshaping} the entire creative industry.
e.zh: 人工智能正在迅速重塑整个创意产业。

e.en: The architect is {reshaping} the lobby to feel more open.
e.zh: 建筑师正在重新设计大堂,让空间更通透。

reshuffle.t:
v. 改组；重新洗牌
n. 人事改组

e.en: The prime minister announced a major cabinet {reshuffle}.
e.zh: 首相宣布了一次重大的内阁改组。

e.en: Let me {reshuffle} the playlist before the party starts.
e.zh: 派对开始前我来重新打乱一下歌单。

reshuffling.t: v. 改组（reshuffle 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is {reshuffling} its lineup before the playoffs.
e.zh: 球队正在季后赛前调整阵容。

e.en: Management is {reshuffling} departments to cut costs.
e.zh: 管理层正在重组各部门以削减成本。

e.en: Most students {reside} on campus during their first year.
e.zh: 大多数学生第一年住在校内。

e.en: The real power seems to {reside} with the board chair.
e.zh: 真正的权力似乎掌握在董事长手中。

resided.t: v. 居住（reside 的过去式）

e.en: She {resided} in Tokyo for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 她在东京居住了将近十年。

e.en: The charm of the village {resided} in its quiet streets.
e.zh: 这座小村庄的魅力就在于它静谧的街道。

e.en: The ambassador's official {residence} is on Park Avenue.
e.zh: 大使的官邸位于公园大道。

e.en: You need proof of {residence} to apply for the card.
e.zh: 申请这张卡需要居住证明。

e.en: Several luxury {residences} overlook the harbor.
e.zh: 几栋豪华住宅俯瞰着港口。

e.en: The university built new student {residences} this year.
e.zh: 大学今年新建了多栋学生宿舍。

residency.t: n. 居留权；住院实习期

e.en: She's doing her medical {residency} at a children's hospital.
e.zh: 她正在一家儿童医院做住院医师培训。

e.en: Permanent {residency} usually takes several years to obtain.
e.zh: 永久居留权通常需要好几年才能拿到。

resident.t:
n. 居民；住户
adj. 常驻的

e.en: Every {resident} received a notice about the water shutoff.
e.zh: 每位居民都收到了停水通知。

e.en: He's the {resident} expert on machine learning at the office.
e.zh: 他是办公室里公认的机器学习专家。

e.en: This street is purely {residential}, with no shops at all.
e.zh: 这条街完全是住宅区,没有任何商店。

e.en: The company offers {residential} broadband at lower prices.
e.zh: 该公司以较低价格提供家庭宽带服务。

e.en: The area is zoned {residentially} and bans all factories.
e.zh: 该地区被划为住宅用地,禁止设立任何工厂。

e.en: Properties marked {residentially} cannot be used for offices.
e.zh: 标注为住宅用途的房产不得用作办公场所。

e.en: Local {residents} protested the proposed highway expansion.
e.zh: 当地居民抗议拟议中的高速公路扩建。

e.en: Most {residents} of the building are young professionals.
e.zh: 这栋楼里大多数住户都是年轻的上班族。

e.en: The author currently {resides} in a small Vermont town.
e.zh: 这位作家目前住在佛蒙特州的一个小镇。

e.en: True happiness {resides} in everyday small moments.
e.zh: 真正的幸福藏在日常的点滴瞬间里。

residing.t: v. 居住（reside 的现在分词）

e.en: Foreigners {residing} in Japan must register at city hall.
e.zh: 在日本居住的外国人必须到市政厅登记。

e.en: The fault was {residing} in an outdated driver.
e.zh: 问题出在一个过时的驱动程序上。

residual.t:
adj. 残余的；剩余的
n. 残差；残留

e.en: He still feels some {residual} pain after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他仍然感到一些残余疼痛。

e.en: Actors earn {residual} income from reruns of old shows.
e.zh: 演员能从老剧重播中获得分成收入。

residuals.t: n. 残余；残留收益（复数）

e.en: The actor still earns sizable {residuals} from that sitcom.
e.zh: 这位演员至今仍能从那部情景喜剧获得可观分成。

e.en: Engineers checked the {residuals} left after the chemical reaction.
e.zh: 工程师检查了化学反应后留下的残留物。

e.en: His daughter was named the {residuary} beneficiary in the will.
e.zh: 他的女儿在遗嘱中被指定为剩余财产受益人。

e.en: The {residuary} estate goes to the surviving spouse.
e.zh: 剩余遗产归在世的配偶所有。

e.en: Wash the pan to remove any oily {residue}.
e.zh: 把锅洗一下,把油渍残留物去掉。

e.en: A faint {residue} of regret lingered in her voice.
e.zh: 她的语气里残留着一丝隐约的遗憾。

reproached.t: v. 责备；指责（reproach 的过去式）

e.en: She {reproached} herself for missing the important meeting.
e.zh: 她为错过那场重要会议而自责。

e.en: His mother gently {reproached} him for being rude.
e.zh: 母亲温柔地责备他没礼貌。

reproaches.t:
v. 责备（第三人称单数）
n. 责备；指责

e.en: He ignored her angry {reproaches} and walked away.
e.zh: 他无视她愤怒的责备,转身离开了。

e.en: She constantly {reproaches} him for forgetting their anniversary.
e.zh: 她总是责怪他忘了他们的结婚纪念日。

reproachful.t: adj. 带有责备的；责备的

e.en: The dog gave him a {reproachful} look after being scolded.
e.zh: 被训斥之后,那只狗用责备的眼神望着他。

e.en: She shot her husband a {reproachful} glance across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向丈夫投去责备的一瞥。

e.en: The child looked {reproachfully} at his father after the broken promise.
e.zh: 父亲食言后,孩子带着责备的眼神望着他。

e.en: She sighed {reproachfully} when he arrived late again.
e.zh: 当他再次迟到时,她带着责备地叹了口气。

e.en: Stop {reproaching} yourself for things you can't control.
e.zh: 别再为自己无法控制的事情自责了。

e.en: She kept {reproaching} him for forgetting her birthday.
e.zh: 她一直责怪他忘了她的生日。

reprobate.t:
n. 堕落者；无赖
adj. 堕落的

e.en: The old {reprobate} spent every evening at the bar.
e.zh: 那个老无赖每晚都泡在酒吧里。

e.en: His grandfather was a charming but unrepentant {reprobate}.
e.zh: 他的祖父虽然迷人,却是个不知悔改的浪荡子。

e.en: His behavior earned the {reprobation} of the entire community.
e.zh: 他的行为招致了整个社区的谴责。

e.en: The ancient text speaks of divine {reprobation} for the wicked.
e.zh: 那本古籍谈到对恶人的神圣谴责。

e.en: The plant will {reprocess} used nuclear fuel next year.
e.zh: 该工厂明年将对乏核燃料进行再处理。

e.en: We need to {reprocess} the data after fixing the bug.
e.zh: 修复这个错误后我们需要重新处理这些数据。

e.en: Nuclear fuel {reprocessing} remains controversial in many countries.
e.zh: 核燃料再处理在许多国家仍存在争议。

e.en: The factory specializes in {reprocessing} plastic waste.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门从事塑料废料的再加工。

reproduce.t:
v. 复制；重现
v. 繁殖

e.en: Engineers couldn't {reproduce} the bug on their machines.
e.zh: 工程师们没法在自己的机器上复现这个错误。

e.en: Pandas struggle to {reproduce} in captivity.
e.zh: 大熊猫在圈养环境下繁殖困难。

e.en: The painting was carefully {reproduced} for the museum gift shop.
e.zh: 这幅画被精心复制后在博物馆礼品店出售。

e.en: The experiment was successfully {reproduced} by another lab.
e.zh: 该实验在另一家实验室成功复现。

e.en: The bug report included a minimal {reproducer} script.
e.zh: 错误报告中附上了一段最小复现脚本。

e.en: Please attach a {reproducer} so we can debug the issue.
e.zh: 请附上一个复现示例,这样我们才能调试问题。

reproduces.t: v. 复制；繁殖（第三人称单数）

e.en: This bacterium {reproduces} every twenty minutes under ideal conditions.
e.zh: 这种细菌在理想条件下每二十分钟就繁殖一次。

e.en: The new printer {reproduces} colors with stunning accuracy.
e.zh: 这款新打印机能极其精准地还原色彩。

reproducibility.t: n. 可复现性；可重复性

e.en: Scientists are concerned about the {reproducibility} crisis in psychology.
e.zh: 科学家们对心理学领域的可重复性危机感到担忧。

e.en: Docker containers improve the {reproducibility} of software builds.
e.zh: Docker 容器能提高软件构建的可重复性。

reproducible.t: adj. 可复现的；可重复的

e.en: All findings must be {reproducible} before publication.
e.zh: 所有研究结果在发表前都必须可重复。

e.en: Please provide a {reproducible} example of the error.
e.zh: 请提供一个可复现该错误的示例。

reproducing.t: v. 复制；繁殖（现在分词）

e.en: I'm having trouble {reproducing} the crash on my laptop.
e.zh: 我没办法在自己笔记本上复现这次崩溃。

e.en: Salmon swim upstream for {reproducing} in their birth rivers.
e.zh: 鲑鱼会逆流而上,回到出生的河流繁殖。

reproduction.t:
n. 复制品；再现
n. 繁殖

e.en: The museum displays a faithful {reproduction} of the ancient vase.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了这件古代花瓶的精准复制品。

e.en: Climate change threatens animal {reproduction} in the Arctic.
e.zh: 气候变化威胁着北极动物的繁殖。

e.en: The shop sells affordable {reproductions} of famous paintings.
e.zh: 这家店出售价格亲民的名画复制品。

e.en: Cheap {reproductions} of the antique chair flooded the market.
e.zh: 这款古董椅的廉价仿制品涌入了市场。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {reproductive} health for women.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门提供女性生殖健康服务。

e.en: Pollution can damage the {reproductive} systems of fish.
e.zh: 污染会损害鱼类的生殖系统。

reprogram.t: v. 重新编程；重新设定

e.en: You can {reprogram} the remote to work with any TV.
e.zh: 你可以重新设定遥控器,让它适配任何电视。

e.en: Therapy helped her {reprogram} negative thought patterns.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她重塑了负面思维模式。

e.en: The technician {reprogrammed} the thermostat for energy savings.
e.zh: 技师重新设置了恒温器以节省能源。

e.en: Scientists {reprogrammed} skin cells into stem cells.
e.zh: 科学家把皮肤细胞重编程为干细胞。

reprogramming.t:
n. 重新编程
v. 重新编程（现在分词）

e.en: The team is {reprogramming} the robot to handle new tasks.
e.zh: 团队正在重新编程让机器人处理新任务。

e.en: Therapy helps with {reprogramming} negative thought patterns.
e.zh: 心理治疗有助于重塑负面思维模式。

e.en: The teacher gave him a gentle {reproof} for being late.
e.zh: 老师对他迟到一事温和地训诫了一番。

e.en: Her silence felt like a sharper {reproof} than words.
e.zh: 她的沉默比言语更像是一种严厉的责备。

e.en: Parents should {reprove} bad behavior calmly and clearly.
e.zh: 父母应当冷静明确地训诫不良行为。

e.en: The coach didn't {reprove} the player in front of the team.
e.zh: 教练没有当着全队的面责备那名球员。

e.en: The manager {reproved} him for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 经理因他错过截止日期而训斥了他。

e.en: She {reproved} her son for speaking rudely to the guest.
e.zh: 她责备儿子对客人说话无礼。

reproves.t: v. 责备（第三人称单数）

e.en: The editor {reproves} writers who ignore the style guide.
e.zh: 编辑会训斥那些无视风格指南的作者。

e.en: He never {reproves} his staff in public meetings.
e.zh: 他从不在公开会议上责备员工。

reproving.t:
adj. 责备的
v. 责备（现在分词）

e.en: She gave him a {reproving} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去责备的目光。

e.en: The teacher's {reproving} tone made the class fall silent.
e.zh: 老师责备的语气让全班顿时安静下来。

e.en: He shook his head {reprovingly} at the noisy children.
e.zh: 他责备地朝吵闹的孩子们摇了摇头。

e.en: She looked at him {reprovingly} when he interrupted.
e.zh: 他打断别人时,她责备地看了他一眼。

e.en: A snake is a {reptile} that sheds its skin regularly.
e.zh: 蛇是一种会定期蜕皮的爬行动物。

e.en: The zoo just opened a new {reptile} exhibit.
e.zh: 动物园刚开放了一个新的爬行动物展区。

reptilian.t:
adj. 爬行动物的
n. 爬行动物

e.en: The dinosaur had clearly {reptilian} features and scales.
e.zh: 那只恐龙明显具有爬行类的特征和鳞片。

e.en: His cold, {reptilian} stare made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他冷漠如爬虫般的凝视让所有人都不自在。

repton.t: n. 雷普顿（英国地名/人名）

e.en: He attended {Repton}, a well-known English boarding school.
e.zh: 他就读于英国知名寄宿学校瑞普顿公学。

e.en: The village of {Repton} has a long medieval history.
e.zh: 瑞普顿村有着悠久的中世纪历史。

e.en: France has been a {republic} since the late eighteenth century.
e.zh: 法国自十八世纪末以来一直是共和国。

e.en: The new {republic} held its first elections last spring.
e.zh: 这个新成立的共和国去年春天举行了首次选举。

republican.t:
adj. 共和党的；共和制的
n. 共和党人

e.en: She holds strongly {republican} views on government.
e.zh: 她持有强烈的共和派政府观点。

e.en: The {republican} party won most seats in the senate.
e.zh: 共和党在参议院赢得了多数席位。

e.en: {Republicanism} spread quickly across Europe in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 共和主义在十九世纪迅速传遍欧洲。

e.en: His writings defend {republicanism} as the fairest system.
e.zh: 他的著作捍卫共和主义为最公平的制度。

e.en: Many former Soviet {republics} became independent in 1991.
e.zh: 许多前苏联加盟共和国于1991年获得独立。

e.en: Several small {republics} formed a regional trade alliance.
e.zh: 几个小共和国组建了一个地区贸易联盟。

e.en: The publisher plans to {republish} the novel with new artwork.
e.zh: 出版商计划用新封面重新出版这部小说。

e.en: Bloggers often {republish} old posts to attract new readers.
e.zh: 博主常常重发旧文以吸引新读者。

e.en: The senator was quick to {repudiate} the racist comments.
e.zh: 那位参议员迅速否认并谴责了那些种族主义言论。

e.en: He chose to {repudiate} the contract after finding errors.
e.zh: 发现错误后,他决定拒绝承认这份合同。

e.en: Her public {repudiation} of the policy shocked the party.
e.zh: 她公开否认这项政策的做法震惊了全党。

e.en: The court ruled the {repudiation} of the debt was unlawful.
e.zh: 法院裁定拒绝偿还这笔债务的行为不合法。

e.en: She felt deep {repugnance} at the cruelty in the video.
e.zh: 看到视频中的残忍画面,她感到深深的厌恶。

e.en: His {repugnance} for dishonesty shaped his entire career.
e.zh: 他对不诚实的反感塑造了他整个职业生涯。

repugnant.t: adj. 令人厌恶的；反感的

e.en: Most viewers found the show's humor genuinely {repugnant}.
e.zh: 大多数观众觉得这档节目的幽默实在令人厌恶。

e.en: Such discrimination is {repugnant} to modern values.
e.zh: 这种歧视行为与现代价值观格格不入。

e.en: The defenders managed to {repulse} the attack at dawn.
e.zh: 守军在黎明时分成功击退了进攻。

e.en: His arrogance seemed to {repulse} everyone at the party.
e.zh: 他的傲慢似乎让派对上的每个人都反感。

repulsed.t: v. 击退；使反感（过去式）

e.en: She was {repulsed} by the smell coming from the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里飘出的气味让她感到恶心。

e.en: The army {repulsed} the enemy and held the bridge.
e.zh: 军队击退了敌人,守住了那座桥。

e.en: He felt instant {repulsion} when he read the hateful comment.
e.zh: 读到那条充满仇恨的评论时,他立刻感到反感。

e.en: Magnetic {repulsion} keeps the two poles apart.
e.zh: 磁力的排斥作用让两极相互分离。

repulsive.t: adj. 令人厌恶的；排斥的

e.en: The leftover food had a {repulsive} smell after a week.
e.zh: 那些剩饭放了一周后散发出令人作呕的气味。

e.en: Many readers found the villain's behavior utterly {repulsive}.
e.zh: 许多读者觉得反派的行为令人极度厌恶。

repurchase.t:
v. 回购；再次购买
n. 回购

e.en: The company announced a {repurchase} of its own shares.
e.zh: 该公司宣布回购自家股票。

e.en: Customers can {repurchase} the item at a discounted price.
e.zh: 顾客可以以折扣价再次购买该商品。

reputable.t: adj. 有信誉的；名声好的

e.en: Always buy electronics from a {reputable} online retailer.
e.zh: 购买电子产品请始终选择信誉良好的在线零售商。

e.en: She works at a highly {reputable} law firm downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心一家声誉极佳的律师事务所工作。

e.en: The restaurant has built a strong {reputation} for fresh seafood.
e.zh: 这家餐厅因新鲜海鲜而建立了良好声誉。

e.en: One bad review can damage a brand's online {reputation}.
e.zh: 一条差评就可能损害品牌的网络声誉。

reputational.t: adj. 声誉的；名誉相关的

e.en: The scandal caused serious {reputational} damage to the firm.
e.zh: 这场丑闻对公司声誉造成了严重损害。

e.en: Companies invest heavily to manage {reputational} risk online.
e.zh: 企业投入大量资源来管理网络声誉风险。

e.en: Both candidates have solid {reputations} for honesty.
e.zh: 两位候选人都以诚实著称。

e.en: Online reviews can make or break restaurant {reputations}.
e.zh: 网络评价能成就或毁掉餐厅的声誉。

repute.t:
n. 名声；声誉
v. 认为；以为

e.en: He is a scholar of great {repute} in his field.
e.zh: 他是该领域享有盛誉的学者。

e.en: The hotel is held in high {repute} among travelers.
e.zh: 这家酒店在旅行者中享有很高的声誉。

e.en: Pesticide {residues} were found on the imported fruit.
e.zh: 进口水果上检测出了农药残留。

e.en: The lab analyzed chemical {residues} from the crime scene.
e.zh: 实验室分析了犯罪现场的化学残留物。

e.en: After distillation, only a thick {residuum} remained in the flask.
e.zh: 蒸馏后,烧瓶里只剩下浓稠的残余物。

e.en: A small {residuum} of doubt still troubled the jury.
e.zh: 陪审团心里仍残留着一丝疑虑。

e.en: He plans to {resign} from the board next month.
e.zh: 他打算下个月从董事会辞职。

e.en: Don't {resign} yourself to a job you hate.
e.zh: 别因为讨厌一份工作就听天由命地忍下去。

resignation.t:
n. 辞职；辞呈
n. 顺从，听天由命

e.en: The CEO submitted his {resignation} after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻曝光后,CEO递交了辞职信。

e.en: She accepted the bad news with quiet {resignation}.
e.zh: 她以平静而无奈的态度接受了这个坏消息。

e.en: Three senior {resignations} in one week shocked the staff.
e.zh: 一周内三位高管辞职震惊了全体员工。

e.en: The minister received {resignations} from two key advisers.
e.zh: 部长收到了两位主要顾问的辞呈。

resigned.t:
adj. 顺从的，听天由命的
v. 辞职（过去式）

e.en: She finally {resigned} after years of being underpaid.
e.zh: 在多年低薪之后,她终于辞职了。

e.en: He looked {resigned} as the verdict was read aloud.
e.zh: 判决宣读时,他看上去一脸认命的样子。

e.en: He shrugged {resignedly} and started cleaning up the mess.
e.zh: 他无奈地耸耸肩,开始收拾这堆烂摊子。

e.en: She nodded {resignedly} when the flight was canceled again.
e.zh: 航班再次取消时,她无奈地点点头。

e.en: He's seriously thinking about {resigning} from his stressful job.
e.zh: 他正认真考虑从压力很大的工作中辞职。

e.en: Two ministers are reportedly {resigning} over the policy dispute.
e.zh: 据报道,两位部长因政策分歧将辞职。

resigns.t: v. 辞职（第三人称单数）

e.en: If the coach {resigns}, the whole season could collapse.
e.zh: 如果教练辞职,整个赛季可能就毁了。

e.en: She {resigns} herself to a long wait at the airport.
e.zh: 她只好认命地在机场长时间等待。

resilience.t:
n. 韧性，恢复力
n. 弹性

e.en: Kids show remarkable {resilience} after stressful events.
e.zh: 孩子们在经历压力事件后表现出惊人的韧性。

e.en: The bridge was designed for {resilience} against earthquakes.
e.zh: 这座桥的设计具备良好的抗震韧性。

e.en: Different communities show different {resiliences} to economic shocks.
e.zh: 不同社区面对经济冲击时表现出不同的韧性。

e.en: Researchers compared the {resiliences} of various ecosystems.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了不同生态系统的恢复力。

e.en: Cloud systems are praised for their {resiliency} during outages.
e.zh: 云系统因故障时的高韧性而备受好评。

e.en: Her emotional {resiliency} helped her through the divorce.
e.zh: 她坚韧的情绪让她挺过了那场离婚。

resilient.t: adj. 有韧性的，能快速恢复的

e.en: Children are surprisingly {resilient} when faced with change.
e.zh: 孩子们在面对变化时表现得出奇地坚韧。

e.en: This fabric is {resilient} and bounces back after stretching.
e.zh: 这种面料弹性很好,拉伸后能恢复原状。

e.en: Pine trees produce a sticky {resin} that smells wonderful.
e.zh: 松树会分泌一种气味芬芳的黏性树脂。

e.en: The artist sealed the painting with a clear {resin}.
e.zh: 艺术家用透明树脂封住了画面。

e.en: The forest air had a sweet, {resinous} smell.
e.zh: 森林里的空气带着甜甜的树脂香气。

e.en: He chewed a piece of {resinous} bark from the pine.
e.zh: 他嚼了一块从松树上掰下来的松脂树皮。

e.en: Natural {resins} have been used for varnishes for centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来,天然树脂一直被用作清漆。

e.en: Modern epoxy {resins} bond almost any two surfaces together.
e.zh: 现代环氧树脂几乎能粘合任意两种表面。

resist.t:
v. 抵抗，抵制
v. 忍住（不做某事）

e.en: I just can't {resist} a good chocolate dessert.
e.zh: 我就是抵挡不住一份美味的巧克力甜点。

e.en: This jacket is designed to {resist} heavy rain.
e.zh: 这件外套的设计可以抵御大雨。

resistance.t:
n. 抵抗，阻力
n. 电阻

e.en: There's a lot of {resistance} to the new tax proposal.
e.zh: 新税收提案遭到了很大的抵制。

e.en: Antibiotic {resistance} is a growing global concern.
e.zh: 抗生素耐药性正成为日益严重的全球问题。

e.en: The circuit has several {resistances} measured in ohms.
e.zh: 该电路有多个以欧姆为单位的电阻值。

e.en: Local {resistances} to the policy emerged in different cities.
e.zh: 对该政策的抵制在不同城市相继出现。

e.en: This phone case is shock and water {resistant}.
e.zh: 这款手机壳具备防震和防水功能。

e.en: He's been {resistant} to any kind of change at work.
e.zh: 他对工作中任何形式的变化都很抗拒。

e.en: She bravely {resisted} the urge to check her phone.
e.zh: 她勇敢地忍住了想看手机的冲动。

e.en: The villagers {resisted} the developer's offer for years.
e.zh: 村民们多年来一直抵制开发商的提议。

e.en: The {resister} refused to comply with the unjust new law.
e.zh: 那位反抗者拒绝服从这条不公正的新法律。

e.en: Every {resister} in the group was eventually arrested.
e.zh: 小组里每一个抵抗者最终都被逮捕了。

e.en: The temptation to check my phone is barely {resistible}.
e.zh: 想看手机的诱惑几乎让人难以抗拒。

e.en: Her charm proved more {resistible} than he expected.
e.zh: 她的魅力比他想象中更容易抵挡。

e.en: He was charged with {resisting} arrest at the protest.
e.zh: 他在抗议中因拒捕被起诉。

e.en: I'm {resisting} the urge to buy another gadget online.
e.zh: 我正忍着不在网上再买一件电子产品。

e.en: The phone uses a {resistive} touchscreen instead of capacitive.
e.zh: 这部手机使用电阻式触摸屏而非电容式。

e.en: Some students remain {resistive} to any change in routine.
e.zh: 有些学生对任何作息改变都持抵触态度。

e.en: Copper has very low electrical {resistivity}, making it ideal for wiring.
e.zh: 铜的电阻率非常低,非常适合做电线。

e.en: Engineers measured the soil's {resistivity} before building the tower.
e.zh: 工程师在建塔前测量了土壤的电阻率。

e.en: Add a 220-ohm {resistor} in series with the LED.
e.zh: 在 LED 上串联一个 220 欧姆的电阻。

e.en: The {resistor} burned out and the circuit stopped working.
e.zh: 电阻烧坏了,电路就停止工作了。

resists.t: v. 抵抗（第三人称单数）

e.en: This jacket {resists} water but isn't fully waterproof.
e.zh: 这件夹克防水,但并非完全防水。

e.en: She always {resists} the urge to reply to trolls online.
e.zh: 她总是忍住不去回复网上的喷子。

e.en: He has to {resit} the math exam next month.
e.zh: 他下个月得重考数学。

e.en: Students who fail can {resit} the test for free.
e.zh: 考试不及格的学生可以免费补考。

resize.t: v. 调整大小（窗口、图片）

e.en: Drag the corner to {resize} the image in the editor.
e.zh: 在编辑器里拖动边角来调整图片大小。

e.en: You can {resize} the browser window to test responsive layouts.
e.zh: 你可以调整浏览器窗口大小来测试响应式布局。

resold.t: v. 转卖（resell 的过去式）

e.en: He bought the sneakers cheap and {resold} them for a profit.
e.zh: 他低价买入这双球鞋后转卖赚了一笔。

e.en: The concert tickets were {resold} for triple the original price.
e.zh: 那批演唱会门票被以三倍原价转卖了。

e.en: She remained {resolute} despite intense pressure from her bosses.
e.zh: 尽管上司施加重压,她依然意志坚定。

e.en: His {resolute} stare told everyone he wouldn't back down.
e.zh: 他坚定的目光告诉所有人他绝不让步。

e.en: He {resolutely} refused to comment on the rumors.
e.zh: 他坚决拒绝对那些传闻发表评论。

e.en: She walked {resolutely} into the boardroom to defend her plan.
e.zh: 她坚定地走进会议室为自己的方案辩护。

e.en: Her {resoluteness} in the negotiation impressed everyone present.
e.zh: 她在谈判中的坚定态度让在场所有人印象深刻。

e.en: The team admired the captain's quiet {resoluteness} under pressure.
e.zh: 队员们敬佩队长在压力下沉静的坚定。

resolution.t:
n. 分辨率（屏幕、图像）
n. 决心；解决

e.en: My New Year's {resolution} is to read more books.
e.zh: 我的新年决心是多读书。

e.en: This monitor supports 4K {resolution} at 120 Hz.
e.zh: 这台显示器支持 4K 分辨率,刷新率 120 赫兹。

e.en: Most New Year {resolutions} are abandoned by February.
e.zh: 大多数新年计划到二月就被放弃了。

e.en: The display supports several {resolutions} up to 4K.
e.zh: 该显示器支持多种分辨率,最高可达 4K。

resolvable.t: adj. 可解决的；可解析的

e.en: The bug turned out to be easily {resolvable} with one config change.
e.zh: 这个 bug 改一处配置就能轻松解决。

e.en: Most domain names are not {resolvable} from inside this network.
e.zh: 大多数域名在这个网络内部都解析不了。

resolve.t:
v. 解决；解析（域名、依赖）
n. 决心

e.en: We need to {resolve} this merge conflict before deploying.
e.zh: 我们得先解决这个合并冲突再部署。

e.en: Her quiet {resolve} got the team through the crisis.
e.zh: 她沉静的决心带着团队挺过了危机。

resolved.t:
v. 已解决（过去式）
adj. 坚决的

e.en: The support team {resolved} my issue within an hour.
e.zh: 客服团队在一小时内解决了我的问题。

e.en: She was {resolved} to finish the marathon no matter what.
e.zh: 无论如何她都决心要跑完这场马拉松。

resolves.t: v. 解决；解析（第三人称单数）

e.en: This patch {resolves} the login bug reported last week.
e.zh: 这个补丁修复了上周报告的登录漏洞。

e.en: The promise {resolves} once the API call completes.
e.zh: API 调用完成后,这个 promise 就会被解决。

resolving.t: v. 解决，解析（现在分词）

e.en: DNS is still {resolving} the domain name, please wait.
e.zh: DNS 还在解析域名,请稍等。

e.en: The team spent all day {resolving} merge conflicts on the branch.
e.zh: 团队花了一整天解决分支上的合并冲突。

e.en: The poem has deep emotional {resonance} for many readers.
e.zh: 这首诗在许多读者心中产生深深的共鸣。

e.en: The bridge collapsed due to mechanical {resonance} from the wind.
e.zh: 那座桥因风引起的机械共振而坍塌。

e.en: The speaker has a deep, {resonant} voice perfect for podcasts.
e.zh: 这位演讲者的声音浑厚而有共鸣,很适合做播客。

e.en: His message felt especially {resonant} to younger listeners.
e.zh: 他的讯息在年轻听众中引起强烈共鸣。

resonate.t: v. 引起共鸣；产生共振

e.en: The themes of the novel {resonate} with anyone who has lost someone.
e.zh: 这本小说的主题能引起所有失去过亲人之人的共鸣。

e.en: Her speech really {resonate}d with the engineering team.
e.zh: 她的演讲真的在工程团队中引起了强烈共鸣。

e.en: His honest apology {resonated} with viewers across the country.
e.zh: 他诚恳的道歉在全国观众中引起了共鸣。

e.en: The song {resonated} long after the concert ended.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后那首歌仍在心中回荡。

resonates.t: v. 产生共鸣（第三人称单数）

e.en: This ad {resonates} strongly with first-time parents.
e.zh: 这则广告在新手父母中引起强烈共鸣。

e.en: The cathedral bell {resonates} across the entire valley.
e.zh: 大教堂的钟声在整个山谷中回荡。

resonating.t: v. 产生共鸣（现在分词）

e.en: The bass was still {resonating} through the floor an hour later.
e.zh: 一小时后,低音还在地板上震动回响。

e.en: Her message is {resonating} with millions of young voters online.
e.zh: 她的讯息正在网上引起数百万年轻选民的共鸣。

e.en: The guitar's wooden {resonator} gives it a warm, rich tone.
e.zh: 这把吉他的木质共鸣箱赋予它温暖而饱满的音色。

e.en: Engineers tuned the {resonator} to filter out unwanted frequencies.
e.zh: 工程师调整了谐振器以滤除不需要的频率。

e.en: Bone {resorption} accelerates after menopause without proper treatment.
e.zh: 如果不加治疗,绝经后骨吸收会加速。

e.en: The dentist warned about possible root {resorption} after the trauma.
e.zh: 牙医警告说外伤后可能出现牙根吸收。

resort.t:
n. 度假胜地
v. 求助于，诉诸

e.en: We spent the weekend at a beach {resort} in Bali.
e.zh: 我们在巴厘岛的一家海滨度假村度过了周末。

e.en: Don't {resort} to shouting when calm words will work.
e.zh: 能心平气和说清楚的事就别动不动就大喊大叫。

resorted.t: v. 诉诸，求助于（resort 的过去式）

e.en: When emails failed, she {resorted} to calling him directly.
e.zh: 邮件没回应,她只好直接打电话给他。

e.en: The team {resorted} to a hotfix to keep the site online.
e.zh: 团队不得不打了个紧急补丁以维持网站运行。

resorting.t: v. 诉诸，求助于（resort 的现在分词）

e.en: He solved the puzzle without {resorting} to the hint button.
e.zh: 他没有借助提示按钮就解开了这个谜题。

e.en: They fixed the leak without {resorting} to expensive plumbers.
e.zh: 他们没请昂贵的水管工就修好了漏水。

resorts.t:
n. 度假胜地
v. 诉诸，求助于

e.en: Many ski {resorts} are closing earlier due to warmer winters.
e.zh: 由于冬季变暖,许多滑雪度假村提早关闭。

e.en: She rarely {resorts} to threats to get her way.
e.zh: 她很少靠威胁来达到目的。

e.en: Cheers {resound} through the stadium after the winning goal.
e.zh: 绝杀进球后,欢呼声响彻整个体育场。

e.en: Let your achievements {resound} louder than your words.
e.zh: 让你的成就比言语更响亮地回响。

e.en: Applause {resounded} through the hall as she finished her speech.
e.zh: 她结束演讲时,掌声响彻整个大厅。

e.en: The thunder {resounded} across the empty valley.
e.zh: 雷声在空旷的山谷中回荡。

resounding.t:
adj. 响亮的；彻底的
v. 回响

e.en: The new app launch was a {resounding} success.
e.zh: 这款新应用的发布取得了巨大成功。

e.en: Voters gave the proposal a {resounding} no.
e.zh: 选民对这项提案给出了响亮的否决。

e.en: The home team won {resoundingly} by twenty points.
e.zh: 主队以二十分的悬殊比分大胜。

e.en: Critics {resoundingly} praised her debut album.
e.zh: 乐评人对她的首张专辑赞不绝口。

e.en: Her laughter {resounds} through the empty hallway.
e.zh: 她的笑声在空荡的走廊里回荡。

e.en: The message {resounds} with anyone who has felt overlooked.
e.zh: 这一讯息在每个曾被忽视的人心中都能引起回响。

e.en: Stack Overflow is a great {resource} for new developers.
e.zh: Stack Overflow 对新手开发者来说是个很棒的资源。

e.en: Water is becoming a scarce {resource} in many regions.
e.zh: 在许多地区,水正变成稀缺资源。

resourced.t: v. 为…提供资源（过去式）

e.en: The project was poorly {resourced} from the very beginning.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始资源就配置不足。

e.en: Well-{resourced} hospitals handled the outbreak much better.
e.zh: 资源充足的医院应对疫情时效果好得多。

resourceful.t: adj. 机智的，足智多谋的

e.en: She's incredibly {resourceful} when it comes to fixing old gadgets.
e.zh: 在修旧电子设备方面,她特别足智多谋。

e.en: You need to be {resourceful} when traveling on a tight budget.
e.zh: 预算紧张地旅行时,你得善于随机应变。

resourcefulness.t: n. 机智，随机应变的能力

e.en: Her {resourcefulness} saved the team during the server outage.
e.zh: 她的机智在服务器宕机时拯救了整个团队。

e.en: Survival shows really test contestants' {resourcefulness}.
e.zh: 野外生存节目真的很考验选手的应变能力。

e.en: The startup ran out of {resources} before launching the product.
e.zh: 这家初创公司还没发布产品就耗尽了资源。

e.en: Our company offers great learning {resources} for new engineers.
e.zh: 我们公司为新工程师提供了很棒的学习资源。

resourcing.t: n./v. 资源调配，提供资源

e.en: Proper {resourcing} is critical for hitting the launch deadline.
e.zh: 合理的资源配置对赶上发布截止日期至关重要。

e.en: The manager is {resourcing} the project with three more engineers.
e.zh: 经理正在为项目再配备三名工程师。

respect.t:
n./v. 尊重，尊敬
n. 方面

e.en: You should always {respect} other people's boundaries online.
e.zh: 你应该始终尊重他人在网络上的边界。

e.en: She earned the {respect} of her teammates through hard work.
e.zh: 她靠努力赢得了队友的尊重。

e.en: The brand has gained {respectability} after years of solid products.
e.zh: 经过多年扎实的产品打磨,这个品牌赢得了好口碑。

e.en: He cared more about {respectability} than actually being honest.
e.zh: 他更在乎体面,而不是真正的诚实。

respectable.t: adj. 体面的，可敬的；相当不错的

e.en: She got a {respectable} score on the entrance exam.
e.zh: 她在入学考试中取得了不错的成绩。

e.en: He runs a small but {respectable} accounting firm downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心经营着一家虽小却受人尊重的会计事务所。

e.en: The indie film performed {respectably} at the box office.
e.zh: 这部独立电影在票房上表现得相当不错。

e.en: He dressed {respectably} for his first court appearance.
e.zh: 他第一次出庭时穿得相当得体。

respected.t:
adj. 受尊敬的
v. 尊重（过去式）

e.en: She is a widely {respected} researcher in machine learning.
e.zh: 她是一位在机器学习领域广受敬重的研究员。

e.en: The new manager {respected} every team member's opinion.
e.zh: 这位新经理尊重每一位团队成员的意见。

respecter.t: n. 尊敬者（常用于 no respecter of）

e.en: The virus is no {respecter} of age or social status.
e.zh: 病毒可不分年龄或社会地位。

e.en: Time is no {respecter} of even the most powerful CEOs.
e.zh: 时间对再强势的 CEO 也毫不留情。

e.en: Please keep the comments {respectful} and on topic.
e.zh: 请保持评论得体且不偏离主题。

e.en: He gave a {respectful} nod to the elderly couple.
e.zh: 他向那对老夫妇恭敬地点了点头。

e.en: She {respectfully} declined the job offer last week.
e.zh: 她上周礼貌地拒绝了那份工作邀请。

e.en: Please {respectfully} disagree without raising your voice.
e.zh: 请在不提高音量的情况下礼貌地表达异议。

respecting.t:
prep. 关于，至于
v. 尊重

e.en: He believes in {respecting} other people's boundaries online.
e.zh: 他认为应该尊重他人在网上的界限。

e.en: The new law has clauses {respecting} data privacy.
e.zh: 新法律包含有关数据隐私的条款。

e.en: The students returned to their {respective} classrooms.
e.zh: 学生们回到了各自的教室。

e.en: Both authors signed copies of their {respective} novels.
e.zh: 两位作者都为各自的小说签了名。

e.en: Anna and Ben scored 90 and 85, {respectively}.
e.zh: 安娜和本分别考了九十分和八十五分。

e.en: The cities host 5 and 3 million people, {respectively}.
e.zh: 这两座城市分别住着五百万和三百万人。

respects.t: n./v. 尊重；方面（复数/三单）

e.en: My boss truly {respects} everyone on the team.
e.zh: 我的老板真心尊重团队里的每一个人。

e.en: In many {respects}, the new design is better.
e.zh: 在许多方面,新设计都更胜一筹。

respirable.t: adj. 可吸入的，适于呼吸的

e.en: Workers wear masks to filter out {respirable} dust particles.
e.zh: 工人戴口罩以过滤可吸入的粉尘颗粒。

e.en: The factory monitors levels of {respirable} silica daily.
e.zh: 工厂每天监测可吸入二氧化硅的浓度。

e.en: The nurse checked his pulse and {respiration} rate.
e.zh: 护士检查了他的脉搏和呼吸频率。

e.en: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis, not {respiration}.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用而非呼吸作用中释放氧气。

e.en: The patient's {respirations} were shallow and rapid.
e.zh: 病人的呼吸又浅又急。

e.en: Nurses count {respirations} to assess lung function.
e.zh: 护士通过数呼吸次数来评估肺功能。

e.en: The firefighter put on a {respirator} before entering.
e.zh: 消防员在进入前戴上了呼吸器。

e.en: Doctors placed the patient on a {respirator} overnight.
e.zh: 医生让病人整夜使用了呼吸机。

respiratory.t: adj. 呼吸的，呼吸系统的

e.en: Smoking can cause serious {respiratory} problems later in life.
e.zh: 吸烟可能在日后引发严重的呼吸系统问题。

e.en: The flu spreads through {respiratory} droplets in the air.
e.zh: 流感通过空气中的呼吸道飞沫传播。

e.en: Fish {respire} by drawing oxygen through their gills.
e.zh: 鱼通过鳃吸取氧气来呼吸。

e.en: All living cells {respire} to produce energy.
e.zh: 所有活细胞都通过呼吸作用产生能量。

e.en: The cool evening offered a welcome {respite} from the heat.
e.zh: 凉爽的夜晚给了人们一段难得的避暑时光。

e.en: Caregivers desperately need a brief {respite} sometimes.
e.zh: 照护者有时迫切需要一段短暂的喘息。

e.en: Short {respites} between meetings help me recharge.
e.zh: 会议之间的短暂休息帮助我重新充电。

e.en: The hike offers occasional {respites} under shady trees.
e.zh: 这条徒步路线偶尔有树荫下的休憩点。

e.en: The bride looked {resplendent} in her silk gown.
e.zh: 新娘穿着丝绸礼服显得光彩照人。

e.en: Autumn leaves were {resplendent} in red and gold.
e.zh: 秋叶呈现出灿烂的红色与金色。

e.en: The peacock strutted {resplendently} across the lawn.
e.zh: 孔雀光彩夺目地在草坪上昂首阔步。

e.en: The hall was {resplendently} decorated for the gala.
e.zh: 大厅为晚会装饰得富丽堂皇。

e.en: Please {respond} to my email by Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 请在周五下午前回复我的邮件。

e.en: How did the audience {respond} to the new show?
e.zh: 观众对这部新剧的反响如何?

e.en: She {responded} quickly to the customer's complaint.
e.zh: 她迅速回应了顾客的投诉。

e.en: The market {responded} positively to the earnings report.
e.zh: 市场对这份财报作出了积极反应。

e.en: Each survey {respondent} answered twenty multiple-choice questions.
e.zh: 每位受访者回答了二十道选择题。

e.en: The {respondent} in the lawsuit denied all allegations.
e.zh: 诉讼中的被告否认了所有指控。

e.en: Most {respondents} said they prefer working from home.
e.zh: 大多数受访者表示更喜欢在家办公。

e.en: Only ten percent of {respondents} owned a car.
e.zh: 只有百分之十的受访者拥有汽车。

e.en: The first {responder} arrived within three minutes.
e.zh: 第一位急救人员在三分钟内赶到。

e.en: She was the top {responder} in our online poll.
e.zh: 她是我们网上投票里反应最积极的参与者。

responding.t: v. 回应，回复（现在分词）

e.en: Thanks for {responding} so quickly to my message.
e.zh: 感谢你这么快回复我的消息。

e.en: The patient is finally {responding} well to treatment.
e.zh: 病人终于对治疗有了良好反应。

e.en: Our chatbot {responds} to questions in under a second.
e.zh: 我们的聊天机器人能在一秒内回答问题。

e.en: He always {responds} calmly under heavy pressure.
e.zh: 他在巨大压力下总能冷静作出回应。

e.en: I'm still waiting for a {response} to my application.
e.zh: 我还在等待我申请的回复。

e.en: Her {response} surprised everyone in the meeting room.
e.zh: 她的回应让会议室里的所有人都感到意外。

e.en: The survey gathered over a thousand thoughtful {responses}.
e.zh: 这次调查收集到了一千多份认真的回复。

e.en: Different cultures show very different emotional {responses}.
e.zh: 不同文化展现出截然不同的情感反应。

e.en: Parenting comes with many new daily {responsibilities}.
e.zh: 为人父母带来许多新的日常责任。

e.en: Her job {responsibilities} include managing the design team.
e.zh: 她的工作职责包括管理设计团队。

e.en: Taking {responsibility} for mistakes builds trust with others.
e.zh: 为错误承担责任能够建立他人对你的信任。

e.en: Cleaning the kitchen is your {responsibility} this week.
e.zh: 这周清洁厨房是你的责任。

responsible.t: adj. 负责的；有责任心的

e.en: Who is {responsible} for closing up the shop tonight?
e.zh: 今晚谁负责关店?

e.en: Heavy rain was {responsible} for the flight delay.
e.zh: 大雨是航班延误的原因。

e.en: Please drink {responsibly} at the company holiday party.
e.zh: 请在公司假日聚会上理性饮酒。

e.en: He manages his finances very {responsibly} every month.
e.zh: 他每个月都非常负责任地管理自己的财务。

responsive.t: adj. 响应的，反应灵敏的；自适应的（界面）

e.en: Our team is highly {responsive} to customer feedback.
e.zh: 我们的团队对客户反馈反应非常迅速。

e.en: The website uses a {responsive} design for mobile.
e.zh: 该网站采用了适配移动端的响应式设计。

e.en: The cafe is {reputed} to serve the best coffee in town.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆据说供应全城最好的咖啡。

e.en: He's a {reputed} expert on ancient Chinese pottery.
e.zh: 他是公认的中国古代陶器专家。

e.en: The old mansion is {reputedly} haunted by a former owner.
e.zh: 据传那座老宅闹鬼,出没的是前任屋主。

e.en: She {reputedly} earns more than the company's CEO.
e.zh: 据说她的收入比公司的首席执行官还高。

reputes.t: v. 认为；视为（repute 第三人称单数）

e.en: The town {reputes} the old bridge to be over five centuries old.
e.zh: 小镇上人们认为那座古桥已有五百多年历史。

e.en: Local lore {reputes} the cave to hide buried treasure.
e.zh: 当地传说这个洞穴里藏有宝藏。

reputing.t: v. 认为；视为（repute 现在分词）

e.en: Critics were {reputing} the film as the year's best release.
e.zh: 评论家们都把这部电影誉为年度最佳。

e.en: Travelers keep {reputing} this island as a hidden paradise.
e.zh: 旅行者们一直把这座小岛誉为隐藏的天堂。

request.t:
n. 请求；申请
v. 请求；要求

e.en: Please {request} a refund through the app's help menu.
e.zh: 请通过应用的帮助菜单申请退款。

e.en: Her {request} for a quiet table was granted immediately.
e.zh: 她想要安静座位的请求立刻得到了满足。

requested.t:
v. 已请求（request 过去式）
adj. 被请求的

e.en: I {requested} an extension and my professor approved it.
e.zh: 我申请延期,教授批准了。

e.en: The driver {requested} directions to the nearest gas station.
e.zh: 司机询问了去最近加油站的路线。

e.en: The system emails the {requester} once the ticket is closed.
e.zh: 工单关闭后系统会发邮件通知申请人。

e.en: Each {requester} must verify their identity before submitting.
e.zh: 每位申请人在提交之前都必须验证身份。

requesting.t: v. 请求中（request 现在分词）

e.en: She is {requesting} a meeting with the principal tomorrow.
e.zh: 她正在请求明天与校长会面。

e.en: Many users are {requesting} a dark mode in the next update.
e.zh: 许多用户正在请求在下次更新中加入深色模式。

requests.t:
n. 请求（复数）
v. 请求（第三人称单数）

e.en: The server handles thousands of {requests} per second.
e.zh: 该服务器每秒处理数千个请求。

e.en: She politely {requests} feedback after every presentation.
e.zh: 她每次演讲后都礼貌地征求反馈。

e.en: The choir performed Mozart's famous {requiem} on Sunday.
e.zh: 周日合唱团演唱了莫扎特著名的安魂曲。

e.en: The film ends with a haunting {requiem} for the lost soldiers.
e.zh: 影片以一首萦绕人心的阵亡将士安魂曲结束。

e.en: Most online accounts {require} a strong password to sign up.
e.zh: 大多数网络账户注册时需要设置强密码。

e.en: This recipe doesn't {require} any special equipment.
e.zh: 这道菜谱不需要任何特殊器具。

required.t:
adj. 必需的；必填的
v. 要求（过去式）

e.en: A valid passport is {required} to board the flight.
e.zh: 登机时必须出示有效护照。

e.en: The job {required} more travel than she had expected.
e.zh: 这份工作的出差需求比她预期的要多。

e.en: A bachelor's degree is the minimum {requirement} for the role.
e.zh: 学士学位是该职位的最低要求。

e.en: Each app has its own storage {requirement} on your phone.
e.zh: 每款应用在你手机上都有各自的存储要求。

e.en: Please review the system {requirements} before installing.
e.zh: 安装前请查看系统要求。

e.en: The course lists prerequisites and graduation {requirements}.
e.zh: 该课程列出了先修条件和毕业要求。

requires.t: v. 需要；要求（第三人称单数）

e.en: This software {requires} at least 8 gigabytes of memory.
e.zh: 这款软件至少需要8GB内存。

e.en: Learning a new language {requires} daily practice.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言需要每天练习。

e.en: The new policy is {requiring} all staff to wear name badges.
e.zh: 新规定要求所有员工佩戴名牌。

e.en: Tasks {requiring} deep focus are best done in the morning.
e.zh: 需要深度专注的任务最好在早上完成。

requisite.t:
adj. 必需的
n. 必需品

e.en: She has all the {requisite} skills for a senior engineer.
e.zh: 她具备担任高级工程师所需的全部技能。

e.en: Filling out the {requisite} forms took nearly an hour.
e.zh: 填写所需的表格花了将近一个小时。

requisition.t:
n. 申领；征用
v. 正式申请

e.en: Submit a purchase {requisition} before ordering new equipment.
e.zh: 在订购新设备前请先提交采购申请单。

e.en: The army issued a {requisition} for additional supplies.
e.zh: 部队发出了征调更多补给的申请。

requisitioning.t: v. 申领；征用（现在分词）

e.en: The hospital is {requisitioning} more masks from the warehouse.
e.zh: 医院正从仓库申请调拨更多口罩。

e.en: Officers were {requisitioning} vehicles for the relief effort.
e.zh: 官员正在征用车辆用于救援工作。

requisitions.t:
n. 申领单（复数）
v. 申领（第三人称单数）

e.en: All supply {requisitions} must be approved by a manager.
e.zh: 所有物资申请单都必须经过主管批准。

e.en: He files several {requisitions} for office supplies each week.
e.zh: 他每周都会提交几份办公用品申请单。

e.en: He offered a small gift in {requital} for her kindness.
e.zh: 他送上一份小礼物以回报她的善意。

e.en: The villain finally received fitting {requital} for his crimes.
e.zh: 反派最终为他的罪行得到了应有的报应。

e.en: He hoped to {requite} her kindness with a thoughtful gift.
e.zh: 他希望用一份贴心的礼物来回报她的善意。

e.en: She could never {requite} the love he had shown her.
e.zh: 她永远无法回报他给予她的爱。

e.en: I had to {reread} the email to understand his point.
e.zh: 我得重新读一遍邮件才明白他的意思。

e.en: She loves to {reread} her favorite novels every winter.
e.zh: 她喜欢每年冬天重读她最爱的小说。

reredo.t: v. 重做（非标准拼写，罕用）

e.en: The carved {reredo} behind the altar dates back to medieval times.
e.zh: 祭坛后那座雕花屏风可追溯到中世纪。

e.en: Tourists admired the gilded {reredo} in the old chapel.
e.zh: 游客们在古老教堂里欣赏着镀金的祭坛屏风。

rerouting.t: v. 改道；重新路由（现在分词）

e.en: The app is {rerouting} traffic around the closed bridge.
e.zh: 应用正在将车流改道,绕开封闭的大桥。

e.en: Heavy rain forced the airline into {rerouting} several flights.
e.zh: 大雨迫使航空公司为多个航班改道。

rerum.t: (罕用) 拉丁词，常见于 rerum novarum 等短语

e.en: The encyclical {Rerum} Novarum addressed workers' rights in 1891.
e.zh: 《新事》通谕于1891年探讨了工人权益问题。

e.en: Scholars often quote the Latin phrase {rerum} in academic essays.
e.zh: 学者们在学术论文中常引用拉丁短语"rerum"。

rerun.t:
n. 重播
v. 重新运行

e.en: Let's watch a {rerun} of that classic sitcom tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们来看那部经典情景喜剧的重播吧。

e.en: The team had to {rerun} the experiment after a power failure.
e.zh: 团队在停电后不得不重新做这个实验。

res.t: n. 事项；事物（法律/拉丁）

e.en: In Latin, {res} simply means "a thing" or "matter."
e.zh: 在拉丁语中,"res"就是"事物"或"事情"的意思。

e.en: The court ruled the case as {res} judicata, barring retrial.
e.zh: 法院将该案判为既判事项,不再重审。

e.en: Toyota cars typically have strong {resale} value.
e.zh: 丰田汽车通常二手转售价值很高。

e.en: She bought the dress at a {resale} shop downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心的二手商店里买了这条连衣裙。

e.en: Can we {reschedule} the meeting to Thursday afternoon?
e.zh: 我们能把会议改到周四下午吗?

e.en: The airline will {reschedule} your flight free of charge.
e.zh: 航空公司会免费为你改签航班。

rescheduling.t:
v. 改期（现在分词）
n. 重新安排

e.en: The doctor's office is {rescheduling} all Monday appointments.
e.zh: 诊所正在重新安排所有周一的预约。

e.en: {Rescheduling} the launch gave the team time to fix bugs.
e.zh: 推迟发布让团队有时间修复漏洞。

e.en: The company decided to {rescind} the job offer last minute.
e.zh: 公司在最后一刻决定撤回那份录用通知。

e.en: Lawmakers voted to {rescind} the controversial regulation.
e.zh: 立法者投票撤销了那项有争议的法规。

e.en: The contract's {rescission} left both parties without obligations.
e.zh: 合同的撤销让双方都无需再承担义务。

e.en: He filed for {rescission} after discovering the seller's fraud.
e.zh: 他在发现卖方欺诈后申请撤销合同。

rescript.t:
v. 重新编写（脚本）
n. 敕令

e.en: The emperor issued a {rescript} clarifying the new tax law.
e.zh: 皇帝颁布了一道敕令,阐明新的税法。

e.en: The director asked the writer to {rescript} the final scene.
e.zh: 导演请编剧重写最后一场戏。

rescue.t:
v. 救援；营救
n. 救援

e.en: Firefighters managed to {rescue} the cat from the burning house.
e.zh: 消防员成功从着火的房子里救出了那只猫。

e.en: The {rescue} team arrived within minutes of the call.
e.zh: 救援队在接到电话后几分钟内就赶到了。

rescued.t:
v. 获救（rescue 过去式）
adj. 被救的

e.en: Volunteers {rescued} dozens of dogs from the flooded shelter.
e.zh: 志愿者们从被淹的收容所救出了几十只狗。

e.en: She {rescued} the project just before the deadline.
e.zh: 她在截止日期前及时挽救了这个项目。

e.en: The hiker hugged his {rescuer} tightly after the long ordeal.
e.zh: 经过漫长的折磨,徒步者紧紧拥抱了救他的人。

e.en: Each {rescuer} received a medal for bravery from the mayor.
e.zh: 每位救援者都从市长那里获得了一枚英勇勋章。

rescues.t:
n. 救援（复数）
v. 救援（第三人称单数）

e.en: The lifeguard performs several {rescues} every summer.
e.zh: 这位救生员每年夏天都会进行多次救援。

e.en: She often {rescues} stray cats from her neighborhood.
e.zh: 她经常救助附近的流浪猫。

e.en: They spent the weekend {rescuing} animals after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后他们花了整个周末救助动物。

e.en: He devoted his career to {rescuing} endangered species.
e.zh: 他把整个职业生涯都奉献给了拯救濒危物种。

e.en: Be sure to {reseal} the bag to keep the chips fresh.
e.zh: 记得把袋子重新封好,这样薯片才能保持新鲜。

e.en: The contractor will {reseal} the driveway next week.
e.zh: 承包商下周会重新给车道做密封处理。

research.t:
n. 研究；调研
v. 研究

e.en: Scientists are conducting {research} on a promising new vaccine.
e.zh: 科学家们正在研究一种很有前景的新疫苗。

e.en: You should {research} the company before your interview.
e.zh: 面试前你应该先调查一下这家公司。

researched.t:
v. 研究（过去式）
adj. 经研究的

e.en: She {researched} every hotel before booking the family vacation.
e.zh: 在预订家庭度假前,她调查了每一家酒店。

e.en: The article is well {researched} and full of useful citations.
e.zh: 这篇文章资料详实,引用丰富。

e.en: The {researcher} published her findings in a top journal.
e.zh: 这位研究员把她的发现发表在了顶级期刊上。

e.en: As a market {researcher}, he analyzes consumer trends daily.
e.zh: 作为市场研究员,他每天分析消费者趋势。

e.en: {Researchers} at MIT discovered a new way to store energy.
e.zh: 麻省理工的研究人员发现了一种储存能量的新方法。

e.en: Several {researchers} have questioned the study's methodology.
e.zh: 多位研究人员对这项研究的方法提出了质疑。

researches.t:
n. 研究（复数）
v. 研究（第三人称单数）

e.en: He carefully {researches} every product before buying online.
e.zh: 他在网购前都会仔细研究每一件商品。

e.en: Her {researches} into ancient pottery have won wide acclaim.
e.zh: 她对古代陶器的研究广受赞誉。

e.en: I'm {researching} graduate programs in computer science.
e.zh: 我正在研究计算机科学的研究生项目。

e.en: The journalist spent months {researching} the corruption case.
e.zh: 这位记者花了几个月调查这起腐败案。

reseat.t: v. 重新安放；重新插拔

e.en: Please {reseat} the cable if your monitor isn't working.
e.zh: 如果显示器不工作,请重新插一下数据线。

e.en: The usher had to {reseat} guests after the mix-up.
e.zh: 出现混乱后,引座员不得不重新安排客人就座。

e.en: Surgeons will {resect} the tumor early next week.
e.zh: 外科医生将于下周初切除该肿瘤。

e.en: The team chose to {resect} part of the damaged liver.
e.zh: 团队决定切除部分受损的肝脏。

resected.t:
v. 切除（过去式）
adj. 已切除的

e.en: The doctor {resected} the inflamed appendix without complications.
e.zh: 医生顺利切除了发炎的阑尾,没有并发症。

e.en: After the tumor was {resected}, she began chemotherapy.
e.zh: 肿瘤切除之后,她开始接受化疗。

e.en: The patient recovered quickly after the bowel {resection}.
e.zh: 患者在肠道切除手术后恢复得很快。

e.en: A lung {resection} is sometimes needed for early-stage cancer.
e.zh: 早期癌症有时需要进行肺部切除手术。

responsively.t: adv. 自适应地（响应式布局）

e.en: The page resizes {responsively} when you rotate your phone.
e.zh: 当你旋转手机时,页面会自适应地调整大小。

e.en: Good leaders act {responsively} during a crisis.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者在危机中能迅速作出回应。

responsiveness.t: n. 响应速度；反应灵敏度

e.en: The app's {responsiveness} improved after the latest update.
e.zh: 这款应用在最新更新后响应速度变快了。

e.en: Customers praised the team's {responsiveness} on social media.
e.zh: 顾客在社交媒体上称赞了团队的响应能力。

rest.t:
v./n. 休息
n. 其余部分

e.en: You should {rest} for a few days after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后你应该休息几天。

e.en: I'll finish the {rest} of the report tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明早把报告剩下的部分写完。

restage.t: v. 重新上演；重新举办

e.en: The director plans to {restage} the play next spring.
e.zh: 导演计划明年春天重新上演这部戏剧。

e.en: Doctors may {restage} the cancer after chemotherapy ends.
e.zh: 医生可能在化疗结束后重新进行癌症分期。

e.en: Try to {restart} your laptop to fix the issue.
e.zh: 试着重启笔记本电脑来解决这个问题。

e.en: The company hopes to {restart} production next month.
e.zh: 公司希望下个月重启生产。

e.en: Could you {restate} the question in simpler words?
e.zh: 你能用更简单的话重新说一下这个问题吗?

e.en: Let me {restate} the main point of my argument.
e.zh: 让我重新表述一下我论点的主要观点。

restated.t:
adj. 经重新表述的
v. restate 的过去式

e.en: The CEO {restated} the company's commitment to safety.
e.zh: 首席执行官重申了公司对安全的承诺。

e.en: She {restated} her position more clearly the second time.
e.zh: 她第二次更清楚地重新表达了自己的立场。

e.en: The speech was a clear {restatement} of party values.
e.zh: 这次演讲是对党的价值观的明确重申。

e.en: The firm issued a {restatement} of last year's earnings.
e.zh: 该公司发布了去年盈利数据的更正声明。

e.en: We tried a new Thai {restaurant} downtown last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚去市中心的一家新泰式餐厅尝鲜。

e.en: This {restaurant} is famous for its handmade pasta.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以手工意面闻名。

e.en: Many small {restaurants} closed during the pandemic.
e.zh: 许多小餐馆在疫情期间倒闭了。

e.en: The neighborhood is full of cozy {restaurants} and cafes.
e.zh: 这个街区到处都是温馨的餐馆和咖啡店。

restaurateur.t: n. 餐厅老板；餐饮业主

e.en: The {restaurateur} opened her third bistro last month.
e.zh: 这位餐厅老板上个月开了她的第三家小酒馆。

e.en: He's a famous {restaurateur} known for innovative menus.
e.zh: 他是位以创新菜单闻名的著名餐饮经营者。

rested.t:
adj. 休息好的
v. rest 的过去式

e.en: After a long nap, she felt completely {rested}.
e.zh: 睡了一个长长的午觉后,她感到完全恢复了精力。

e.en: His hand {rested} gently on the dog's head.
e.zh: 他的手轻轻地搭在狗的头上。

e.en: The doctor monitored him closely for signs of {restenosis}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察他是否有再狭窄的迹象。

e.en: Drug-coated stents help reduce the risk of {restenosis}.
e.zh: 药物涂层支架有助于降低再狭窄的风险。

restful.t: adj. 宁静的；令人放松的

e.en: The cabin by the lake looked very {restful}.
e.zh: 湖边的小木屋看起来非常宁静放松。

e.en: I had a {restful} weekend with no work calls.
e.zh: 我度过了一个没有工作电话的安宁周末。

resting.t:
v. 休息中
adj. 静止的

e.en: The cat is {resting} on the windowsill again.
e.zh: 猫又在窗台上休息了。

e.en: His {resting} heart rate dropped after months of training.
e.zh: 经过几个月的训练,他的静息心率下降了。

e.en: The court ordered him to pay {restitution} to victims.
e.zh: 法庭判他向受害者支付赔偿。

e.en: The museum agreed to make {restitution} of the artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆同意归还这些文物。

restive.t: adj. 烦躁不安的；难驾驭的

e.en: The audience grew {restive} during the long delay.
e.zh: 观众在漫长的延误中变得焦躁不安。

e.en: Children become {restive} when lessons run too long.
e.zh: 课程拖得太长时,孩子们就会坐不住。

e.en: Her {restiveness} during meetings showed she wanted change.
e.zh: 她在会议中的不安表明她渴望改变。

e.en: The horse's {restiveness} warned the rider of danger.
e.zh: 马的躁动向骑手发出了危险的警示。

restless.t: adj. 焦躁的；无法安静的

e.en: She felt {restless} after sitting in the office all day.
e.zh: 在办公室坐了一整天后,她感到坐立不安。

e.en: The baby was {restless} and wouldn't fall asleep.
e.zh: 宝宝烦躁不安,怎么也睡不着。

e.en: He paced {restlessly} while waiting for the test results.
e.zh: 等待检测结果时,他焦躁不安地来回踱步。

e.en: The dog whined {restlessly} near the front door.
e.zh: 狗在前门附近不安地呜咽着。

e.en: Caffeine often causes {restlessness} late at night.
e.zh: 咖啡因常常让人在深夜难以平静。

e.en: Her {restlessness} pushed her to travel solo abroad.
e.zh: 她内心的躁动促使她独自出国旅行。

e.en: The store will {restock} the shelves on Monday morning.
e.zh: 这家商店周一早上会重新上货。

e.en: We need to {restock} our fridge before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来之前我们得把冰箱补满。

e.en: Staff are {restocking} the popular items that sold out quickly.
e.zh: 员工正在补充那些迅速售罄的热门商品。

e.en: The warehouse charges a {restocking} fee for returned electronics.
e.zh: 仓库对退回的电子产品收取一笔补货费。

e.en: The {restoration} of the old church took nearly five years.
e.zh: 这座老教堂的修复工作花了近五年。

e.en: Citizens are demanding the {restoration} of public services.
e.zh: 市民要求恢复公共服务。

restorationist.t: n. 复辟论者；修复主义者

e.en: A skilled {restorationist} carefully cleaned the centuries-old painting.
e.zh: 一位熟练的修复师小心地清理了那幅几百年前的画作。

e.en: The museum hired a {restorationist} to repair the damaged sculpture.
e.zh: 博物馆聘请了一位修复专家来修补受损的雕塑。

e.en: Several historic {restorations} are underway across the old town.
e.zh: 老城区正在进行多项历史建筑修复工程。

e.en: The dentist specializes in tooth {restorations} using modern materials.
e.zh: 这位牙医擅长用现代材料进行牙齿修复。

restorative.t:
adj. 恢复性的
n. 补品

e.en: A long walk in the forest can be deeply {restorative}.
e.zh: 在森林里长时间散步能让人恢复活力。

e.en: The school adopted a {restorative} approach to handling conflicts.
e.zh: 学校采用了恢复性方式来处理冲突。

e.en: Click here to {restore} your account from the latest backup.
e.zh: 点击这里从最新备份恢复你的账户。

e.en: They hope to {restore} public trust in the institution.
e.zh: 他们希望恢复公众对该机构的信任。

restored.t: adj. 已恢复的；修复后的
