e.en: The team {restored} the website after a six-hour outage.
e.zh: 团队在六小时的中断后恢复了网站。

e.en: She bought a beautifully {restored} vintage bicycle online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一辆修复得很漂亮的复古自行车。

e.en: The art {restorer} spent months working on the damaged fresco.
e.zh: 这位艺术修复师花了好几个月修复受损的壁画。

e.en: A professional furniture {restorer} brought the antique chair back to life.
e.zh: 一位专业家具修复师让那把古董椅焕然一新。

restores.t: v. 恢复；还原（第三人称单数）

e.en: This button {restores} the previous version of your document.
e.zh: 这个按钮会恢复你文档的上一个版本。

e.en: A good night's sleep {restores} your energy and focus.
e.zh: 一夜好眠能让你恢复精力和专注力。

e.en: They are {restoring} an old farmhouse into a boutique hotel.
e.zh: 他们正在把一座旧农舍改造修复成精品酒店。

e.en: The app is {restoring} your photos from cloud backup now.
e.zh: 应用正在从云端备份恢复你的照片。

e.en: Security guards had to {restrain} the angry customer.
e.zh: 保安不得不制止那位愤怒的顾客。

e.en: Try to {restrain} yourself from replying when you're upset.
e.zh: 心情糟糕时尽量克制自己别回复消息。

e.en: Her response to the criticism was calm and {restrained}.
e.zh: 她对批评的回应冷静而克制。

e.en: The dog had to be {restrained} during the vet exam.
e.zh: 看兽医检查时那只狗不得不被按住。

e.en: She filed for a {restraining} order against her former neighbor.
e.zh: 她申请了对前邻居的限制令。

e.en: He was {restraining} his laughter during the serious meeting.
e.zh: 开严肃的会议时他在憋着笑。

e.en: The negotiator showed remarkable {restraint} under pressure.
e.zh: 谈判员在压力下表现出了非凡的克制。

e.en: Eat with {restraint} if you want to lose weight gradually.
e.zh: 想慢慢减肥就要节制饮食。

e.en: Budget {restraints} forced the team to cut several features.
e.zh: 预算限制迫使团队砍掉了好几项功能。

e.en: The patient was placed in soft {restraints} for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全起见,病人被用软质约束带固定住。

e.en: You can {restrict} who sees your posts in the privacy settings.
e.zh: 你可以在隐私设置里限制谁能看到你的帖子。

e.en: The doctor told him to {restrict} his salt intake.
e.zh: 医生让他控制盐的摄入量。

e.en: Access to this folder is {restricted} to admins only.
e.zh: 这个文件夹仅限管理员访问。

e.en: The film is {restricted} to viewers over eighteen.
e.zh: 这部电影限十八岁以上观众观看。

restricting.t:
v. 限制中
adj. 限制性的

e.en: The new policy is {restricting} how much data apps can collect.
e.zh: 新政策正在限制应用可收集的数据量。

e.en: He's considering {restricting} his screen time before bed.
e.zh: 他在考虑限制睡前看屏幕的时间。

e.en: There's a height {restriction} for this roller coaster.
e.zh: 这台过山车有身高限制。

e.en: The age {restriction} on the app prevents kids from signing up.
e.zh: 该应用的年龄限制让小孩无法注册。

e.en: Travel {restrictions} were lifted after the outbreak ended.
e.zh: 疫情结束后旅行限制被取消了。

e.en: Read the {restrictions} carefully before booking the discounted ticket.
e.zh: 预订折扣票前请仔细阅读使用限制。

e.en: He found his parents' rules far too {restrictive}.
e.zh: 他觉得父母的规矩管得太严了。

e.en: Some diets are too {restrictive} to follow long term.
e.zh: 有些饮食法限制太多,难以长期坚持。

e.en: The contract was written {restrictively} to limit the company's liability.
e.zh: 合同写得很有限制性,以减少公司的责任。

e.en: Visa rules are applied {restrictively} for citizens of certain countries.
e.zh: 对某些国家的公民,签证规则执行得相当严格。

e.en: The {restrictiveness} of the new law sparked public protests.
e.zh: 新法律的严苛限制引发了公众抗议。

e.en: Critics complained about the {restrictiveness} of the platform's content rules.
e.zh: 批评者抱怨该平台内容规则限制太多。

restricts.t: v. 限制（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {restricts} downloads to users on Wi-Fi networks.
e.zh: 该应用仅允许使用Wi-Fi的用户下载。

e.en: This contract {restricts} him from working for competitors.
e.zh: 这份合同限制他去竞争对手公司工作。

restroom.t: n. 洗手间；公共卫生间

e.en: Excuse me, where's the nearest {restroom}?
e.zh: 打扰一下,最近的洗手间在哪里?

e.en: The {restroom} on the second floor is currently being cleaned.
e.zh: 二楼的洗手间正在清洁中。

e.en: The company plans to {restructure} its sales department next quarter.
e.zh: 公司计划下季度对销售部门进行重组。

e.en: We need to {restructure} this paragraph to make it clearer.
e.zh: 我们得重新组织这一段,让它更清楚。

restructured.t:
adj. 已重组的
v. restructure 过去式

e.en: The startup {restructured} its team after losing key investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在失去关键投资人后重组了团队。

e.en: She {restructured} her essay based on the teacher's feedback.
e.zh: 她根据老师的反馈重新调整了作文结构。

e.en: The company announced a major {restructuring} that affects hundreds of jobs.
e.zh: 公司宣布了一项波及数百个岗位的大规模重组。

e.en: He's {restructuring} his daily routine to make time for exercise.
e.zh: 他正在调整日常作息,以腾出时间锻炼。

rests.t:
v. 休息；搁置
n. 休息；支架

e.en: The decision {rests} entirely with the board of directors.
e.zh: 这项决定完全取决于董事会。

e.en: He {rests} for a few minutes between intense workout sets.
e.zh: 高强度的训练组之间他会休息几分钟。

restyle.t: v. 重新设计造型；改款

e.en: She wants to {restyle} her hair before the wedding.
e.zh: 她想在婚礼前换个发型。

e.en: The designer plans to {restyle} the brand's logo for a fresher look.
e.zh: 设计师打算重新设计品牌标志,让它看起来更新潮。

restyled.t: v. 已改款；重新设计造型（restyle 过去式）

e.en: The car maker {restyled} its flagship model for younger buyers.
e.zh: 这家汽车厂商为年轻买家重新设计了旗舰车型的造型。

e.en: She {restyled} her bedroom in a calming minimalist palette.
e.zh: 她把卧室重新装饰成令人放松的极简色调。

resubmit.t: v. 重新提交（表单、申请）

e.en: Please {resubmit} the form after correcting the date field.
e.zh: 请改正日期栏后重新提交表格。

e.en: He had to {resubmit} his application with additional documents.
e.zh: 他得附上更多材料重新提交申请。

result.t:
n. 结果；成绩
v. 导致，产生

e.en: The {result} of the experiment surprised the entire research team.
e.zh: 实验结果让整个研究团队都很惊讶。

e.en: Skipping breakfast can {result} in low energy by noon.
e.zh: 不吃早餐会导致中午没什么精力。

resultant.t: adj. 作为结果的，随之产生的

e.en: The merger and the {resultant} layoffs shocked employees.
e.zh: 合并以及随之而来的裁员让员工们震惊。

e.en: Heavy rain caused flooding and {resultant} damage to nearby homes.
e.zh: 暴雨造成洪水,并对附近住户带来连带损失。

resulted.t: v. 导致，造成（result 过去式）

e.en: The negotiations {resulted} in a five-year partnership agreement.
e.zh: 这场谈判最终促成了一份五年的合作协议。

e.en: The bug {resulted} from a missing semicolon in the code.
e.zh: 这个bug是代码里漏了一个分号造成的。

resulting.t: adj. 随之而来的，由此产生的

e.en: They reduced the price, {resulting} in a sales spike.
e.zh: 他们降低了价格,带来了销量暴涨。

e.en: Heavy rain and the {resulting} traffic delayed her flight.
e.zh: 暴雨和随之而来的交通堵塞让她的航班延误了。

results.t:
n. 结果，成绩
v. 导致（result 第三人称单数）

e.en: The lab will email your test {results} within two days.
e.zh: 化验室会在两天内把你的检测结果发邮件给你。

e.en: Regular practice usually {results} in noticeable improvement.
e.zh: 经常练习通常会带来明显的进步。

resume.t:
v. 继续；恢复
n. 简历

e.en: Please {resume} the video where we left off yesterday.
e.zh: 请从我们昨天暂停的地方继续播放视频。

e.en: She updated her {resume} before applying for the new role.
e.zh: 申请新职位前她更新了简历。

resumed.t: v. 恢复；继续（resume 过去式）

e.en: Flights {resumed} once the storm finally passed the airport.
e.zh: 风暴终于过境后航班恢复了。

e.en: He {resumed} his morning runs after recovering from the injury.
e.zh: 伤势康复后他重新开始了晨跑。

resumes.t:
v. 恢复，继续
n. 简历（复数）

e.en: The recruiter reviews dozens of {resumes} every single day.
e.zh: 招聘官每天都要看几十份简历。

e.en: The series {resumes} next week with a brand new episode.
e.zh: 这部剧下周回归,会有全新一集。

resuming.t: v. 正在恢复，继续进行

e.en: The team is {resuming} work after a much-needed break.
e.zh: 团队在好好休息了一段后重新开工。

e.en: Train service is {resuming} now that the tracks are clear.
e.zh: 轨道清理完毕后火车开始恢复运营。

e.en: Both sides welcomed the {resumption} of trade talks.
e.zh: 双方对贸易谈判的恢复表示欢迎。

e.en: Fans are excited about the {resumption} of the league next month.
e.zh: 球迷们对联赛下个月恢复感到兴奋。

resupply.t: v./n. 重新补给，补充物资

e.en: A helicopter will {resupply} the climbers stranded on the mountain.
e.zh: 一架直升机会给被困山上的登山者补给物资。

e.en: The base needs a weekly {resupply} of food and water.
e.zh: 基地每周都需要补给食物和水。

resurface.t: v. 重新浮现；重铺路面

e.en: Old photos sometimes {resurface} on social media years later.
e.zh: 老照片有时多年后会在社交媒体上重新出现。

e.en: The city plans to {resurface} the highway this summer.
e.zh: 市政府计划今年夏天重新铺设这条高速公路的路面。

resurfacing.t: v. 重新出现；重铺表面

e.en: Workers are {resurfacing} the parking lot starting next Monday.
e.zh: 工人下周一开始重新铺设停车场路面。

e.en: Old rumors are {resurfacing} now that the trial has begun.
e.zh: 案件开庭后旧传闻又重新冒了出来。

resurge.t: v. 重新兴起，再度高涨

e.en: Vinyl records continue to {resurge} in popularity among young listeners.
e.zh: 黑胶唱片在年轻听众中持续走红。

e.en: Flu cases tend to {resurge} during cold winter months.
e.zh: 流感病例在寒冷的冬季往往会再次激增。

e.en: There has been a strong {resurgence} of interest in board games.
e.zh: 人们对桌游的兴趣再次强势回归。

e.en: Doctors warn of a possible {resurgence} of measles this year.
e.zh: 医生警告今年麻疹可能卷土重来。

e.en: A {resurgent} economy has lifted consumer confidence sharply.
e.zh: 经济复苏强劲,大幅提振了消费者信心。

e.en: The {resurgent} indie music scene is thriving in small clubs.
e.zh: 重新崛起的独立音乐圈在小酒吧里蓬勃发展。

resurrect.t: v. 使复活；重启（旧项目）

e.en: Fans hope the studio will {resurrect} the canceled series.
e.zh: 粉丝们希望制片公司能让这部被砍的剧集复活。

e.en: He tried to {resurrect} an old project from his college days.
e.zh: 他试图重启大学时期的一个旧项目。

resurrected.t: v. 复活；重启（resurrect 过去式）

e.en: The studio {resurrected} the cancelled show after fan protests.
e.zh: 在粉丝抗议之后,工作室让那部被取消的剧集重见天日。

e.en: Christians believe Jesus {resurrected} on the third day.
e.zh: 基督徒相信耶稣在第三天复活。

e.en: Easter celebrates the {resurrection} of Jesus Christ.
e.zh: 复活节是为了纪念耶稣基督的复活。

e.en: The brand's {resurrection} surprised everyone in the industry.
e.zh: 这个品牌的复兴令业内所有人都感到意外。

resurvey.t: v./n. 重新调查，再次勘测

e.en: Engineers had to {resurvey} the land before construction.
e.zh: 工程师必须在施工前重新测量这片土地。

e.en: We will {resurvey} customers after the redesign launches.
e.zh: 新设计上线后我们将再次对顾客进行调研。

e.en: Paramedics tried to {resuscitate} the drowning swimmer.
e.zh: 急救人员试图抢救那位溺水的游泳者。

e.en: The new CEO hopes to {resuscitate} the failing company.
e.zh: 新任首席执行官希望能让濒临倒闭的公司重获生机。

resuscitated.t: v. 使复苏（resuscitate 过去式）

e.en: Doctors {resuscitated} the patient after his heart stopped.
e.zh: 在病人心脏停跳后,医生成功将他抢救过来。

e.en: The marketing campaign {resuscitated} interest in the old brand.
e.zh: 这次营销活动重新唤起了人们对老品牌的兴趣。

resuscitates.t: v. 使复苏，急救（第三人称单数）

e.en: A defibrillator often {resuscitates} patients in cardiac arrest.
e.zh: 除颤器常常能让心脏骤停的病人恢复生命。

e.en: This funding round {resuscitates} the struggling startup.
e.zh: 这轮融资让陷入困境的初创公司起死回生。

e.en: The nurse spent ten minutes {resuscitating} the unconscious child.
e.zh: 护士花了十分钟抢救那个昏迷的孩子。

e.en: They are {resuscitating} the abandoned downtown theater.
e.zh: 他们正在让市中心那座废弃的剧院重焕生机。

e.en: Every lifeguard learns basic {resuscitation} techniques.
e.zh: 每位救生员都要学习基本的心肺复苏技术。

e.en: The economy needs serious {resuscitation} after the recession.
e.zh: 经济在衰退之后需要大力复苏。

e.en: The ER team performed three {resuscitations} during the night shift.
e.zh: 急诊团队在夜班期间进行了三次抢救。

e.en: Successful {resuscitations} depend on quick response times.
e.zh: 成功的抢救取决于快速的反应时间。

resveratrol.t: n. 白藜芦醇（抗氧化成分）

e.en: Red wine contains {resveratrol}, which some claim slows aging.
e.zh: 红酒含有白藜芦醇,有人声称它能延缓衰老。

e.en: Scientists are studying {resveratrol} for its antioxidant effects.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究白藜芦醇的抗氧化功效。

ret.t: v. 沤（麻、亚麻），浸泡软化

e.en: Farmers {ret} flax stalks in water to loosen the fibers.
e.zh: 农民将亚麻茎浸在水中以软化纤维。

e.en: Workers traditionally {ret} hemp for several weeks before processing.
e.zh: 工人通常会先将大麻沤泡数周再加工。

retail.t:
n./v. 零售
adj. 零售的

e.en: The shoes {retail} for about ninety dollars online.
e.zh: 这双鞋在网上的零售价大约九十美元。

e.en: She works in {retail} at a downtown clothing store.
e.zh: 她在市中心一家服装店做零售工作。

e.en: Amazon is the largest online {retailer} in the world.
e.zh: 亚马逊是全球最大的在线零售商。

e.en: The local {retailer} closed after fifty years of business.
e.zh: 那家本地零售店在经营五十年后关门了。

retailers.t: n. 零售商，零售店（复数）

e.en: Many {retailers} offer huge discounts on Black Friday.
e.zh: 许多零售商在黑色星期五推出大幅折扣。

e.en: Small {retailers} struggle to compete with online giants.
e.zh: 小零售商很难与网络巨头竞争。

retailing.t:
n. 零售业
v. 零售

e.en: Online {retailing} has transformed how people shop.
e.zh: 网络零售业已改变了人们的购物方式。

e.en: The handbag is {retailing} for three hundred dollars.
e.zh: 这款手提包零售价为三百美元。

retails.t: v. 零售（第三人称单数）

e.en: This phone {retails} for about a thousand dollars unlocked.
e.zh: 这款无锁手机的零售价约为一千美元。

e.en: The new console {retails} at five hundred dollars.
e.zh: 新款游戏机的零售价是五百美元。

retain.t: v. 保留；留住（用户、人才）

e.en: Companies struggle to {retain} talented employees these days.
e.zh: 如今公司很难留住有才华的员工。

e.en: Try to {retain} the original formatting when copying text.
e.zh: 复制文本时尽量保留原有的格式。

retained.t: v. 保留，留住（retain 过去式）

e.en: She {retained} her composure throughout the difficult interview.
e.zh: 在那场艰难的面试中她始终保持镇定。

e.en: The lawyer was {retained} to handle the divorce case.
e.zh: 那位律师被聘请来处理这起离婚案。

e.en: The law firm charges a monthly {retainer} of two thousand dollars.
e.zh: 律师事务所收取每月两千美元的聘用费。

e.en: She wears a clear {retainer} after her braces came off.
e.zh: 摘掉牙套后她戴着透明的牙齿保持器。

retaining.t:
v. 正在保留
adj. 保持的

e.en: The {retaining} wall prevents the hillside from collapsing.
e.zh: 挡土墙防止山坡发生坍塌。

e.en: The company is focused on {retaining} its top engineers.
e.zh: 公司专注于留住顶尖工程师。

retains.t: v. 保留，留住（第三人称单数）

e.en: The hotel {retains} much of its original 1920s charm.
e.zh: 这家酒店保留了许多1920年代的原有魅力。

e.en: Even after washing, this fabric {retains} its bright color.
e.zh: 即使洗过之后,这种面料仍能保持鲜艳的颜色。

e.en: I need to {retake} the driving test next month.
e.zh: 我下个月得重新参加驾照考试。

e.en: Let's {retake} that group photo with better lighting.
e.zh: 我们用更好的光线重新拍那张合影吧。

retaken.t: v. 重新夺回；重考（retake 过去分词）

e.en: The exam can be {retaken} only once per semester.
e.zh: 这门考试每学期只能补考一次。

e.en: The fortress was {retaken} by allied forces last week.
e.zh: 那座要塞上周被盟军重新夺回。

e.en: The country threatened to {retaliate} against the new tariffs.
e.zh: 该国威胁要对新关税采取报复行动。

e.en: Don't {retaliate} when someone insults you online.
e.zh: 当有人在网上侮辱你时,不要以牙还牙。

e.en: Employees fear {retaliation} for reporting workplace harassment.
e.zh: 员工害怕因举报职场骚扰而遭到报复。

e.en: The airstrike was launched in {retaliation} for the bombing.
e.zh: 这次空袭是对那场爆炸的报复行动。

e.en: China announced {retaliatory} tariffs on American goods.
e.zh: 中国宣布对美国商品征收报复性关税。

e.en: The lawsuit alleges {retaliatory} firing after the complaint.
e.zh: 诉讼指控公司在投诉之后进行了报复性解雇。

retard.t:
v. 延缓，阻碍
n. 减速

e.en: Cold temperatures {retard} the growth of most plants.
e.zh: 寒冷的气温会延缓大多数植物的生长。

e.en: Adding salt can {retard} the freezing process of water.
e.zh: 加盐可以减缓水的结冰过程。

retardant.t:
n. 阻滞剂（如阻燃剂）
adj. 延缓的

e.en: Children's pajamas must be treated with flame {retardant}.
e.zh: 儿童睡衣必须经过阻燃剂处理。

e.en: Firefighters dropped {retardant} from planes onto the wildfire.
e.zh: 消防员从飞机上向野火投放阻燃剂。

e.en: Lead exposure can cause severe developmental {retardation} in children.
e.zh: 接触铅可能导致儿童严重的发育迟缓。

e.en: The chemical causes a noticeable {retardation} of crystal growth.
e.zh: 这种化学物质会明显延缓晶体的生长。

e.en: Let's {retrace} our steps to find the lost keys.
e.zh: 我们沿原路返回找找丢失的钥匙吧。

e.en: The detective tried to {retrace} the suspect's movements that night.
e.zh: 侦探试图重现嫌犯当晚的行踪。

retraced.t: v. retrace 的过去式，追溯；折返

e.en: He carefully {retraced} his route through the dark forest.
e.zh: 他小心地沿原路穿过黑暗的森林。

e.en: The historian {retraced} the explorer's journey across the desert.
e.zh: 那位历史学家重走了探险家穿越沙漠的旅程。

retraces.t: v. retrace 的三单，追溯；折返

e.en: The documentary {retraces} the band's rise to global fame.
e.zh: 这部纪录片回顾了乐队走向全球成名的历程。

e.en: Each morning the postman {retraces} the same delivery route.
e.zh: 每天早晨邮递员都沿着同样的路线送信。

retracing.t: v. retrace 的现在分词，追溯；折返

e.en: She spent hours {retracing} her grandfather's wartime path.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时重走祖父的战时路线。

e.en: The lawyer kept {retracing} the timeline to find inconsistencies.
e.zh: 律师不断重新梳理时间线,以发现矛盾之处。

e.en: The newspaper was forced to {retract} the false story.
e.zh: 那家报纸被迫撤回了那则失实报道。

e.en: Cats can {retract} their claws when they're not needed.
e.zh: 猫在不需要时可以把爪子收回去。

retractable.t: adj. 可收回的；可伸缩的

e.en: The stadium has a {retractable} roof for rainy game days.
e.zh: 这座球场有可伸缩的屋顶,以应对下雨的比赛日。

e.en: He clicked the {retractable} pen nervously during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时他紧张地按着那支按压式圆珠笔。

retracted.t: v. retract 的过去式，收回；缩回

e.en: The journal {retracted} the paper after fraud was discovered.
e.zh: 在发现造假后,期刊撤回了那篇论文。

e.en: He {retracted} his earlier statement and apologized publicly.
e.zh: 他收回了之前的声明并公开道歉。

e.en: The magazine printed a full {retraction} on its front page.
e.zh: 那家杂志在头版刊登了完整的更正声明。

e.en: Scientists demanded a {retraction} of the misleading study.
e.zh: 科学家们要求撤回那项具有误导性的研究。

e.en: The surgeon asked the nurse to hand over the {retractor}.
e.zh: 外科医生让护士递过来牵开器。

e.en: A small {retractor} held the wound open during the operation.
e.zh: 手术中用一只小型牵开器把伤口撑开。

e.en: The company offered to {retrain} workers displaced by automation.
e.zh: 公司提出为因自动化而被取代的员工重新培训。

e.en: You can {retrain} the model on your own dataset.
e.zh: 你可以用自己的数据集重新训练这个模型。

e.en: Government grants support {retraining} for laid-off coal miners.
e.zh: 政府拨款支持下岗煤矿工人接受再培训。

e.en: The team is {retraining} the AI on cleaner data this week.
e.zh: 团队本周正在用更干净的数据重新训练这个AI。

e.en: Cable networks pay broadcasters {retransmission} fees each year.
e.zh: 有线电视网络每年都要向广播公司支付转播费。

e.en: Packet loss triggers automatic {retransmission} in the protocol.
e.zh: 丢包会触发协议中的自动重传机制。

e.en: The router will {retransmit} any packet that fails to arrive.
e.zh: 路由器会重新发送任何未能送达的数据包。

e.en: Local stations {retransmit} the signal to remote villages.
e.zh: 地方电视台把信号转播到偏远村庄。

retread.t:
n. 翻新轮胎
v. 翻新

e.en: This sequel feels like a tired {retread} of the original.
e.zh: 这部续集感觉就是对原作的拙劣翻版。

e.en: Truckers often buy {retread} tires to save money.
e.zh: 卡车司机经常购买翻新轮胎以节省开支。

e.en: The general ordered a swift {retreat} from the burning city.
e.zh: 将军下令从燃烧的城市迅速撤退。

e.en: We're booking a yoga {retreat} in Bali next spring.
e.zh: 我们正在预订明年春天在巴厘岛的瑜伽静修营。

retreating.t: v. retreat 的现在分词，撤退中

e.en: The {retreating} glacier has exposed rocks hidden for centuries.
e.zh: 消退的冰川让隐藏数百年的岩石重见天日。

e.en: Soldiers fired on the {retreating} enemy from the ridge.
e.zh: 士兵们从山脊向撤退的敌人开火。

e.en: The startup hosts quarterly {retreats} to align the whole team.
e.zh: 这家创业公司每季度举办一次集训,让整个团队保持一致。

e.en: Whenever conflict arises, he simply {retreats} into silence.
e.zh: 每当出现冲突,他就干脆退回到沉默之中。

e.en: Many tech firms had to {retrench} after the funding dried up.
e.zh: 在融资枯竭后,许多科技公司不得不缩减开支。

e.en: The bank will {retrench} hundreds of staff next quarter.
e.zh: 该银行下个季度将裁掉数百名员工。

e.en: The recession forced widespread {retrenchment} across the industry.
e.zh: 经济衰退迫使整个行业普遍紧缩。

e.en: Workers protested the company's sudden {retrenchment} policy.
e.zh: 工人们抗议公司突然出台的裁员政策。

e.en: The judge ordered a {retrial} after new evidence emerged.
e.zh: 在出现新证据后,法官下令重审此案。

e.en: His lawyers are pushing for a {retrial} on procedural grounds.
e.zh: 他的律师正以程序问题为由争取重审。

e.en: He swore {retribution} against those who betrayed his family.
e.zh: 他发誓要向背叛他家人的人复仇。

e.en: Whistleblowers often fear {retribution} from their employers.
e.zh: 举报人常常担心遭到雇主的报复。

e.en: The court rejected a purely {retributive} approach to sentencing.
e.zh: 法院拒绝采取纯粹报复性的量刑方式。

e.en: Many people support {retributive} justice for serious crimes.
e.zh: 许多人支持对严重罪行实施报应性司法。

retrievable.t: adj. 可检索的；可挽回的

e.en: Deleted files are still {retrievable} from the recycle bin.
e.zh: 已删除的文件仍可从回收站中恢复。

e.en: All session data is {retrievable} via the admin dashboard.
e.zh: 所有会话数据都可通过管理后台检索到。

e.en: The chatbot uses document {retrieval} to answer questions.
e.zh: 该聊天机器人通过文档检索来回答问题。

e.en: Memory {retrieval} slows down as we age.
e.zh: 随着年龄增长，记忆提取速度会变慢。

e.en: Click here to {retrieve} your forgotten password.
e.zh: 点击这里找回你忘记的密码。

e.en: The dog ran to {retrieve} the tennis ball.
e.zh: 那只狗跑去把网球叼回来。

retrieved.t: v. retrieve 的过去式，已检索；取回

e.en: She {retrieved} the file from cloud backup.
e.zh: 她从云备份中找回了那个文件。

e.en: The diver {retrieved} a rusty key from the lake.
e.zh: 潜水员从湖底捞起一把生锈的钥匙。

e.en: Her golden {retriever} loves swimming in the lake.
e.zh: 她的金毛寻回犬喜欢在湖里游泳。

e.en: The {retriever} component fetches data from the database.
e.zh: 该检索器组件负责从数据库获取数据。

retrieves.t: v. retrieve 的三单，检索；取回

e.en: The app {retrieves} your location every few minutes.
e.zh: 该应用每隔几分钟获取一次你的位置。

e.en: This function {retrieves} user profiles from the API.
e.zh: 这个函数从 API 获取用户资料。

retrieving.t: v. retrieve 的现在分词，检索中

e.en: The system is {retrieving} your order history now.
e.zh: 系统正在为你调取订单历史。

e.en: He spent hours {retrieving} lost photos from the old drive.
e.zh: 他花了几个小时从旧硬盘里恢复丢失的照片。

e.en: She loves {retro} fashion from the eighties.
e.zh: 她喜欢八十年代的复古时尚。

e.en: The cafe has a cool {retro} arcade vibe.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有一种复古街机的氛围。

retroactive.t: adj. 追溯的；有追溯力的

e.en: The pay raise is {retroactive} to January first.
e.zh: 加薪自一月一日起追溯生效。

e.en: Lawmakers debated whether the tax should be {retroactive}.
e.zh: 立法者争论该税是否应当追溯执行。

retroactively.t: adv. 追溯地；有追溯力地

e.en: The new policy applies {retroactively} to last year's claims.
e.zh: 新政策将追溯适用于去年的索赔。

e.en: They {retroactively} approved the overtime hours.
e.zh: 他们追溯批准了那些加班工时。

e.en: The law's {retroactivity} sparked widespread legal challenges.
e.zh: 该法律的追溯效力引发了广泛的法律挑战。

e.en: Judges remain cautious about {retroactivity} in criminal cases.
e.zh: 法官对刑事案件中的追溯适用持谨慎态度。

e.en: They plan to {retrofit} the building with solar panels.
e.zh: 他们计划为这栋建筑加装太阳能板。

e.en: Older cars need a {retrofit} to meet new standards.
e.zh: 旧车需要改装才能符合新标准。

retrofitted.t: v. retrofit 的过去式，已翻新改装

e.en: The factory was {retrofitted} with energy-saving equipment.
e.zh: 这座工厂被改装上了节能设备。

e.en: They {retrofitted} the bus to run on electricity.
e.zh: 他们改装了这辆巴士使其用电运行。

e.en: {Retrofitting} old homes for insulation can cut bills significantly.
e.zh: 为旧房加装保温层能大幅降低账单。

e.en: The city is {retrofitting} bridges to resist earthquakes.
e.zh: 该市正在对桥梁进行抗震改造。

e.en: Critics called the new rules a {retrograde} step.
e.zh: 批评者称新规是一种倒退之举。

e.en: Mercury appears to move in {retrograde} motion sometimes.
e.zh: 水星有时看起来呈逆行运动。

e.en: The report warns of social {retrogression} in rural areas.
e.zh: 报告警告农村地区出现社会倒退。

e.en: Economic {retrogression} followed the long political crisis.
e.zh: 长期的政治危机之后出现了经济倒退。

e.en: Many viewed the law as deeply {retrogressive}.
e.zh: 许多人认为这项法律是严重倒退的。

e.en: Banning the books felt like a {retrogressive} move.
e.zh: 禁这些书的做法令人感觉是一种倒退。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with a {retropharyngeal} abscess.
e.zh: 这名儿童被诊断出咽后脓肿。

e.en: Doctors examined the {retropharyngeal} space using a CT scan.
e.zh: 医生通过CT扫描检查了咽后间隙。

e.en: In {retrospect}, I should have accepted the offer.
e.zh: 现在回想起来，我当初应该接受那份邀约。

e.en: In {retrospect}, the warning signs were obvious.
e.zh: 事后回想，那些警示信号其实很明显。

e.en: Her memoir is full of honest {retrospection}.
e.zh: 她的回忆录充满了真诚的回顾。

e.en: Quiet {retrospection} helps me process difficult years.
e.zh: 静静地回顾能帮我消化那些艰难的岁月。

e.en: His late {retrospections} reveal a softer, wiser man.
e.zh: 他晚年的回顾流露出一个更温和、更睿智的人。

e.en: The book gathers {retrospections} from veteran journalists.
e.zh: 这本书汇集了资深记者们的回顾文章。

retrospective.t:
adj. 回顾的
n. 回顾展

e.en: The museum opened a {retrospective} of her early work.
e.zh: 博物馆为她的早期作品开办了回顾展。

e.en: The team held a {retrospective} after the project shipped.
e.zh: 项目交付后，团队举行了一次复盘会议。

e.en: {Retrospectively}, the decision saved the company millions.
e.zh: 事后看来，那个决定为公司省下了数百万。

e.en: The bonus was applied {retrospectively} to last quarter.
e.zh: 该奖金被追溯发放至上一季度。

retrospects.t: n./v. retrospect 的复数/三单，回顾

e.en: She often {retrospects} on her teaching career with pride.
e.zh: 她常常自豪地回顾自己的教学生涯。

e.en: The author {retrospects} on a turbulent decade abroad.
e.zh: 作者回顾了在国外动荡的十年。

e.en: The clinic offers free {retroviral} testing to residents.
e.zh: 该诊所为居民提供免费的逆转录病毒检测。

e.en: Researchers studied a new {retroviral} therapy for HIV.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了一种治疗艾滋病的新逆转录病毒疗法。

e.en: HIV is the most well-known human {retrovirus}.
e.zh: 艾滋病毒是最为人熟知的人类逆转录病毒。

e.en: The lab studies how a {retrovirus} integrates into DNA.
e.zh: 实验室研究逆转录病毒如何整合进入DNA。

e.en: Click {retry} if the upload fails the first time.
e.zh: 如果首次上传失败，请点击重试。

e.en: The script will {retry} the request after a short delay.
e.zh: 脚本会在短暂延迟后重试该请求。

retune.t: v. 重新调谐；重新调校

e.en: You may need to {retune} the guitar before playing.
e.zh: 演奏前你可能需要重新调音吉他。

e.en: The mechanic will {retune} the engine for better mileage.
e.zh: 机械师会重新调校引擎以提升油耗表现。

retarded.t:
adj. 智力迟缓的（含冒犯，慎用）
v. 延迟（retard 的过去式）

e.en: The cold weather {retarded} the ripening of the fruit.
e.zh: 寒冷的天气延迟了水果的成熟。

e.en: Heavy rain {retarded} the construction project by two weeks.
e.zh: 大雨使建筑项目延误了两周。

retarding.t: v. 延缓、阻滞（retard 的现在分词）

e.en: The thick coating is {retarding} the corrosion of the pipes.
e.zh: 这层厚涂层正在减缓管道的腐蚀。

e.en: Excessive regulation is {retarding} innovation in the sector.
e.zh: 过度的监管正在阻碍该行业的创新。

retards.t:
v. 延缓、阻滞
n. 智障者（冒犯用语）

e.en: Refrigeration {retards} the spoilage of fresh food.
e.zh: 冷藏可以延缓新鲜食品的变质。

e.en: This additive {retards} the hardening of the concrete.
e.zh: 这种添加剂能延缓混凝土的硬化。

retarget.t: v. 重新定位目标（广告、营销中常用）

e.en: We can {retarget} ads to users who abandoned their carts.
e.zh: 我们可以重新向放弃购物车的用户投放广告。

e.en: The missile system can {retarget} within seconds.
e.zh: 该导弹系统可以在几秒内重新锁定目标。

e.en: The smell of rotten fish made him {retch} immediately.
e.zh: 腐烂鱼的气味让他立刻干呕起来。

e.en: Pregnant women often {retch} at certain food smells.
e.zh: 孕妇常常会对某些食物的气味感到反胃。

retching.t: v. 干呕（retch 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the morning {retching} over the toilet.
e.zh: 她整个早上都在马桶边干呕。

e.en: The patient kept {retching} after taking the medication.
e.zh: 病人服药后一直干呕。

retd.t: adj. retired 的缩写，已退休

e.en: The card listed his title as Colonel {retd}.
e.zh: 名片上他的头衔是退役上校。

e.en: Major Thompson, {retd}, gave a speech at the ceremony.
e.zh: 退役少校汤普森在仪式上发表了讲话。

e.en: Grandparents love to {retell} stories from their childhood.
e.zh: 祖父母喜欢反复讲述他们童年的故事。

e.en: The film is a modern {retell} of the classic fairy tale.
e.zh: 这部电影是对经典童话的现代演绎。

e.en: Her novel is a feminist {retelling} of Greek mythology.
e.zh: 她的小说是对希腊神话的女性主义重述。

e.en: He kept {retelling} the same joke at every party.
e.zh: 他在每次聚会上都重复讲同一个笑话。

retells.t: v. 复述（retell 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The documentary {retells} the story from the survivors' perspective.
e.zh: 这部纪录片从幸存者的角度重新讲述了这个故事。

e.en: Each generation {retells} the legend in its own way.
e.zh: 每一代人都以自己的方式重新讲述这个传说。

retention.t: n. 留存率、保持（用户留存）

e.en: The app focuses on improving user {retention} after signup.
e.zh: 这款应用专注于提升用户注册后的留存率。

e.en: Drinking less salt reduces water {retention} in the body.
e.zh: 减少盐分摄入可以降低身体的水分滞留。

e.en: The contract specifies several {retentions} from the final payment.
e.zh: 合同规定从尾款中扣留几笔保留金。

e.en: Quarterly customer {retentions} have improved across all regions.
e.zh: 各地区的季度客户留存率都有所提升。

retentive.t: adj. 记忆力强的、有保持力的

e.en: Her {retentive} memory helps her ace every exam.
e.zh: 她超强的记忆力让她每次考试都拿高分。

e.en: Clay soil is more {retentive} of moisture than sand.
e.zh: 黏土比沙土更能保持水分。

e.en: Engineers must {retest} the software after each update.
e.zh: 工程师必须在每次更新后重新测试软件。

e.en: The doctor wants to {retest} my blood next week.
e.zh: 医生想下周再给我做一次血液检测。

e.en: The lab is {retesting} the samples for accuracy.
e.zh: 实验室正在对样本进行复检以确保准确性。

e.en: Automated {retesting} catches regressions before deployment.
e.zh: 自动化回归测试能在部署前发现问题。

e.en: We need to {rethink} our marketing strategy for next year.
e.zh: 我们需要重新思考明年的营销策略。

e.en: The pandemic forced everyone to {rethink} how they work.
e.zh: 疫情迫使每个人重新思考工作方式。

e.en: The company is {rethinking} its remote work policy.
e.zh: 公司正在重新考虑其远程办公政策。

e.en: Cities are {rethinking} urban design after the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情过后,各城市正在重新思考城市设计。

rethought.t: v. rethink 的过去式和过去分词

e.en: After the feedback, she {rethought} her entire approach.
e.zh: 在收到反馈后,她重新考虑了整个思路。

e.en: The team {rethought} the design from scratch.
e.zh: 团队从头开始重新构思了这个设计。

e.en: His {reticence} during the interview puzzled the hiring manager.
e.zh: 他在面试中的沉默寡言让招聘经理感到困惑。

e.en: The witness's {reticence} frustrated the prosecuting attorney.
e.zh: 证人的沉默令起诉律师十分沮丧。

reticent.t: adj. 沉默寡言的、不愿多说的

e.en: He was {reticent} about discussing his personal life publicly.
e.zh: 他不愿在公开场合谈论自己的私生活。

e.en: Investors are {reticent} to fund the risky startup.
e.zh: 投资者对资助这家高风险的初创公司持谨慎态度。

reticle.t: n. 瞄准镜中的十字分划线

e.en: Center the {reticle} on the target before pulling the trigger.
e.zh: 扣动扳机前先将十字准线对准目标。

e.en: The scope's {reticle} glowed red in low light.
e.zh: 瞄准镜的十字线在弱光下发出红光。

e.en: The brain's {reticular} formation controls sleep and arousal.
e.zh: 大脑的网状结构控制睡眠与觉醒。

e.en: Scientists studied the {reticular} pattern of veins on the leaf.
e.zh: 科学家研究了叶片上的网状叶脉。

e.en: The {reticulated} python is one of the world's longest snakes.
e.zh: 网纹蟒是世界上最长的蛇之一。

e.en: The artist drew a {reticulated} pattern across the entire canvas.
e.zh: 艺术家在整张画布上画了网格状图案。

e.en: The fine {reticulation} on the porcelain glaze is highly prized.
e.zh: 瓷器釉面上细密的开片纹路极受追捧。

e.en: Engineers studied the {reticulation} of pipes under the city.
e.zh: 工程师研究了城市地下的管网分布。

reticule.t:
n. 女用手提包（旧式）
n. 十字线（=reticle）

e.en: She carried a small beaded {reticule} to the ball.
e.zh: 她带着一个小巧的串珠手袋去参加舞会。

e.en: The Victorian {reticule} held only a handkerchief and coins.
e.zh: 那个维多利亚时代的手提袋里只装着手帕和硬币。

reticulum.t: n. 网状组织（生物、解剖）

e.en: The endoplasmic {reticulum} folds proteins inside every cell.
e.zh: 内质网在每个细胞内折叠蛋白质。

e.en: Cows digest grass partly in the {reticulum} of their stomach.
e.zh: 牛部分依靠胃中的网胃来消化青草。

retina.t: n. 视网膜（也指苹果的 Retina 屏幕）

e.en: Bright sunlight can damage the {retina} permanently.
e.zh: 强烈的阳光会对视网膜造成永久性损伤。

e.en: The doctor scanned her {retina} to confirm her identity.
e.zh: 医生扫描她的视网膜来确认身份。

retinal.t:
adj. 视网膜的
n. 视黄醛

e.en: Diabetes is a major cause of {retinal} disease worldwide.
e.zh: 糖尿病是全球视网膜疾病的主要诱因。

e.en: He underwent surgery to repair a torn {retinal} layer.
e.zh: 他接受了修复视网膜撕裂层的手术。

e.en: The bright flash left spots floating across both {retinas}.
e.zh: 那道强光在两只眼睛的视网膜上留下了光斑。

e.en: Cats' {retinas} reflect light, making their eyes glow at night.
e.zh: 猫的视网膜会反光,让它们的眼睛在夜里发亮。

e.en: {Retinitis} pigmentosa gradually narrows the patient's field of vision.
e.zh: 视网膜色素变性会逐渐缩小患者的视野。

e.en: The clinic specializes in treating {retinitis} and other eye disorders.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗视网膜炎和其他眼疾。

retinoic.t: adj. 视黄酸的（retinoic acid 视黄酸）

e.en: Doctors prescribe {retinoic} acid to clear severe acne.
e.zh: 医生开维A酸来治疗严重的痤疮。

e.en: {Retinoic} acid plays a key role in embryo development.
e.zh: 维甲酸在胚胎发育中起着关键作用。

retinoid.t: n. 类视黄醇（护肤、药用成分）

e.en: She added a {retinoid} cream to her nightly skincare routine.
e.zh: 她在夜间护肤流程中加入了一款维A酸面霜。

e.en: Dermatologists often recommend a {retinoid} for anti-aging treatment.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生常推荐维A类药物用于抗衰老。

retinol.t: n. 视黄醇、维生素 A（护肤常见）

e.en: This serum contains {retinol} to reduce fine lines overnight.
e.zh: 这款精华含有视黄醇,可以一夜淡化细纹。

e.en: Beginners should start with low-strength {retinol} to avoid irritation.
e.zh: 新手应从低浓度的视黄醇开始,以免刺激皮肤。

e.en: Diabetic {retinopathy} is a leading cause of blindness in adults.
e.zh: 糖尿病视网膜病变是成人失明的主要原因之一。

e.en: Regular eye exams can catch {retinopathy} before vision loss begins.
e.zh: 定期眼科检查可在视力下降前发现视网膜病变。

e.en: The queen arrived with a {retinue} of advisors and guards.
e.zh: 女王带着一队顾问和卫兵抵达。

e.en: The pop star travels everywhere with a small {retinue}.
e.zh: 那位流行歌手走到哪里都带着一小群随行人员。

retiral.t: n. 退休（印度/苏格兰英语）

e.en: He received a generous {retiral} package after thirty years of service.
e.zh: 在服务三十年后,他获得了一笔丰厚的退休金。

e.en: The company hosted a dinner to mark his {retiral}.
e.zh: 公司举办晚宴以纪念他的退休。

retire.t:
v. 退休、退役
v. 退出、就寝

e.en: Many engineers hope to {retire} before they turn sixty.
e.zh: 许多工程师希望在六十岁之前退休。

e.en: The exhausted hikers decided to {retire} to their tents early.
e.zh: 疲惫的徒步者决定早早回帐篷休息。

retired.t:
adj. 已退休的
v. retire 的过去式

e.en: My uncle {retired} last year and now travels constantly.
e.zh: 我叔叔去年退休了,现在到处旅行。

e.en: The {retired} general still gives lectures at the academy.
e.zh: 那位退役将军仍在军校讲课。

e.en: The cruise ship was full of cheerful American {retiree} couples.
e.zh: 邮轮上满是兴致勃勃的美国退休夫妇。

e.en: Each {retiree} receives a monthly pension from the company.
e.zh: 每位退休员工每月都能领到公司发的养老金。

e.en: She is saving aggressively for an early {retirement}.
e.zh: 她正在积极攒钱以便提前退休。

e.en: His sudden {retirement} from football shocked the fans.
e.zh: 他突然从足坛退役让球迷们震惊。

e.en: A wave of {retirements} has left the hospital short-staffed.
e.zh: 一波退休潮让医院人手严重不足。

e.en: The team announced two {retirements} at the end of the season.
e.zh: 球队在赛季末宣布了两位球员退役。

retires.t: v. 退休（第三人称单数）

e.en: When the CEO {retires} next year, his deputy takes over.
e.zh: 明年首席执行官退休时,副手将接任。

e.en: She usually {retires} to bed by ten on weeknights.
e.zh: 工作日晚上她通常十点就上床睡觉。

retiring.t:
adj. 内向害羞的
v. 退休中

e.en: The {retiring} principal gave a moving farewell speech.
e.zh: 即将退休的校长发表了感人的告别演说。

e.en: He's a quiet, {retiring} man who avoids the spotlight.
e.zh: 他是个安静内敛、不愿出风头的人。

retold.t: v. retell 的过去式和过去分词

e.en: Grandma {retold} the same story every Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 奶奶每年圣诞夜都会重复讲那个故事。

e.en: The novel is a classic fairy tale {retold} for adults.
e.zh: 这本小说是为成年人重写的经典童话。

retook.t: v. retake 的过去式，重新拿回、重考

e.en: She {retook} the driving test and finally passed.
e.zh: 她重考了驾照,终于通过了。

e.en: Government forces {retook} the city after weeks of fighting.
e.zh: 政府军经过数周战斗后重新夺回了那座城市。

retool.t: v. 重新配置、改造升级

e.en: The factory had to {retool} to produce electric vehicles.
e.zh: 这家工厂不得不重新改造设备以生产电动汽车。

e.en: We need to {retool} our marketing strategy for younger users.
e.zh: 我们需要为年轻用户重新调整营销策略。

retooled.t: v. 重新配置（retool 的过去式）

e.en: The startup {retooled} its app after disappointing user feedback.
e.zh: 创业公司在收到不佳的用户反馈后重新改造了应用。

e.en: Detroit plants were {retooled} to build tanks during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间,底特律的工厂被改造用于制造坦克。

retooling.t: n./v. 重新配置、改造升级

e.en: The company is {retooling} its entire production line this summer.
e.zh: 公司今年夏天正在改造整条生产线。

e.en: Mid-career workers face the challenge of {retooling} their skills.
e.zh: 中年职场人面临重新打磨技能的挑战。

e.en: She had a witty {retort} ready for every insult.
e.zh: 对每句侮辱,她都准备好了机智的回应。

e.en: "Mind your own business," was his sharp {retort}.
e.zh: “管好你自己的事”是他尖锐的回击。

e.en: Photographers often {retouch} portraits to smooth out skin tones.
e.zh: 摄影师经常对肖像进行修图以使肤色更均匀。

e.en: He asked the painter to {retouch} a few faded spots.
e.zh: 他请画家把几处褪色的地方补一下色。

return.t:
v. 返回；归还
n. 回报；收益

e.en: Please {return} the book by next Friday.
e.zh: 请在下周五之前归还这本书。

e.en: This function should {return} a list of users.
e.zh: 这个函数应当返回一个用户列表。

returnable.t: adj. 可退还的；可归还的

e.en: Sale items are not {returnable} after seven days.
e.zh: 特价商品在七天后不可退货。

e.en: The bottles are {returnable} for a small deposit.
e.zh: 这些瓶子可凭少量押金退还。

returned.t: adj. 已归还的；已返回的

e.en: She {returned} the dress because it didn't fit.
e.zh: 她把那条裙子退掉了，因为不合身。

e.en: The API {returned} an unexpected error code.
e.zh: 该接口返回了一个意外的错误码。

e.en: The startup was founded by a {returnee} from Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 这家创业公司由一位硅谷归国者创办。

e.en: Each {returnee} received help finding a new job.
e.zh: 每位归国者都获得了找工作的帮助。

returner.t: n. 重返岗位的人；回归者

e.en: The gym offers discounts for first-time {returner} members.
e.zh: 健身房为首次回归的会员提供折扣。

e.en: He's the best kick {returner} in the league this season.
e.zh: 他是本赛季联盟中最出色的接踢球手。

e.en: She is {returning} home after five years abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外待了五年之后即将回家。

e.en: The function is {returning} the wrong data type.
e.zh: 这个函数返回的数据类型不对。

returns.t:
n. 收益；回报
v. 返回（return 的第三人称）

e.en: The store accepts {returns} within thirty days.
e.zh: 该店在三十天内接受退货。

e.en: This investment {returns} about six percent annually.
e.zh: 这笔投资每年回报约百分之六。

e.en: Please {retype} your password to confirm the change.
e.zh: 请再次输入密码以确认更改。

e.en: I had to {retype} the whole essay after the crash.
e.zh: 系统崩溃后，我只好把整篇文章重新打了一遍。

reuben.t: n. 鲁本三明治（一种牛肉三明治）

e.en: I ordered a {reuben} sandwich with extra sauerkraut.
e.zh: 我点了一份额外加酸菜的鲁本三明治。

e.en: This deli makes the best {reuben} in town.
e.zh: 这家熟食店做的鲁本三明治是城里最好的。

e.en: German {reunification} happened in 1990.
e.zh: 德国统一发生在1990年。

e.en: The family celebrated their long-awaited {reunification}.
e.zh: 这家人庆祝了他们盼望已久的团聚。

e.en: History shows that national {reunifications} are rarely smooth.
e.zh: 历史表明，国家的重新统一很少一帆风顺。

e.en: The charity arranges {reunifications} for refugee families.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为难民家庭安排团聚。

e.en: Germany was {reunified} after the Berlin Wall fell.
e.zh: 柏林墙倒塌后，德国实现了统一。

e.en: The siblings were finally {reunified} after twenty years.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹们在二十年后终于团聚了。

reunifies.t: v. 重新统一（第三人称单数）

e.en: The ending {reunifies} the long-separated family.
e.zh: 结局让长期分离的一家人重新团聚。

e.en: The treaty {reunifies} the divided territories under one flag.
e.zh: 该条约将分裂的领土重新统一在一面旗帜下。

e.en: Leaders met to discuss how to {reunify} the country.
e.zh: 领导人会面讨论如何让国家重新统一。

e.en: The agency works to {reunify} children with their parents.
e.zh: 该机构致力于让儿童与父母团聚。

e.en: {Reunifying} the country took decades of negotiation.
e.zh: 让国家重新统一花费了数十年的谈判。

e.en: They are {reunifying} the two divisions into one team.
e.zh: 他们正在把两个部门合并成一个团队。

e.en: Our class is planning a ten-year {reunion} this fall.
e.zh: 我们班正在筹备今年秋天的十年同学会。

e.en: The family {reunion} brought everyone home for the holidays.
e.zh: 这次家庭团聚让大家都回家过节了。

e.en: High school {reunions} can be both fun and awkward.
e.zh: 高中同学聚会既好玩又有点尴尬。

e.en: The hotel hosts wedding {reunions} every weekend.
e.zh: 这家酒店每周末都举办婚礼聚会。

e.en: The band will {reunite} for a world tour next year.
e.zh: 乐队明年将重组进行世界巡演。

e.en: Volunteers helped {reunite} lost pets with their owners.
e.zh: 志愿者帮助走失的宠物与主人团聚。

e.en: She was {reunited} with her brother after thirty years.
e.zh: 她在三十年后与哥哥重逢。

e.en: The kitten was {reunited} with its worried owner.
e.zh: 小猫终于回到了焦急的主人身边。

reuptake.t: n. 再摄取（神经递质回收）

e.en: This antidepressant blocks serotonin {reuptake} in the brain.
e.zh: 这种抗抑郁药能阻断大脑中血清素的再摄取。

e.en: Drugs that affect dopamine {reuptake} can alter mood.
e.zh: 影响多巴胺再摄取的药物可能会改变情绪。

reusable.t: adj. 可重复使用的；可复用的

e.en: I always carry a {reusable} water bottle to work.
e.zh: 我上班总是带着可重复使用的水杯。

e.en: They built a library of {reusable} React components.
e.zh: 他们搭建了一个可复用的 React 组件库。

reuse.t:
v. 重复使用
n. 再利用

e.en: Please {reuse} the shopping bag instead of throwing it away.
e.zh: 请重复使用购物袋，不要扔掉。

e.en: The app lets you {reuse} old photos in new albums.
e.zh: 这款应用让你能在新相册里再次使用旧照片。

reuter.t: n. 路透（姓氏，路透社创始人）

e.en: Paul {Reuter} founded one of the world's first news agencies.
e.zh: 保罗·路透创办了世界上最早的通讯社之一。

e.en: The biography traces how {Reuter} built his telegraph empire.
e.zh: 这本传记讲述了路透如何建立他的电报帝国。

reuters.t: n. 路透社（国际新闻机构）

e.en: According to {Reuters}, the central bank will raise rates next month.
e.zh: 据路透社报道，央行下月将加息。

e.en: She works as a foreign correspondent for {Reuters} in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她在东京担任路透社驻外记者。

rev.t:
n. 转速（每分钟）
v. 加大油门

e.en: Don't {rev} the engine while the car is parked.
e.zh: 车停着的时候别猛踩油门轰引擎。

e.en: The driver gave the motorcycle a quick {rev} before taking off.
e.zh: 司机在出发前快速轰了一下摩托车油门。

revaluation.t: n. 重新估值；货币升值

e.en: The currency {revaluation} made imports much cheaper overnight.
e.zh: 货币重估让进口商品一夜之间便宜了许多。

e.en: Property owners are bracing for the upcoming tax {revaluation}.
e.zh: 房产业主正在为即将到来的税收重估做准备。

revalue.t: v. 重新评估价值；使升值

e.en: The government may {revalue} the yuan to ease trade tensions.
e.zh: 政府可能会重新评估人民币汇率以缓解贸易紧张。

e.en: Banks plan to {revalue} their real estate assets this quarter.
e.zh: 银行计划在本季度重新评估其房地产资产。

revamp.t:
v. 翻新；改造
n. 翻新改造

e.en: The team plans to {revamp} the website next month.
e.zh: 团队计划下个月改版网站。

e.en: Management wants to {revamp} the entire onboarding process.
e.zh: 管理层想全面改造整个入职流程。

e.en: Apple just {revamped} its iPad lineup with faster chips.
e.zh: 苹果刚刚用更快的芯片改版了 iPad 产品线。

e.en: The {revamped} cafe attracts a much younger crowd now.
e.zh: 这家改造后的咖啡馆现在吸引了更年轻的顾客。

e.en: The studio is {revamping} its streaming platform from scratch.
e.zh: 该工作室正在从头重新打造其流媒体平台。

e.en: They are {revamping} the kitchen before putting the house on sale.
e.zh: 他们在卖房前正在翻新厨房。

e.en: Analysts warn of {revanchist} rhetoric coming from neighboring states.
e.zh: 分析人士警告邻国正在发出复仇主义的言论。

e.en: The party's {revanchist} platform calls for reclaiming lost territory.
e.zh: 该党的复仇主义纲领呼吁收回失去的领土。

e.en: The invitation was addressed to the {Revd} James Carter.
e.zh: 邀请函寄给了詹姆斯·卡特牧师。

e.en: {Revd} Patel will lead Sunday's morning service.
e.zh: 帕特尔牧师将主持周日的晨间礼拜。

e.en: The trailer doesn't {reveal} any major plot twists.
e.zh: 预告片没有透露任何重要的剧情转折。

e.en: Tomorrow's keynote will {reveal} the next iPhone model.
e.zh: 明天的主题演讲将公布下一代 iPhone 机型。

revealed.t: v. 被揭示（过去式/分词）

e.en: The CEO {revealed} layoffs in this morning's email.
e.zh: 首席执行官在今早的邮件中宣布了裁员消息。

e.en: Pulling back the curtain {revealed} a stunning ocean view.
e.zh: 拉开窗帘露出了令人惊叹的海景。

revealing.t: adj. 揭露真相的；暴露的

e.en: Her interview was surprisingly {revealing} about life backstage.
e.zh: 她的采访意外地揭露了许多幕后生活。

e.en: He wore a {revealing} outfit to the beach party.
e.zh: 他穿了一件比较暴露的衣服去海滩派对。

e.en: {Revealingly}, the CEO refused to answer any questions about layoffs.
e.zh: 耐人寻味的是，首席执行官拒绝回答任何裁员问题。

e.en: She smiled {revealingly} when asked about the new project.
e.zh: 被问到新项目时，她意味深长地笑了。

reveals.t: v. 揭示（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new study {reveals} that exercise improves memory.
e.zh: 新研究显示锻炼能改善记忆力。

e.en: Each episode {reveals} another piece of the mystery.
e.zh: 每一集都揭示出谜团的另一片碎片。

e.en: The bugler sounded {reveille} at six sharp every morning.
e.zh: 号手每天清晨六点准时吹响起床号。

e.en: Soldiers grumbled when {reveille} came earlier than expected.
e.zh: 起床号比预想的来得早，士兵们抱怨连连。

revel.t:
v. 狂欢；陶醉于
n. 狂欢作乐

e.en: Fans {revel} in every behind-the-scenes detail of the show.
e.zh: 粉丝们沉醉于这档节目的每一个幕后细节。

e.en: She seems to {revel} in stirring up controversy online.
e.zh: 她似乎乐于在网上挑起争议。

e.en: The documentary's biggest {revelation} shocked everyone in the room.
e.zh: 这部纪录片最大的爆料震惊了在场所有人。

e.en: Trying sushi for the first time was a real {revelation}.
e.zh: 第一次尝试寿司真是让人大开眼界。

e.en: Her memoir offers {revelational} insights into early Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 她的回忆录揭示了早期硅谷不为人知的内幕。

e.en: The lecture had a {revelational} effect on the young researcher.
e.zh: 那场讲座对这位年轻研究员产生了启示性的影响。

revelations.t: n. 揭露；惊人内幕（复数）

e.en: Recent {revelations} about the scandal have rocked the company.
e.zh: 最近关于这桩丑闻的爆料震动了整家公司。

e.en: Her diary contained shocking {revelations} about the family.
e.zh: 她的日记里有关于这个家族的惊人内幕。

revelatory.t: adj. 揭示的；富有启发性的

e.en: The interview was {revelatory} about how the algorithm actually works.
e.zh: 这次采访揭示了该算法的实际运作方式。

e.en: Reading her letters was a {revelatory} experience for historians.
e.zh: 对历史学家来说，阅读她的信件是一次启示性的经历。

reveler.t: n. 狂欢者；寻欢作乐者

e.en: One {reveler} climbed the lamppost during the New Year's countdown.
e.zh: 跨年倒计时时，有个狂欢者爬上了路灯柱。

e.en: A late-night {reveler} stumbled out of the karaoke bar.
e.zh: 一位深夜狂欢的人摇摇晃晃地走出了卡拉 OK 酒吧。

revell.t: n. 雷维尔（姓氏/品牌名）

e.en: Collectors prize vintage {Revell} model car kits from the sixties.
e.zh: 收藏家们珍视六十年代的复古 Revell 模型车套件。

e.en: He spent the weekend assembling a {Revell} fighter jet kit.
e.zh: 他花了一个周末组装一架 Revell 战斗机模型。

reveller.t: n. 狂欢者（revel 的英式拼写）

e.en: A drunken {reveller} was helped home by his friends.
e.zh: 一名喝醉的狂欢者被朋友们扶回了家。

e.en: Each {reveller} at the festival received a glow stick.
e.zh: 音乐节上的每位狂欢者都领到了一根荧光棒。

e.en: Late-night {revelry} kept the neighbors awake until dawn.
e.zh: 深夜的狂欢让邻居们一直睡不着到天亮。

e.en: The festival was full of music, food, and {revelry}.
e.zh: 节日里充满了音乐、美食和欢闹。

e.en: The film features a {revenant} seeking justice for past wrongs.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一个亡灵归来寻求昔日冤屈昭雪的故事。

e.en: Local legends speak of a {revenant} that haunts the old bridge.
e.zh: 当地传说有个亡魂常出没在那座老桥上。

revenge.t:
n. 复仇；报复
v. 报复

e.en: He swore {revenge} after losing the championship final.
e.zh: 他在锦标赛决赛失利后发誓要复仇。

e.en: The sequel is basically a {revenge} story set in space.
e.zh: 这部续集基本上就是一个发生在太空的复仇故事。

revengeful.t: adj. 复仇心强的；爱报复的

e.en: His {revengeful} tone made the entire room uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他报复性的语气让整个房间的人都不自在。

e.en: She sent a {revengeful} email to her former boss.
e.zh: 她给前任老板发了一封充满报复意味的邮件。

e.en: The startup's {revenue} doubled in just six months.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的营收在短短六个月内翻了一番。

e.en: Advertising remains the platform's main source of {revenue}.
e.zh: 广告仍是该平台的主要收入来源。

e.en: Quarterly {revenues} beat Wall Street's expectations again.
e.zh: 季度营收再次超出华尔街的预期。

e.en: Tax {revenues} have fallen sharply during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间税收收入大幅下降。

e.en: Some Buddhists deeply {rever} their ancestral teachers.
e.zh: 一些佛教徒深深敬仰他们的祖师。

e.en: Many fans {rever} the original director's cut of the film.
e.zh: 许多影迷崇敬这部电影的原始导演剪辑版。

e.en: Add a little {reverb} to make the vocals sound bigger.
e.zh: 加一点混响能让人声听起来更饱满。

e.en: The cathedral's natural {reverb} made the choir sound heavenly.
e.zh: 大教堂天然的混响让合唱听起来宛如天籁。

e.en: The hall is too {reverberant} for clear speech recordings.
e.zh: 这个大厅混响太重，无法清晰录制人声。

e.en: His {reverberant} voice carried across the empty stadium.
e.zh: 他洪亮回荡的嗓音传遍了空旷的体育场。

e.en: The bass notes {reverberate} through the entire concert hall.
e.zh: 低音在整个音乐厅里回荡。

e.en: Her resignation will {reverberate} across the tech industry for months.
e.zh: 她的辞职将在科技行业引起数月的回响。

e.en: The explosion {reverberated} for miles across the desert.
e.zh: 爆炸声在沙漠中回响了好几英里。

e.en: News of the merger {reverberated} through global markets overnight.
e.zh: 合并的消息一夜之间震动了全球市场。

e.en: His speech still {reverberates} in classrooms today.
e.zh: 他的演讲至今仍在课堂上回响。

e.en: Thunder {reverberates} between the steep canyon walls.
e.zh: 雷声在陡峭的峡谷峭壁间回荡。

e.en: The {reverberating} drumbeat could be heard across the village.
e.zh: 回荡的鼓声响彻整个村庄。

e.en: Layoffs are {reverberating} through the whole startup ecosystem.
e.zh: 裁员潮正在整个创业生态圈引发连锁反应。

e.en: The room's {reverberation} ruined an otherwise perfect take.
e.zh: 房间的混响毁了原本完美的一条录音。

e.en: Every policy change has political {reverberation} in this town.
e.zh: 每一次政策变化在这个城市都会引起政治回响。

e.en: The bank's collapse sent {reverberations} through the global economy.
e.zh: 这家银行的倒闭在全球经济中引发了连锁反应。

e.en: Deep {reverberations} from the engine shook the whole ship.
e.zh: 引擎深沉的轰鸣震动了整艘船。

e.en: This plugin offers a dozen vintage {reverbs} for vocals.
e.zh: 这款插件提供十几种适合人声的复古混响效果。

e.en: Try one of the hall {reverbs} on the acoustic guitar.
e.zh: 试试在原声吉他上加一种大厅混响效果。

e.en: Many programmers still {revere} the early Unix pioneers.
e.zh: 许多程序员至今仍敬仰早期的 Unix 先驱。

e.en: Students {revere} the professor for her groundbreaking research.
e.zh: 学生们因这位教授开创性的研究而对她敬重有加。

revered.t:
adj. 受尊崇的
v. 崇敬（过去式）

e.en: He is widely {revered} as the father of modern physics.
e.zh: 他被广泛尊为现代物理学之父。

e.en: The {revered} chef opened her first restaurant at twenty-one.
e.zh: 这位备受尊敬的厨师在二十一岁就开了第一家餐厅。

e.en: She speaks about her grandmother with deep {reverence}.
e.zh: 她谈起祖母时充满深深的敬意。

e.en: Visitors enter the temple in silent {reverence}.
e.zh: 游客们怀着无声的敬意走进寺庙。

e.en: This community {reverences} elders as keepers of tradition.
e.zh: 这个社区把长辈奉为传统的守护者。

e.en: The poem {reverences} nature in every single line.
e.zh: 这首诗每一行都流露出对自然的敬仰。

reverend.t:
n. 牧师
adj. 可敬的

e.en: The {Reverend} delivered a moving sermon on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 牧师在周日早晨发表了一篇感人的布道。

e.en: {Reverend} Smith has led this congregation for thirty years.
e.zh: 史密斯牧师已带领这个教众三十年了。

e.en: The crowd fell into a {reverent} silence as she spoke.
e.zh: 她开始讲话时，人群陷入了肃然的沉默。

e.en: He gave a {reverent} bow before the ancient shrine.
e.zh: 他在古老的神龛前恭敬地鞠了一躬。

e.en: Fans spoke about the legendary coach in {reverential} tones.
e.zh: 球迷们以充满敬意的语气谈论这位传奇教练。

e.en: The documentary takes a {reverential} approach to its subject.
e.zh: 这部纪录片以敬仰的视角呈现其主角。

e.en: He spoke {reverentially} about his late mentor's work.
e.zh: 他满怀敬意地谈起已故导师的作品。

e.en: The audience clapped {reverentially} after the final note faded.
e.zh: 最后一个音符消散后，观众恭敬地鼓起了掌。

e.en: She placed the old book {reverently} on the shelf.
e.zh: 她恭敬地把那本旧书放回书架上。

e.en: Pilgrims walked {reverently} along the temple's stone path.
e.zh: 朝圣者们沿着寺庙的石径恭敬地行走。

e.en: She {reveres} her grandmother for her quiet strength.
e.zh: 她非常敬重祖母那份沉静的力量。

e.en: The team {reveres} its founder as a visionary.
e.zh: 团队把创始人尊崇为有远见的人。

e.en: He drifted into a {reverie} during the long meeting.
e.zh: 在冗长的会议中他陷入了遐想。

e.en: A car horn snapped her out of the {reverie}.
e.zh: 一声汽车喇叭把她从遐想中惊醒。

e.en: Fans kept {revering} the singer years after her death.
e.zh: 歌迷在她去世多年后仍崇敬着她。

e.en: The novel describes a culture {revering} ancestors deeply.
e.zh: 小说描写了一种深深崇敬祖先的文化。

e.en: The court ordered a {reversal} of the earlier ruling.
e.zh: 法院下令推翻先前的裁决。

e.en: Stock prices saw a sudden {reversal} this morning.
e.zh: 今早股价出现了急剧反转。

reverse.t:
v. 反转；撤销
adj. 相反的

e.en: Please {reverse} the car slowly into the garage.
e.zh: 请把车慢慢倒进车库。

e.en: The opposite is true in {reverse} order.
e.zh: 反过来顺序则结论相反。

reversed.t:
adj. 反向的
v. 反转（过去式）

e.en: She {reversed} her decision after hearing the feedback.
e.zh: 听完反馈后她改变了主意。

e.en: The roles were {reversed} in the second half.
e.zh: 下半场两人的角色互换了。

e.en: The locomotive's {reverser} controls forward and backward motion.
e.zh: 机车的换向器控制前进与后退。

e.en: Engineers replaced the worn {reverser} during maintenance.
e.zh: 工程师在维修时更换了磨损的换向器。

e.en: The new policy {reverses} years of strict regulation.
e.zh: 新政策推翻了多年来的严格监管。

e.en: This drug sometimes {reverses} early symptoms of the disease.
e.zh: 这种药有时能逆转疾病的早期症状。

e.en: The {reversibility} of the process makes it useful for testing.
e.zh: 该过程的可逆性使其便于用于测试。

e.en: Doctors questioned the {reversibility} of the nerve damage.
e.zh: 医生对神经损伤的可逆性表示怀疑。

e.en: This jacket is {reversible} — wear either side out.
e.zh: 这件夹克是双面的,哪面朝外都行。

e.en: The damage to the engine is not {reversible}.
e.zh: 发动机的损坏是不可逆的。

e.en: He hit a pole while {reversing} out of the driveway.
e.zh: 他倒车出车道时撞上了一根柱子。

e.en: The company is {reversing} its remote work policy.
e.zh: 公司正在推翻其远程办公政策。

e.en: We're seeing a {reversion} to older design trends.
e.zh: 我们看到了向旧设计风潮的回归。

e.en: The contract specifies {reversion} of land to the owner.
e.zh: 合同规定土地归还给原所有者。

e.en: The will included a {reversionary} clause for the estate.
e.zh: 遗嘱中包含一条关于遗产复归的条款。

e.en: Investors bought the {reversionary} interest at a discount.
e.zh: 投资者以折扣价买下了复归权益。

revert.t: v. 还原；恢复（至旧状态）

e.en: Click here to {revert} to the previous version.
e.zh: 点击这里恢复到之前的版本。

e.en: Please {revert} to me with your decision by Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前回复我你的决定。

e.en: He sat by the window lost in {revery}.
e.zh: 他坐在窗边陷入幻想之中。

e.en: A sudden noise broke her quiet {revery}.
e.zh: 突然的声响打断了她安静的遐想。

e.en: The stone {revetment} protects the riverbank from erosion.
e.zh: 石砌护岸保护河岸免受侵蚀。

e.en: Soldiers built a sandbag {revetment} along the trench.
e.zh: 士兵们沿战壕筑起了沙袋护墙。

e.en: The two players continued to {revie} each other in poker.
e.zh: 两位玩家在扑克中不断互相加注挑战。

e.en: Old gamblers would {revie} bets late into the night.
e.zh: 老赌徒们会通宵互相提高赌注。

review.t:
n. 评论；回顾
v. 审阅；复习

e.en: I left a five-star {review} for the restaurant.
e.zh: 我给那家餐厅留了五星好评。

e.en: Let's {review} the slides before the presentation.
e.zh: 我们在演示前过一遍幻灯片吧。

reviewable.t: adj. 可审阅的；可评议的

e.en: All decisions are {reviewable} by the appeals board.
e.zh: 所有决定都可由申诉委员会复审。

e.en: Please keep the document {reviewable} with track changes on.
e.zh: 请保留修订记录以便文件可供审阅。

e.en: The manager {reviewed} my code and suggested fixes.
e.zh: 经理审阅了我的代码并提出了修改建议。

e.en: Critics {reviewed} the film as overlong but moving.
e.zh: 影评人评价这部电影过长但动人。

e.en: A grumpy {reviewer} gave the book one star.
e.zh: 一位脾气暴躁的评论者给这本书打了一星。

e.en: The {reviewer} requested changes before approving the pull request.
e.zh: 审核者要求修改后才同意合并请求。

e.en: She's {reviewing} job offers from three different companies.
e.zh: 她正在比较三家公司的录用通知。

e.en: The committee is {reviewing} the grant applications this week.
e.zh: 委员会本周正在审阅资助申请。

reviews.t:
n. 评论（复数）
v. 审阅（第三人称）

e.en: Always check the {reviews} before booking a hotel.
e.zh: 订酒店前一定要先看看评价。

e.en: The professor {reviews} each draft within a week.
e.zh: 教授会在一周内审阅每份草稿。

e.en: Critics continue to {revile} the politician for his lies.
e.zh: 评论者们仍因谎言而痛斥这位政客。

e.en: It's unfair to {revile} someone you've never met.
e.zh: 辱骂一个素未谋面的人并不公平。

e.en: The dictator was {reviled} by his own people.
e.zh: 这位独裁者遭到本国人民的痛斥。

e.en: Once {reviled}, the artist is now widely celebrated.
e.zh: 这位艺术家曾被唾弃,如今广受赞誉。

e.en: The columnist routinely {reviles} corporate greed in her articles.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家在文章中经常痛斥企业贪婪。

e.en: He {reviles} anyone who disagrees with him online.
e.zh: 他在网上痛骂任何与他意见不合的人。

e.en: Stop {reviling} the referee and focus on the game.
e.zh: 别再骂裁判了,专心比赛吧。

e.en: Talk shows spent the week {reviling} the new tax plan.
e.zh: 脱口秀整周都在抨击新税收方案。

e.en: I need to {revise} my essay before submitting it.
e.zh: 我得先修改一下论文再提交。

e.en: Economists may {revise} their forecasts after the new data.
e.zh: 经济学家可能会在新数据出炉后调整预测。

revised.t:
adj. 修订后的
v. 修订（过去式）

e.en: She {revised} the contract to include a refund clause.
e.zh: 她修改了合同,加入了退款条款。

e.en: The {revised} estimate is lower than expected.
e.zh: 修订后的估算比预期要低。

e.en: Our editor {revises} every chapter twice before printing.
e.zh: 我们的编辑会在付印前把每章修改两遍。

e.en: The agency {revises} its travel advisory each month.
e.zh: 该机构每月更新一次旅行建议。

revising.t: v. 修订；修改（revise 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {revising} the proposal based on your feedback.
e.zh: 我正根据你的反馈修改提案。

e.en: Historians keep {revising} their views on the war.
e.zh: 历史学家不断修正对那场战争的看法。

e.en: This is the third {revision} of the design.
e.zh: 这是设计的第三次修订版。

e.en: The textbook needs a major {revision} for next year.
e.zh: 这本教科书明年需要大幅修订。

revisionary.t: adj. 修订的；修正主义的

e.en: The book offers a {revisionary} take on Cold War history.
e.zh: 这本书对冷战史提出了修正性的解读。

e.en: Scholars welcomed her {revisionary} reading of the poem.
e.zh: 学者们欢迎她对这首诗的修正性解读。

e.en: Critics accused the documentary of historical {revisionism}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这部纪录片在篡改历史。

e.en: His essay defends a careful form of {revisionism}.
e.zh: 他的文章为一种谨慎的修正主义辩护。

revisionist.t:
n. 修正主义者
adj. 修正主义的

e.en: The {revisionist} historian challenged the official narrative.
e.zh: 这位修正派历史学家挑战了官方叙事。

e.en: Many call the new biography purely {revisionist}.
e.zh: 许多人称这本新传记纯属修正主义之作。

e.en: The editor sent back the draft with several {revisions}.
e.zh: 编辑把草稿连同多处修改意见退了回来。

e.en: Git lets you track {revisions} to every file.
e.zh: Git 让你能追踪每个文件的修改历史。

e.en: Let's {revisit} this idea after the holidays.
e.zh: 我们假期后再回头讨论这个想法吧。

e.en: I'd love to {revisit} Kyoto in the autumn.
e.zh: 我很想秋天再去一趟京都。

revisited.t: v. 重访；重新审视（过去式）

e.en: The team {revisited} the old codebase to fix bugs.
e.zh: 团队回头检查旧代码库以修复漏洞。

e.en: She {revisited} her childhood home after twenty years.
e.zh: 二十年后她重访了童年的家。

revitalise.t: v. 使恢复活力；振兴（英式拼写）

e.en: The mayor pledged to {revitalise} the city centre.
e.zh: 市长承诺要振兴市中心。

e.en: A short walk can {revitalise} you on busy days.
e.zh: 忙碌的日子里散散步就能让你重新振作。

revitalised.t: v. 使焕发新生（英式，过去式）

e.en: The festival has {revitalised} the small coastal town.
e.zh: 节庆活动让这座沿海小镇焕发了活力。

e.en: She felt completely {revitalised} after the weekend break.
e.zh: 周末休假后她感觉精神焕发。

revitalising.t: v. 使恢复活力（英式，进行时）

e.en: The grant is {revitalising} the local arts scene.
e.zh: 这笔拨款正在振兴当地的艺术圈。

e.en: A {revitalising} face mask is part of her routine.
e.zh: 焕活面膜是她日常护肤的一部分。

e.en: The neighborhood underwent a remarkable {revitalization} in recent years.
e.zh: 这个街区近年经历了显著的复兴。

e.en: Funding supports the {revitalization} of endangered languages.
e.zh: 该基金支持濒危语言的复兴工作。

e.en: New cafes are helping {revitalize} the old downtown.
e.zh: 新开的咖啡馆正在帮助振兴老城区。

e.en: A short nap can {revitalize} you for the afternoon.
e.zh: 小睡片刻可以让你在下午重获活力。

revitalized.t: v. 使焕发新生（过去式）

e.en: The CEO {revitalized} the brand with a bold campaign.
e.zh: CEO 通过大胆的营销让品牌焕发新生。

e.en: After vacation, she returned {revitalized} and ready to work.
e.zh: 度假归来,她精神焕发,准备投入工作。

revitalizing.t: v. 使恢复活力（进行时）

e.en: The city is {revitalizing} its waterfront with new parks.
e.zh: 该市正以新公园重振滨水区。

e.en: Yoga has a {revitalizing} effect on both body and mind.
e.zh: 瑜伽对身心都有焕活的效果。

e.en: Vinyl records are enjoying a surprising {revival}.
e.zh: 黑胶唱片正经历一场意外的复兴。

e.en: The Broadway {revival} of the musical sold out fast.
e.zh: 这部音乐剧在百老汇的复演很快就售罄了。

e.en: Religious {revivalism} swept across the rural towns.
e.zh: 宗教复兴运动席卷了乡村小镇。

e.en: The festival celebrates a {revivalism} of folk traditions.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝民间传统的复兴。

e.en: A {revivalist} preacher drew huge crowds last summer.
e.zh: 一位复兴派牧师去年夏天吸引了大批人群。

e.en: The band has a clear {revivalist} sound from the 70s.
e.zh: 这支乐队有着鲜明的七十年代复古音色。

e.en: This theater specializes in {revivals} of classic plays.
e.zh: 这家剧院专门复演经典戏剧。

e.en: The neighborhood has seen several {revivals} over the decades.
e.zh: 几十年来这个街区经历了多次复兴。

e.en: Paramedics worked hard to {revive} the patient.
e.zh: 急救人员竭力抢救这位病人。

e.en: The studio plans to {revive} the cancelled series.
e.zh: 该工作室计划重启那部被取消的剧集。

e.en: The coffee {revived} me after a long meeting.
e.zh: 喝完咖啡后,我在长会后又恢复了精神。

e.en: The studio {revived} the classic show for a new generation.
e.zh: 该工作室为新一代观众重启了这部经典剧集。

e.en: A short nap often {revives} my focus in the afternoon.
e.zh: 小睡片刻常能让我下午重新集中精神。

e.en: The new director {revives} the failing theater every season.
e.zh: 新导演每个演季都让濒临倒闭的剧院重焕生机。

revivify.t: v. 使复活；使恢复生气

e.en: Fresh paint can {revivify} an old wooden chair.
e.zh: 刷上新漆能让旧木椅焕发新貌。

e.en: The mayor hopes new parks will {revivify} the downtown area.
e.zh: 市长希望新建的公园能让市中心重新焕发活力。

e.en: The brand is {reviving} a logo from the 1980s.
e.zh: 该品牌正在复刻一个上世纪八十年代的标志。

e.en: Cold water on her face was slowly {reviving} her.
e.zh: 冷水拍在脸上,正慢慢让她清醒过来。

revlon.t: n. 露华浓（美国化妆品品牌）

e.en: She bought a new {Revlon} lipstick at the drugstore.
e.zh: 她在药妆店买了一支新的露华浓口红。

e.en: {Revlon} has been a major cosmetics brand for decades.
e.zh: 露华浓几十年来一直是知名化妆品品牌。

revocable.t: adj. 可撤销的；可废除的

e.en: The offer is {revocable} until you sign the contract.
e.zh: 在签合同之前,该报价是可以撤销的。

e.en: Most online permissions are {revocable} from your account settings.
e.zh: 大多数在线授权都可以在账户设置中撤回。

e.en: The court ordered the {revocation} of his driver's license.
e.zh: 法院下令吊销他的驾驶执照。

e.en: App users received notice of the {revocation} of API access.
e.zh: 应用用户收到了 API 访问权被撤销的通知。

revoke.t: v. 撤销；吊销（执照、权限）

e.en: The school may {revoke} your library card for late returns.
e.zh: 学校可能会因逾期未还书而吊销你的借书证。

e.en: You can {revoke} an app's permissions in your phone settings.
e.zh: 你可以在手机设置中撤销某个应用的权限。

revoked.t: v. 已撤销；已吊销（过去式）

e.en: The company {revoked} his access right after he resigned.
e.zh: 公司在他辞职后立刻撤销了他的访问权限。

e.en: Her visa was {revoked} due to incorrect documents.
e.zh: 由于文件有误,她的签证被吊销了。

revolt.t:
n. 反抗；起义
v. 反抗；使反感

e.en: Hungry citizens began to {revolt} against the new tax.
e.zh: 饥饿的市民开始反抗新征收的税款。

e.en: The peasant {revolt} spread quickly across three provinces.
e.zh: 农民起义迅速蔓延到三个省份。

e.en: The smell of spoiled milk {revolted} everyone in the room.
e.zh: 变质牛奶的气味让屋里每个人都感到恶心。

e.en: The soldiers {revolted} when their pay was cut again.
e.zh: 军饷再次被削减时,士兵们发动了哗变。

revolting.t: adj. 令人反感的；恶心的

e.en: The leftover food in the fridge looked absolutely {revolting}.
e.zh: 冰箱里的剩饭看上去实在令人作呕。

e.en: Workers are {revolting} against the unfair new policies.
e.zh: 工人们正在反抗不公平的新政策。

e.en: Smartphones started a {revolution} in how we communicate.
e.zh: 智能手机引发了通讯方式的一场革命。

e.en: The French {Revolution} reshaped European politics forever.
e.zh: 法国大革命永久地改变了欧洲政治格局。

revolutionary.t:
adj. 革命性的
n. 革命者

e.en: The new battery is a {revolutionary} step for electric cars.
e.zh: 这款新电池是电动汽车的革命性突破。

e.en: He wrote a book about {revolutionary} leaders of the past.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于历代革命领袖的书。

revolutionise.t: v. 彻底变革（英式拼写）

e.en: AI tools could {revolutionise} the way teachers grade essays.
e.zh: AI 工具可能会彻底改变老师批改作文的方式。

e.en: The new engine will {revolutionise} long-distance air travel.
e.zh: 这款新引擎将彻底革新长途航空旅行。

revolutionised.t: v. 彻底变革（英式，过去式）

e.en: Streaming has completely {revolutionised} the music industry.
e.zh: 流媒体彻底变革了音乐行业。

e.en: Online maps {revolutionised} the way tourists explore cities.
e.zh: 在线地图彻底改变了游客探索城市的方式。

revolutionises.t: v. 彻底变革（英式，三单）

e.en: This app {revolutionises} how small businesses track expenses.
e.zh: 这款应用彻底改变了小企业记账的方式。

e.en: Every decade, a new gadget {revolutionises} home cooking.
e.zh: 每隔十年,就会有新工具彻底改变家庭烹饪方式。

revolutionising.t: v. 彻底变革（英式，进行时）

e.en: Robots are {revolutionising} warehouses around the world.
e.zh: 机器人正在革新全球各地的仓库作业。

e.en: Cloud services are {revolutionising} how startups build software.
e.zh: 云服务正在彻底改变初创公司开发软件的方式。

e.en: The young {revolutionist} gave fiery speeches in the square.
e.zh: 那位年轻的革命者在广场上发表激昂演说。

e.en: History remembers her as a fearless {revolutionist}.
e.zh: 历史将她铭记为一位无畏的革命者。

revolutionize.t: v. 彻底变革；使革命化

e.en: Electric trucks could {revolutionize} the shipping industry.
e.zh: 电动卡车可能会彻底变革货运行业。

e.en: This software promises to {revolutionize} online learning.
e.zh: 这款软件有望彻底改变在线学习方式。

e.en: The iPhone {revolutionized} the entire mobile phone market.
e.zh: iPhone 彻底变革了整个手机市场。

e.en: Cheap sensors {revolutionized} home automation in just a decade.
e.zh: 廉价传感器在短短十年内彻底改变了家庭自动化。

e.en: This printer {revolutionizes} how designers prototype products.
e.zh: 这款打印机彻底改变了设计师做产品原型的方式。

e.en: Each generation, a new tool {revolutionizes} how we work.
e.zh: 每一代都会有新工具彻底改变我们的工作方式。

e.en: AI is {revolutionizing} how doctors diagnose rare diseases.
e.zh: 人工智能正在彻底改变医生诊断罕见病的方式。

e.en: Drones are {revolutionizing} the delivery of medical supplies.
e.zh: 无人机正在彻底改变医疗物资的配送方式。

e.en: The engine spins at three thousand {revolutions} per minute.
e.zh: 该引擎每分钟转速达到三千转。

e.en: Many {revolutions} in history began with student protests.
e.zh: 历史上许多革命都始于学生抗议。

e.en: The planets {revolve} around the sun in steady orbits.
e.zh: 行星沿稳定的轨道围绕太阳公转。

e.en: Her stories often {revolve} around small-town family life.
e.zh: 她的故事常常围绕小镇家庭生活展开。

e.en: The discussion {revolved} around budget cuts for hours.
e.zh: 讨论围绕预算削减进行了好几个小时。

e.en: The wheel slowly {revolved} as the carousel started up.
e.zh: 旋转木马启动时,轮盘缓缓转动起来。

e.en: The detective carried a small {revolver} in his coat pocket.
e.zh: 侦探在外套口袋里揣着一把小左轮手枪。

e.en: He cleaned the antique {revolver} before locking it away.
e.zh: 他把那把古董左轮擦干净后锁了起来。

e.en: Her whole life {revolves} around her two young children.
e.zh: 她的整个生活都围绕着两个年幼的孩子。

e.en: The Earth {revolves} around the sun once every year.
e.zh: 地球每年绕太阳公转一周。

e.en: We entered the hotel through the shiny {revolving} door.
e.zh: 我们从那扇闪亮的旋转门走进了酒店。

e.en: The company has a {revolving} cast of interns each summer.
e.zh: 公司每年夏天都有一批轮换的实习生。

revote.t:
v. 重新投票
n. 复投

e.en: The committee called for a {revote} after the tie.
e.zh: 出现平票后,委员会要求重新投票。

e.en: Members demanded a {revote} on the controversial proposal.
e.zh: 成员们要求就那项有争议的提案进行重新投票。

revue.t: n. 时事讽刺剧；歌舞杂剧

e.en: The students put on a comedy {revue} at the end of term.
e.zh: 学生们在学期末上演了一场喜剧综艺秀。

e.en: Broadway's musical {revue} mixes singing, dancing, and sketches.
e.zh: 百老汇的音乐综艺秀融合了歌唱、舞蹈和短剧。

e.en: She felt instant {revulsion} at the sight of the rotten meat.
e.zh: 看到那块腐肉,她立刻感到一阵反胃。

e.en: His cruel words triggered widespread {revulsion} online.
e.zh: 他残忍的言论在网上引起了广泛的反感。

revulsions.t: n. 强烈的反感（revulsion 的复数）

e.en: The film stirred deep {revulsions} among many viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影让许多观众产生了强烈的厌恶感。

e.en: Public {revulsions} forced the company to pull the ad.
e.zh: 公众的强烈反感迫使公司撤下了那则广告。

reward.t:
n. 奖励；回报
v. 奖赏

e.en: The app gives you a small {reward} for daily check-ins.
e.zh: 该应用每日签到会给你一份小奖励。

e.en: Police offered a {reward} for information about the robbery.
e.zh: 警方为那起抢劫案的线索提供了一笔赏金。

rewarded.t: v. 奖赏、回报（reward 的过去式）

e.en: Her hard work was finally {rewarded} with a promotion.
e.zh: 她的辛勤付出终于以晋升得到了回报。

e.en: The dog was {rewarded} with a treat for sitting still.
e.zh: 那只狗因乖乖坐着而得到了一块小零食作为奖励。

rewarding.t: adj. 有回报的、值得做的

e.en: Teaching young children can be incredibly {rewarding} work.
e.zh: 教幼儿可以是一份非常有成就感的工作。

e.en: She finds volunteering at the shelter deeply {rewarding}.
e.zh: 她觉得在收容所做志愿者非常有成就感。

rewards.t:
n. 奖励（复数）
v. 奖赏（第三人称单数）

e.en: The credit card {rewards} cashback on every grocery purchase.
e.zh: 这张信用卡每次买菜都会返现作为奖励。

e.en: Patience often {rewards} you more than rushing things.
e.zh: 耐心常常比急于求成更能让你有所收获。

e.en: You can {rewarm} the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
e.zh: 你可以用微波炉把汤加热两分钟。

e.en: Don't {rewarm} cooked rice more than once for safety.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑,煮熟的米饭不要重复加热超过一次。

rewind.t: v. 倒回、倒放（视频、录音）

e.en: Press this button to {rewind} the video by ten seconds.
e.zh: 按这个按钮可以把视频回退十秒。

e.en: I wish I could {rewind} time and try that again.
e.zh: 我真希望能让时间倒流,再试一次。

rewire.t: v. 重新布线；重塑（思维）

e.en: The electrician will {rewire} the entire kitchen tomorrow.
e.zh: 电工明天会把整个厨房的电线重新布线。

e.en: Meditation can slowly {rewire} how your brain handles stress.
e.zh: 冥想可以慢慢重塑大脑应对压力的方式。

reword.t: v. 换种说法、重新表述

e.en: Could you {reword} that sentence to sound more polite?
e.zh: 你能把那句话改得更礼貌一些吗?

e.en: The teacher asked her to {reword} the essay's opening.
e.zh: 老师让她重新措辞文章的开头部分。

e.en: The designer had to {rework} the logo three times.
e.zh: 那位设计师不得不把标志返工修改了三次。

e.en: Let's {rework} the schedule to fit the new deadline.
e.zh: 我们来重新调整一下日程,以配合新的截止日期。

reworked.t: v. 重做、修改过的（rework 的过去式）

e.en: The chef {reworked} the menu to feature local vegetables.
e.zh: 主厨重新设计了菜单,主打本地蔬菜。

e.en: She {reworked} her resume before the big interview.
e.zh: 在重要面试之前,她重新修改了简历。

reworking.t:
n. 改编、重做
v. 正在返工

e.en: The team is {reworking} the app's homepage based on feedback.
e.zh: 团队正根据反馈重新设计应用的首页。

e.en: He spent the weekend {reworking} chapter three of his novel.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在修改小说的第三章。

rewound.t: v. 倒回（rewind 的过去式）

e.en: She {rewound} the cassette tape to her favorite song.
e.zh: 她把磁带倒回到她最喜欢的那首歌。

e.en: He {rewound} the clip to catch the joke he missed.
e.zh: 他把片段回放,以便听清刚才错过的笑点。

rewritable.t: adj. 可重写的（光盘、存储）

e.en: This {rewritable} disc lets you erase and save new files.
e.zh: 这种可重写光盘允许你删除文件并保存新内容。

e.en: Choose a {rewritable} DVD if you plan to update content often.
e.zh: 如果你打算经常更新内容,请选用可重写的 DVD。

rewrite.t:
v. 重写、改写
n. 改写版本

e.en: The editor asked me to {rewrite} the opening paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑让我重写文章的开头段落。

e.en: They had to {rewrite} the code after a major bug appeared.
e.zh: 出现重大漏洞后,他们不得不重写代码。

rewrites.t:
v. 重写（第三人称单数）
n. 改写版本（复数）

e.en: The author often {rewrites} a chapter five or six times.
e.zh: 那位作者常常把一个章节反复重写五六遍。

e.en: This new book {rewrites} much of what we knew about the war.
e.zh: 这本新书改写了我们对那场战争的许多既有认识。

rewriting.t:
v. 正在重写
n. 改写

e.en: She is {rewriting} her thesis based on her advisor's notes.
e.zh: 她正根据导师的批注重写自己的论文。

e.en: The team is {rewriting} the old payment system in Go.
e.zh: 团队正在用 Go 语言重写那个旧的支付系统。

rewritten.t: v. 被重写（rewrite 的过去分词）

e.en: The script was completely {rewritten} before filming began.
e.zh: 剧本在开拍之前被彻底重写了一遍。

e.en: This article has been {rewritten} to reflect the latest data.
e.zh: 本文已重新撰写以反映最新数据。

rewrote.t: v. 重写（rewrite 的过去式）

e.en: She {rewrote} the opening paragraph three times before submitting.
e.zh: 她把开头那段重写了三遍才交上去。

e.en: The team {rewrote} the entire backend in Rust last year.
e.zh: 团队去年用 Rust 重写了整个后端。

rex.t: n. 雷克斯（人名/宠物名）；拉丁语意为国王

e.en: The museum's main attraction is a massive T. {rex} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆的主要看点是一具巨大的霸王龙骨架。

e.en: My neighbor named his golden retriever {Rex}.
e.zh: 我邻居给他的金毛取名叫雷克斯。

rey.t: n. 雷伊（人名，西班牙语意为国王）

e.en: {Rey} became the unexpected hero of the new Star Wars trilogy.
e.zh: 蕾伊成了新版《星球大战》三部曲中意想不到的主角。

e.en: Fans debated whether {Rey} should have taken the Skywalker name.
e.zh: 粉丝们争论蕾伊是否应该继承天行者这个姓氏。

reykjavik.t: n. 雷克雅未克（冰岛首都）

e.en: {Reykjavik} is the northernmost capital city in the world.
e.zh: 雷克雅未克是世界上最靠北的首都。

e.en: We spent three days exploring cafes and museums in {Reykjavik}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间在雷克雅未克逛咖啡馆和博物馆。

reynard.t: n. 列那狐（寓言中狐狸的名字）

e.en: Medieval fables often cast {Reynard} the fox as a clever trickster.
e.zh: 中世纪寓言常把狐狸列那塑造成机智的骗子。

e.en: The children's book featured {Reynard} outwitting a hungry wolf.
e.zh: 那本童书讲的是列那智胜一只饿狼的故事。

e.en: Ryan {Reynolds} is known for his sarcastic humor in Deadpool.
e.zh: 瑞安·雷诺兹因《死侍》里的毒舌幽默而出名。

e.en: Engineers calculate the {Reynolds} number to predict turbulent flow.
e.zh: 工程师通过计算雷诺数来预测湍流情况。

rezoning.t: n. 重新划定区域（多指土地用途）

e.en: The city council approved {rezoning} the old factory site for housing.
e.zh: 市议会批准将旧厂区重新划分为住宅用地。

e.en: Neighbors protested the {rezoning} plan at last night's meeting.
e.zh: 邻居们在昨晚的会议上抗议这项重新分区计划。

rfc.t: n. 征求意见稿（Request for Comments，互联网技术标准文档）

e.en: The protocol is documented in {RFC} 2616 from 1999.
e.zh: 该协议记录在 1999 年发布的 RFC 2616 文档中。

e.en: Our team published an internal {RFC} before changing the API.
e.zh: 我们团队在改动 API 前先发布了一份内部 RFC。

e.en: The Rugby Football League ({RFL}) governs professional rugby in England.
e.zh: 英式橄榄球联盟(RFL)管理着英格兰的职业橄榄球赛事。

e.en: He saved the file with an {RFL} extension by mistake.
e.zh: 他不小心把文件存成了 RFL 扩展名。

e.en: The Rugby Football Union ({RFU}) announced new safety rules this week.
e.zh: 英格兰橄榄球协会(RFU)本周公布了新的安全规则。

e.en: Fluorescence is often measured in relative fluorescence units, or {RFU}.
e.zh: 荧光强度通常以相对荧光单位 RFU 来衡量。

e.en: The Royal Hibernian Academy ({RHA}) hosts an annual exhibition in Dublin.
e.zh: 皇家爱尔兰艺术院(RHA)每年在都柏林举办展览。

e.en: She earned the {RHA} designation after years of clinical training.
e.zh: 经过多年的临床培训,她获得了 RHA 资格认证。

rhabdomyosarcoma.t: n. 横纹肌肉瘤（一种恶性肿瘤）

e.en: {Rhabdomyosarcoma} is a rare cancer that mostly affects children.
e.zh: 横纹肌肉瘤是一种主要发生在儿童身上的罕见癌症。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the tumor as a form of {rhabdomyosarcoma}.
e.zh: 医生将这种肿瘤诊断为一种横纹肌肉瘤。

rhapsodic.t: adj. 热情洋溢的、狂喜的

e.en: The critic was {rhapsodic} about the young pianist's debut.
e.zh: 评论家对那位年轻钢琴家的首演赞不绝口。

e.en: She gave a {rhapsodic} description of her trip to Italy.
e.zh: 她滔滔不绝地描述着她的意大利之旅。

rhapsodize.t: v. 狂热地谈论、大加赞赏

e.en: Fans still {rhapsodize} about the band's 2010 reunion concert.
e.zh: 乐迷们至今仍在津津乐道乐队 2010 年的重聚演唱会。

e.en: He tends to {rhapsodize} whenever the subject of jazz comes up.
e.zh: 一聊到爵士乐他就会滔滔不绝地大加赞美。

rhapsody.t: n. 狂想曲（乐曲）；热情赞美

e.en: Queen's "Bohemian {Rhapsody}" remains one of rock's most iconic songs.
e.zh: 皇后乐队的《波西米亚狂想曲》至今仍是摇滚乐最具代表性的歌曲之一。

e.en: The chef went into a {rhapsody} over the fresh truffles.
e.zh: 厨师对那批新鲜松露赞不绝口。

rhea.t: n. 美洲鸵（鸟类）；瑞亚（人名）

e.en: The {rhea} is a flightless bird native to South America.
e.zh: 美洲鸵是一种原产于南美洲的不会飞的鸟。

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Rhea} was the mother of Zeus.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,瑞亚是宙斯的母亲。

rheme.t: n. 述位（语言学中句子的新信息部分）

e.en: In linguistics, the {rheme} carries the new information in a sentence.
e.zh: 在语言学中,述位承载着句子里的新信息。

e.en: Translators must preserve the theme and {rheme} structure carefully.
e.zh: 译者必须谨慎地保留主位和述位的结构。

rhenish.t:
adj. 莱茵河地区的
n. 莱茵葡萄酒

e.en: They opened a bottle of crisp {Rhenish} wine with dinner.
e.zh: 他们晚餐时开了一瓶清爽的莱茵白葡萄酒。

e.en: Schumann's {Rhenish} Symphony evokes the landscapes along the Rhine.
e.zh: 舒曼的《莱茵交响曲》描绘了莱茵河沿岸的景色。

e.en: Turn the {rheostat} slowly to dim the stage lights.
e.zh: 慢慢转动变阻器把舞台灯光调暗。

e.en: Old radios used a {rheostat} to control the volume.
e.zh: 老式收音机用变阻器来调节音量。

rhesus.t: n. 恒河猴；Rh 血型因子

e.en: Researchers studied memory formation in {rhesus} monkeys for decades.
e.zh: 研究人员对恒河猴的记忆形成研究了几十年。

e.en: Her blood test showed she was {rhesus} negative.
e.zh: 她的验血结果显示她是 Rh 阴性血。

rhetoric.t: n. 修辞、华丽辞藻；花言巧语

e.en: His campaign speeches were full of fiery {rhetoric} but few details.
e.zh: 他的竞选演讲充满激烈的辞令,却没什么实质内容。

e.en: She studied classical {rhetoric} as part of her philosophy degree.
e.zh: 她在攻读哲学学位时学习了古典修辞学。

rhetorical.t: adj. 修辞的；夸张的（rhetorical question 反问句）

e.en: "Who wouldn't want a raise?" is obviously a {rhetorical} question.
e.zh: “谁不想加薪呢?”显然是一个反问句。

e.en: The senator used a {rhetorical} flourish to end her speech.
e.zh: 参议员用一段华丽的修辞来结束她的演讲。

rhetorically.t: adv. 修辞上；以反问方式

e.en: He asked, {rhetorically}, whether anyone actually reads terms of service.
e.zh: 他反问道,究竟有没有人真的会去看服务条款。

e.en: She paused, {rhetorically}, before delivering the punchline.
e.zh: 她为了修辞效果故意停顿了一下,才说出那句妙语。

e.en: Cicero is often regarded as Rome's greatest {rhetorician}.
e.zh: 西塞罗常被视为罗马最伟大的修辞学家。

e.en: The senator was a skilled {rhetorician} who could sway any crowd.
e.zh: 那位参议员是个高明的演说家,能打动任何听众。

e.en: Different cultures develop their own {rhetorics} of persuasion.
e.zh: 不同文化发展出各自的劝说修辞体系。

e.en: The course compares the {rhetorics} of advertising and political speech.
e.zh: 这门课比较了广告与政治演讲中的各种修辞手法。

rheumatic.t:
adj. 风湿病的
n. 风湿病患者

e.en: Untreated strep throat can sometimes lead to {rheumatic} fever.
e.zh: 链球菌性咽炎若不及时治疗有时会引发风湿热。

e.en: Her grandmother suffered from {rheumatic} pain in cold weather.
e.zh: 她奶奶一到冷天就会犯风湿痛。

e.en: Damp weather always makes his {rheumatism} flare up.
e.zh: 潮湿的天气总会让他的风湿病发作。

e.en: Grandma rubbed ointment on her knees to ease the {rheumatism}.
e.zh: 奶奶在膝盖上涂药膏以缓解风湿。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {rheumatoid} arthritis in her early thirties.
e.zh: 她三十出头时就被诊断出类风湿性关节炎。

e.en: New biologic drugs have transformed {rheumatoid} arthritis treatment.
e.zh: 新型生物制剂彻底改变了类风湿性关节炎的治疗方式。

e.en: Her doctor referred her to a {rheumatologist} for joint pain.
e.zh: 医生因为她关节疼痛把她转诊给了风湿病专科医生。

e.en: The {rheumatologist} adjusted her medication after reviewing the blood work.
e.zh: 风湿科医生看过血检结果后调整了她的用药。

e.en: He decided to specialize in {rheumatology} after his internal medicine residency.
e.zh: 内科住院医师培训结束后,他决定专攻风湿病学。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {rheumatology} clinic last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月新开了一家风湿病专科门诊。

rheumy.t: adj. 流泪的；水汪汪的（眼睛）

e.en: The old sailor stared at the horizon with {rheumy} eyes.
e.zh: 那位老水手用一双浑浊的眼睛凝望着地平线。

e.en: His {rheumy} cough kept him up most of the night.
e.zh: 他咳嗽带痰,一整晚几乎没怎么睡。

e.en: Fleetwood Mac's "{Rhiannon}" became one of their signature songs.
e.zh: Fleetwood Mac 的《Rhiannon》成了他们的代表作之一。

e.en: In Welsh mythology, {Rhiannon} rides a magical white horse.
e.zh: 在威尔士神话中,瑞安农骑着一匹神奇的白马。

e.en: We took a scenic cruise along the {Rhine} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿莱茵河来了一趟风景游船之旅。

e.en: The castles overlooking the {Rhine} attract millions of tourists.
e.zh: 俯瞰莱茵河的城堡每年吸引着数百万游客。

e.en: The {Rhineland} is famous for its vineyards and medieval castles.
e.zh: 莱茵兰地区以葡萄园和中世纪城堡而闻名。

e.en: Germany remilitarized the {Rhineland} in 1936.
e.zh: 德国于 1936 年重新武装了莱茵兰地区。

e.en: Her denim jacket was covered in tiny {rhinestone} studs.
e.zh: 她的牛仔外套上钉满了细小的水钻饰钉。

e.en: Elvis was famous for his sparkling {rhinestone} jumpsuits.
e.zh: 猫王以他那闪闪发亮的水钻连体演出服而闻名。

e.en: Spring pollen always triggers her allergic {rhinitis}.
e.zh: 春天的花粉总会引发她的过敏性鼻炎。

e.en: Chronic {rhinitis} can make sleeping through the night difficult.
e.zh: 慢性鼻炎会让人难以一觉睡到天亮。

e.en: Poaching has driven the black {rhino} to the edge of extinction.
e.zh: 偷猎已经把黑犀牛逼到了濒临灭绝的边缘。

e.en: We saw a {rhino} drinking at the watering hole at dawn.
e.zh: 我们在黎明时分看到一头犀牛在水坑边喝水。

e.en: The {rhinoceros} charged when it sensed the photographers nearby.
e.zh: 那头犀牛察觉到附近有摄影师,便冲了过来。

e.en: A white {rhinoceros} can weigh more than two tons.
e.zh: 一头白犀牛体重可超过两吨。

e.en: She saved for years to afford a {rhinoplasty} procedure.
e.zh: 她攒了好几年钱才负担得起鼻整形手术。

e.en: Recovery after {rhinoplasty} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 鼻整形术后通常需要几周的恢复期。

e.en: Persistent {rhinorrhea} during allergy season made her miserable.
e.zh: 过敏季节持续不断的流鼻涕让她苦不堪言。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an antihistamine to control the {rhinorrhea}.
e.zh: 医生开了抗组胺药来控制流涕症状。

e.en: Most common colds are caused by some strain of {rhinovirus}.
e.zh: 大多数普通感冒都是由某种鼻病毒引起的。

e.en: Researchers are trying to develop a vaccine against {rhinovirus}.
e.zh: 研究人员正在尝试研发针对鼻病毒的疫苗。

e.en: Bamboo is a {rhizomatous} plant that spreads quickly underground.
e.zh: 竹子是一种根状茎植物,会在地下迅速蔓延。

e.en: Gardeners often divide {rhizomatous} irises every few years.
e.zh: 园丁通常每隔几年就要把根状茎鸢尾分株一次。

e.en: Ginger grows from a thick underground {rhizome}.
e.zh: 姜是从粗壮的地下根茎中长出来的。

e.en: Slice the {rhizome} thinly before adding it to the soup.
e.zh: 把根茎切成薄片再加进汤里。

e.en: The dosimeter reading was given in {rhm} units per hour.
e.zh: 剂量计的读数以每小时若干 rhm 为单位给出。

e.en: Old radiation safety manuals still reference the {rhm} measurement.
e.zh: 旧的辐射安全手册中仍会提到 rhm 这一计量单位。

e.en: The Greek letter {rho} looks similar to the Latin letter p.
e.zh: 希腊字母 ρ 看起来和拉丁字母 p 很像。

e.en: Statisticians use Spearman's {rho} to measure rank correlation.
e.zh: 统计学家用斯皮尔曼 ρ 来衡量等级相关性。

e.en: {Rhode} Island is the smallest state in the United States.
e.zh: 罗德岛是美国面积最小的州。

e.en: Her grandparents retired to a quiet town in {Rhode} Island.
e.zh: 她的祖父母退休后搬到了罗德岛一个安静的小镇。

rhodes.t: n. 罗德岛（希腊）；罗兹（姓氏）

e.en: We spent a week exploring the medieval old town of {Rhodes}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览罗德岛的中世纪古城。

e.en: She won a {Rhodes} scholarship to study at Oxford.
e.zh: 她获得了罗德奖学金去牛津深造。

rhodesia.t: n. 罗得西亚（今津巴布韦）

e.en: {Rhodesia} was renamed Zimbabwe after gaining independence in 1980.
e.zh: 罗德西亚在 1980 年独立后更名为津巴布韦。

e.en: His parents grew up on a farm in colonial {Rhodesia}.
e.zh: 他的父母在殖民时期的罗德西亚一座农场长大。

rhodesian.t:
adj. 罗得西亚的
n. 罗得西亚人

e.en: The {Rhodesian} ridgeback is a loyal and athletic breed of dog.
e.zh: 罗得西亚脊背犬是一种忠诚又运动能力强的犬种。

e.en: Her grandfather served as a {Rhodesian} police officer in the 1960s.
e.zh: 她外公在 1960 年代曾是罗德西亚的一名警察。

e.en: Catalytic converters contain small amounts of {rhodium} to reduce emissions.
e.zh: 汽车催化转化器中含有少量铑用于减少尾气排放。

e.en: {Rhodium} is one of the rarest and most expensive precious metals.
e.zh: 铑是最稀有、最昂贵的贵金属之一。

rhododendron.t: n. 杜鹃花；杜鹃属植物

e.en: The garden bloomed with pink {rhododendron} flowers every spring.
e.zh: 花园里每年春天都盛开着粉色的杜鹃花。

e.en: She planted a {rhododendron} bush near the front porch.
e.zh: 她在前廊旁种了一丛杜鹃花。

e.en: {Rhodopsin} helps the eye detect light in dim conditions.
e.zh: 视紫红质帮助眼睛在昏暗环境中感知光线。

e.en: Scientists studied how {rhodopsin} breaks down under bright light.
e.zh: 科学家研究视紫红质在强光下如何分解。

rhomboid.t:
n. 长菱形
adj. 菱形的

e.en: The tile was cut into a perfect {rhomboid} shape.
e.zh: 这块瓷砖被切成了完美的菱形。

e.en: Stretching helps relieve tension in the {rhomboid} muscles.
e.zh: 拉伸有助于缓解菱形肌的紧张。

e.en: Her grandfather worked in the coal mines of the {Rhondda}.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在朗达谷的煤矿工作。

e.en: We drove through the {Rhondda} valley on our Welsh trip.
e.zh: 我们在威尔士旅行时开车穿过了朗达山谷。

e.en: The {Rhone} river flows from Switzerland into southern France.
e.zh: 罗讷河从瑞士流向法国南部。

e.en: We tasted wines from the {Rhone} valley last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们品尝了罗讷河谷出产的葡萄酒。

rhs.t: n. 右侧（right-hand side 的缩写）

e.en: Move all variables to the {RHS} of the equation.
e.zh: 把所有变量移到方程的右边。

e.en: The {RHS} hosts a famous flower show in Chelsea.
e.zh: 英国皇家园艺学会在切尔西举办著名的花展。

e.en: We hiked along the cliffs near {Rhu} village.
e.zh: 我们沿着鲁村附近的悬崖徒步。

e.en: The marina at {Rhu} was full of small sailboats.
e.zh: 鲁村的码头停满了小帆船。

e.en: My grandmother bakes a delicious {rhubarb} pie every summer.
e.zh: 我祖母每年夏天都会烤美味的大黄派。

e.en: The two coaches got into a heated {rhubarb} courtside.
e.zh: 两位教练在场边激烈地争吵起来。

e.en: They danced a slow {rhumba} under the soft lights.
e.zh: 他们在柔和的灯光下跳着缓慢的伦巴。

e.en: The band played a lively {rhumba} for the guests.
e.zh: 乐队为客人演奏了一曲欢快的伦巴。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend at the beach in {Rhyl}.
e.zh: 我们在莱尔的海滩度过了一个阳光明媚的周末。

e.en: The seaside town of {Rhyl} draws many summer tourists.
e.zh: 海滨小镇莱尔吸引了许多夏季游客。

rhyme.t:
n. 押韵；韵脚
v. 押韵

e.en: Children love any song with a catchy {rhyme}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢任何押韵动听的歌曲。

e.en: The poet struggled to find a {rhyme} for orange.
e.zh: 诗人努力想为 orange 找一个押韵词。

rhymed.t:
adj. 押韵的
v. 押韵（过去式）

e.en: His verses {rhymed} perfectly from beginning to end.
e.zh: 他的诗句从头到尾押韵得恰到好处。

e.en: She {rhymed} moon with June in her love song.
e.zh: 她在情歌里把 moon 和 June 押了韵。

rhymes.t:
n. 韵脚（复数）
v. 押韵（三单）

e.en: This rapper writes clever {rhymes} about everyday life.
e.zh: 这位说唱歌手写出关于日常生活的巧妙押韵。

e.en: The toddler giggled at the silly nursery {rhymes}.
e.zh: 幼儿听到滑稽的童谣咯咯直笑。

rhyming.t:
adj. 押韵的
v. 押韵（进行式）

e.en: She read a {rhyming} picture book to the kids.
e.zh: 她给孩子们读了一本押韵的图画书。

e.en: He keeps a {rhyming} dictionary on his desk.
e.zh: 他在书桌上放着一本押韵词典。

e.en: The drummer kept a steady {rhythm} throughout the song.
e.zh: 鼓手在整首歌中都保持着稳定的节奏。

e.en: I finally found a daily {rhythm} that works for me.
e.zh: 我终于找到了适合自己的日常节奏。

rhythmic.t: adj. 有节奏的；有韵律的

e.en: The {rhythmic} sound of waves helped me fall asleep.
e.zh: 有节奏的海浪声让我入睡了。

e.en: Her {rhythmic} typing filled the quiet office.
e.zh: 她有节奏的打字声充满了安静的办公室。

rhythmical.t: adj. 有节奏的；有韵律的

e.en: The dancers moved in {rhythmical} unison across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者们以富有节奏的整齐步伐跨过舞台。

e.en: His breathing became slow and {rhythmical} during meditation.
e.zh: 他冥想时呼吸变得缓慢而富有节奏。

e.en: She tapped her foot {rhythmically} to the beat.
e.zh: 她随着节拍有节奏地用脚打着拍子。

e.en: The wipers swept {rhythmically} across the windshield.
e.zh: 雨刷有节奏地在挡风玻璃上摆动。

e.en: African drum {rhythms} influenced much of modern pop music.
e.zh: 非洲鼓的节奏影响了很多现代流行音乐。

e.en: Our bodies follow natural circadian {rhythms} every day.
e.zh: 我们的身体每天都遵循自然的昼夜节律。

rialto.t: n. 商业区；剧院区（源自威尼斯地名）

e.en: Tourists crowded the {Rialto} bridge to take photos.
e.zh: 游客挤在里亚托桥上拍照。

e.en: The old {Rialto} theater was restored last year.
e.zh: 那座老里亚托剧院去年被修复了。

rib.t:
n. 肋骨；（伞、船等的）肋状物
v. 取笑

e.en: He cracked a {rib} during the soccer match.
