e.zh: 他在足球比赛中摔断了一根肋骨。

e.en: My friends always {rib} me about my terrible singing.
e.zh: 我朋友总是拿我糟糕的唱功开玩笑。

riba.t: n. 利息（伊斯兰教中禁止的高利贷）

e.en: Islamic finance strictly prohibits charging {riba} on loans.
e.zh: 伊斯兰金融严禁在贷款中收取利息。

e.en: Scholars debated what counts as {riba} in modern banking.
e.zh: 学者们讨论现代银行业中哪些算作利息。

ribald.t: adj. 下流的，粗俗的（玩笑、语言）

e.en: The comedian told {ribald} jokes that shocked the audience.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员讲了让观众咋舌的下流笑话。

e.en: The sailors sang a {ribald} song late into the night.
e.zh: 水手们一直唱着粗俗的歌曲到深夜。

ribaldry.t: n. 下流的言辞，粗俗的玩笑

e.en: The play was full of Shakespearean wit and {ribaldry}.
e.zh: 这部戏充满了莎士比亚式的机智与粗俗笑料。

e.en: His drunken {ribaldry} embarrassed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他酒后的粗俗言语让晚宴上每个人都感到尴尬。

riband.t: n. 丝带（尤指奖带，ribbon 的旧称）

e.en: A blue {riband} was tied around the prize basket.
e.zh: 奖品篮子上系着一条蓝色丝带。

e.en: The ocean liner won the famous Blue {Riband} award.
e.zh: 那艘远洋客轮赢得了著名的蓝带奖。

ribavirin.t: n. 利巴韦林（抗病毒药物）

e.en: Doctors prescribed {ribavirin} to treat her chronic hepatitis C.
e.zh: 医生开了利巴韦林来治疗她的慢性丙肝。

e.en: {Ribavirin} can cause serious side effects in some patients.
e.zh: 利巴韦林可能在部分患者中引起严重副作用。

ribbed.t: adj. 有棱纹的，罗纹的（织物、表面）

e.en: She wore a soft {ribbed} sweater on the chilly morning.
e.zh: 在寒冷的早晨她穿了一件柔软的罗纹毛衣。

e.en: His brothers {ribbed} him about his new haircut.
e.zh: 他的兄弟们拿他的新发型开玩笑。

ribber.t: n. 爱开玩笑的人；罗纹编织者

e.en: My uncle is a constant {ribber} at family gatherings.
e.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚会上总爱开玩笑取笑别人。

e.en: The team's biggest {ribber} kept everyone laughing all afternoon.
e.zh: 队里最爱开玩笑的人让大家笑了整个下午。

ribbing.t:
n. 罗纹织法；肋状结构
n. 戏弄

e.en: He took the friendly {ribbing} from his teammates well.
e.zh: 他大度地接受了队友们友好的调侃。

e.en: The cuffs have a tight {ribbing} to keep heat in.
e.zh: 袖口有紧密的罗纹以保暖。

ribble.t: n. 里布尔河（英国地名）

e.en: We fished for trout along the {Ribble} river last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在里布尔河边钓鳟鱼。

e.en: The {Ribble} flooded after several days of heavy rain.
e.zh: 连续几天大雨后里布尔河泛滥了。

ribbon.t: n. 丝带，缎带；（软件）功能区

e.en: She tied a red {ribbon} around the gift box.
e.zh: 她在礼盒上系了一条红色丝带。

e.en: The new feature is hidden in the toolbar {ribbon}.
e.zh: 这个新功能藏在工具栏的功能区里。

ribboned.t: adj. 饰有丝带的；条纹状的

e.en: Her hair was neatly {ribboned} for the school photo.
e.zh: 她的头发为校园合照整齐地系上了丝带。

e.en: The {ribboned} medal hung proudly on the wall.
e.zh: 那枚系着绶带的奖章自豪地挂在墙上。

e.en: The kids tied colorful {ribbons} to their bicycle handles.
e.zh: 孩子们在自行车把手上系上五颜六色的丝带。

e.en: Her dress was torn to {ribbons} by the brambles.
e.zh: 她的裙子被荆棘刮成了一条条碎片。

e.en: The doctor felt around her {ribcage} for any tenderness.
e.zh: 医生在她的胸廓周围按压检查是否有压痛。

e.en: His heart pounded loudly inside his {ribcage}.
e.zh: 他的心脏在胸腔里剧烈地跳动。

riboflavin.t: n. 核黄素（维生素 B2）

e.en: Milk and eggs are good sources of {riboflavin}.
e.zh: 牛奶和鸡蛋是核黄素的良好来源。

e.en: A {riboflavin} deficiency can cause cracks at the lips.
e.zh: 核黄素缺乏会导致嘴角开裂。

ribose.t: n. 核糖（RNA 的组成糖类）

e.en: {Ribose} is a key sugar found in RNA molecules.
e.zh: 核糖是 RNA 分子中关键的一种糖。

e.en: Some athletes take {ribose} supplements to boost energy.
e.zh: 一些运动员服用核糖补充剂来提高能量。

e.en: Scientists sequenced the {ribosomal} RNA to identify the bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家测序了核糖体 RNA 来鉴定这种细菌。

e.en: Many antibiotics target {ribosomal} proteins inside the cell.
e.zh: 许多抗生素以细胞内的核糖体蛋白为靶点。

ribosome.t: n. 核糖体（细胞内合成蛋白质的结构）

e.en: Each {ribosome} reads mRNA and assembles proteins inside the cell.
e.zh: 每个核糖体在细胞内读取 mRNA 并合成蛋白质。

e.en: The {ribosome} is one of the oldest molecular machines known.
e.zh: 核糖体是已知最古老的分子机器之一。

ribozyme.t: n. 核酶（具催化功能的 RNA）

e.en: A {ribozyme} is an RNA molecule that catalyzes chemical reactions.
e.zh: 核酶是一种能催化化学反应的 RNA 分子。

e.en: Researchers engineered a {ribozyme} to cut specific viral sequences.
e.zh: 研究人员改造了一种核酶来切割特定的病毒序列。

ribs.t: n. 肋骨（rib 的复数）；肋排

e.en: He bruised two {ribs} in the cycling accident.
e.zh: 他在自行车事故中撞伤了两根肋骨。

e.en: We grilled barbecue {ribs} for the whole family.
e.zh: 我们为全家烤了烧烤排骨。

ric.t: n. Ric（人名，多为 Richard 的昵称）

e.en: My cousin {Ric} runs a small coffee shop downtown.
e.zh: 我表哥里克在市中心经营一家小咖啡店。

e.en: Everyone calls him {Ric} instead of his full name.
e.zh: 大家都叫他里克,而不是用他的全名。

rica.t: n. Rica（人名）；哥斯达黎加简称

e.en: We honeymooned in Costa {Rica} surrounded by rainforest.
e.zh: 我们在被雨林环绕的哥斯达黎加度蜜月。

e.en: Costa {Rica} is famous for its biodiversity and beaches.
e.zh: 哥斯达黎加以生物多样性和海滩闻名。

e.en: Christina {Ricci} starred in many memorable nineties films.
e.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·里奇出演了许多令人难忘的九十年代电影。

e.en: He studied {Ricci} curvature in his geometry course.
e.zh: 他在几何课上学习了里奇曲率。

rice.t:
n. 大米，米饭
v. 把…压成米粒状

e.en: I usually eat {rice} with almost every dinner.
e.zh: 我几乎每顿晚饭都要吃米饭。

e.en: She added jasmine {rice} to the boiling pot.
e.zh: 她把茉莉香米加入了沸腾的锅里。

ricer.t: n. 压泥器（把食物压成米粒状的厨具）

e.en: Use a {ricer} to make perfectly smooth mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 用压泥器可以做出完全顺滑的土豆泥。

e.en: He pushed the boiled potatoes through a metal {ricer}.
e.zh: 他把煮熟的土豆通过金属压泥器压过去。

rich.t: adj. 富有的；丰富的；（食物）油腻的

e.en: His uncle became {rich} from early tech investments.
e.zh: 他叔叔靠早期的科技投资变得富有。

e.en: This chocolate cake has a wonderfully {rich} flavor.
e.zh: 这款巧克力蛋糕口味浓郁醇厚。

e.en: Professor {Richardson} taught me everything about modern poetry.
e.zh: 理查森教授教会了我现代诗的一切。

e.en: The actor Ralph {Richardson} was knighted in 1947.
e.zh: 演员拉尔夫·理查森于 1947 年被授予爵士头衔。

richelieu.t: n. 黎塞留（法国枢机主教、首相）

e.en: Cardinal {Richelieu} centralized power in seventeenth century France.
e.zh: 黎塞留枢机主教在十七世纪的法国集中了权力。

e.en: The novel features {Richelieu} as a cunning political schemer.
e.zh: 小说将黎塞留刻画成一个狡诈的政治阴谋家。

e.en: He left all his {riches} to charity in his will.
e.zh: 他在遗嘱中把所有财富都留给了慈善机构。

e.en: True happiness rarely comes from material {riches} alone.
e.zh: 真正的幸福很少仅来自物质财富。

richly.t: adv. 丰富地；豪华地；完全应得地

e.en: The hall was {richly} decorated with gold and velvet.
e.zh: 大厅用金色和天鹅绒华丽地装饰着。

e.en: She {richly} deserves the promotion she just received.
e.zh: 她完全配得上刚刚获得的晋升。

e.en: Only a {richman} could afford that beachfront mansion.
e.zh: 只有富翁才买得起那栋海滨豪宅。

e.en: The novel mocks the lonely {richman} living in his huge estate.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了独居在大庄园里的富翁。

richmond.t: n. 里士满（英美多地地名）

e.en: We drove down to {Richmond} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末开车去了里士满。

e.en: {Richmond} is the capital city of Virginia.
e.zh: 里士满是弗吉尼亚州的首府。

richness.t: n. 丰富；富裕；（色彩、味道）浓郁

e.en: I love the {richness} of this chocolate cake.
e.zh: 我喜欢这款巧克力蛋糕的醇厚口感。

e.en: The film captures the {richness} of local culture.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了当地文化的丰富多彩。

richter.t: n. 里氏（地震震级）；里希特（姓氏）

e.en: The earthquake measured 6.5 on the {Richter} scale.
e.zh: 那次地震达到里氏6.5级。

e.en: Scientists use the {Richter} scale to compare quake magnitudes.
e.zh: 科学家用里氏震级来比较地震强度。

ricin.t: n. 蓖麻毒素（剧毒蛋白质）

e.en: {Ricin} is a deadly toxin extracted from castor beans.
e.zh: 蓖麻毒素是从蓖麻籽中提取的致命毒素。

e.en: The suspect was charged with mailing {ricin} to officials.
e.zh: 嫌犯被指控向官员邮寄蓖麻毒素。

rick.t:
n. 干草堆
v. 扭伤（脖子、背）

e.en: I {rick}ed my back lifting that heavy box.
e.zh: 我搬那个重箱子时把腰扭伤了。

e.en: The farmer built a tall {rick} of hay in the field.
e.zh: 农夫在田里堆起了一座高高的干草垛。

rickenbacker.t: n. 里肯巴克（乐器品牌；姓氏）

e.en: He plays a vintage {Rickenbacker} guitar in the band.
e.zh: 他在乐队里弹一把复古的瑞肯巴克吉他。

e.en: The Beatles famously used a {Rickenbacker} on early records.
e.zh: 披头士早期唱片中有名地使用了瑞肯巴克吉他。

rickets.t: n. 佝偻病（维生素 D 缺乏导致）

e.en: Vitamin D deficiency can cause {rickets} in young children.
e.zh: 维生素D缺乏会导致幼儿患佝偻病。

e.en: Doctors rarely see {rickets} in developed countries today.
e.zh: 如今发达国家的医生很少见到佝偻病。

rickety.t: adj. 摇摇晃晃的；破旧不稳的

e.en: We climbed up the {rickety} wooden staircase carefully.
e.zh: 我们小心地爬上那段摇摇晃晃的木楼梯。

e.en: He drives a {rickety} old truck to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天开一辆破旧的老卡车去上班。

rickmansworth.t: n. 里克曼斯沃思（英国英格兰小镇）

e.en: She commutes from {Rickmansworth} into central London.
e.zh: 她从里克曼斯沃思通勤到伦敦市中心。

e.en: {Rickmansworth} sits on the edge of the London Underground network.
e.zh: 里克曼斯沃思位于伦敦地铁网络的边缘。

e.en: We took a {rickshaw} ride through the old city streets.
e.zh: 我们坐人力车穿过了古城的街道。

e.en: The {rickshaw} driver knew every shortcut in town.
e.zh: 那位人力车夫熟悉城里的每一条捷径。

rico.t:
n. 里科（人名）
n. RICO 法案（美国反勒索法）

e.en: Prosecutors used {RICO} statutes to charge the crime family.
e.zh: 检察官用《反勒索法》起诉了那个犯罪家族。

e.en: Puerto {Rico} is a U.S. territory in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 波多黎各是加勒比海地区的美国领地。

ricochet.t:
n. 跳弹；反弹
v. 弹开；反弹

e.en: The bullet {ricochet}ed off the brick wall harmlessly.
e.zh: 子弹无害地从砖墙上反弹开来。

e.en: Watch the ball {ricochet} off the back wall in squash.
e.zh: 看那球在壁球比赛中从后墙弹回来。

ricocheting.t: v. 弹跳；反弹（ricochet 的现在分词）

e.en: Stray bullets were {ricocheting} dangerously around the alley.
e.zh: 流弹在巷子里危险地四处弹射。

e.en: The news kept {ricocheting} across social media all night.
e.zh: 这条新闻整夜在社交媒体上反复传播。

e.en: I spread fresh {ricotta} cheese on warm toast.
e.zh: 我把新鲜的乳清干酪抹在温热的吐司上。

e.en: This lasagna uses creamy {ricotta} between the layers.
e.zh: 这道千层面在每层之间夹了奶香的瑞可塔奶酪。

rics.t: n. 英国皇家特许测量师学会

e.en: He passed the {RICS} exam to become a chartered surveyor.
e.zh: 他通过了皇家特许测量师学会的考试,成为特许测量师。

e.en: The valuation was prepared according to {RICS} standards.
e.zh: 该估价是按照皇家特许测量师学会的标准编制的。

e.en: His face froze in a terrifying {rictus} of pain.
e.zh: 他的脸定格在痛苦的可怕僵笑中。

e.en: The clown's painted {rictus} grin scared the children.
e.zh: 小丑那张僵硬的咧嘴假笑吓到了孩子们。

e.en: I want to get {rid} of these old textbooks.
e.zh: 我想把这些旧课本处理掉。

e.en: The new filter helps {rid} the water of impurities.
e.zh: 新的过滤器有助于去除水中的杂质。

riddance.t: n. 摆脱；解除（常用 good riddance）

e.en: He finally quit, and good {riddance} to him!
e.zh: 他终于辞职了,真是谢天谢地!

e.en: Good {riddance} to that buggy old software update.
e.zh: 那个有bug的旧版软件总算下线了,真好。

ridden.t:
v. ride 的过去分词
adj. 充斥…的（如 debt-ridden）

e.en: She has {ridden} horses since she was a child.
e.zh: 她从小就开始骑马。

e.en: The neighborhood is {ridden} with potholes after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,这个街区到处都是坑洼。

e.en: Vin Diesel plays the antihero in the {Riddick} films.
e.zh: 范·迪塞尔在《星际传奇》系列电影中饰演反英雄角色。

e.en: Fans hope another {Riddick} sequel is in development.
e.zh: 粉丝们希望《星际传奇》还有续集在筹拍中。

ridding.t: v. 清除；摆脱（rid 的现在分词）

e.en: The city is {ridding} the parks of invasive plants.
e.zh: 市政府正在清除公园里的入侵植物。

e.en: He spent the weekend {ridding} the garage of junk.
e.zh: 他周末都在清理车库里的杂物。

riddle.t:
n. 谜语；难题
v. 布满（孔洞）

e.en: Can you solve this tricky {riddle} about a river?
e.zh: 你能解开这个关于河流的脑筋急转弯吗?

e.en: Her sudden disappearance remains a complete {riddle}.
e.zh: 她突然失踪一事至今仍是个谜。

riddled.t: adj. 布满（孔洞、问题等）的

e.en: The report was {riddled} with spelling errors.
e.zh: 这份报告里满是拼写错误。

e.en: The old fence was {riddled} with bullet holes.
e.zh: 那道旧栅栏上满是弹孔。

riddles.t:
n. 谜语（复数）
v. 使布满（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandfather loves telling clever {riddles} at dinner.
e.zh: 我爷爷喜欢在晚饭时讲一些机灵的谜语。

e.en: This puzzle book contains a hundred {riddles} for kids.
e.zh: 这本谜题书里包含了一百道儿童谜语。

riddling.t: v. 解谜；使布满（riddle 的现在分词）

e.en: Hailstones were {riddling} the metal roof loudly.
e.zh: 冰雹噼里啪啦地把金属屋顶砸得到处是坑。

e.en: The professor gave a {riddling} answer to my question.
e.zh: 教授对我的问题给了一个谜一样的回答。

ride.t:
v. 骑；乘坐
n. 乘车；游乐项目

e.en: I usually {ride} my bike to work in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我通常骑自行车去上班。

e.en: The Uber {ride} from the airport took an hour.
e.zh: 从机场打的Uber花了一个小时。

rider.t:
n. 骑手；乘客
n. 附加条款

e.en: The motorcycle {rider} wore a bright orange helmet.
e.zh: 那位摩托车手戴着一顶亮橙色头盔。

e.en: The contract included a {rider} about overtime pay.
e.zh: 合同里附加了一项关于加班工资的条款。

riderless.t: adj. 无人骑的；无骑手的

e.en: A {riderless} horse galloped down the dusty road.
e.zh: 一匹无人骑乘的马沿着尘土飞扬的小路飞奔。

e.en: The {riderless} bike had been abandoned by the river.
e.zh: 那辆没人骑的自行车被遗弃在河边。

e.en: All bus {riders} must wear masks during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段所有公交乘客都必须戴口罩。

e.en: The horse {riders} lined up at the starting gate.
e.zh: 骑手们在起点闸门前排成一列。

e.en: Subway {ridership} dropped sharply during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间地铁客流量急剧下降。

e.en: The new app boosted {ridership} on weekend buses.
e.zh: 这款新App提升了周末公交的乘客量。

rides.t:
v. ride 的第三人称单数
n. 游乐设施；车程

e.en: My daughter loves the spinning {rides} at the fair.
e.zh: 我女儿喜欢游乐场里那些旋转的游乐设施。

e.en: He {rides} the train into the city every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上乘火车进城。

e.en: We hiked along the mountain {ridge} until sunset.
e.zh: 我们沿着山脊徒步走到日落。

e.en: A high-pressure {ridge} is bringing dry, sunny weather.
e.zh: 一道高压脊带来了干燥晴朗的天气。

e.en: These boots have a thick, {ridged} rubber sole.
e.zh: 这双靴子有厚实的、带凸纹的橡胶底。

e.en: He ran his fingers over the {ridged} surface of the shell.
e.zh: 他用手指抚过贝壳上凹凸的纹路。

e.en: The carpenter set the {ridgepole} along the top of the roof.
e.zh: 木匠把脊檩架在了屋顶最高处。

e.en: A heavy snowfall snapped the cabin's wooden {ridgepole}.
e.zh: 一场大雪压断了小木屋的木制脊檩。

e.en: Ocean waves carved deep {ridges} in the sand.
e.zh: 海浪在沙地上刻出深深的波纹。

e.en: From the plane, we could see snow-covered {ridges} below.
e.zh: 从飞机上,我们能看到下方覆盖着白雪的山脊。

e.en: We pitched our tent on a windy {ridgetop} overlooking the valley.
e.zh: 我们把帐篷扎在俯瞰山谷的多风山脊顶上。

e.en: The trail follows a narrow {ridgetop} for several miles.
e.zh: 这条小径沿着狭窄的山脊顶端延伸了好几英里。

e.en: Ancient travelers used the {Ridgeway} path across southern England.
e.zh: 古时的旅人沿着脊路穿越英格兰南部。

e.en: We walked a stretch of the {Ridgeway} National Trail yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天走了一段脊路国家步道。

e.en: General {Ridgway} took command of the Eighth Army in Korea.
e.zh: 李奇微将军在朝鲜战场接管了第八集团军。

e.en: A statue of {Ridgway} stands at the military academy.
e.zh: 军校里矗立着一座李奇微的雕像。

ridicule.t:
v. 嘲笑；奚落
n. 嘲笑

e.en: He faced public {ridicule} after his embarrassing tweet.
e.zh: 那条尴尬的推文发出后,他遭到公众嘲笑。

e.en: Critics {ridicule}d the movie's silly plot online.
e.zh: 影评人在网上嘲讽这部电影荒唐的剧情。

ridiculed.t: v. 嘲笑（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Classmates {ridiculed} him for wearing mismatched socks.
e.zh: 同学们嘲笑他穿了两只不一样的袜子。

e.en: The proposal was {ridiculed} by the entire committee.
e.zh: 这项提案遭到了整个委员会的嘲笑。

e.en: That's the most {ridiculous} excuse I've ever heard.
e.zh: 这是我听过最荒唐的借口了。

e.en: Paying that much for a coffee is {ridiculous}.
e.zh: 花那么多钱买一杯咖啡真是太离谱了。

e.en: The new phone is {ridiculously} expensive for what it offers.
e.zh: 这款新手机的功能配不上它高得离谱的价格。

e.en: She finished the marathon {ridiculously} fast.
e.zh: 她以快得离谱的速度跑完了马拉松。

e.en: We laughed at the sheer {ridiculousness} of the situation.
e.zh: 我们都被这局面的荒唐程度逗笑了。

e.en: The show's charm lies in its cheerful {ridiculousness}.
e.zh: 这部剧的魅力就在于它欢乐的荒诞感。

riding.t:
n. 骑马；骑乘
v. ride 的现在分词

e.en: She enjoys {riding} her bike along the river path.
e.zh: 她喜欢沿着河边小路骑自行车。

e.en: The stock price is {riding} high after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报发布后,该公司股价一路走高。

e.en: {Ridley} Scott directed Blade Runner and Alien.
e.zh: 雷德利·斯科特执导了《银翼杀手》和《异形》。

e.en: The {Ridley} sea turtle is one of the smallest marine turtles.
e.zh: 丽龟是体型最小的海龟之一。

rids.t: v. 清除；使摆脱（rid 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This spray quickly {rids} your kitchen of ants.
e.zh: 这种喷雾能迅速清除厨房里的蚂蚁。

e.en: A hot shower {rids} me of the day's tension.
e.zh: 洗个热水澡能让我消除一天的紧张感。

e.en: She sang "Je ne regrette {rien}" at the cabaret.
e.zh: 她在歌舞表演上唱了《我无怨无悔》。

e.en: He shrugged and said "{rien}" when asked what was wrong.
e.zh: 被问到怎么了时,他耸耸肩说了句"没事"。

riesling.t: n. 雷司令（白葡萄酒/葡萄品种）

e.en: We ordered a chilled {Riesling} to go with dinner.
e.zh: 我们点了一瓶冰镇雷司令配晚餐。

e.en: German {Riesling} pairs beautifully with spicy Thai food.
e.zh: 德国雷司令搭配辛辣的泰国菜非常合适。

rievaulx.t: n. 里沃（英国修道院遗址）

e.en: We visited the ruins of {Rievaulx} Abbey in Yorkshire.
e.zh: 我们参观了约克郡的里沃修道院遗址。

e.en: {Rievaulx} was once one of England's greatest Cistercian monasteries.
e.zh: 里沃曾是英格兰最伟大的西多会修道院之一。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {rifampin} to treat the tuberculosis infection.
e.zh: 医生开了利福平来治疗结核感染。

e.en: Patients taking {rifampin} may notice their urine turning orange.
e.zh: 服用利福平的患者可能会发现尿液变成橙色。

e.en: The office is {rife} with rumors about the merger.
e.zh: 办公室里到处都是关于合并的传言。

e.en: Corruption was {rife} in the previous administration.
e.zh: 上届政府腐败盛行。

riff.t:
n. 即兴反复乐段
v. 即兴演奏

e.en: The guitarist played a catchy {riff} that everyone remembered.
e.zh: 吉他手弹了一段让所有人都记住的动听旋律。

e.en: The comedian did a hilarious {riff} on modern dating apps.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员对现代约会软件即兴发挥了一段搞笑段子。

riffle.t:
v. 快速翻动（书页）
n. 浅滩；急流

e.en: She began to {riffle} through the pages looking for the chapter.
e.zh: 她开始快速翻动书页寻找那一章。

e.en: The dealer expertly {riffled} the deck of cards.
e.zh: 发牌员熟练地洗了一副牌。

riffraff.t: n. 乌合之众；社会渣滓

e.en: The exclusive club kept the {riffraff} away from its members.
e.zh: 那家高级俱乐部把闲杂人等挡在了会员之外。

e.en: He dismissed the protesters as nothing but {riffraff}.
e.zh: 他把抗议者贬为不过是一群乌合之众。

rifle.t:
n. 步枪
v. 翻找；抢劫

e.en: The hunter carefully cleaned his {rifle} after the trip.
e.zh: 猎人在打猎归来后细心擦拭他的步枪。

e.en: Burglars began to {rifle} through the drawers searching for cash.
e.zh: 窃贼开始翻遍抽屉寻找现金。

rifled.t:
adj. (枪管) 有膛线的
v. 翻找；抢劫 (rifle 的过去式)

e.en: Someone {rifled} through my desk while I was at lunch.
e.zh: 我去吃午饭时有人翻遍了我的办公桌。

e.en: The thieves {rifled} the safe but found nothing valuable.
e.zh: 窃贼翻遍了保险箱却没找到值钱的东西。

e.en: The {rifleman} took aim from his position on the ridge.
e.zh: 那名步枪手在山脊上的阵地瞄准目标。

e.en: Each {rifleman} carried extra ammunition into the field.
e.zh: 每名步枪兵都带了额外的弹药进入战场。

e.en: Summer camp included swimming, archery, and {riflery}.
e.zh: 夏令营的项目包括游泳、射箭和步枪射击。

e.en: She won a medal in {riflery} at the regional competition.
e.zh: 她在地区比赛的步枪射击项目中赢得了一枚奖牌。

rifles.t:
n. 步枪（复数）
v. 翻找；抢劫

e.en: The soldiers cleaned their {rifles} before the morning drill.
e.zh: 士兵们在晨练前擦拭他们的步枪。

e.en: He {rifles} through his backpack looking for his keys.
e.zh: 他在背包里翻来翻去找钥匙。

e.en: He mounted a new {riflescope} for better long-range accuracy.
e.zh: 他装上了一个新的瞄准镜以提高远距离精度。

e.en: The {riflescope} fogged up in the cold morning air.
e.zh: 瞄准镜在清晨的寒气中起了雾。

rifling.t:
n. 膛线；来复线
v. 翻找 (现在分词)

e.en: The {rifling} inside the barrel makes the bullet spin accurately.
e.zh: 枪管内的膛线使子弹精准地旋转飞行。

e.en: I caught him {rifling} through my private papers.
e.zh: 我抓到他正在翻我的私人文件。

rift.t:
n. 裂缝；分歧
v. 使分裂

e.en: A serious {rift} developed between the two co-founders.
e.zh: 两位联合创始人之间出现了严重的裂痕。

e.en: Geologists studied the deep {rift} along the ocean floor.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了海床上那道深深的裂谷。

rifting.t: n. (地质) 裂谷作用；断裂

e.en: Continental {rifting} eventually formed the Atlantic Ocean.
e.zh: 大陆的张裂最终形成了大西洋。

e.en: Scientists detect ongoing {rifting} beneath East Africa.
e.zh: 科学家探测到东非地下持续发生的地壳张裂。

e.en: Political {rifts} have divided the once-united party.
e.zh: 政治分歧已经让这个曾团结的政党四分五裂。

e.en: Volcanic activity often occurs along oceanic {rifts}.
e.zh: 火山活动经常发生在海洋裂谷沿线。

rig.t:
v. 操纵；装配
n. 钻井平台；装置

e.en: They tried to {rig} the election by stuffing ballot boxes.
e.zh: 他们企图通过往投票箱塞选票来操纵选举。

e.en: The oil {rig} stood tall against the gray ocean horizon.
e.zh: 那座钻油平台高耸地矗立在灰蒙蒙的海平线上。

riga.t: n. 里加（拉脱维亚首都）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring the old town of {Riga}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个长周末游览里加的老城区。

e.en: {Riga} is the capital and largest city of Latvia.
e.zh: 里加是拉脱维亚的首都和最大城市。

rigatoni.t: n. 波纹管状意大利面

e.en: She ordered the {rigatoni} with spicy tomato sauce.
e.zh: 她点了配辣番茄酱的粗管面。

e.en: Baked {rigatoni} is a comforting weeknight dinner.
e.zh: 焗烤粗管面是平日晚餐的温暖之选。

rigged.t:
adj. 被操纵的；作弊的
v. 装配；暗中操纵

e.en: Many people believe the system is {rigged} against newcomers.
e.zh: 很多人认为这个系统对新人来说就是被操纵的。

e.en: They {rigged} up a temporary shelter using tarps and rope.
e.zh: 他们用防水布和绳子临时搭起了一个庇护所。

e.en: The {rigger} secured the cables before the crane lifted the load.
e.zh: 索具工在起重机吊起货物前把缆绳固定好。

e.en: An experienced {rigger} is essential for film stunt safety.
e.zh: 经验丰富的索具技师对电影特技安全至关重要。

rigging.t:
n. 船上索具
v. 操纵；装配

e.en: Sailors checked the {rigging} carefully before leaving the harbor.
e.zh: 水手们在离港前仔细检查了船上的索具。

e.en: He was charged with {rigging} bids on government contracts.
e.zh: 他被指控操纵政府合同的投标。

right.t:
adj. 正确的；右边的
n. 权利

e.en: Turn {right} at the next traffic light to reach the museum.
e.zh: 在下一个红绿灯右转就能到达博物馆。

e.en: You have the {right} to remain silent during questioning.
e.zh: 在审讯中你有权保持沉默。

e.en: She is the CEO's {right-hand} woman and trusted advisor.
e.zh: 她是首席执行官的得力助手和信任的顾问。

e.en: The settings menu is in the top {right-hand} corner.
e.zh: 设置菜单在屏幕右上角。

e.en: He felt {righteous} anger after seeing the injustice firsthand.
e.zh: 亲眼目睹不公后,他感到一种义愤填膺。

e.en: That guitar solo was absolutely {righteous}, dude!
e.zh: 老兄,那段吉他独奏简直棒极了!

e.en: She {righteously} refused to participate in the cover-up.
e.zh: 她义正词严地拒绝参与这场掩盖行动。

e.en: The activist spoke {righteously} about workers' rights.
e.zh: 那位活动人士理直气壮地谈论工人的权利。

e.en: His sense of {righteousness} sometimes made him insufferable.
e.zh: 他的正义感有时让人难以忍受。

e.en: The sermon emphasized humility over self-{righteousness}.
e.zh: 那篇布道强调谦卑胜过自以为是。

e.en: The philosopher contrasted competing {righteousnesses} across cultures.
e.zh: 那位哲学家比较了不同文化中相互冲突的正义观念。

e.en: Different religions promote different {righteousnesses} as ideals.
e.zh: 不同宗教将不同的正义理念奉为理想。

e.en: After years of dispute, she finally received her {rightful} inheritance.
e.zh: 经过多年纷争,她终于得到了她应得的遗产。

e.en: The painting was returned to its {rightful} owner.
e.zh: 那幅画被归还给了它的合法主人。

e.en: The land {rightfully} belongs to the indigenous community.
e.zh: 这片土地理应属于当地原住民社区。

e.en: Customers were {rightfully} angry about the hidden fees.
e.zh: 顾客对那些隐藏费用感到愤怒是有道理的。

e.en: Place the cursor in the {righthand} column to start typing.
e.zh: 把光标放在右栏开始输入。

e.en: He is the manager's {righthand} man for daily operations.
e.zh: 他是经理日常运营中的得力助手。

rightist.t:
n. 右翼分子
adj. 右派的

e.en: The newspaper has a clearly {rightist} editorial slant.
e.zh: 那家报纸的社论倾向明显偏右。

e.en: A {rightist} candidate won the recent presidential election.
e.zh: 一位右翼候选人赢得了最近的总统选举。

e.en: Critics {rightly} pointed out flaws in the new design.
e.zh: 评论家正确地指出了新设计的缺陷。

e.en: She was {rightly} proud of her son's achievements.
e.zh: 她为儿子的成就感到自豪是理所应当的。

e.en: Click the {rightmost} button to submit the form.
e.zh: 点击最右边的按钮提交表单。

e.en: The {rightmost} column shows the total revenue per month.
e.zh: 最右边的一列显示每月的总收入。

e.en: He never doubted the {rightness} of his decision to leave.
e.zh: 他从不怀疑自己离开的决定是正确的。

e.en: The jury debated the moral {rightness} of the verdict.
e.zh: 陪审团讨论了这一判决在道德上是否正当。

e.en: "{Righto}, I'll meet you at the pub at seven," he replied.
e.zh: “好的,我七点在酒吧等你,”他回答道。

e.en: "{Righto}, let's get this project finished today," said the boss.
e.zh: “好嘞,我们今天把这个项目搞定,”老板说道。

rights.t:
n. 权利（复数）
v. 扶正

e.en: Workers fought hard to secure their basic labor {rights}.
e.zh: 工人们努力争取他们的基本劳动权利。

e.en: The studio bought the film {rights} to her bestselling novel.
e.zh: 那家制片公司买下了她畅销小说的电影改编权。

rightward.t:
adv. 向右
adj. 向右的

e.en: Public opinion has shifted {rightward} over the past decade.
e.zh: 公众舆论在过去十年里向右倾斜。

e.en: The bird made a sudden {rightward} turn in midair.
e.zh: 那只鸟在半空中突然向右转向。

e.en: Drag the slider {rightwards} to increase the volume.
e.zh: 把滑块向右拖动可以增大音量。

e.en: The country's politics have drifted steadily {rightwards}.
e.zh: 该国的政治稳步向右倾。

e.en: The school enforces a {rigid} dress code without exceptions.
e.zh: 这所学校实行严格的着装要求,毫无例外。

e.en: The frame is made of {rigid} carbon fiber for durability.
e.zh: 框架由坚硬的碳纤维制成,以确保耐用性。

e.en: The {rigidity} of the company's policies frustrated many employees.
e.zh: 公司政策的死板让许多员工感到沮丧。

e.en: Engineers tested the {rigidity} of the new bridge materials.
e.zh: 工程师测试了新桥梁材料的刚性。

e.en: He {rigidly} adhered to the schedule despite the bad weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气恶劣,他仍严格按照时间表行事。

e.en: The soldier stood {rigidly} at attention before the general.
e.zh: 士兵在将军面前笔直地立正站好。

e.en: I had to go through the whole {rigmarole} of resetting my password.
e.zh: 我不得不经历整个繁琐的过程来重置密码。

e.en: Booking a flight shouldn't involve so much {rigmarole}.
e.zh: 订机票不应该这么麻烦。

e.en: We watched a stunning performance of {Rigoletto} at La Scala.
e.zh: 我们在斯卡拉歌剧院观看了一场精彩的《弄臣》演出。

e.en: Verdi composed {Rigoletto} based on a play by Victor Hugo.
e.zh: 威尔第根据维克多·雨果的戏剧创作了歌剧《弄臣》。

e.en: The research was conducted with scientific {rigor} and care.
e.zh: 这项研究是以严谨的科学态度进行的。

e.en: Students struggled with the academic {rigor} of the program.
e.zh: 学生们对该课程的学术严苛感到吃力。

e.en: All new hires undergo {rigorous} training before starting work.
e.zh: 所有新员工在上岗前都要接受严格的培训。

e.en: The study followed a {rigorous} methodology to ensure validity.
e.zh: 该研究遵循严谨的方法论以确保结果的可靠性。

e.en: The hypothesis was {rigorously} tested in multiple laboratories.
e.zh: 该假设在多个实验室中得到了严格的验证。

e.en: She {rigorously} reviewed every line of the contract.
e.zh: 她仔细严格地审阅了合同的每一行。

rigour.t: n. 严格（rigor 的英式拼写）

e.en: The journal demands academic {rigour} from every submission.
e.zh: 该期刊要求每篇投稿都具备学术严谨性。

e.en: She approached the investigation with the {rigour} of a detective.
e.zh: 她以侦探般的严谨态度展开调查。

e.en: Don't let his rude comments {rile} you up before the meeting.
e.zh: 别让他粗鲁的话在开会前把你惹火。

e.en: The unfair decision will {rile} the entire community.
e.zh: 这个不公平的决定会激怒整个社区。

riled.t:
adj. 被激怒的
v. 激怒 (过去式)

e.en: The referee's bad call {riled} the home crowd.
e.zh: 裁判的错判惹恼了主场观众。

e.en: She got really {riled} up over the broken promise.
e.zh: 她因为那个被打破的承诺而非常生气。

riley.t:
n. 赖利（姓氏）
adj. 浑浊的

e.en: The horse got {riley} when strangers approached the stable.
e.zh: 陌生人靠近马厩时,那匹马变得焦躁不安。

e.en: Customers grew {riley} after waiting an hour for service.
e.zh: 顾客等了一个小时还没人服务,变得很不耐烦。

e.en: A small {rill} trickled down the mossy hillside after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后一条小溪顺着长满青苔的山坡流下。

e.en: Children floated paper boats along the garden {rill}.
e.zh: 孩子们让纸船沿着花园的小水沟漂流。

e.en: Officer {Ripley} is the iconic hero of the Alien films.
e.zh: 雷普利中尉是《异形》系列电影中的经典英雄。

e.en: That bizarre fact sounds like something from {Ripley}'s Believe It or Not.
e.zh: 那个离奇的事实听起来像出自《里普利信不信由你》。

e.en: The cathedral in {Ripon} dates back to the seventh century.
e.zh: 里彭的大教堂可追溯至七世纪。

e.en: We stopped for tea in the market town of {Ripon}.
e.zh: 我们在集市小镇里彭停下来喝了茶。

riposte.t:
n. 机智的回击
v. 迅速反驳

e.en: Her witty {riposte} silenced the heckler immediately.
e.zh: 她机智的反击让起哄者立刻闭了嘴。

e.en: The fencer delivered a swift {riposte} after the parry.
e.zh: 击剑手在格挡后迅速回击。

ripped.t:
adj. 撕破的；肌肉发达的
v. rip 的过去式

e.en: He {ripped} the letter in half without reading it.
e.zh: 他没看就把信撕成了两半。

e.en: After months at the gym, he looks absolutely {ripped}.
e.zh: 在健身房泡了几个月后,他练得肌肉超级发达。

ripper.t: n. 开膛手；极棒的人或事物

e.en: That new song is an absolute {ripper}!
e.zh: 那首新歌简直太棒了!

e.en: Jack the {Ripper} remains one of history's most infamous mysteries.
e.zh: 开膛手杰克至今仍是历史上最臭名昭著的谜团之一。

ripping.t:
v. 撕扯（rip 的现在分词）
adj. 极好的

e.en: Stop {ripping} pages out of the notebook!
e.zh: 别再把笔记本里的页撕下来了!

e.en: They had a {ripping} good time at the carnival.
e.zh: 他们在嘉年华上玩得超级开心。

ripple.t:
n. 波纹，涟漪
v. 泛起涟漪

e.en: A small stone made a {ripple} across the pond.
e.zh: 一颗小石子在池塘上激起了一道涟漪。

e.en: The news will {ripple} through the entire industry.
e.zh: 这条消息将波及整个行业。

rippled.t:
v. 泛起波纹（ripple 的过去式）
adj. 有波纹的

e.en: The flag {rippled} gently in the afternoon breeze.
e.zh: 旗帜在午后的微风中轻轻飘动。

e.en: Laughter {rippled} through the crowd at her joke.
e.zh: 她的笑话引起人群中一阵阵笑声。

rippling.t:
v. 起涟漪（ripple 的现在分词）
adj. 波纹状的

e.en: Sunlight danced on the {rippling} surface of the lake.
e.zh: 阳光在波光粼粼的湖面上跳跃。

e.en: The policy change had {rippling} effects across departments.
e.zh: 政策变化在各部门间产生了连锁反应。

e.en: Engineers placed {riprap} along the riverbank to prevent erosion.
e.zh: 工程师在河岸边铺设乱石护坡以防止侵蚀。

e.en: The shoreline is protected by heavy granite {riprap}.
e.zh: 海岸线由厚重的花岗岩护堤石保护着。

rips.t:
v. 撕开（rip 的第三人称单数）
n. 裂口

e.en: My old jeans have several {rips} at the knees.
e.zh: 我那条旧牛仔裤膝盖处有好几个破洞。

e.en: She always {rips} open packages without checking the label.
e.zh: 她总是不看标签就把包裹撕开。

e.en: The tent is made from lightweight {ripstop} nylon.
e.zh: 这顶帐篷由轻巧的防撕裂尼龙制成。

e.en: His jacket uses {ripstop} fabric to resist tearing on hikes.
e.zh: 他的夹克采用防撕裂面料,徒步时不易破损。

e.en: Swimmers were warned about the dangerous {riptide} near the shore.
e.zh: 游泳者被警告小心岸边危险的离岸流。

e.en: He got caught in a {riptide} and had to swim sideways.
e.zh: 他被卷入离岸流，只能侧向游出。

risc.t: n. 精简指令集计算机（RISC）

e.en: Apple's M-series chips use a {RISC} architecture for efficiency.
e.zh: 苹果的M系列芯片采用精简指令集架构以提升能效。

e.en: {RISC} processors typically consume less power than older designs.
e.zh: 精简指令集处理器通常比旧架构更省电。

rise.t:
v. 上升，升起
n. 上涨，增加

e.en: Housing prices continue to {rise} in major cities.
e.zh: 大城市的房价持续上涨。

e.en: There has been a sharp {rise} in app downloads this year.
e.zh: 今年应用下载量出现大幅增长。

e.en: Streaming subscriptions have {risen} sharply since the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情以来流媒体订阅量大幅上升。

e.en: The sun had already {risen} when we reached the summit.
e.zh: 我们登顶时太阳已经升起。

riser.t: n. 起床者；立管；踢脚板

e.en: She's an early {riser} who jogs before sunrise.
e.zh: 她是个早起的人，日出前就去跑步。

e.en: Each stair {riser} should be the same height for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全，每级台阶的踢面高度应该一致。

rises.t:
v. 上升（rise 的第三人称单数）
n. 上涨（复数）

e.en: The temperature {rises} every afternoon during summer.
e.zh: 夏天每天下午气温都会升高。

e.en: Bread dough {rises} faster in a warm kitchen.
e.zh: 在温暖的厨房里面团发得更快。

e.en: His excuse for being late was frankly {risible}.
e.zh: 他迟到的借口实在可笑。

e.en: The CEO's {risible} claim was mocked online for days.
e.zh: 那位CEO可笑的说法在网上被嘲讽了好几天。

rising.t:
v. 上升中（rise 的现在分词）
adj. 上升的；新兴的

e.en: She's a {rising} star in the tech industry.
e.zh: 她是科技行业里崭露头角的明星。

e.en: Sea levels are {rising} faster than scientists predicted.
e.zh: 海平面上升速度比科学家预测的还快。

risk.t:
n. 风险
v. 冒…的风险

e.en: Investing in startups carries significant {risk}.
e.zh: 投资初创公司风险很大。

e.en: Don't {risk} your savings on a single stock.
e.zh: 不要把全部积蓄押在一只股票上。

risked.t: v. 冒险（risk 的过去式）

e.en: He {risked} his career to expose the scandal.
e.zh: 他冒着断送职业生涯的风险揭露了那起丑闻。

e.en: She {risked} everything to start her own company.
e.zh: 为了创业，她押上了一切。

e.en: Investors should consider the {riskiness} of crypto assets carefully.
e.zh: 投资者应认真考虑加密资产的风险性。

e.en: The report highlighted the {riskiness} of unsecured loans.
e.zh: 报告强调了无担保贷款的高风险性。

risking.t: v. 冒…的风险（risk 的现在分词）

e.en: He kept {risking} his savings on bad investments.
e.zh: 他一再把积蓄押在糟糕的投资上。

e.en: She's {risking} burnout by working seven days a week.
e.zh: 每周工作七天，她有过劳的风险。

e.en: There's no such thing as a truly {riskless} investment.
e.zh: 世上根本没有完全无风险的投资。

e.en: Government bonds are often described as nearly {riskless}.
e.zh: 政府债券常被形容为近乎无风险。

risks.t:
n. 风险（复数）
v. 冒险（第三人称单数）

e.en: Every entrepreneur takes calculated {risks} early on.
e.zh: 每个创业者在早期都会承担经过盘算的风险。

e.en: She always {risks} her health by skipping breakfast.
e.zh: 她总是不吃早餐，拿自己的健康冒险。

e.en: Quitting your job without savings is pretty {risky}.
e.zh: 没有存款就辞职相当冒险。

e.en: That trade looks too {risky} for a beginner.
e.zh: 那种交易对新手来说太冒险了。

e.en: She ordered mushroom {risotto} at the Italian restaurant.
e.zh: 她在那家意大利餐厅点了蘑菇烩饭。

e.en: Making creamy {risotto} requires constant stirring.
e.zh: 做出奶香浓郁的意式烩饭需要不停搅拌。

risque.t: adj. 近乎猥亵的，有伤风化的

e.en: His jokes were a bit too {risqué} for the meeting.
e.zh: 他的笑话在会议上有点儿过于露骨了。

e.en: The film was considered quite {risqué} for its time.
e.zh: 这部电影在当时被认为相当大胆。

e.en: Mum fried up a batch of beef {rissole} for dinner.
e.zh: 妈妈晚饭炸了一批牛肉煎肉饼。

e.en: The pub serves a popular lamb {rissole} with mash.
e.zh: 那家酒吧供应一道很受欢迎的羊肉煎饼配土豆泥。

e.en: Getting your driver's license is a teenage {rite} of passage.
e.zh: 考取驾照是青少年的一个成长仪式。

e.en: The ancient burial {rite} took place at dawn.
e.zh: 那场古老的葬礼仪式在黎明举行。

e.en: The temple still performs traditional {rites} every spring.
e.zh: 那座寺庙每年春天仍举行传统仪式。

e.en: Graduation ceremonies are modern {rites} of passage.
e.zh: 毕业典礼是现代的成长仪式。

ritter.t: n. 人名或姓氏；（德语）骑士

e.en: The German title "{Ritter}" roughly translates to "knight."
e.zh: 德语头衔"Ritter"大致可译为"骑士"。

e.en: He was awarded the rank of {Ritter} for his service.
e.zh: 因服役有功，他被授予骑士爵位。

ritual.t:
n. 仪式，例行程序
adj. 仪式性的

e.en: Her morning {ritual} includes coffee and meditation.
e.zh: 她每天早上的固定流程包括喝咖啡和冥想。

e.en: The wedding {ritual} has been passed down for centuries.
e.zh: 这种婚礼仪式已经流传了几个世纪。

ritualised.t:
adj. 仪式化的（英式拼写）
v. 使成仪式

e.en: Their tea-drinking has become a highly {ritualised} affair.
e.zh: 他们喝茶已经变成一件极具仪式感的事。

e.en: Office meetings can feel oddly {ritualised} and performative.
e.zh: 公司开会有时显得仪式化又流于表演。

ritualistic.t: adj. 仪式性的，例行公事的

e.en: He has a {ritualistic} approach to brewing his morning coffee.
e.zh: 他冲泡晨间咖啡有一套仪式般的流程。

e.en: The ceremony involved {ritualistic} chanting and dancing.
e.zh: 仪式上有仪式性的吟唱和舞蹈。

ritualistically.t: adv. 按仪式地，例行公事地

e.en: He {ritualistically} checks his phone the moment he wakes up.
e.zh: 他一醒来就仪式般地查看手机。

e.en: Fans {ritualistically} rewatch the finale every year.
e.zh: 粉丝们每年都仪式般地重看那集大结局。

e.en: The {ritualization} of coffee breaks helps team bonding.
e.zh: 将喝咖啡时间仪式化有助于增进团队感情。

e.en: Anthropologists study the {ritualization} of everyday behaviors.
e.zh: 人类学家研究日常行为的仪式化现象。

e.en: Many cultures {ritualize} the transition into adulthood.
e.zh: 许多文化将进入成年的过渡仪式化。

e.en: Try to {ritualize} your bedtime routine for better sleep.
e.zh: 试着把睡前流程仪式化，以改善睡眠。

ritualized.t:
adj. 被仪式化的
v. 仪式化（过去式）

e.en: Their morning meeting has become a {ritualized} habit.
e.zh: 他们的晨会已经变成一种仪式化的习惯。

e.en: Japanese tea ceremonies are highly {ritualized} events.
e.zh: 日本茶道是高度仪式化的活动。

e.en: He {ritually} wipes down his desk before starting work.
e.zh: 他每次开工前都仪式般地擦一遍桌子。

e.en: The shrine is {ritually} cleaned every full moon.
e.zh: 每逢满月，神社都会按仪式打扫一次。

e.en: Successful athletes often have pre-game {rituals}.
e.zh: 成功的运动员通常都有赛前的固定仪式。

e.en: Bedtime {rituals} help children fall asleep more easily.
e.zh: 睡前小仪式有助于孩子更容易入睡。

ritz.t: n. 丽思（酒店名）；奢华气派

e.en: They stayed at the {Ritz} during their Paris trip.
e.zh: 他们巴黎之行住在丽兹酒店。

e.en: The new rooftop bar has all the {ritz} of old Hollywood.
e.zh: 那家新开的顶楼酒吧充满老好莱坞的奢华气派。

e.en: They had dinner at a {ritzy} hotel downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家奢华的酒店吃了晚餐。

e.en: Her new neighborhood is way too {ritzy} for me.
e.zh: 她的新小区对我来说太高档了。

rival.t:
n. 竞争对手
v. 与…匹敌

e.en: Tesla's main {rival} in China is BYD.
e.zh: 特斯拉在中国的主要竞争对手是比亚迪。

e.en: Few smartphones {rival} the iPhone's camera quality.
e.zh: 很少有手机能与iPhone的拍照质量相媲美。

rivalrous.t: adj. 竞争性的；排他性的（经济学）

e.en: The two siblings have always been deeply {rivalrous}.
e.zh: 这两个兄弟姐妹一直存在很深的竞争关系。

e.en: Tech giants are increasingly {rivalrous} over AI talent.
e.zh: 科技巨头在AI人才方面的争夺越来越激烈。

e.en: The {rivalry} between Apple and Samsung drives innovation.
e.zh: 苹果与三星的竞争推动了创新。

e.en: Their friendly {rivalry} pushes both teams to improve.
e.zh: 他们之间友好的竞争促使两支队伍都不断进步。

rivals.t:
n. 对手（复数）
v. 与…匹敌

e.en: Their startup quickly outpaced its main {rivals}.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司迅速超过了主要竞争对手。

e.en: This phone's camera {rivals} much pricier models.
e.zh: 这款手机的相机可与许多更贵的机型相媲美。

e.en: Lightning can {rive} a tall oak tree in seconds.
e.zh: 闪电几秒之内就能劈裂一棵高大的橡树。

e.en: Political scandals continue to {rive} the small party.
e.zh: 政治丑闻不断撕裂着这个小党。

e.en: The country remains {riven} by deep political divisions.
e.zh: 这个国家仍因深刻的政治分歧而四分五裂。

e.en: The community was {riven} by the controversial decision.
e.zh: 这个社区因那项有争议的决定而分裂。

e.en: They kayaked down the {river} on a sunny morning.
e.zh: 一个晴朗的早晨，他们划着皮艇顺河而下。

e.en: The {river} flooded after three days of heavy rain.
e.zh: 连下三天大雨后，那条河发了洪水。

e.en: We had a picnic on the grassy {riverbank}.
e.zh: 我们在长满青草的河岸上野餐。

e.en: Erosion has worn away much of the {riverbank}.
e.zh: 侵蚀已经把河岸冲掉了大半。

e.en: During the drought, the {riverbed} was completely dry.
e.zh: 干旱期间，河床完全干涸了。

e.en: Smooth stones lined the shallow {riverbed}.
e.zh: 光滑的石头铺满了浅浅的河床。

e.en: They took a {riverboat} cruise along the Mississippi.
e.zh: 他们乘河船游览了密西西比河。

e.en: The old {riverboat} has been converted into a hotel.
e.zh: 那艘老河船已被改造成酒店。

e.en: The new {riverfront} apartments offer stunning sunset views.
e.zh: 这片新建的河滨公寓拥有绝美的落日景观。

e.en: They renovated the {riverfront} into a vibrant park.
e.zh: 他们把这片河滨地带改造成了一座充满活力的公园。

e.en: The reserve protects fragile {riverine} ecosystems.
e.zh: 该保护区守护着脆弱的河流生态系统。

e.en: Many bird species depend on healthy {riverine} habitats.
e.zh: 许多鸟类依赖健康的河岸栖息地生存。

e.en: Pollution is destroying many of Asia's {rivers}.
e.zh: 污染正在毁掉亚洲许多河流。

e.en: Several major {rivers} originate in the Tibetan Plateau.
e.zh: 多条主要河流发源于青藏高原。

riverside.t:
n. 河畔
adj. 河边的

e.en: We rented a small cottage on the {riverside}.
e.zh: 我们在河边租了一间小屋。

e.en: They opened a trendy {riverside} cafe last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天开了一家时髦的河畔咖啡馆。

e.en: The ancient {riverway} once carried trade goods inland.
e.zh: 这条古老的水路曾把货物运往内陆。

e.en: Authorities are dredging the {riverway} to improve shipping.
e.zh: 当局正在疏浚这条航道，以改善航运。

rivet.t:
n. 铆钉
v. 铆接；吸引（注意）

e.en: Each {rivet} on the bridge was inspected for cracks.
e.zh: 桥上每一颗铆钉都被检查是否有裂纹。

e.en: The dramatic finale will {rivet} viewers to their seats.
e.zh: 那个戏剧性的结局会让观众目不转睛。

riveted.t: adj. 全神贯注的；被吸引住的

e.en: Audiences were {riveted} by her keynote speech.
e.zh: 听众被她的主旨演讲深深吸引。

e.en: He stood {riveted} as the rocket lifted off.
e.zh: 火箭升空时他目不转睛地站在那儿。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {riveter} on warships.
e.zh: 他爷爷曾在军舰上当铆工。

e.en: The pneumatic {riveter} sped up assembly on the line.
e.zh: 气动铆钉枪加快了流水线上的装配速度。

riveting.t: adj. 扣人心弦的；引人入胜的

e.en: The documentary was absolutely {riveting} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那部纪录片从头到尾都扣人心弦。

e.en: She gave a {riveting} speech at the conference yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天在会议上做了一场精彩的演讲。

riviera.t: n. 里维埃拉（地中海沿岸度假胜地）

e.en: They spent the summer on the French {Riviera}.
e.zh: 他们在法国蔚蓝海岸度过了夏天。

e.en: The Italian {Riviera} attracts millions of tourists each year.
e.zh: 意大利里维埃拉每年吸引数百万游客。

rivoli.t: n. 里沃利（巴黎街名/地名）

e.en: We strolled down Rue de {Rivoli} in central Paris.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎市中心的里沃利街上散步。

e.en: The Battle of {Rivoli} was a key Napoleonic victory.
e.zh: 里沃利战役是拿破仑的一次关键胜利。

e.en: A small {rivulet} ran through the mossy forest floor.
e.zh: 一条小溪穿过长满青苔的林地。

e.en: Sweat formed a {rivulet} down his tired face.
e.zh: 汗水顺着他疲惫的脸流成一道细流。

riyadh.t: n. 利雅得（沙特阿拉伯首都）

e.en: {Riyadh} is the capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia.
e.zh: 利雅得是沙特阿拉伯的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our flight to {Riyadh} departs early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们飞往利雅得的航班明天一早起飞。

e.en: {Rizzo} is the tough-talking leader in the musical Grease.
e.zh: 丽佐是音乐剧《油脂》中说话强势的头儿。

e.en: The character {Rizzo} steals every scene she appears in.
e.zh: 丽佐这个角色在每一幕中都抢尽风头。

rmc.t: n. RMC（缩写，常指皇家军事学院等）

rmi.t: n. 远程方法调用（Java RMI）

e.en: I saw a {roach} skitter across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 我看见一只蟑螂从厨房地板上窜过。

e.en: The exterminator promised to eliminate every {roach} in the building.
e.zh: 灭虫工承诺消灭楼里每一只蟑螂。

e.en: The {road} to the airport was blocked by traffic.
e.zh: 通往机场的路被交通堵塞。

e.en: Learning a new language is a long {road}.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言是一段漫长的路程。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the {roadbed} before laying fresh asphalt.
e.zh: 工程师在铺新沥青前加固了路基。

e.en: Heavy rain washed away part of the railway {roadbed}.
e.zh: 暴雨冲毁了部分铁路路基。

e.en: Police set up a {roadblock} to catch the suspect.
e.zh: 警方设置路障以抓捕嫌犯。

e.en: Funding remains the biggest {roadblock} to launching the project.
e.zh: 资金仍是项目启动的最大障碍。

e.en: We stopped at a {roadhouse} for burgers and beer.
e.zh: 我们在一家路边小馆停下来吃汉堡喝啤酒。

e.en: The old {roadhouse} hosts live country music every weekend.
e.zh: 那家老路边酒馆每个周末都有现场乡村音乐。

roadie.t: n. 巡回演出技术人员

e.en: He worked as a {roadie} for the band on tour.
e.zh: 巡演期间他给乐队当随队工作人员。

e.en: Every {roadie} on the crew helped set up the stage.
e.zh: 剧组的每一位巡演助理都帮忙搭建了舞台。

e.en: We swerved to avoid a piece of {roadkill}.
e.zh: 我们急转弯避开了一具被压死的动物尸体。

e.en: Vultures were feasting on {roadkill} beside the highway.
e.zh: 秃鹫正在高速公路旁啃食被压死的动物。

roadless.t: adj. 无道路的；未通路的

e.en: The hikers ventured into a {roadless} wilderness area.
e.zh: 徒步者进入了一片没有道路的荒野地区。

e.en: Conservationists fought to protect the {roadless} forests from logging.
e.zh: 环保人士努力保护无路森林免遭砍伐。

e.en: The CEO shared the product {roadmap} for next year.
e.zh: 首席执行官分享了明年的产品路线图。

e.en: This guide offers a clear {roadmap} for beginners.
e.zh: 这本指南为初学者提供了清晰的路线图。

roadrunner.t: n. 走鹃（一种善跑的鸟）

e.en: A {roadrunner} darted across the desert highway.
e.zh: 一只走鹃飞快地穿过沙漠公路。

e.en: The cartoon {roadrunner} always outsmarts the hungry coyote.
e.zh: 动画片里的走鹃总能智胜饥饿的郊狼。

e.en: Snow made the mountain {roads} dangerous to drive on.
e.zh: 积雪让山路变得很危险。

e.en: Many country {roads} are unpaved and full of potholes.
e.zh: 许多乡村道路没有铺砌且坑洼不平。

e.en: The startup launched a global {roadshow} to attract investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司启动了全球路演以吸引投资者。

e.en: Their tech {roadshow} stops in five cities this month.
e.zh: 他们的科技巡展本月将在五个城市停留。

roadside.t:
n. 路边
adj. 路旁的

e.en: We bought fresh peaches from a {roadside} stand.
e.zh: 我们在路边摊买了新鲜的桃子。

e.en: His car broke down on the {roadside} late at night.
e.zh: 他的车深夜在路边抛锚了。

e.en: Wildflowers bloom along the {roadsides} every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天野花都会沿着路边盛开。

e.en: Volunteers cleared litter from the {roadsides} all weekend.
e.zh: 志愿者整个周末都在清理路边的垃圾。

e.en: He drove a vintage {roadster} along the coastal highway.
e.zh: 他开着一辆复古双座敞篷跑车沿海岸公路行驶。

e.en: The new electric {roadster} accelerates from zero to sixty fast.
e.zh: 这款新电动跑车从零加速到六十迈非常快。

rille.t: n. 月溪，月球表面的细长沟槽

e.en: The astronauts photographed a long {rille} on the lunar surface.
e.zh: 宇航员拍下了月球表面一条长长的月溪。

e.en: This {rille} was likely carved by ancient lava flows.
e.zh: 这条月溪很可能是远古熔岩流冲刷形成的。

rim.t:
n. 边缘，轮圈
v. 镶边

e.en: She wiped the {rim} of her coffee cup with a napkin.
e.zh: 她用纸巾擦了擦咖啡杯的杯沿。

e.en: The basketball bounced off the {rim} and missed the net.
e.zh: 篮球弹到篮筐边上,没能进网。

rime.t:
n. 白霜，雾凇
n. 押韵（古体）

e.en: A thin {rime} of frost covered the morning windshield.
e.zh: 清晨的挡风玻璃上覆盖着一层薄薄的白霜。

e.en: The poem's {rime} scheme follows a strict pattern.
e.zh: 这首诗的押韵格式遵循严格的规则。

rimini.t: n. 里米尼（意大利城市）

e.en: We spent the summer holiday on the beaches of {Rimini}.
e.zh: 我们在里米尼的海滩上度过了暑假。

e.en: {Rimini} is famous for its lively nightlife and Adriatic coast.
e.zh: 里米尼以热闹的夜生活和亚得里亚海岸而闻名。

e.en: He prefers {rimless} glasses because they look almost invisible.
e.zh: 他喜欢无框眼镜,因为戴上去几乎看不见。

e.en: The designer chose {rimless} frames for a minimalist look.
e.zh: 设计师选用无框设计,营造极简风格。

e.en: Her eyes were red-{rimmed} from crying all night.
e.zh: 她哭了一整夜,眼圈都红了。

e.en: The plate was {rimmed} with delicate gold trim.
e.zh: 盘子的边缘镶着精致的金边。

e.en: Hikers climbed up to the {rimrock} for a sunset view.
e.zh: 徒步者爬上崖顶岩石观赏日落。

e.en: The trail winds along the {rimrock} above the canyon.
e.zh: 小径沿着峡谷上方的崖边岩石蜿蜒延伸。

e.en: He bought new alloy {rims} for his car.
e.zh: 他给自己的车买了新的合金轮毂。

e.en: Salt {rims} the edge of a classic margarita glass.
e.zh: 经典玛格丽特酒杯的杯口沾着一圈盐。

rind.t: n. 果皮，外皮（水果、奶酪）

e.en: Don't throw away the lemon {rind}—you can zest it.
e.zh: 别扔柠檬皮,可以用来刨皮屑。

e.en: The cheese has a thick, edible {rind}.
e.zh: 这种奶酪外层有一层厚厚的、可食用的外皮。

e.en: {Rinderpest} was officially declared eradicated worldwide in 2011.
e.zh: 牛瘟于2011年被正式宣布全球根除。

e.en: Outbreaks of {rinderpest} once devastated cattle herds across Africa.
e.zh: 牛瘟疫情曾使非洲各地的牛群损失惨重。

ring.t:
n. 戒指，环形
v. 响铃，打电话

e.en: He gave her a diamond {ring} on their anniversary.
e.zh: 在结婚纪念日他送了她一枚钻戒。

e.en: Please {ring} me when you arrive at the station.
e.zh: 你到车站时请给我打个电话。

e.en: Saturn is {ringed} by a stunning system of icy particles.
e.zh: 土星被一圈壮观的冰粒环系所环绕。

e.en: Police {ringed} the building during the standoff.
e.zh: 对峙期间警察将大楼团团围住。

ringer.t:
n. 酷似他人者
n. 敲钟人

e.en: She's a dead {ringer} for her older sister.
e.zh: 她和姐姐长得简直一模一样。

e.en: The team brought in a {ringer} to win the tournament.
e.zh: 球队请来一名外援高手来赢得比赛。

ringing.t:
n. 响声，鸣响
adj. 响亮的

e.en: My phone keeps {ringing} during the meeting.
e.zh: 我的手机在会议中一直响个不停。

e.en: The speech received a {ringing} endorsement from the audience.
e.zh: 这场演讲赢得了观众强烈的支持。

e.en: Police arrested the {ringleader} of the smuggling operation.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了走私团伙的主谋。

e.en: She was the {ringleader} behind the office prank.
e.zh: 办公室那场恶作剧的主谋就是她。

e.en: His {ringless} finger suggested he wasn't married.
e.zh: 他手指上没戴戒指,说明他没结婚。

e.en: She left the jewelry shop {ringless} but smiling.
e.zh: 她没买到戒指就离开了珠宝店,但还是笑着。

e.en: A blonde {ringlet} fell across her forehead.
e.zh: 一缕金色卷发垂落在她的额前。

e.en: The doll had perfect {ringlet} curls down its back.
e.zh: 那个洋娃娃背后垂着完美的螺旋卷发。

ringmaster.t: n. 马戏团表演主持人

e.en: The {ringmaster} announced each act in a booming voice.
e.zh: 马戏团主持人用洪亮的声音介绍每个节目。

e.en: As CEO, she acts like the {ringmaster} of the whole company.
e.zh: 身为CEO,她就像整个公司的总指挥。

ringo.t: n. 林戈（人名，如披头士鼓手）

e.en: {Ringo} Starr was the drummer for the Beatles.
e.zh: 林戈·斯塔尔是披头士乐队的鼓手。

e.en: My nephew named his puppy {Ringo} after his favorite Beatle.
e.zh: 我侄子以他最喜欢的披头士成员把小狗取名为林戈。

rings.t:
n. 戒指，环（复数）
v. 响铃（第三人称）

e.en: The doorbell {rings} every time a delivery arrives.
e.zh: 每次有快递送来,门铃都会响。

e.en: She wears two silver {rings} on her right hand.
e.zh: 她右手戴着两枚银戒指。

ringside.t: n. 拳台边座位，近距离观看处

e.en: We had {ringside} seats for the championship boxing match.
e.zh: 我们在拳王争霸赛上拿到了拳台旁的座位。

e.en: Reporters watched the negotiations from a {ringside} view.
e.zh: 记者们在最近距离观看了这场谈判。

e.en: He grew up in a small town called {Ringwood}.
e.zh: 他在一个叫林伍德的小镇长大。

e.en: The {Ringwood} estate is open to visitors on weekends.
e.zh: 林伍德庄园周末对游客开放。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed the rash as {ringworm} from the cat.
e.zh: 医生诊断这块皮疹是被猫传染的癣。

e.en: {Ringworm} is highly contagious among children at daycare.
e.zh: 癣在托儿所的孩子之间传染性很强。

e.en: The kids skated for hours at the ice {rink}.
e.zh: 孩子们在溜冰场滑了好几个小时。

e.en: Our local roller {rink} hosts disco nights every Friday.
e.zh: 我们当地的旱冰场每周五晚上都有迪斯科之夜。

rinse.t:
v. 冲洗，漂洗
n. 漂洗

e.en: Please {rinse} the dishes before loading the dishwasher.
e.zh: 放进洗碗机之前请先把碗冲一下。

e.en: Use a vinegar {rinse} to make your hair shinier.
e.zh: 用醋水冲洗一下能让头发更有光泽。

e.en: She {rinsed} the lettuce thoroughly under cold water.
e.zh: 她用冷水把生菜彻底冲洗干净。

e.en: He {rinsed} his mouth after brushing his teeth.
e.zh: 他刷完牙后漱了口。

rinsing.t:
v. 冲洗（进行时）
n. 漂洗液

e.en: I'm {rinsing} the soap out of my hair right now.
e.zh: 我正在把头发上的洗发水冲干净。

e.en: After {rinsing} the vegetables, pat them dry with a towel.
e.zh: 蔬菜冲洗过后,用毛巾轻轻拍干。

e.en: Carnival in {Rio} attracts millions of tourists every year.
e.zh: 里约的狂欢节每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: We watched the sunset over Copacabana beach in {Rio}.
e.zh: 我们在里约的科帕卡巴纳海滩看了日落。

rioja.t: n. 里奥哈（西班牙葡萄酒产区）

e.en: He poured a glass of aged {Rioja} with dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时他倒了一杯陈年里奥哈红酒。

e.en: This {Rioja} pairs beautifully with grilled lamb.
e.zh: 这款里奥哈葡萄酒与烤羊肉非常搭配。

riot.t:
n. 暴乱，骚乱
v. 闹事

e.en: Police struggled to control the {riot} downtown.
e.zh: 警方艰难地控制住了市中心的骚乱。

e.en: The garden was a {riot} of color in late spring.
e.zh: 暮春时节花园里一片缤纷的色彩。

e.en: A {rioter} smashed the storefront window with a brick.
e.zh: 一名暴徒用砖头砸碎了店铺的橱窗。

e.en: Each {rioter} arrested was charged with property damage.
e.zh: 每名被逮捕的暴乱者都被指控破坏财物。

rioting.t:
n. 骚乱，暴动
v. 闹事（进行时）

e.en: {Rioting} broke out after the controversial verdict.
e.zh: 在那个有争议的判决之后爆发了骚乱。

e.en: The city imposed a curfew to stop the {rioting}.
e.zh: 该市实施宵禁以制止骚乱。

e.en: The comedy show was a {riotous} success with the audience.
e.zh: 那场喜剧演出大获观众欢迎,场面热烈。

e.en: The market burst into a {riotous} mix of colors and smells.
e.zh: 市场上充满了缤纷的色彩与杂乱的气味。

e.en: The kids laughed {riotously} at the clown's antics.
e.zh: 孩子们看着小丑的滑稽动作笑得前仰后合。

e.en: The wildflowers grew {riotously} along the country road.
e.zh: 野花沿着乡间小路恣意地疯长。

e.en: The protest escalated into {riots} that lasted three nights.
e.zh: 抗议升级为持续三个晚上的骚乱。

e.en: History books detail the {riots} that shook the city in 1968.
e.zh: 历史书详细记述了1968年震撼这座城市的暴动。

rip.t:
v. 撕裂，扯开
n. 裂口

e.en: Be careful not to {rip} the wrapping paper.
e.zh: 小心别把包装纸撕破了。

e.en: There's a small {rip} in the knee of my jeans.
e.zh: 我牛仔裤的膝盖处有个小破口。

e.en: The new law protects {riparian} habitats along the river.
e.zh: 新法律保护河岸沿线的栖息地。

e.en: Farmers must respect {riparian} rights when drawing water.
e.zh: 农民取水时必须遵守河岸权利。

e.en: The skydiver pulled the {ripcord} at five thousand feet.
e.zh: 跳伞员在五千英尺高度拉下了开伞索。

e.en: He yanked the {ripcord} just in time to slow his fall.
e.zh: 他及时拉动开伞索,放慢了下落的速度。

e.en: These mangoes are perfectly {ripe} and ready to eat.
e.zh: 这些芒果熟得正好,可以吃了。

e.en: The market is {ripe} for a disruptive new product.
e.zh: 这个市场已经成熟,正适合推出颠覆性的新产品。

e.en: Tomatoes {ripen} faster on a sunny windowsill.
e.zh: 番茄放在阳光充足的窗台上熟得更快。

e.en: Give the avocados a few days to {ripen} on the counter.
e.zh: 把牛油果放在台面上几天让它们变熟。

ripened.t:
adj. 已成熟的
v. 成熟（过去式）

e.en: The peaches {ripened} beautifully during the warm weekend.
e.zh: 暖和的周末让桃子完美地成熟了。

e.en: Sun-{ripened} tomatoes taste much sweeter than store-bought ones.
e.zh: 日晒成熟的番茄比超市买的甜得多。

e.en: Squeeze the avocado gently to test its {ripeness}.
e.zh: 轻轻捏一下牛油果,测试它的成熟度。

e.en: The wine is judged on color, aroma, and {ripeness} of fruit.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒从色泽、香气和果实成熟度来评判。

ripening.t:
v. 成熟中（进行时）
n. 熟化

e.en: Bananas keep {ripening} even after you bring them home.
e.zh: 香蕉买回家之后还会继续成熟。

e.en: The {ripening} grapes glowed gold in the late afternoon sun.
e.zh: 成熟中的葡萄在傍晚的阳光下泛着金光。

e.en: The app handles errors {robustly} even on slow networks.
e.zh: 该应用即使在慢速网络下也能稳健地处理错误。

e.en: She {robustly} defended her research at the conference.
e.zh: 她在会议上有力地为自己的研究辩护。

e.en: We test the {robustness} of our code with random inputs.
e.zh: 我们用随机输入来测试代码的健壮性。

e.en: The bridge's {robustness} was proven during the storm.
e.zh: 这座桥的坚固性在风暴中得到了证明。

roc.t:
n. 大鹏鸟（神话中的巨鸟）
n. ROC 曲线（机器学习）

e.en: The legendary {roc} could supposedly carry off elephants.
e.zh: 传说中的大鹏鸟据说能叼走大象。

e.en: Sinbad encountered a giant {roc} on his second voyage.
e.zh: 辛巴达在第二次航行中遇到了一只巨大的大鹏。

rochdale.t: n. 罗奇代尔（英国城镇）

e.en: {Rochdale} is famous as the birthplace of the cooperative movement.
e.zh: 罗奇代尔以合作社运动的发源地而闻名。

e.en: She grew up in a small town near {Rochdale}.
e.zh: 她在罗奇代尔附近的一个小镇长大。

rochefort.t: n. 罗什福尔（法国城市）

e.en: {Rochefort} is a beautiful coastal town in western France.
e.zh: 罗什福尔是法国西部一座美丽的沿海小镇。

e.en: We tasted a strong Belgian {Rochefort} beer at the bar.
e.zh: 我们在酒吧品尝了一款浓郁的比利时罗什福尔啤酒。

e.en: {Rochelle} salt was once used in early radio crystals.
e.zh: 罗谢尔盐曾被用于早期的无线电晶体中。

e.en: La {Rochelle} is a charming port city on the Atlantic.
e.zh: 拉罗谢尔是大西洋沿岸一座迷人的港口城市。

e.en: {Rochester} is known for its long, snowy winters.
e.zh: 罗切斯特以漫长多雪的冬天而闻名。

e.en: Mr. {Rochester} is the brooding hero of Jane Eyre.
e.zh: 罗切斯特先生是《简爱》中那位忧郁的男主角。

rochford.t: n. 罗奇福德（英国地名）

e.en: {Rochford} is a small district in southeast Essex, England.
e.zh: 罗奇福德是英格兰埃塞克斯东南部的一个小区。

e.en: Anne Boleyn's brother held the title Viscount {Rochford}.
e.zh: 安妮·博林的哥哥曾持有罗奇福德子爵的头衔。

rock.t:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐
v. 摇动

e.en: She tripped over a loose {rock} on the trail.
e.zh: 她在小路上被一块松动的石头绊倒了。

e.en: My dad still listens to classic {rock} every weekend.
e.zh: 我爸每个周末还在听经典摇滚。

rockabilly.t: n. 山区摇滚（摇滚与乡村乐结合的风格）

e.en: He plays {rockabilly} guitar in a small basement club.
e.zh: 他在一家小型地下俱乐部弹奏山区摇滚吉他。

e.en: {Rockabilly} blends country music with early rock and roll.
e.zh: 山区摇滚融合了乡村音乐和早期的摇滚乐。

rockall.t: n. 罗科尔（北大西洋小岛）

e.en: {Rockall} is a tiny rocky islet in the North Atlantic.
e.zh: 罗科尔是北大西洋上一座小小的岩石小岛。

e.en: Several countries have disputed ownership of {Rockall}.
e.zh: 几个国家曾对罗科尔岛的归属存在争议。

rocked.t: v. 摇动；震惊（rock 过去式）

e.en: The earthquake {rocked} buildings across the entire city.
e.zh: 地震震动了整个城市的建筑物。

e.en: She {rocked} the baby gently until he fell asleep.
e.zh: 她轻轻地摇着宝宝,直到他睡着。

rockefeller.t: n. 洛克菲勒（美国家族姓氏）

e.en: {Rockefeller} built one of the largest fortunes in American history.
e.zh: 洛克菲勒积累了美国历史上最庞大的财富之一。

e.en: We skated under the giant tree at {Rockefeller} Center.
e.zh: 我们在洛克菲勒中心的大圣诞树下滑了冰。

e.en: Grandma fell asleep in her wooden {rocker} by the fire.
e.zh: 奶奶在火炉旁的木摇椅上睡着了。

e.en: He's an aging {rocker} who still tours every summer.
e.zh: 他是一位上了年纪的摇滚歌手,每年夏天仍在巡演。

e.en: The old {rockers} reunited for one final farewell tour.
e.zh: 那些老牌摇滚歌手重聚举办了最后一次告别巡演。

e.en: The porch had two wooden {rockers} facing the sunset.
e.zh: 门廊上有两把木摇椅正对着夕阳。

e.en: She built a small {rockery} with succulents in her garden.
e.zh: 她在花园里用多肉植物建了一个小假山园。

e.en: The {rockery} adds texture and color to the backyard.
e.zh: 这个假山园为后院增添了层次和色彩。

rocket.t:
n. 火箭
v. 飙升

e.en: The {rocket} launched successfully from Cape Canaveral this morning.
e.zh: 火箭今早从卡纳维拉尔角成功发射。

e.en: Housing prices have shot up like a {rocket} this year.
e.zh: 今年房价像火箭一样飞涨。

e.en: Every amateur {rocketeer} dreams of building a working spacecraft.
e.zh: 每个业余火箭爱好者都梦想着造出一艘真正的飞船。

e.en: The young {rocketeer} won first prize at the science fair.
e.zh: 那位年轻的火箭爱好者在科学展上获得了一等奖。

e.en: Energy prices are {rocketing} due to the supply shortage.
e.zh: 由于供应短缺,能源价格正在飞涨。

e.en: Her career has been {rocketing} since the viral interview.
e.zh: 自从那次爆红的采访后,她的事业一路飙升。

e.en: Modern {rocketry} owes much to the work of Robert Goddard.
e.zh: 现代火箭技术在很大程度上归功于罗伯特·戈达德的工作。

e.en: He's been fascinated by {rocketry} since he was a child.
e.zh: 他从小就对火箭技术着迷。

e.en: SpaceX has launched dozens of {rockets} in the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年里SpaceX已经发射了数十枚火箭。

e.en: Kids love watching {rockets} streak across the night sky.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢看火箭划过夜空。

e.en: The startup is a real {rocketship} growing ten percent monthly.
e.zh: 这家初创公司就像一艘火箭飞船,每月增长百分之十。

e.en: He drew a colorful {rocketship} flying past the moon.
e.zh: 他画了一艘色彩鲜艳的火箭飞船飞过月亮。

e.en: The climbers slowly worked their way up the steep {rockface}.
e.zh: 攀岩者慢慢沿着陡峭的岩壁向上攀登。

e.en: A waterfall plunged dramatically down the sheer {rockface}.
e.zh: 一道瀑布壮观地从陡直的岩壁上倾泻而下。

e.en: The hiking trail was closed after a major {rockfall}.
e.zh: 在发生一次较大的落石后,徒步小径被关闭了。

e.en: Drivers should watch for {rockfall} on this mountain road.
e.zh: 司机在这条山路上要小心落石。

e.en: We caught several {rockfish} off the coast yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在海岸边钓到了好几条石斑鱼。

e.en: Pacific {rockfish} can live for over a hundred years.
e.zh: 太平洋石斑鱼的寿命可以超过一百年。

rocking.t:
adj. 摇晃的；超棒的
v. 摇动

e.en: She sat {rocking} the baby quietly in the nursery.
e.zh: 她坐在婴儿房里静静地摇着宝宝。

e.en: The band was absolutely {rocking} the stadium last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那支乐队简直嗨翻了整个体育场。

e.en: {Rockingham} Castle has stood in Northamptonshire for centuries.
e.zh: 罗金厄姆城堡矗立在北安普敦郡已有数百年。

e.en: We toured the historic {Rockingham} pottery factory last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们参观了历史悠久的罗金厄姆陶瓷工厂。

rocks.t:
n. 岩石（复数）
v. 摇动

e.en: Smooth {rocks} lined the riverbed where we went swimming.
e.zh: 我们游泳的河床上排着光滑的石头。

e.en: I'll have a whisky on the {rocks}, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一杯加冰块的威士忌。

e.en: A sudden {rockslide} blocked the highway for several hours.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的山体滑坡把高速公路堵了好几个小时。

e.en: Heavy rain triggered a dangerous {rockslide} on the mountain.
e.zh: 大雨在山上引发了一场危险的岩石滑坡。

rockwell.t: n. 洛克威尔（人名／硬度单位）

e.en: Norman {Rockwell} painted iconic scenes of American daily life.
e.zh: 诺曼·洛克威尔描绘了美国日常生活的经典场景。

e.en: The diner felt like a scene from a {Rockwell} painting.
e.zh: 那家餐馆感觉就像洛克威尔画作中的场景。

e.en: We hiked along a steep, {rocky} path to the summit.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条陡峭多石的小路徒步登顶。

e.en: Their marriage got off to a {rocky} start.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻一开始就磕磕绊绊。

rococo.t:
adj. 洛可可风格的
n. 洛可可艺术

e.en: The palace features ornate {rococo} decorations and gilded mirrors.
e.zh: 宫殿内饰有华丽的洛可可风格装饰和镀金镜子。

e.en: His writing style is overly {rococo} for modern readers.
e.zh: 他的写作风格对现代读者来说过于繁复华丽。

e.en: She {rode} her bike to school every morning last year.
e.zh: 去年她每天早上骑自行车上学。

e.en: We {rode} the subway across town to meet our friends.
e.zh: 我们坐地铁穿过市区去见朋友。

e.en: A small {rodent} scurried beneath the kitchen cabinet.
e.zh: 一只小啮齿动物从厨柜下面窜过。

e.en: Hamsters are popular pets in the {rodent} family.
e.zh: 仓鼠是啮齿类家族中很受欢迎的宠物。

e.en: Cowboys competed at the local {rodeo} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末牛仔们在当地的牛仔竞技赛上比拼。

e.en: This isn't my first {rodeo} dealing with tough clients.
e.zh: 应付难缠的客户对我来说不是第一次了。

e.en: {Rodin} sculpted The Thinker in the late nineteenth century.
e.zh: 罗丹在十九世纪末雕刻了《思想者》。

e.en: We visited the {Rodin} Museum during our trip to Paris.
e.zh: 巴黎之行中我们参观了罗丹博物馆。

e.en: Crews repaved the {roadway} after the harsh winter.
e.zh: 工人们在严冬之后重新铺设了路面。

e.en: Fallen branches blocked the entire {roadway} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后倒下的树枝堵塞了整条道路。

e.en: Expect delays due to {roadwork} on the highway.
e.zh: 由于公路施工,预计会出现延误。

e.en: The boxer started his daily {roadwork} before sunrise.
e.zh: 这位拳击手在日出前开始了每日的路跑训练。

e.en: The mechanic confirmed the old car is still {roadworthy}.
e.zh: 机械师确认这辆旧车仍然适合上路。

e.en: Make sure your vehicle is {roadworthy} before a long trip.
e.zh: 长途旅行前请确保你的车辆适合上路。

e.en: Wild horses still {roam} freely across these plains.
e.zh: 野马仍在这些平原上自由漫游。

e.en: Kids love to {roam} the neighborhood during summer break.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在暑假期间在社区里闲逛。

e.en: He was a born {roamer}, never staying in one city.
e.zh: 他天生是个漂泊者,从不在一个城市久留。

e.en: The dog is a notorious {roamer} who escapes the yard.
e.zh: 这只狗是出了名的爱乱跑,总从院子里跑出去。

roaming.t:
n. (手机) 漫游
v. 漫游中

e.en: Turn off data {roaming} before you travel abroad.
e.zh: 出国旅行前请关闭数据漫游。

e.en: Cattle were {roaming} freely across the open prairie.
e.zh: 牛群在开阔的草原上自由游荡。

roams.t: v. 漫游 (roam 第三人称单数)

e.en: A stray cat often {roams} around our backyard at night.
e.zh: 一只流浪猫晚上经常在我们后院游荡。

e.en: She {roams} the city with her camera on weekends.
e.zh: 周末她带着相机在城里到处闲逛。

roan.t:
n. 花斑马
adj. 杂色的

e.en: She rode a beautiful {roan} mare through the meadow.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹漂亮的杂色母马穿过草地。

e.en: The {roan} stallion stood out among the other horses.
e.zh: 那匹斑毛公马在其他马中格外显眼。

roar.t:
v. 咆哮；轰鸣
n. 吼声

e.en: The lion's mighty {roar} echoed across the savanna.
e.zh: 狮子洪亮的吼声在大草原上回荡。

e.en: The crowd let out a {roar} when the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时,人群发出了一阵咆哮。

e.en: The engine {roared} to life after several attempts.
e.zh: 发动机在几次尝试后轰鸣着启动了。

e.en: The audience {roared} with laughter at the comedian's joke.
e.zh: 观众听到喜剧演员的笑话哄堂大笑。

roaring.t:
adj. 轰鸣的；兴旺的
v. 咆哮中

e.en: They sat by a {roaring} fire on the cold night.
e.zh: 寒冷的夜晚他们坐在熊熊燃烧的火炉旁。

e.en: The new café is doing a {roaring} trade downtown.
e.zh: 新开的咖啡馆在市中心生意火爆。

roars.t: v. 咆哮 (roar 第三人称单数)

e.en: The motorcycle {roars} loudly as it speeds down the street.
e.zh: 摩托车在街上飞驰时发出巨大的轰鸣声。

e.en: The crowd {roars} every time the home team scores.
e.zh: 主队每次得分,观众都会大声欢呼。

roast.t:
v. 烘烤
n. 烤肉；吐槽

e.en: We're having a Sunday {roast} with all the family.
e.zh: 我们全家一起吃周日烤肉大餐。

e.en: The comedians took turns to {roast} the birthday boy.
e.zh: 喜剧演员们轮流调侃寿星。

roasted.t:
adj. 烤过的
v. 烤 (过去式)

e.en: She {roasted} the chicken with garlic and rosemary.
e.zh: 她用大蒜和迷迭香烤了那只鸡。

e.en: He {roasted} his friend mercilessly during the wedding speech.
e.zh: 婚礼致辞时他毫不留情地调侃了他的朋友。

e.en: The coffee {roaster} on the corner sells the freshest beans.
e.zh: 街角的咖啡烘焙店出售最新鲜的咖啡豆。

e.en: Place the turkey in a large {roaster} before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前把火鸡放入一个大烤盘里。

roasting.t:
n. 烘烤
adj. 灼热的

e.en: The smell of {roasting} coffee filled the whole café.
e.zh: 烘焙咖啡的香味弥漫了整个咖啡馆。

e.en: It's absolutely {roasting} outside today, stay hydrated.
e.zh: 今天外面热得要命,记得多喝水。

roasts.t: v. 烤 (roast 第三人称单数)

e.en: My grandmother {roasts} a turkey every Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 我外婆每年感恩节都会烤火鸡。

e.en: The comedian's savage {roasts} had everyone laughing nonstop.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员犀利的吐槽让大家笑个不停。

e.en: Two masked men {robbed} the bank in broad daylight.
e.zh: 两名蒙面男子在光天化日之下抢劫了银行。

e.en: The injury {robbed} her of a chance to compete.
e.zh: 伤病让她失去了参赛的机会。

e.en: Police arrested the {robber} after a short chase.
e.zh: 警方在短暂追捕后逮捕了那名劫匪。

e.en: The {robber} fled the scene with a bag of cash.
e.zh: 劫匪带着一袋现金逃离了现场。

e.en: A string of {robberies} has shaken the small town.
e.zh: 一连串的抢劫案震惊了这个小镇。

e.en: Bank {robberies} have dropped sharply in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来银行抢劫案的数量大幅下降。

e.en: He was sentenced to ten years for armed {robbery}.
e.zh: 他因持械抢劫被判处十年监禁。

e.en: Charging twenty dollars for coffee feels like daylight {robbery}.
e.zh: 一杯咖啡卖二十美元简直是明抢。

robbing.t: v. 抢劫 (rob 现在分词)

e.en: They were caught {robbing} a convenience store last night.
e.zh: 他们昨晚抢劫便利店时被抓个正着。

e.en: Skipping breakfast is {robbing} you of morning energy.
e.zh: 不吃早餐会让你失去一上午的精力。

e.en: The judge entered the courtroom in a black {robe}.
e.zh: 法官身穿黑色长袍走进法庭。

e.en: She slipped on a soft bath {robe} after showering.
e.zh: 她洗完澡后披上一件柔软的浴袍。

e.en: The {robed} priests walked solemnly down the aisle.
e.zh: 身穿长袍的神父庄严地走过过道。

e.en: She emerged {robed} in white silk for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她身着白色丝绸长袍出现在仪式上。

robespierre.t: n. 罗伯斯庇尔 (法国大革命人物)

e.en: {Robespierre} became a key figure in the French Revolution.
e.zh: 罗伯斯庇尔成为法国大革命中的关键人物。

e.en: Historians still debate {Robespierre}'s role in the Reign of Terror.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论罗伯斯庇尔在恐怖统治中的角色。

e.en: A {robin} hopped across the lawn looking for worms.
e.zh: 一只知更鸟在草坪上跳来跳去找虫子。

e.en: The first {robin} of spring appeared in our garden.
e.zh: 春天的第一只知更鸟出现在我们的花园里。

e.en: Several {robins} were singing outside my window this morning.
e.zh: 今早几只知更鸟在我窗外歌唱。

e.en: The {robins} return north every year as spring begins.
e.zh: 每年春天来临时知更鸟都会北归。

e.en: Mr. {Robinson} has taught at this school for decades.
e.zh: 罗宾逊先生在这所学校任教已有数十年。

e.en: I just finished reading {Robinson} Crusoe again.
e.zh: 我刚刚又读完了一遍《鲁滨逊漂流记》。

robocop.t: n. 机械战警 (电影角色)

e.en: My kids love watching the old {Robocop} movies on weekends.
e.zh: 我的孩子们周末喜欢看老版的《机械战警》。

e.en: The new security guard moves like {Robocop} on patrol.
e.zh: 新来的保安巡逻起来像机械战警一样。

e.en: This {robot} can vacuum the entire house automatically.
e.zh: 这个机器人可以自动打扫整个房子。

e.en: Stop replying to emails like a {robot} and add personality.
e.zh: 别再像机器人一样回邮件了,加点个人风格。

robotic.t: adj. 机器人的；机械式的

e.en: Surgeons now use {robotic} arms for delicate operations.
e.zh: 外科医生现在使用机械臂进行精细手术。

e.en: His voice sounded flat and {robotic} during the speech.
e.zh: 他演讲时的声音听起来呆板而机械。

e.en: She studies {robotics} at a top engineering university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖工程大学学习机器人学。

e.en: Advances in {robotics} are reshaping the manufacturing industry.
e.zh: 机器人技术的进步正在重塑制造业。

e.en: Factories increasingly rely on {robots} to assemble products.
e.zh: 工厂越来越依赖机器人来组装产品。

e.en: Search engine {robots} crawl websites to index pages.
e.zh: 搜索引擎的爬虫机器人会抓取网站并索引页面。

robs.t: v. 抢劫 (rob 第三人称单数)

e.en: Lack of sleep {robs} you of focus and creativity.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会夺走你的专注力和创造力。

e.en: Whoever {robs} a store on camera rarely gets away.
e.zh: 在摄像头下抢劫商店的人很少能逃脱。

e.en: The system is {robust} against network failures.
e.zh: 该系统在网络故障下也能稳定运行。

e.en: She wrote a {robust} defense of the new policy.
e.zh: 她为这项新政策写了一份强有力的辩护。

e.en: Most instant coffee is made from cheaper {robusta} beans.
e.zh: 大多数速溶咖啡都是用较便宜的罗布斯塔豆制成的。

e.en: {Robusta} contains nearly twice the caffeine of arabica.
e.zh: 罗布斯塔咖啡的咖啡因含量几乎是阿拉比卡的两倍。

e.en: Steel {rods} reinforce the concrete in modern buildings.
e.zh: 钢筋加固了现代建筑中的混凝土。

e.en: They packed their fishing {rods} for the weekend trip.
e.zh: 他们为周末旅行打包了钓鱼竿。

roe.t:
n. 鱼卵、鱼子
n. 狍（roe deer）

e.en: A {roebuck} stepped cautiously into the forest clearing.
e.zh: 一只雄狍小心翼翼地走进林间空地。

e.en: The hunter spotted a {roebuck} grazing at dawn.
e.zh: 猎人在黎明时发现一只雄狍在吃草。

e.en: She studies dance at the University of {Roehampton} in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的罗汉普顿大学学习舞蹈。

e.en: The {Roehampton} estate is well known for its modernist architecture.
e.zh: 罗汉普顿住宅区以其现代主义建筑而闻名。

roentgen.t:
n. 伦琴（辐射剂量单位）
n. 人名 Röntgen

e.en: Wilhelm {Roentgen} discovered X-rays back in 1895.
e.zh: 威廉·伦琴于1895年发现了X射线。

e.en: Radiation exposure used to be measured in {roentgen} units.
e.zh: 过去辐射剂量是用伦琴为单位来测量的。

roger.t:
int. 收到、明白（无线电用语）
n. 男子名 Roger

e.en: {Roger} that, the package has been delivered safely.
e.zh: 收到,包裹已安全送达。

e.en: {Roger} Federer is one of tennis's greatest legends.
e.zh: 罗杰·费德勒是网球界最伟大的传奇之一。

roget.t: n. 人名（《Roget 同义词词典》作者）

e.en: I keep a {Roget}'s Thesaurus on my writing desk.
e.zh: 我在书桌上放着一本罗杰同义词词典。

e.en: Peter Mark {Roget} compiled his famous thesaurus in 1852.
e.zh: 彼得·马克·罗杰于1852年编纂了他著名的同义词词典。

rogue.t:
n. 无赖、流氓
adj. 失控的、擅自行动的

e.en: A {rogue} employee leaked confidential data to the press.
e.zh: 一名违规员工向媒体泄露了机密数据。

e.en: The detective hunted the charming {rogue} across Europe.
e.zh: 侦探在欧洲各地追捕那个迷人的无赖。

e.en: He gave her a {roguish} grin before slipping out the door.
e.zh: 他俏皮地朝她一笑，便溜出了门。

e.en: The actor is famous for playing {roguish} but lovable characters.
e.zh: 这位演员以扮演调皮可爱的角色而闻名。

e.en: The horsemen of {Rohan} charged across the plains in the film.
e.zh: 电影中洛汗的骑兵冲锋穿过平原。

e.en: My classmate {Rohan} just moved here from Mumbai last week.
e.zh: 我的同学罗汉上周刚从孟买搬来这里。

roi.t: n. 投资回报率（Return on Investment）

e.en: Tariff threats continue to {roil} global stock markets this week.
e.zh: 关税威胁本周持续搅动全球股市。

e.en: Storm winds {roil} the surface of the lake at dusk.
e.zh: 暴风在黄昏时搅动着湖面。

e.en: The ferry crossed the {roiling} sea with great difficulty.
e.zh: 渡轮艰难地穿越翻腾的海面。

e.en: A {roiling} controversy has engulfed the company's leadership.
e.zh: 一场愈演愈烈的争议席卷了公司高层。

e.en: After the rain, the river ran {roily} and brown.
e.zh: 雨后，河水变得浑浊泛黄。

e.en: Fish are hard to spot in {roily} water.
e.zh: 在浑浊的水中很难看见鱼。

e.en: The sailors began to {roister} loudly in the tavern.
e.zh: 水手们开始在酒馆里大声喧闹作乐。

e.en: Students {roister} through the streets after winning the championship.
e.zh: 学生们在夺冠后在街上狂欢闹腾。

e.en: The film {Roja} became a landmark in Indian cinema history.
e.zh: 电影《罗惹》成为印度电影史上的里程碑。

e.en: She painted the wall a deep {roja} red.
e.zh: 她把墙刷成了深红色。

e.en: She landed her first major {role} in a streaming series.
e.zh: 她在一部流媒体剧集里拿到了第一个重要角色。

e.en: Sleep plays a key {role} in memory consolidation.
e.zh: 睡眠在记忆巩固中起着关键作用。

roles.t: n. 角色、职责（role 复数）

e.en: Admins can assign different {roles} to team members in the dashboard.
e.zh: 管理员可以在面板里给团队成员分配不同角色。

e.en: She has played many memorable {roles} over her long career.
e.zh: 在漫长的职业生涯中，她演过许多令人难忘的角色。

e.en: He saved for years to buy his first vintage {Rolex}.
e.zh: 他攒了好几年钱才买下第一块复古劳力士。

e.en: Counterfeit {Rolex} watches are common in tourist markets.
e.zh: 假冒的劳力士手表在旅游市场上很常见。

roll.t:
v. 滚动、卷起
n. 名单、面包卷

e.en: Just {roll} the dough into a thin rectangle.
e.zh: 把面团擀成薄薄的长方形就行。

e.en: The kids love to {roll} down the grassy hill.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢从草坡上滚下来。

rollback.t: n. 回滚、回退（软件/价格）

e.en: We had to do an emergency {rollback} after the deploy broke production.
e.zh: 部署搞坏线上后，我们不得不紧急回滚。

e.en: Voters opposed the {rollback} of environmental protections.
e.zh: 选民反对削减环保措施。

rolled.t: v. 滚动、卷起（roll 过去式）

e.en: She {rolled} her eyes when he made the same joke again.
e.zh: 他又讲那个老笑话时，她翻了个白眼。

e.en: The new feature was {rolled} out to all users yesterday.
e.zh: 新功能昨天向所有用户推出了。

e.en: Use a paint {roller} to cover large walls quickly.
e.zh: 用漆滚筒可以快速涂刷大面积墙面。

e.en: The kids spent the afternoon at the {roller} skating rink.
e.zh: 孩子们在旱冰场玩了一下午。

e.en: A {rollerblader} zipped past us along the boardwalk.
e.zh: 一名轮滑爱好者沿着木栈道从我们身边飞驰而过。

e.en: The park bans every {rollerblader} from the main fountain area.
e.zh: 公园禁止所有轮滑者进入主喷泉区域。

rollercoaster.t:
n. 过山车
adj. 起伏剧烈的

e.en: Her startup journey has been an emotional {rollercoaster}.
e.zh: 她的创业之路就像情绪过山车一样起伏不定。

e.en: The new {rollercoaster} reaches speeds of seventy miles per hour.
e.zh: 这台新过山车的最高时速可达七十英里。

rollicking.t: adj. 欢闹的、热闹有趣的

e.en: The pub erupted into a {rollicking} sing-along after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，酒吧里爆发出一阵欢闹的合唱。

e.en: Critics called the novel a {rollicking} adventure story.
e.zh: 评论家称这本小说是一部欢快热闹的冒险故事。

rolling.t:
adj. 滚动的、连绵起伏的
v. 滚动（进行时）

e.en: We drove through miles of {rolling} green hills.
e.zh: 我们开车穿过了绵延数英里的青翠丘陵。

e.en: The team is {rolling} out updates every two weeks now.
e.zh: 团队现在每两周就会推送一次更新。

e.en: The phased {rollout} starts with users in Europe next Monday.
e.zh: 分阶段发布将于下周一从欧洲用户开始。

e.en: Marketing planned a flashy {rollout} for the new product line.
e.zh: 市场部为新产品线策划了一场华丽的发布。

rollover.t:
n. 滚存、展期
n. 车辆翻滚

e.en: Unused data has automatic {rollover} to the next billing cycle.
e.zh: 未用完的流量会自动结转到下个账单周期。

e.en: Highway officials investigated the cause of the truck {rollover}.
e.zh: 高速公路官员正在调查货车翻车的原因。

rolls.t:
n. 卷、名册（roll 复数）
n. 劳斯（Rolls-Royce）

e.en: The bakery {rolls} out fresh croissants every morning at six.
e.zh: 面包店每天早上六点出炉新鲜的羊角包。

e.en: She bought a dozen warm dinner {rolls} for the party.
e.zh: 她为聚会买了一打热腾腾的小餐包。

e.en: His {Rolodex} of industry contacts opened doors at every meeting.
e.zh: 他庞大的行业人脉让每次会议都顺风顺水。

e.en: She still keeps an old {Rolodex} on her desk for nostalgia.
e.zh: 她为了怀旧仍在桌上摆着一个旧名片簿。

roma.t:
n. 罗马（意大利语）
n. 罗姆人

e.en: The {Roma} have faced discrimination across Europe for centuries.
e.zh: 罗姆人几个世纪以来在欧洲一直遭受歧视。

e.en: AS {Roma} drew with Lazio in last night's derby.
e.zh: 罗马队在昨晚的德比战中与拉齐奥战平。

romaine.t: n. 长叶生菜、罗马生菜

e.en: A classic Caesar salad uses crisp {romaine} lettuce.
e.zh: 经典的凯撒沙拉用的是脆嫩的罗马生菜。

e.en: Health officials recalled bagged {romaine} after an E. coli outbreak.
e.zh: 大肠杆菌爆发后，卫生部门召回了袋装罗马生菜。

roman.t:
adj. 罗马的
n. 罗马人

e.en: The museum exhibits ancient {Roman} coins from across the empire.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自帝国各地的古罗马钱币。

e.en: Please type the page number in lowercase {Roman} numerals.
e.zh: 请用小写罗马数字输入页码。

romance.t:
n. 浪漫；爱情故事
v. 追求；恋爱

e.en: Their workplace {romance} surprised everyone in the office.
e.zh: 他们的办公室恋情让全公司的人都很意外。

e.en: She mostly reads {romance} novels on her commute.
e.zh: 她通勤时大多在看言情小说。

romances.t:
n. 浪漫故事（复数）
v. 追求（第三人称单数）

e.en: Streaming platforms have invested heavily in Korean {romances} this year.
e.zh: 今年流媒体平台在韩国爱情剧上投入了重金。

e.en: He {romances} every new client with expensive dinners.
e.zh: 他用昂贵的晚餐讨好每一个新客户。

romanesque.t: adj. 罗马式的（建筑风格）

e.en: The cathedral features thick walls typical of {Romanesque} architecture.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的厚墙是罗马式建筑的典型特征。

e.en: Tourists admired the {Romanesque} arches in the old abbey.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着古老修道院里的罗马式拱门。

e.en: {Romania} joined the European Union back in 2007.
e.zh: 罗马尼亚于2007年加入了欧盟。

e.en: We're planning a hiking trip in the mountains of {Romania}.
e.zh: 我们正计划去罗马尼亚的山区徒步旅行。

romanian.t:
adj. 罗马尼亚的
n. 罗马尼亚人；罗马尼亚语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Romanian} thanks to her grandmother.
e.zh: 多亏了奶奶，她能讲一口流利的罗马尼亚语。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Romanian} dumplings and stews.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的罗马尼亚饺子和炖菜。

e.en: Grate fresh {Romano} cheese over the pasta before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在意面上撒上新鲜磨碎的罗马诺奶酪。

e.en: The chef prefers {Romano} to parmesan for this sauce.
e.zh: 厨师做这种酱料时更喜欢罗马诺而不是帕马森。

romanov.t: n. 罗曼诺夫王朝（俄国）

e.en: The {Romanov} dynasty ruled Russia for over three centuries.
e.zh: 罗曼诺夫王朝统治俄罗斯长达三百多年。

e.en: Historians still debate the fate of the last {Romanov} children.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论最后几位罗曼诺夫子女的命运。

romantic.t:
adj. 浪漫的；爱情的
n. 浪漫主义者

e.en: He planned a {romantic} dinner on the rooftop for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他为周年纪念在屋顶安排了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

e.en: She has a very {romantic} view of life in Paris.
e.zh: 她对巴黎的生活抱有非常浪漫的想象。

romantically.t: adv. 浪漫地；在恋爱关系上

e.en: The two coworkers have been {romantically} involved for months.
e.zh: 这两位同事已经谈恋爱好几个月了。

e.en: He {romantically} described his small hometown as paradise.
e.zh: 他充满浪漫色彩地把家乡小镇描述成天堂。

romanticise.t: v. 使浪漫化；美化（英式拼写）

e.en: Don't {romanticise} the struggles of being a starving artist.
e.zh: 不要把穷困艺术家的挣扎美化得太浪漫。

e.en: Films often {romanticise} life in nineteenth-century London.
e.zh: 电影常把十九世纪伦敦的生活美化得很浪漫。

romanticised.t:
v. 浪漫化（过去式）
adj. 被美化的

e.en: The novel {romanticised} pirate life beyond all recognition.
e.zh: 这部小说把海盗生活美化得面目全非。

e.en: Her {romanticised} memories of college skip the hard parts.
e.zh: 她对大学生活的浪漫回忆略过了所有艰难的部分。

romanticism.t: n. 浪漫主义（文艺流派）

e.en: His paintings show clear influences of nineteenth-century {Romanticism}.
e.zh: 他的画作明显受到十九世纪浪漫主义的影响。

e.en: There's a touch of {romanticism} in how she remembers her childhood.
e.zh: 她回忆童年时带着一丝浪漫主义色彩。

e.en: As a true {romanticist}, he believes love conquers everything.
e.zh: 作为一个真正的浪漫主义者，他相信爱能战胜一切。

e.en: The poet was a {romanticist} drawn to wild landscapes.
e.zh: 这位诗人是一位钟情于荒野风光的浪漫主义者。

e.en: The film's {romanticization} of war drew sharp criticism online.
e.zh: 这部电影对战争的浪漫化处理在网上招致了尖锐批评。

e.en: Critics warn against the {romanticization} of toxic relationships in pop songs.
e.zh: 评论家警告流行歌曲不要把有毒关系浪漫化。

e.en: Social media tends to {romanticize} the digital nomad lifestyle.
e.zh: 社交媒体倾向于把数字游民的生活美化得很浪漫。

e.en: Please don't {romanticize} how difficult that job actually was.
e.zh: 请别把那份工作有多难给浪漫化了。

romanticized.t:
v. 浪漫化（过去式）
adj. 被美化的

e.en: Hollywood has long {romanticized} the American Old West.
e.zh: 好莱坞长期以来一直把美国旧西部浪漫化。

e.en: Her {romanticized} version of their relationship ignored the fights.
e.zh: 她对两人关系的浪漫化版本忽略了所有争吵。

romany.t:
n. 吉普赛人；罗姆语
adj. 吉普赛的

e.en: Her grandfather still spoke {Romany} at family gatherings.
e.zh: 她的外公在家庭聚会上仍说罗姆语。

e.en: The festival celebrated {Romany} music and dance traditions.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝罗姆人的音乐和舞蹈传统。

e.en: We spent a week eating our way through {Rome}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间在罗马吃遍了各种美食。

e.en: All roads, as they say, lead to {Rome}.
e.zh: 正如人们所说，条条大路通罗马。

e.en: He fancies himself a real {Romeo} with the new interns.
e.zh: 他自以为在新实习生面前是个十足的情圣。

e.en: The school is putting on {Romeo} and Juliet next month.
e.zh: 学校下个月要上演《罗密欧与朱丽叶》。

romford.t: n. 罗姆福德（伦敦地区）

e.en: She catches the train from {Romford} into central London daily.
e.zh: 她每天从朗福德乘火车前往伦敦市中心。

e.en: The new shopping center in {Romford} opens this weekend.
e.zh: 朗福德的新购物中心将于本周末开业。

romp.t:
v. 嬉闹；轻松获胜
n. 嬉戏

e.en: The puppies love to {romp} in the backyard after dinner.
e.zh: 小狗们喜欢在晚饭后到后院里撒欢。

e.en: Critics called the comedy a delightful summer {romp}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部喜剧是一部令人愉悦的夏日轻松佳作。

romped.t: v. 嬉闹（过去式）；轻松取胜

e.en: The team {romped} to a 5-0 victory in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中以5比0轻松大胜。

e.en: Children {romped} happily through the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 孩子们在秋叶中欢快地嬉戏奔跑。

e.en: The baby looked adorable in a tiny striped {romper}.
e.zh: 宝宝穿着小小的条纹连体衣，可爱极了。

e.en: She bought a linen {romper} for the beach trip.
e.zh: 她为海滩之行买了一件亚麻连体短裤。

e.en: Summer {rompers} are flying off the shelves at the boutique.
e.zh: 夏季连体短裤在精品店里热卖。

e.en: The twins always wear matching {rompers} in family photos.
e.zh: 双胞胎在全家福里总穿着同款连体衣。

romping.t:
v. 嬉闹（进行时）
adj. 欢闹的

e.en: Two golden retrievers were {romping} on the lawn together.
e.zh: 两只金毛猎犬在草坪上一起欢快地玩耍。

e.en: The team is {romping} through the playoffs unbeaten.
e.zh: 该队在季后赛中势如破竹，所向披靡。

romps.t:
v. 嬉闹（第三人称单数）
n. 嬉戏（复数）

e.en: The puppy {romps} around the yard every morning.
e.zh: 小狗每天早上在院子里欢快地跑来跑去。

e.en: Our team {romps} to victory in the final match.
e.zh: 我们队在决赛中轻松大胜。

romulan.t: n. 罗慕兰人（《星际迷航》种族）

e.en: The {Romulan} warship decloaked beside the Enterprise.
e.zh: 那艘罗慕兰战舰在进取号旁边解除了隐形。

e.en: He cosplayed as a {Romulan} senator at the convention.
e.zh: 他在动漫展上扮成一位罗慕兰元老。

romulus.t: n. 罗慕路斯（罗马建城者）

e.en: Legend says {Romulus} founded the city of Rome.
e.zh: 传说罗慕路斯建立了罗马城。

e.en: A statue of {Romulus} stands in the museum courtyard.
e.zh: 博物馆庭院里立着一尊罗慕路斯的雕像。

e.en: The pianist played a lively Mozart {rondo}.
e.zh: 钢琴家演奏了一首欢快的莫扎特回旋曲。

e.en: The symphony ends with a brilliant {rondo}.
e.zh: 这部交响曲以一段精彩的回旋曲收尾。

rood.t: n. 十字架（教堂中的基督受难像）

e.en: A carved {rood} hangs above the church altar.
e.zh: 教堂祭坛上方悬挂着一个雕刻的十字苦像。

e.en: Pilgrims knelt before the ancient stone {rood}.
e.zh: 朝圣者们跪在那座古老的石制十字架前。

roof.t:
n. 屋顶
v. 给…盖顶

e.en: Heavy rain leaked through the old {roof}.
e.zh: 大雨从那破旧的屋顶漏了进来。

e.en: They installed solar panels on the {roof} last week.
e.zh: 他们上周在屋顶上安装了太阳能板。

e.en: The {roofer} replaced all the broken tiles yesterday.
e.zh: 屋顶工昨天把所有碎瓦都换掉了。

e.en: We hired a local {roofer} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后我们雇了一位当地的屋顶工。

e.en: Metal {roofing} lasts much longer than asphalt shingles.
e.zh: 金属屋顶材料比沥青瓦耐用得多。

e.en: The {roofing} contractor finished the job in two days.
e.zh: 屋顶承包商两天就完成了工程。

roofless.t: adj. 无屋顶的；无家可归的

e.en: The earthquake left dozens of families {roofless}.
e.zh: 地震让数十个家庭无家可归。

e.en: They explored a {roofless} ruin on the hilltop.
e.zh: 他们在山顶探访了一座没有屋顶的废墟。

e.en: The hotel's curved {roofline} dominates the skyline.
e.zh: 酒店那弯曲的屋顶轮廓主宰了整片天际线。

e.en: Birds gathered along the steep {roofline} at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时鸟儿聚集在陡峭的屋顶线上。

e.en: Snow blanketed the {roofs} of the village overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间大雪覆盖了村庄的屋顶。

e.en: Solar panels now cover many {roofs} in our neighborhood.
e.zh: 如今我们小区许多屋顶都装上了太阳能板。

e.en: We had drinks at a {rooftop} bar overlooking the river.
e.zh: 我们在一家俯瞰河景的屋顶酒吧喝了几杯。

e.en: A cat watched the sunset from the {rooftop}.
e.zh: 一只猫在屋顶上看着日落。

rook.t:
n. 国际象棋中的车
n. 白嘴鸦

e.en: She moved her {rook} to capture the bishop.
e.zh: 她移动车吃掉了对方的象。

e.en: A noisy {rook} landed on the chimney.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的白嘴鸦落在了烟囱上。

rookery.t: n. 白嘴鸦群栖地；海鸟或海豹聚居地

e.en: The cliff hosts a huge penguin {rookery} each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天这座悬崖都会聚集大量企鹅繁殖群。

e.en: We watched seabirds nesting in the noisy {rookery}.
e.zh: 我们看着海鸟在喧闹的繁殖地里筑巢。

rookie.t:
n. 新手；菜鸟
adj. 新加入的

e.en: The {rookie} pitcher struck out three batters in a row.
e.zh: 那名新秀投手连续三振了三名打者。

e.en: Don't worry, that's a common {rookie} mistake.
e.zh: 别担心,那是新手常犯的错误。

room.t:
n. 房间
n. 空间；余地

e.en: There isn't enough {room} on the table for another plate.
e.zh: 桌子上再也放不下一个盘子了。

e.en: Please book a quiet {room} for the meeting.
e.zh: 请为会议预订一个安静的房间。

roomed.t: adj. 有…房间的（构词用，如 two-roomed）

e.en: I {roomed} with Jenny during my freshman year.
e.zh: 大一那年我和珍妮住同一间宿舍。

e.en: They {roomed} together at summer camp last August.
e.zh: 去年八月他们在夏令营里同住一间房。

roomful.t: n. 满满一屋子（的人或物）

e.en: A {roomful} of children cheered when the clown arrived.
e.zh: 小丑一进来,满屋子的孩子都欢呼起来。

e.en: He addressed a {roomful} of skeptical investors.
e.zh: 他向满屋子持怀疑态度的投资人发表讲话。

roomie.t: n. 室友（roommate 的口语说法）

e.en: My {roomie} keeps stealing my leftovers from the fridge.
e.zh: 我室友老是偷吃我放在冰箱里的剩饭。

e.en: I'm meeting my old college {roomie} for brunch.
e.zh: 我要和大学时的老室友一起吃早午餐。

e.en: Buyers love the {roominess} of the new SUV's cabin.
e.zh: 买家很喜欢这款新SUV车厢的宽敞。

e.en: The apartment's {roominess} makes it perfect for families.
e.zh: 这套公寓的宽敞让它非常适合家庭居住。

rooming.t: n. 租住；合租（rooming house 合租公寓）

e.en: She's {rooming} with two classmates this semester.
e.zh: 这学期她和两个同学合租一间宿舍。

e.en: The old {rooming} house still rents weekly.
e.zh: 那家老式合租公寓依然按周出租。

e.en: My {roommate} forgot to pay the electricity bill again.
e.zh: 我室友又忘记交电费了。

e.en: I'm looking for a quiet {roommate} to share the apartment.
e.zh: 我在找一个安静的室友合租这套公寓。

e.en: The four {roommates} take turns cooking dinner.
e.zh: 四个室友轮流做晚饭。

e.en: We've been {roommates} since freshman year of college.
e.zh: 我们从大一开始就是室友了。

rooms.t:
n. 房间（复数）
v. 居住；合租

e.en: The hotel has 200 {rooms} and a rooftop pool.
e.zh: 这家酒店有200间客房和一个屋顶泳池。

e.en: All the meeting {rooms} are booked until five.
e.zh: 所有会议室一直预订到五点。

e.en: The car's trunk is surprisingly {roomy} for a sedan.
e.zh: 作为一辆轿车,它的后备箱意外地宽敞。

e.en: I love these {roomy} hiking pants for long trails.
e.zh: 我很喜欢这条宽松的登山裤,适合长途徒步。

roos.t: n. 袋鼠（kangaroo 的复数口语）

e.en: A mob of {roos} bounded across the dusty highway.
e.zh: 一群袋鼠蹦跳着穿过尘土飞扬的公路。

e.en: At dusk the {roos} gather to graze near our farm.
e.zh: 黄昏时分袋鼠会聚到我们农场附近吃草。

roosevelt.t: n. 罗斯福（美国总统姓氏）

e.en: President {Roosevelt} signed the New Deal into law.
e.zh: 罗斯福总统签署了新政法案。

e.en: We visited the {Roosevelt} memorial in Washington yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天我们参观了华盛顿的罗斯福纪念馆。

roost.t:
n. 栖木；鸟窝
v. 栖息；过夜

e.en: The chickens return to the {roost} at sunset.
e.zh: 鸡群在日落时分回到栖架上。

e.en: Bats {roost} in the cave during the day.
e.zh: 蝙蝠白天栖息在洞穴里。

e.en: Dozens of pigeons {roosted} on the courthouse ledge.
e.zh: 几十只鸽子栖息在法院的窗台上。

e.en: The owls {roosted} quietly in the old barn.
e.zh: 猫头鹰静静地栖息在老谷仓里。

e.en: A loud {rooster} woke us before dawn every morning.
e.zh: 每天天没亮就有一只大公鸡把我们吵醒。

e.en: The {rooster} strutted proudly across the yard.
e.zh: 那只公鸡神气地穿过院子。

roosting.t: v. 栖息；歇夜（现在分词）

e.en: Hundreds of starlings were {roosting} in the trees.
e.zh: 成百上千只椋鸟栖息在树上。

e.en: The hens are {roosting} in the coop already.
e.zh: 母鸡们已经在鸡舍里安顿下来过夜了。

root.t:
n. 根；根源
v. 生根；扎根

e.en: We need to find the {root} cause of this bug.
e.zh: 我们需要找出这个漏洞的根本原因。

e.en: The tree's {root} broke through the sidewalk.
e.zh: 那棵树的根穿透了人行道。

rooted.t: adj. 根深蒂固的；扎根的

e.en: Her beliefs are deeply {rooted} in family tradition.
e.zh: 她的信念深深植根于家族传统。

e.en: He stood {rooted} to the spot in shock.
e.zh: 他震惊得呆立在原地。

e.en: Her {rootedness} in the community made her a natural leader.
e.zh: 她对社区的深厚情感使她成为天然的领袖。

e.en: The poem celebrates a deep {rootedness} in rural traditions.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂了对乡村传统的深厚归属感。

rooter.t: n. 热情支持者；啦啦队员

e.en: He's the loudest {rooter} at every home football game.
e.zh: 他是每场主场橄榄球赛最热情的助威者。

e.en: My grandmother was always my biggest {rooter} growing up.
e.zh: 我祖母从小到大一直是我最坚定的支持者。

rooting.t:
v. 扎根；翻找
v. 支持；加油

e.en: The whole town is {rooting} for the local team tonight.
e.zh: 全镇今晚都在为本地球队加油。

e.en: I caught the dog {rooting} through the kitchen trash.
e.zh: 我抓到狗在厨房垃圾桶里翻找东西。

e.en: After years abroad, he felt completely {rootless} and lonely.
e.zh: 在国外多年后，他感到完全无根而孤独。

e.en: The novel portrays a {rootless} generation searching for meaning.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一代漂泊无依、寻找意义的人。

e.en: Modern urban life often breeds a profound sense of {rootlessness}.
e.zh: 现代都市生活常常滋生深刻的无根感。

e.en: His memoir explores the {rootlessness} of immigrant childhood.
e.zh: 他的回忆录探讨了移民童年的漂泊无依。

e.en: Each tiny {rootlet} helps the seedling absorb water from soil.
e.zh: 每条细小的根须都帮助幼苗从土壤中吸水。
