e.en: Be careful not to break a single {rootlet} when transplanting.
e.zh: 移栽时小心不要弄断任何一根细根。

e.en: She traveled to Ireland to explore her family {roots}.
e.zh: 她前往爱尔兰寻根。

e.en: The tree's {roots} cracked the old concrete sidewalk.
e.zh: 树根把陈旧的水泥人行道撑裂了。

e.en: Apple growers graft new varieties onto sturdy {rootstock}.
e.zh: 苹果种植者把新品种嫁接到健壮的砧木上。

e.en: This {rootstock} resists most common soil-borne diseases.
e.zh: 这种砧木能抵抗大多数常见的土传病害。

rootsy.t: adj. 具传统本土风格的（音乐等）

e.en: Her new album has a warm, {rootsy} country sound.
e.zh: 她的新专辑有一种温暖、质朴的乡村风。

e.en: The band plays a {rootsy} blend of folk and blues.
e.zh: 这支乐队演奏着民谣与布鲁斯交融的本土风。

rootworm.t: n. 根虫（危害作物根部的害虫）

e.en: Corn farmers lost millions to the {rootworm} infestation last year.
e.zh: 去年玉米农因根虫灾害损失了数百万。

e.en: This hybrid seed resists the destructive western corn {rootworm}.
e.zh: 这种杂交种子能抵抗破坏性极强的西方玉米根虫。

e.en: The trail was steep, muddy, and very {rooty} in places.
e.zh: 小路陡峭泥泞，有些地方布满了树根。

e.en: Mountain bikers love the {rooty} sections of this forest trail.
e.zh: 山地车手喜欢这条林道中布满树根的路段。

rope.t:
n. 绳子
v. 用绳捆；套住

e.en: He tied the boat to the dock with a thick {rope}.
e.zh: 他用一根粗绳把船拴在码头上。

e.en: The climbers checked every {rope} before starting their ascent.
e.zh: 攀登者在开始攀登前检查了每一根绳子。

roped.t: v. 用绳捆；拉拢（过去式）

e.en: They {roped} me into helping with the school fundraiser.
e.zh: 他们硬拉我去帮忙学校的筹款活动。

e.en: The cowboy expertly {roped} the runaway calf in seconds.
e.zh: 牛仔几秒钟就熟练地套住了那只逃跑的小牛。

e.en: He's the best {roper} at the rodeo this season.
e.zh: 他是本赛季牛仔竞技大赛中最厉害的套绳手。

e.en: A skilled {roper} can lasso a calf in three seconds.
e.zh: 熟练的套绳手三秒就能套住一只小牛。

ropes.t: n. 绳子（复数）；诀窍（learn the ropes）

e.en: The new intern is still learning the {ropes} of journalism.
e.zh: 新实习生还在学习新闻工作的门道。

e.en: Sailors hauled on the heavy {ropes} to raise the sail.
e.zh: 水手们拉动粗绳把帆升起。

ropey.t: adj. 质量差的；不适的（英式口语）

e.en: The internet connection has been a bit {ropey} all morning.
e.zh: 整个上午网络连接都不太稳定。

e.en: His knees felt {ropey} after the long mountain hike.
e.zh: 长途登山后他的膝盖感觉不太行。

roping.t: v. 用绳捆绑（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {roping} cattle on the family ranch.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在家庭牧场上套牛。

e.en: She's {roping} her friends into a weekend camping trip.
e.zh: 她正拉着朋友们一起去周末露营。

e.en: The melted cheese stretched into long, {ropy} strands.
e.zh: 融化的奶酪拉出长长的丝状。

e.en: His arms were lean and {ropy} from years of rowing.
e.zh: 多年划船让他的双臂精瘦而结实。

ros.t: n. 人名昵称（Rosalind/Ross 等的简称）

e.en: She uses gentle skincare to manage her chronic {rosacea}.
e.zh: 她使用温和的护肤品来控制慢性玫瑰痤疮。

e.en: Sunlight and spicy food can trigger {rosacea} flare-ups.
e.zh: 阳光和辛辣食物可能引发玫瑰痤疮发作。

rosario.t: n. 罗萨里奥（人名／地名）

e.en: We flew into {Rosario} before driving down to Buenos Aires.
e.zh: 我们先飞到罗萨里奥，再开车前往布宜诺斯艾利斯。

e.en: {Rosario} is famous as the birthplace of Lionel Messi.
e.zh: 罗萨里奥以梅西的出生地而闻名。

e.en: Grandmother prayed the {rosary} every evening before bed.
e.zh: 祖母每晚睡前都会念诵玫瑰经。

e.en: He kept a wooden {rosary} in his pocket for comfort.
e.zh: 他口袋里总放着一串木制念珠以求安慰。

rose.t:
n. 玫瑰
v. 上升（rise 的过去式）

e.en: He gave her a single red {rose} on Valentine's Day.
e.zh: 情人节那天他送了她一支红玫瑰。

e.en: Housing prices {rose} sharply across the city last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度全市房价大幅上涨。

e.en: The sky turned a soft {roseate} hue at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空染上了柔和的玫瑰色。

e.en: He paints a {roseate} picture of the company's future.
e.zh: 他把公司的未来描绘得一片光明。

e.en: Lord {Rosebery} served briefly as British Prime Minister.
e.zh: 罗斯伯里勋爵曾短暂担任英国首相。

e.en: We strolled through {Rosebery} Park on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的午后漫步穿过罗斯伯里公园。

e.en: A tiny {rosebud} began to open in the morning sun.
e.zh: 一朵小小的玫瑰花蕾在晨光中绽放。

e.en: The garden was full of {rosebud} clusters waiting to bloom.
e.zh: 花园里满是即将绽放的玫瑰花蕾。

e.en: She planted a climbing {rosebush} along the back fence.
e.zh: 她在后院篱笆旁种了一丛爬藤玫瑰。

e.en: The thorny {rosebush} produces dozens of pink flowers each summer.
e.zh: 那丛带刺的玫瑰每年夏天会开出几十朵粉红花。

e.en: They bought a charming old house in {Rosedale} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们在罗斯代尔买了一栋迷人的老房子。

e.en: {Rosedale} is one of Toronto's most affluent neighborhoods.
e.zh: 罗斯代尔是多伦多最富裕的社区之一。

rosemary.t:
n. 迷迭香（香草）
n. 罗斯玛丽（人名）

e.en: She added fresh {rosemary} to the roasted chicken.
e.zh: 她在烤鸡上加了新鲜的迷迭香。

e.en: A pot of {rosemary} sat on the kitchen windowsill.
e.zh: 厨房窗台上放着一盆迷迭香。

e.en: He sent her a dozen red {roses} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 周年纪念日他给她送了一打红玫瑰。

e.en: Life isn't always {roses}, but we keep going anyway.
e.zh: 生活并非总是一帆风顺，但我们仍要继续前行。

rosetta.t: n. 罗塞塔（埃及地名，罗塞塔石碑）

e.en: The {Rosetta} Stone unlocked the secrets of ancient Egyptian writing.
e.zh: 罗塞塔石碑揭开了古埃及文字的奥秘。

e.en: Many learners use {Rosetta} Stone software to study languages.
e.zh: 许多学习者使用罗塞塔石碑软件来学习语言。

e.en: Her horse won a blue {rosette} at the country show.
e.zh: 她的马在乡村展览会上赢得了一枚蓝色花结奖章。

e.en: The chef arranged the salmon slices into a delicate {rosette}.
e.zh: 厨师把三文鱼片摆成了精致的玫瑰花形。

e.en: The guitar's neck is crafted from beautifully grained {rosewood}.
e.zh: 这把吉他的琴颈用纹理精美的玫瑰木制成。

e.en: They bought an antique {rosewood} cabinet at the auction.
e.zh: 他们在拍卖会上买下了一个古董玫瑰木柜。

rosicrucian.t:
n. 玫瑰十字会成员
adj. 玫瑰十字会的

e.en: He claimed to be a member of an old {Rosicrucian} order.
e.zh: 他声称自己是一个古老玫瑰十字会的成员。

e.en: The novel weaves {Rosicrucian} symbols into its central mystery.
e.zh: 小说将玫瑰十字会的符号融入了核心谜团。

e.en: The violinist rubbed {rosin} on her bow before the concert.
e.zh: 小提琴家在音乐会前给琴弓擦了松香。

e.en: Gymnasts use {rosin} to keep their grip on the bars.
e.zh: 体操运动员用松香来保持抓杠的摩擦力。

rossendale.t: n. 罗森代尔（英国地名）

e.en: They hiked across the green hills of {Rossendale} last weekend.
e.zh: 他们上周末徒步穿越了罗森代尔的绿色山丘。

e.en: {Rossendale} is a borough in eastern Lancashire, England.
e.zh: 罗森代尔是英格兰兰开夏郡东部的一个自治市。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Rosslyn} Chapel for its mysterious carvings.
e.zh: 游客们涌向罗斯林教堂参观那些神秘的雕刻。

e.en: She rented an apartment in {Rosslyn}, just across the river.
e.zh: 她在河对岸的罗斯林租了一套公寓。

e.en: The chef recommended a glass of vermouth {rosso} with dinner.
e.zh: 主厨推荐晚餐配一杯红味美思酒。

e.en: They painted the kitchen wall a deep Italian {rosso}.
e.zh: 他们把厨房墙刷成了浓郁的意大利红。

e.en: The coach added two new players to the team {roster}.
e.zh: 教练在球队名单上新增了两名球员。

e.en: Please check the duty {roster} for next week's shifts.
e.zh: 请查看下周的值班表。

rostock.t: n. 罗斯托克（德国城市）

e.en: The ferry from {Rostock} to Denmark takes about two hours.
e.zh: 从罗斯托克到丹麦的渡轮大约需要两小时。

e.en: {Rostock} is a major port city on Germany's Baltic coast.
e.zh: 罗斯托克是德国波罗的海沿岸的主要港口城市。

rostov.t: n. 罗斯托夫（俄罗斯城市）

e.en: The train to {Rostov} departs from platform six at midnight.
e.zh: 开往罗斯托夫的列车午夜从六号站台出发。

e.en: {Rostov} sits near the mouth of the Don River.
e.zh: 罗斯托夫坐落在顿河入海口附近。

e.en: The speaker stepped onto the {rostrum} and adjusted the microphone.
e.zh: 演讲者走上讲台,调整了麦克风。

e.en: The conductor took her place on the {rostrum} and raised her baton.
e.zh: 指挥家走上指挥台,举起了指挥棒。

e.en: The forecast for the company's growth looks quite {rosy}.
e.zh: 公司增长前景看起来相当乐观。

e.en: The baby's {rosy} cheeks made everyone smile.
e.zh: 婴儿红润的脸颊让大家都笑了。

rosyth.t: n. 罗塞斯（苏格兰地名）

e.en: Naval ships are still maintained at {Rosyth} dockyard in Scotland.
e.zh: 海军舰艇仍在苏格兰的罗赛斯船坞进行维护。

e.en: He grew up in {Rosyth}, just north of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 他在爱丁堡以北的罗赛斯长大。

rot.t:
v. 腐烂；变质
n. 腐朽

e.en: The cleaning {rota} is pinned to the kitchen noticeboard.
e.zh: 清洁值日表钉在厨房的公告板上。

e.en: We take turns cooking according to a weekly {rota}.
e.zh: 我们按每周的轮值表轮流做饭。

rotary.t:
adj. 旋转的
n. 环形交叉路口

e.en: Old phones had a {rotary} dial instead of buttons.
e.zh: 老式电话用的是旋转拨号盘而不是按键。

e.en: Drive around the {rotary} and take the second exit.
e.zh: 绕着环岛行驶,从第二个出口出去。

e.en: The screen is fully {rotatable} for both portrait and landscape modes.
e.zh: 屏幕可完全旋转,支持竖屏和横屏模式。

e.en: Each chair has a {rotatable} base for easy turning.
e.zh: 每把椅子都有可旋转底座,方便转向。

e.en: Tap the icon to {rotate} the image ninety degrees.
e.zh: 点击图标可将图像旋转九十度。

e.en: Team members {rotate} through different roles every quarter.
e.zh: 团队成员每季度轮换不同的岗位。

rotated.t: v. 旋转（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {rotated} the puzzle piece until it fit perfectly.
e.zh: 她转动拼图块,直到它正好嵌入。

e.en: The crops are {rotated} each season to preserve soil health.
e.zh: 每个季节都会轮种作物,以保持土壤健康。

rotates.t: v. 旋转（第三人称单数）

e.en: The Earth {rotates} on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
e.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕地轴自转一周。

e.en: Our team {rotates} the on-call duty every week.
e.zh: 我们团队每周轮换一次值班任务。

rotating.t:
v. 旋转中（现在分词）
adj. 旋转的

e.en: The restaurant has a slowly {rotating} floor with city views.
e.zh: 那家餐厅有缓缓旋转的地板,可俯瞰城市。

e.en: We have a {rotating} schedule of guest speakers each month.
e.zh: 我们每月安排不同的嘉宾轮流演讲。

e.en: The pitcher is back in the starting {rotation} this week.
e.zh: 那位投手本周重回先发轮值阵容。

e.en: One full {rotation} of the wheel takes two seconds.
e.zh: 轮子转一整圈需要两秒。

roundabouts.t: n. 环岛；旋转木马（roundabout 复数）

e.en: British towns use {roundabouts} instead of traffic lights.
e.zh: 英国城镇用环岛代替红绿灯。

e.en: What you lose on swings, you gain on {roundabouts}.
e.zh: 失之东隅，收之桑榆。

rounded.t:
adj. 圆形的；圆润的
v. 绕过（round 过去式）

e.en: The table has nicely {rounded} edges for child safety.
e.zh: 这张桌子有圆润的边角，保障儿童安全。

e.en: She has a well-{rounded} background in art and science.
e.zh: 她在艺术和科学方面都有全面的背景。

roundel.t: n. 圆形装饰；圆形徽章

e.en: A blue {roundel} marks every London Underground station.
e.zh: 每个伦敦地铁站都有一个蓝色圆形标志。

e.en: The aircraft displayed a red {roundel} on its wing.
e.zh: 那架飞机机翼上有一个红色圆形徽章。

rounder.t:
adj. 更圆的（round 比较级）
n. 浪荡子

e.en: Her face looks {rounder} after gaining a few pounds.
e.zh: 她长了几斤后脸看起来更圆了。

e.en: The new lens makes objects appear {rounder} and softer.
e.zh: 新镜头让物体看起来更圆润、更柔和。

rounders.t: n. 英式圆场棒球（一种球类运动）

e.en: Children played {rounders} in the school playground every recess.
e.zh: 孩子们每次课间都在操场上玩棒球式游戏。

e.en: {Rounders} is a traditional bat-and-ball game in Britain.
e.zh: 圆场棒球是英国一种传统的棒球类运动。

roundhead.t: n. 圆颅党人（英国内战时期）

e.en: The {roundhead} soldiers fought against the king's forces.
e.zh: 圆颅党士兵与国王的军队作战。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on {roundhead} politics during the civil war.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于内战时期圆颅党政治的论文。

roundhouse.t:
n. 机车扇形车库
n. 大幅挥拳

e.en: The boxer landed a powerful {roundhouse} kick to the jaw.
e.zh: 那位拳手向下颚踢出一记有力的回旋踢。

e.en: Old locomotives were stored in the railway {roundhouse}.
e.zh: 旧机车存放在铁路扇形车库里。

rounding.t:
n. 四舍五入；取整
v. 绕过（round 现在分词）

e.en: The {rounding} error caused a small discrepancy in the total.
e.zh: 四舍五入误差导致总数出现小幅偏差。

e.en: She was {rounding} the corner when the rain began.
e.zh: 她正绕过街角时下起了雨。

e.en: The puppy has a {roundish} face and floppy ears.
e.zh: 那只小狗有张圆圆的脸和耷拉的耳朵。

e.en: He drew a {roundish} shape that resembled a potato.
e.zh: 他画了一个像土豆似的圆乎乎的形状。

e.en: Critics {roundly} condemned the company's misleading advertising.
e.zh: 评论人士严厉谴责该公司误导性的广告。

e.en: Her proposal was {roundly} rejected by the entire committee.
e.zh: 她的提案遭到整个委员会的彻底否决。

e.en: The {roundness} of the moon was breathtaking that night.
e.zh: 那晚月亮的圆润令人惊叹。

e.en: He admired the perfect {roundness} of the handmade vase.
e.zh: 他赞叹那只手工花瓶完美的圆润形状。

rounds.t:
n. 几轮；巡查
v. 绕过（round 第三人称单数）

e.en: The doctor makes her {rounds} every morning at seven.
e.zh: 那位医生每天早上七点查房。

e.en: He bought {rounds} of drinks for everyone at the bar.
e.zh: 他给酒吧里的每个人都买了一轮酒。

roundtable.t:
n. 圆桌会议
adj. 圆桌的

e.en: Experts joined a {roundtable} discussion about climate policy.
e.zh: 专家们参加了关于气候政策的圆桌讨论。

e.en: The CEO hosted a {roundtable} with senior engineers yesterday.
e.zh: 首席执行官昨天与高级工程师举行了圆桌会议。

roundup.t:
n. 新闻摘要；围捕
n. 牲畜集拢

e.en: Here's a quick {roundup} of this week's tech news.
e.zh: 这是本周科技新闻的快速综述。

e.en: The cowboys finished the cattle {roundup} before sunset.
e.zh: 牛仔们在日落前完成了牛群的围拢。

roundups.t: n. 摘要；围捕（roundup 复数）

e.en: The website publishes weekly {roundups} of trending topics.
e.zh: 该网站每周发布热门话题综述。

e.en: Police conducted several {roundups} of suspected gang members.
e.zh: 警方对涉嫌帮派成员进行了多次围捕。

e.en: The vet treated the puppy for a {roundworm} infection.
e.zh: 兽医为小狗治疗蛔虫感染。

e.en: Wash vegetables thoroughly to avoid {roundworm} contamination.
e.zh: 彻底清洗蔬菜以避免蛔虫污染。

e.en: The loud alarm failed to {rouse} him from sleep.
e.zh: 响亮的闹钟没能把他从睡梦中唤醒。

e.en: Her speech managed to {rouse} the crowd to action.
e.zh: 她的演讲成功激起了人群的行动。

e.en: His final song was a real {rouser} that energized everyone.
e.zh: 他的压轴歌曲非常激动人心，让所有人都振奋起来。

e.en: The coach's pep talk was a great {rouser} before the match.
e.zh: 赛前教练的鼓劲讲话非常激励人心。

rousing.t: adj. 激动人心的；热烈的

e.en: The team received a {rousing} welcome from cheering fans.
e.zh: 球队受到欢呼球迷的热烈欢迎。

e.en: She gave a {rousing} speech that inspired the volunteers.
e.zh: 她发表了振奋人心的演讲，激励了志愿者们。

e.en: Philosophy students still debate {Rousseau}'s social contract theory.
e.zh: 哲学专业的学生仍在争论卢梭的社会契约论。

e.en: {Rousseau} argued that humans are born inherently good.
e.zh: 卢梭认为人天生本善。

e.en: Officers came to {roust} the squatters from the building.
e.zh: 警员前来把占屋者从大楼里赶出去。

e.en: Mom had to {roust} the kids out of bed early.
e.zh: 妈妈不得不一大早把孩子们从床上拽起来。

roustabout.t: n. 码头工人；油田杂工

e.en: He worked as a {roustabout} on offshore oil platforms.
e.zh: 他在海上石油平台上当杂工。

e.en: The circus hired a {roustabout} to set up the tents.
e.zh: 马戏团雇了一名杂工来搭帐篷。

rout.t:
n. 溃败
v. 击溃

e.en: The home team suffered a humiliating {rout} on Saturday.
e.zh: 主队周六遭遇了一场惨败。

e.en: Their army managed to {rout} the enemy within hours.
e.zh: 他们的军队几小时内就击溃了敌人。

route.t:
n. 路线；路由
v. 按路线发送

e.en: The GPS suggested a faster {route} avoiding the highway.
e.zh: 导航推荐了一条避开高速的更快路线。

e.en: We need to {route} the cables along the wall.
e.zh: 我们需要把电缆沿着墙布线。

routed.t: v. 路由（route 过去式）；击溃（rout 过去式）

e.en: The champions {routed} their rivals seven goals to nothing.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军以七比零大胜对手。

e.en: All customer emails are {routed} through our support system.
e.zh: 所有客户邮件都通过我们的客服系统转发。

e.en: Restart the {router} if your WiFi keeps dropping out.
e.zh: 如果Wi-Fi总是断线，就重启一下路由器。

e.en: He uses a {router} to shape decorative edges on wood.
e.zh: 他用刨槽机在木头上修出装饰边缘。

routes.t:
n. 路线（route 复数）
v. 发送（route 第三人称单数）

e.en: The app shows several {routes} from your home to work.
e.zh: 这款应用显示从家到公司的几条路线。

e.en: New bus {routes} were added to serve the suburbs.
e.zh: 新增了几条公交路线为郊区提供服务。

routine.t:
n. 日常惯例；例行程序
adj. 常规的

e.en: My morning {routine} includes coffee and a quick workout.
e.zh: 我早上的例行活动包括喝咖啡和简短锻炼。

e.en: The dentist said it was just a {routine} check-up.
e.zh: 牙医说这只是一次常规检查。

e.en: The servers are {routinely} backed up every night at midnight.
e.zh: 服务器每晚午夜定期备份。

e.en: Doctors {routinely} check blood pressure during annual physicals.
e.zh: 医生在年度体检中例行检查血压。

routines.t: n. 日常惯例；例行程序（routine 复数）

e.en: Kids thrive when they have consistent daily {routines}.
e.zh: 孩子有稳定的日常作息时会茁壮成长。

e.en: The gymnast practiced her floor {routines} for hours.
e.zh: 那位体操运动员练习自由体操动作好几个小时。

routing.t:
n. 路由；线路安排
v. 发送（route 现在分词）

e.en: The new app handles {routing} for delivery drivers automatically.
e.zh: 这款新应用自动为送货司机规划路线。

e.en: Network {routing} determines how data packets reach their destination.
e.zh: 网络路由决定数据包如何到达目的地。

e.en: The {routinization} of office tasks freed up creative time.
e.zh: 办公任务的常规化腾出了创意时间。

e.en: Critics warned against the {routinization} of artistic expression.
e.zh: 评论家警告艺术表达不应被程式化。

routinized.t:
adj. 常规化的
v. 使成惯例（过去式）

e.en: The factory {routinized} every step of the assembly process.
e.zh: 工厂将装配流程的每一步都程式化了。

e.en: His {routinized} schedule left little room for spontaneity.
e.zh: 他程式化的日程几乎没有自发性的空间。

routledge.t: n. 劳特利奇（出版社名）

e.en: The textbook was published by {Routledge} last spring.
e.zh: 这本教科书去年春天由劳特利奇出版社出版。

e.en: She signed a book deal with {Routledge} for her thesis.
e.zh: 她与劳特利奇出版社签了她论文的出书合约。

roux.t: n. 油面酱（面粉和黄油炒制的调味基底）

e.en: Make a {roux} with butter and flour before adding milk.
e.zh: 先用黄油和面粉做一个油面酱，再加牛奶。

e.en: A dark {roux} gives gumbo its rich, nutty flavor.
e.zh: 深色油面酱赋予秋葵浓汤浓郁的坚果风味。

e.en: His eyes {rove} across the crowd, searching for a friend.
e.zh: 他的目光在人群中扫视，寻找朋友。

e.en: Wild horses {rove} freely across the open plains.
e.zh: 野马在开阔的平原上自由游荡。

rover.t: n. 漫游者；月球车、火星车

e.en: The Mars {rover} sent back stunning new images today.
e.zh: 火星探测车今天传回了震撼的新图像。

e.en: He's a true {rover} who never stays in one city.
e.zh: 他是个真正的漂泊者，从不在一座城市久留。

e.en: A {roving} reporter covered the protest from multiple angles.
e.zh: 一位巡回记者从多个角度报道了抗议活动。

e.en: Her {roving} eyes made him uncomfortable during the meeting.
e.zh: 她游移的目光让他在会议中感到不自在。

row.t:
n. 一排；行
v. 划船

e.en: A {rowan} tree stood guard beside the old cottage.
e.zh: 一棵花楸树守护在老屋旁。

e.en: The {rowan} berries turned bright red in early autumn.
e.zh: 花楸果在初秋变得鲜红。

e.en: We rented a small {rowboat} to explore the lake.
e.zh: 我们租了一艘小划艇去游览湖面。

e.en: The wooden {rowboat} drifted slowly toward the shore.
e.zh: 那艘木划艇慢慢漂向岸边。

rowdies.t: n. 吵闹者；闹事者（rowdy 复数）

e.en: The bouncer kicked out the {rowdies} causing trouble inside.
e.zh: 保安把在里面闹事的家伙们赶了出去。

e.en: A group of {rowdies} disturbed the quiet neighborhood last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一群闹事者打扰了安静的社区。

e.en: The teacher couldn't tolerate the {rowdiness} in her classroom.
e.zh: 老师无法容忍课堂上的吵闹。

e.en: Stadium security increased after recent fan {rowdiness}.
e.zh: 由于近期球迷骚乱，球场安保有所加强。

rowdy.t:
adj. 吵闹的；粗野的
n. 闹事者

e.en: The bar got {rowdy} after the team's championship win.
e.zh: 球队夺冠后，酒吧变得喧闹起来。

e.en: A {rowdy} group of kids ran through the playground.
e.zh: 一群吵闹的孩子在操场上跑来跑去。

e.en: They {rowed} across the lake before sunrise.
e.zh: 他们在日出前划船穿越了湖面。

e.en: She {rowed} steadily toward the distant shoreline.
e.zh: 她稳稳地朝远处的海岸划去。

e.en: Engineers measured the {rotational} speed of the turbine.
e.zh: 工程师测量了涡轮的转速。

e.en: Junior staff complete a six-month {rotational} program.
e.zh: 初级员工要完成为期六个月的轮岗培训。

rotations.t: n. 旋转；轮换（rotation 复数）

e.en: The propeller completed thousands of {rotations} per minute.
e.zh: 螺旋桨每分钟旋转数千圈。

e.en: Medical students do clinical {rotations} in different departments.
e.zh: 医学生要在不同科室进行临床轮转。

e.en: He tore his {rotator} cuff during the tennis match.
e.zh: 他在网球比赛中拉伤了肩袖。

e.en: The antenna sits on a motorized {rotator} on the roof.
e.zh: 天线安装在屋顶一个电动旋转座上。

e.en: Babies receive a {rotavirus} vaccine to prevent severe diarrhea.
e.zh: 婴儿要接种轮状病毒疫苗以预防严重腹泻。

e.en: An outbreak of {rotavirus} closed the daycare for a week.
e.zh: 轮状病毒爆发使托儿所停办了一周。

rote.t:
n. 死记硬背
adj. 机械记忆的

e.en: She learned the multiplication tables by {rote}.
e.zh: 她靠死记硬背学会了乘法口诀。

e.en: Pure {rote} memorization rarely leads to deep understanding.
e.zh: 单纯的死记硬背很难带来真正的理解。

e.en: Organic farmers once used {rotenone} as a natural pesticide.
e.zh: 有机农人过去用鱼藤酮作为天然杀虫剂。

e.en: Biologists applied {rotenone} to remove invasive fish from the lake.
e.zh: 生物学家施用鱼藤酮以清除湖中入侵鱼种。

e.en: They drank cheap {rotgut} whiskey from a flask.
e.zh: 他们就着随身酒壶灌着廉价劣质威士忌。

e.en: Avoid that bar's {rotgut} unless you want a hangover.
e.zh: 除非想宿醉,否则别碰那家酒吧的劣质烈酒。

e.en: Anglers cast their lines along the banks of the {Rother}.
e.zh: 垂钓者沿着罗瑟河岸抛竿钓鱼。

e.en: Heavy rain caused the {Rother} to overflow last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天大雨让罗瑟河漫过了堤岸。

rotherham.t: n. 罗瑟勒姆（英国城市）

e.en: He grew up in {Rotherham} before moving to London.
e.zh: 他在搬到伦敦之前一直在罗瑟勒姆长大。

e.en: {Rotherham} United plays its home games at the New York Stadium.
e.zh: 罗瑟勒姆联队在纽约球场进行主场比赛。

rothesay.t: n. 罗撒西（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The ferry to {Rothesay} leaves every hour from Wemyss Bay.
e.zh: 开往罗瑟西的渡轮每小时从威姆斯湾出发。

e.en: Tourists stroll along the seafront promenade in {Rothesay}.
e.zh: 游客们在罗瑟西的海滨长廊上漫步。

e.en: He lit a {Rothmans} and stared out the window.
e.zh: 他点燃一支乐富门,望向窗外。

e.en: The corner shop no longer stocks {Rothmans} cigarettes.
e.zh: 街角小店不再卖乐富门香烟了。

rotifer.t: n. 轮虫（微小水生动物）

e.en: Under the microscope, a tiny {rotifer} spun its crown of cilia.
e.zh: 显微镜下,一只小小的轮虫旋动着冠状纤毛。

e.en: Each {rotifer} filters bacteria from the pond water.
e.zh: 每只轮虫都从池水中过滤细菌为食。

rotisserie.t: n. 旋转烤肉架；烤肉店

e.en: We bought a {rotisserie} chicken for dinner.
e.zh: 我们买了一只烤全鸡当晚餐。

e.en: The deli's {rotisserie} turns slowly behind the counter.
e.zh: 熟食店的烤肉转炉在柜台后缓缓转动。

e.en: The helicopter's {rotor} began spinning faster as it lifted off.
e.zh: 直升机起飞时,旋翼转得越来越快。

e.en: Mechanics replaced the worn brake {rotor} on my car.
e.zh: 机修工换掉了我车上磨损的刹车盘。

e.en: The military deployed {rotorcraft} for the rescue mission.
e.zh: 军方派出旋翼飞机执行救援任务。

e.en: Modern {rotorcraft} can hover steadily in strong winds.
e.zh: 现代旋翼飞行器能在强风中稳定悬停。

e.en: He used a {rototiller} to break up the hard garden soil.
e.zh: 他用旋耕机翻松了花园里坚硬的土壤。

e.en: You can rent a {rototiller} from the hardware store.
e.zh: 你可以从五金店租到一台旋耕机。

rotted.t: v. 腐烂（rot 的过去式）

e.en: The fence posts {rotted} after years of heavy rain.
e.zh: 经过多年大雨,栅栏柱都烂掉了。

e.en: The fruit had {rotted} at the bottom of the basket.
e.zh: 水果在篮底已经烂掉了。

e.en: Don't eat that apple — it's gone {rotten}.
e.zh: 别吃那个苹果,已经烂了。

e.en: I've had a {rotten} day at work.
e.zh: 我今天上班过得糟透了。

e.en: The investigation revealed deep {rottenness} inside the agency.
e.zh: 调查揭露了那个机构内部的深层腐败。

e.en: You could smell the {rottenness} of the old timber.
e.zh: 那些旧木头的腐臭味闻得一清二楚。

e.en: Her ex-boyfriend turned out to be a complete {rotter}.
e.zh: 她前男友原来是个十足的混蛋。

e.en: Only a {rotter} would steal from his own grandmother.
e.zh: 只有坏蛋才会偷自己祖母的东西。

e.en: {Rotterdam} is one of the busiest ports in Europe.
e.zh: 鹿特丹是欧洲最繁忙的港口之一。

e.en: We took the train from Amsterdam to {Rotterdam} in an hour.
e.zh: 我们从阿姆斯特丹坐火车一小时就到了鹿特丹。

rotting.t: v. 正在腐烂（rot 的现在分词）

e.en: A pile of {rotting} leaves filled the gutter.
e.zh: 一堆腐烂的树叶堵住了排水沟。

e.en: His old novels are {rotting} away in the basement.
e.zh: 他的旧小说在地下室里慢慢腐烂。

e.en: Their {Rottweiler} is surprisingly gentle with the children.
e.zh: 他们家的罗威纳犬对孩子出奇地温柔。

e.en: A trained {Rottweiler} guards the warehouse at night.
e.zh: 一只受过训练的罗威纳犬夜里守卫仓库。

e.en: The {rotund} chef wiped flour from his apron.
e.zh: 那位胖乎乎的厨师从围裙上拍掉面粉。

e.en: A {rotund} little robin hopped across the lawn.
e.zh: 一只圆滚滚的小知更鸟在草坪上跳来跳去。

rotunda.t: n. 圆形大厅；圆顶建筑

e.en: Tourists gathered under the dome of the Capitol {rotunda}.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在国会大厦圆形大厅的穹顶下。

e.en: The hotel lobby features a marble {rotunda} with a fountain.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里有一座带喷泉的大理石圆形大厅。

e.en: The {rouble} has weakened sharply against the dollar.
e.zh: 卢布兑美元大幅贬值。

e.en: He paid the taxi driver a few hundred {rouble}.
e.zh: 他付给出租车司机几百卢布。

e.en: Joan of Arc was famously tried and executed in {Rouen}.
e.zh: 圣女贞德著名地在鲁昂被审判并处决。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the medieval streets of {Rouen}.
e.zh: 我们用一个周末游览了鲁昂的中世纪街道。

rouge.t:
n. 胭脂；腮红
v. 涂胭脂

e.en: She dabbed a little {rouge} on her cheeks before leaving.
e.zh: 她出门前在脸颊上轻拍了一点胭脂。

e.en: Vintage compacts of {rouge} are popular with collectors.
e.zh: 老式胭脂粉盒在收藏家中很受欢迎。

e.en: She {rouged} her cheeks before the photo shoot started.
e.zh: 她在拍摄开始前涂了腮红。

e.en: The actress {rouged} her lips a deep crimson red.
e.zh: 那位女演员把嘴唇涂成深红色。

rough.t:
adj. 粗糙的；粗略的
v. 粗加工

e.en: The road ahead is {rough} and full of potholes.
e.zh: 前方的路很颠簸，到处是坑洞。

e.en: He sketched a {rough} draft of the new logo.
e.zh: 他画了一份新标志的草图。

e.en: Vegetables provide essential {roughage} for healthy digestion.
e.zh: 蔬菜为健康消化提供必需的粗纤维。

e.en: Doctors recommend more {roughage} in your daily diet.
e.zh: 医生建议日常饮食中多摄入粗纤维。

e.en: Sandpaper will {roughen} the surface before painting.
e.zh: 砂纸会在上漆前让表面变得粗糙。

e.en: Cold winds tend to {roughen} your skin in winter.
e.zh: 寒风往往会让皮肤在冬天变得粗糙。

e.en: Years of farm work {roughened} his hands considerably.
e.zh: 多年的农活让他的双手变得十分粗糙。

e.en: The {roughened} texture helps the glue stick better.
e.zh: 粗糙的表面让胶水粘得更牢。

e.en: The kids love to {roughhouse} on the living room couch.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在客厅沙发上打闹。

e.en: Please don't {roughhouse} near the glass coffee table.
e.zh: 请不要在玻璃茶几旁打闹。

roughly.t: adv. 大致；粗略地；粗暴地

e.en: The trip will take {roughly} three hours by train.
e.zh: 这趟旅程坐火车大约要三小时。

e.en: He pushed the door open {roughly} and stormed inside.
e.zh: 他粗暴地推开门，冲了进去。

roughneck.t: n. 钻井工人；粗鲁的人

e.en: The {roughneck} worked twelve-hour shifts on the oil rig.
e.zh: 那名钻井工人在石油钻塔上轮班十二小时。

e.en: Don't act like a {roughneck} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 别在晚宴上表现得像个粗人。

e.en: The {roughness} of the fabric irritated her sensitive skin.
e.zh: 布料的粗糙让她敏感的皮肤感到不适。

e.en: Sandpaper smooths the {roughness} of the wooden surface.
e.zh: 砂纸能磨平木头表面的粗糙。

e.en: The new manager rode {roughshod} over everyone's concerns.
e.zh: 新经理对大家的顾虑置之不理，专横独断。

e.en: Don't run {roughshod} over your colleagues' opinions.
e.zh: 不要粗暴地践踏同事的意见。

rouille.t: n. 红椒蒜泥酱（法式调味酱）

e.en: Serve the fish soup with crusty bread and {rouille}.
e.zh: 鱼汤搭配脆皮面包和红椒蒜泥酱一起上桌。

e.en: The chef prepared a spicy {rouille} for the bouillabaisse.
e.zh: 厨师为马赛鱼汤准备了辣味红椒蒜泥酱。

roulade.t: n. 肉卷；花式装饰乐段

e.en: She baked a chocolate {roulade} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴烤了一个巧克力蛋糕卷。

e.en: The chef stuffed the beef {roulade} with herbs and cheese.
e.zh: 厨师在牛肉卷里填入香草和奶酪。

e.en: He lost a fortune playing {roulette} in Las Vegas.
e.zh: 他在拉斯维加斯玩轮盘赌输掉了一大笔钱。

e.en: Driving without a seatbelt is like playing Russian {roulette}.
e.zh: 不系安全带开车就像玩俄罗斯轮盘赌。

round.t:
adj. 圆的
n. 一轮；一回合

e.en: The earth is {round}, not flat as some believed.
e.zh: 地球是圆的，并非有些人以为的那样平坦。

e.en: She made it through to the final {round} of interviews.
e.zh: 她挺进了最后一轮面试。

roundabout.t:
n. 环岛；旋转木马
adj. 迂回的

e.en: He took a {roundabout} route to avoid the traffic jam.
e.zh: 他绕了一条远路避开堵车。

e.en: Slow down before you enter the busy {roundabout}.
e.zh: 进入繁忙的环岛前请减速。

e.en: The Olympic {rower} trained six hours every single day.
e.zh: 那位奥运赛艇运动员每天训练六个小时。

e.en: Each {rower} synchronized perfectly with the rest of the crew.
e.zh: 每位划手都与其他队员配合得天衣无缝。

rowing.t:
n. 划船（运动）
v. 划（船）

e.en: She joined the university {rowing} team last September.
e.zh: 她去年九月加入了大学赛艇队。

e.en: He kept {rowing} until his arms ached badly.
e.zh: 他一直划到双臂酸痛得厉害。

e.en: The {Rowntree} chocolate factory shaped York's industrial history.
e.zh: 朗特里巧克力工厂塑造了约克的工业史。

e.en: My grandfather worked at {Rowntree} for over forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在朗特里工作了四十多年。

e.en: She planted neat {rows} of tomatoes in the garden.
e.zh: 她在花园里种了一排排整齐的番茄。

e.en: The front {rows} of the theater were already full.
e.zh: 剧院前排的座位已经坐满了。

roxburgh.t: n. 罗克斯堡（地名/姓氏）

e.en: The Duke of {Roxburgh} owned vast estates in Scotland.
e.zh: 罗克斯堡公爵在苏格兰拥有大片庄园。

e.en: We visited {Roxburgh} Castle during our Scottish road trip.
e.zh: 我们在苏格兰自驾游时参观了罗克斯堡城堡。

e.en: The {royal} family waved from the palace balcony.
e.zh: 王室成员在王宫阳台上挥手致意。

e.en: She received a {royal} welcome at the airport yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天在机场受到了隆重的欢迎。

royale.t: n./adj. 皇家（常用于品牌或菜名）

e.en: He ordered a quarter pounder and a chicken {royale}.
e.zh: 他点了一份四盎司汉堡和一份皇家鸡肉堡。

e.en: The new battle {royale} game attracted millions of players.
e.zh: 这款新的大逃杀游戏吸引了数百万玩家。

royalist.t:
n. 保皇党人
adj. 拥护君主的

e.en: His grandmother remained a fierce {royalist} all her life.
e.zh: 他的祖母一辈子都是坚定的保皇派。

e.en: The {royalist} forces lost the decisive battle in 1645.
e.zh: 保皇党军队在1645年的决战中失利。

e.en: The hotel staff treated us absolutely {royally} during our stay.
e.zh: 我们入住期间，酒店员工待我们如同贵宾。

e.en: He {royally} messed up the presentation in front of clients.
e.zh: 他在客户面前把演讲彻底搞砸了。

royalties.t: n. 版税，特许权使用费（royalty 的复数）

e.en: The author earns generous {royalties} from her bestselling novel.
e.zh: 这位作家从她的畅销小说中赚取了丰厚的版税。

e.en: Streaming platforms pay tiny {royalties} per song play.
e.zh: 流媒体平台每播放一首歌支付的版税少得可怜。

royalty.t:
n. 版税，使用费
n. 王室成员

e.en: European {royalty} attended the lavish wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 欧洲王室成员出席了那场盛大的婚礼。

e.en: He receives a small {royalty} for each book sold.
e.zh: 每卖出一本书他都能拿到一笔小额版税。

royce.t: n. 罗伊斯（姓氏，如劳斯莱斯）

e.en: A gleaming Rolls-{Royce} pulled up to the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 一辆锃亮的劳斯莱斯停在了酒店门口。

e.en: The Rolls-{Royce} engine purred quietly down the highway.
e.zh: 那台劳斯莱斯发动机在高速上安静地运转着。

royston.t: n. 罗伊斯顿（地名/人名）

e.en: We caught a train from {Royston} to London Kings Cross.
e.zh: 我们从罗伊斯顿坐火车到伦敦国王十字站。

e.en: {Royston} is a small market town in Hertfordshire.
e.zh: 罗伊斯顿是赫特福德郡的一个小集镇。

e.en: Watch out, there's a {rozzer} on the corner.
e.zh: 小心,街角有个条子。

e.en: The old crook still calls every cop a {rozzer}.
e.zh: 那个老骗子至今还把每个警察都叫成条子。

rpc.t: n. 远程过程调用（Remote Procedure Call）

rpf.t: n. 卢旺达爱国阵线（Rwandan Patriotic Front）

rpi.t: n. 零售物价指数（Retail Price Index）

rpm.t: n. 每分钟转速（revolutions per minute）

rpr.t: n. 快速血浆反应素试验（Rapid Plasma Reagin）

rps.t:
n. 石头剪刀布（Rock Paper Scissors）
n. 每秒请求数

rsa.t:
n. RSA 加密算法
n. 南非共和国

rsc.t: n. 英国皇家莎士比亚剧团

rspb.t: n. 英国皇家鸟类保护协会

e.en: The {RSPB} runs hundreds of bird reserves across Britain.
e.zh: 皇家鸟类保护协会在英国管理着数百个鸟类保护区。

e.en: She volunteers for the {RSPB} every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都为皇家鸟类保护协会做志愿者。

rspca.t: n. 英国皇家防止虐待动物协会

e.en: The {RSPCA} rescued the abandoned puppies from the warehouse.
e.zh: 皇家防止虐待动物协会从仓库里救出了被遗弃的小狗。

e.en: Call the {RSPCA} if you see an injured animal.
e.zh: 如果看到受伤的动物,请联系皇家防止虐待动物协会。

e.en: Please {RSVP} to the wedding by next Friday.
e.zh: 请在下周五前回复是否出席婚礼。

e.en: Only twenty guests have {RSVPed} to the party so far.
e.zh: 目前只有二十位客人回复将出席派对。

rte.t:
n. 路线（route 缩写）
n. 爱尔兰国家广播电视

rtr.t: n. 准备发送（Ready To Receive/Run）

rub.t:
v. 摩擦，揉搓
n. 难点，障碍

rubato.t: n. 自由速度（音乐术语）

e.en: She played the Chopin nocturne with delicate {rubato}.
e.zh: 她用细腻的弹性速度演奏了肖邦的夜曲。

e.en: Too much {rubato} can make the melody sound shapeless.
e.zh: 过多的弹性速度会让旋律显得没有形状。

rubbed.t: v. 擦，揉（rub 的过去式）

e.en: She {rubbed} her tired eyes and yawned.
e.zh: 她揉了揉疲惫的眼睛,打了个哈欠。

e.en: He {rubbed} sunscreen onto his shoulders before swimming.
e.zh: 游泳前他在肩膀上涂抹了防晒霜。

rubber.t:
n. 橡胶
n. 橡皮擦

e.en: These {rubber} boots keep my feet completely dry.
e.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我的脚完全保持干燥。

e.en: Always use a {rubber} band to secure the cables.
e.zh: 一定要用橡皮筋把电线扎好。

rubberised.t: adj. 涂橡胶的（英式拼写）

e.en: The phone case has a {rubberised} grip for extra safety.
e.zh: 这款手机壳有橡胶涂层握把,握起来更安全。

e.en: Workers wear {rubberised} aprons to repel chemical splashes.
e.zh: 工人们穿着橡胶涂层围裙以防化学品溅到身上。

rubberized.t: adj. 涂橡胶的，橡胶处理的

e.en: The dashboard has a soft {rubberized} finish.
e.zh: 仪表盘表面有一层柔软的橡胶涂层。

e.en: My headphones have {rubberized} earcups for comfort.
e.zh: 我的耳机耳罩采用橡胶涂层,戴起来很舒服。

e.en: Drivers always {rubberneck} when they pass an accident.
e.zh: 司机经过事故现场时总爱伸长脖子围观。

e.en: Please don't {rubberneck} — keep the traffic moving.
e.zh: 请不要驻足围观,让车流继续前进。

rubbernecker.t: n. 伸长脖子看热闹的人

e.en: A {rubbernecker} caused a second crash on the highway.
e.zh: 一名围观的司机在高速上引发了第二起车祸。

e.en: The officer waved every {rubbernecker} along impatiently.
e.zh: 警察不耐烦地挥手让每个围观者继续前行。

rubbers.t:
n. 橡胶制品；套鞋
n. rubber 的复数

e.en: Don't forget your {rubbers} — the streets are flooded.
e.zh: 别忘了带胶鞋,街上都积水了。

e.en: The pharmacy keeps {rubbers} behind the counter.
e.zh: 药房把避孕套放在柜台后面。

rubbery.t: adj. 像橡胶的；有弹性的

e.en: The overcooked steak tasted dry and {rubbery}.
e.zh: 那块煮过头的牛排吃起来又干又像橡胶。

e.en: My legs felt {rubbery} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步后我的双腿感觉软绵绵的。

rubbing.t:
n. 摩擦；拓印
v. rub 的现在分词

e.en: She is {rubbing} her hands together to keep warm.
e.zh: 她正搓着双手取暖。

e.en: The constant {rubbing} wore a hole in his sleeve.
e.zh: 持续的摩擦把他袖子磨出了一个洞。

rubbish.t:
n. 垃圾；废话
adj. 差劲的

e.en: Please take the {rubbish} out before bed.
e.zh: 睡前请把垃圾拿出去。

e.en: Honestly, that movie was complete {rubbish}.
e.zh: 老实说,那部电影完全是垃圾。

rubbishy.t: adj. 毫无价值的；废物般的

e.en: He gave me a {rubbishy} excuse for being late.
e.zh: 他为迟到给了我一个很烂的借口。

e.en: The store sells cheap, {rubbishy} plastic toys.
e.zh: 那家店卖的是廉价又劣质的塑料玩具。

e.en: Rescuers searched the {rubble} for survivors.
e.zh: 救援人员在瓦砾中搜寻幸存者。

e.en: The earthquake reduced the old church to {rubble}.
e.zh: 地震把那座古老的教堂夷为废墟。

rubbles.t: n. rubble 的复数；碎石堆

e.en: Piles of {rubbles} lined the bombed-out streets.
e.zh: 被炸毁的街道两旁堆满了瓦砾。

e.en: Workers cleared the {rubbles} from the construction site.
e.zh: 工人们清走了工地上的碎石堆。

e.en: After the marathon, he got a quick {rubdown}.
e.zh: 马拉松之后,他做了个简短的按摩。

e.en: The trainer gave the horse a thorough {rubdown}.
e.zh: 训练员给那匹马做了彻底的擦拭按摩。

e.en: The con artist targeted every {rube} who walked into the casino.
e.zh: 那个骗子盯上了每个走进赌场的乡巴佬。

e.en: Don't act like a {rube} when you visit the city.
e.zh: 进城的时候别一副土包子的样子。

e.en: Children are vaccinated against {rubella} at twelve months.
e.zh: 孩子们在十二个月大时接种风疹疫苗。

e.en: {Rubella} during pregnancy can harm the developing baby.
e.zh: 孕期感染风疹可能危害胎儿发育。

e.en: The museum's {Rubens} painting draws huge crowds every weekend.
e.zh: 博物馆里那幅鲁本斯的画每个周末都吸引大批人潮。

e.en: She studied {Rubens} during her semester in Antwerp.
e.zh: 她在安特卫普交换那个学期研究了鲁本斯。

rubicon.t: n. 卢比孔河；不可逆的界限

e.en: Quitting his job meant crossing the {Rubicon}.
e.zh: 辞掉工作意味着他越过了不归点。

e.en: Signing the contract was their personal {Rubicon}.
e.zh: 签下那份合同是他们个人的决断时刻。

e.en: The innkeeper had a {rubicund} face and a hearty laugh.
e.zh: 那位客栈老板红光满面,笑声爽朗。

e.en: Years of farming gave him a {rubicund} complexion.
e.zh: 多年的务农让他面色红润。

e.en: Atomic clocks often rely on {rubidium} for precision timing.
e.zh: 原子钟常用铷来实现精准计时。

e.en: Scientists detected {rubidium} traces in the meteorite sample.
e.zh: 科学家在陨石样本中检测到铷的痕迹。

e.en: Her grandmother loved listening to {Rubinstein} play Chopin.
e.zh: 她奶奶喜欢听鲁宾斯坦演奏肖邦。

e.en: The conservatory's annual {Rubinstein} competition starts next week.
e.zh: 音乐学院一年一度的鲁宾斯坦比赛下周开赛。

rubric.t: n. 标题；类别；评分标准

e.en: The teacher graded essays using a clear {rubric}.
e.zh: 老师按照明确的评分标准批改作文。

e.en: These expenses fall under the {rubric} of marketing.
e.zh: 这些支出归在市场推广这一类别下。

rubrum.t: n. 红花百合（一种百合品种）

e.en: The garden featured a stunning Lilium {rubrum} in full bloom.
e.zh: 花园里那株盛开的红百合美得惊人。

e.en: Botanists labeled the specimen with the species name {rubrum}.
e.zh: 植物学家给标本标注了rubrum这个种名。

rubs.t: v. rub 的第三人称单数；摩擦

e.en: He {rubs} his eyes whenever he gets sleepy.
e.zh: 他一困就揉眼睛。

e.en: That comment really {rubs} me the wrong way.
e.zh: 那句话真的让我很不舒服。

ruby.t:
n. 红宝石
adj. 宝石红的

e.en: She wore a delicate {ruby} pendant to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一条精致的红宝石吊坠去参加晚会。

e.en: Many startups still build their backend in {Ruby}.
e.zh: 许多初创公司仍用Ruby语言开发后端。

e.en: The bridesmaids wore elegant {ruched} satin dresses.
e.zh: 伴娘们穿着优雅的褶皱缎面礼服。

e.en: She picked a {ruched} top to flatter her waistline.
e.zh: 她挑了一件抽褶上衣来修饰腰线。

ruck.t:
n. 一堆；(橄榄球) 争球
v. 起皱

e.en: Hikers shouldered their heavy {ruck} and started up the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者们背起沉重的行囊,踏上山径。

e.en: Her career has lifted her well above the {ruck}.
e.zh: 她的事业已让她远远超出芸芸众生。

e.en: He stuffed his books into a battered {rucksack}.
e.zh: 他把书塞进一个破旧的背包里。

e.en: She carried a heavy {rucksack} on the hiking trail.
e.zh: 她背着沉重的双肩包走在徒步路上。

e.en: The kids caused a {ruckus} in the living room.
e.zh: 孩子们在客厅里闹得不可开交。

e.en: His tweet kicked up quite a {ruckus} online.
e.zh: 他的推文在网上引发了一场不小的骚动。

e.en: There was a real {ruction} at the team meeting.
e.zh: 团队会议上发生了一场真正的争吵。

e.en: The new policy caused a {ruction} among employees.
e.zh: 新政策在员工中引发了一阵骚动。

e.en: Yellow {rudbeckia} blooms brighten the summer garden.
e.zh: 金黄的金光菊让夏日花园更加明亮。

e.en: She planted {rudbeckia} along the fence last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天沿着篱笆种了金光菊。

rudd.t: n. 红鳍鲌；欧洲淡水鱼

e.en: He caught a small {rudd} in the village pond.
e.zh: 他在村里的池塘里钓到了一条小红眼鱼。

e.en: The {rudd} is a common freshwater fish in Europe.
e.zh: 红眼鱼是欧洲常见的一种淡水鱼。

e.en: The captain turned the {rudder} sharply to port.
e.zh: 船长猛地把舵转向左舷。

e.en: Without clear goals, a team has no {rudder}.
e.zh: 没有明确的目标,团队就如同没有舵一般。

rudderless.t: adj. 无舵的；群龙无首的

e.en: The company felt {rudderless} after the CEO resigned.
e.zh: 首席执行官辞职后,公司像失去了方向。

e.en: He drifted through college feeling completely {rudderless}.
e.zh: 他在大学里浑浑噩噩,完全没有方向。

e.en: A tiny {ruddock} hopped onto the garden bench.
e.zh: 一只小知更鸟跳上了花园的长椅。

e.en: In old English, a robin is called a {ruddock}.
e.zh: 在古英语里,知更鸟被称作 ruddock。

e.en: He returned from the farm with {ruddy} cheeks.
e.zh: 他从农场回来,脸颊红扑扑的。

e.en: The sunset painted the sky a {ruddy} orange.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成了红橙色。

e.en: It's {rude} to interrupt people while they're talking.
e.zh: 在别人说话时打断是很不礼貌的。

e.en: The waiter was unexpectedly {rude} to our table.
e.zh: 那位服务员对我们这桌出乎意料地无礼。

e.en: She was {rudely} awakened by a loud alarm.
e.zh: 她被刺耳的闹铃粗暴地惊醒了。

e.en: He {rudely} pushed past the elderly woman.
e.zh: 他粗鲁地从那位老妇人身边挤了过去。

e.en: Her {rudeness} to the staff shocked everyone present.
e.zh: 她对员工的无礼让在场所有人都很震惊。

e.en: I won't tolerate that kind of {rudeness} here.
e.zh: 我不会容忍那种无礼行为出现在这里。

e.en: He learned the first {rudiment} of programming online.
e.zh: 他在网上学到了编程的第一个基本要点。

e.en: Every {rudiment} of grammar must be mastered carefully.
e.zh: 语法的每一项基础知识都必须认真掌握。

rudimentary.t: adj. 基本的；初步的；未充分发育的

e.en: My Spanish is still pretty {rudimentary}.
e.zh: 我的西班牙语还很初级。

e.en: The app has only {rudimentary} support for offline mode.
e.zh: 这款应用对离线模式只有最基本的支持。

e.en: She taught the children the {rudiments} of music.
e.zh: 她教孩子们音乐的基础知识。

e.en: He picked up the {rudiments} of cooking from YouTube.
e.zh: 他从 YouTube 上学到了烹饪的基本入门。

rue.t:
v. 后悔；懊悔
n. 芸香

e.en: He gave a {rueful} smile after losing the match.
e.zh: 输掉比赛后,他露出了一丝懊悔的微笑。

e.en: Her tone was {rueful} as she recalled the mistake.
e.zh: 她回忆起那个错误时,语气中满是懊悔。

e.en: He shook his head {ruefully} at his missed shot.
e.zh: 他懊悔地摇了摇头,为自己投失的那球感到惋惜。

e.en: She laughed {ruefully} about her cooking disaster.
e.zh: 她带着几分懊恼笑着谈起那次烹饪灾难。

e.en: The Elizabethan portrait shows a stiff white {ruff}.
e.zh: 那幅伊丽莎白时代的肖像画展示了一圈僵硬的白色皱领。

e.en: The dog's thick {ruff} kept its neck warm.
e.zh: 那只狗厚厚的颈毛让它的脖子保持温暖。

e.en: A {ruffed} grouse darted across the forest path.
e.zh: 一只披肩松鸡飞快地穿过林间小路。

e.en: The lemur is easily recognized by its {ruffed} collar.
e.zh: 那只狐猴很容易通过它毛茸茸的颈圈辨认出来。

e.en: A masked {ruffian} grabbed her bag and ran.
e.zh: 一个蒙面歹徒抢了她的包就跑。

e.en: The novel's villain is a charming but cruel {ruffian}.
e.zh: 小说的反派是个有魅力却残忍的恶棍。

ruffle.t:
v. 弄皱；使烦恼
n. 褶边

e.en: A breeze began to {ruffle} the surface of the lake.
e.zh: 一阵微风开始吹皱湖面。

e.en: His sarcastic comments tend to {ruffle} his colleagues.
e.zh: 他讽刺的言论常常惹恼同事们。

e.en: The bird {ruffled} its feathers to stay warm.
e.zh: 那只鸟把羽毛蓬起来保暖。

e.en: She wore a white blouse with a {ruffled} collar.
e.zh: 她穿着一件带荷叶边领的白衬衫。

e.en: The toddler twirled in her {ruffly} pink dress.
e.zh: 小女孩穿着她那条荷叶边粉裙转着圈。

e.en: She bought a {ruffly} blouse for the summer party.
e.zh: 她为夏日派对买了一件荷叶边衬衫。

e.en: A {rufous} hummingbird hovered near the feeder.
e.zh: 一只棕煌蜂鸟在喂食器旁悬停着。

e.en: The bird's {rufous} tail flashed in the sunlight.
e.zh: 那只鸟红褐色的尾巴在阳光下闪着光。

e.en: The store sells various {rugbies} for school teams.
e.zh: 这家店销售多款适合校队的橄榄球衫。

e.en: He owns several vintage {rugbies} from the nineties.
e.zh: 他收藏了好几件九十年代的复古橄榄球衫。

e.en: He played {rugby} all through high school.
e.zh: 他整个高中都在打橄榄球。

e.en: The {rugby} match ended in a thrilling draw.
e.zh: 那场橄榄球比赛以激动人心的平局收场。

rugged.t: adj. 崎岖的；粗犷的；坚固耐用的

e.en: The phone has a {rugged} case for outdoor use.
e.zh: 这款手机配有适合户外使用的坚固外壳。

e.en: They hiked through the {rugged} mountains of Patagonia.
e.zh: 他们徒步穿越了巴塔哥尼亚崎岖的山脉。

e.en: The actor is often described as {ruggedly} handsome.
e.zh: 那位演员常被形容为有种粗犷的英俊。

e.en: The laptop is {ruggedly} built for field engineers.
e.zh: 这款笔记本电脑为现场工程师做了坚固耐用的设计。

e.en: The jeep is famous for its off-road {ruggedness}.
e.zh: 这款吉普车以其越野耐用性而闻名。

e.en: Tourists admire the {ruggedness} of the Scottish highlands.
e.zh: 游客们赞叹苏格兰高地的粗犷壮美。

e.en: He played a bit of {rugger} at university.
e.zh: 他在大学里打过一阵子橄榄球。

e.en: The British call rugby "{rugger}" informally.
e.zh: 英国人非正式地把橄榄球叫作 rugger。

e.en: The tree's {rugose} bark felt rough under my hand.
e.zh: 那棵树皱褶的树皮摸上去很粗糙。

e.en: Botanists describe the leaf as {rugose} and dark green.
e.zh: 植物学家把这片叶子描述为皱缩的深绿色。

e.en: She bought two Persian {rugs} for the living room.
e.zh: 她为客厅买了两块波斯地毯。

e.en: The {rugs} need to be vacuumed every weekend.
e.zh: 这些地毯每周末都得用吸尘器清洁。

e.en: The {Ruhr} valley was Germany's industrial heartland.
e.zh: 鲁尔河谷曾是德国的工业心脏地带。

e.en: Steel mills along the {Ruhr} have largely closed down.
e.zh: 鲁尔河沿岸的钢铁厂大多已经关闭。

ruin.t:
v. 毁掉；破坏
n. 废墟；毁灭

e.en: One bad review can {ruin} a small restaurant.
e.zh: 一条差评就足以毁掉一家小餐馆。

e.en: They explored the crumbling {ruin} of an old castle.
e.zh: 他们探访了一座古堡的残垣断壁。

e.en: Gambling led to the {ruination} of his family.
e.zh: 赌博导致了他家庭的彻底毁灭。

e.en: The scandal spelled the {ruination} of her career.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻意味着她事业的彻底崩塌。

e.en: The painter sketched a romantic French {ruine}.
e.zh: 画家速写了一处浪漫的法式废墟。

e.en: They photographed an overgrown {ruine} in the countryside.
e.zh: 他们在乡间拍下了一处杂草丛生的废墟。

e.en: The heavy rain {ruined} our picnic plans.
e.zh: 那场大雨毁了我们的野餐计划。

e.en: Tourists wandered around the {ruined} ancient temple.
e.zh: 游客们在那座残破的古庙周围漫步。

e.en: You're {ruining} the surprise by telling everyone.
e.zh: 你跟大家说出去,这惊喜都被你毁了。

e.en: Constant notifications are {ruining} my focus today.
e.zh: 不停的通知今天严重影响了我的专注力。

ruinous.t: adj. 毁灭性的；破坏性的

e.en: The lawsuit had {ruinous} consequences for the company.
e.zh: 这起诉讼给公司带来了毁灭性的后果。

e.en: Borrowing at such high rates would be {ruinous}.
e.zh: 以这么高的利率借款无异于自毁前程。

e.en: Housing in that city is {ruinously} expensive for young families.
e.zh: 那个城市的房价对年轻家庭来说贵得离谱。

e.en: The startup expanded {ruinously} fast and ran out of cash.
e.zh: 这家初创公司扩张得太快,最终资金链断裂。

e.en: Tourists wandered through the ancient {ruins} at sunset.
e.zh: 游客们在夕阳下漫步于古代遗迹中。

e.en: The scandal {ruins} her chances of winning the election.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻毁了她赢得选举的机会。

rule.t:
n. 规则；规定
v. 统治；裁定

e.en: The new {rule} bans phones during meetings.
e.zh: 新规定禁止在会议期间使用手机。

e.en: Democrats are expected to {rule} the chamber for years.
e.zh: 预计民主党将主导该议会多年。

e.en: He threw out the {rulebook} and tried something completely new.
e.zh: 他抛开了所有条条框框,尝试了全新的方式。

e.en: Referees must follow the official {rulebook} during every match.
e.zh: 裁判在每场比赛中都必须遵守官方规则手册。

ruled.t:
adj. 有格线的
v. rule 的过去式

e.en: The judge {ruled} in favor of the plaintiff.
e.zh: 法官判决原告胜诉。

e.en: Queen Victoria {ruled} Britain for over sixty years.
e.zh: 维多利亚女王统治英国长达六十多年。

e.en: Use a {ruler} to draw a straight line on the page.
e.zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。

e.en: He became the most powerful {ruler} in the region.
e.zh: 他成为该地区最有权势的统治者。

e.en: Ancient {rulers} often built monuments to celebrate their reigns.
e.zh: 古代统治者常建造纪念碑来彰显其统治。

e.en: Students lined up their {rulers} neatly on each desk.
e.zh: 学生们把尺子整齐地摆在每张课桌上。

e.en: His {rulership} was marked by reform and economic growth.
e.zh: 他的统治时期以改革与经济增长为标志。

e.en: The empire collapsed within a decade of her {rulership}.
e.zh: 帝国在她统治结束十年内便瓦解了。

rules.t:
n. 规则
v. 统治（第三人称单数）

e.en: Every player must follow the {rules} of the game.
e.zh: 每位玩家都必须遵守游戏规则。

e.en: That café absolutely {rules} on weekend mornings.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆周末早晨简直棒极了。

ruling.t:
n. 裁决；判决
adj. 统治的

e.en: The court's {ruling} surprised legal analysts everywhere.
e.zh: 法院的裁决让各地的法律分析人士都感到意外。

e.en: The {ruling} party lost seats in the recent election.
e.zh: 执政党在最近的选举中失去了席位。

e.en: Recent Supreme Court {rulings} have reshaped privacy law.
e.zh: 最近的最高法院裁决重塑了隐私法。

e.en: The referee's {rulings} were broadcast to the stadium.
e.zh: 裁判的判罚通过广播传遍了整个体育场。

e.en: {Rumania} is now more commonly spelled Romania.
e.zh: Rumania现在更常拼写为Romania(罗马尼亚)。

e.en: My grandmother emigrated from {Rumania} in 1955.
e.zh: 我祖母于1955年从罗马尼亚移民出来。

rumanian.t:
adj. 罗马尼亚的
n. 罗马尼亚人

e.en: She speaks fluent {Rumanian} and French.
e.zh: 她能说流利的罗马尼亚语和法语。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Rumanian} dishes.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的罗马尼亚菜肴。

e.en: They danced the {rumba} at their wedding reception.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼招待会上跳了伦巴舞。

e.en: The band played a slow Cuban {rumba}.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一首慢节奏的古巴伦巴。

rumble.t:
v. 发出隆隆声
n. 低沉轰鸣

e.en: I heard a distant {rumble} of thunder.
e.zh: 我听到远处传来一阵雷声。

e.en: My stomach started to {rumble} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会的时候我的肚子开始咕咕叫。

e.en: The subway train {rumbled} beneath the apartment.
e.zh: 地铁列车在公寓下方隆隆驶过。

e.en: Thunder {rumbled} across the valley all night.
e.zh: 雷声整夜在山谷中隆隆作响。

e.en: The old engine {rumbles} loudly when it starts.
e.zh: 这台旧引擎启动时会发出很大的轰鸣声。

e.en: You can feel the {rumbles} of nearby construction.
e.zh: 你能感觉到附近施工传来的隆隆震动。

rumbling.t:
n. 低沉轰鸣声
adj. 轰隆作响的

e.en: A low {rumbling} sound came from the basement.
e.zh: 地下室传来低沉的隆隆声。

e.en: Trucks kept {rumbling} past our house all night.
e.zh: 卡车整夜不停地隆隆驶过我们家。

rumbustious.t: adj. 喧闹的；吵吵嚷嚷的

e.en: The puppy was a {rumbustious} bundle of energy.
e.zh: 这只小狗是个活泼吵闹的小家伙。

e.en: They had a {rumbustious} debate over dinner.
e.zh: 他们在晚餐时展开了一场喧闹激烈的辩论。

e.en: Bacteria in the cow's {rumen} break down tough plant fibers.
e.zh: 牛瘤胃中的细菌能分解坚韧的植物纤维。

e.en: The vet examined the sheep's {rumen} for signs of bloat.
e.zh: 兽医检查了羊的瘤胃以查看胀气迹象。

ruminant.t:
n. 反刍动物
adj. 反刍的

e.en: A cow is a typical {ruminant} that chews its cud.
e.zh: 牛是典型的会反刍的反刍动物。

e.en: Sheep and goats are common {ruminant} animals on farms.
e.zh: 绵羊和山羊是农场上常见的反刍动物。

e.en: I tend to {ruminate} on past mistakes at night.
e.zh: 我晚上总是会反复琢磨过去的错误。

e.en: Cattle {ruminate} for hours after grazing in pastures.
e.zh: 牛在牧场吃草后会反刍好几个小时。

e.en: She {ruminated} on the offer for several days.
e.zh: 她对那个提议反复思考了好几天。

e.en: He {ruminated} over his career choices in his journal.
e.zh: 他在日记里反复琢磨自己的职业选择。

ruminates.t: v. ruminate 的第三人称单数

e.en: The novel {ruminates} on themes of loss and memory.
e.zh: 这部小说反复探讨了失去与记忆的主题。

e.en: He often {ruminates} about decisions long after making them.
e.zh: 他常常在做完决定后还反复琢磨良久。

ruminating.t:
v. 沉思，反复思考
v. (牛) 反刍

e.en: Stop {ruminating} on the rejection and move forward.
e.zh: 别再纠结于这次被拒绝了,向前看吧。

e.en: She spent the weekend {ruminating} about her future.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在反复思考自己的未来。

e.en: Excessive {rumination} can worsen anxiety and depression.
e.zh: 过度反刍思考会加重焦虑和抑郁。

e.en: His essay is a quiet {rumination} on aging.
e.zh: 他的散文是对衰老的一段静静沉思。

e.en: Her blog features daily {ruminations} on parenting.
e.zh: 她的博客每天分享关于育儿的随想。

e.en: The book collects his {ruminations} on modern life.
e.zh: 这本书收录了他对现代生活的种种思索。

e.en: The film has a slow, {ruminative} pace.
e.zh: 这部电影节奏缓慢,富有沉思意味。

e.en: He gave a {ruminative} answer to the interviewer's question.
e.zh: 他对采访者的问题给出了一个深思熟虑的回答。

rummage.t:
v. 翻找，翻腾
n. 杂物

e.en: I had to {rummage} through my bag to find the keys.
e.zh: 我得在包里翻找才找到了钥匙。

e.en: She found the photo at a neighborhood {rummage} sale.
e.zh: 她在社区的旧货义卖上找到了那张照片。

e.en: We played {rummy} for hours during the power outage.
e.zh: 停电期间我们玩了几个小时的拉米牌。

e.en: My grandmother taught me how to play gin {rummy}.
e.zh: 我奶奶教过我怎么玩金拉米牌。

rumor.t:
n. 谣言，传闻
v. 谣传

e.en: There's a {rumor} that the company will be acquired.
e.zh: 有传言说这家公司将被收购。

e.en: Don't spread that {rumor} until you verify the facts.
e.zh: 在核实事实之前别去传播那个谣言。

rumored.t:
adj. 据传的
v. 传说（rumor 过去式）

e.en: Apple is {rumored} to be launching a new headset.
e.zh: 据传苹果即将推出一款新头显设备。

e.en: She is {rumored} to have signed with a major label.
e.zh: 据传她已经与一家大唱片公司签约了。

e.en: {Rumors} of a merger sent the stock price soaring.
e.zh: 合并的传闻让股价飙升。

e.en: Don't believe everything you read in online {rumors}.
e.zh: 别相信你在网上看到的所有传言。

e.en: There's a {rumour} going around that he's resigning.
e.zh: 有传言说他要辞职了。

e.en: The {rumour} turned out to be completely false.
e.zh: 那个传闻最后证明是完全不实的。

e.en: The actor is {rumoured} to be dating his co-star.
e.zh: 据传这位演员正在和他的搭档约会。

e.en: A new iPhone is {rumoured} to launch this autumn.
e.zh: 据传新款iPhone将于今秋发布。

e.en: Wild {rumours} spread across social media within hours.
e.zh: 各种离谱的传闻在几小时内传遍了社交媒体。

e.en: The company denied {rumours} of impending layoffs.
e.zh: 该公司否认了即将裁员的传闻。

e.en: The chef recommended the {rump} steak with peppercorn sauce.
e.zh: 厨师推荐配胡椒酱的牛臀肉牛排。

e.en: Only a {rump} of the original committee remained.
e.zh: 原委员会只剩下一小撮残余成员。

e.en: Try not to {rumple} the freshly ironed shirt.
e.zh: 尽量别把刚熨好的衬衫弄皱了。

e.en: She loves to {rumple} her son's hair affectionately.
e.zh: 她喜欢慈爱地揉乱儿子的头发。

e.en: He showed up to the meeting in a {rumpled} suit.
e.zh: 他穿着一套皱巴巴的西装出现在会议上。

e.en: The bed was {rumpled} after the cat's nap.
e.zh: 猫午睡之后床铺被弄得乱糟糟的。

rumpole.t: n. 朗波尔（人名/角色名）

e.en: {Rumpole} of the Bailey is a beloved British TV series.
e.zh: 《老贝利的鲁波尔》是一部深受喜爱的英国电视剧。

e.en: The barrister reminded everyone of the fictional {Rumpole}.
e.zh: 这位大律师让大家想起了虚构的鲁波尔。

e.en: The kids made a huge {rumpus} in the basement.
e.zh: 孩子们在地下室闹腾得不亦乐乎。

e.en: There was a real {rumpus} when the news broke.
e.zh: 消息一传开,真是引起了一阵骚动。

run.t:
v. 跑；运行（程序）
n. 奔跑；一次运行

e.en: She bought a small {runabout} for city driving.
e.zh: 她买了一辆小型代步车在城里开。

e.en: The vintage {runabout} boat looked great on the lake.
e.zh: 那艘复古小快艇在湖面上看起来很棒。

e.en: The customer service department gave me the {runaround}.
e.zh: 客服部门一直在跟我打太极推诿。

e.en: Stop giving me the {runaround} and answer my question.
e.zh: 别再跟我兜圈子了,回答我的问题。

runaway.t:
adj. 逃跑的；失控的
n. 逃跑者

e.en: The film became a {runaway} success at the box office.
e.zh: 这部电影在票房上取得了势不可挡的成功。

e.en: Police are searching for the {runaway} teenager.
e.zh: 警方正在搜寻那名离家出走的青少年。

e.en: The shelter helps {runaways} reconnect with their families.
e.zh: 这家收容所帮助离家出走者与家人重新取得联系。

e.en: Several {runaways} were found safe in the city.
e.zh: 几名离家出走者在城里被安全找到。

e.en: {Runcorn} is a town in Cheshire, northwest England.
e.zh: 朗科恩是英格兰西北部柴郡的一座城镇。

e.en: The bridge connects {Runcorn} to Widnes across the Mersey.
e.zh: 这座桥跨越默西河,连接朗科恩和威德尼斯。

rundown.t:
n. 简要介绍
adj. 破败的；疲惫的

e.en: Give me a quick {rundown} of today's meeting.
e.zh: 给我简要说明一下今天会议的内容。

e.en: The coach offered a {rundown} of the team's strategy.
e.zh: 教练简要介绍了球队的战术。

e.en: The stone was carved with an ancient {rune}.
e.zh: 那块石头上刻着一个古老的符文。

e.en: In the game, each {rune} grants a special power.
e.zh: 在游戏中,每个符文都能赋予特殊能力。

rung.t:
n. 梯子的横档
v. ring 的过去分词

e.en: He climbed to the top {rung} of the ladder.
e.zh: 他爬到了梯子的最高一级。

e.en: She reached a higher {rung} on the career ladder.
e.zh: 她在事业阶梯上更上了一层。

runic.t: adj. 符文的，古北欧文字的

e.en: The museum displays a {runic} inscription from Norway.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一段来自挪威的如尼文铭文。

e.en: He studies {runic} alphabets used by the Vikings.
e.zh: 他研究维京人使用的如尼字母。

e.en: A small {runnel} of water trickled down the hillside.
e.zh: 一条小水沟顺着山坡缓缓流下。

e.en: Rainwater carved a tiny {runnel} across the path.
e.zh: 雨水在小路上冲出一条细沟。

runner.t:
n. 跑步者；运行者
n. 滑轨

e.en: The {runner} crossed the finish line in record time.
e.zh: 那名跑者以破纪录的成绩冲过了终点线。

e.en: She placed a long {runner} along the dining table.
e.zh: 她在餐桌上铺了一条长长的桌旗。

e.en: Hundreds of {runners} gathered at the starting line.
e.zh: 数百名跑者聚集在起跑线上。

e.en: The kitchen drawers slide on smooth {runners}.
e.zh: 厨房抽屉在光滑的滑轨上滑动。

running.t:
n. 跑步；运行
adj. 连续的

e.en: She goes {running} every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天早上上班前都去跑步。

e.en: The server has been {running} smoothly for weeks.
e.zh: 这台服务器已经稳定运行了好几周。

e.en: He is in the {runnings} for the manager position.
e.zh: 他是经理职位的有力竞争者之一。

e.en: Several startups are in the {runnings} for the contract.
e.zh: 几家初创公司都在角逐这份合同。

e.en: My toddler has a {runny} nose again.
e.zh: 我家小孩又流鼻涕了。

e.en: I like my fried eggs with {runny} yolks.
e.zh: 我喜欢蛋黄半流的煎蛋。

runnymede.t: n. 兰尼米德（地名，签大宪章处）

e.en: The Magna Carta was sealed at {Runnymede} in 1215.
e.zh: 《大宪章》于1215年在兰尼米德签署。

e.en: Tourists visit {Runnymede} to see the historic meadow.
e.zh: 游客们前往兰尼米德参观那片历史悠久的草地。

e.en: The two top candidates will face each other in a {runoff} election.
e.zh: 两位领先候选人将在决选中对决。

e.en: Heavy rain caused dangerous {runoff} from the hillside.
e.zh: 暴雨导致山坡上出现危险的径流。

runs.t:
v. 跑，运行
n. 奔跑

e.en: She {runs} five kilometers every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天早上上班前都跑五公里。

e.en: This bus {runs} every fifteen minutes on weekdays.
e.zh: 这趟公交车工作日每十五分钟一班。

runt.t: n. 一窝中最瘦小的；矮子

e.en: The {runt} of the litter needed extra feeding to survive.
e.zh: 这窝里最弱小的那只需要额外喂食才能存活。

e.en: As a kid, he was the {runt} on every basketball team.
e.zh: 小时候他在每支篮球队里都是最矮小的那个。

e.en: The farmer kept the {runty} piglet in a separate pen.
e.zh: 农夫把那只瘦小的小猪关在单独的圈里。

e.en: He was a {runty} kid who later grew into a tall man.
e.zh: 他小时候瘦小,后来长成了个高个子。

e.en: The plane taxied down the {runway} and took off smoothly.
e.zh: 飞机沿跑道滑行,平稳地起飞了。

e.en: The model strutted confidently down the {runway}.
e.zh: 模特自信地走过T台。

e.en: The airport added two new {runways} to handle more flights.
e.zh: 机场新增了两条跑道以处理更多航班。

e.en: Designers debuted spring collections on Paris {runways} last week.
e.zh: 设计师们上周在巴黎T台上发布了春季新品。

rupee.t: n. 卢比（印度等国货币）

e.en: The Indian {rupee} weakened slightly against the dollar today.
e.zh: 印度卢比今天对美元小幅走弱。

e.en: A bottle of water costs about twenty {rupee} here.
e.zh: 这里一瓶水大约要二十卢比。

rupture.t:
n. 破裂，决裂
v. 使破裂

e.en: The trade dispute caused a serious {rupture} between the two nations.
e.zh: 贸易争端导致两国关系严重破裂。

e.en: Doctors worried the appendix might {rupture} at any moment.
e.zh: 医生担心阑尾随时可能破裂。

e.en: The pipeline {ruptured} after years of corrosion.
e.zh: 管道在多年腐蚀后破裂了。

e.en: He {ruptured} a tendon during yesterday's football match.
e.zh: 他在昨天的足球比赛中拉断了一根肌腱。

e.en: Many young people are leaving {rural} villages for big cities.
e.zh: 许多年轻人正离开乡村去往大城市。

e.en: Internet access is still limited in some {rural} areas.
e.zh: 一些农村地区的网络接入仍然有限。

e.en: The phone call turned out to be a clever {ruse} to steal her password.
e.zh: 那通电话原来是个骗取她密码的巧妙伎俩。

e.en: His sudden illness was just a {ruse} to skip work.
e.zh: 他突然生病只是个翘班的借口。

rush.t:
v. 匆忙，赶
n. 高峰；热潮

e.en: Don't {rush} the decision; take your time to think it over.
e.zh: 别急着做决定,慢慢考虑一下。

e.en: The morning {rush} on the subway is unbearable.
e.zh: 地铁早高峰的拥挤简直让人受不了。

e.en: She {rushed} to the airport to catch the last flight.
e.zh: 她赶往机场去搭最后一班飞机。

e.en: The report felt {rushed} and contained several errors.
e.zh: 这份报告显得仓促,有好几处错误。

e.en: The European team won the {Ryder} Cup in dramatic fashion.
e.zh: 欧洲队以戏剧性的方式赢得了莱德杯。

e.en: My neighbor named her golden retriever {Ryder}.
e.zh: 我邻居给她的金毛犬取名叫莱德。

e.en: Farmers planted {ryegrass} to prevent soil erosion over winter.
e.zh: 农民种植黑麦草以防止冬季水土流失。

e.en: The lawn is mostly {ryegrass} mixed with clover.
e.zh: 这片草坪主要由黑麦草和三叶草混合而成。

e.en: The team's star {rusher} gained over a hundred yards last night.
e.zh: 球队的明星冲球手昨晚推进了超过一百码。

e.en: He was the leading {rusher} in the league this season.
e.zh: 他是本赛季联盟的冲球王。

rushes.t:
v. 冲；急赶（rush 的第三人称单数）
n. 灯心草（复数）

e.en: He always {rushes} through breakfast to catch the early train.
e.zh: 他总是匆匆吃完早餐去赶早班火车。

e.en: Tall green {rushes} grew along the edge of the pond.
e.zh: 高高的绿灯心草沿着池塘边生长。

rushing.t:
v. 急赶；冲
adj. 匆忙的

e.en: Stop {rushing} and pay attention to the details.
e.zh: 别再着急了,注意一下细节。

e.en: The {rushing} river drowned out our conversation.
e.zh: 奔腾的河水淹没了我们的谈话声。

e.en: The baby happily chewed on a sweet {rusk} after lunch.
e.zh: 宝宝午饭后开心地啃着一块甜面包干。

e.en: She dipped a {rusk} into her morning tea.
e.zh: 她把一块面包干蘸进了早茶里。

russet.t:
n. 赤褐色
adj. 红棕色的

e.en: The autumn leaves turned a beautiful {russet} color.
e.zh: 秋天的树叶变成了美丽的红褐色。

e.en: {Russet} potatoes are the best choice for baking.
e.zh: 褐皮土豆是烘烤的最佳选择。

e.en: {Russia} is the largest country in the world by area.
e.zh: 按面积计算,俄罗斯是世界上最大的国家。

e.en: She spent a year studying literature in {Russia}.
e.zh: 她在俄罗斯学习了一年文学。

russian.t:
adj. 俄罗斯的
n. 俄罗斯人；俄语

e.en: He has been learning {Russian} for almost three years.
e.zh: 他学习俄语已经将近三年了。

e.en: The {Russian} novelist's work has been translated into many languages.
e.zh: 这位俄罗斯小说家的作品已被翻译成多种语言。

rust.t:
n. 铁锈
v. 生锈

e.en: The old bicycle was covered in orange {rust}.
e.zh: 那辆旧自行车上布满了橙色的铁锈。

e.en: Many developers are switching to {Rust} for systems programming.
e.zh: 许多开发者正在转向使用 Rust 进行系统编程。

rusted.t:
v. 生锈（rust 的过去式）
adj. 生锈的

e.en: The garden gate had {rusted} shut over the winter.
e.zh: 花园的大门在冬天里锈得打不开了。

e.en: He found a {rusted} key buried in the soil.
e.zh: 他在土里挖出一把生锈的钥匙。

rustic.t:
adj. 乡村的；质朴的
n. 乡下人

e.en: They booked a {rustic} cabin in the mountains for the weekend.
e.zh: 他们订了一间山间的乡村小木屋过周末。

e.en: The cafe has a charming {rustic} interior with wooden beams.
e.zh: 咖啡馆内部以木梁装饰,具有迷人的乡村风格。

e.en: Visitors are charmed by the {rusticity} of the small fishing village.
e.zh: 游客们被这个小渔村的乡土气息所吸引。

e.en: The cabin's {rusticity} made it feel wonderfully cozy.
e.zh: 小木屋的质朴让它显得格外温馨。

rusting.t: v. 生锈（rust 的现在分词）

e.en: A {rusting} tractor sat abandoned in the field.
e.zh: 一台生锈的拖拉机被遗弃在田里。

e.en: Salt air speeds up the {rusting} of metal fixtures.
e.zh: 含盐空气会加速金属配件的生锈。

rustle.t:
n. 沙沙声
v. 发出沙沙声

e.en: I heard leaves {rustle} in the breeze outside the window.
e.zh: 我听见窗外的树叶在微风中沙沙作响。

e.en: Can you {rustle} up some dinner before the guests arrive?
e.zh: 你能在客人到之前赶紧弄点晚饭吗?

rustled.t: v. 发出沙沙声（rustle 的过去式）

e.en: A small animal {rustled} through the dry leaves nearby.
e.zh: 一只小动物在附近的枯叶间窸窣作响。

e.en: She quickly {rustled} up a sandwich for the hungry child.
e.zh: 她迅速给饥饿的孩子做了个三明治。

rustler.t: n. 盗牲口者；精力充沛的人

e.en: The sheriff finally caught the cattle {rustler} after months of searching.
e.zh: 经过几个月的搜寻,警长终于抓住了那个偷牛贼。

e.en: In old Western films, the {rustler} is always the villain.
e.zh: 在老西部片里,偷牲口的贼总是反派。

rustles.t: v. 发出沙沙声（rustle 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The wind {rustles} the curtains every time the window opens.
e.zh: 每次开窗,风都会把窗帘吹得沙沙作响。

e.en: Mom always {rustles} up something delicious from leftovers.
e.zh: 妈妈总能用剩菜快速做出美味的东西。

rustling.t:
v. 沙沙作响
n. 沙沙声

e.en: The {rustling} of leaves made the forest feel alive.
e.zh: 树叶的沙沙声让森林显得充满生机。

e.en: Cattle {rustling} was a serious crime in the old West.
e.zh: 在旧西部,偷牛是一项重罪。

e.en: The old {Ruston} diesel engine still powers the village pump.
e.zh: 那台老旧的鲁斯顿柴油机仍在为村里的水泵供电。

e.en: He grew up in {Ruston}, a small town in northern Louisiana.
e.zh: 他在路易斯安那州北部的小镇拉斯顿长大。

rustproof.t:
adj. 防锈的
v. 做防锈处理

e.en: Buy a {rustproof} bike chain if you ride in the rain.
e.zh: 如果你常在雨中骑车,买条防锈的自行车链条。

e.en: The screws are coated to make them completely {rustproof}.
e.zh: 这些螺丝表面有涂层,完全防锈。

e.en: My French is a little {rusty} after years without practice.
e.zh: 我的法语好多年没练,有点生疏了。

e.en: He cut his hand on a {rusty} nail in the shed.
e.zh: 他在棚子里被一根生锈的钉子划伤了手。

rut.t:
n. 车辙；老套
v. 形成凹痕

rutabaga.t: n. 芜菁甘蓝（一种根菜）

e.en: She added chunks of {rutabaga} to the winter stew.
e.zh: 她往冬季炖菜里加了几块芜菁甘蓝。

e.en: {Rutabaga} tastes like a cross between a turnip and a cabbage.
e.zh: 芜菁甘蓝的味道像萝卜和卷心菜的混合。

ruth.t: n. 露丝（人名）；怜悯（古义）

e.en: He showed no {ruth} toward his defeated rivals.
e.zh: 他对被击败的对手毫无怜悯之心。

e.en: The judge sentenced the criminal without {ruth}.
e.zh: 法官毫无同情地对罪犯进行了宣判。

rutherford.t: n. 卢瑟福（人名，如物理学家）

e.en: Ernest {Rutherford} discovered the structure of the atom.
e.zh: 欧内斯特·卢瑟福发现了原子的结构。

e.en: The lab was named after physicist {Rutherford}.
e.zh: 该实验室以物理学家卢瑟福的名字命名。

e.en: The CEO was {ruthless} in cutting underperforming teams.
e.zh: 这位CEO在裁掉表现不佳的团队时毫不留情。

e.en: She is {ruthless} about deleting old emails.
e.zh: 她删除旧邮件时绝不手软。

e.en: The startup {ruthlessly} prioritized features that drove revenue.
e.zh: 这家创业公司无情地优先考虑能带来收入的功能。

e.en: He {ruthlessly} edited his manuscript down to 200 pages.
e.zh: 他狠心地把手稿删减到了200页。

e.en: Her {ruthlessness} in negotiations earned her many enemies.
e.zh: 她在谈判中的冷酷无情为她树敌众多。

e.en: The film portrays the dictator's {ruthlessness} in stark detail.
e.zh: 这部电影鲜明地刻画了这位独裁者的冷酷无情。

ruthlessnesses.t: n. 冷酷无情（ruthlessness 的复数）

e.en: Historians compared the {ruthlessnesses} of various wartime regimes.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了各个战时政权的残酷无情。

e.en: The novel explores different {ruthlessnesses} across generations.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了几代人之间不同形式的冷酷。

e.en: {Rutland} is the smallest historic county in England.
e.zh: 拉特兰是英格兰最小的历史悠久郡。

e.en: We drove through {Rutland} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中开车经过了拉特兰。

rutted.t:
adj. 有车辙的
v. 留下凹痕（过去式）

e.en: The truck bounced along the {rutted} dirt road.
e.zh: 卡车在坑洼的土路上颠簸前行。

e.en: Heavy rain left the field deeply {rutted}.
e.zh: 大雨过后田地里满是深深的车辙。

rutter.t: n. 拉特（人名）；航海指南（古义）

e.en: The old sailor consulted his {rutter} before setting sail.
e.zh: 老水手在启航前查阅了他的航海指南。

e.en: John {Rutter} composed many beloved Christmas carols.
e.zh: 约翰·拉特创作了许多深受喜爱的圣诞颂歌。

rutting.t: v. (雄兽) 发情；形成车辙

e.en: Male deer become aggressive during the {rutting} season.
e.zh: 雄鹿在发情季节会变得具有攻击性。

e.en: Tourists watch the elk {rutting} in autumn.
e.zh: 游客在秋天观看麋鹿求偶。

e.en: {Rwanda} has made remarkable progress since the 1994 genocide.
e.zh: 自1994年大屠杀以来,卢旺达取得了显著进步。

e.en: We saw mountain gorillas during our trip to {Rwanda}.
e.zh: 我们在卢旺达旅行时见到了山地大猩猩。

e.en: Wordsworth lived at {Rydal} Mount for many years.
e.zh: 华兹华斯在莱德尔山住了多年。

e.en: We hiked around {Rydal} Water in the Lake District.
e.zh: 我们在湖区徒步绕行了莱德尔湖。

e.en: The ferry to {Ryde} takes about ten minutes.
e.zh: 开往莱德的渡轮大约需要十分钟。

e.en: {Ryde} is the largest town on the Isle of Wight.
e.zh: 莱德是怀特岛上最大的城镇。

racier.t: a. 保持原味的, 活泼的, 生动的, 为竞赛设计的

raciest.t: a. 保持原味的, 活泼的, 生动的, 为竞赛设计的

rainiest.t: a. 下雨的, 多雨的

ramified.t: v. (使)分枝, (使)分叉, (使)成枝岔状

randiest.t: a. 喧闹的, 大声的, 好色的\nn. 粗鲁悍妇, 莽汉

rarest.t: a. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的\nadv. 非常

ratified.t: vt. 批准, 认可\n[经] 证实, 肯定, 确认

raunchier.t: a. 不整洁的, 不修边幅的, 肮脏的, 淫秽的

n. 预备好的状态, 现款
a. 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的
adv. 预先, 迅速
vt. 使准备好

recopied.t: v. 再抄写, 再复制

rectified.t: vt. 订正, 矫正, 改正, 调正, 校正, 精馏, 整流\n[化] 精馏

redrawn.t: vt. 重画\nvi. 刷新屏幕\n[计] 刷新屏幕

reedier.t: a. 芦苇丛生的, 芦苇做的, 芦苇状的

reheard.t: vt. 复审, 再审\n[法] 复审, 再审问

remade.t: vt. 再作, 再制, 重作\nn. 再制, 改作, 重制物

remedied.t: n. 药物, 治疗法, 治疗, 补救, 赔偿\nvt. 治疗, 补救, 矫正, 改善, 修补, 修缮

remotest.t: a. 遥远的, 偏僻的, 疏远的, 微少的\n[计] 远程, 远程访问实用程序

reran.t: n. 重新开动, 再度上演\nvt. 重新开动, 再度上演\n[计] 再运行; 重新运行

retried.t: vt. 再试, 再审\n[计] 重发; 重试

revivified.t: v. (使)再生, (使)复活, (使)振奋精神

richest.t: a. 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的

riflemen.t: n. 步枪射手, 步兵

ripest.t: a. 成熟的, 熟练的, 成年的\n[医] 成熟的

riposts.t: n. (击剑中)还击, 机敏的回答\nvi. 迅速还击, 机敏回答

rockier.t: a. 岩石的, 多石的, 像岩石的, 无情的, 摇动的, 摇晃的

rodding.t: n. 竿, 笞鞭, 小枝\n[化] 棒

roomiest.t: a. 广阔的, 宽敞的, 宽大的

ropier.t: a. 绳状的, 可拉成丝的, 粘稠的, 强健的\n[医] 粘稠的, 粘的

rosier.t: a. 蔷薇色的, 玫瑰红色的

rosiest.t: a. 蔷薇色的, 玫瑰红色的

rots.t: n. 腐烂, 腐蚀, 败坏\nvi. 腐烂, 烂, 堕落, 憔悴\nvt. 使腐烂, 使腐朽, 使堕落

roughest.t:
n. 粗糙的东西, 毛坯, 未加工品, 梗概, 草图, 暴徒, 艰难
a. 粗糙的, 粗暴的, 蓬乱的, 草率的, 大致的, 简陋的, 暴风雨的, 艰难的
vt. 使粗糙, 使不平, 使蓬乱, 粗制, 草拟, 粗暴对待, 对...动粗
vi. 变粗糙
adv. 粗糙地, 粗暴地

rowdier.t: n. 好吵闹的人\na. 吵闹的

rowdiest.t: n. 好吵闹的人\na. 吵闹的

ruddier.t: a. 红的, 红润的\nv. (使)变红

ruddied.t: a. 红的, 红润的\nv. (使)变红

rudest.t: a. 粗鲁无礼的, 粗陋的, 粗暴的, 原始的, 未开化的, 大略的, 崎岖不平的, 狂暴的

ruing.t: n. 懊悔, 后悔, 芸香\nv. 后悔, 悲伤, 懊悔

rues.t: n. 懊悔, 后悔, 芸香\nv. 后悔, 悲伤, 懊悔

rued.t: n. 懊悔, 后悔, 芸香\nv. 后悔, 悲伤, 懊悔

rums.t: n. 朗姆酒\na. 古怪的, 奇特的

rummer.t: n. 朗姆酒\na. 古怪的, 奇特的

runnier.t: a. 松软的, 水分过多的, 流鼻涕的

russes.t: a. 俄国的；俄国人的；俄国语的

rustiest.t: a. 生锈的, 腐蚀的, 生疏的, 顽固的, 腐烂的\n[医] 锈色的

rustier.t: a. 生锈的, 腐蚀的, 生疏的, 顽固的, 腐烂的\n[医] 锈色的

ruts.t: n. 辙迹, 凹槽, 常规, 惯例, 发情期\nvi. 交尾, 发情\nvt. 挖槽于

e.en: The printer adjusted the {r-color} layer separately.
e.zh: 打印机单独调整了R色图层。

e.en: The image looked warmer after the {r-color} value increased.
e.zh: R通道颜色值提高后，图像显得更暖。

e.en: The map used {r-colored} marks for restricted roads.
e.zh: 地图用带R色的标记表示限行道路。

e.en: The sample appeared {r-colored} under the filter.
e.zh: 样本在滤镜下呈现R色。

e.en: The channel showed an {r-rated} film after midnight.
e.zh: 这个频道午夜后播放了一部限制级电影。

e.en: His jokes became too {r-rated} for the school event.
e.zh: 他的笑话对学校活动来说太少儿不宜了。

e.en: The model's {r-squared} improved after adding income data.
e.zh: 加入收入数据后，模型的R平方提高了。

e.en: A high {r-squared} does not prove causation.
e.zh: 较高的R平方并不能证明因果关系。

e.en: Thicker insulation gives the wall a higher {r-value}.
e.zh: 更厚的保温材料会提高墙体的R值。

e.en: Check the {r-value} before buying attic insulation.
e.zh: 购买阁楼保温材料前要查看R值。

e.en: The actor wore a stiff {rabato} in the period drama.
e.zh: 演员在古装剧里戴着硬挺的大翻领。

e.en: Her costume included a lace {rabato} around the neck.
e.zh: 她的戏服在颈部配有蕾丝大翻领。

e.en: The village {rabbin} answered questions about the law.
e.zh: 村里的拉比回答了有关律法的问题。

e.en: A learned {rabbin} led the evening discussion.
e.zh: 一位博学的拉比主持了晚间讨论。

e.en: The essay traces the growth of {rabbinism} after the temple period.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了圣殿时期后拉比犹太教传统的发展。

e.en: Critics debated the authority of {rabbinism} in daily practice.
e.zh: 批评者讨论了拉比传统在日常实践中的权威。

e.en: The scholar was known as a strict {rabbinist}.
e.zh: 这位学者以严格支持拉比传统而闻名。

e.en: A {rabbinist} reading shaped his view of the text.
e.zh: 拉比传统派的解读塑造了他对文本的看法。

e.en: The boxer was disqualified for a {rabbit-punch}.
e.zh: 那名拳手因击打对手后颈被取消资格。

e.en: A sudden {rabbit-punch} can cause serious injury.
e.zh: 突然击打后颈可能造成严重伤害。

e.en: Yellow {rabbitbrush} bloomed along the dry road.
e.zh: 黄色兔灌木在干燥的路边开花。

e.en: Ranchers cleared {rabbitbrush} from the grazing land.
e.zh: 牧场主清除了牧场上的兔灌木。

e.en: She planted {rabbiteye} blueberries behind the shed.
e.zh: 她在棚屋后面种了兔眼蓝莓。

e.en: The {rabbiteye} variety tolerates heat better than many blueberries.
e.zh: 兔眼蓝莓品种比许多蓝莓更耐热。

e.en: The diver spotted a silver {rabbitfish} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近看到一条银色兔鱼。

e.en: Some {rabbitfish} have venomous spines on their fins.
e.zh: 有些兔鱼的鱼鳍上有毒刺。

e.en: He carried a dried {rabbitfoot} for luck.
e.zh: 他随身带着一只干兔脚求好运。

e.en: The fern is called {rabbitfoot} because of its fuzzy roots.
e.zh: 这种蕨类因毛茸茸的根像兔脚而得名。

e.en: The child made a {rabbitlike} hop across the room.
e.zh: 孩子像兔子一样蹦过房间。

e.en: His {rabbitlike} caution kept him from taking risks.
e.zh: 他兔子般的谨慎让他不敢冒险。

e.en: They built a small {rabbitry} behind the barn.
e.zh: 他们在谷仓后面建了一座小养兔场。

e.en: The {rabbitry} must stay clean to prevent disease.
e.zh: 兔舍必须保持清洁以预防疾病。

e.en: The umpire inspected the {raceball} before play began.
e.zh: 比赛开始前，裁判检查了比赛用球。

e.en: A scuffed {raceball} can change speed on the track.
e.zh: 磨损的赛球在赛道上的速度可能会改变。

e.en: The {racecard} listed six races for the afternoon.
e.zh: 赛马日程表列出了下午的六场比赛。

e.en: She studied the {racecard} before placing a small bet.
e.zh: 下注一点钱之前，她仔细看了赛事卡。

e.en: The chemist separated the {racemate} into two enantiomers.
e.zh: 化学家把这种外消旋化合物分离成两种对映体。

e.en: This drug is sold as a {racemate} rather than a single isomer.
e.zh: 这种药以外消旋体出售，而不是单一异构体。

e.en: The paper described {racemation} in several related plants.
e.zh: 论文描述了几种近缘植物的总状花序形成。

e.en: Early {racemation} made the young shoot easy to identify.
e.zh: 早期的总状花序形成让幼芽很容易辨认。

e.en: Each {raceme} carried dozens of small white flowers.
e.zh: 每个总状花序上都有几十朵白色小花。

e.en: The botanist measured the length of the {raceme}.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了这个总状花序的长度。

e.en: The {racemed} stems bent under the weight of blossoms.
e.zh: 成总状花序的茎在花朵重量下弯了下来。

e.en: She noted the {racemed} arrangement in her field notebook.
e.zh: 她在野外笔记本中记下了这种总状排列。

e.en: The lab produced a {racemic} mixture by accident.
e.zh: 实验室意外制得了一种外消旋混合物。

e.en: A {racemic} drug may have different effects from one pure enantiomer.
e.zh: 外消旋药物的效果可能不同于单一纯对映体。

e.en: The {racemiferous} plant attracted many bees in spring.
e.zh: 这种具总状花序的植物在春天吸引了许多蜜蜂。

e.en: Her description emphasized the {racemiferous} branches.
e.zh: 她的描述重点提到了那些具总状花序的枝条。

e.en: The shrub had a {racemiform} cluster of pale flowers.
e.zh: 这株灌木有一簇总状花序状的浅色花。

e.en: A {racemiform} structure appears near the tip of the stem.
e.zh: 茎尖附近出现了一个总状花序状结构。

e.en: The lecture introduced {racemism} in organic chemistry.
e.zh: 这堂课介绍了有机化学中的外消旋现象。

e.en: Researchers discussed {racemism} as a problem in drug synthesis.
e.zh: 研究人员把外消旋现象作为药物合成中的问题来讨论。

e.en: Heat can speed up {racemization} in some amino acids.
e.zh: 加热会加快某些氨基酸的外消旋化。

e.en: The team measured {racemization} to estimate the sample's age.
e.zh: 团队通过测量外消旋化来估算样本年代。

e.en: Strong acid may {racemize} the compound during purification.
e.zh: 强酸可能在纯化过程中使该化合物外消旋化。

e.en: The sample began to {racemize} after prolonged heating.
e.zh: 样品在长时间加热后开始外消旋化。

e.en: The fossil showed a {racemoid} pattern along one edge.
e.zh: 这块化石的一侧呈现近似总状的图案。

e.en: Botanists used {racemoid} for an imperfect flower cluster.
e.zh: 植物学家用近似总状来描述这种不典型花簇。

e.en: The vine produced {racemose} clusters of tiny flowers.
e.zh: 这株藤蔓长出了总状的小花簇。

e.en: The scan revealed a {racemose} vascular malformation.
e.zh: 扫描显示出一种葡萄串状的血管畸形。

e.en: A small {racemule} formed beside the main flower stalk.
e.zh: 主花茎旁形成了一个小总状花序。

e.en: The specimen's {racemule} was shorter than expected.
e.zh: 这个标本的小总状花序比预期更短。

e.en: The {racemulose} branches were crowded with pale buds.
e.zh: 具小总状花序的枝条上挤满了浅色花蕾。

e.en: He identified the grass by its {racemulose} inflorescence.
e.zh: 他根据其具小总状花序的花序认出了这种草。

e.en: The young {racerunner} finished the trial in record time.
e.zh: 这名年轻赛跑者以创纪录的时间完成了测试。

e.en: A six-lined {racerunner} darted across the warm sand.
e.zh: 一只六线鞭尾蜥飞快地穿过温热的沙地。

e.en: The old poem mentions a {rache} following the deer.
e.zh: 那首古诗提到一只猎犬追踪鹿。

e.en: A trained {rache} could follow a scent for miles.
e.zh: 受训的嗅猎犬能沿着气味追踪数英里。

e.en: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a {rachet}.
e.zh: 机械师用棘轮扳手拧紧了螺栓。

e.en: A worn {rachet} made the winch slip under load.
e.zh: 磨损的棘轮装置让绞盘在受力时打滑。

e.en: The report noted a {rachid} deformity in the patient.
e.zh: 报告指出患者有脊柱畸形。

e.en: The fossil preserved the {rachid} region unusually well.
e.zh: 这块化石异常完整地保存了脊轴区域。

e.en: The specimen had a long {rachiform} central support.
e.zh: 这个标本有一条长而轴状的中央支撑。

e.en: A {rachiform} ridge ran down the back of the shell.
e.zh: 壳背上有一道脊柱状的隆起。

e.en: The grass spikelet broke at the {rachilla}.
e.zh: 这枚禾草小穗从小穗轴处断开。

e.en: She examined the {rachilla} under a hand lens.
e.zh: 她用手持放大镜观察小穗轴。

e.en: The extinct animal had a {rachiodont} pattern of teeth.
e.zh: 这种已灭绝动物具有脊齿型牙列。

e.en: A {rachiodont} jaw fragment helped classify the fossil.
e.zh: 一块脊齿型颌骨碎片帮助归类了这件化石。

e.en: The fern leaflets grew along a central {rachis}.
e.zh: 蕨类的小叶沿中央叶轴生长。

e.en: An injury to the {rachis} can affect the spinal cord.
e.zh: 脊柱受伤可能会影响脊髓。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with {rachischisis} soon after birth.
e.zh: 这个新生儿出生后不久被诊断出脊柱裂。

e.en: Severe {rachischisis} may require specialist surgical care.
e.zh: 严重的脊椎裂畸形可能需要专科手术治疗。

e.en: The fern's {rachises} were covered with tiny brown scales.
e.zh: 这株蕨类的叶轴上布满了细小的褐色鳞片。

e.en: Botanists compared the flower {rachises} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下比较这些花序轴。

e.en: The doctor noticed the child's {rachitic} legs.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个孩子的腿有佝偻病特征。

e.en: The old shed stood on {rachitic} wooden posts.
e.zh: 那间旧棚屋靠几根发育不良般瘦弱的木柱支撑着。

e.en: Vitamin D deficiency can cause {rachitis} in children.
e.zh: 维生素D缺乏会导致儿童患佝偻病。

e.en: Early treatment of {rachitis} can prevent bone deformities.
e.zh: 早期治疗佝偻病可以防止骨骼畸形。

racialistic.t: 种族主义的；强调种族的

e.en: The essay rejected {racialistic} theories of intelligence.
e.zh: 这篇文章驳斥了关于智力的种族主义理论。

e.en: Her speech avoided the {racialistic} language common at the time.
e.zh: 她的演讲避开了当时常见的强调种族的措辞。

e.en: The media can {racialize} crime in subtle ways.
e.zh: 媒体可能以隐晦方式把犯罪问题种族化。

e.en: They tried not to {racialize} every conflict in the school.
e.zh: 他们尽量不把学校里的每次冲突都按种族来解读。

e.en: The report {racializes} poverty without examining class.
e.zh: 这份报告把贫困种族化，却没有考察阶级因素。

e.en: Such language {racializes} ordinary neighborhood disputes.
e.zh: 这种说法会把普通的邻里纠纷按种族来解读。

e.en: The scene was written {racily} but not crudely.
e.zh: 这个场景写得很刺激露骨，但并不粗俗。

e.en: She described the scandal {racily} for the Sunday paper.
e.zh: 她为周日的报纸把这桩丑闻写得绘声绘色。

e.en: The film's {raciness} surprised older viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影的露骨劲儿让年长观众感到意外。

e.en: Editors toned down the {raciness} of the headline.
e.zh: 编辑们降低了标题里的刺激感。

e.en: He dreamed of driving a {racing-car} one day.
e.zh: 他梦想有一天能驾驶赛车。

e.en: The {racing-car} reached the bend at terrifying speed.
e.zh: 那辆赛车以惊人的速度冲到弯道前。

e.en: The gate uses a {rack-and-pinion} drive system.
e.zh: 这扇大门使用齿条齿轮传动系统。

e.en: Many cars rely on {rack-and-pinion} steering.
e.zh: 许多汽车依靠齿条齿轮式转向机构。

e.en: We bought a {rack-mount} server for the studio.
e.zh: 我们为工作室买了一台机架安装式服务器。

e.en: The kit lets you {rack-mount} the audio interface.
e.zh: 这个套件可以让你把音频接口装入机架。

e.en: The routers are {rack-mounted} in the data room.
e.zh: 这些路由器安装在数据室的机架上。

e.en: A {rack-mounted} mixer saves desk space.
e.zh: 安装在机架上的调音台可以节省桌面空间。

e.en: The landlord was denounced as a cruel {rack-renter}.
e.zh: 这个房东被斥为残酷索取高额地租的人。

e.en: Victorian reformers attacked the {rack-renter} in pamphlets.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的改革者在小册子里抨击高租剥削者。

e.en: The stray horse looked like a poor {rackabones}.
e.zh: 那匹流浪马看起来像个可怜的瘦骨嶙峋家伙。

e.en: He called himself an old {rackabones} after the illness.
e.zh: 病后他自嘲成了一个瘦骨嶙峋的老家伙。

e.en: Miners once used {rackarock} for difficult blasting jobs.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾用这种早期烈性炸药处理艰难爆破。

e.en: The manual warned that {rackarock} was highly dangerous.
e.zh: 手册警告说这种烈性炸药非常危险。

e.en: The children made a {rackety} parade through the hall.
e.zh: 孩子们在大厅里吵吵闹闹地列队走过。

e.en: He led a {rackety} life before settling down.
e.zh: 安定下来之前，他过着放荡喧闹的生活。

e.en: His {rackle} habits worried his family.
e.zh: 他鲁莽放荡的习惯让家人担心。

e.en: The old poem mocks a {rackle} young lord.
e.zh: 这首古诗嘲讽了一位放荡的年轻贵族。

rackman.t: 机架工；使用齿条装置者

e.en: The {rackman} checked each frame before the shift ended.
e.zh: 下班前，机架工检查了每一个框架。

e.en: A skilled {rackman} kept the mechanism running smoothly.
e.zh: 熟练的齿条装置操作工让机构保持顺畅运转。

e.en: The clock's {rackwork} needed careful adjustment.
e.zh: 这座钟的齿条机构需要仔细调整。

e.en: Engineers inspected the lift's old {rackwork}.
e.zh: 工程师检查了升降机老旧的齿杆装置。

e.en: The ship identified the harbor entrance by its {racon}.
e.zh: 船只通过雷达信标识别出港口入口。

e.en: A faulty {racon} can confuse vessels in poor visibility.
e.zh: 有故障的雷达信标会在能见度差时误导船只。

e.en: The old {raconteuse} held the room with one story after another.
e.zh: 那位善讲故事的老妇人用一个接一个的故事吸引了全场。

e.en: She became known as a witty {raconteuse} at dinner parties.
e.zh: 她在晚宴上以机智健谈、会讲故事而出名。

e.en: The technician checked the room with a {radameter} before entering.
e.zh: 技术员进入前先用辐射测量仪检查了房间。

e.en: A portable {radameter} can warn workers of dangerous radiation levels.
e.zh: 便携式辐射测量仪能提醒工人辐射水平危险。

e.en: The lab studied {radappertization} as a way to preserve packaged meals.
e.zh: 实验室研究用辐照灭菌保藏法来保存包装餐食。

e.en: Critics questioned whether {radappertization} would affect the food's flavor.
e.zh: 批评者质疑辐照灭菌保藏法是否会影响食物风味。

e.en: Engineers used {radargrammetry} to map the rough polar terrain.
e.zh: 工程师用雷达摄影测量法绘制崎岖的极地地形。

e.en: The course introduced {radargrammetry} alongside aerial photogrammetry.
e.zh: 这门课程把雷达摄影测量法和航空摄影测量一起介绍。

e.en: The {radarman} spotted an aircraft on the screen.
e.zh: 雷达操作员在屏幕上发现了一架飞机。

e.en: During the storm, the ship's {radarman} tracked nearby vessels carefully.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，船上的雷达操作员仔细追踪附近船只。

e.en: A bright mark appeared on the {radarscope} at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时，雷达显示器上出现了一个亮点。

e.en: The pilot glanced at the {radarscope} before changing course.
e.zh: 飞行员改航向前看了一眼雷达显示器。

e.en: The shepherd marked the sheep with {raddle} during breeding season.
e.zh: 牧羊人在繁殖季用红赭石给羊做标记。

e.en: Workers used to {raddle} the bricks before firing them.
e.zh: 工人过去会在烧制前把砖涂成红赭色。

e.en: His {raddled} face showed years of hard drinking.
e.zh: 他憔悴的脸显出多年酗酒的痕迹。

e.en: The farmer separated the {raddled} sheep from the rest of the flock.
e.zh: 农夫把身上有红赭标记的羊从羊群中分出来。

e.en: The village {raddleman} sold marking paste to local shepherds.
e.zh: 村里的红赭石贩子把标记膏卖给当地牧羊人。

e.en: In the old account book, a {raddleman} is listed among the tradesmen.
e.zh: 在旧账簿里，红赭石贩子被列在商贩之中。

e.en: She keeps several {raddles} for marking different groups of sheep.
e.zh: 她备有几块红赭石，用来标记不同组的羊。

e.en: He {raddles} the ewes so he can identify them later.
e.zh: 他给母羊涂上红赭色，好在之后辨认。

e.en: The farmer finished {raddling} the flock before dusk.
e.zh: 农夫在黄昏前给羊群完成了红赭标记。

e.en: Old pottery sometimes shows traces of {raddling} on the surface.
e.zh: 古陶器表面有时能看到涂红赭色的痕迹。

e.en: They took a quiet {rade} through the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 他们黎明时沿山谷安静地骑行了一段路。

e.en: The old map marks a {rade} leading to the coast.
e.zh: 那张旧地图标出了一条通往海岸的道路。

e.en: The dentist recommended {radectomy} to save the damaged tooth.
e.zh: 牙医建议做牙根切除术来保住那颗受损的牙。

e.en: After the {radectomy}, she returned for several follow-up visits.
e.zh: 牙根切除术后，她又复诊了几次。

e.en: The rescue team carried a {radiac} into the contaminated zone.
e.zh: 救援队带着辐射探测仪进入受污染区域。

e.en: A {radiac} reading confirmed that the package was safe to handle.
e.zh: 辐射探测仪的读数确认这个包裹可以安全处理。

e.en: Each worker wore a {radiacmeter} near the reactor.
e.zh: 每名工人在反应堆附近都佩戴了辐射剂量仪。

e.en: The inspector checked the {radiacmeter} after leaving the site.
e.zh: 检查员离开现场后查看了辐射剂量仪。

e.en: The fossil's {radiale} helped identify the animal's forelimb structure.
e.zh: 化石中的桡骨侧腕骨帮助确认了这种动物的前肢结构。

e.en: In anatomy class, she labeled the {radiale} on the diagram.
e.zh: 解剖课上，她在图中标出了桡骨侧腕骨。

e.en: The surgeon examined the arteria {radialis} before the procedure.
e.zh: 手术前，外科医生检查了桡动脉。

e.en: Pain near the extensor {radialis} can affect wrist movement.
e.zh: 桡侧伸肌附近的疼痛会影响手腕活动。

e.en: The design's {radialization} made every path lead toward the center.
e.zh: 这个设计的放射状化让每条路径都通向中心。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {radialization} as part of the hand reconstruction.
e.zh: 外科医生讨论了把桡侧化作为手部重建的一部分。

e.en: The map showed a {radialized} network of roads around the capital.
e.zh: 地图显示首都周围形成了放射状道路网络。

e.en: The child's hand was {radialized} during reconstructive surgery.
e.zh: 孩子的手在重建手术中进行了桡侧化处理。

e.en: The dry field was dotted with {rabbitweed} after the rains.
e.zh: 雨后，干燥的田地里零星长出了兔草。

e.en: Local guides pointed out {rabbitweed} along the sandy trail.
e.zh: 当地向导指给我们看沙地小路旁的兔草。

e.en: The handle was carved from pale {rabbitwood}.
e.zh: 这个手柄是用浅色兔木雕成的。

e.en: A line of {rabbitwood} shrubs bordered the old pasture.
e.zh: 一排兔木灌木围在旧牧场边上。

e.en: He gave a quick, {rabbity} glance toward the door.
e.zh: 他像受惊的兔子一样迅速瞥了一眼门口。

e.en: Her {rabbity} front teeth made her smile memorable.
e.zh: 她那对像兔子似的门牙让笑容很有辨识度。

rabble-rouser.t: 煽动闹事者；蛊惑民众者

e.en: The mayor dismissed him as a dangerous {rabble-rouser}.
e.zh: 市长把他斥为危险的煽动闹事者。

e.en: A skilled {rabble-rouser} can turn fear into anger.
e.zh: 老练的煽动者能把恐惧变成愤怒。

rabble-rousers.t: 煽动闹事者；蛊惑民众者

e.en: Police blamed outside {rabble-rousers} for the violence.
e.zh: 警方把暴力事件归咎于外来的煽动闹事者。

e.en: The paper called the protesters {rabble-rousers}, but many were peaceful.
e.zh: 报纸称抗议者是闹事煽动者，但其中许多人很和平。

e.en: His {rabble-rousing} speech filled the square with angry chants.
e.zh: 他那番煽动性的演说让广场上响起愤怒的口号。

e.en: The article avoided facts and relied on {rabble-rousing} slogans.
e.zh: 这篇文章避开事实，只靠蛊惑人心的口号。

e.en: The lord sneered at the {rabblement} outside the gate.
e.zh: 那位贵族轻蔑地看着门外的乌合之众。

e.en: In the play, the {rabblement} becomes a voice of public anger.
e.zh: 在剧中，那群民众成了公众愤怒的声音。

e.en: Mary turned and said, {Rabboni}, when she recognized him.
e.zh: 玛丽认出他后转过身说，拉波尼。

e.en: The old text glosses {Rabboni} as a respectful form of teacher.
e.zh: 这段古文把拉波尼解释为对老师的尊称。

e.en: She sauteed {rabe} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 她用大蒜和橄榄油炒了油菜苔。

e.en: Broccoli {rabe} tastes pleasantly bitter in pasta.
e.zh: 西兰花油菜苔放在意面里有一种舒服的微苦味。

rabelaesian.t: 拉伯雷式的；粗犷滑稽的

e.en: The novel has a {Rabelaesian} appetite for jokes and excess.
e.zh: 这部小说有拉伯雷式的笑料和放纵气息。

e.en: His {Rabelaesian} humor shocked the polite audience.
e.zh: 他那种粗犷滑稽的幽默震惊了文雅的观众。

e.en: The doctor watched for {rabic} symptoms after the bite.
e.zh: 被咬后，医生留意是否出现狂犬病症状。

e.en: Old reports described a {rabic} fury in the infected animal.
e.zh: 旧报告描述了那只染病动物狂犬病般的狂怒。

e.en: The farm stopped using {rabicide} near the wetlands.
e.zh: 农场停止在湿地附近使用杀兔剂。

e.en: Critics called the policy {rabicide} on a national scale.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策是在全国范围内灭兔。

e.en: The dog's {rabidity} made treatment impossible.
e.zh: 那条狗的狂犬病状态使治疗变得不可能。

e.en: The debate was marked by unusual {rabidity} on both sides.
e.zh: 这场辩论中双方都表现出异常的狂暴。

e.en: The carpenter smoothed the plank with a {rabot}.
e.zh: 木匠用刨子把木板刨平。

e.en: A small {rabot} lay beside the shavings on the bench.
e.zh: 工作台上的木屑旁放着一把小刨子。

e.en: The sermon warned against calling a brother {raca}.
e.zh: 布道告诫人们不要骂弟兄为笨蛋。

e.en: In the old translation, {raca} appears as a term of contempt.
e.zh: 在旧译本中，raca 是一个表示轻蔑的骂词。

e.en: Commentators accused the host of being a {race-baiter}.
e.zh: 评论员指责那名主持人煽动种族对立。

e.en: A {race-baiter} often exploits fear for political gain.
e.zh: 煽动种族对立的人常常利用恐惧谋取政治利益。

e.en: The campaign was condemned for {race-baiting} advertisements.
e.zh: 这场竞选因发布煽动种族对立的广告而受到谴责。

e.en: She rejected the charge of {race-baiting} during the debate.
e.zh: 她在辩论中否认了煽动种族对立的指控。

e.en: He was accused of playing the {race-card} to win votes.
e.zh: 他被指责为了赢得选票而打种族牌。

e.en: The phrase {race-card} can itself be politically loaded.
e.zh: “种族牌”这个说法本身也可能带有政治意味。

e.en: Every {race-goer} checked the odds before the first event.
e.zh: 第一场比赛前，每个赛马观众都查看了赔率。

e.en: A casual {race-goer} may come for the atmosphere, not the betting.
e.zh: 普通观赛者可能是为现场气氛而来，并不是为了下注。

e.en: The spring {race-meeting} attracts visitors from across the county.
e.zh: 春季赛马会吸引全郡各地的游客。

e.zh: 大雨迫使官方推迟了这场赛事日活动。

e.en: The drivers tested their cars on the {race-track}.
e.zh: 车手们在赛道上测试他们的汽车。

e.zh: 许多家庭聚到跑马场观看下午的比赛。

e.zh: 城市附近开了几条新的赛道。

e.zh: 旧跑马场常常会改造成公园或住宅区。

e.en: The {radiancy} of the morning filled the room.
e.zh: 清晨的光辉洒满了房间。

e.zh: 听到好消息后，她脸上有一种安静的光彩。

e.en: The lab installed {radiation-proof} doors around the reactor.
e.zh: 实验室在反应堆周围安装了防辐射门。
