e.zh: 报告警告网络诈骗正在猖獗蔓延。

e.en: Gardeners struggled with the {rampancy} of the vines.
e.zh: 园丁们为藤蔓的疯狂蔓延而苦恼。

e.en: A lone {rampike} stood beside the frozen lake.
e.zh: 一截孤零零的枯立树干立在结冰的湖边。

e.en: The owl perched on a blackened {rampike}.
e.zh: 猫头鹰停在一根烧黑的枯立树干上。

e.en: She added young {rampion} leaves to the salad.
e.zh: 她把嫩风铃草叶加进沙拉里。

e.en: The old recipe called for {rampion} roots.
e.zh: 这道老食谱需要用风铃草的根。

e.en: The cook chopped fresh {ramse} into the soup.
e.zh: 厨师把新鲜野蒜切碎放进汤里。

e.en: We smelled {ramse} growing near the stream.
e.zh: 我们闻到溪边生长的熊葱气味。

e.en: The pond contained several {ramshorn} snails.
e.zh: 池塘里有几只盘卷状的羊角螺。

e.en: The old gate had a {ramshorn} handle.
e.zh: 那扇旧门有一个羊角形把手。

e.en: The recipe calls for crushed {ramtil} and jaggery.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要压碎的芝麻和粗糖。

e.en: Farmers pressed {ramtil} seeds for a fragrant oil.
e.zh: 农民榨芝麻籽来取得香味浓郁的油。

ramulose.t: 有许多小枝的；多细枝的

e.en: The shrub has a {ramulose} crown above the path.
e.zh: 这灌木在小路上方形成了多细枝的树冠。

e.en: A {ramulose} coral shape filled the microscope slide.
e.zh: 显微镜载玻片上布满了多分枝的珊瑚状形态。

e.en: The surgeon identified the nerve {ramus} before cutting.
e.zh: 外科医生在下刀前辨认出了那条神经分支。

e.en: Each {ramus} of the jawbone was carefully measured.
e.zh: 下颌骨的每个支状部分都被仔细测量。

e.en: The paper described {ranaconine} from a poisonous plant extract.
e.zh: 论文描述了从有毒植物提取物中得到的这种生物碱。

e.en: Chemists tested whether {ranaconine} affected nerve signals.
e.zh: 化学家测试这种有毒生物碱是否会影响神经信号。

rancherie.t: 原住民村落；印第安人聚居地

e.en: The mission stood near a small {rancherie}.
e.zh: 传教站建在一个小型原住民村落附近。

e.en: Families returned to the {rancherie} after the harvest.
e.zh: 收获结束后，各家人回到了那个印第安人聚居地。

e.en: The {ranchman} repaired fences before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，牧场主修好了围栏。

e.en: A hired {ranchman} rode out to check the cattle.
e.zh: 一名受雇的牧场工人骑马出去查看牛群。

e.en: Several {ranchmen} met to discuss water rights.
e.zh: 几位牧场主碰面讨论用水权问题。

e.en: The {ranchmen} drove the herd across the valley.
e.zh: 牧场工人把牛群赶过山谷。

e.en: The oil's {rancidity} spoiled the whole dish.
e.zh: 油的酸败味毁了整道菜。

e.en: Cool storage slows the {rancidity} of nuts and seeds.
e.zh: 低温储存能减缓坚果和种子的酸败。

e.en: They practiced {randan} on the quiet river.
e.zh: 他们在平静的河面上练习三人划船。

e.en: After payday, the sailors went on a noisy {randan}.
e.zh: 发薪后，水手们出去闹了一场喧哗的狂欢。

e.en: A {randem} team pulled the coach through mud.
e.zh: 三匹马纵列组成的马队拉着马车穿过泥地。

e.en: The driver preferred a {randem} arrangement on narrow lanes.
e.zh: 车夫在狭窄小路上更喜欢三马纵列的套法。

e.en: The sequel was {randier} than the original film.
e.zh: 这部续集比原片更露骨好色。

e.en: His jokes became {randier} as the evening went on.
e.zh: 夜越深，他的笑话就变得越发下流。

e.en: The play's {randiness} shocked some older viewers.
e.zh: 这出戏的下流露骨让一些年长观众感到震惊。

e.en: He mistook crude {randiness} for romantic confidence.
e.zh: 他把粗俗的好色误当成了浪漫自信。

e.en: A {random-access} file lets the program jump directly to records.
e.zh: 随机存取文件让程序能直接跳到指定记录。

e.en: The device uses {random-access} memory for temporary data.
e.zh: 这台设备使用随机存取存储器保存临时数据。

e.en: The lab synthesized a flexible {randomcopolymer} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种柔性的无规共聚物用于测试。

e.en: A {randomcopolymer} has monomer units arranged without a fixed pattern.
e.zh: 无规共聚物的单体单元排列没有固定规律。

e.en: The model's {randomicity} made exact predictions impossible.
e.zh: 这个模型的随机性使精确预测变得不可能。

e.en: Critics disliked the apparent {randomicity} of the plot.
e.zh: 评论者不喜欢情节中那种明显的偶然性。

e.en: The trial used {randomisation} to assign patients fairly.
e.zh: 这项试验采用随机化来公平分配患者。

e.en: Good {randomisation} reduces bias in the results.
e.zh: 良好的随机分配能减少结果中的偏差。

e.en: His notes were a {randommess} of dates and names.
e.zh: 他的笔记里日期和姓名杂乱无章。

e.en: The drawer became a {randommess} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家后，那个抽屉变成了一团混乱。

e.en: Old laws punished {rane} as a violent taking.
e.zh: 旧法律把抢夺视为暴力占有而加以惩罚。

e.en: The poem speaks of {rane} and ruin after battle.
e.zh: 这首诗写到战后的掠夺与毁灭。

e.en: The {ranee} received visitors in a jeweled hall.
e.zh: 那位印度王后在珠宝装饰的大厅里接见来客。

e.en: A local legend says the {ranee} hid treasure there.
e.zh: 当地传说那位女王公曾把宝藏藏在那里。

e.en: In Australian slang, a {ranga} is a red-haired person.
e.zh: 在澳大利亚俚语中，ranga 指红头发的人。

e.en: He joked about being the only {ranga} in the family.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己是家里唯一的红发人。

e.en: The {rangatira} spoke first at the gathering.
e.zh: 那位毛利首领在集会上首先发言。

e.en: She was treated as a {rangatira} by her people.
e.zh: 她受到族人的尊敬，被视为贵族。

e.en: The device's {rangeability} impressed the engineers.
e.zh: 这台设备的可变范围让工程师们印象深刻。

e.en: Her vocal {rangeability} lets her sing many styles.
e.zh: 她嗓音的适应范围使她能演唱多种风格。

e.en: The careful {rangement} of books pleased the librarian.
e.zh: 书籍的细致排列让图书管理员很满意。

e.en: His desk needed some {rangement} before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前，他的书桌需要整理一下。

rangership.t: 护林员职位；巡逻员身份

e.en: He applied for {rangership} in the national park.
e.zh: 他申请了国家公园的护林员职位。

e.en: Her {rangership} required long days in remote forests.
e.zh: 她的巡逻员身份意味着要在偏远森林里长时间工作。

e.en: The cabin had only a sink and a {rangette}.
e.zh: 小屋里只有一个水槽和一个小型炉灶。

e.en: She cooked soup on the old {rangette}.
e.zh: 她在那台旧小灶具上煮汤。

rangey.t: 腿长瘦高的；活动范围大的

e.en: The {rangey} horse moved easily across the field.
e.zh: 那匹腿长瘦高的马轻松地穿过田野。

e.en: He wrote a {rangey} essay covering politics and art.
e.zh: 他写了一篇涉猎很广的文章，谈到政治和艺术。

e.en: The colt's {ranginess} suggested speed and stamina.
e.zh: 这匹小马的瘦高体形显示出速度和耐力。

e.en: The novel's {ranginess} can delight or exhaust readers.
e.zh: 这部小说题材范围之广，可能让读者喜爱也可能让人疲惫。

e.en: The {rani} governed while the ruler was away.
e.zh: 统治者外出时，那位印度王后代为治理。

e.en: A portrait of the {rani} hung in the palace.
e.zh: 宫殿里挂着那位王公妻子的画像。

e.en: The union's {rank-and-file} rejected the agreement.
e.zh: 工会的普通成员拒绝了这项协议。

e.en: Managers ignored concerns from {rank-and-file} employees.
e.zh: 管理层忽视了基层员工的担忧。

e.en: As a {rank-and-filer}, she wanted clearer rules.
e.zh: 作为一名普通成员，她希望规则更清楚。

e.en: The report quoted one {rank-and-filer} from the factory.
e.zh: 报告引用了工厂里一名基层员工的话。

e.en: That was the {rankest} hypocrisy I had ever seen.
e.zh: 那是我见过的最恶劣的虚伪。

e.en: The {rankest} smell came from the flooded cellar.
e.zh: 最刺鼻的气味来自被水淹过的地下室。

e.en: The engineer converted the reading to {Rankine}.
e.zh: 工程师把读数换算成兰金温标。

e.en: Some thermodynamics tables list temperatures in {Rankine}.
e.zh: 一些热力学表格用兰金温标列出温度。

e.en: A {rankish} odor drifted from the old drain.
e.zh: 旧排水口飘来一股略臭的气味。

e.en: His {rankish} humor made the guests uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他有点粗野的幽默让客人们不舒服。

e.en: The drums beat a steady {rantan} through the street.
e.zh: 鼓声在街上敲出稳定的砰砰节奏。

e.en: We heard the {rantan} of rain on the roof.
e.zh: 我们听见雨点打在屋顶上的连续响声。

e.en: The {rantankerous} old man argued with everyone.
e.zh: 那个暴躁难缠的老人和每个人争吵。

e.en: Even the calm nurse struggled with the {rantankerous} patient.
e.zh: 就连那位冷静的护士也难以应付这个难缠的病人。

e.en: The old play features a {rantipole} servant who mocks everyone.
e.zh: 那出老戏里有个放荡顽皮的仆人，嘲笑所有人。

e.en: She grew tired of his {rantipole} behavior at dinner.
e.zh: 她厌烦了他在晚餐时那种胡闹放肆的举止。

e.en: His {ranty} speech lost the audience after ten minutes.
e.zh: 他那番咆哮式演讲十分钟后就让听众失去兴趣。

e.en: The article sounded {ranty} rather than persuasive.
e.zh: 这篇文章听起来像在发牢骚，而不是在说服人。

e.en: The botanist described the flower as {ranunculaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花描述为毛茛科植物。

e.en: Several {ranunculaceous} species grow near the wet meadow.
e.zh: 湿草甸附近生长着几种毛茛科植物。

e.en: The garden bed was bright with yellow {ranunculi}.
e.zh: 花坛里黄色毛茛花开得很亮眼。

e.en: She ordered {ranunculi} for the spring wedding bouquet.
e.zh: 她为春季婚礼花束订了毛茛花。

e.en: A single {ranunculus} bloomed beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁开着一朵毛茛花。

e.en: The florist added a pink {ranunculus} to the bouquet.
e.zh: 花艺师在花束里加了一朵粉色毛茛。

e.en: The nursery sells {ranunculuses} in early spring.
e.zh: 这家苗圃早春时出售毛茛花。

e.en: Her painting shows red {ranunculuses} in a blue vase.
e.zh: 她的画里有插在蓝色花瓶中的红色毛茛花。

e.en: Doctors used {rapamycin} to help prevent organ rejection.
e.zh: 医生使用雷帕霉素来帮助防止器官排斥。

e.en: Researchers study {rapamycin} for its effects on cell growth.
e.zh: 研究人员研究雷帕霉素对细胞生长的影响。

e.en: The lab isolated {raphanin} from radish seeds.
e.zh: 实验室从萝卜种子中分离出萝卜素。

e.en: Older studies linked {raphanin} with antibacterial activity.
e.zh: 早期研究把萝卜素与抗菌活性联系起来。

e.en: The basket was woven from dried {raphia}.
e.zh: 这个篮子是用干拉菲草编成的。

e.en: She tied the package with a strip of {raphia}.
e.zh: 她用一条酒椰纤维把包裹系好。

e.en: A {raphide} can irritate the mouth if the leaf is chewed.
e.zh: 咀嚼叶子时，植物针晶可能刺激口腔。

e.en: The microscope revealed a sharp {raphide} inside the plant cell.
e.zh: 显微镜显示植物细胞内有一根尖锐的针晶。

e.en: Some houseplants contain {raphides} that sting the tongue.
e.zh: 有些室内植物含有会刺痛舌头的植物针晶。

e.en: The students sketched {raphides} seen under the microscope.
e.zh: 学生们画下了显微镜下看到的植物针晶。

e.en: The diagram marks the {raphis} along the seed.
e.zh: 图中标出了种子上的接合脊。

e.en: The surgeon noted a faint {raphis} in the tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到组织中有一条淡淡的缝线。

rapid-fire.t: 连珠炮似的；快速连续的

e.en: The reporter asked three {rapid-fire} questions.
e.zh: 记者连珠炮似的问了三个问题。

e.en: The meeting ended with a {rapid-fire} review of deadlines.
e.zh: 会议最后快速连续地回顾了各项截止日期。

e.en: The old soldier was known as a skilled {rapid-firer}.
e.zh: 那名老兵以熟练的快速射击者著称。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {rapid-firer} from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件战争时期的早期连发枪。

rapid-firing.t: 快速连发的；连珠炮式的

e.en: The host kept {rapid-firing} questions at the guests.
e.zh: 主持人不停地向嘉宾连珠炮似的提问。

e.en: A {rapid-firing} cannon guarded the narrow harbor entrance.
e.zh: 一门快速连发炮守卫着狭窄的港口入口。

e.en: He answered with a {rapier-thrust} that silenced the room.
e.zh: 他用一句尖刻妙语回应，让全场安静下来。

e.en: The fencer practiced a clean {rapier-thrust} before the bout.
e.zh: 击剑手在比赛前练习了一次干净的细剑刺击。

e.en: The poem condemns the army's {rapine} after victory.
e.zh: 这首诗谴责军队胜利后的劫掠行为。

e.en: Villagers feared another night of {rapine} and fire.
e.zh: 村民担心又一个充满掠夺和火光的夜晚。

e.en: She sauteed {rapini} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 她用蒜和橄榄油炒了意式菜心。

e.en: The pasta came with bitter {rapini} and sausage.
e.zh: 这道意面配了带苦味的芥蓝菜薹和香肠。

e.en: The ballad tells of a bold {rapparee} in the hills.
e.zh: 这首民谣讲述山中一名勇敢的爱尔兰游击兵。

e.en: Travelers feared meeting a {rapparee} on the lonely road.
e.zh: 旅人害怕在偏僻道路上遇到强盗。

e.en: The old man kept {rappee} in a silver box.
e.zh: 老人把浓味鼻烟装在一个银盒里。

e.en: A pinch of {rappee} made him sneeze loudly.
e.zh: 一撮浓味鼻烟让他大声打了个喷嚏。

e.en: The fare rose by one {rappen} after the change.
e.zh: 调整后票价上涨了一个拉彭。

e.en: He found an old {rappen} under the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉下面发现了一枚旧拉彭硬币。

e.en: The chef blanched {rappini} before adding it to pasta.
e.zh: 厨师先焯了意式菜心，再把它加入意面。

e.en: Fresh {rappini} tastes slightly bitter when steamed.
e.zh: 新鲜芥蓝菜薹蒸熟后味道略带苦味。

e.en: The mantis folded its {raptatorial} forelegs under its body.
e.zh: 螳螂把适于攫捕的前足收在身下。

e.en: Owls have {raptatorial} claws for seizing prey.
e.zh: 猫头鹰有猛禽式的利爪用来抓住猎物。

e.en: The insect uses {raptatory} limbs to catch smaller flies.
e.zh: 这种昆虫用攫捕性的肢体捕捉更小的苍蝇。

e.en: Its {raptatory} beak looked built for tearing flesh.
e.zh: 它那猛禽般的喙看起来就是为撕肉而生的。

e.en: The hawk's {raptorial} feet gripped the branch tightly.
e.zh: 鹰那适于捕食的脚紧紧抓住树枝。

e.en: Some beetles have {raptorial} front legs for ambush hunting.
e.zh: 有些甲虫有适于伏击捕食的前腿。

raree-show.t: 街头西洋镜；珍奇小展览

e.en: Children paid a penny to see the {raree-show}.
e.zh: 孩子们花一便士去看街头西洋镜。

e.en: The cabinet was filled like a {raree-show} of odd treasures.
e.zh: 柜子里摆满稀奇宝物，像个珍奇小展览。

e.en: Heat can have a {rarefactive} effect on the gas.
e.zh: 加热会对气体产生使其稀薄的作用。

e.en: The poem's {rarefactive} style strips away ordinary detail.
e.zh: 这首诗稀疏化的风格删去了寻常细节。

e.en: The vapor is {rarefiable} under reduced pressure.
e.zh: 这种蒸气在低压下可以变得稀薄。

e.en: Air is {rarefiable} when it rises through the atmosphere.
e.zh: 空气上升穿过大气层时会变得稀薄。

e.en: The experiment measured the {rarefication} of air in the chamber.
e.zh: 实验测量了舱内空气的稀薄化。

e.en: Critics noticed a deliberate {rarefication} of language in her later work.
e.zh: 评论家注意到她后期作品中有意让语言变得稀疏。

e.en: The farmer planted a {rareripe} peach near the wall.
e.zh: 农夫在墙边种了一棵早熟桃树。

e.en: Those {rareripe} apples reached the market before midsummer.
e.zh: 那些早熟苹果在仲夏前就上市了。

e.en: Altitude {rarifies} the air around the mountain camp.
e.zh: 海拔高度使山地营地周围的空气变得稀薄。

e.en: Her editing {rarifies} the prose until only essentials remain.
e.zh: 她的编辑让散文变得精炼，只留下要点。

e.en: The pump will {rarify} the gas inside the tube.
e.zh: 这台泵会使管内气体变得稀薄。

e.en: Academic jargon can {rarify} a simple idea.
e.zh: 学术行话可能把一个简单想法弄得过于精致难懂。

rarifying.t: 正在稀薄化的；使精致的

e.en: The rising heat was {rarifying} the air above the road.
e.zh: 升起的热气正使路面上方的空气变稀薄。

e.en: The editor's {rarifying} touch made the essay elegant but distant.
e.zh: 编辑那种精炼化的处理让文章优雅却有距离感。

e.en: The mayor denounced the town's petty {rascaldom}.
e.zh: 市长谴责镇上那些小无赖的行径。

e.en: In the novel, {rascaldom} thrives behind respectable doors.
e.zh: 在小说里，无赖之风在体面门面背后滋长。

e.en: His cheerful {rascalism} made him both charming and unreliable.
e.zh: 他那快活的无赖作风让他既迷人又不可靠。

e.en: The judge had no patience for political {rascalism}.
e.zh: 法官对政治上的恶棍行径毫无耐心。

e.en: The memoir lists his youthful {rascalities} with surprising pride.
e.zh: 回忆录带着惊人的得意列举了他年轻时的无赖行为。

e.en: Their little {rascalities} annoyed every shopkeeper on the street.
e.zh: 他们那些小恶作剧把街上的每个店主都惹恼了。

e.en: The scheme revealed a level of {rascality} nobody expected.
e.zh: 这个阴谋暴露出一种没人料到的卑劣品性。

e.en: He laughed off the child's {rascality} as harmless mischief.
e.zh: 他把那孩子的调皮捣蛋一笑置之，认为并无大害。

e.en: The old sailor called the thief a {rascallion}.
e.zh: 老水手把那个小偷叫作无赖。

e.en: Every comedy needs a smiling {rascallion} to stir trouble.
e.zh: 每部喜剧都需要一个笑嘻嘻的无赖来搅局。

e.en: The dress used light {raschel} lace around the sleeves.
e.zh: 这条裙子的袖口用了轻薄的拉舍尔花边。

e.en: A {raschel} machine can knit nets and patterned fabrics.
e.zh: 拉舍尔经编机可以织网布和花纹织物。

e.en: The clerk tried to {rase} the mark from the page.
e.zh: 职员试图把纸页上的痕迹擦掉。

e.en: Invaders threatened to {rase} the fortress to the ground.
e.zh: 入侵者威胁要把堡垒夷为平地。

e.en: The old inscription was nearly {rased} from the stone.
e.zh: 石头上的旧铭文几乎被擦掉了。

e.en: The village was {rased} after the siege ended.
e.zh: 围城结束后，村庄被夷为平地。

e.en: The restorer carefully {rases} later paint from the icon.
e.zh: 修复师小心地刮除圣像上后涂的颜料。

e.en: War {rases} boundaries that once seemed permanent.
e.zh: 战争会抹去那些曾经看似永久的边界。

e.en: The family collected their monthly {rashan} from the shop.
e.zh: 这家人从店里领了每月的配给粮。

e.en: During the shortage, {rashan} became a word everyone used.
e.zh: 短缺时期，口粮成了人人都会说的词。

e.en: The witnesses gave {Rashomon} accounts of the crash.
e.zh: 目击者对这场车祸给出了罗生门式的不同说法。

e.en: The film uses a {Rashomon} structure to question memory.
e.zh: 这部电影采用罗生门式结构来质疑记忆的可靠性。

e.en: The old manuscript showed signs of {rasion}.
e.zh: 那份旧手稿有刮除文字的痕迹。

e.en: Careless {rasion} damaged the surface of the tablet.
e.zh: 粗心的刮除损坏了碑板表面。

e.en: The surgical assistant acted as the {rasophore} during the procedure.
e.zh: 手术助手在操作中负责携带刮削器具。

e.en: A trained {rasophore} kept the instruments ready beside the table.
e.zh: 受过训练的器械员把刮削工具放在手术台旁待用。

e.en: Chickens are typical {rasorial} birds.
e.zh: 鸡是典型的刮地觅食鸟类。

e.en: The bird's strong feet suited its {rasorial} habits.
e.zh: 这种鸟强壮的脚适合它刨地觅食的习性。

e.en: The surgeon used a {raspatory} to lift the tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生用刮骨器分离组织。

e.en: A blunt {raspatory} can damage delicate bone surfaces.
e.zh: 钝的刮骨器可能损伤脆弱的骨面。

e.en: She wore a {raspberry-red} scarf.
e.zh: 她戴着一条覆盆子红色的围巾。

e.en: The sunset turned the clouds {raspberry-red}.
e.zh: 夕阳把云彩染成了覆盆子红。

e.en: The {rasse} is a small civet found in parts of Asia.
e.zh: 麝香狸是一种分布在亚洲部分地区的小型灵猫。

e.en: A {rasse} moved quietly through the forest at night.
e.zh: 一只麝香狸夜里悄悄穿过森林。

e.en: The boys began to {rassle} in the yard.
e.zh: 男孩们开始在院子里扭打起来。

e.en: She had to {rassle} with the heavy gate.
e.zh: 她只好费力地摆弄那扇沉重的大门。

e.en: They spent the afternoon {rassling} in the grass.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在草地上摔跤玩。

e.en: He was {rassling} with a difficult decision.
e.zh: 他正为一个艰难决定反复挣扎。

e.en: The {rastaman} wore his hair in long dreadlocks.
e.zh: 那位拉斯塔法里信徒留着长长的脏辫。

e.en: A local {rastaman} spoke about music and faith.
e.zh: 一位当地的拉斯塔法里信徒谈起音乐和信仰。

e.en: The spider uses its {rastellus} to dig soil.
e.zh: 这种蜘蛛用小耙状结构挖土。

e.en: Under magnification, the {rastellus} looked like tiny teeth.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，小耙状结构看起来像细小的齿。

e.en: The image lost detail after {rasterization}.
e.zh: 图像在光栅化后丢失了一些细节。

e.en: Modern graphics cards handle {rasterization} very quickly.
e.zh: 现代显卡能非常快速地处理光栅化。

e.en: The software will {rasterize} the vector logo.
e.zh: 这个软件会把矢量标志栅格化。

e.en: You should {rasterize} the layer before applying that filter.
e.zh: 应用那个滤镜前，你应该先把图层光栅化。

e.en: The contract showed a suspicious {rasure} near the date.
e.zh: 合同日期附近有一处可疑的删改痕迹。

e.en: The editor marked every {rasure} in the draft.
e.zh: 编辑标出了草稿中的每一处擦除痕迹。

e.en: A {rat-a-tat} sounded at the door.
e.zh: 门上传来一阵急促的敲击声。

e.en: The drummer played a sharp {rat-a-tat}.
e.zh: 鼓手敲出一串清脆急促的鼓点。

e.en: He came home completely {rat-arsed}.
e.zh: 他回家时已经醉得不成样子。

e.en: They were too {rat-arsed} to find a taxi.
e.zh: 他们醉得太厉害，连出租车都找不到。

e.en: The village hired a {rat-catcher} after the harvest.
e.zh: 收割后，村里雇了一名捕鼠人。

e.en: An old {rat-catcher} stood in the corner of the shed.
e.zh: 棚屋角落里放着一个旧捕鼠器。

e.en: The cartoon villain had a narrow {rat-face}.
e.zh: 那个卡通反派长着一张又窄又尖的鼠脸。

e.en: He disliked being called {rat-face} at school.
e.zh: 他讨厌在学校里被人叫作鼠脸。

e.en: The campaign tried to {rat-fuck} its rival with false rumors.
e.zh: 竞选团队试图用假传闻暗中整垮对手。

e.en: That whole investigation became a political {rat-fuck}.
e.zh: 那整场调查变成了一次政治上的肮脏破坏。

e.en: A mouse vanished into a {rat-hole} behind the stove.
e.zh: 一只老鼠钻进炉子后面的鼠洞里不见了。

e.en: He rented a damp {rat-hole} near the station.
e.zh: 他在车站附近租了一间潮湿肮脏的小屋。

e.en: She left the {rat-race} to start a farm.
e.zh: 她离开激烈的职场竞争，去经营农场。

e.en: The city job felt like an endless {rat-race}.
e.zh: 那份城市工作让人觉得像无休止的谋生竞争。

e.en: Drivers use this street as a {rat-run} during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时司机把这条街当作避堵捷径。

e.en: Residents want traffic calming to stop the {rat-run}.
e.zh: 居民希望设置减速措施，阻止车辆抄小路穿行。

e.en: A sharp {rat-tat} sounded at the door.
e.zh: 门上传来一阵清脆的嗒嗒敲击声。

e.en: The drummer played a quick {rat-tat} on the snare.
e.zh: 鼓手在小军鼓上敲出一串急促的嗒嗒声。

e.en: The agency questioned the bond's {ratability} after the audit.
e.zh: 审计之后，机构质疑这只债券是否还能被评级。

e.en: Clear criteria improve the {ratability} of each proposal.
e.zh: 明确的标准能提高每份提案的可评估性。

e.en: The service is {ratable} on a five-star scale.
e.zh: 这项服务可以按五星制评分。

e.en: The council listed the warehouse as {ratable} property.
e.zh: 市政会把这座仓库列为应纳税房产。

e.en: The costs were divided {ratably} among the partners.
e.zh: 费用按比例分摊给各合伙人。

e.en: The improvements can be measured {ratably} over time.
e.zh: 这些改进可以随着时间逐步量化评估。

e.en: She served tea with a plate of {ratafee}.
e.zh: 她端上茶，还配了一盘淡杏仁味小饼干。

e.en: The old recipe calls for crushed almonds in the {ratafee}.
e.zh: 这份老食谱要求在杏仁小饼干里加入碎杏仁。

e.en: They drank a small glass of {ratafia} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们喝了一小杯果仁甜酒。

e.en: The baker packed crisp {ratafia} biscuits in a tin.
e.zh: 面包师把酥脆的杏仁小饼装进铁盒里。

e.en: The merchant weighed the spice by the {ratal}.
e.zh: 商人按古代重量单位拉塔尔称量香料。

e.en: A {ratal} varied from region to region.
e.zh: 拉塔尔这个重量单位在不同地区数值不一。

e.en: The parade began with a loud {rataplan} of drums.
e.zh: 游行在一阵响亮急促的鼓声中开始。

e.en: Rain made a steady {rataplan} on the tin roof.
e.zh: 雨点在铁皮屋顶上敲出连续不断的嗒嗒声。

e.en: That old {ratbag} shouted at the kids again.
e.zh: 那个讨厌的老家伙又冲孩子们嚷嚷了。

e.en: Despite his {ratbag} image, he was generous to friends.
e.zh: 尽管他看起来像个怪人，对朋友却很慷慨。

e.en: The meeting collapsed into pure {ratbaggery}.
e.zh: 会议最后完全变成了一场胡闹。

e.en: Voters were tired of the senator's theatrical {ratbaggery}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了那位参议员作秀式的讨厌作风。

e.en: The doctor cleaned the {ratbite} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细清洗了那处鼠咬伤。

e.en: A neglected {ratbite} can become infected.
e.zh: 鼠咬伤如果不处理，可能会感染。

e.en: The worn {ratch} made the winch slip.
e.zh: 磨损的棘轮齿让绞盘打滑了。

e.en: They went to {ratch} through the shed for old tools.
e.zh: 他们去棚屋里翻找旧工具。

e.en: The lane was surfaced with loose {ratchel}.
e.zh: 小路表面铺着松散的粗砾石。

e.en: His boots crunched over the {ratchel} by the gate.
e.zh: 他的靴子踩过门边的碎石，发出嘎吱声。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {ratching} in the attic.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在阁楼里翻找东西。

e.en: The {ratching} sound came from the old mechanism.
e.zh: 那阵棘轮般的咔嗒声来自旧机械装置。

e.en: The analyst assessed the loan's {rateability}.
e.zh: 分析师评估了这笔贷款的可评级性。

e.en: The dispute concerned the building's {rateability}.
e.zh: 争议涉及这栋建筑是否应缴纳地方税。

e.en: His coat was made of heavy {rateen}.
e.zh: 他的外套是用厚重的粗斜纹呢做的。

e.en: The museum displayed a faded {rateen} uniform.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一套褪色的粗呢制服。

e.en: The {ratel} is known for its fierce defence.
e.zh: 蜜獾以防卫凶猛著称。

e.en: A {ratel} raided the beehive at night.
e.zh: 一只蜜獾在夜里袭击了蜂箱。

e.en: The technician replaced the faulty {ratemeter}.
e.zh: 技术员更换了有故障的费率计。

e.en: A {ratemeter} recorded the flow through the pipe.
e.zh: 流量计记录了管道中的流速。

e.en: Only {ratepaying} residents could vote in that election.
e.zh: 那次选举只有缴纳地方税的居民才能投票。

e.en: The council consulted local {ratepaying} businesses.
e.zh: 市政会征询了当地纳税商户的意见。

e.en: He called the informant a dirty {ratfink}.
e.zh: 他骂那个告密者是卑鄙小人。

e.en: Nobody trusted the {ratfink} after he betrayed them.
e.zh: 他出卖大家之后，没人再信任这个告密者。

e.en: The diver spotted a pale {ratfish} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近看到一条浅色鼠鱼。

e.en: A {ratfish} has a long tail and large eyes.
e.zh: 鼠鱼有长长的尾巴和很大的眼睛。

e.en: The sailors fitted a {ratguard} to the mooring rope.
e.zh: 水手在系泊绳上装了防鼠挡板。

e.en: A metal {ratguard} stopped pests from boarding the ship.
e.zh: 金属防鼠挡板阻止害物爬上船。

e.en: The archaeologists mapped the ancient {rath}.
e.zh: 考古学家绘制了那座古爱尔兰环形土堡的地图。

e.en: A grassy {rath} still rises above the fields.
e.zh: 一座长满草的环形土堡仍矗立在田野上。

e.en: The festival procession pulled a decorated {ratha}.
e.zh: 节日游行队伍拉着一辆装饰华丽的印度礼车。

e.en: A carved {ratha} stood beside the temple entrance.
e.zh: 一辆雕刻精美的神庙战车立在寺庙入口旁。

e.en: The {rathe} blossoms opened before the frost had gone.
e.zh: 早开的花在霜还未尽时就绽放了。

e.en: He made a {rathe} reply and left the hall.
e.zh: 他迅速答了一句便离开了大厅。

e.en: The {ratheripe} fruit split on the branch.
e.zh: 早熟的果子在枝头裂开了。

e.en: Critics called the young poet's style {ratheripe}.
e.zh: 评论家说这位年轻诗人的风格过早成熟。

e.en: Her answer had a {ratherish} tone of doubt.
e.zh: 她的回答带着一种颇有些怀疑的语气。

e.en: The adjective feels {ratherish} in this old sentence.
e.zh: 这个形容词在这句旧文里显得有点像rather的用法。

e.en: The farmer prized the {rathripe} apples for market.
e.zh: 农夫看重这些早熟苹果，准备拿去上市。

e.en: His {rathripe} judgment surprised the older lawyers.
e.zh: 他过早成熟的判断力让年长律师们吃惊。

e.en: We met in a crowded {rathskeller} near campus.
e.zh: 我们在校园附近一家拥挤的地下啤酒馆见面。

e.en: The old hotel kept a cool {rathskeller} below the lobby.
e.zh: 那家老酒店在大厅下方保留着一间凉爽的地下餐馆。

e.en: The cellar was treated with {raticide} after the infestation.
e.zh: 鼠患之后，地窖用了灭鼠剂处理。

e.en: The report criticized careless {raticide} near the river.
e.zh: 报告批评了河边草率的灭鼠行为。

e.en: The coat was made of heavy {ratine}.
e.zh: 这件外套是用厚重的拉廷呢做的。

e.en: She chose {ratine} for its rough, warm texture.
e.zh: 她选择粗绒织物，因为它质地粗实又保暖。

e.en: Detectives must {ratiocinate} from small clues.
e.zh: 侦探必须根据细小线索进行推理。

e.en: He preferred to {ratiocinate} calmly before answering.
e.zh: 他喜欢先冷静地逻辑思考再作答。

e.en: She {ratiocinated} her way through the puzzle.
e.zh: 她通过推理一步步解开了谜题。

e.en: The philosopher {ratiocinated} before accepting the claim.
e.zh: 那位哲学家经过逻辑思考后才接受这个说法。

e.en: The narrator {ratiocinates} like a trained lawyer.
e.zh: 叙述者像训练有素的律师一样进行推理。

e.en: Whenever he panics, she {ratiocinates} for both of them.
e.zh: 每当他慌乱时，她就替两个人冷静思考。

e.en: He sat alone, {ratiocinating} over the strange letter.
e.zh: 他独自坐着，对那封怪信反复推理。

e.en: Her {ratiocinating} mind resisted easy explanations.
e.zh: 她善于逻辑思辨的头脑不接受轻率解释。

e.en: The essay has a dry, {ratiocinative} style.
e.zh: 这篇文章带有干巴巴的推理风格。

e.en: His {ratiocinative} habits made him a patient judge.
e.zh: 他的逻辑思考习惯使他成为一名耐心的法官。

e.en: Poe's detective is a brilliant {ratiocinator}.
e.zh: 坡笔下的侦探是一位杰出的推理者。

e.en: As a {ratiocinator}, she distrusted sudden intuition.
e.zh: 作为善于逻辑思考的人，她不太相信突发直觉。

e.en: Grandma kept her wartime {ration-book} in a drawer.
e.zh: 祖母把战时的配给本保存在抽屉里。

e.en: Without a {ration-book}, families could not buy sugar.
e.zh: 没有定量供应簿，家庭就买不到糖。

rationalistical.t: 理性主义的；过分理性的

e.en: The sermon attacked a {rationalistical} view of faith.
e.zh: 那篇布道抨击了一种理性主义的信仰观。

e.en: His {rationalistical} tone made the poem feel cold.
e.zh: 他过分理性的语气让这首诗显得冷冰冰。

rationalistically.t: 以理性主义方式；过分理性地

e.en: She interpreted the myth {rationalistically}, ignoring its ritual force.
e.zh: 她以理性主义方式解读神话，忽略了其仪式力量。

e.en: He spoke {rationalistically} about grief and sounded distant.
e.zh: 他过分理性地谈论悲伤，听起来很疏离。

e.en: An ostrich is a large {ratite}.
e.zh: 鸵鸟是一种大型平胸鸟。

e.en: The museum displayed {ratite} bones from New Zealand.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自新西兰的平胸鸟骨骼。

e.en: A {ratlike} face peered through the bars.
e.zh: 一张像老鼠似的脸从栏杆后窥视。

e.en: He moved with a quick, {ratlike} caution.
e.zh: 他动作很快，带着老鼠般鬼祟的谨慎。

e.en: The sailor gripped a wet {ratlin} while climbing.
e.zh: 水手攀爬时抓住一根湿滑的帆船横索。

e.en: A broken {ratlin} made the mast dangerous.
e.zh: 一根断裂的绳梯横索让桅杆变得危险。

e.en: The crew replaced a frayed {ratline} before sailing.
e.zh: 船员在出航前更换了一根磨损的横索。

e.en: The fugitive escaped along a secret {ratline}.
e.zh: 逃亡者沿着一条秘密逃亡路线逃走了。

e.en: The old ship's {ratlines} were stiff with salt.
e.zh: 那艘旧船的横索被盐分弄得发硬。

e.en: Investigators traced the smugglers' {ratlines} across Europe.
e.zh: 调查人员追踪了走私者横跨欧洲的逃亡路线。

ravehook.t: 带倒刺的钩子；挂钩器具

e.en: The old carpenter lifted the chain with a {ravehook}.
e.zh: 老木匠用带倒刺的钩子把链条提起来。

e.en: A rusty {ravehook} hung beside the stable door.
e.zh: 马厩门旁挂着一个生锈的挂钩器具。

e.en: The soldiers sheltered behind the {ravelin} before dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们黎明前躲在三角堡后面。

e.en: A deep ditch separated the {ravelin} from the main wall.
e.zh: 一道深沟把半月堡和主城墙隔开。

e.en: She found a {ravelment} of threads in the drawer.
e.zh: 她在抽屉里发现一团缠结的线。

e.en: The dispute became a {ravelment} of old promises and debts.
e.zh: 这场争端变成了旧承诺和债务交织的混乱局面。

e.en: A {raven-haired} woman waited by the window.
e.zh: 一位乌发女子在窗边等候。

e.en: The portrait shows a {raven-haired} child in a blue coat.
e.zh: 这幅肖像画中是一个穿蓝外套的黑发孩子。

e.en: The painter mixed a {ravidous} shade for the winter sky.
e.zh: 画家调出一种灰白色来表现冬日天空。

e.en: His face looked {ravidous} under the weak lantern light.
e.zh: 在昏暗的灯光下，他的脸显得发灰。

e.en: The hawk's {ravin} left only feathers in the grass.
e.zh: 鹰的猎食过后，草地上只剩羽毛。

e.en: The poet condemned the {ravin} of greedy conquerors.
e.zh: 诗人谴责贪婪征服者的掠夺。

e.en: Heavy rain caused serious {ravinement} on the hillside.
e.zh: 暴雨使山坡出现严重沟蚀。

e.en: The engineer studied {ravinement} along the new road.
e.zh: 工程师研究新路沿线的冲沟形成情况。

e.en: The music filled her with sudden {ravishment}.
e.zh: 音乐让她突然充满狂喜。

e.en: The old legal text used {ravishment} for violent abduction.
e.zh: 那部旧法律文本用ravishment指暴力劫持。

raw-boned.t: 骨架粗大的；瘦骨嶙峋的

e.en: A {raw-boned} farmer opened the gate for us.
e.zh: 一个骨架粗大的农夫给我们开了门。

e.en: The horse looked {raw-boned} after the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长冬天过后，那匹马显得瘦骨嶙峋。

rawhead.t: 吓唬小孩的怪物；血头鬼

e.en: Grandmother warned the children that {rawhead} waited in the dark.
e.zh: 祖母吓唬孩子说血头鬼在黑暗中等着。

e.en: The tale of {rawhead} appears in old nursery warnings.
e.zh: 血头鬼的故事出现在旧时吓唬儿童的告诫里。

e.en: The mill's {rawheel} clicked steadily through the night.
e.zh: 磨坊的旧式棘轮整夜有节奏地咔嗒作响。

e.en: He replaced the broken {rawheel} in the machine.
e.zh: 他更换了机器里坏掉的齿轮装置。

e.en: The weather team launched a {rawinsonde} before sunrise.
e.zh: 气象小组在日出前发射了一台无线电探空仪。

e.en: Data from the {rawinsonde} helped predict the storm path.
e.zh: 无线电探空仪的数据帮助预测了风暴路径。

e.en: The steak was still {rawish} in the middle.
e.zh: 这块牛排中间还是有点生。

e.en: His first draft felt {rawish} but honest.
e.zh: 他的初稿略显粗糙，但很真诚。

e.en: The archive mentions a {raya} who paid taxes to the empire.
e.zh: 档案提到一名向帝国纳税的非穆斯林臣民。

e.en: Historians use {raya} when discussing Ottoman social classes.
e.zh: 历史学家讨论奥斯曼社会阶层时会使用raya一词。

e.en: A {rayah} could be protected yet heavily taxed.
e.zh: 一名非穆斯林臣民可能受到保护，但也被课以重税。

e.en: The term {rayah} appears in older histories of the empire.
e.zh: rayah这个词出现在较早的帝国史著作中。

e.en: The surveyor checked the distance with a {raydist}.
e.zh: 测量员用射线距离测量仪核对距离。

e.en: An early {raydist} made the fieldwork faster.
e.zh: 早期的射线距离测量仪让野外作业更快。

e.en: She chose a {raye} silk for the waistcoat.
e.zh: 她选了一块条纹丝绸来做背心。

e.en: The catalog described the old fabric as {raye}.
e.zh: 目录把那块旧布料描述为有条纹的。

e.en: The material measured one {rayl} in acoustic impedance.
e.zh: 这种材料的声阻抗测得为一瑞利。

e.en: Engineers still use the {rayl} in specialized acoustics papers.
e.zh: 工程师在专业声学论文中仍会使用瑞利这个单位。

e.en: The cave felt {rayless} after the torch went out.
e.zh: 火把熄灭后，洞穴里一片无光。

e.en: A {rayless} sky pressed heavily over the town.
e.zh: 无光的天空沉沉压在小镇上方。

e.en: The exhibition included several works of Russian {rayonism}.
e.zh: 展览中有几件俄罗斯光线主义作品。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {rayonism} and early abstraction.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是光线主义与早期抽象艺术。

e.en: The chapel shows a delicate {rayonnant} window design.
e.zh: 这座小教堂展现了精致的辐射式窗饰设计。

e.en: Art historians classify the facade as {rayonnant} Gothic.
e.zh: 艺术史学家把这面外墙归为辐射式哥特风格。

e.en: The old warship became a {razee} after major alterations.
e.zh: 那艘旧战舰经过大改后成了削低甲板的船。

e.en: A {razee} could be faster than its original design.
e.zh: 改削船可能比原来的设计航速更快。

e.en: The navy considered {razeeing} several aging ships.
e.zh: 海军考虑把几艘老船削低改装。

e.en: Careless {razeeing} could weaken the vessel's structure.
e.zh: 草率改削可能削弱船体结构。

e.en: He left town without a {razoo} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他离开镇上时口袋里一分钱也没有。

e.en: I would not pay a {razoo} for that broken radio.
e.zh: 那台坏收音机我一分钱也不会出。

razor-backed.t: 背脊尖窄的；脊背如刀的

e.en: The {razor-backed} ridge was difficult to cross in winter.
e.zh: 那道刀脊般的山 ridge 冬天很难翻越。

e.en: A {razor-backed} hog appeared near the fence.
e.zh: 一头背脊尖窄的猪出现在篱笆旁。

e.en: He replaced the {razor-blade} before shaving.
e.zh: 他刮胡子前换了剃须刀片。

e.en: The paper cut felt like a tiny {razor-blade}.
e.zh: 那道纸割伤感觉像被小刀片划了一下。

e.en: The knife had a polished {razor-edge}.
e.zh: 这把刀有一条磨亮的锋利刀口。

e.en: The election was decided by a {razor-edge} margin.
e.zh: 这场选举以极其微小的差距分出胜负。

e.en: We found {razor-fish} shells along the wet sand.
e.zh: 我们在潮湿的沙滩上发现了竹蛏壳。

e.en: The chef steamed the {razor-fish} with garlic.
e.zh: 厨师用蒜蓉清蒸了这些竹蛏。

e.en: The chef keeps every knife {razor-sharp}.
e.zh: 厨师把每把刀都保持得极其锋利。

e.en: Her {razor-sharp} wit impressed the audience.
e.zh: 她敏锐犀利的机智给观众留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Police arrested the {razor-slasher} after another attack.
e.zh: 又一次袭击后，警方逮捕了那名持剃刀伤人者。

e.en: The tabloids called the suspect a {razor-slasher}.
e.zh: 小报把嫌疑人称作持剃刀行凶者。

e.en: The company operates on {razor-thin} profit margins.
e.zh: 这家公司靠极微薄的利润率经营。

e.en: She sliced the onions into {razor-thin} rings.
e.zh: 她把洋葱切成极薄的圆片。

e.en: The barber said the beard was barely {razorable} yet.
e.zh: 理发师说这胡子还几乎没到能剃的程度。

e.en: Use warm water to make the stubble more {razorable}.
e.zh: 用温水能让胡茬更容易刮。

e.en: A loose {razorblade} was lying in the drawer.
e.zh: 抽屉里放着一片散落的剃须刀片。

e.en: The critic had a {razorblade} style of humor.
e.zh: 那位评论家的幽默风格像刀片一样尖刻。

e.en: He sharpened the blade on a leather {razorstrop}.
e.zh: 他在皮制剃刀磨革上磨利刀刃。

e.en: The old barber kept a {razorstrop} beside the chair.
e.zh: 老理发师把磨刀皮带放在椅子旁边。

e.en: The barn cat carried a tiny {ratling} outside.
e.zh: 那只谷仓猫把一只小老鼠叼到了外面。

e.en: A {ratling} squeaked beneath the old floorboards.
e.zh: 一只幼鼠在旧地板下面吱吱叫。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {ratlins} in the gear.
e.zh: 机械师更换了齿轮里磨损的小齿爪。

e.en: Old clockmakers kept spare {ratlins} in labeled drawers.
e.zh: 老钟表匠把备用棘轮止回爪放在贴好标签的抽屉里。

e.en: The artist drew a {ratomorphic} monster for the game.
e.zh: 画师为游戏画了一个像老鼠形态的怪物。

e.en: The fossil skull had a strangely {ratomorphic} outline.
e.zh: 那块头骨化石有一种奇怪的鼠形轮廓。

ratoon.t: 宿根再生作物；留茬再生

e.en: The farmer harvested the sugarcane {ratoon} in spring.
e.zh: 农民在春天收割了甘蔗宿根再生作物。

e.en: They allowed the field to {ratoon} after cutting the cane.
e.zh: 他们割完甘蔗后让田地留茬再生。

e.en: The pamphlet called him a fierce {rator} of corruption.
e.zh: 那本小册子称他是严厉批评腐败的人。

e.en: A public {rator} stood outside the hall denouncing the policy.
e.zh: 一名公开斥责者站在大厅外谴责这项政策。

e.en: They built a {ratproof} storehouse for the grain.
e.zh: 他们为粮食建了一座防鼠仓库。

e.en: The crew worked to {ratproof} the ship's pantry.
e.zh: 船员们设法让船上的食品储藏室防鼠。

e.en: After ten years as a {ratracer}, she left finance.
e.zh: 在激烈职场竞争中忙了十年后，她离开了金融业。

e.en: The novel follows a tired {ratracer} in Manhattan.
e.zh: 这部小说写的是曼哈顿一个疲惫的职场拼命人。

e.en: The apothecary kept {ratsbane} on a high shelf.
e.zh: 药剂师把灭鼠药放在高高的架子上。

e.en: Old murder stories often mention {ratsbane} as a poison.
e.zh: 旧式谋杀故事常把毒鼠剂当作毒药提到。

e.en: The dog looked ill, as if {ratsbaned} by accident.
e.zh: 那条狗看起来病恹恹的，像是不小心被灭鼠药毒到了。

e.en: A {ratsbaned} fox was found near the shed.
e.zh: 有人在棚屋附近发现了一只被毒鼠剂毒死的狐狸。

e.en: He wore a thin {rattail} down his neck.
e.zh: 他脖子后面留着一条细长的鼠尾辫。

e.en: The plant has {rattail} stems that trail over the pot.
e.zh: 这种植物有鼠尾状的细长茎，垂在花盆边上。

e.en: A sharp {rattat} sounded on the front door.
e.zh: 前门响起一阵清脆的嗒嗒敲门声。

e.en: We heard the {rattat} of drums from the parade.
e.zh: 我们听见游行队伍传来的嗒嗒鼓声。

e.en: The sailor wore a coat of heavy {ratteen}.
e.zh: 那个水手穿着一件厚粗呢外套。

e.en: Merchants once sold {ratteen} for winter garments.
e.zh: 商人从前出售粗呢布，用来做冬衣。

e.en: The mill specialized in {ratteening} coarse wool cloth.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门给粗毛织布做起绒整理。

e.en: After {ratteening}, the fabric felt warmer and thicker.
e.zh: 经过制成粗呢的处理后，布料摸起来更暖更厚。

ratten.t: 破坏工具报复；偷走工具

e.en: The union men threatened to {ratten} the scab's tools.
e.zh: 工会成员威胁要偷走那名顶替工人的工具以示报复。

e.en: Police investigated a case of {ratten} at the workshop.
e.zh: 警方调查了车间里一起破坏并偷走工具的报复事件。

e.en: The farm kept two quick {ratters} in the stable.
e.zh: 农场在马厩里养了两只敏捷的捕鼠犬。

e.en: Professional {ratters} were hired to clear the warehouse.
e.zh: 仓库请来了专业捕鼠者进行清理。

e.en: This motel is {rattier} than the one downtown.
e.zh: 这家汽车旅馆比市中心那家更破旧。

e.en: His smile looked even {rattier} in the dim light.
e.zh: 在昏暗灯光下，他的笑容显得更像老鼠般鬼祟。

e.en: They chose the {rattiest} sofa for the garage.
e.zh: 他们把最破旧的沙发选来放在车库里。

e.en: The villain had the {rattiest} little eyes.
e.zh: 那个反派有一双最像老鼠般的小眼睛。

e.en: The curtains hung {rattily} from bent metal hooks.
e.zh: 窗帘破旧地挂在弯曲的金属钩上。

e.en: He glanced {rattily} around the empty room.
e.zh: 他像老鼠般鬼祟地扫视着空房间。

e.en: The room's {rattiness} made the rent seem too high.
e.zh: 房间的破旧让人觉得租金太高。

e.en: There was a certain {rattiness} in his nervous grin.
e.zh: 他紧张的笑容里有几分鼠样的鬼祟。

e.en: A {rattish} face peered through the cracked window.
e.zh: 一张像老鼠的脸从破窗里窥视出来。

e.en: His {rattish} behavior made the others distrust him.
e.zh: 他那种卑怯鬼祟的举止让别人不信任他。

rattlebladder.t: 爱空谈的人；喋喋不休者

e.en: The old {rattlebladder} bored everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 那个爱空谈的老人把晚餐上的每个人都烦坏了。

e.en: She dismissed the politician as a noisy {rattlebladder}.
e.zh: 她把那名政客斥为吵闹而喋喋不休的人。

e.en: The old sailor was a cheerful {rattlebox} at dinner.
e.zh: 那位老水手吃饭时是个爱说笑的唠叨鬼。

e.en: Everyone knew the office {rattlebox} would spread the news.
e.zh: 大家都知道办公室那个话匣子会把消息传开。

e.en: Only a {rattlebrain} would forget the tickets twice.
e.zh: 只有糊涂虫才会两次忘带票。

e.en: She called herself a {rattlebrain} after missing the obvious clue.
e.zh: 她漏掉那个明显线索后，自嘲是个糊涂人。

e.en: His {rattlebrained} plan collapsed before lunch.
e.zh: 他那个轻率的计划午饭前就破产了。

e.en: I made a {rattlebrained} mistake in the address.
e.zh: 我在地址上犯了个糊涂错误。

e.en: Don't be a {rattlehead}; check the lock first.
e.zh: 别犯傻，先检查一下锁。

e.en: The comic servant is treated as a lovable {rattlehead}.
e.zh: 那个喜剧仆人被写成一个可爱的糊涂蛋。

e.en: The {rattleheaded} clerk filed every receipt in the wrong drawer.
e.zh: 那个糊涂的职员把每张收据都放错了抽屉。

e.en: She sounded {rattleheaded} after a night without sleep.
e.zh: 一夜没睡后，她听起来有些昏头昏脑。

e.en: The village {rattlepate} mistook the scarecrow for a stranger.
e.zh: 村里的傻瓜把稻草人误认成陌生人。

e.en: He played the {rattlepate} to make the children laugh.
e.zh: 他装成糊涂虫逗孩子们笑。

e.en: That {rattlepated} excuse fooled no one.
e.zh: 那个愚蠢的借口没有骗过任何人。

e.en: The {rattlepated} hero survives by luck alone.
e.zh: 那个糊涂的主角全靠运气活下来。

e.en: The healer dried {rattleroot} for winter remedies.
e.zh: 那位草药师把响根草晒干，留作冬天用药。

e.en: Old herbals list {rattleroot} among plants for snakebite.
e.zh: 旧草药书把响根草列为治蛇咬的植物之一。

e.en: A tiny {ratton} darted behind the grain sack.
e.zh: 一只小老鼠飞快钻到粮袋后面。

e.en: The dialect word {ratton} appears in the old rural tale.
e.zh: 方言词ratton出现在那个古老的乡村故事里。

e.en: The farmer let the {rattoon} grow after cutting the cane.
e.zh: 农民砍下甘蔗后让宿根蔗继续生长。

e.en: A healthy {rattoon} can save the planter a season of work.
e.zh: 健康的再生蔗能让种植者省下一季劳作。

e.en: He set a {rattrap} beside the pantry door.
e.zh: 他在食品柜门旁放了一个捕鼠器。

e.en: That old bus is a {rattrap} on wheels.
e.zh: 那辆旧巴士简直是个会跑的破烂危险物。

e.en: The poet used {rau} language for a harsher effect.
e.zh: 诗人用了粗粝的语言来营造更刺耳的效果。

e.en: His {rau} manners shocked the polite guests.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的举止让讲礼貌的客人很震惊。

e.en: The paper measured {raubasine} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 论文测定了植物提取物中的萝芙碱含量。

e.en: Doctors once studied {raubasine} for its vascular effects.
e.zh: 医生们曾研究萝芙碱对血管的作用。

e.en: The chemist separated {raubasinine} from related alkaloids.
e.zh: 化学家把萝芙辛碱从相关生物碱中分离出来。

e.en: Few students encounter {raubasinine} outside pharmacology texts.
e.zh: 很少有学生会在药理学课本之外见到萝芙辛碱。

e.en: The {raucity} of his voice worried the singer.
e.zh: 他嗓音的沙哑让那位歌手很担心。

e.en: The critic noted the deliberate {raucity} in the recording.
e.zh: 评论家注意到录音里刻意保留的粗嘎感。

e.en: His {raughty} answer ended the friendly conversation.
e.zh: 他粗暴的回答结束了那场友好的谈话。

e.en: The lord spoke in a {raughty} tone to the servants.
e.zh: 那位贵族用傲慢的口气对仆人说话。

e.en: The film's {raunchiness} made some viewers uncomfortable.
e.zh: 这部电影的低俗露骨让一些观众感到不适。

e.en: The room's {raunchiness} was hidden by dim lighting.
e.zh: 昏暗的灯光掩盖了房间的肮脏邋遢。

e.en: The geologist identified {rauvite} in the yellow crust.
e.zh: 地质学家在黄色外壳中鉴定出钒矿物。

e.en: Samples of {rauvite} were stored in the museum cabinet.
e.zh: 铀钒矿样本被存放在博物馆的陈列柜里。

e.en: Traditional medicine used {rauwolfia} for calming remedies.
e.zh: 传统医学曾用萝芙木制作镇静药方。

e.en: The drug was derived from {rauwolfia} roots.
e.zh: 这种药物来源于萝芙木的根。

e.en: The report described the {ravagement} of coastal villages.
e.zh: 报告描述了沿海村庄遭受的严重破坏。

e.en: Years of war left clear signs of {ravagement}.
e.zh: 多年战争留下了明显的蹂躏痕迹。

e.en: The band ended with a wild {rave-up}.
e.zh: 乐队以一段狂热的即兴演奏收尾。

e.en: They organized a weekend {rave-up} in the old warehouse.
e.zh: 他们在旧仓库办了一场周末狂欢派对。

e.en: Their early shows often became chaotic {rave-ups}.
e.zh: 他们早期的演出常常变成混乱的狂热现场。

e.en: The magazine covered underground {rave-ups} across the city.
e.zh: 那本杂志报道了全城各处的地下狂欢派对。

re-allocate.t: 重新分配；重新调拨资源

e.en: The manager had to {re-allocate} staff after the deadline changed.
e.zh: 截止日期改变后，经理不得不重新分配人手。

e.en: The city will {re-allocate} funds to repair older bridges.
e.zh: 市政府将重新调拨资金，用来修复老旧桥梁。

e.en: The spell was said to {re-animate} the fallen warrior.
e.zh: 据说这个咒语能让倒下的战士复活。

e.en: New evidence helped {re-animate} interest in the cold case.
e.zh: 新的证据重新激起了人们对这桩悬案的兴趣。

e.en: The missing file may {re-appear} after the system restarts.
e.zh: 系统重启后，丢失的文件可能会再次出现。

e.en: Old tensions can {re-appear} during stressful negotiations.
e.zh: 在紧张的谈判中，旧有矛盾可能重新浮现。

re-appeared.t: 再次出现了；重新露面了

e.en: The cat {re-appeared} at the door after three days.
e.zh: 三天后，那只猫又出现在门口。

e.en: His doubts {re-appeared} when the plan became risky.
e.zh: 当计划变得有风险时，他的疑虑又冒了出来。

e.en: The warning {re-appears} whenever the program is opened.
e.zh: 每次打开程序时，这条警告都会再次出现。

e.en: That theme {re-appears} throughout her later novels.
e.zh: 那个主题在她后期小说中反复出现。

e.en: Her {re-application} was approved after she updated the documents.
e.zh: 她更新文件后，重新申请获得了批准。

e.en: The {re-application} of the coating improved the floor's durability.
e.zh: 再次涂覆保护层提高了地板的耐用性。

e.en: You can {re-apply} for the grant next year.
e.zh: 你明年可以重新申请这笔补助。

e.en: Remember to {re-apply} sunscreen after swimming.
e.zh: 游泳后记得再涂一次防晒霜。

e.en: The board voted to {re-appoint} her as chair.
e.zh: 董事会投票决定再次任命她为主席。

e.en: The president may {re-appoint} the same ministers next month.
e.zh: 总统下个月可能会重新任命同一批部长。

e.en: The committee {re-appoints} its auditor every two years.
e.zh: 委员会每两年重新任命一次审计员。

e.en: If the governor {re-appoints} him, the dispute may continue.
e.zh: 如果州长再次任命他，争议可能会继续。

e.en: The scandal forced a {re-appraisal} of his legacy.
e.zh: 这起丑闻迫使人们重新评价他的遗产。

e.en: The bank requested a {re-appraisal} of the house.
e.zh: 银行要求对这所房子重新估价。

e.en: Critics began to {re-appraise} the film years later.
e.zh: 多年后，评论家开始重新评价这部电影。

e.en: We need to {re-appraise} the property before selling it.
e.zh: 出售前，我们需要重新估价这处房产。

e.en: There is no need to {re-argue} every decision from last month.
e.zh: 没有必要把上个月的每个决定都重新争论一遍。

e.en: The lawyer asked to {re-argue} the case before the court.
e.zh: 律师请求在法庭上重新辩论此案。

re-arm.t: 重新武装；再次装备武器

e.en: The rebels tried to {re-arm} after the ceasefire collapsed.
e.zh: 停火破裂后，叛军试图重新武装。

e.en: Several countries chose to {re-arm} in response to the threat.
e.zh: 面对威胁，几个国家选择重新装备武器。

e.en: We need to {re-arrange} the meeting for Friday.
e.zh: 我们需要把会议重新安排到星期五。

e.en: She helped {re-arrange} the chairs before the concert.
e.zh: 音乐会开始前，她帮忙重新摆放椅子。

e.en: The sudden {re-arrangement} of flights confused many passengers.
e.zh: 航班突然重新安排，让许多乘客感到困惑。

e.en: A small {re-arrangement} of the furniture made the room brighter.
e.zh: 稍微重新摆放家具后，房间显得更明亮了。

e.en: She {re-arranges} her schedule whenever clients cancel.
e.zh: 每当客户取消预约时，她都会重新安排日程。

e.en: The app {re-arranges} photos by date automatically.
e.zh: 这个应用会自动按日期重新排列照片。

e.en: Police may {re-arrest} the suspect if new evidence appears.
e.zh: 如果出现新证据，警方可能再次逮捕嫌疑人。

e.en: The court order allowed officers to {re-arrest} him immediately.
e.zh: 法院命令允许警员立即重新拘捕他。

e.en: It took an hour to {re-assemble} the broken machine.
e.zh: 重新组装这台坏机器花了一个小时。

e.en: The team will {re-assemble} after the holiday break.
e.zh: 假期结束后，团队将再次集合。

e.en: The leader tried to {re-assert} control over the party.
e.zh: 这位领导人试图重新掌控该党。

e.en: She paused, then chose to {re-assert} her earlier claim.
e.zh: 她停顿了一下，然后选择重申先前的说法。

e.en: He {re-asserted} his innocence during the interview.
e.zh: 他在采访中重申自己无罪。

e.en: The company {re-asserted} its position in the market.
e.zh: 公司重新确立了自己在市场中的地位。

e.en: The report {re-asserts} the need for stronger rules.
e.zh: 这份报告重申了制定更严格规则的必要性。

e.en: The ruling {re-asserts} Parliament's authority over spending.
e.zh: 这项裁决重新确立了议会对支出的权威。

e.en: We should {re-assess} the budget before hiring more staff.
e.zh: 在招聘更多员工之前，我们应该重新评估预算。

e.en: The injury forced him to {re-assess} his career plans.
e.zh: 这次受伤迫使他重新考虑自己的职业规划。

e.en: The school may {re-assign} teachers to different classes.
e.zh: 学校可能会把教师重新分配到不同班级。

e.en: They decided to {re-assign} the case to another officer.
e.zh: 他们决定把这个案件改派给另一名警官。

e.en: He plans to {re-assume} his duties next week.
e.zh: 他计划下周重新履行职责。

e.en: The monarch tried to {re-assume} power after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后，君主试图重新掌权。

e.en: She {re-assumes} control whenever negotiations break down.
e.zh: 每当谈判破裂时，她都会重新接管控制权。

e.en: The vice president {re-assumes} office after the appeal succeeds.
e.zh: 上诉成功后，副总统重新就任。

e.en: The doctor tried to {re-assure} the anxious patient.
e.zh: 医生试图再次安抚那位焦虑的病人。

e.en: Please {re-assure} them that the payment is safe.
e.zh: 请再次向他们保证这笔付款是安全的。

e.en: You need to {re-attach} the cable before restarting.
e.zh: 重启前你需要把电缆重新接上。

e.en: She used glue to {re-attach} the broken handle.
e.zh: 她用胶水把断掉的把手重新粘上。

e.en: The song seemed to {re-awaken} old memories.
e.zh: 这首歌似乎重新唤起了旧日回忆。

e.en: The crisis may {re-awaken} interest in local farming.
e.zh: 这场危机可能重新激起人们对本地农业的兴趣。

e.en: Spring {re-awakens} the garden after winter.
e.zh: 春天让花园在冬天之后重新苏醒。

e.en: His speech {re-awakens} a sense of national pride.
e.zh: 他的演讲重新激起了民族自豪感。

e.en: The computer {re-boots} automatically after the update.
e.zh: 更新后电脑会自动重新启动。

e.en: The studio {re-boots} the series with a younger cast.
e.zh: 制片厂用更年轻的演员阵容重启了这个系列。

e.en: The mechanic had to {re-bore} the engine cylinder.
e.zh: 机械师不得不重新镗削发动机气缸。

e.en: They will {re-bore} the tunnel to improve drainage.
e.zh: 他们将重新钻开隧道以改善排水。

e.en: They plan to {re-build} the school after the fire.
e.zh: 他们计划在火灾后重建这所学校。

e.en: It took years to {re-build} public trust.
e.zh: 重新建立公众信任花了多年时间。

e.en: I had to {re-buy} the book after losing it.
e.zh: 把书弄丢后，我只好重新买一本。

e.en: Many customers {re-buy} the product every month.
e.zh: 许多顾客每个月都会再次购买这款产品。

e.en: The app will {re-calculate} the route if you turn.
e.zh: 如果你转弯，应用会重新计算路线。

e.en: We must {re-calculate} the costs after the delay.
e.zh: 延误之后，我们必须重新核算成本。

e.en: The software {re-calculates} the total automatically.
e.zh: 软件会自动重新计算总数。

e.en: She {re-calculates} the budget whenever prices change.
e.zh: 每当价格变化时，她都会重新核算预算。

e.en: Let me {re-cap} the main points quickly.
e.zh: 让我快速概括回顾一下要点。

e.en: Please {re-cap} the bottle after using it.
e.zh: 用完之后请把瓶盖重新盖上。

e.en: The bank needed investors to {re-capitalize} it.
e.zh: 这家银行需要投资者为其重新注资。

e.en: Officials moved to {re-capitalize} the failing company.
e.zh: 官员采取行动为这家濒危公司补充资本。

re-capped.t: 已概括回顾；重新盖上了

e.en: She {re-capped} the meeting in a short email.
e.zh: 她在一封简短邮件中回顾了会议内容。

e.en: He {re-capped} the pen before putting it away.
e.zh: 他把笔收起来前重新盖上了笔帽。

e.en: The army tried to {re-capture} the town.
e.zh: 军队试图重新夺回那座城镇。

e.en: The film fails to {re-capture} the original magic.
e.zh: 这部电影未能重现原作的魅力。

re-cast.t: 重新塑造；重新分配角色

e.en: The director decided to {re-cast} the lead role.
e.zh: 导演决定重新选派主角演员。

e.en: The report {re-cast} the problem as a social issue.
e.zh: 报告把这个问题重新界定为社会议题。

e.en: She tried to {re-channel} her anger into exercise.
e.zh: 她试图把愤怒重新引导到运动中。

e.en: The company will {re-channel} funds toward research.
e.zh: 公司将把资金重新投入研究方向。

e.en: The program {re-channels} donations to local clinics.
e.zh: 该项目把捐款重新转给当地诊所。

e.en: He {re-channels} stress into careful planning.
e.zh: 他把压力重新转化为细致的计划。

e.en: I need to {re-charge} my phone tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚需要给手机重新充电。

e.en: A quiet weekend helped her {re-charge}.
e.zh: 一个安静的周末帮助她恢复了精力。

e.en: Please {re-check} the address before sending it.
e.zh: 发送前请再次核对地址。

e.en: The nurse will {re-check} your blood pressure soon.
e.zh: 护士很快会重新检查你的血压。

re-checked.t: 重新检查过；再次核对过

e.en: I {re-checked} the figures and found no mistake.
e.zh: 我重新核对了数字，没有发现错误。

e.en: The guard {re-checked} our tickets at the gate.
e.zh: 门口的警卫再次检查了我们的票。

re-christen.t: 重新命名；重新施洗命名

e.en: They decided to {re-christen} the pub after renovation.
e.zh: 翻新后他们决定给这家酒吧重新命名。

e.en: The press quickly {re-christen} the policy a disaster.
e.zh: 媒体很快把这项政策重新称作一场灾难。

e.en: The system can {re-circulate} warm air through the room.
e.zh: 这个系统可以让暖空气在房间里重新循环。

e.en: Please {re-circulate} the memo to the whole team.
e.zh: 请把这份备忘录再次传阅给整个团队。

e.en: The pump {re-circulates} water through the filter.
e.zh: 水泵让水通过过滤器重新循环。

e.en: She {re-circulates} the proposal after each revision.
e.zh: 每次修改后，她都会再次传阅这份提案。

re-claim.t: 重新夺回； reclaim回收开垦

e.en: The group hopes to {re-claim} the empty building.
e.zh: 该团体希望重新夺回那栋空楼的使用权。

e.en: Farmers worked to {re-claim} land from the marsh.
e.zh: 农民努力从沼泽中开垦土地。

e.en: The museum will {re-classify} several ancient objects.
e.zh: 博物馆将重新分类几件古代文物。

e.en: Officials may {re-classify} the document as confidential.
e.zh: 官员可能会把这份文件重新列为机密。

e.en: We need to {re-coat} the deck before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前我们需要给露台重新涂上一层。

e.en: The factory will {re-coat} the metal parts after cleaning.
e.zh: 清洗后，工厂会给这些金属部件重新覆上一层涂层。

e.en: The developer had to {re-code} the login page.
e.zh: 开发人员不得不重新编写登录页面的代码。

e.en: Researchers will {re-code} the survey answers into broader categories.
e.zh: 研究人员会把问卷答案重新编码到更大的类别中。

e.en: Please {re-coil} the cable after using it.
e.zh: 用完后请把电缆重新卷起来。

e.en: The snake seemed to {re-coil} before striking again.
e.zh: 那条蛇似乎又盘起身子，准备再次攻击。

re-coiled.t: 重新卷起的；再次盘绕了

e.en: She {re-coiled} the hose neatly beside the wall.
e.zh: 她把软管整齐地重新卷好，放在墙边。

e.en: The spring was {re-coiled} after the repair.
e.zh: 维修后，弹簧被重新盘绕好了。

e.en: The team will {re-collect} the samples tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 团队明天早上会重新收集这些样本。

e.en: You may need to {re-collect} your ticket at the counter.
e.zh: 你可能需要到柜台重新领取票。

e.en: The lab ordered a {re-collection} of the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室要求重新采集这份血样。

e.en: A {re-collection} fee applies if the parcel is returned.
e.zh: 如果包裹被退回，再次收取时会产生费用。

e.en: You can {re-combine} the files after downloading them.
e.zh: 下载后你可以把这些文件重新合并。

e.en: The artist likes to {re-combine} old images in new ways.
e.zh: 这位艺术家喜欢用新的方式重新组合旧图像。

e.en: Work will {re-commence} once the storm passes.
e.zh: 暴风雨过去后，工作将重新开始。

e.en: The hearing is expected to {re-commence} next week.
e.zh: 听证会预计下周重新开始。

e.en: The course {re-commences} after the holiday break.
e.zh: 假期结束后，课程重新开始。

e.en: Production {re-commences} when safety checks are complete.
e.zh: 安全检查完成后，生产会重新启动。

re-compile.t: 重新编译；重新汇编资料

e.en: You must {re-compile} the program after changing the code.
e.zh: 修改代码后，你必须重新编译这个程序。

e.en: The editor will {re-compile} the report with updated figures.
e.zh: 编辑会用更新后的数据重新汇编这份报告。

e.en: The system will {re-compute} the route automatically.
e.zh: 系统会自动重新计算路线。

e.en: We had to {re-compute} the totals after finding an error.
e.zh: 发现错误后，我们不得不重新计算总数。

e.en: You may need to {re-configure} the router.
e.zh: 你可能需要重新配置路由器。

e.en: The office was {re-configured} to fit more desks.
e.zh: 办公室被重新布置，以便放下更多桌子。

e.en: Please {re-confirm} your appointment by email.
e.zh: 请通过电子邮件再次确认你的预约。

e.en: The test results {re-confirm} the earlier diagnosis.
e.zh: 检测结果再次确认了先前的诊断。

e.en: This message {re-confirms} your booking details.
e.zh: 这条消息再次确认了你的预订详情。

e.en: The new evidence {re-confirms} their original theory.
e.zh: 新的证据再次证实了他们最初的理论。

e.en: Try to {re-connect} the printer to the network.
e.zh: 试着把打印机重新连接到网络。

e.en: She wanted to {re-connect} with old classmates.
e.zh: 她想和老同学重新联系起来。

e.en: Please {re-consider} our proposal before making a decision.
e.zh: 做决定前，请重新考虑我们的提议。

e.en: The court agreed to {re-consider} the case.
e.zh: 法院同意重新审议此案。

e.en: The committee will {re-constitute} itself after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，委员会将重新组成。

e.en: Add water to {re-constitute} the dried soup mix.
e.zh: 加入水即可把干汤料复原。

e.en: The museum displays several {re-constructions} of ancient tools.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件古代工具的复原品。

e.en: Their {re-constructions} of the events differed sharply.
e.zh: 他们对事件经过的重构差异很大。

e.en: We need to {re-convert} the file to PDF.
e.zh: 我们需要把这个文件重新转换成PDF。

e.en: Some churches tried to {re-convert} former members.
e.zh: 一些教会试图让以前的成员重新皈依。

e.en: Please {re-copy} the document without the missing page.
e.zh: 请重新复制这份文件，不要漏掉那一页。

e.en: He had to {re-copy} the notes after spilling coffee on them.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒在笔记上后，只好重新抄一遍。

e.en: The cashier had to {re-count} the money twice.
e.zh: 收银员不得不把钱重新数了两遍。

e.en: Officials will {re-count} the votes by hand.
e.zh: 官员们将手工重新清点选票。

e.en: We should {re-cover} the sofa with stronger fabric.
e.zh: 我们应该用更结实的布料重新包这张沙发。

e.en: Workers will {re-cover} the hole after checking the pipe.
e.zh: 工人检查管道后会把洞重新盖上。

e.en: The company {re-covers} old chairs for hotels.
e.zh: 这家公司为酒店重新包旧椅子的面。

e.en: Snow often {re-covers} the path within an hour.
e.zh: 雪常常在一小时内又把小路覆盖住。

re-creatable.t: 可重新创造的；可复现的

e.en: The experiment is {re-creatable} under normal laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 这个实验在普通实验室条件下是可以复现的。

e.en: The scene was not easily {re-creatable} for the film crew.
e.zh: 电影摄制组很难轻易重现那个场景。

e.en: They tried to {re-create} the meal from memory.
e.zh: 他们试着凭记忆重做那顿饭。

e.en: The software can {re-create} a 3D model from photos.
e.zh: 这款软件可以根据照片重建三维模型。

e.en: The museum {re-created} the ancient room for visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆为游客重新再现了那间古老的房间。

e.en: She {re-created} the recipe from memory.
e.zh: 她凭记忆重新做出了那道菜。

e.en: The software {re-creates} realistic weather conditions.
e.zh: 这款软件能再现逼真的天气状况。

e.en: He {re-creates} famous paintings with paper scraps.
e.zh: 他用碎纸重新创作名画。

e.en: They are {re-creating} the battle scene for a film.
e.zh: 他们正在为电影再现那场战斗场面。

e.en: She enjoys {re-creating} childhood dishes at home.
e.zh: 她喜欢在家重新做童年吃过的菜。

e.en: The painting is a careful {re-creation} of the original.
e.zh: 这幅画是对原作的细致重现。

e.en: Historical {re-creation} requires both research and imagination.
e.zh: 历史场景的再创造既需要研究，也需要想象力。

e.en: Her {re-creative} approach gave the old story new life.
e.zh: 她的再创造手法让这个老故事焕发了新生命。

e.en: Translation can be a {re-creative} act, not just copying words.
e.zh: 翻译可以是一种再创造行为，而不只是照搬词语。

e.en: We had to {re-cross} the river before sunset.
e.zh: 我们必须在日落前再次渡过那条河。

e.en: Do not {re-cross} the line after the signal changes.
e.zh: 信号变化后不要再次越过那条线。

e.en: They {re-crossed} the border at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明时再次越过边境。

e.en: She {re-crossed} her legs during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她又把双腿交叉起来。

e.en: The path {re-crosses} the stream near the bridge.
e.zh: 小路在桥边再次穿过溪流。

e.en: He {re-crosses} his arms whenever he feels nervous.
e.zh: 他一紧张就会再次交叉双臂。

e.en: Please {re-cycle} these bottles after the party.
e.zh: 聚会后请把这些瓶子回收利用。

e.en: The system can {re-cycle} warm air through the building.
e.zh: 这个系统能让暖空气在楼内再循环。

e.en: They plan to {re-decorate} the living room this spring.
e.zh: 他们计划今年春天重新装饰客厅。

e.zh: 银行可以向央行再贴现这张票据。

e.en: The state plans to {re-district} before the next election.
e.zh: 该州计划在下次选举前重新划分选区。

e.en: Lawmakers argued over how to {re-district} the growing suburbs.
e.zh: 议员们为如何重新划分不断扩张的郊区选区而争论。

e.zh: 受挫之后，我们必须加倍努力。

e.zh: 请用更简单的语言重新起草合同。

e.zh: 政策改变后，他不得不修改演讲稿。

e.zh: 设计师会手工重新绘制这张地图。

e.zh: 法院命令官员重新划定选区边界。

re-dress.t: 重新穿衣；重新处理伤口

e.zh: 她上楼重新换衣服准备吃晚饭。

e.en: The nurse came back to {re-dress} the wound.
e.zh: 护士回来重新包扎伤口。

re-dressed.t: 重新穿好衣服；重新包扎

e.en: He {re-dressed} quickly after the medical exam.
e.zh: 体检后他很快重新穿好衣服。

e.en: The wound was {re-dressed} with a clean bandage.
e.zh: 伤口用干净绷带重新包扎了。

e.en: Her words seemed to {re-echo} through the hall.
e.zh: 她的话似乎在大厅里再次回响。

e.en: The article {re-echoes} arguments made years earlier.
e.zh: 这篇文章重复呼应了多年前提出的论点。

e.en: The preacher hoped to {re-edify} his divided congregation.
e.zh: 牧师希望重新教化他那分裂的会众。

e.zh: 这门课程旨在再次启发读者认识公民责任。

e.zh: 发表前她必须重新编辑这篇文章。

e.zh: 导演选择重新剪辑最后一场戏。

e.zh: 这个项目试图重新教育曾经犯罪的人。

e.zh: 技术变化时，公司必须对员工进行再培训。

e.en: Voters may {re-elect} the mayor this autumn.
e.zh: 选民今年秋天可能会让市长连任。

e.en: The board voted to {re-elect} her as chair.
e.zh: 董事会投票再次选举她担任主席。

e.en: The president was {re-elected} by a narrow margin.
e.zh: 总统以微弱优势再次当选。

e.en: She was {re-elected} chair of the committee.
e.zh: 她获连任，继续担任委员会主席。

e.en: They are considering {re-electing} the same representative.
e.zh: 他们正在考虑再次选举同一位代表。

e.en: The shareholders supported {re-electing} him to the board.
e.zh: 股东支持让他连任董事会成员。

e.zh: 这位参议员很早就开始了连任竞选。

e.zh: 他的再次当选让许多政治分析人士感到意外。

e.zh: 如果这座城市让他连任，税收可能会上升。

e.zh: 俱乐部每年春天都会重新选举管理人员。

e.zh: 乘客必须在船离港前重新登船。

e.zh: 短暂休息后，他们将重新开始这个项目。

e.en: Old tensions may {re-emerge} during the negotiations.
e.zh: 谈判期间，旧有紧张关系可能重新出现。

e.zh: 这支乐队希望以新的风格再度兴起。

e.zh: 报告发表后，这个问题重新出现了。

e.zh: 她走过那栋房子时，童年记忆再度浮现。

e.en: The debate {re-emerges} whenever prices rise.
e.zh: 每当价格上涨，这场争论就会重新出现。

e.zh: 一种被遗忘的风格在现代时尚中再度兴起。

e.zh: 这种材料可以把吸收的光重新以热量形式发出。

e.zh: 该设备会再次发出少量辐射。

e.zh: 我想再次强调耐心的重要性。

e.zh: 这份报告会在每一章重新着重说明安全问题。

e.en: The chair {re-emphasised} the deadline during the meeting.
e.zh: 主席在会议中再次强调了截止日期。

e.en: She {re-emphasised} that safety came before speed.
e.zh: 她再次强调安全比速度更重要。

e.en: The report {re-emphasises} the need for reform.
e.zh: 这份报告再次强调改革的必要性。

e.zh: 培训新员工时，他常常再次强调耐心。

e.zh: 在公众压力下，该州再次制定了这项法律。

e.en: Officials discussed {re-enacting} the expired regulation.
e.zh: 官员们讨论了再次制定那项过期规定。

e.en: The legislature {re-enacts} the tax rule each year.

e.en: The wall needed {re-enforcement} after the storm.

e.en: The teacher tried to {re-engage} the quiet students.

e.zh: 魔术师试图用快速动作让观众眼花缭乱。

e.zh: 期末考试后，他们出去尽情狂欢。

e.zh: 他的演讲辞藻炫目，却几乎没有明确承诺。

e.zh: 重新适应家里的生活花了好几个月。

e.en: The move required a difficult {re-adjustment} for the whole family.
e.zh: 这次搬家让全家都经历了一段艰难的重新适应。
