e.zh: 镜头稍作重新调整后，图像变得更清楚了。

e.en: The camera {re-adjusts} focus when the subject moves.
e.zh: 拍摄对象移动时，相机会重新调整焦点。

e.en: She quickly {re-adjusts} to new routines after each trip.
e.zh: 每次旅行后，她都能很快重新适应新的日常安排。

re-admit.t: 重新接纳；再次准许进入

e.en: The school agreed to {re-admit} him after his apology.
e.zh: 他道歉后，学校同意重新接收他。

e.en: The hospital may {re-admit} the patient if symptoms return.
e.zh: 如果症状复发，医院可能会再次收治这名病人。

e.en: The city may {re-adopt} the policy next year.
e.zh: 该市明年可能会重新采用这项政策。

e.en: They decided to {re-adopt} the dog after the first placement failed.
e.zh: 第一次安置失败后，他们决定再次收养那只狗。

re-adopted.t: 被重新采用；被再次收养

e.en: The old rule was {re-adopted} after several complaints.
e.zh: 在多次投诉后，旧规定被重新采用。

e.en: The child was {re-adopted} by relatives in another city.
e.zh: 这个孩子后来被另一个城市的亲戚再次收养。

re-advertise.t: 重新刊登广告；再次宣传

e.en: They had to {re-advertise} the job after no one suitable applied.
e.zh: 没有合适的人应聘后，他们不得不重新发布招聘广告。

e.en: The agency will {re-advertise} the tour before the holiday season.
e.zh: 旅行社会在假期前再次宣传这条旅游线路。

e.en: The leaders will {re-affirm} their commitment to peace.
e.zh: 各国领导人将重申他们对和平的承诺。

e.en: The court may {re-affirm} the earlier decision.
e.zh: 法院可能会再次确认先前的判决。

e.en: The statement {re-affirms} the company's safety policy.
e.zh: 这份声明重申了公司的安全政策。

e.en: Her success {re-affirms} the value of steady practice.
e.zh: 她的成功再次证明了持续练习的价值。

e.en: The merger caused a major {re-alignment} of departments.
e.zh: 合并导致各部门进行了一次重大重组。

e.en: The election led to a political {re-alignment} across the region.
e.zh: 这次选举引发了该地区政治阵营的重新组合。

e.en: The army {re-equips} old units with modern radios.
e.zh: 军队为旧部队重新配备现代无线电。

e.en: She {re-equips} the lab after each field trip.
e.zh: 每次野外考察后，她都会重新装备实验室。

e.en: Workers will {re-erect} the fallen sign tomorrow.
e.zh: 工人明天会把倒下的招牌重新竖起来。

e.en: The town hopes to {re-erect} the historic arch.
e.zh: 小镇希望重建那座历史拱门。

e.en: The treaty {re-establishes} trade between the two countries.
e.zh: 这项条约恢复了两国之间的贸易。

e.en: A good apology {re-establishes} trust after a mistake.
e.zh: 真诚的道歉能在犯错后重新建立信任。

e.en: We need to {re-estimate} the cost after the delay.
e.zh: 延误之后，我们需要重新估计成本。

e.en: The analyst will {re-estimate} demand using newer data.
e.zh: 分析师会用更新的数据重新评估需求。

e.en: You should {re-evaluate} your plan before investing more money.
e.zh: 在投入更多资金前，你应该重新评估自己的计划。

e.en: The diagnosis made her {re-evaluate} her priorities.
e.zh: 这个诊断让她重新考虑人生中的轻重缓急。

e.en: The committee {re-evaluates} each proposal after public comments.
e.zh: 公众提出意见后，委员会会重新评估每项提案。

e.en: He {re-evaluates} his career goals every year.
e.zh: 他每年都会重新考虑自己的职业目标。

e.en: Doctors will {re-examine} the patient this afternoon.
e.zh: 医生今天下午会重新检查这名病人。

e.en: The scandal forced voters to {re-examine} his record.
e.zh: 这起丑闻迫使选民重新审视他的过往表现。

re-examined.t: 重新检查过；重新审视过

e.en: The evidence was {re-examined} by an independent expert.
e.zh: 这些证据由一名独立专家重新检查过。

e.en: After the debate, her assumptions were {re-examined}.
e.zh: 辩论之后，她的假设被重新审视。

e.en: The doctor {re-examines} the wound after two days.
e.zh: 两天后，医生重新检查了伤口。

e.en: The book {re-examines} the causes of the war.
e.zh: 这本书重新审视了那场战争的起因。

re-examining.t: 正在重新检查；重新审视

e.en: They are {re-examining} the contract for hidden risks.
e.zh: 他们正在重新检查合同，寻找隐藏风险。

e.en: She spent the summer {re-examining} her beliefs.
e.zh: 她整个夏天都在重新审视自己的信念。

e.en: The music helped him {re-experience} his childhood memories.
e.zh: 这段音乐帮助他重新体验童年的记忆。

e.en: Some survivors {re-experience} trauma in vivid dreams.
e.zh: 一些幸存者会在生动的梦中再次经历创伤。

e.en: Could you {re-explain} the rule more slowly?
e.zh: 你能把这条规则再慢慢解释一遍吗？

e.en: The teacher had to {re-explain} the assignment.
e.zh: 老师不得不重新说明这项作业。

e.en: Scientists plan to {re-explore} the cave with better equipment.
e.zh: 科学家计划用更好的设备重新探索这个洞穴。

e.en: The essay invites readers to {re-explore} old moral questions.
e.zh: 这篇文章邀请读者再次探讨古老的道德问题。

e.en: She will {re-fashion} the dress into a jacket.
e.zh: 她会把那条裙子改造成一件夹克。

e.en: The mayor tried to {re-fashion} himself as a reformer.
e.zh: 市长试图把自己重新塑造成改革者。

e.en: The coach refused to {re-fight} last year's match.
e.zh: 教练拒绝重新打一场去年的比赛。

e.en: They should not {re-fight} the same political battles forever.
e.zh: 他们不该永远反复争论同样的政治斗争。

re-finish.t: 重新修整；再次完成表面处理

e.en: We need to {re-finish} the table after sanding it.
e.zh: 打磨之后，我们需要重新修整这张桌子的表面。

e.en: The contractor will {re-finish} the floor next week.
e.zh: 承包商下周会重新给地板做表面处理。

e.en: The mechanic tried to {re-fire} the stalled engine.
e.zh: 机械师试图重新点燃熄火的发动机。

e.en: The potter must {re-fire} the bowl to fix the glaze.
e.zh: 陶艺师必须再次烧制这个碗来修复釉面。

e.en: They will {re-fit} the old ship for research work.
e.zh: 他们会把那艘旧船改装成科研船。

e.en: The tailor can {re-fit} the suit after your weight loss.
e.zh: 你瘦下来之后，裁缝可以重新修改这套西装。

e.en: The company {re-fits} vans for wheelchair access.
e.zh: 这家公司改装面包车，以便轮椅上下。

e.en: This part {re-fits} easily after cleaning.
e.zh: 这个零件清洁后很容易重新装上。

re-focusing.t: 重新聚焦；重新集中注意力

e.en: The camera kept {re-focusing} as the subject moved.
e.zh: 拍摄对象移动时，相机一直在重新对焦。

e.en: The team is {re-focusing} on customer service.
e.zh: 团队正在把注意力重新集中到客户服务上。

e.en: Please {re-fold} the map before putting it away.
e.zh: 收起来之前，请把地图重新折好。

e.en: She had to {re-fold} the shirt neatly.
e.zh: 她不得不把衬衫重新整齐地折好。

e.en: The band decided to {re-form} after ten years apart.
e.zh: 分开十年后，乐队决定重新组建。

e.en: Ice crystals {re-form} when the temperature drops again.
e.zh: 温度再次下降时，冰晶会重新形成。

e.en: Please {re-format} the report before sending it.
e.zh: 发送前请把报告重新排版。

e.en: You may need to {re-format} the drive completely.
e.zh: 你可能需要把这个硬盘彻底重新格式化。

re-formatted.t: 已重新格式化；已重排版

e.en: The document was {re-formatted} for easier reading.
e.zh: 这份文档已重新排版，便于阅读。

e.en: My hard drive was {re-formatted} during the repair.
e.zh: 维修期间，我的硬盘被重新格式化了。

re-formed.t: 重新组成的；重新形成的

e.en: The {re-formed} band announced a new tour.
e.zh: 重新组建的乐队宣布了新的巡演。

e.en: The storm clouds {re-formed} over the hills.
e.zh: 暴风云在山丘上空重新形成。

re-forming.t: 重新形成；重新塑造；改组自己

e.en: The committee is {re-forming} after last year's collapse.
e.zh: 委员会在去年解散后正在重新组建。

e.en: The clay is {re-forming} into a smoother shape.
e.zh: 这块黏土正在重新塑造成更平滑的形状。

re-forms.t: 重新形成；重新组织；改造

e.en: The band {re-forms} for one final concert.
e.zh: 乐队为了最后一场演唱会重新组队。

e.en: Heat {re-forms} the plastic into a new shape.
e.zh: 加热会把塑料重新塑造成新的形状。

e.en: She had to {re-formulate} the question more clearly.
e.zh: 她不得不把问题重新表述得更清楚。

e.en: The company will {re-formulate} the product without sugar.
e.zh: 公司将重新配制这款产品，不再加糖。

e.en: The plane stopped to {re-fuel} in Dubai.
e.zh: 飞机在迪拜停下来补充燃料。

e.en: We need to {re-fuel} the generator before nightfall.
e.zh: 天黑前我们需要给发电机重新加油。

e.en: They plan to {re-furbish} the old hotel.
e.zh: 他们计划翻新这家老酒店。

e.en: The charity will {re-furbish} used laptops for students.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构会整修二手笔记本电脑给学生使用。

e.en: He worked hard to {re-gain} her trust.
e.zh: 他努力工作，想重新赢得她的信任。

e.en: The patient slowly began to {re-gain} strength.
e.zh: 病人慢慢开始恢复体力。

e.en: The troops will {re-gather} beyond the hill.
e.zh: 部队将在山后重新集结。

e.en: She paused to {re-gather} her thoughts.
e.zh: 她停下来重新整理自己的思绪。

re-gathered.t: 重新聚集的；再次收集的

e.en: The scattered papers were {re-gathered} into one pile.
e.zh: 散落的文件被重新收拢成一摞。

e.en: After the storm, the team {re-gathered} in the shelter.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，队伍在避难所重新集合。

e.en: Some lizards can {re-generate} a lost tail.
e.zh: 有些蜥蜴能再生断掉的尾巴。

e.en: Click the button to {re-generate} the report.
e.zh: 点击按钮即可重新生成报告。

e.en: The damaged tissue slowly {re-generated} after treatment.
e.zh: 受损组织在治疗后慢慢再生。

e.en: The password was {re-generated} for security reasons.
e.zh: 出于安全原因，密码被重新生成。

e.en: The teacher agreed to {re-grade} the exam.
e.zh: 老师同意重新批改这份试卷。

e.en: The road crew will {re-grade} the steep driveway.
e.zh: 道路施工队将重新平整这条陡峭的车道。

e.en: The court may {re-grant} the license next month.
e.zh: 法院可能在下个月重新授予许可证。

e.en: The agency decided to {re-grant} funding after the appeal.
e.zh: 申诉之后，该机构决定再次批准资金。

e.en: The students are {re-grouping} by skill level.
e.zh: 学生们正按技能水平重新分组。

e.en: After the setback, the company is {re-grouping} quickly.
e.zh: 受挫之后，公司正在迅速重整旗鼓。

e.en: The grass will {re-grow} after the rain.
e.zh: 下雨后，草会重新长出来。

e.en: Scientists hope to {re-grow} damaged nerve cells.
e.zh: 科学家希望让受损的神经细胞再生。

e.en: This plant {re-grows} quickly after cutting.
e.zh: 这种植物修剪后会很快重新长出来。

e.en: Hair usually {re-grows} after chemotherapy ends.
e.zh: 化疗结束后，头发通常会重新长出来。

re-hash.t: 重提旧事；改头换面再用

e.en: Let's not {re-hash} the same argument tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们别再重提同一个争论了。

e.en: The sequel seemed to {re-hash} the first film.
e.zh: 这部续集像是在把第一部电影改头换面再用。

e.en: You can {re-heat} the soup for lunch.
e.zh: 你可以把汤重新加热当午餐。

e.en: Do not {re-heat} rice more than once.
e.zh: 米饭不要反复重新加热。

e.en: The company decided to {re-hire} several former workers.
e.zh: 公司决定重新雇用几名前员工。

e.en: They may {re-hire} the consultant for another project.
e.zh: 他们可能再次聘请这位顾问做另一个项目。

re-house.t: 重新安置住房；迁入新居

e.en: The council promised to {re-house} the flooded families.
e.zh: 市政会承诺为受洪水影响的家庭重新安置住房。

e.en: The museum will {re-house} the collection in a safer building.
e.zh: 博物馆将把这批藏品迁入更安全的建筑。

e.en: The company will {re-imburse} your travel costs.
e.zh: 公司会报销你的差旅费用。

e.en: Please keep receipts so we can {re-imburse} you.
e.zh: 请保留收据，这样我们才能给你报销。

e.en: The insurer {re-imburses} patients within two weeks.
e.zh: 保险公司会在两周内给病人报销。

e.en: Our department {re-imburses} staff for approved meals.
e.zh: 我们部门会为获批的员工餐费报销。

e.en: The government may {re-impose} travel restrictions.
e.zh: 政府可能重新实施旅行限制。

e.en: The school decided to {re-impose} the old dress code.
e.zh: 学校决定重新执行旧的着装规定。

e.en: The editor tried to {re-incorporate} the deleted paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑试图把删掉的段落重新纳入文中。

e.en: The region voted to {re-incorporate} into the larger province.
e.zh: 该地区投票决定重新并入更大的省份。

re-index.t: 重新编索引；重新建立索引

e.en: The database must {re-index} all new records.
e.zh: 数据库必须为所有新记录重新建立索引。

e.en: The librarian will {re-index} the archive by date.
e.zh: 图书管理员会按日期重新编制档案索引。

e.en: Poor hygiene can {re-infect} the wound.
e.zh: 卫生条件差可能会让伤口再次感染。

e.en: The virus may {re-infect} patients after several months.
e.zh: 这种病毒可能在几个月后再次感染患者。

e.en: The new beams will {re-inforce} the old bridge.
e.zh: 这些新梁会再次加固那座旧桥。

e.en: Commanders moved troops to {re-inforce} the border.
e.zh: 指挥官调动部队去增援边境。

e.en: The wall needs extra {re-inforcement} before winter.
e.zh: 这堵墙入冬前需要额外加固。

e.en: Police requested {re-inforcement} as the crowd grew.
e.zh: 人群越来越多，警方请求增援。

e.en: This policy {re-inforces} old social divisions.
e.zh: 这项政策再次强化了旧有的社会分化。

e.en: The extra steel {re-inforces} the concrete floor.
e.zh: 额外的钢材加固了混凝土地面。

e.en: Please {re-insert} the card and try again.
e.zh: 请重新插入卡片再试一次。

e.en: The editor decided to {re-insert} the deleted paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑决定把删掉的段落重新放回去。

e.en: The nurse {re-inserts} the tube carefully.
e.zh: 护士小心地重新插入导管。

e.en: The program {re-inserts} missing line breaks automatically.
e.zh: 程序会自动重新加入缺失的换行。

e.en: The mechanic will {re-inspect} the brakes tomorrow.
e.zh: 技师明天会重新检查刹车。

e.en: Officials returned to {re-inspect} the factory after complaints.
e.zh: 接到投诉后，官员回来再次视察工厂。

e.en: The court ordered them to {re-instate} her benefits.
e.zh: 法院命令他们恢复她的福利。

e.en: The company agreed to {re-instate} the dismissed worker.
e.zh: 公司同意让那名被解雇的工人复职。

e.en: Her {re-instatement} was welcomed by the whole team.
e.zh: 她的复职受到整个团队欢迎。

e.en: The union demanded the {re-instatement} of overtime pay.
e.zh: 工会要求恢复加班费。

e.en: The ruling {re-instates} his right to appeal.
e.zh: 这项裁决恢复了他的上诉权。

e.en: The school {re-instates} uniforms after several complaints.
e.zh: 几起投诉后，学校重新实施校服规定。

e.en: The mayor plans to {re-institute} weekly safety checks.
e.zh: 市长计划重新实行每周安全检查。

e.en: They voted to {re-institute} the old scholarship program.
e.zh: 他们投票决定重新设立旧奖学金项目。

e.en: The program helps former prisoners {re-integrate} into society.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助前囚犯重新融入社会。

e.en: Engineers had to {re-integrate} the module after the update.
e.zh: 更新后，工程师必须重新整合这个模块。

e.en: The family chose to {re-inter} his remains in the village.
e.zh: 家人选择把他的遗骸重新安葬在村里。

e.en: Archaeologists helped {re-inter} the bones with proper ceremony.
e.zh: 考古人员协助以合适仪式重新埋葬这些骨骸。

e.en: The zoo hopes to {re-introduce} wolves to the area.
e.zh: 动物园希望把狼重新引入该地区。

e.en: Let me {re-introduce} myself after so many years.
e.zh: 这么多年后，请允许我再次介绍自己。

e.en: The bill {re-introduces} stricter rules for landlords.
e.zh: 这项法案重新引入了对房东更严格的规定。

e.en: She {re-introduces} the character in the final chapter.
e.zh: 她在最后一章再次介绍这个人物。

e.en: The startup wants to {re-invent} online shopping.
e.zh: 这家初创公司想彻底改造网上购物。

e.en: After losing his job, he tried to {re-invent} himself.
e.zh: 失业后，他试图彻底改变自己。

e.en: They plan to {re-invest} the profits in new equipment.
e.zh: 他们计划把利润再投资到新设备上。

e.en: She chose to {re-invest} her energy in community work.
e.zh: 她选择把精力重新投入社区工作。

e.en: Police agreed to {re-investigate} the old case.
e.zh: 警方同意重新调查这起旧案。

e.en: Scientists will {re-investigate} the data after finding errors.
e.zh: 发现错误后，科学家将重新检查这些数据。

e.en: The family called for a full {re-investigation} of the accident.
e.zh: 家属要求对事故进行全面重新调查。

e.en: A {re-investigation} revealed mistakes in the original report.
e.zh: 重新调查发现原报告中有错误。

e.en: Several {re-investigations} failed to identify the real culprit.
e.zh: 几次重新调查都没能找出真正的罪犯。

e.en: The agency ordered {re-investigations} of three disputed cases.
e.zh: 该机构下令复查三起有争议的案件。

e.en: The new coach helped {re-invigorate} the tired team.
e.zh: 新教练帮助这支疲惫的队伍重新振作。

e.en: Tax cuts were meant to {re-invigorate} the economy.
e.zh: 减税本意是重新激活经济。

e.en: The patient's {re-isolation} was necessary after symptoms returned.
e.zh: 症状复发后，病人有必要再次隔离。

e.en: The lab required {re-isolation} of the bacterial strain.
e.zh: 实验室需要重新分离该细菌菌株。

e.en: I must {re-iterate} that the deadline is final.
e.zh: 我必须重申，截止日期不会改变。

e.en: The report {re-iterate} the need for stronger oversight.
e.zh: 这份报告反复说明需要更严格的监督。

e.en: She {re-iterated} her support for the proposal.
e.zh: 她重申了自己对该提案的支持。

e.en: The memo {re-iterated} the rules in plain language.
e.zh: 这份备忘录用通俗语言再次说明了规则。

e.en: The minister {re-iterates} the government's position every week.
e.zh: 部长每周都重申政府立场。

e.en: This paragraph {re-iterates} points made earlier in the essay.
e.zh: 这一段重复说明了文章前面提出的观点。

e.en: We need to {re-jig} the schedule before Friday.
e.zh: 我们需要在周五前重新安排日程。

e.en: The designer will {re-jig} the layout for mobile screens.
e.zh: 设计师会为手机屏幕调整版面。

e.en: She plans to {re-join} the team next month.
e.zh: 她计划下个月重新加入团队。

e.en: After lunch, we will {re-join} the main group.
e.zh: 午饭后，我们会重新和大部队会合。

re-joined.t: 重新加入了；重新会合了

e.en: He {re-joined} the company after two years abroad.
e.zh: 他在国外待了两年后重新加入了这家公司。

e.en: The path {re-joined} the road near the bridge.
e.zh: 这条小路在桥边重新接回了公路。

re-key.t: 重新输入；重新设定钥匙

e.en: Please {re-key} the password carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细重新输入密码。

e.en: The landlord had to {re-key} every lock.
e.zh: 房东不得不重新设定每一把锁的钥匙。

e.en: The speech helped {re-kindle} public interest.
e.zh: 那场演讲帮助重新激起了公众兴趣。

e.en: They tried to {re-kindle} their old friendship.
e.zh: 他们试图重新恢复昔日的友谊。

e.en: The company will {re-launch} the app in June.
e.zh: 公司将在六月重新推出这款应用。

e.en: They hope to {re-launch} talks after the election.
e.zh: 他们希望选举后重新启动谈判。

e.en: The brand {re-launches} its website this week.
e.zh: 这个品牌本周重新推出官网。

e.en: The minister often {re-launches} old policies with new names.
e.zh: 这位部长常把旧政策换个名字重新推出。

e.en: Workers will {re-lay} the damaged tiles tomorrow.
e.zh: 工人明天会重新铺设受损的瓷砖。

e.en: We had to {re-lay} the cable under the floor.
e.zh: 我们不得不重新铺设地板下的电缆。

e.en: The crew {re-lays} the track every summer.
e.zh: 施工队每年夏天都会重新铺设轨道。

e.en: She {re-lays} the table when more guests arrive.
e.zh: 有更多客人到来时，她会重新摆放餐桌。

e.en: I had to {re-learn} basic grammar.
e.zh: 我不得不重新学习基础语法。

e.en: After the injury, he had to {re-learn} how to walk.
e.zh: 受伤后，他不得不重新学习走路。

e.en: They decided to {re-lease} the office space.
e.zh: 他们决定把办公场地重新出租。

e.en: The agency can {re-lease} the car after inspection.
e.zh: 中介检查后可以再次出租这辆车。

e.en: The owner wants to {re-let} the apartment quickly.
e.zh: 业主想尽快把公寓重新出租。

e.en: Students may not {re-let} rooms without permission.
e.zh: 学生未经许可不得转租房间。

e.en: The tailor will {re-line} the old coat.
e.zh: 裁缝会给这件旧外套重新加衬里。

e.en: The council plans to {re-line} the parking spaces.
e.zh: 市政会计划重新画停车位线。

e.en: They cannot {re-litigate} the same claim again.
e.zh: 他们不能就同一项主张再次提起诉讼。

e.en: We should not {re-litigate} every past mistake.
e.zh: 我们不该把过去每个错误都重新争论一遍。

e.en: Photos help her {re-live} the holiday.
e.zh: 照片帮助她重温那次假期。

e.en: He refused to {re-live} the accident in court.
e.zh: 他拒绝在法庭上重新经历那场事故。

e.en: She {re-lived} the concert through the recording.
e.zh: 她通过录音重温了那场音乐会。

e.en: The witness {re-lived} the attack during testimony.
e.zh: 证人在作证时重新经历了那次袭击。

e.en: He {re-lives} his childhood in those stories.
e.zh: 他在那些故事里重温自己的童年。

e.en: A veteran often {re-lives} the battle in dreams.
e.zh: 一名老兵常在梦中重新经历那场战斗。

e.en: Click here to {re-load} the page.
e.zh: 点击这里重新加载页面。

e.en: The soldiers stopped to {re-load} their rifles.
e.zh: 士兵们停下来重新给步枪装弹。

e.en: The firm will {re-locate} staff to Singapore.
e.zh: 公司会把员工重新安置到新加坡。

e.en: We may {re-locate} closer to the school.
e.zh: 我们可能会搬到离学校更近的地方。

e.en: The {re-location} took longer than expected.
e.zh: 这次搬迁花的时间比预期更长。

e.en: Employees received help with {re-location} costs.
e.zh: 员工获得了搬迁费用方面的帮助。

e.en: They will {re-make} the film for television.
e.zh: 他们会把这部电影重新制作成电视版。

e.en: She decided to {re-make} the dress herself.
e.zh: 她决定自己重新改做这条裙子。

e.en: Scientists need to {re-map} the damaged area.
e.zh: 科学家需要重新绘制受损区域的地图。

e.en: You can {re-map} the keys in the settings.
e.zh: 你可以在设置里重新映射这些按键。

e.en: He chose to {re-marry} after many years alone.
e.zh: 独身多年后，他选择再婚。

e.en: Some couples divorce and later {re-marry} each other.
e.zh: 有些夫妻离婚后又彼此复婚。

e.en: The factory can {re-melt} scrap metal.
e.zh: 工厂可以重新熔化废金属。

e.en: Do not {re-melt} chocolate too many times.
e.zh: 不要把巧克力反复重新融化太多次。

e.en: Stir well and {re-mix} the paint before use.
e.zh: 使用前要充分搅拌，重新混合油漆。

e.en: The DJ will {re-mix} the song for clubs.
e.zh: 这位DJ会把这首歌混音改编成夜店版本。

e.en: They plan to {re-model} the kitchen this spring.
e.zh: 他们计划今年春天改造厨房。

e.en: The team must {re-model} its budget forecast.
e.zh: 团队必须重新设计预算预测模型。

e.en: The city council voted to {re-name} the station after a local hero.
e.zh: 市议会投票决定以一位当地英雄的名字重新命名车站。

e.en: Please {re-name} the file before you upload it.
e.zh: 上传前请先把这个文件改名。

e.en: The government may {re-nationalize} the railway after years of poor service.
e.zh: 多年服务不佳后，政府可能会重新国有化铁路。

e.en: Some voters want to {re-nationalize} key utilities.
e.zh: 一些选民希望把关键公用事业重新国有化。

e.en: The union wants to {re-negotiate} the pay agreement.
e.zh: 工会希望重新谈判工资协议。

e.en: They had to {re-negotiate} the loan after interest rates rose.
e.zh: 利率上升后，他们不得不重新协商贷款条件。

e.en: The party decided to {re-nominate} the sitting mayor.
e.zh: 该党决定再次提名现任市长。

e.en: Members can {re-nominate} a candidate if the first vote fails.
e.zh: 如果第一次投票失败，成员可以重新提名候选人。

e.en: We need to {re-number} the pages after adding a new section.
e.zh: 新增章节后，我们需要重新给页码编号。

e.en: The apartments were {re-numbered} during the renovation.
e.zh: 翻修期间，这些公寓被重新编号了。

e.en: Troops moved in to {re-occupy} the abandoned base.
e.zh: 部队进入并重新占领了废弃基地。

e.en: Students hoped to {re-occupy} the hall after repairs finished.
e.zh: 维修结束后，学生们希望再次使用那座礼堂。

e.en: The same error may {re-occur} if the software is not updated.
e.zh: 如果软件不更新，同样的错误可能会再次发生。

e.en: Her symptoms could {re-occur} during periods of stress.
e.zh: 在压力大的时期，她的症状可能会复发。

e.en: The problem {re-occurred} soon after the system restart.
e.zh: 系统重启后不久，这个问题又发生了。

e.en: His knee pain {re-occurred} during the final match.
e.zh: 在最后一场比赛中，他的膝盖疼痛复发了。

e.en: If the fault {re-occurs}, call the support team.
e.zh: 如果故障再次发生，请联系支持团队。

e.en: This theme {re-occurs} throughout the novel.
e.zh: 这个主题在整部小说中反复出现。

e.en: The report found that fewer released prisoners {re-offended} within a year.
e.zh: 报告发现，获释囚犯中一年内再次犯罪的人减少了。

e.en: He {re-offended} after failing to find stable work.
e.zh: 他因没能找到稳定工作而再次犯罪。

e.en: The seller agreed to {re-offer} the discount next month.
e.zh: 卖家同意下个月再次提供这个折扣。

e.en: The university may {re-offer} the course in the spring.
e.zh: 大学可能会在春季重新开设这门课程。

re-offered.t: 再次提供了；重新提出了

e.en: The company {re-offered} the job after the first candidate declined.
e.zh: 第一位候选人拒绝后，公司重新提供了这个职位。

e.en: The class was {re-offered} because many students missed it.
e.zh: 由于很多学生错过了，这门课又重新开设了。

e.en: You should {re-oil} the chain after riding in heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨中骑行后，你应该给链条重新上油。

e.en: The wooden table needs to be {re-oiled} every year.
e.zh: 这张木桌每年都需要重新上油保养。

e.en: The museum {re-opens} to visitors on Monday.
e.zh: 博物馆周一重新向游客开放。

e.en: The shop {re-opens} after lunch every day.
e.zh: 这家店每天午饭后再次开门。

e.en: The company announced a major {re-organisation} of its sales teams.
e.zh: 公司宣布对销售团队进行重大重组。

e.en: The files need some {re-organisation} before the audit.
e.zh: 审计前，这些文件需要重新整理一下。

e.en: Several {re-organisations} left staff unsure about their roles.
e.zh: 几次重组让员工不确定自己的职责。

e.en: School {re-organisations} often affect transport and timetables.
e.zh: 学校改组常常会影响交通安排和课程表。

e.en: We must {re-organise} the meeting schedule before Friday.
e.zh: 我们必须在周五前重新安排会议日程。

e.en: She spent the afternoon trying to {re-organise} her notes.
e.zh: 她花了一下午试着重新整理笔记。

e.en: The manager {re-organises} the rota whenever someone is ill.
e.zh: 有人生病时，经理就会重新安排值班表。

e.en: This app {re-organises} photos by date and location.
e.zh: 这个应用会按日期和地点重新整理照片。

e.en: Frequent {re-organizations} made long-term planning difficult.
e.zh: 频繁重组使长期规划变得困难。

e.en: The merger led to several department {re-organizations}.
e.zh: 这次合并导致了几个部门的重组。

e.en: They plan to {re-organize} the warehouse to save space.
e.zh: 他们计划重新整理仓库以节省空间。

e.en: The director will {re-organize} the team around new projects.
e.zh: 主管将围绕新项目重新组织团队。

re-orient.t: 重新定位；重新调整方向

e.en: The course aims to {re-orient} students toward practical research.
e.zh: 这门课程旨在让学生重新转向实用研究。

e.en: After the move, he needed time to {re-orient} himself.
e.zh: 搬家后，他需要时间重新适应环境。

e.en: The training helps workers {re-orientate} after a career break.
e.zh: 这项培训帮助员工在职业中断后重新适应。

e.en: We had to {re-orientate} the map to match the road ahead.
e.zh: 我们不得不重新调整地图方向，使其与前方道路一致。

re-package.t: 重新包装；换种方式呈现

e.en: The factory will {re-package} the tablets in smaller boxes.
e.zh: 工厂会把这些药片重新包装成较小的盒装。

e.en: Politicians often {re-package} old ideas as new reforms.
e.zh: 政客常把旧想法换个包装说成新改革。

e.en: We need to {re-paint} the kitchen before selling the house.
e.zh: 卖房前，我们需要重新粉刷厨房。

e.en: He decided to {re-paint} the bike bright yellow.
e.zh: 他决定把自行车重新漆成亮黄色。

re-pair.t: 重新配对；重新结成一对

e.en: The teacher asked us to {re-pair} with different partners.
e.zh: 老师让我们和不同的伙伴重新配对。

e.en: The devices will {re-pair} automatically after the update.
e.zh: 更新后，这些设备会自动重新配对。

re-pairs.t: 重新配对；再次成对出现

e.en: The app {re-pairs} the headphones automatically.
e.zh: 这个应用会自动重新配对耳机。

e.en: She {re-pairs} students after every activity.
e.zh: 每次活动后她都会重新给学生分组配对。

e.en: The bill may {re-pass} after minor changes.
e.zh: 这项法案稍作修改后可能再次通过。

e.en: Please {re-pass} the message to the team.
e.zh: 请把这条消息重新传给团队。

re-passed.t: 再次通过了；重新传递了

e.en: The proposal was {re-passed} by the committee.
e.zh: 该提案又一次获得委员会通过。

e.en: The ball was {re-passed} to the goalkeeper.
e.zh: 球又被回传给了守门员。

re-people.t: 重新移民定居；重新充满人

e.en: The government tried to {re-people} the abandoned valley.
e.zh: 政府试图让移民重新定居在那片废弃山谷。

e.en: Artists helped {re-people} the empty downtown streets.
e.zh: 艺术家们帮助让空荡的市中心街道重新有了人气。

e.en: Residents plan to {re-petition} the council next month.
e.zh: 居民计划下个月再次向市议会请愿。

e.en: He may {re-petition} the court for custody.
e.zh: 他可能会再次向法院申请监护权。

e.en: The editor asked me to {re-photograph} the cover.
e.zh: 编辑要求我重新拍摄封面照片。

e.en: Researchers will {re-photograph} the glacier each summer.
e.zh: 研究人员每年夏天都会再次拍摄那座冰川。

e.en: Could you {re-phrase} the question more simply?
e.zh: 你能把这个问题换个更简单的说法吗？

e.en: Lawyers often {re-phrase} clauses to avoid ambiguity.
e.zh: 律师常常重新措辞条款以避免歧义。

e.en: Please {re-place} the books on the shelf.
e.zh: 请把这些书重新放回书架上。

e.en: Workers will {re-place} the stones after inspection.
e.zh: 工人检查后会把石块重新放好。

e.en: We need to {re-plant} the seedlings after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后我们需要重新栽种幼苗。

e.en: The dentist hopes to {re-plant} the knocked-out tooth.
e.zh: 牙医希望把脱落的牙齿再植回去。

e.en: They hired a mason to {re-point} the brick wall.
e.zh: 他们雇了泥瓦匠给砖墙重新勾缝。

e.en: You must {re-point} the antenna toward the tower.
e.zh: 你必须把天线重新指向信号塔。

re-pointed.t: 重新勾缝的；重新指向的

e.en: The old chimney was {re-pointed} last spring.
e.zh: 那座旧烟囱去年春天重新勾过缝。

e.en: The camera was {re-pointed} at the entrance.
e.zh: 摄像头被重新指向入口处。

e.en: Let me {re-pose} the problem in practical terms.
e.zh: 让我用实际一点的话重新提出这个问题。

e.en: The photographer asked her to {re-pose} by the window.
e.zh: 摄影师请她在窗边重新摆姿势。

e.en: The company {re-positions} itself as a luxury brand.
e.zh: 这家公司把自己重新定位为奢侈品牌。

e.en: The nurse {re-positions} the patient every two hours.
e.zh: 护士每两小时给病人调整一次体位。

e.en: The bank may {re-possess} the car after missed payments.
e.zh: 拖欠还款后，银行可能收回这辆车。

e.en: He longed to {re-possess} his childhood home.
e.zh: 他渴望重新拥有童年住过的房子。

e.en: The family fought the {re-possession} of their house.
e.zh: 这家人反对房子被依法收回。

e.en: His {re-possession} of the title surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他重新夺回头衔让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: You should {re-pot} the orchid in fresh soil.
e.zh: 你应该用新土给这株兰花换盆。

e.en: The gardener will {re-pot} the herbs before winter.
e.zh: 园丁会在冬天前给香草重新换盆。

e.en: The museum will {re-present} the exhibit next year.
e.zh: 博物馆明年会重新呈现这个展览。

e.en: She tried to {re-present} the data more clearly.
e.zh: 她试图把数据重新呈现得更清楚。

e.en: The film is a {re-presentation} of historical events.
e.zh: 这部电影是对历史事件的重新呈现。

e.en: His {re-presentation} of the facts changed the debate.
e.zh: 他对事实的重新陈述改变了这场辩论。

e.en: The course compares different {re-presentations} of war.
e.zh: 这门课比较战争的不同重新呈现方式。

e.en: Her {re-presentations} of the argument became clearer.
e.zh: 她对论点的几次重新陈述变得更清楚了。

e.en: The article {re-presents} the case for public funding.
e.zh: 这篇文章重新提出了支持公共资助的理由。

e.en: The gallery {re-presents} familiar objects in strange ways.
e.zh: 画廊以奇特方式重新呈现熟悉的物件。

e.en: If it fails, {re-press} the power button.
e.zh: 如果失败，就再次按下电源按钮。

e.en: The factory will {re-press} the vinyl album.
e.zh: 工厂会重新压制这张黑胶唱片。

e.en: The publisher decided to {re-print} the novel.
e.zh: 出版社决定重印这本小说。

e.en: Please {re-print} the receipt for the customer.
e.zh: 请给顾客重新打印收据。

e.en: The lab must {re-process} the contaminated samples.
e.zh: 实验室必须重新处理受污染的样本。

e.en: The plant can {re-process} used cooking oil.
e.zh: 这家工厂能再加工用过的食用油。

e.en: The artist tried to {re-produce} the original color.
e.zh: 艺术家试图重新做出原来的颜色。

e.en: The team could not {re-produce} the experiment's results.
e.zh: 团队无法再次得出该实验的结果。

e.en: Engineers need to {re-program} the robot tonight.
e.zh: 工程师今晚需要重新给机器人编程。

e.en: Therapy helped him {re-program} harmful habits.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他重新训练有害的习惯模式。

e.en: Please {re-proof} the brochure before it goes to print.
e.zh: 在小册子付印前，请再校对一遍。

e.en: The mathematician had to {re-proof} the lemma after finding a gap.
e.zh: 发现漏洞后，那位数学家不得不重新证明这个引理。

e.en: The server was {re-provisioned} with more memory overnight.
e.zh: 这台服务器夜里被重新配置了更多内存。

e.en: The campsite was {re-provisioned} after the storm cut off supplies.
e.zh: 风暴切断补给后，营地重新获得了物资供应。

e.en: Customers can {re-purchase} the same plan at a discount.
e.zh: 客户可以用折扣价重新购买同一套餐。

e.en: The company may {re-purchase} its shares next quarter.
e.zh: 公司可能在下个季度回购自己的股票。

e.en: She {re-qualified} as a nurse after moving abroad.
e.zh: 移居海外后，她重新取得了护士资格。

e.en: The supplier was {re-qualified} under the new safety rules.
e.zh: 该供应商按照新的安全规定重新通过了认证。

e.en: Drivers must {re-qualify} every five years.
