e.en: We need to {re-vision} the project after the funding cuts.
e.zh: 经费削减后，我们需要重新构想这个项目。

re-visioned.t: 重新构想过的；再设想的

e.en: The story was {re-visioned} for a younger audience.
e.zh: 这个故事被重新构想，以面向更年轻的观众。

e.en: Her {re-visioned} plan gave the museum a clearer purpose.
e.zh: 她重新设想后的计划让博物馆有了更清晰的目标。

e.en: We {re-visited} the village where my grandmother was born.
e.zh: 我们重访了我祖母出生的那个村子。

e.en: The committee {re-visited} the issue after new evidence appeared.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，委员会重新讨论了这个问题。

e.en: The novel {re-visits} the hero's childhood memories.
e.zh: 这部小说重新审视了主人公的童年记忆。

e.en: Her work includes several {re-visits} to earlier themes.
e.zh: 她的作品中有几次对早期主题的重新回顾。

e.en: You should {re-wash} the shirt because the stain remains.
e.zh: 污渍还在，你应该把这件衬衫再洗一遍。

e.en: The nurse had to {re-wash} her hands before the procedure.
e.zh: 护士在操作前不得不重新洗手。

e.en: An electrician came to {re-wire} the old apartment.
e.zh: 电工来给这套旧公寓重新布线。

e.en: Meditation may help {re-wire} the brain's stress response.
e.zh: 冥想可能有助于重塑大脑的压力反应。

e.en: Could you {re-word} that sentence to sound friendlier?
e.zh: 你能把那句话重新措辞，让它听起来更友好吗？

e.en: The lawyer asked him to {re-word} the statement carefully.
e.zh: 律师要求他仔细改写那份声明的说法。

e.en: The designer had to {re-work} the logo after feedback.
e.zh: 收到反馈后，设计师不得不重新修改标志。

e.en: Too much {re-work} can delay the whole project.
e.zh: 返工太多会拖慢整个项目。

e.en: She is {re-working} the final chapter tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚正在重新修改最后一章。

e.en: The factory reduced costs by {re-working} damaged parts.
e.zh: 工厂通过返工处理受损零件来降低成本。

e.en: Please {re-write} the paragraph in simpler English.
e.zh: 请用更简单的英语重写这一段。

e.en: The editor ordered a full {re-write} of the article.
e.zh: 编辑要求把这篇文章彻底重写。

e.en: He {re-writes} every speech several times.
e.zh: 他每篇演讲稿都会重写好几遍。

e.en: The script went through three major {re-writes}.
e.zh: 这个剧本经历了三次大幅改写。

reable.t: 能再次做到的；可重做的

e.en: The experiment is {reable} if the same conditions are kept.
e.zh: 如果保持相同条件，这个实验是可以重做的。

e.en: This rare task is barely {reable} without the original tools.
e.zh: 没有原来的工具，这项少见任务几乎无法再次完成。

reaccess.t: 重新访问；再次取得权限

e.en: Users must log in again to {reaccess} their accounts.
e.zh: 用户必须重新登录才能再次访问自己的账户。

e.en: The archivist helped researchers {reaccess} the old records.
e.zh: 档案管理员帮助研究人员重新取得旧记录的访问权限。

e.en: The airline offered {reaccommodation} after the flight was canceled.
e.zh: 航班取消后，航空公司提供了重新安排行程的服务。

e.en: Recovery required a slow {reaccommodation} to daily life.
e.zh: 康复需要慢慢重新适应日常生活。

e.en: He arrived in a worn {reach-me-down} coat.
e.zh: 他穿着一件别人传下来的旧外套来了。

e.en: The children often wore {reach-me-down} clothes from cousins.
e.zh: 这些孩子常穿表亲们传下来的旧衣服。

e.en: The map shows the {reachability} of hospitals by bus.
e.zh: 这张地图显示了乘公交到达各医院的便利程度。

e.en: Network engineers tested the server's {reachability} after the outage.
e.zh: 网络工程师在故障后测试了服务器是否可以访问。

e.en: The shelf was {reachless} for the child.
e.zh: 那个架子对孩子来说够不着。

e.en: Peace felt {reachless} after years of war.
e.zh: 多年战争之后，和平显得遥不可及。

e.en: The therapist discussed several {reaction-formations} in his behavior.
e.zh: 治疗师谈到了他行为中的几种反向形成。

e.en: Some public virtues may hide private {reaction-formations}.
e.zh: 有些公开表现出的美德可能掩盖了内心的反向形成。

e.en: The test measures your {reaction-time} to sudden sounds.
e.zh: 这项测试测量你对突发声音的反应时间。

e.en: His slow {reaction-time} made driving dangerous.
e.zh: 他反应时间很慢，开车因此很危险。

reactionism.t: 反动主义；保守反改革思想

e.en: The essay criticizes political {reactionism} after the revolution.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了革命后的政治反动主义。

e.en: Her speech confused caution with {reactionism}.
e.zh: 她的演讲把谨慎和反改革的保守思想混为一谈。

e.en: The newspaper called him a {reactionist} opposed to reform.
e.zh: 报纸称他是反对改革的反动派。

e.en: She rejected the {reactionist} tone of the debate.
e.zh: 她反感这场辩论中反改革的调子。

e.en: The program will {read-in} the data file.
e.zh: 程序会把数据文件读入。

e.en: Critics sometimes {read-in} meanings the author never intended.
e.zh: 评论家有时会把作者无意表达的意思解读进去。

e.en: The document is {read-only} on this device.
e.zh: 这份文档在这台设备上是只读的。

e.en: Use a {read-only} account for public access.
e.zh: 公共访问请使用只读账户。

e.en: Please {read-through} the contract before signing.
e.zh: 签字前请把合同通读一遍。

e.en: The cast held a {read-through} of the new script.
e.zh: 演员们对新剧本进行了围读排练。

e.en: The database supports {read-while-writing} for faster reports.
e.zh: 该数据库支持写入时读取，以便更快生成报表。

e.en: A {read-while-writing} conflict corrupted the file.
e.zh: 一次写入时读取冲突损坏了文件。

e.en: The folder needs {read-write} permission.
e.zh: 这个文件夹需要读写权限。

e.en: Modern drives have faster {read-write} speeds.
e.zh: 现代硬盘的读写速度更快。

e.en: She writes {readably} about difficult science.
e.zh: 她把艰深的科学内容写得易读。

e.en: The label was printed {readably} in large letters.
e.zh: 标签用大字清楚地印了出来。

e.en: Veterans may need time to {readapt} to civilian life.
e.zh: 退伍军人可能需要时间重新适应平民生活。

e.en: The director will {readapt} the novel for television.
e.zh: 导演将把这部小说重新改编成电视剧。

reader-interpreter.t: 读者阐释者；阅读解释器

e.en: The theory treats the {reader-interpreter} as central to meaning.
e.zh: 该理论把读者阐释者视为意义形成的核心。

e.en: This old machine used a {reader-interpreter} for punched cards.
e.zh: 这台旧机器用读卡解释器处理穿孔卡。

e.en: The study compared {reader-responses} to two endings.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了读者对两个结尾的反应。

e.en: Editors monitor {reader-responses} after publication.
e.zh: 编辑会在出版后关注读者回应。

e.en: The script can {readfrom} a remote server.
e.zh: 这个脚本可以从远程服务器读取数据。

e.en: Choose the file you want to {readfrom}.
e.zh: 请选择你想从中读取内容的文件。

e.en: The parser calls {readhexstring} before decoding the image.
e.zh: 解析器在解码图像前会调用读取十六进制字符串的功能。

e.en: Use {readhexstring} to load the encoded bytes.
e.zh: 使用读取十六进制字符串来载入编码后的字节。

e.en: She was the {readiest} volunteer in the group.
e.zh: 她是小组里最积极愿意帮忙的志愿者。

e.en: The {readiest} explanation is usually the simplest.
e.zh: 最现成的解释通常也是最简单的。

e.en: The system will {readin} each record automatically.
e.zh: 系统会自动读入每条记录。

e.en: Do not {readin} your own fears to the story.
e.zh: 不要把自己的恐惧读进这个故事里。

e.en: He used a {reading-glass} to study the map.
e.zh: 他用放大镜仔细查看地图。

e.en: Her {reading-glass} made the small print clear.
e.zh: 她的阅读镜片让小字变得清楚。

e.en: Students whispered in the library {reading-room}.
e.zh: 学生们在图书馆阅览室里低声说话。

e.en: The old {reading-room} closes at six.
e.zh: 那间旧阅览室六点关门。

e.en: The committee voted to {readjourn} until Monday.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定再次休会至星期一。

e.en: The judge may {readjourn} the hearing after lunch.
e.zh: 法官可能会在午饭后重新延期听证。

e.en: The chair announced a {readjournment} of the meeting.
e.zh: 主席宣布会议再次休会。

e.en: A sudden illness caused the trial's {readjournment}.
e.zh: 突发疾病导致审判重新延期。

e.en: The hut was built from {readmade} panels.
e.zh: 这间小屋是用预制板搭起来的。

e.en: She preferred a {readmade} answer to a careful explanation.
e.zh: 她宁愿要一个现成答案，也不要细致解释。

e.en: Check the {readme} before installing the package.
e.zh: 安装这个软件包前先看说明文件。

e.en: The project {readme} explains the basic commands.
e.zh: 项目自述文件解释了基本命令。

e.en: The school considered his {readmittance} after the suspension ended.
e.zh: 停学期结束后，学校考虑重新接纳他。

e.en: Fans needed a stamp for {readmittance} to the concert hall.
e.zh: 歌迷需要盖章才能再次进入音乐厅。

e.en: The file is {readonly}, so you cannot save changes.
e.zh: 这个文件是只读的，所以你不能保存修改。

e.en: Guests have {readonly} access to the shared folder.
e.zh: 访客对共享文件夹只有只读权限。

e.en: The council voted to {readopt} the old traffic plan.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定重新采用旧的交通方案。

e.en: They hoped to {readopt} the child after their situation improved.
e.zh: 他们希望情况好转后再次收养那个孩子。

e.en: They will {readorn} the hall for the winter festival.
e.zh: 他们会为冬季节日重新装饰大厅。

e.en: Fresh flowers {readorn} the memorial each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天，鲜花都会再次点缀这座纪念碑。

e.en: The troops began to {readvance} at dawn.
e.zh: 部队在黎明时开始再次前进。

e.en: The company tried to {readvance} its stalled proposal.
e.zh: 公司试图重新推进停滞的提案。

e.en: She bought a {ready-made} meal after work.
e.zh: 下班后她买了一份现成的饭。

e.en: There is no {ready-made} solution to this problem.
e.zh: 这个问题没有现成的解决办法。

e.en: The workers ordered {ready-mix} for the driveway.
e.zh: 工人们为车道订了预拌混凝土。

e.en: Use {ready-mix} plaster for small repairs.
e.zh: 小修补可以用预拌灰泥。

e.en: The site received {ready-mixed} concrete in the morning.
e.zh: 工地早上收到了预拌混凝土。

e.en: She used {ready-mixed} paint for the bedroom walls.
e.zh: 她用预先调好的油漆刷卧室墙壁。

e.en: The boutique sells {ready-to-wear} dresses and tailored suits.
e.zh: 这家精品店出售成衣裙装和定制西装。

e.en: Her designs moved from couture to {ready-to-wear}.
e.zh: 她的设计从高级定制转向了成衣系列。

e.en: A {ready-witted} host saved the awkward moment.
e.zh: 一位机智敏捷的主持人化解了尴尬时刻。

e.en: The debate favored {ready-witted} speakers over careful planners.
e.zh: 这场辩论更有利于反应快的发言者，而不是周密准备的人。

e.en: His {readywitted} reply made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他机智敏捷的回答逗笑了所有人。

e.en: She stayed calm and {readywitted} under pressure.
e.zh: 她在压力下依然冷静，反应很快。

e.en: The engineers measured {reaeration} in the polluted river.
e.zh: 工程师测量了受污染河流的重新曝气情况。

e.en: Proper {reaeration} helps the wine recover after bottling.
e.zh: 适当的再充气有助于葡萄酒在装瓶后恢复状态。

reafference.t: 再传入；再传入神经冲动

e.en: The study examined {reafference} after voluntary eye movement.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了自主眼动后的再传入信号。

e.en: Damage to the pathway can disturb normal {reafference}.
e.zh: 通路受损会干扰正常的再传入过程。

e.en: Volunteers plan to {reafforest} the burned hillside.
e.zh: 志愿者计划在烧毁的山坡上重新造林。

e.en: The agency will {reafforest} abandoned farmland with native trees.
e.zh: 该机构将用本地树种在废弃农田上再植森林。

e.en: The valley showed clear signs of {reafforestation}.
e.zh: 山谷里出现了明显的重新造林迹象。

e.en: Government funding supported {reafforestation} after decades of logging.
e.zh: 政府资金支持了多年采伐后的再植林工作。

e.en: The senator defended a {reaganomic} approach to taxation.
e.zh: 那位参议员为里根经济学式的税收政策辩护。

e.en: Critics called the plan {reaganomic} in spirit.
e.zh: 批评者称该计划在精神上属于里根经济学。

e.en: The lab tested {reageing} in the treated plastic.
e.zh: 实验室测试了处理后塑料的再次老化情况。

e.en: Some wines benefit from careful {reageing} after blending.
e.zh: 有些葡萄酒在调配后经过谨慎重新陈化会更好。

reagency.t: 重新代理；再次行动能力

e.en: The contract allowed {reagency} after a six-month break.
e.zh: 合同允许在六个月中断后重新代理。

e.en: Therapy helped restore her sense of {reagency}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她恢复了再次掌控行动的感觉。

e.en: The technician began {reagentizing} the mineral sample.
e.zh: 技术员开始用试剂处理矿物样品。

e.en: Careful {reagentizing} improves the separation process.
e.zh: 谨慎加药处理能改善分离过程。

e.en: The cells began to {reaggregate} in the culture dish.
e.zh: 细胞开始在培养皿中重新聚集。

e.en: Analysts had to {reaggregate} the data by region.
e.zh: 分析师不得不按地区重新汇总数据。

e.en: The {reaggregated} cells formed a loose cluster.
e.zh: 重新聚集的细胞形成了一个松散的团块。

e.en: The report used {reaggregated} figures from several departments.
e.zh: 报告使用了几个部门重新汇总后的数字。

e.en: The test detected {reagin} in the patient's serum.
e.zh: 检测在患者血清中发现了反应素。

e.en: Early allergy studies often measured {reagin} indirectly.
e.zh: 早期过敏研究常常间接测量反应素。

e.en: The restored leather began {reaging} after months in sunlight.
e.zh: 修复过的皮革在阳光下放了几个月后又开始老化。

e.en: The winemaker considered {reaging} the blend in oak barrels.
e.zh: 酿酒师考虑把这批混酿重新放入橡木桶陈化。

reaim.t: 重新瞄准；重新定位目标

e.en: She had to {reaim} the camera after the bird moved.
e.zh: 鸟移动后，她不得不重新瞄准相机。

e.en: The campaign will {reaim} its message at younger voters.
e.zh: 这场宣传将把信息重新定位给年轻选民。

e.en: They invested in {real-estate} near the new station.
e.zh: 他们投资了新车站附近的房地产。

e.en: The city has strict {real-estate} disclosure rules.
e.zh: 这座城市有严格的房地产信息披露规定。

e.en: The movie is based on a {real-life} rescue.
e.zh: 这部电影改编自一次真实的救援。

e.en: Students need {real-life} examples, not just theory.
e.zh: 学生需要现实生活中的例子，而不只是理论。

e.en: The children were excited to see a {real-live} astronaut.
e.zh: 孩子们看到一位真正的宇航员时非常兴奋。

e.en: They finally played before a {real-live} audience.
e.zh: 他们终于在现场观众面前演出了。

e.en: The app gives {real-time} traffic updates.
e.zh: 这个应用会提供实时交通更新。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient's heartbeat in {real-time}.
e.zh: 医生实时监测病人的心跳。

e.en: The model uses a {real-valued} function for scoring.
e.zh: 这个模型使用实值函数来评分。

e.en: Every {real-valued} measurement was normalized before analysis.
e.zh: 每个实值测量结果在分析前都经过归一化处理。

e.en: The course includes {real-world} business problems.
e.zh: 这门课包含现实世界中的商业问题。

e.en: Lab results may differ from {real-world} performance.
e.zh: 实验室结果可能与实际表现不同。

e.en: The merchant paid one {reale} for the small loaf.
e.zh: 商人用一个雷亚尔买了那条小面包。

e.en: An old silver {reale} was found under the floorboards.
e.zh: 地板下面发现了一枚旧银雷亚尔硬币。

e.en: The mineral sample contained bright orange {realgar}.
e.zh: 这块矿物样本含有鲜橙色的雄黄。

e.en: Historically, {realgar} was used as a pigment.
e.zh: 历史上，雄黄曾被用作颜料。

e.en: The teacher brought menus as {realia} for the lesson.
e.zh: 老师带来了菜单作为这节课的实物教具。

e.en: Museums preserve {realia} from everyday nineteenth-century life.
e.zh: 博物馆保存了十九世纪日常生活中的真实物品。

e.en: The mechanic will {realine} the wheels after replacing the tires.
e.zh: 更换轮胎后，技师会重新校准车轮。

e.en: We need to {realine} the team around one goal.
e.zh: 我们需要让团队围绕同一个目标重新对齐。

e.en: The committee questioned the {realizability} of the proposal.
e.zh: 委员会质疑这项提案的可实现性。

e.en: Engineers tested the design for practical {realizability}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了该设计在实践中的可实行性。

reallowance.t: 重新准许；再次给付津贴

e.en: The court ordered {reallowance} of the disputed claim.
e.zh: 法院命令重新准许这项有争议的索赔。

e.en: The policy permits {reallowance} after a new review.
e.zh: 该政策允许在重新审查后再次给付津贴。

e.en: The exiled king was {realmless} but still proud.
e.zh: 那位流亡国王虽无王国，却仍然骄傲。

e.en: The poem imagines a {realmless} spirit drifting through time.
e.zh: 这首诗想象一个无归属领域的灵魂在时间中漂泊。

e.en: The prosthetic hand was covered with {realskin}.
e.zh: 这只假手覆盖着仿真皮肤。

e.en: Some luxury cases advertise {realskin} leather finishes.
e.zh: 一些高端保护套宣传采用真皮饰面。

e.en: Her plan is {realstic} enough to finish this month.
e.zh: 她的计划足够现实，这个月能完成。

e.en: The drawing looks {realstic} from a distance.
e.zh: 这幅画从远处看很逼真。

e.en: The dashboard updates sales data in {realtime}.
e.zh: 仪表盘会实时更新销售数据。

e.en: Gamers need fast {realtime} communication during matches.
e.zh: 玩家在比赛中需要快速的实时沟通。

e.en: The circuit kept {reamplifying} the weak radio signal.
e.zh: 这个电路不断重新放大微弱的无线电信号。

e.en: The article risked {reamplifying} the harmful rumor.
e.zh: 这篇文章有可能再次放大那条有害谣言。

e.en: Researchers will {reanalyze} the data with a newer model.
e.zh: 研究人员将用更新的模型重新分析这些数据。

e.en: Please {reanalyze} the sample before reporting the result.
e.zh: 请在报告结果前重新分析这个样本。

e.en: The empire tried to {reannex} the province after the revolt.
e.zh: 叛乱后，帝国试图重新兼并该省。

e.en: Parliament refused to {reannex} the disputed territory.
e.zh: 议会拒绝再次吞并那片争议领土。

e.en: The treaty blocked the {reannexation} of the island.
e.zh: 该条约阻止了对该岛的重新兼并。

e.en: Historians still debate the legality of the {reannexation}.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论那次再吞并是否合法。

e.en: The farmer sharpened his {reaphook} before dawn.
e.zh: 农夫天亮前磨好了他的收割镰。

e.en: An old {reaphook} hung above the barn door.
e.zh: 一把旧割禾钩挂在谷仓门上方。

e.en: The costume team had to {reapparel} the actors quickly.
e.zh: 服装组不得不迅速重新给演员穿衣。

e.en: Spring seemed to {reapparel} the hills in green.
e.zh: 春天仿佛给群山重新披上绿色。

e.en: The comet's {reapparition} excited amateur astronomers.
e.zh: 彗星的再次出现让业余天文学家很兴奋。

e.en: She feared the {reapparition} of old symptoms.
e.zh: 她担心旧症状会重新出现。

e.en: The committee will {reapportion} seats after the census.
e.zh: 委员会将在普查后重新分配席位。

e.en: Managers decided to {reapportion} the project budget.
e.zh: 经理们决定重新分配项目预算。

e.en: The districts were {reapportioned} after population shifts.
e.zh: 人口变化后，各选区被重新划分。

e.en: Funds were {reapportioned} to cover emergency repairs.
e.zh: 资金被重新分配，用于支付紧急维修。

e.en: The state is {reapportioning} legislative seats this year.
e.zh: 该州今年正在重新分配立法席位。

e.en: They are {reapportioning} staff across three departments.
e.zh: 他们正在三个部门之间重新分配人员。

e.en: The formula {reapportions} seats every ten years.
e.zh: 这个公式每十年重新分配一次席位。

e.en: The director {reapportions} funds when priorities change.
e.zh: 优先事项变化时，主管会重新分配资金。

e.en: We should {reapproach} the client with a clearer offer.
e.zh: 我们应该带着更清楚的报价再次接触客户。

e.en: After new evidence emerged, she chose to {reapproach} the problem.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，她选择重新处理这个问题。

e.en: The council voted to {reappropriate} funds for housing.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定重新拨用资金建住房。

e.en: Artists often {reappropriate} old symbols for new meanings.
e.zh: 艺术家常重新占用旧符号，赋予新意义。

e.en: The bill {reappropriates} unused money for schools.
e.zh: 该法案把未用资金重新拨给学校。

e.en: Her work {reappropriates} stereotypes and turns them into satire.
e.zh: 她的作品重新占用刻板印象，并将其变成讽刺。

e.en: Our car was {rear-ended} at the traffic light.
e.zh: 我们的车在红绿灯处被追尾了。

e.en: He {rear-ended} a truck during the morning commute.
e.zh: 他在早高峰通勤时从后面撞上了一辆卡车。

e.en: The driver admitted {rear-ending} the taxi.
e.zh: 司机承认追尾了那辆出租车。

e.en: Distracted driving often leads to {rear-ending} another vehicle.
e.zh: 分心驾驶常会导致从后方撞上其他车辆。

e.en: He always brakes late and nearly {rear-ends} people.
e.zh: 他总是很晚才刹车，差点追尾别人。

e.en: The bus {rear-ends} a van in the opening scene.
e.zh: 开场一幕中，公交车从后面撞上了一辆货车。

e.en: The old sports car was {rear-engined} and lightweight.
e.zh: 那辆老跑车是后置发动机，而且车身很轻。

e.en: Mechanics praised the {rear-engined} design for traction.
e.zh: 技师称赞这种后置发动机设计有利于抓地。

e.en: The spare tire sits in the {rear-most} compartment.
e.zh: 备用轮胎放在最靠后的舱格里。

e.en: She chose the {rear-most} seat on the bus.
e.zh: 她选了公交车最后面的座位。

e.en: The film used {rear-projection} for the driving scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影的驾驶场景使用了背投技术。

e.en: Their old television had a {rear-projection} screen.
e.zh: 他们的旧电视采用后方投影屏幕。

e.en: The runner felt pain in her {rearfoot} after training.
e.zh: 训练后，那名跑者感到脚后部疼痛。

e.en: These shoes provide extra {rearfoot} cushioning.
e.zh: 这双鞋在后足部位提供额外缓震。

e.en: The lawyer asked to {reargue} the case before the court.
e.zh: 律师请求在法庭上重新辩论此案。

e.en: There is no point trying to {reargue} every old disagreement.
e.zh: 试图重新争辩每个旧分歧没有意义。

reargued.t: 重新辩论了；再次争辩过

e.en: The appeal was {reargued} before a full panel.
e.zh: 该上诉在全体法官小组面前重新辩论。

e.en: They {reargued} the same issue for hours.
e.zh: 他们就同一个问题又争辩了好几个小时。

e.en: The court granted a {reargument} of the motion.
e.zh: 法院准许对该动议重新辩论。

e.en: Their dinner turned into a {reargument} about money.
e.zh: 他们的晚餐变成了关于钱的再次争吵。

e.en: The {rearhorse} stumbled as the wagon turned.
e.zh: 马车转弯时，后排的马绊了一下。

e.en: He tightened the harness on the {rearhorse}.
e.zh: 他把后马身上的挽具系紧了。

e.en: The city bought a new {rearloader} for trash collection.
e.zh: 市政府买了一辆新的后装式垃圾车。

e.en: A {rearloader} is useful on narrow residential streets.
e.zh: 后装式车辆在狭窄的居民街道上很有用。

rebab.t: 热巴布琴；中东弓弦乐器

e.en: The musician played a {rebab} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式上，乐师演奏了一把热巴布琴。

e.en: A {rebab} often has a small body and bowed strings.
e.zh: 热巴布琴通常琴身较小，并用弓拉奏琴弦。

e.en: The carpenter had to {rebabbit} the old window frame.
e.zh: 木匠不得不重新给旧窗框开榫槽。

e.en: They {rebabbit} the joint so the shelf sits flush.
e.zh: 他们重做了接合槽，好让架子贴合平整。

e.en: {Rebabbiting} the frame took longer than expected.
e.zh: 重新给框架开榫槽花的时间比预期更久。

e.en: Careful {rebabbiting} can save a damaged cabinet door.
e.zh: 仔细重做凹槽能修好受损的柜门。

e.en: The company will {rebadge} the car for another market.
e.zh: 公司会把这款车换标后卖到另一个市场。

e.en: They {rebadged} the software as a premium product.
e.zh: 他们把这款软件重新包装成高端产品销售。

e.en: {Rebaking} the bread made the crust crisp again.
e.zh: 重新烘烤让面包皮又变得酥脆。

e.en: The ceramic tiles needed {rebaking} after the glaze failed.
e.zh: 釉面失败后，这些瓷砖需要再次烧制。

e.en: The startup considered {rebanking} after its account was closed.
e.zh: 账户被关闭后，这家初创公司考虑重新开户。

e.en: {Rebanking} the river helped protect the fields from flooding.
e.zh: 重新修筑河堤有助于保护田地免受洪水侵袭。

e.en: The sect practiced {rebaptism} for adult converts.
e.zh: 这个教派会为成年皈依者施行再洗礼。

e.en: He described the move as a kind of political {rebaptism}.
e.zh: 他把这次转变形容为一种政治上的重新洗礼。

e.en: The preacher refused to {rebaptize} the new member.
e.zh: 牧师拒绝再次为这名新成员施洗。

e.en: The party tried to {rebaptize} itself with a new slogan.
e.zh: 该党试图用新口号为自己重新洗牌。

rebaptizer.t: 主张再洗礼者；再施洗者

e.en: The pamphlet attacked him as a dangerous {rebaptizer}.
e.zh: 那本小册子攻击他是危险的再洗礼主张者。

e.en: A {rebaptizer} visited the village to preach his doctrine.
e.zh: 一名再施洗者来到村里宣讲他的教义。

e.en: Workers tied the {rebar} before pouring the concrete.
e.zh: 工人们在浇筑混凝土前绑好了钢筋。

e.en: Rusty {rebar} can weaken an old bridge.
e.zh: 生锈的钢筋会削弱旧桥的结构。

e.en: The critic said the war would {rebarbarize} society.
e.zh: 评论家说，这场战争会使社会重新野蛮化。

e.en: Propaganda can {rebarbarize} people who once valued law.
e.zh: 宣传可能让曾经重视法律的人重新变得野蛮。

e.en: The damaged trunk began to {rebark} after spring rains.
e.zh: 春雨过后，受损的树干开始重新长出树皮。

e.en: The startled dog seemed to {rebark} at every passing car.
e.zh: 受惊的狗似乎对每辆经过的车都再次狂吠。

e.en: The tenant requested a {rebatement} of the rent.
e.zh: 租户请求减免一部分租金。

e.en: The contract allowed a {rebatement} for late delivery.
e.zh: 合同允许因交货延迟而给予扣减。

e.en: Her costume included a stiff {rebato} around the neck.
e.zh: 她的戏服在颈部配有硬挺的旧式高领。

e.en: The portrait shows a lace {rebato} framing her face.
e.zh: 画像中，蕾丝轮状皱领衬托着她的脸。

e.en: The {rebbitzin} welcomed guests after the service.
e.zh: 礼拜结束后，拉比的妻子接待了客人。

e.en: Many congregants asked the {rebbitzin} for advice.
e.zh: 许多会众向这位拉比夫人请教。

e.en: The minstrel carried a small {rebec} on his back.
e.zh: 游吟乐师背着一把小雷贝克琴。

e.en: A {rebec} has a sharp sound suited to medieval dance.
e.zh: 雷贝克琴声音尖亮，适合中世纪舞曲。

e.en: He tuned the {rebeck} before the court performance.
e.zh: 宫廷演出前，他调好了雷贝克琴。

e.en: The old song was accompanied by a {rebeck}.
e.zh: 这首古老歌曲由雷贝克琴伴奏。

e.en: The province became the center of {rebeldom}.
e.zh: 这个省成了叛乱势力的中心。

e.en: He wrote bitterly about his years in {rebeldom}.
e.zh: 他痛苦地写到自己身处反叛状态的那些年。

e.en: The crowd began to {rebellow} after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲结束后，人群又开始怒吼起来。

e.en: His command seemed to {rebellow} through the hall.
e.zh: 他的命令仿佛在大厅里回声般咆哮。

e.en: The contractor decided to {rebid} for the project.
e.zh: 承包商决定重新竞标这个项目。

e.en: In bridge, she chose to {rebid} her strongest suit.
e.zh: 打桥牌时，她选择再次叫出自己最强的花色。

e.en: The clinic had to {rebill} the patient after an error.
e.zh: 出错后，诊所不得不重新给病人开账单。

e.en: The service will {rebill} your card next month.
e.zh: 这项服务下个月会再次从你的卡里扣费。

e.en: The company started {rebilling} customers after fixing the invoice errors.
e.zh: 公司修正发票错误后开始重新向客户收费。

e.en: Automatic {rebilling} can surprise users who forgot to cancel.
e.zh: 自动再次收费可能会让忘记取消的用户感到意外。

e.en: The librarian will {rebind} the damaged history book.
e.zh: 图书管理员会把那本受损的历史书重新装订。

e.en: You may need to {rebind} the shortcut after updating the app.
e.zh: 更新应用后，你可能需要重新绑定这个快捷键。

e.en: The old volume is ready for {rebinding} at the workshop.
e.zh: 这本旧书已经可以送到工坊重新装订。

e.en: Key {rebinding} lets players choose controls that feel natural.
e.zh: 按键重新绑定能让玩家选择更顺手的操作方式。

e.en: She {rebinds} rare books for private collectors.
e.zh: 她为私人收藏家重新装订珍本书。

e.en: The software {rebinds} the device when the connection drops.
e.zh: 连接中断时，软件会重新绑定该设备。

e.en: The technician finished {reblading} the worn turbine assembly.
e.zh: 技术员完成了磨损涡轮组件的叶片更换。

e.en: Regular {reblading} keeps the cutting machine accurate.
e.zh: 定期重新装刀片能让切割机保持精确。

e.en: The winemaker tried {reblending} the batch after tasting it.
e.zh: 酿酒师品尝后尝试重新调配这一批酒。

e.en: Careful {reblending} helped the paint match the original color.
e.zh: 细致的重新混合让油漆接近了原来的颜色。

e.en: With enough light, the orchid may {rebloom} in spring.
e.zh: 光照充足的话，这株兰花春天可能会再次开花。

e.en: The district began to {rebloom} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 多年被忽视后，这个街区开始重新繁盛起来。

e.en: The cherry tree seemed to {reblossom} after the late rain.
e.zh: 晚来的雨后，那棵樱桃树似乎又开花了。

e.en: Their friendship began to {reblossom} during the reunion.
e.zh: 重聚期间，他们的友谊开始重新热络起来。

e.en: The glassmaker considered {reblowing} the vase to fix its shape.
e.zh: 玻璃匠考虑重新吹制花瓶来修正形状。

e.en: Repeated {reblowing} cleared the dust from the narrow tube.
e.zh: 反复重新吹气把窄管里的灰尘清了出来。

e.en: A {reboant} cheer rolled through the stadium.
e.zh: 一阵轰鸣般的欢呼声在体育场里回荡。

e.en: The hall grew {reboant} with organ music.
e.zh: 大厅里回荡着管风琴声，显得洪亮震荡。

e.en: Passengers {reboarded} the plane after the security check.
e.zh: 安检结束后，乘客重新登上了飞机。

e.en: We {reboarded} the bus at the next stop.
e.zh: 我们在下一站又上了那辆公交车。

e.en: The spirit was {rebodied} in a new human form.
e.zh: 那个灵魂被重新赋予了一个新的人形身体。

e.en: The vintage car was {rebodied} after a serious crash.
e.zh: 那辆老爷车在严重撞毁后换了新车身。

e.en: The artist wanted to {rebody} the myth in modern images.
e.zh: 艺术家想用现代图像重新赋予这个神话以形体。

e.en: The garage can {rebody} the damaged truck this month.
e.zh: 修车厂这个月可以给那辆受损卡车换车身。

e.en: Please {reboil} the water before making tea.
e.zh: 泡茶前请把水重新烧开。

e.en: Do not {reboil} the sauce too often, or it may thicken.
e.zh: 不要太频繁地重新煮沸酱汁，否则它可能会变稠。

e.en: She {reboiled} the soup before serving dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐上桌前，她把汤重新煮开了。

e.en: The {reboiled} water tasted flat to him.
e.zh: 他觉得重新烧开的水喝起来没什么味道。

e.en: The refinery replaced a leaking {reboiler} during maintenance.
e.zh: 炼油厂在检修期间更换了漏水的再沸器。

e.en: A small {reboiler} keeps the liquid at the required temperature.
e.zh: 一台小型再沸器让液体保持在所需温度。

e.en: The mill installed a {rebolter} for finer flour.
e.zh: 磨坊安装了一台重新筛粉机来得到更细的面粉。

e.en: A skilled {rebolter} checked the meal before packing.
e.zh: 熟练的复筛工在包装前检查了粉料。

rebond.t: 重新黏合；重新建立联系

e.en: Use this glue to {rebond} the loose tile.
e.zh: 用这种胶把松动的瓷砖重新黏合起来。

e.en: The retreat helped the team {rebond} after months of conflict.
e.zh: 这次静修帮助团队在数月冲突后重新建立联系。

e.en: I need to {rebook} my flight for next Monday.
e.zh: 我需要把航班改订到下周一。

e.en: The hotel allowed us to {rebook} without a fee.
e.zh: 酒店允许我们免费重新预订。

rebop.t: 比波普爵士乐；跳跃节奏

e.en: The drummer slipped into {rebop} during the late set.
e.zh: 鼓手在晚场演出中转入了比波普爵士乐节奏。

e.en: Old {rebop} records filled the tiny basement bar.
e.zh: 老比波普爵士唱片的声音充满了那间小地下酒吧。

e.en: The mechanic had to {rebore} the engine cylinder.
e.zh: 机械师不得不重新镗削发动机气缸。

e.en: They will {rebore} the pipe to restore the proper diameter.
e.zh: 他们会重新镗孔，使管道恢复合适的直径。

e.en: The workshop specializes in {reboring} worn cylinders.
e.zh: 这家车间专门重新镗削磨损的气缸。

e.en: Careful {reboring} improved the fit of the metal sleeve.
e.zh: 细致的重新镗孔改善了金属套筒的贴合度。

e.en: She wrapped a red {rebozo} around her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把一条红色墨西哥披巾披在肩上。

e.en: The baby slept against her chest in a woven {rebozo}.
e.zh: 婴儿躺在她胸前的编织长披巾里睡着了。

e.en: The pruned shrub may {rebranch} near the base.
e.zh: 修剪过的灌木可能会在根部附近重新分枝。

e.en: Developers decided to {rebranch} the project after the release.
e.zh: 发布之后，开发人员决定为项目另开一个分支。

e.en: The camera is {rearmounted} for a clearer road view.
e.zh: 摄像头安装在后部，以便更清楚地观察路况。

e.en: A {rearmounted} engine changes the car's balance.
e.zh: 后置发动机会改变汽车的重量平衡。

rearmouse.t: 后部鼠标；后置鼠标装置

e.en: The prototype uses a {rearmouse} for hidden cursor control.
e.zh: 这个原型使用后置鼠标来隐藏式控制光标。

e.en: She replaced the broken {rearmouse} in the lab device.
e.zh: 她更换了实验设备里损坏的后部鼠标装置。

e.en: The balloon began to {reascend} after dropping its ballast.
e.zh: 气球丢下压舱物后又开始上升。

e.en: He hoped to {reascend} the throne after years in exile.
e.zh: 流亡多年后，他希望重新登上王位。

e.en: The capsule's {reascension} surprised the tracking team.
e.zh: 太空舱再次上升让追踪小组感到意外。

e.en: The king's {reascension} restored the old court rituals.
e.zh: 国王重新登位恢复了旧日的宫廷礼仪。

e.en: His {reasonless} anger frightened everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他毫无理由的怒气吓坏了晚餐上的所有人。

e.en: The law seemed {reasonless} to those affected by it.
e.zh: 在受影响的人看来，这项法律毫无道理。

e.en: She was {reasonlessly} blamed for the delay.
e.zh: 她无缘无故地被责怪造成了延误。

e.en: The rule was applied {reasonlessly} across different cases.
e.zh: 这条规则在不同案件中被不合理地套用。

e.en: The community helped refugees {reassimilate} after the war.
e.zh: 战后，社区帮助难民重新融入当地生活。

e.en: The body can {reassimilate} some minerals during recovery.
e.zh: 身体在恢复期间能再次吸收一些矿物质。

e.en: Therapy helped him {reassociate} the memory with safety.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他把那段记忆重新与安全感联系起来。

e.en: Please {reassociate} your account with the new email address.
e.zh: 请将你的账户重新关联到新的电子邮箱地址。

reassociated.t: 已重新联系的；重新关联的

e.en: The file was {reassociated} with the correct program.
e.zh: 这个文件已重新关联到正确的程序。

e.en: She {reassociated} the song with a happier time.
e.zh: 她把这首歌重新和一段更快乐的时光联系起来。

reassorted.t: 重新分类的；重新搭配的

e.en: The cards were {reassorted} after each round.
e.zh: 每一轮之后，卡片都会被重新分类。

e.en: The shop displayed {reassorted} gift boxes for spring.
e.zh: 商店陈列了为春季重新搭配的礼盒。

e.en: His {reassumption} of office calmed the staff.
e.zh: 他重新就职让员工们安定下来。

e.en: The treaty allowed the {reassumption} of trade.
e.zh: 这项条约允许贸易重新开始。

e.en: Cool the mixture until it begins to {reast}.
e.zh: 把混合物冷却到它开始重新凝固为止。

e.en: The wax may {reast} around the wick overnight.
e.zh: 蜡可能会在夜里围着烛芯重新凝结。

e.en: The cowboy coiled his {reata} beside the saddle.
e.zh: 牛仔把套索盘好放在马鞍旁。

e.en: A good {reata} must be strong and flexible.
e.zh: 一根好的牧牛套索必须结实又柔韧。

e.en: Use this clip to {reattach} the loose cable.
e.zh: 用这个夹子把松开的电缆重新固定好。

e.en: Surgeons tried to {reattach} the severed finger.
e.zh: 外科医生试图把断指重新接上。

e.en: The mechanic checked the {reattachment} of the panel.
e.zh: 机械师检查了面板是否重新装牢。

e.en: Successful {reattachment} of the retina saved her sight.
e.zh: 视网膜成功复位让她保住了视力。

e.en: The athlete trained hard to {reattain} his speed.
e.zh: 这名运动员刻苦训练，以重新达到原来的速度。

e.en: The company hopes to {reattain} profitability this year.
e.zh: 公司希望今年重新实现盈利。

e.en: The policy aimed at the {reattainment} of price stability.
e.zh: 这项政策旨在重新实现价格稳定。

e.en: Her {reattainment} of confidence took several months.
e.zh: 她重新找回信心花了好几个月。

e.en: They will {reattempt} the climb at dawn.
e.zh: 他们将在黎明时再次尝试攀登。

e.en: A second {reattempt} may overload the system.
e.zh: 第二次重新尝试可能会使系统过载。

e.en: Raiders came to {reave} the coastal village.
e.zh: 袭击者前来抢掠这个沿海村庄。

e.en: Grief can {reave} a person of sleep.
e.zh: 悲痛会夺走一个人的睡眠。

e.en: The invaders {reaved} the town of its stores.
e.zh: 入侵者抢走了镇上的储备物资。

e.en: The storm {reaved} many families of their homes.
e.zh: 暴风雨夺走了许多家庭的住所。

e.en: The villagers hid when the {reavers} approached.
e.zh: 掠夺者逼近时，村民们躲了起来。

e.en: Border {reavers} were feared across the valley.
e.zh: 边境抢掠者让整个山谷的人都感到恐惧。

e.en: The war {reaves} families of peace and safety.
e.zh: 战争夺走了家庭的安宁与安全。

e.en: Legend says he {reaves} treasure from passing ships.
e.zh: 传说他会从过往船只上抢掠财宝。

e.en: The coast suffered years of {reaving} by pirates.
e.zh: 这片海岸多年遭受海盗抢掠之苦。

e.en: His {reaving} words stripped her of hope.
e.zh: 他那些夺人希望的话让她心灰意冷。

e.en: The old diary called him a {reb} soldier.
e.zh: 那本旧日记称他为南方邦联士兵。

e.en: Some locals used {reb} as a political insult.
e.zh: 有些当地人把“叛军”这个词当作政治辱骂。

e.en: The company will {rebrand} its stores next year.
e.zh: 这家公司明年会重塑门店品牌。

e.en: They tried to {rebrand} the policy as a reform.
e.zh: 他们试图把这项政策重新包装成改革。

e.en: The {rebranding} campaign changed the logo and slogan.
e.zh: 这次品牌重塑活动更换了标志和口号。

e.en: His speech felt like political {rebranding}.
e.zh: 他的演讲听起来像是在做政治上的重新包装。

e.en: Divers must not {rebreathe} too much stale air.
e.zh: 潜水员不能反复吸入太多污浊空气。

e.en: She paused to {rebreathe} before continuing the exercise.
e.zh: 她停下来重新调整呼吸，然后继续练习。

e.en: The trapped air was {rebreathed} inside the mask.
e.zh: 滞留的空气在面罩里被再次吸入。

e.en: He {rebreathed} slowly until his pulse settled.
e.zh: 他慢慢重新呼吸，直到脉搏平稳下来。

rebreather.t: 循环呼吸器；再呼吸装置

e.en: The diver checked his {rebreather} before entering the cave.
e.zh: 潜水员进洞前检查了他的循环呼吸器。

e.en: A {rebreather} can recycle exhaled gas.
e.zh: 循环呼吸器可以回收呼出的气体。

e.en: The department began {rebudgeting} after the funding cut.
e.zh: 经费削减后，部门开始重新编制预算。

e.en: Careful {rebudgeting} helped them avoid layoffs.
e.zh: 谨慎调整预算帮助他们避免了裁员。

e.en: His rude interruption was clearly {rebukable}.
e.zh: 他粗鲁地打断别人，显然应受责备。

e.en: The mistake was minor but still {rebukable}.
e.zh: 这个错误虽小，但仍然可以斥责。

e.en: She gave him a {rebukeful} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去责备的目光。

e.en: His {rebukeful} tone silenced the room.
e.zh: 他责难的语气让整个房间安静下来。

rebunk.t: 重新相信；反驳辟谣说法

e.en: The article tried to {rebunk} the old conspiracy theory.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图重新为那个旧阴谋论辩护。

e.en: Some critics {rebunk} myths after others debunk them.
e.zh: 有些评论者会在别人辟谣后又替神话翻案。

e.en: Her {rebutment} addressed every accusation in detail.
e.zh: 她的反驳详细回应了每一项指控。

e.en: The lawyer prepared a concise {rebutment}.
e.zh: 律师准备了一份简明的抗辩陈述。

e.en: The manager was frustrated by the team's {recalcitrancy}.
e.zh: 经理对团队的顽抗态度感到沮丧。

e.en: His {recalcitrancy} made compromise nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他的桀骜不驯让妥协几乎不可能。

e.en: Some officials continued to {recalcitrate} despite the order.
e.zh: 尽管有命令，一些官员仍继续顽抗。

e.en: The child may {recalcitrate} when routines change suddenly.
e.zh: 日常安排突然改变时，孩子可能会拒不服从。

e.en: The committee {recalcitrated} until public pressure grew.
e.zh: 委员会一直顽抗，直到公众压力增大。

e.en: He {recalcitrated} whenever anyone questioned his authority.
e.zh: 每当有人质疑他的权威时，他就拒不服从。

e.en: She {recalcitrates} when forced into a decision.
e.zh: 被迫作决定时，她就会顽抗。

e.en: The system {recalcitrates} under heavy administrative control.
e.zh: 在严密行政控制下，这个系统会抗拒运作。

e.en: The {recalcitrating} officials delayed the reform again.
e.zh: 那些顽抗的官员再次拖延了改革。

e.en: He kept {recalcitrating} instead of admitting the mistake.
e.zh: 他一直拒不服从，而不是承认错误。

e.en: Their {recalcitration} slowed the negotiations for weeks.
e.zh: 他们的顽抗让谈判拖慢了好几个星期。

e.en: The report blamed bureaucratic {recalcitration}.
e.zh: 报告将问题归咎于官僚体系的拒不配合。

e.en: The droplets began to {recalesce} on the cold glass.
e.zh: 水滴开始在冰冷的玻璃上重新聚合。

e.en: Old factions may {recalesce} after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，旧派系可能会重新结合。

e.en: The alloy showed {recalescence} as it solidified.
e.zh: 合金凝固时出现了再辉热现象。

e.en: Scientists measured the brief {recalescence} during cooling.
e.zh: 科学家测量了冷却过程中短暂的重新升温现象。

e.en: Technicians must {recalibrate} the sensors every month.
e.zh: 技术人员必须每月重新校准传感器。

e.en: The crisis forced leaders to {recalibrate} their strategy.
e.zh: 这场危机迫使领导者重新调整战略。

e.en: The defective batteries are {recallable} under safety rules.
e.zh: 这些有缺陷的电池按安全规定可以召回。

e.en: Only a few details remained {recallable} after years.
e.zh: 多年之后，只有少数细节还记得起来。

e.en: The formal {recallment} of the envoy surprised observers.
e.zh: 正式召回特使让观察人士感到意外。

e.en: Her {recallment} of childhood scenes was vivid.
e.zh: 她对童年场景的回忆十分生动。

e.en: She rested on a velvet {recamier} by the window.
e.zh: 她靠窗躺在一张天鹅绒雷卡米耶式卧榻上。

e.en: The antique {recamier} suited the drawing room.
e.zh: 那张古董雷卡米耶式卧榻很适合客厅。

e.en: Doctors confirmed {recanalization} of the blocked artery.
e.zh: 医生确认堵塞的动脉已经再通。

e.en: Natural {recanalization} can occur after a clot dissolves.
e.zh: 血栓溶解后可能发生自然再通。

e.en: The procedure can {recanalize} a blocked vessel.
e.zh: 这种手术可以使堵塞的血管再通。

e.en: Surgeons tried to {recanalize} the narrowed duct.
e.zh: 外科医生试图让变窄的导管重新通畅。

e.en: The metal showed {recandescence} as it was heated again.
e.zh: 金属再次受热时重新炽热发光。

e.en: The poet imagined hope as a quiet {recandescence}.
e.zh: 诗人把希望想象成一种静静复燃的光。

recapitalise.t: 重新注资；调整资本结构

e.en: The bank agreed to {recapitalise} the failing insurer.
e.zh: 银行同意为这家濒危保险公司重新注资。

e.en: They plan to {recapitalise} the firm after the merger.
e.zh: 他们计划在合并后调整公司的资本结构。

e.en: The final chapter is largely {recapitulative}.
e.zh: 最后一章主要是在概括前文要点。

e.en: Her {recapitulative} remarks helped the audience follow the argument.
e.zh: 她的总结性发言帮助听众跟上论证。

e.en: He gave a {recapitulatory} lecture before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前他做了一场提纲挈领的复习课。

e.en: The report ends with a {recapitulatory} table of findings.
e.zh: 报告最后用一张总结表列出研究结果。

recappable.t: 可重盖的；可重新概述的

e.en: The bottle has a {recappable} top for travel.
e.zh: 这个瓶子有可重新盖上的瓶盖，适合旅行。

e.en: The plot is easily {recappable} in a few lines.
e.zh: 这个情节很容易用几句话重新概括。

e.en: The editor requested a {recaption} for the old photograph.
e.zh: 编辑要求给那张老照片重新配说明文字。

e.en: A careful {recaption} made the chart less misleading.
e.zh: 重新认真标注后，这张图表不那么容易误导人了。

e.en: The steel required {recarburization} after refining.
e.zh: 钢材精炼后需要重新增碳。

e.en: Poor control of {recarburization} can weaken the casting.
e.zh: 再渗碳控制不当会削弱铸件强度。

e.en: Technicians must {recarburize} the molten iron before casting.
e.zh: 技术人员必须在浇铸前给铁水重新增碳。

e.en: The process can {recarburize} a surface layer of steel.
e.zh: 该工艺可以使钢材表层再渗碳。

e.en: The foundry added a graphite {recarburizer} to the melt.
e.zh: 铸造厂向熔液中加入了石墨增碳剂。

e.en: A low-quality {recarburizer} may introduce unwanted impurities.
e.zh: 劣质增碳剂可能带入不需要的杂质。

e.en: The soldiers made a quick {reccy} before dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明前做了一次快速侦察。

e.en: We did a {reccy} of the venue before the event.
e.zh: 活动前我们先去场地踩了点。

receiptor.t: 收据签发人；保管接收人

e.en: The {receiptor} signed for the seized goods.
e.zh: 接收保管人签收了被扣押的货物。

e.en: A court may appoint a {receiptor} for disputed property.
e.zh: 法院可以为有争议的财产指定接收保管人。

e.en: The court questioned the {receivability} of the evidence.
e.zh: 法院质疑这份证据是否可以受理。

e.en: Engineers tested the signal's {receivability} inside the tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师测试了隧道内信号的可接收性。

e.en: Please confirm {receival} of the documents by email.
e.zh: 请通过邮件确认已收到这些文件。

e.en: The warehouse records every {receival} of fresh produce.
e.zh: 仓库会记录每一次新鲜农产品的收货。

e.en: The network uses several {receiving-stations} along the coast.
e.zh: 该网络在沿海设置了多个接收站。

e.en: Old radio {receiving-stations} were converted into museums.
e.zh: 旧的无线电接收站被改造成了博物馆。

recelebrate.t: 重新庆祝；再次举行仪式

e.en: They decided to {recelebrate} their wedding with family.
e.zh: 他们决定和家人重新庆祝婚礼。

e.en: The priest was asked to {recelebrate} the mass.
e.zh: 有人请神父再次举行弥撒仪式。

recemented.t: 重新黏合的；再用水泥固定的

e.en: The loose crown was {recemented} by the dentist.
e.zh: 牙医把松动的牙冠重新粘牢了。

e.en: Workers {recemented} the tiles after the leak was fixed.
e.zh: 漏水修好后，工人们把瓷砖重新用水泥固定。

e.en: Scholars tried to {recense} the medieval manuscript.
e.zh: 学者们试图校勘这份中世纪手稿。

e.en: The editor will {recense} the poem against earlier copies.
e.zh: 编辑会对照早期抄本修订这首诗。

e.en: This {recension} of the epic differs from the printed version.
e.zh: 这部史诗的校订本与印刷版不同。

e.en: The article discusses the manuscript's later {recension}.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了该手稿后来的文本修订。

recensionist.t: 文本校订者；修订派学者

e.en: The {recensionist} compared every surviving copy of the text.
e.zh: 文本校订者比较了这部作品现存的每一个抄本。

e.en: A cautious {recensionist} avoids modernizing old spellings too freely.
e.zh: 谨慎的校订者不会随意把古旧拼写现代化。

recentralizing.t: 重新集中管理；再中央集权

e.en: The ministry is {recentralizing} control over local budgets.
e.zh: 该部正在重新集中管理地方预算。

e.en: Critics warned that {recentralizing} power would weaken regional voices.
e.zh: 批评者警告说，重新集中权力会削弱地方声音。

e.en: The philosopher distinguished a {recept} from an abstract concept.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把感知对象和抽象概念区分开来。

e.en: Each sensory {recept} was treated as part of experience.
e.zh: 每一个感知内容都被视为经验的一部分。

e.en: The specimen showed a small {receptaculum} near the duct.
e.zh: 标本显示导管附近有一个小囊腔。

e.en: Early writers used {receptaculum} to mean a container or holder.
e.zh: 早期作者用receptaculum表示容器或承载物。

e.en: The theory depends on the mind's {receptibility} to impressions.
e.zh: 该理论依赖于心灵对印象的接纳能力。

e.en: Soil {receptibility} affects how much water the roots receive.
e.zh: 土壤的吸收能力会影响根部获得多少水分。

e.en: The surface is {receptible} to a thin coat of paint.
e.zh: 这个表面可以接受一层薄薄的油漆。

e.en: A tired audience is less {receptible} to complex arguments.
e.zh: 疲惫的听众不太容易接受复杂的论证。

e.en: Please wait in the {reception-room} until the doctor calls you.
e.zh: 请在接待室等候，直到医生叫你。

e.en: The hotel kept fresh flowers in its {reception-room}.
e.zh: 酒店在会客室里摆放了鲜花。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {receptorology} in nerve cells.
e.zh: 她的论文研究神经细胞中的受体学。

e.en: Advances in {receptorology} changed how the drug was designed.
e.zh: 受体研究的进展改变了这种药物的设计方式。

recession-resistant.t: 抗衰退的；不易受经济衰退影响的

e.en: Healthcare is often seen as a {recession-resistant} industry.
e.zh: 医疗保健常被视为抗衰退行业。

e.en: She moved her savings into more {recession-resistant} investments.
e.zh: 她把储蓄转入更不易受经济衰退影响的投资。

e.en: The warehouse is {receving} new stock today.
e.zh: 仓库今天正在接收新货。

e.en: She noticed the email was marked as {receving} late.
e.zh: 她注意到那封邮件被标为收到较晚。

e.en: The lawyer {rechallenges} the evidence after new facts appear.
e.zh: 新事实出现后，律师再次质疑证据。

e.en: The champion {rechallenges} himself with a harder race.
e.zh: 冠军用一场更难的比赛再次挑战自己。

rechamber.t: 重新装入膛室；再置入腔室

e.en: The technician had to {rechamber} the sample before testing.
e.zh: 技术员必须在测试前把样品重新置入腔室。

e.en: He learned how to {rechamber} the rifle safely.
e.zh: 他学会了如何安全地给步枪重新上膛。

e.en: They may {rechange} the schedule if the storm worsens.
e.zh: 如果风暴加剧，他们可能会再次更改日程。

e.en: Do not {rechange} the settings without checking the manual.
e.zh: 没有查看手册前，不要重新更改设置。

e.en: The city will {rechannel} the stream away from the road.
e.zh: 市政府将把溪流改道，引离道路。

e.en: She tried to {rechannel} her anger into useful work.
e.zh: 她试着把怒气重新转化为有用的工作动力。

e.en: The project involves {rechanneling} water through a new tunnel.
e.zh: 这个项目包括通过新隧道改道输水。

e.en: He is {rechanneling} his energy into music.
e.zh: 他正在把精力重新投入音乐。

recharter.t: 重新租用；重新授予特许状

e.en: The company decided to {recharter} the vessel for another month.
e.zh: 公司决定把那艘船再租用一个月。

e.en: The legislature voted to {recharter} the old bank.
e.zh: 立法机构投票决定重新授予那家老银行特许状。

e.en: The teacher warned him not to {recheat} on the exam.
e.zh: 老师警告他不要在考试中再次作弊。

e.en: The scammer tried to {recheat} the same victims online.
e.zh: 骗子试图在网上再次欺骗同一批受害者。

e.en: The figures were {reched} before the report was sent.
e.zh: 报告发出前，这些数字被重新核对过。

e.en: He {reched} the lock after hearing a noise downstairs.
e.zh: 听到楼下有响动后，他又检查了一遍门锁。

e.en: The mill bought a {rechipper} for oversized wood pieces.
e.zh: 工厂买了一台重新切削机来处理过大的木块。

e.en: A skilled {rechipper} can recover usable material from waste.
e.zh: 熟练的再削片工能从废料中回收可用材料。

e.en: You can {rechoose} your seat after the page reloads.
e.zh: 页面重新加载后，你可以重新选择座位。

e.en: After failing the course, he had to {rechoose} his major.
e.zh: 课程不及格后，他不得不重新选择专业。

e.en: The chemist decided to {rechromatograph} the contaminated sample.
e.zh: 化学家决定对受污染的样品重新进行色谱分析。

e.en: They had to {rechromatograph} the extract to confirm the result.
e.zh: 他们必须对提取物再次做色谱分析以确认结果。

e.en: Stop the lathe before you {rechuck} the metal rod.
e.zh: 重新夹紧金属杆前，先停下车床。

e.en: The machinist had to {rechuck} the part for a cleaner cut.
e.zh: 机加工师必须重新装夹零件，以便切削得更干净。

e.en: {Rechucking} the pipe took longer than expected.
e.zh: 重新夹紧管子花的时间比预期更长。

e.en: Careless {rechucking} can throw the workpiece off center.
e.zh: 粗心的再装夹可能使工件偏离中心。

e.en: Without support, some former prisoners may {recidivate}.
e.zh: 没有支持时，一些前囚犯可能会再次犯罪。

e.en: Patients can {recidivate} after treatment if follow-up care is poor.
e.zh: 如果后续护理不足，患者治疗后可能复发。

e.en: The report found that he had {recidivated} within two years.
e.zh: 报告发现他在两年内再次犯罪。

e.en: Several patients {recidivated} after stopping the medication.
e.zh: 几名患者停药后病情复发。

e.en: The program tracks whether an offender {recidivates} after release.
e.zh: 该项目会跟踪罪犯获释后是否再次犯罪。

e.en: If the cancer {recidivates}, doctors may change the treatment.
e.zh: 如果癌症复发，医生可能会调整治疗方案。

recidivating.t: 正在再次犯罪；正在复发

e.en: The study examined factors linked to {recidivating} offenders.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了与再次犯罪者相关的因素。

e.en: Doctors monitored patients at risk of {recidivating} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生监测术后有复发风险的患者。

e.en: Education programs can reduce {recidivation} among young offenders.
e.zh: 教育项目可以减少青少年罪犯的再犯。

e.en: The clinic studies {recidivation} after long-term treatment.
e.zh: 诊所研究长期治疗后的复发现象。

e.en: The old tower was {reclad} in pale stone.
e.zh: 那座旧塔重新覆上了浅色石材。

e.en: Workers {reclad} the pipes after the inspection.
e.zh: 检查结束后，工人重新包覆了管道。

e.en: Most of the packaging is {reclaimable} after use.
e.zh: 这些包装大多用后可以回收再利用。

e.en: The damaged land may still be {reclaimable}.
e.zh: 那片受损土地或许仍能恢复利用。

e.en: The {reclaimant} filed documents proving ownership.
e.zh: 索回者提交了证明所有权的文件。

e.en: Each {reclaimant} must describe the lost property clearly.
e.zh: 每位申索人都必须清楚说明遗失财物。

e.en: She stopped to {reclasp} the necklace.
e.zh: 她停下来重新扣好项链。

e.en: He tried to {reclasp} her hand in the crowd.
e.zh: 在人群中，他试着再次握住她的手。

reclasped.t: 重新扣紧的；再次抱住的

e.en: The bracelet was {reclasped} before she left.
e.zh: 她离开前，手链被重新扣好了。

e.en: He {reclasped} the folder under his arm.
e.zh: 他又把文件夹夹在胳膊下。

e.en: The factory installed a {recleaner} for the grain.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台谷物再清洁机。

e.en: A careful {recleaner} checked every returned coat.
e.zh: 一名细心的复洗人员检查了每件退回的大衣。

e.en: The plant has {reclinate} leaves near the base.
e.zh: 这种植物基部附近有向后弯曲的叶子。

e.en: The sculpture shows a {reclinate} figure at rest.
e.zh: 这座雕塑表现了一个后倾休息的人像。

e.en: Store the snacks in a {reclosable} bag.
e.zh: 把零食放在可重新封口的袋子里。

e.en: The bottle has a {reclosable} safety cap.
e.zh: 这个瓶子配有可再次盖紧的安全盖。

e.en: Please {reclose} the gate after entering.
e.zh: 进来后请把大门重新关上。

e.en: The wound may {reclose} without surgery.
e.zh: 这个伤口可能不用手术也会再次愈合。

e.en: The road was {reclosed} after the parade.
e.zh: 游行结束后，道路又被封闭了。

e.en: She {reclosed} the drawer quietly.
e.zh: 她轻轻地又把抽屉关上。

e.en: The utility replaced a faulty {recloser} on the line.
e.zh: 电力公司更换了线路上有故障的重合闸器。

e.en: A reliable {recloser} prevents long power outages.
e.zh: 可靠的重合闸器能避免长时间停电。

e.en: The valve {recloses} automatically after ten seconds.
e.zh: 阀门十秒后会自动重新关闭。

e.en: She {recloses} the book whenever someone enters.
e.zh: 每当有人进来，她就又把书合上。

e.en: The shop is {reclosing} for repairs tomorrow.
e.zh: 这家店明天将再次关门维修。

e.en: He kept {reclosing} the window against the wind.
e.zh: 他不断把被风吹开的窗户重新关上。

e.en: Volunteers helped {reclothe} families after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后，志愿者帮助这些家庭重新添置衣物。

e.en: Spring rains will {reclothe} the hills in green.
e.zh: 春雨会让山坡重新披上绿色。

reclothed.t: 重新穿上衣服的；重新覆盖的

e.en: The children were {reclothed} with donated jackets.
e.zh: 孩子们穿上了捐赠的夹克，重新有了衣物。

e.en: The valley was {reclothed} in grass by June.
e.zh: 到六月，山谷又被青草覆盖。

e.en: Years of {reclusion} made him shy with strangers.
e.zh: 多年的隐居让他面对陌生人时很腼腆。

e.en: The writer chose {reclusion} after sudden fame.
e.zh: 突然成名后，那位作家选择了与世隔绝。

e.en: The ship had to {recoal} before crossing the ocean.
e.zh: 那艘船横渡大洋前必须重新装煤。

e.en: They stopped to {recoal} the old furnace.
e.zh: 他们停下来给旧炉子再加煤。

e.en: You should {recoat} the table after sanding it.
e.zh: 打磨之后，你应该给桌子重新涂一层漆。

e.en: The dentist decided to {recoat} the tooth with sealant.
e.zh: 牙医决定给那颗牙重新涂上封闭剂。

e.en: He was released on {recognisance} until trial.
e.zh: 他以具结担保方式获释，等待审判。

e.en: The court accepted her {recognisance} without cash bail.
e.zh: 法院接受了她的具结担保，没有要求现金保释。

e.en: The test measures {recognitional} memory in children.
e.zh: 这项测试衡量儿童的识别记忆。

e.en: The award has strong {recognitional} value for young artists.
e.zh: 这个奖项对年轻艺术家有很强的认可价值。

e.en: The judge noted the {recognitory} wording of the statement.
e.zh: 法官注意到声明中带有承认性质的措辞。

e.en: Birds may use {recognitory} calls within the flock.
e.zh: 鸟群内部可能会使用识别性的叫声。

e.en: The logo's {recognizability} helped the campaign spread.
e.zh: 标志的高辨认度帮助活动传播开来。

e.en: Age can reduce the {recognizability} of old photographs.
e.zh: 年代久远会降低老照片中人物的可识别性。

e.en: The committee was {recognizant} of the budget limits.
e.zh: 委员会意识到了预算限制。

e.en: He remained {recognizant} of his duty to report fairly.
e.zh: 他始终明白自己有公正报道的责任。

e.en: The study measured {recidivity} after release from prison.
e.zh: 这项研究衡量了出狱后的再犯倾向。

e.en: Poverty can increase {recidivity} among former offenders.
e.zh: 贫困可能会增加前罪犯的累犯性。

e.en: The court considered his {recidivous} conduct during sentencing.
e.zh: 法院在量刑时考虑了他惯于再犯的行为。

e.en: A {recidivous} offender needs careful supervision after release.
e.zh: 累犯者获释后需要谨慎监管。

e.en: The mill used a {reciner} to sort the flour again.
e.zh: 磨坊用再筛机把面粉重新筛分。

e.en: A careful {reciner} removed the remaining coarse grains.
e.zh: 细心的再筛工清除了剩下的粗颗粒。

e.en: The agent had to {recipher} the message before sending it.
e.zh: 特工在发送前必须重新加密这条消息。

e.en: They {reciphered} the code after a possible leak.
e.zh: 发现可能泄密后，他们重编了密码。

e.en: Her {recipience} of new ideas impressed the committee.
e.zh: 她接纳新思想的能力给委员会留下了印象。

e.en: The lecture depended on the audience's {recipience}.
e.zh: 这场讲座的效果取决于听众的接受程度。

e.en: Trust grows through {reciprocality} between neighbors.
e.zh: 邻里之间的相互性会让信任增长。

e.en: The treaty emphasized {reciprocality} in trade concessions.
e.zh: 该条约强调贸易让步中的互惠关系。

e.en: The workshop repaired the old {reciprocating-apparatus} overnight.
e.zh: 车间连夜修好了那台旧的往复式装置。

e.en: A {reciprocating-apparatus} moves parts back and forth repeatedly.
e.zh: 往复式装置会反复带动部件来回运动。

e.en: Their friendship had a strongly {reciprocative} character.
e.zh: 他们的友谊带有很强的相互性。

e.en: The agreement created {reciprocative} duties for both parties.
e.zh: 这项协议为双方设立了互惠义务。

e.en: She was a generous {reciprocator} of every kindness.
e.zh: 别人对她好，她总是慷慨回报。

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {reciprocator} in the pump.
e.zh: 工程师调整了泵里的往复装置。

e.en: The clubs maintained a {reciprocatory} arrangement for members.
e.zh: 这些俱乐部为会员维持着互惠安排。

e.en: The machine used a {reciprocatory} motion to cut metal.
e.zh: 这台机器用往复运动来切割金属。

e.en: The economist called himself a {reciprocitarian} in trade policy.
e.zh: 这位经济学家称自己在贸易政策上是互惠主义者。

e.en: A strict {reciprocitarian} expects every favor to be returned.
e.zh: 严格的互惠主义者希望每个人情都得到回报。

e.en: The hikers had to {recircle} the lake after losing the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者迷路后不得不再次绕湖而行。

e.en: She used red ink to {recircle} the important date.
e.zh: 她用红墨水把那个重要日期重新圈起来。

e.en: The lawyer requested {recission} of the contract.
e.zh: 律师请求撤销该合同。

e.en: Parliament debated the {recission} of the old tax rule.
e.zh: 议会讨论废除那项旧税规。

e.en: The poem is short and easily {recitable}.
e.zh: 这首诗很短，很容易背诵。

e.en: She chose a {recitable} passage for the school event.
e.zh: 她为学校活动选了一段适合朗诵的文字。

e.en: The young {recitalist} played Bach with confidence.
e.zh: 这位年轻的独奏会演奏者自信地演奏了巴赫。

e.en: A skilled {recitalist} can hold an audience with one poem.
e.zh: 熟练的朗诵者能用一首诗吸引住听众。

e.en: The opera shifts into {recitatif} before the aria begins.
e.zh: 歌剧在咏叹调开始前转入宣叙调。

e.en: He delivered the line in a dry {recitatif}.
e.zh: 他用干涩的宣叙调唱出了那句台词。

e.en: The singer practiced the {recitativo} with the conductor.
e.zh: 歌手和指挥一起练习宣叙调。

e.en: A clear {recitativo} carries the plot forward.
e.zh: 清晰的宣叙调推动剧情向前发展。

e.en: The chant returns often to the same {recitingnote}.
e.zh: 这段圣咏常常回到同一个吟诵音。

e.en: The teacher marked the {recitingnote} above the psalm text.
e.zh: 老师在圣歌文本上方标出了朗诵基音。

e.en: The old spelling {reciver} appears in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿中出现了reciver这个旧拼法，意思是接收者。

e.en: Each {reciver} signed for the delivered goods.
e.zh: 每位接收者都签收了送达的货物。

e.en: The reformers hoped to {recivilize} the war-torn region.
e.zh: 改革者希望使这个饱受战争破坏的地区重新文明化。

e.en: Education was seen as a way to {recivilize} public life.
e.zh: 教育被视为让公共生活重新文明化的一种方式。

e.en: He did not {reck} the danger before him.
e.zh: 他并不在意眼前的危险。

e.en: Few now use {reck} except in old poetry.
e.zh: 如今除了古诗中，几乎没人使用reck这个词。

e.en: She never {recked} the cost of helping him.
e.zh: 她从未计较帮助他的代价。

e.en: The knight {recked} little of the coming storm.
e.zh: 那名骑士几乎不在意即将到来的风暴。

e.en: He went on, {recking} nothing of the warnings.
e.zh: 他继续前行，完全不顾那些警告。

e.en: Her {recking} of small insults made peace impossible.
e.zh: 她对小冒犯的在意让和解变得不可能。

e.en: The youngest child was called the family {reckling}.
e.zh: 最小的孩子被称为家里的体弱幼儿。

e.en: A tiny {reckling} survived despite the harsh winter.
e.zh: 一个瘦小的弱儿尽管寒冬严酷仍活了下来。

recognizee.t: 被识别者；被认出的人或物

e.en: The system stores each {recognizee} as a separate profile.
e.zh: 系统把每个被识别者存成单独的档案。

e.en: In the experiment, the {recognizee} was shown in several blurred photos.
e.zh: 实验中，被识别对象出现在几张模糊照片里。

e.en: The {recognizor} compared the face with old records.
e.zh: 识别者把这张脸和旧记录进行了比对。

e.en: A trained {recognizor} can notice tiny differences in handwriting.
e.zh: 受过训练的辨认者能注意到笔迹中的细微差别。

e.en: The museum displayed a {recoil-operated} machine gun.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一挺后坐力驱动的机枪。

e.en: A {recoil-operated} mechanism uses the kick from firing to cycle the weapon.
e.zh: 后坐力驱动机构利用射击时的反冲来完成枪械循环。

e.en: She stepped back {recoilingly} from the sudden flame.
e.zh: 她畏缩地从突然冒出的火焰旁退开。

e.en: He answered {recoilingly}, as if the question had hurt him.
e.zh: 他退缩地回答，仿佛那个问题刺痛了他。

recoin.t: 重新铸币；重新创造词语

e.en: The government decided to {recoin} the damaged silver pieces.
e.zh: 政府决定把受损的银币重新铸造。

e.en: Writers sometimes {recoin} old phrases for modern readers.
e.zh: 作家有时会为现代读者重新造用旧说法。

e.en: The {recoinage} replaced worn coins with cleaner designs.
e.zh: 这次重新铸币用更简洁的设计替换了磨损硬币。

e.en: His poem depends on the {recoinage} of forgotten words.
e.zh: 他的诗依靠对被遗忘词语的重新创造。

e.en: The tunnel {recollapses} whenever heavy rain loosens the soil.
e.zh: 大雨使土壤松动时，隧道就会再次塌陷。

e.en: The peace deal {recollapses} after each new border incident.
e.zh: 每次新的边境事件后，和平协议都会再度崩溃。

e.en: Her essay has a quiet, {recollective} tone.
e.zh: 她的文章带着安静的追忆语气。

e.en: The music created a {recollective} mood in the old hall.
e.zh: 音乐在旧大厅里营造出一种回忆的氛围。

e.en: You can {recolor} the icon to match the theme.
e.zh: 你可以重新给图标着色，让它配合主题。

e.en: The artist chose to {recolor} the sky in warmer tones.
e.zh: 画家决定用更暖的色调重新处理天空颜色。

e.en: The app supports quick {recoloring} of old photos.
e.zh: 这个应用支持快速给旧照片重新上色。

e.en: Her {recoloring} of the logo made it easier to read.
e.zh: 她对标志的改色让它更容易辨认。

e.en: The designer will {recolour} the buttons for the British version.
e.zh: 设计师会为英国版本重新调整按钮颜色。

e.en: They used software to {recolour} the black-and-white footage.
e.zh: 他们用软件给黑白影像重新上色。

e.en: The lab studied {recombinational} repair in damaged DNA.
e.zh: 实验室研究受损DNA中的重组修复。

e.en: Some viruses show high {recombinational} activity under pressure.
e.zh: 有些病毒在压力下表现出很高的重组活性。

e.en: The mutation created a {recombinogenic} region in the chromosome.
e.zh: 这种突变在染色体中形成了一个诱发重组的区域。

e.en: Researchers measured the {recombinogenic} effect of the chemical.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种化学物质诱发重组的作用。

e.en: She tried to {recomfort} the child after the thunder returned.
e.zh: 雷声再次响起后，她试着重新安慰孩子。

e.en: The letter did little to {recomfort} the grieving family.
e.zh: 那封信几乎没有重新宽慰悲伤的一家人。

e.en: The {recommencement} of talks brought cautious hope.
e.zh: 谈判的重新开始带来了谨慎的希望。

e.en: Rain delayed the {recommencement} of the match until evening.
e.zh: 降雨把比赛的重新开始推迟到了晚上。

e.en: The committee issued a {recommendatory} report, not a binding order.
e.zh: 委员会发布的是一份建议性报告，并非强制命令。

e.en: Her tone was {recommendatory} rather than demanding.
e.zh: 她的语气是劝告性的，而不是命令式的。

e.en: The navy plans to {recommission} the old vessel next year.
e.zh: 海军计划明年重新启用那艘旧舰。

e.en: The council voted to {recommission} the artist for a new mural.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定再次委托那位艺术家创作新壁画。

e.en: The judge ordered his {recommittal} to custody.
e.zh: 法官下令将他重新收押。

e.en: The bill faced {recommittal} for further debate.
e.zh: 该法案面临被重新提交以作进一步辩论。

e.en: You must {recompile} the program after changing the header file.
e.zh: 修改头文件后，你必须重新编译程序。

e.en: The server can {recompile} templates when the page changes.
e.zh: 页面变化时，服务器可以重新编译模板。

recomplement.t: 再次补足；重新补体作用

e.en: The team had to {recomplement} the data with newer samples.
e.zh: 团队不得不用较新的样本再次补足数据。

e.en: Scientists tried to {recomplement} the deficient cells in culture.
e.zh: 科学家尝试在培养中重新补足这些缺陷细胞。

e.en: The audit required a full {recomputation} of the tax owed.
e.zh: 审计要求对所欠税款进行完整的重新计算。

e.en: Caching avoids expensive {recomputation} of the same result.
e.zh: 缓存可以避免对同一结果进行耗时的重复计算。

e.en: The software is {recomputing} the route after the road closure.
e.zh: 道路封闭后，软件正在重新计算路线。

e.en: {Recomputing} every value slowed the spreadsheet dramatically.
e.zh: 重新计算每个数值让电子表格明显变慢。

e.en: After the interruption, he struggled to {reconcentrate} on the lecture.
e.zh: 被打断后，他很难重新集中精力听讲座。

e.en: The chemist needed to {reconcentrate} the solution before testing it.
e.zh: 化学师需要在测试前再次浓缩溶液。

e.en: The {reconcentration} of troops near the border alarmed observers.
e.zh: 军队在边境附近的重新集中让观察人士感到警惕。

e.en: The process includes {reconcentration} of the liquid after filtration.
e.zh: 该流程包括过滤后对液体进行再次浓缩。

e.en: The mediator questioned the {reconcilability} of their demands.
e.zh: 调解人质疑他们的要求是否能够调和。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {reconcilability} of freedom and determinism.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论自由与决定论是否可以相容。

e.en: She made a {reconciliatory} speech after the dispute.
e.zh: 争执过后，她发表了一番和解性的讲话。

e.en: His {reconciliatory} tone helped calm the room.
e.zh: 他安抚性的语气帮助屋里的人冷静下来。

e.en: The experiment measured {recondensation} on the cold surface.
e.zh: 实验测量了冷表面上的重新凝结现象。

e.en: Engineers reduced vapor loss through rapid {recondensation}.
