e.zh: 这座城市隆重欢迎了那些投资者。

e.en: She took the {red-eye} from Los Angeles to New York.
e.zh: 她搭乘从洛杉矶飞往纽约的夜航班机。

e.en: The camera flash gave everyone {red-eye} in the photo.
e.zh: 相机闪光让照片里每个人都出现了红眼。

e.en: He arrived {red-eyed} after a night without sleep.
e.zh: 他一夜没睡，来时眼睛通红。

e.en: The {red-eyed} rabbit stared from under the bush.
e.zh: 那只红眼兔子从灌木下盯着外面。

e.en: She looked {red-faced} after running up the stairs.
e.zh: 她跑上楼梯后看起来满脸通红。

e.en: The manager was {red-faced} when the error appeared on screen.
e.zh: 错误出现在屏幕上时，经理十分尴尬。

e.en: A {red-haired} child waved from the bus window.
e.zh: 一个红头发的孩子从公交车窗向外挥手。

e.en: The portrait shows a {red-haired} queen in a green dress.
e.zh: 这幅肖像画中，一位红发女王穿着绿色长裙。

e.en: The guard caught the thief {red-handed} at the door.
e.zh: 保安在门口当场抓住了小偷。

e.en: She was caught {red-handed} copying answers during the exam.
e.zh: 她考试时抄答案被当场抓住。

e.en: The {red-headed} boy sat near the front of the class.
e.zh: 那个红头发的男孩坐在教室前排附近。

e.en: A {red-headed} woodpecker landed on the fence.
e.zh: 一只红头啄木鸟落在了栅栏上。

e.en: The missing wallet was a {red-herring} in the mystery.
e.zh: 那个丢失的钱包只是这桩谜案中的烟幕。

e.en: His comment about taxes was a {red-herring} meant to avoid the question.
e.zh: 他关于税收的评论是为了回避问题而放出的烟幕。

e.en: The blacksmith lifted the {red-hot} iron with tongs.
e.zh: 铁匠用钳子夹起烧得通红的铁块。

e.en: Their new song became a {red-hot} hit overnight.
e.zh: 他们的新歌一夜之间成了大热门。

e.en: The newspaper praised him as a fearless {red-hunter}.
e.zh: 那家报纸称赞他是无畏的共产主义者搜捕者。

e.en: Later critics saw the famous {red-hunter} as a political opportunist.
e.zh: 后来的批评者认为那位著名的搜共者是政治投机分子。

red-hunting.t: 搜捕共产主义者；猎红行动

e.en: The committee's {red-hunting} damaged many innocent careers.
e.zh: 委员会的猎红行动毁掉了许多无辜者的职业生涯。

e.en: Writers protested against {red-hunting} in the film industry.
e.zh: 作家们抗议电影行业中的搜捕共产主义者行动。

e.en: The knight was branded {recreant} after fleeing the field.
e.zh: 那名骑士逃离战场后被斥为怯懦变节。

e.en: No {recreant} could be trusted with the town's defense.
e.zh: 任何叛徒都不能被托付城镇的防务。

e.en: The forest trail attracts every kind of {recreationist}.
e.zh: 这条森林步道吸引了各种休闲活动爱好者。

e.en: A careful {recreationist} leaves no litter behind.
e.zh: 谨慎的户外休闲者不会留下垃圾。

e.en: Gardening has a quiet {recreative} effect on her.
e.zh: 园艺对她有一种安静的休养身心作用。

e.en: The school added more {recreative} activities after exams.
e.zh: 考试后学校增加了更多娱乐活动。

recreatory.t: 供消遣的；有恢复作用的

e.en: The resort promoted its {recreatory} gardens and baths.
e.zh: 度假村宣传其供人消遣休养的花园和浴场。

e.en: He valued walking as a {recreatory} habit after work.
e.zh: 他把散步看作下班后恢复精神的习惯。

e.en: The furnace left a dark {recrement} at the bottom.
e.zh: 炉底留下了一层黑色废渣。

e.en: Old medical texts called certain bodily waste {recrement}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把某些身体废物称作排泄废物。

e.en: The chemist separated the {recremental} matter from the sample.
e.zh: 化学家从样品中分离出废渣成分。

e.en: The report described a {recremental} buildup in the pipe.
e.zh: 报告描述了管道中排泄废物般的堆积。

recrementitious.t: 废物性的；无用渣滓般的

e.en: The editor removed the {recrementitious} passages from the draft.
e.zh: 编辑删去了草稿中那些无用渣滓般的段落。

e.en: They studied the {recrementitious} residue left by the process.
e.zh: 他们研究了该工序留下的废物性残渣。

e.en: The doctor watched for {recrescence} of the tumor.
e.zh: 医生留意肿瘤是否重新增大。

e.en: Spring brought a slow {recrescence} of the meadow grass.
e.zh: 春天使草地上的青草慢慢重新生长。

e.en: Instead of solving the problem, they began to {recriminate}.
e.zh: 他们没有解决问题，反而开始互相指责。

e.en: She refused to {recriminate} after being blamed unfairly.
e.zh: 受到不公平责备后，她拒绝反过来指责对方。

e.en: The ministers {recriminated} for hours after the vote failed.
e.zh: 投票失败后，部长们相互指责了好几个小时。

e.en: He {recriminated} only after hearing the accusation repeated.
e.zh: 直到听见指控被反复提起，他才反过来责备对方。

e.en: Whenever talks collapse, each side {recriminates} loudly.
e.zh: 每当谈判破裂，双方都会大声互相指责。

e.en: She rarely {recriminates}, even when treated badly.
e.zh: 即使受到恶劣对待，她也很少反过来责备别人。

e.en: Their {recriminating} letters made compromise nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他们互相指责的信件让妥协几乎不可能。

e.en: He answered in a {recriminating} tone.
e.zh: 他用反过来责备人的语气回答。

e.en: The debate turned him into a tireless {recriminator}.
e.zh: 那场辩论使他成了不停反责的人。

e.en: A habitual {recriminator} seldom admits any fault.
e.zh: 习惯互相指责的人很少承认自己的过错。

e.en: The meeting ended with a {recriminatory} exchange.
e.zh: 会议以一番互相指责的交锋告终。

e.en: Her {recriminatory} reply only deepened the quarrel.
e.zh: 她带有反责意味的回答只让争吵更深。

e.en: Old tensions may {recrudesce} during the election.
e.zh: 旧有紧张关系可能在选举期间重新爆发。

e.en: The fever seemed to {recrudesce} each evening.
e.zh: 发烧似乎每天晚上都会复发。

e.en: Violence {recrudesced} after the peace talks failed.
e.zh: 和谈失败后，暴力重新爆发。

e.en: Her symptoms {recrudesced} two weeks after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗两周后，她的症状复发了。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {recrudescent} infection closely.
e.zh: 医生密切监测这场复发的感染。

e.en: The city feared {recrudescent} unrest after the verdict.
e.zh: 判决之后，这座城市担心骚乱再度爆发。

e.en: The illness often {recrudesces} under severe stress.
e.zh: 这种病常在严重压力下复发。

e.en: Public anger {recrudesces} whenever prices rise sharply.
e.zh: 每当物价大幅上涨，公众愤怒就会重新爆发。

e.en: The nurse noticed the fever {recrudescing} overnight.
e.zh: 护士注意到发烧在夜里又开始复发。

e.en: Officials worried about {recrudescing} conflict near the border.
e.zh: 官员担心边境附近的冲突正在重燃。

e.en: The quarry installed a {recrusher} for oversized stones.
e.zh: 采石场安装了一台再破碎机来处理过大的石块。

e.en: A skilled {recrusher} adjusted the machine by sound.
e.zh: 熟练的二次破碎工能凭声音调节机器。

e.en: The ore needed {recrushing} before it could be processed.
e.zh: 矿石在加工前需要再次破碎。

e.en: She was {recrushing} the tablets into a finer powder.
e.zh: 她正把药片再次压碎成更细的粉末。

e.en: The chemist purified the compound by {recrystallization}.
e.zh: 化学家通过重结晶提纯了这种化合物。

e.en: Slow cooling encouraged {recrystallization} in the metal.
e.zh: 缓慢冷却促进了金属中的重结晶。

e.en: They will {recrystallize} the salt from hot water.
e.zh: 他们会从热水中使盐重结晶。

e.en: Under pressure, the mineral can {recrystallize} slowly.
e.zh: 在压力下，这种矿物会慢慢再结晶。

e.en: The solution was {recrystallizing} as it cooled.
e.zh: 溶液冷却时正在重结晶。

e.en: The geologist examined {recrystallizing} grains in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家检查岩石中正在再结晶的颗粒。

e.en: The textbook compared the lengths of several {recta}.
e.zh: 教材比较了几条直线的长度。

e.en: The surgeon examined the damaged {recta} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了受损的直肠部位。

e.en: The company is drowning in {red ink} after years of losses.
e.zh: 多年亏损后，这家公司深陷赤字。

e.en: The accountant circled every error in {red ink}.
e.zh: 会计用红墨水圈出了每一个错误。

e.en: Graduation day was a {red-letter} day for the whole family.
e.zh: 毕业那天对全家来说都是值得纪念的日子。

e.en: They marked the victory as a {red-letter} event in local history.
e.zh: 他们把这场胜利视为当地历史上的喜庆大事。

e.en: The driver stopped at the {red light} before turning right.
e.zh: 司机在右转前停在红灯前。

e.en: Falling sales were a {red light} for the management team.
e.zh: 销售下滑对管理层来说是一个危险信号。

e.en: He hated being called a {redneck} just because he grew up rural.
e.zh: 他讨厌别人只因他在乡下长大就叫他乡巴佬。

e.en: The film uses the {redneck} stereotype for cheap jokes.
e.zh: 这部电影用保守粗人的刻板印象来制造廉价笑料。

e.en: A {red-necked} bird landed on the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只红颈鸟落在花园围栏上。

e.en: The workers came back {red-necked} from the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 工人们被下午的太阳晒得脖子发红。

e.en: The editor used a {red pencil} to mark weak paragraphs.
e.zh: 编辑用红笔标出了薄弱段落。

e.en: The budget office will {red-pencil} any unnecessary expense.
e.zh: 预算办公室会删掉任何不必要的开支。

e.en: Astronomers measured the galaxy's {redshift} to estimate its distance.
e.zh: 天文学家测量该星系的红移来估算距离。

e.en: The observed {red-shift} supports the idea that space is expanding.
e.zh: 观测到的红移支持空间正在膨胀的观点。

e.en: The blacksmith worked the iron while it was {red-short}.
e.zh: 铁匠趁铁块加热到暗红状态时进行锻打。

e.en: Some alloys become brittle when {red-short} and must be cooled carefully.
e.zh: 有些合金在暗红高温时会变脆，必须小心冷却。

e.en: The project was delayed by months of {red tape}.
e.zh: 这个项目被几个月的繁文缛节拖延了。

e.en: Small firms often struggle with government {red tape}.
e.zh: 小公司常常难以应付政府的官僚手续。

red-tapism.t: 官僚作风；繁文缛节主义

e.en: The report blamed delays on entrenched {red-tapism}.
e.zh: 报告把延误归咎于根深蒂固的官僚作风。

e.en: Reformers promised to replace {red-tapism} with faster public service.
e.zh: 改革者承诺用更快捷的公共服务取代繁文缛节主义。

red-tapist.t: 官僚主义者；拘泥手续者

e.en: The mayor called him a {red-tapist} who blocked every permit.
e.zh: 市长称他是个阻挠每项许可的官僚主义者。

e.en: A cautious {red-tapist} may protect rules but slow decisions.
e.zh: 谨慎的拘泥手续者也许能维护规则，却会拖慢决策。

e.en: The scandal filled every {red-top} the next morning.
e.zh: 第二天早上，各家通俗小报都登满了这桩丑闻。

e.en: Farmers planted {redtop} in the damp field for hay.
e.zh: 农民在潮湿的田里种红顶草作干草。

e.en: The old glossary defined {red-wat} as a kind of hare.
e.zh: 那本旧词汇表把red-wat解释为一种野兔。

e.en: Few modern readers will recognize {red-wat} outside historical dictionaries.
e.zh: 除了历史词典外，很少有现代读者会认得red-wat这个词。

e.en: A {red-wing} flashed across the marsh at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时，一只红翼鸟掠过沼泽。

e.en: The guide pointed out the {red-winged} blackbird near the reeds.
e.zh: 向导指出芦苇旁那只红翅黑鹂。

e.en: Lawyers must {redact} personal details before releasing the files.
e.zh: 律师在公开文件前必须删去个人信息。

e.en: The scholar helped {redact} the final version of the manuscript.
e.zh: 那位学者协助编辑了手稿的最终版本。

e.en: The agency is {redacting} names from the published report.
e.zh: 该机构正在从公开报告中删去姓名。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {redacting} a complex legal document.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在编辑一份复杂的法律文件。

e.en: The article shows several {redactional} changes made by later editors.
e.zh: 这篇文章显示了后来的编辑所作的几处修订性改动。

e.en: Scholars debate the {redactional} layer in the ancient text.
e.zh: 学者们争论这部古代文本中的编辑层次。

e.en: The {redactor} removed confidential names from the court record.
e.zh: 删节者从法院记录中删除了机密姓名。

e.en: A medieval {redactor} combined several legends into one chronicle.
e.zh: 一位中世纪编辑者把几个传说合成了一部编年史。

e.en: The office {redacts} addresses before sharing complaint files.
e.zh: 该办公室在分享投诉档案前会删去地址。

e.en: He {redacts} old interviews for a historical archive.
e.zh: 他为一个历史档案馆编辑旧访谈。

e.en: The soldiers sheltered behind a low {redan} near the gate.
e.zh: 士兵们躲在城门附近一座低矮的凸角堡后。

e.en: The map marks a {redan} projecting from the fortress wall.
e.zh: 地图标出了从堡垒墙体伸出的一个凸角防御工事。

e.en: The philosopher tried to {redargue} his opponent's main claim.
e.zh: 那位哲学家试图反驳对手的主要主张。

e.en: Old lawyers used {redargue} where modern writers would say refute.
e.zh: 旧时律师会用redargue，而现代作者会说refute。

e.en: Her theory was {redargued} in a sharp review.
e.zh: 她的理论在一篇尖锐评论中被驳斥了。

e.en: The witness was {redargued} by evidence from the letters.
e.zh: 信件中的证据反驳了那名证人的说法。

e.en: He spent the chapter {redarguing} a familiar objection.
e.zh: 他用这一章来反驳一个常见异议。

e.en: The pamphlet is mostly {redarguing} claims made by the minister.
e.zh: 这本小册子主要是在驳斥部长提出的说法。

e.en: His essay offered a formal {redargution} of the charge.
e.zh: 他的文章对这项指控作出了正式反驳。

e.en: The term {redargution} now sounds archaic in ordinary English.
e.zh: redargution这个词在日常英语中如今显得古旧。

e.en: She checked the shed carefully for a {redback} before reaching inside.
e.zh: 她伸手进去前仔细检查棚屋里有没有赤背蜘蛛。

e.en: The guide identified the {redback} by the mark on its abdomen.
e.zh: 向导根据腹部的标记认出了那只赤背蜘蛛。

e.en: The child picked the {redball} from the box.
e.zh: 孩子从盒子里拿起那个红球。

e.en: A bright {redball} hung above the stage.
e.zh: 一个鲜红的球状装饰挂在舞台上方。

e.en: A small {redbelly} darted under the rock.
e.zh: 一条小红腹鱼迅速钻到石头下面。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {redbelly} snake near the path.
e.zh: 向导指出小路旁有一条红腹蛇。

e.en: The committee kept its decisions in a {redbook}.
e.zh: 委员会把决定记录在一本红皮书里。

e.en: Her name appeared in the town {redbook}.
e.zh: 她的名字出现在镇上的官方名册中。

e.en: A {redbreast} sang on the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只知更鸟在花园篱笆上歌唱。

e.en: The old poem calls the robin a {redbreast}.
e.zh: 那首旧诗把知更鸟称作红胸鸟。

e.en: Several {redbreasts} gathered near the feeder.
e.zh: 几只知更鸟聚在喂鸟器旁。

e.en: The children watched the {redbreasts} hop across the lawn.
e.zh: 孩子们看着那些红胸鸟跳过草坪。

e.en: A {redbug} bite made his ankle itch.
e.zh: 恙螨叮咬让他的脚踝发痒。

e.en: The gardener found a tiny {redbug} on the leaf.
e.zh: 园丁在叶子上发现一只小红虫。

e.en: A {redcap} carried our bags through the station.
e.zh: 一名车站搬运工帮我们把行李提了进去。

e.en: The tale warned travelers about a cruel {redcap}.
e.zh: 这个故事警告旅人提防邪恶的红帽妖精。

e.en: The {redcrescent} team brought medicine to the village.
e.zh: 红新月会队伍把药品送到了村里。

e.en: A {redcrescent} symbol was painted on the ambulance.
e.zh: 救护车上画着红新月标志。

e.en: The contract listed each {reddendum} separately.
e.zh: 合同把每项应归还物分别列出。

e.en: The lawyer asked whether the deposit was a {reddendum}.
e.zh: 律师询问押金是否属于应交还事项。

e.en: She chose the {reddest} apple in the basket.
e.zh: 她挑了篮子里最红的苹果。

e.en: His face turned the {reddest} after the race.
e.zh: 赛跑后他的脸变得最红。

e.en: The soil was a deep {reddish-brown} color.
e.zh: 那片土壤呈深红褐色。

e.en: She wore a {reddish-brown} coat in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天她穿了一件红褐色外套。

e.en: The shepherd marked the sheep with {reddle}.
e.zh: 牧羊人用红赭石给羊做了标记。

e.en: A bag of {reddle} lay beside the old wall.
e.zh: 一袋红赭石放在旧墙旁边。

e.en: The {reddleman} walked from farm to farm.
e.zh: 那个卖红赭石的人从一个农场走到另一个农场。

e.en: Hardy's novel gives the {reddleman} a mysterious air.
e.zh: 哈代的小说让这位卖红赭石的人带着神秘气息。

e.en: The king ignored the old woman's {rede}.
e.zh: 国王没有听从老妇人的忠告。

e.en: In the ballad, his {rede} saves the village.
e.zh: 在那首民谣中，他的劝告救了村庄。

e.en: He caught a {redear} in the warm lake.
e.zh: 他在温暖的湖里钓到一条红耳鱼。

e.en: The biologist noted the turtle's {redear} markings.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到那只龟的红耳斑纹。

e.en: The scammer tried to {redeceive} the same victims.
e.zh: 骗子试图再次欺骗同一批受害者。

e.en: She refused to be {redeceived} by his apology.
e.zh: 她拒绝被他的道歉再次欺骗。

e.en: The panel will {redecide} the case next week.
e.zh: 小组将在下周重新裁定此案。

e.en: After new evidence appeared, we had to {redecide}.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，我们不得不重新决定。

e.en: The minister will {redeclare} the policy tomorrow.
e.zh: 部长明天将重新声明这项政策。

e.en: Travelers must {redeclare} expensive items at customs.
e.zh: 旅客必须在海关再次申报贵重物品。

e.en: Investors questioned the bond's {redeemability}.
e.zh: 投资者质疑这只债券的可赎回性。

e.en: The coupon's {redeemability} ends after thirty days.
e.zh: 这张优惠券的可兑现性在三十天后终止。

e.en: Officials feared he might {redefect} during the talks.
e.zh: 官员担心他可能在谈判期间再次叛逃。

e.en: The soldier chose to {redefect} after returning home.
e.zh: 那名士兵回家后选择重新投敌。

e.en: The courier will {redeliver} the package tomorrow.
e.zh: 快递员明天会重新投递这个包裹。

e.en: Please {redeliver} the speech with more confidence.
e.zh: 请更有信心地重新发表这篇演讲。

e.en: You can schedule a {redelivery} online.
e.zh: 你可以在线安排重新投递。

e.en: The {redelivery} of the lecture felt much clearer.
e.zh: 这次重新讲授让课程内容清楚多了。

e.en: The landlord may {redemand} payment after notice.
e.zh: 房东可在通知后再次要求付款。

e.en: Workers decided to {redemand} safer conditions.
e.zh: 工人们决定重新要求更安全的工作条件。

e.en: The teacher will {redemonstrate} the experiment slowly.
e.zh: 老师会慢慢重新演示这个实验。

e.en: The data helped {redemonstrate} the old theory.
e.zh: 这些数据有助于再次证明那条旧理论。

redemptional.t: 赎回的；救赎性的；补偿性的

e.en: The sermon used {redemptional} language throughout.
e.zh: 这篇布道通篇使用了救赎性的语言。

e.en: Her apology had a quiet {redemptional} force.
e.zh: 她的道歉带着一种安静的补偿力量。

e.en: The law allowed the {redemptor} to reclaim the land.
e.zh: 法律允许赎回者重新取得那块土地。

e.en: In the poem, the hero appears as a {redemptor}.
e.zh: 在诗中，英雄以救赎者的形象出现。

redemptory.t: 赎回的；具有救赎作用的

e.en: The contract included a {redemptory} clause.
e.zh: 合同中包含一项赎回条款。

e.en: Critics noted the film's {redemptory} ending.
e.zh: 评论家注意到这部电影具有救赎意味的结局。

e.en: The city promoted {redensification} near transit stations.
e.zh: 该市推动交通站点附近的重新密集开发。

e.en: Bone {redensification} can occur after successful treatment.
e.zh: 治疗成功后，骨骼可能出现重新致密化。

redented.t: 有齿状缺口的；重新压凹的

e.en: The old blade had a {redented} edge.
e.zh: 那把旧刀的边缘带有齿状缺口。

e.en: The metal sheet was {redented} after the second impact.
e.zh: 金属片在第二次撞击后又被压出了凹痕。

redeny.t: 再次否认；重新拒绝承认

e.en: The witness had to {redeny} the accusation in court.
e.zh: 证人不得不在法庭上再次否认那项指控。

e.en: Officials may {redeny} access if the form is incomplete.
e.zh: 如果表格不完整，官员可能会再次拒绝准入。

e.en: The climbers chose to {redescend} before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 登山者选择在暴风雨到来前重新下山。

e.en: Mist began to {redescend} over the valley.
e.zh: 雾气开始再次降落到山谷上。

redescribe.t: 重新描述；换种说法说明

e.en: Can you {redescribe} the problem without technical terms?
e.zh: 你能不用技术术语重新描述这个问题吗？

e.en: The theory attempts to {redescribe} memory as a social process.
e.zh: 该理论试图把记忆重新描述为一种社会过程。

redescribes.t: 重新描述；换种说法说明

e.en: The article {redescribes} poverty as a policy failure.
e.zh: 这篇文章把贫困重新描述为政策失败。

e.en: She {redescribes} the scene in simpler words.
e.zh: 她用更简单的话重新描述了那个场景。

e.en: The appeal led to a {redetermination} of his benefits.
e.zh: 上诉导致他的福利资格被重新裁定。

e.en: The lab requested a {redetermination} of the sample's age.
e.zh: 实验室要求重新测定样本的年代。

e.en: Several {redeterminations} delayed the final ruling.
e.zh: 几次重新裁定推迟了最终判决。

e.en: The report lists annual {redeterminations} of eligibility.
e.zh: 报告列出了每年的资格重新审核。

e.en: The agency will {redetermine} eligibility next month.
e.zh: 该机构下个月将重新判定资格。

e.en: Scientists must {redetermine} the constant under new conditions.
e.zh: 科学家必须在新条件下重新测定这个常数。

redetermined.t: 重新决定的；重新测定的

e.en: The court {redetermined} the amount of compensation.
e.zh: 法院重新确定了赔偿金额。

e.en: The values were {redetermined} after calibration.
e.zh: 校准后，这些数值被重新测定。

e.en: We took a {redeye} to New York.
e.zh: 我们乘坐红眼航班去了纽约。

e.en: The photo had {redeye} in every portrait.
e.zh: 那张照片里每张人像都有红眼现象。

e.en: He arrived exhausted and {redeyed} after the flight.
e.zh: 飞行结束后，他疲惫不堪，眼睛发红地到了。

e.en: The {redeyed} child rubbed her face sleepily.
e.zh: 那个眼睛发红的孩子困倦地揉着脸。

e.en: The angler released a small {redfin} back into the lake.
e.zh: 垂钓者把一条小红鳍鱼放回湖里。

e.en: A {redfin} flashed under the clear water.
e.zh: 一条红鳍鱼在清澈的水下闪过。

e.en: A {redhawk} circled above the empty field.
e.zh: 一只红尾鹰在空旷的田野上方盘旋。

e.en: The hunter mistook the {redhawk} for a larger eagle.
e.zh: 猎人把那只红褐色鹰误认成了更大的鹰。

e.en: The buyer filed a claim in {redhibition}.
e.zh: 买方提出了因隐藏瑕疵撤销买卖的诉求。

e.en: Louisiana law still recognizes {redhibition} in some sales.
e.zh: 路易斯安那法律在某些买卖中仍承认瑕疵撤销制度。

e.en: The blacksmith lifted the {redhot} iron carefully.
e.zh: 铁匠小心地举起炽热的铁块。

e.en: Their new single became {redhot} overnight.
e.zh: 他们的新单曲一夜之间变得非常热门。

e.en: The parasite develops into a {redia} inside the snail.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在蜗牛体内发育成雷蚴。

e.en: A single {redia} can produce many cercariae.
e.zh: 一个雷蚴可以产生许多尾蚴。

e.en: The microscope revealed several {redias} in the tissue.
e.zh: 显微镜显示组织中有几个雷蚴。

e.en: Researchers counted the {redias} before recording the infection rate.
e.zh: 研究人员在记录感染率前清点了雷蚴数量。

e.en: The sign said {rediculous}, but everyone knew it meant ridiculous.
e.zh: 牌子上写着rediculous，但大家都知道它想表达ridiculous。

e.en: He used {rediculous} as a playful misspelling online.
e.zh: 他在网上把rediculous当作一种玩笑式误拼来用。

e.en: Stem cells showed {redifferentiation} after the treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后，干细胞表现出重新分化。

e.en: The study tracked {redifferentiation} in damaged tissue.
e.zh: 该研究追踪了受损组织中的再分化过程。

e.en: The chemical can {rediffuse} through the membrane.
e.zh: 这种化学物质可以通过膜重新扩散。

e.en: Rumors may {rediffuse} quickly on social media.
e.zh: 谣言可能会在社交媒体上再次迅速散布。

e.en: The {rediffusion} of the dye made the edges blur again.
e.zh: 染料的重新扩散让边缘又变模糊了。

e.en: Radio {rediffusion} helped the message reach distant villages.
e.zh: 无线电再传播帮助消息传到偏远村庄。

redigest.t: 重新消化；重新整理吸收

e.en: Some animals {redigest} food to extract more nutrients.
e.zh: 有些动物会重新消化食物，以吸收更多营养。

e.en: She needed time to {redigest} the difficult report.
e.zh: 她需要时间重新整理吸收那份难懂的报告。

redingote.t: 女式长外套；骑装式外衣

e.en: She wore a dark {redingote} over her dress.
e.zh: 她在连衣裙外穿了一件深色长外套。

e.en: The costume designer chose a Victorian {redingote} for the scene.
e.zh: 服装设计师为这个场景选了一件维多利亚式骑装外衣。

e.en: The therapy helped him {redintegrate} painful memories.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他重新整合痛苦的记忆。

e.en: The plan will {redintegrate} the separated units into one department.
e.zh: 该计划会把分离的单位重新整合成一个部门。

e.en: The {redintegration} of the team took several months.
e.zh: 团队的重新整合花了几个月。

e.en: Psychologists studied the {redintegration} of fragmented memories.
e.zh: 心理学家研究了碎片化记忆的恢复整合。

e.en: You should {redip} the brush before painting the edge.
e.zh: 刷边缘前你应该再蘸一次刷子。

e.en: The fabric was {redipped} to deepen the blue color.
e.zh: 这块布被重新蘸染，以加深蓝色。

e.en: The witness had to {redire} the events in court.
e.zh: 证人不得不在法庭上重新讲述事件经过。

e.en: Please {redire} the warning in simpler words.
e.zh: 请用更简单的话再次说明这个警告。

e.en: The browser uses a {redirector} to send traffic safely.
e.zh: 浏览器使用重定向工具来安全转送流量。

e.en: Engineers installed a {redirector} to guide the airflow.
e.zh: 工程师安装了一个转向装置来引导气流。

e.en: The central bank agreed to {rediscount} the commercial bills.
e.zh: 央行同意对这些商业票据再贴现。

e.en: The store may {rediscount} unsold coats next week.
e.zh: 商店下周可能会把滞销外套重新打折。

e.en: The athlete feared a {redislocation} of his shoulder.
e.zh: 这名运动员担心肩膀再次脱位。

e.en: The storm caused the {redislocation} of several loose panels.
e.zh: 暴风雨导致几块松动面板重新移位。

e.en: Gentle stirring caused {redispersion} of the particles.
e.zh: 轻轻搅拌使颗粒重新分散。

e.en: The chemist tested the {redispersion} of the dried powder.
e.zh: 化学师测试了干粉的再分散性能。

e.en: Click refresh to {redisplay} the latest results.
e.zh: 点击刷新以重新显示最新结果。

e.en: The museum will {redisplay} the paintings after restoration.
e.zh: 博物馆会在修复后再次陈列这些画作。

e.en: They had to {redispose} the furniture after the leak.
e.zh: 漏水后他们不得不重新布置家具。

e.en: The manager will {redispose} the staff across departments.
e.zh: 经理会在各部门之间重新安排员工。

e.en: Heat the mixture to {redissolve} the crystals.
e.zh: 加热混合物以重新溶解晶体。

e.en: The committee may {redissolve} after the review ends.
e.zh: 审查结束后，委员会可能再次解散。

e.en: The chemist decided to {redistill} the solvent.
e.zh: 化学师决定重新蒸馏这种溶剂。

e.en: Editors often {redistill} complex ideas into clearer prose.
e.zh: 编辑常把复杂想法再次提炼成更清楚的文字。

redistillate.t: 再蒸馏产物；重新馏出物

e.en: The lab stored the {redistillate} in a sealed flask.
e.zh: 实验室把再蒸馏产物存放在密封烧瓶中。

e.en: This {redistillate} has fewer impurities than the first sample.
e.zh: 这种重新馏出物比第一份样品杂质更少。

e.en: The senator was known as a committed {redistributionist}.
e.zh: 这位参议员以坚定支持财富再分配而闻名。

e.en: A {redistributionist} policy can provoke fierce political debate.
e.zh: 再分配主义政策可能引发激烈的政治争论。

e.en: The state must {redistrict} after the new census.
e.zh: 新人口普查后，该州必须重新划分选区。

e.en: Officials promised to {redistrict} without favoring any party.
e.zh: 官员承诺重新划分选区时不偏向任何政党。

e.en: The county was {redistricted} before the election.
e.zh: 该县在选举前被重新划分了选区。

e.en: Many voters found themselves in a {redistricted} area.
e.zh: 许多选民发现自己所在地区被重新划入了新选区。

e.en: Critics called the style classicism {redivivus}.
e.zh: 评论家称这种风格是复兴的古典主义。

e.en: The old slogan returned, {redivivus}, in the new campaign.
e.zh: 那句旧口号在新宣传中复活般地回来了。

e.en: The old soldier was nicknamed a {redleg} for his artillery service.
e.zh: 这名老兵因服役于炮兵而被称作红腿兵。

e.en: A {redleg} ran quickly across the marsh grass.
e.zh: 一只红腿鸟迅速跑过沼泽草地。

e.en: The driver stopped at the {redlight}.
e.zh: 司机在红灯前停了下来。

e.en: The board decided to {redlight} the risky project.
e.zh: 董事会决定叫停这个有风险的项目。

e.en: The guide identified the fish as a {redmouth}.
e.zh: 向导认出这条鱼是红口鱼。

e.en: A {redmouth} wound appeared after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后出现了一道红口子的伤口。

e.en: The {redolency} of pine filled the cabin.
e.zh: 松木的芬芳充满了小屋。

e.en: Her prose has a faint {redolency} of old sermons.
e.zh: 她的散文隐约带有旧布道文的气息。

e.en: The pilot reported a brief {redout} during the maneuver.
e.zh: 飞行员报告说机动时短暂出现红视。

e.en: After the flash, he saw only a painful {redout}.
e.zh: 闪光过后，他眼前只剩刺痛的红色眩晕。

e.en: The lab used a {redoxostat} to maintain the culture conditions.
e.zh: 实验室用氧化还原稳态调节器维持培养条件。

e.en: A faulty {redoxostat} can distort the experiment's results.
e.zh: 有故障的氧化还原稳态调节器会扭曲实验结果。

e.en: A {redpoll} landed on the birch branch.
e.zh: 一只朱顶雀落在桦树枝上。

e.en: We identified the small finch as a {redpoll}.
e.zh: 我们认出那只小雀是朱顶雀。

redrape.t: 重新披挂；重新装饰帘布

e.en: They will {redrape} the windows before the ceremony.
e.zh: 他们会在典礼前重新挂好窗帘。

e.en: The stylist chose to {redrape} the fabric across the chair.
e.zh: 造型师决定把布料重新披在椅子上。

e.en: The law provides a channel for grievance {redressal}.
e.zh: 这项法律提供了处理申诉的渠道。

e.en: Customers demanded quick {redressal} of their complaints.
e.zh: 顾客要求迅速处理他们的投诉。

e.en: The harm was serious but still {redressible}.
e.zh: 损害很严重，但仍然可以补救。

e.en: A {redressible} error should not ruin the whole case.
e.zh: 一个可纠正的错误不应毁掉整个案子。

e.en: The petition sought {redressment} for years of neglect.
e.zh: 请愿书要求对多年的忽视作出补救。

e.en: True {redressment} requires more than a public apology.
e.zh: 真正的赔偿补救不只是公开道歉。

e.en: She {redrew} the diagram after finding a mistake.
e.zh: 发现错误后，她重新画了那张图。

e.en: The committee {redrew} the voting districts overnight.
e.zh: 委员会连夜重新划定了投票选区。

e.en: This towel is {redrier} than the one outside.
e.zh: 这条毛巾比外面那条更干。

e.en: The inland climate is {redrier} in winter.
e.zh: 内陆地区冬天的气候更干燥。

e.en: The crew had to {redrill} the damaged well.
e.zh: 施工队不得不重新钻那口受损的井。

e.en: The coach made the team {redrill} the same routine.
e.zh: 教练让队员重新练习同一套动作。

e.en: The engineer tried to {redrive} the stalled motor.
e.zh: 工程师试图重新驱动停转的马达。

e.en: We had to {redrive} the route after missing the exit.
e.zh: 错过出口后，我们只好重新开一遍那条路线。

e.en: The herbalist dried {redroot} for winter remedies.
e.zh: 草药师把红根草晒干，用作冬季药材。

e.en: The plant's {redroot} made it easy to identify.
e.zh: 这种植物的红色根部让人很容易认出它。

e.en: The plane had to {redrop} the supplies after missing the target.
e.zh: 飞机错过目标后不得不再次投下补给。

e.en: Do not {redrop} the sample into the clean solution.
e.zh: 不要把样本重新滴入干净的溶液中。

e.en: The bartender served {redrum} with a slice of lime.
e.zh: 酒保端上一杯红朗姆酒，并配了一片青柠。

e.en: In the mirror, {redrum} looked like a warning.
e.zh: 在镜子里，redrum看起来像一句警告。

e.en: The blacksmith let the iron {redsear} in the coals.
e.zh: 铁匠让铁块在煤火中烧到通红。

e.en: The sunset seemed to {redsear} the edge of the clouds.
e.zh: 落日仿佛把云边灼成了红色。

e.en: The old church was built from local {redstone}.
e.zh: 那座老教堂是用当地红砂岩建成的。

e.en: A path of {redstone} led to the garden gate.
e.zh: 一条红色石料铺成的小路通向花园门口。

e.en: Farmers planted {redtop} in the wet meadow.
e.zh: 农民在潮湿草地上种了小糠草。

e.en: The child chose the {redtop} bottle from the shelf.
e.zh: 孩子从架子上选了那个红盖瓶子。

e.en: The system behaves {reducibly} under these assumptions.
e.zh: 在这些假设下，该系统表现为可简化。

e.en: The proof treats the problem {reducibly} as a smaller case.
e.zh: 这个证明把问题可化约地处理成一个较小情形。

e.en: The chemist measured the {reduct} after the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家测量了反应后的还原产物。

e.en: The theory is a {reduct} of a more complex model.
e.zh: 这个理论是更复杂模型的简化结果。

e.en: Hydrogen can act as a {reductant} in this reaction.
e.zh: 氢在这个反应中可以充当还原剂。

e.en: The experiment required a stronger {reductant}.
e.zh: 这项实验需要一种更强的还原剂。

e.en: His argument was criticized for crude {reductivism}.
e.zh: 他的论点因粗糙的还原主义而受到批评。

e.en: Not all scientific explanation is {reductivism}.
e.zh: 并非所有科学解释都是还原主义。

reductor.t: 还原剂；减压器；缩径管件

e.en: The chemist added a {reductor} to the solution.
e.zh: 化学家向溶液中加入了一种还原剂。

e.en: A pipe {reductor} connected the wide section to the narrow outlet.
e.zh: 一个缩径管件把宽管段接到较窄的出口上。

e.en: The editor removed the {redundance} from the paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑删去了这段文字中的冗余部分。

e.en: In engineering, some {redundance} can make a system safer.
e.zh: 在工程中，适度冗余能让系统更安全。

e.en: The poem uses {reduplication} for a playful rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗用重复来营造俏皮的节奏。

e.en: Linguists study {reduplication} in many languages.
e.zh: 语言学家研究许多语言中的重叠构词现象。

e.en: The child enjoyed the song's {reduplicative} phrases.
e.zh: 孩子很喜欢那首歌里重复的短语。

e.en: The language has several {reduplicative} forms for emphasis.
e.zh: 这种语言有几种用于强调的重叠形式。

e.en: A {reduviid} waited motionless on the leaf.
e.zh: 一只猎蝽科昆虫静静地伏在叶子上。

e.en: The guide identified the insect as a {reduviid}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只昆虫是猎蝽科的一种。

e.en: The director released a {redux} version of the film.
e.zh: 导演推出了这部电影的复兴版。

e.en: Critics called the new policy austerity {redux}.
e.zh: 评论家称这项新政策是紧缩政策的回潮。

e.en: The sky shifted {redward} as the sun sank.
e.zh: 太阳下沉时，天空逐渐偏向红色。

e.en: Astronomers measured how the light moved {redward}.
e.zh: 天文学家测量了光线如何向红端移动。

e.en: The gardener added {redworm} compost to the soil.
e.zh: 园丁把红蚯蚓堆肥加进土里。

e.en: The fisherman used a {redworm} as bait.
e.zh: 渔夫用一条红虫作鱼饵。

e.en: She decided to {redye} the faded curtains.
e.zh: 她决定把褪色的窗帘重新染色。

e.en: The fabric is hard to {redye} evenly.
e.zh: 这种布料很难再染得均匀。

e.en: The old hunter watched a {ree} cross the glen.
e.zh: 老猎人看着一只雌鹿穿过峡谷。

e.en: Grain was shaken through a wooden {ree}.
e.zh: 谷物被放进木筛里摇筛。

e.en: Her words seemed to {reecho} in the empty hall.
e.zh: 她的话仿佛在空荡的大厅里再次回响。

e.en: The valley gave back a faint {reecho}.
e.zh: 山谷传回了一阵微弱的反复回声。

e.en: The slogan {reechoed} through the crowd.
e.zh: 口号在人群中再次回响。

e.en: His doubts {reechoed} in her mind all night.
e.zh: 他的疑虑整夜在她脑中反复回荡。

e.en: The chant {reechoes} under the stone bridge.
e.zh: 吟唱声在石桥下反复回响。

e.en: Old arguments leave {reechoes} in the report.
e.zh: 旧争论在这份报告里留下了回声。

e.en: The bells were {reechoing} across the harbor.
e.zh: 钟声正越过港口反复回响。

e.en: She heard his warning {reechoing} in memory.
e.zh: 她听见他的警告在记忆中再次回荡。

reechy.t: 烟熏味重的；污浊难闻的

e.en: The tavern had a {reechy} smell after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，酒馆里有一股烟熏般的浊臭味。

e.en: He wiped soot from the {reechy} chimney stones.
e.zh: 他擦掉了烟熏味很重的烟囱石上的煤灰。

e.en: Ducks nested quietly in the {reed-bed}.
e.zh: 鸭子安静地在芦苇丛里筑巢。

e.en: The village uses a {reed-bed} to filter wastewater.
e.zh: 这个村子用芦苇湿地来过滤废水。

e.en: A {reedbird} sang from the marsh grass.
e.zh: 一只芦苇鸟在沼泽草丛中鸣叫。

e.en: Farmers once feared the hungry {reedbird}.
e.zh: 农民过去曾害怕贪食的食米鸟。

e.en: A {reedbuck} stood alert near the water.
e.zh: 一只苇羚警觉地站在水边。

e.en: The safari guide pointed out a mountain {reedbuck}.
e.zh: 狩猎旅行向导指出了一只山苇羚。

e.en: The {reediest} note came from the old clarinet.
e.zh: 最尖细的音符来自那支旧单簧管。

e.en: They crossed the {reediest} part of the wetland.
e.zh: 他们穿过了湿地里芦苇最密的部分。

e.en: Neglect allowed the pond to {reedify} over time.
e.zh: 长期无人打理使池塘渐渐长满芦苇。

e.en: The artist tried to {reedify} the sculpture's thin lines.
e.zh: 艺术家试图让雕塑的细线条显得像芦苇。

e.en: The flute's {reediness} suited the lonely melody.
e.zh: 长笛的尖细音质很适合这段孤寂的旋律。

e.en: The marsh's {reediness} made walking difficult.
e.zh: 沼泽里芦苇丛生，行走很困难。

e.en: Please {reedit} the article before Friday.
e.zh: 请在星期五前重新编辑这篇文章。

e.en: The studio had to {reedit} the film for television.
e.zh: 制片厂不得不为电视播出重新剪辑这部电影。

reedited.t: 重新编辑过的；修订过的；重新剪辑的

e.en: The {reedited} article removed several unclear paragraphs.
e.zh: 那篇重新编辑过的文章删掉了几段不清楚的内容。

e.en: A {reedited} version of the film appeared online.
e.zh: 这部电影的重新剪辑版出现在网上。

e.en: The plant had tall, {reedlike} stems beside the pond.
e.zh: 池塘边那株植物长着高高的、像芦苇一样的茎。

e.en: His voice was thin and {reedlike} in the cold air.
e.zh: 在寒冷的空气中，他的声音又细又像芦笛。

e.en: A single {reedling} grew from the wet mud.
e.zh: 湿泥里长出了一株小芦苇。

e.en: The gardener moved each {reedling} to a deeper bed.
e.zh: 园丁把每株芦苇幼苗移到更深的苗床里。

e.en: Tall {reedmace} lined the edge of the lake.
e.zh: 湖边长满了高高的香蒲。

e.en: She used dried {reedmace} in the winter flower arrangement.
e.zh: 她在冬季插花中用了晒干的蒲草。

reedman.t: 簧片乐器演奏者；吹奏手

e.en: The jazz band needed a skilled {reedman} for the tour.
e.zh: 这支爵士乐队巡演时需要一名熟练的簧片乐器演奏者。

e.en: As a young {reedman}, he practiced saxophone every night.
e.zh: 年轻时作为一名吹奏手，他每晚练习萨克斯。

e.en: The program aims to {reeducate} workers for new industries.
e.zh: 这个项目旨在为新行业重新培训工人。

e.en: They tried to {reeducate} the public about food waste.
e.zh: 他们试图重新教育公众认识食物浪费问题。

reeducated.t: 被重新教育的；再培训过的

e.en: The {reeducated} staff adapted quickly to the new system.
e.zh: 经过再培训的员工很快适应了新系统。

e.en: He was {reeducated} after years of spreading false information.
e.zh: 多年传播虚假信息后，他接受了重新教育。

e.en: The company is {reeducating} managers about workplace bias.
e.zh: 公司正在重新培训管理者认识职场偏见。

e.en: The campaign focuses on {reeducating} drivers about road safety.
e.zh: 这项活动重点是重新教育司机注意道路安全。

e.en: The workers received {reeducation} before moving to new roles.
e.zh: 工人们在转到新岗位前接受了再教育。

e.en: Political {reeducation} was used to change prisoners' beliefs.
e.zh: 政治再教育被用来改变囚犯的信念。

e.en: The boat avoided the {reefy} stretch near the island.
e.zh: 船避开了岛附近那段多暗礁的水域。

e.en: Divers explored the {reefy} bottom in clear water.
e.zh: 潜水员在清澈的水中探索多礁的海底。

reekies.t: 冒烟的东西；有臭味的东西

e.en: The old chimneys were known locally as {reekies}.
e.zh: 当地人把那些旧烟囱称作冒烟的东西。

e.en: After the fire, several {reekies} still smoldered in the field.
e.zh: 火灾后，田里还有几处冒烟的东西在闷烧。

e.en: We left the {reeky} room as soon as possible.
e.zh: 我们尽快离开了那间臭烘烘的房间。

e.en: A {reeky} fire burned at the back of the yard.
e.zh: 院子后面燃着一堆冒浓烟的火。

reelable.t: 可绕上卷轴的；可收卷的

e.en: The cable is {reelable} and easy to store.
e.zh: 这根电缆可以收卷，存放起来很方便。

e.en: They chose a {reelable} hose for the small workshop.
e.zh: 他们为小车间选了一条可绕上卷轴的软管。

e.en: Voters may {reelect} the mayor next month.
e.zh: 选民下个月可能会再次选举这位市长。

e.en: The board voted to {reelect} her as chair.
e.zh: 董事会投票让她连任主席。

e.en: The president was {reelected} by a large majority.
e.zh: 总统以明显多数再次当选。

e.en: She felt honored to be {reelected} union leader.
e.zh: 她对再次当选工会领袖感到荣幸。

e.en: The members are {reelecting} their committee this week.
e.zh: 成员们本周正在重新选举委员会。

e.en: Many voters supported {reelecting} the experienced governor.
e.zh: 许多选民支持让这位经验丰富的州长连任。

e.en: If the city {reelects} him, he will continue the project.
e.zh: 如果这座城市再次选他，他会继续这个项目。

e.en: The club {reelects} its president every two years.
e.zh: 俱乐部每两年重新选举一次主席。

e.en: The committee voted to {reelevate} him to senior partner.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定重新提升他为高级合伙人。

e.en: Engineers had to {reelevate} the platform after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，工程师不得不重新抬高平台。

e.en: After one year, suspended members become {reeligible} to apply.
e.zh: 一年后，被暂停资格的成员可重新具备申请资格。

e.en: The athlete was declared {reeligible} after the appeal.
e.zh: 申诉之后，这名运动员被宣布重新具备参赛资格。

e.en: The report called for the {reelimination} of outdated rules.
e.zh: 报告要求再次清除过时的规定。

e.en: A second audit led to the {reelimination} of duplicate accounts.
e.zh: 第二次审计导致重复账户被再次清除。

e.en: Passengers will {reembark} after the brief stop ashore.
e.zh: 短暂停靠上岸后，乘客将重新登船。

e.en: The team plans to {reembark} on its research mission tomorrow.
e.zh: 团队计划明天再次启程开展研究任务。

e.en: {Reembarkation} began as soon as the storm passed.
e.zh: 风暴一过去，重新登船就开始了。

e.en: The officer organized the {reembarkation} of the troops.
e.zh: 军官组织部队重新登船。

e.en: She decided to {reembroider} the damaged corner of the cloth.
e.zh: 她决定把布料受损的一角重新刺绣。

e.en: The costume maker will {reembroider} the jacket with gold thread.
e.zh: 服装师会用金线重新绣饰这件夹克。

e.en: Old tensions may {reemerge} during the negotiations.
e.zh: 谈判期间，旧有的紧张关系可能会重新出现。

e.en: The singer began to {reemerge} after years away from music.
e.zh: 离开乐坛多年后，这位歌手开始重新露面。

e.en: The issue {reemerged} during the meeting.
e.zh: 这个问题在会议中再次出现。

e.en: After years away, she {reemerged} as a public figure.
e.zh: 离开多年后，她重新以公众人物身份出现。

e.en: The {reemergence} of inflation worried investors.
e.zh: 通胀的重新出现让投资者感到担忧。

e.en: Scientists tracked the virus's {reemergence} in several regions.
e.zh: 科学家追踪了这种病毒在几个地区的再度出现。

e.en: The problem {reemerges} every winter.
e.zh: 这个问题每年冬天都会再次出现。

e.en: Her confidence {reemerges} when she starts singing.
e.zh: 她一开始唱歌，自信就重新显现出来。

e.en: Old tensions are {reemerging} in the region.
e.zh: 该地区的旧有紧张关系正在重新出现。

e.en: He watched memories {reemerging} from his childhood.
e.zh: 他感到童年的记忆正重新浮现。

e.en: The device prevents {reemission} of harmful vapors.
e.zh: 该装置可防止有害蒸气再次排放。

e.en: The antenna's {reemission} of the signal was delayed.
e.zh: 天线对信号的重新发射出现了延迟。

e.en: Some surfaces {reemit} heat after sunset.
e.zh: 有些表面在日落后会重新释放热量。

e.en: The system can {reemit} the captured signal.
e.zh: 该系统可以重新发出捕获到的信号。

e.en: The policy marks a {reemphasis} on local hiring.
e.zh: 这项政策标志着对本地招聘的重新重视。

e.en: Her speech called for a {reemphasis} on basic skills.
e.zh: 她的演讲呼吁重新强调基本技能。

reemphasize.t: 重新强调；再次着重说明

e.en: The teacher tried to {reemphasize} the main point.
e.zh: 老师试图重新强调重点。

e.en: Officials will {reemphasize} safety after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，官员们将再次强调安全。

e.en: The program helps workers find {reemployment}.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助工人重新就业。

e.en: His {reemployment} by the company surprised everyone.
e.zh: 公司再次雇用他让所有人都很意外。

e.en: The sauce needs {reemulsification} after it separates.
e.zh: 酱汁分层后需要重新乳化。

e.en: Researchers studied {reemulsification} in the oil mixture.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了油混合物中的再乳化过程。

e.en: The technician is {reenabiling} the disabled account.
e.zh: 技术员正在重新启用被停用的账户。

e.en: A software bug kept {reenabiling} the old setting.
e.zh: 一个软件错误不断重新启用旧设置。

e.en: Please {reenable} notifications in the app.
e.zh: 请在应用中重新启用通知。

e.en: The update will {reenable} access for locked users.
e.zh: 这次更新将让被锁定的用户重新获得访问权限。

e.en: The bill's {reenaction} required a new vote.
e.zh: 该法案的重新通过需要再次投票。

e.en: Critics opposed the {reenaction} of the old rule.
e.zh: 批评者反对重新实施那条旧规定。

reenactment.t: 历史重演表演；重新 enact

e.en: The town held a Civil War {reenactment}.
e.zh: 小镇举行了一场内战历史重演表演。

e.en: The court ordered a {reenactment} of the incident.
e.zh: 法院要求重新模拟该事件。

reenble.t: 重新启用的拼写错误形式

e.en: The note said to {reenble} the feature tomorrow.
e.zh: 便条上写着明天重新启用这个功能。

e.en: He typed {reenble} when he meant reenable.
e.zh: 他本想输入 reenable，却打成了 reenble。

e.en: I hoped to {reencounter} her in Paris.
e.zh: 我希望能在巴黎再次遇见她。

e.en: Patients may {reencounter} symptoms months later.
e.zh: 患者可能在数月后再次出现这些症状。

e.en: The coach tried to {reencourage} the tired team.
e.zh: 教练试图再次鼓励疲惫的队伍。

e.en: New evidence may {reencourage} investors to return.
e.zh: 新的证据可能会重新激励投资者回归。

e.en: A short break can {reenergize} the whole team.
e.zh: 短暂休息能让整个团队恢复活力。

e.en: The campaign helped {reenergize} public support.
e.zh: 这场活动帮助重新激发了公众支持。

e.en: They sent troops to {reenforce} the border.
e.zh: 他们派兵去增援边境。

e.en: The beams {reenforce} the old stone wall.
e.zh: 这些横梁加固了那堵旧石墙。

reenforced.t: 加强了；增援了的旧拼法

e.en: The door was {reenforced} with steel plates.
e.zh: 这扇门用钢板加固过。

e.en: Fresh troops {reenforced} the camp at dawn.
e.zh: 拂晓时新部队增援了营地。

e.en: The policy {reenforces} existing inequalities.
e.zh: 这项政策强化了现有的不平等。

e.en: The regiment {reenforces} the northern defenses.
e.zh: 该团增援了北部防线。

reenforcing.t: 正在加强；正在增援的旧拼法

e.en: Workers are {reenforcing} the bridge supports.
e.zh: 工人正在加固桥梁支撑。

e.en: The army is {reenforcing} its coastal positions.
e.zh: 军队正在增援沿海阵地。

e.en: She {reengaged} with the project after a long break.
e.zh: 长时间休息后，她重新参与了这个项目。

e.en: The clutch {reengaged} as the car slowed.
e.zh: 汽车减速时，离合器重新接合。

e.en: The campaign focused on customer {reengagement} after months of silence.
e.zh: 这场活动重点是在沉寂数月后重新吸引客户参与。

e.en: Teacher feedback encouraged his {reengagement} with the course.
e.zh: 老师的反馈鼓励他重新投入这门课程。

reengine.t: 重新设计工程；改造系统

e.en: The team had to {reengine} the platform for heavy traffic.
e.zh: 团队不得不重新设计平台，以应对高流量。

e.en: They will {reengine} the process instead of adding more staff.
e.zh: 他们会改造流程，而不是增加更多人手。

e.en: We need to {reengineer} the payment system before launch.
e.zh: 上线前我们需要重新设计支付系统。

e.en: The company tried to {reengineer} its culture after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后，公司试图重塑自身文化。

e.en: He decided to {reenlist} after two years as a civilian.
e.zh: 做了两年平民后，他决定重新入伍。

e.en: The charity hopes to {reenlist} former volunteers for the campaign.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构希望再次招募以前的志愿者参与活动。

reenlisted.t: 重新入伍的；再次加入的

e.en: She {reenlisted} when her old unit needed experienced medics.
e.zh: 旧部队需要有经验的医护人员时，她重新入伍了。

e.en: Several former members {reenlisted} for the rescue effort.
e.zh: 几名前成员再次加入了救援行动。

e.en: He is {reenlisting} because he misses military life.
e.zh: 他正在重新入伍，因为他怀念军旅生活。

e.en: The club is {reenlisting} past supporters for the anniversary event.
e.zh: 俱乐部正在再次邀请老支持者参加周年活动。

e.en: His {reenlistment} surprised friends who thought he had retired.
e.zh: 他的重新入伍让以为他已退役的朋友们很意外。

e.en: The army offered bonuses for early {reenlistment}.
e.zh: 军队为提前再次服役提供奖金。

e.en: The report discussed uranium {reenrichment} under strict monitoring.
e.zh: 报告讨论了在严格监控下进行铀的重新浓缩。

e.en: Soil {reenrichment} helped the depleted field recover nutrients.
e.zh: 土壤再次富集帮助这片贫瘠田地恢复了养分。

reenslave.t: 使重新受奴役；再次束缚

e.en: The rebels feared the regime would {reenslave} the freed workers.
e.zh: 反抗者担心该政权会让获释工人重新受奴役。

e.en: Debt can {reenslave} families who have just escaped poverty.
e.zh: 债务可能再次束缚刚摆脱贫困的家庭。

e.en: Light therapy can support circadian {reentrainment} after jet lag.
e.zh: 光照疗法可以帮助时差后的生物钟重新同步。

e.en: Engineers measured particle {reentrainment} from the filter surface.
e.zh: 工程师测量了颗粒从过滤器表面被再次夹带的情况。

e.en: The guard checked every visitor's {reentrance} after lunch.
e.zh: 午餐后，保安检查了每位访客的重新入场。

e.en: Her {reentrance} into politics drew immediate media attention.
e.zh: 她重返政坛立即引起了媒体关注。

e.en: The library uses {reentrant} code for safer parallel execution.
e.zh: 这个程序库使用可重入代码，以便更安全地并行执行。

e.en: The coast has a {reentrant} bay protected from strong winds.
e.zh: 这片海岸有一个凹入的海湾，可避开强风。

e.en: The capsule burned brightly during atmospheric {reentry}.
e.zh: 太空舱在重返大气层时明亮燃烧。

e.en: The program helps prisoners prepare for {reentry} into society.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助服刑人员准备重返社会。

e.en: Workers will {reerect} the damaged sign tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 工人们明天早上会把受损的标牌重新竖立起来。

e.en: The town voted to {reerect} the old monument in the square.
e.zh: 镇上投票决定在广场上重建那座旧纪念碑。

e.en: A careless statement could {reescalate} the dispute overnight.
e.zh: 一句不谨慎的声明可能让争端一夜之间再次升级。

e.en: Doctors watched for signs that the fever might {reescalate}.
e.zh: 医生留意着发烧可能重新加重的迹象。

e.en: His {reest} jokes were cut from the broadcast.
e.zh: 他那些最下流的笑话被从广播中删掉了。

e.en: The critic called it the {reest} scene in the whole play.
e.zh: 评论家称那是整部戏里最粗俗的一幕。

e.en: The lab used {reesterification} to modify the fatty acid sample.
e.zh: 实验室通过再酯化来改性脂肪酸样本。

e.en: Incomplete {reesterification} lowered the final yield of biodiesel.
e.zh: 再酯化不完全降低了生物柴油的最终产量。

e.en: We should {reestimate} costs after the supplier changed prices.
e.zh: 供应商改价后，我们应该重新估计成本。

e.en: Analysts will {reestimate} demand using the latest sales data.
e.zh: 分析师将用最新销售数据重新评估需求。

e.en: The technician had to {reetch} the plate after a printing error.
e.zh: 出现印刷错误后，技术员不得不重新蚀刻那块版。

e.en: They {reetch} the circuit pattern to sharpen the tiny lines.
e.zh: 他们重新刻蚀电路图案，以使细线更清晰。

e.en: The policy needs careful {reevaluation} after the new evidence.
e.zh: 出现新证据后，这项政策需要仔细重新评估。

e.en: Her illness forced a {reevaluation} of her career goals.
e.zh: 她的疾病迫使她重新审视自己的职业目标。

e.en: Any remaining solvent may {reevaporate} when the sample is heated.
e.zh: 样本受热时，残留溶剂可能会再次蒸发。

e.en: Condensed moisture can {reevaporate} in dry afternoon air.
e.zh: 凝结的水分会在下午干燥的空气中重新蒸发。

e.en: The geologist identified {reevesite} in the green mineral sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在绿色矿物样本中鉴定出了水碳镍镁石。

e.en: Small crystals of {reevesite} formed along the altered rock surface.
e.zh: 水碳镍镁石的小晶体沿着蚀变岩石表面形成。

reexaminable.t: 可重新审查的；可复验的

e.en: The decision remains {reexaminable} if new evidence appears.
e.zh: 如果出现新证据，这项决定仍可重新审查。

e.en: The samples are {reexaminable} because they were stored properly.
e.zh: 这些样本保存得当，因此可以复验。

e.en: The case was reopened for {reexamination} by an independent judge.
e.zh: 此案被重新开启，由独立法官进行复查。

e.en: A medical {reexamination} confirmed that the injury had healed.
e.zh: 一次医学复查确认伤处已经痊愈。

e.en: The store agreed to {reexchange} the faulty item.
e.zh: 商店同意重新调换这件有问题的商品。

e.en: They had to {reexchange} currencies after the rate changed.
e.zh: 汇率变化后，他们不得不再次兑换货币。

e.en: The museum will {reexhibit} the paintings next spring.
e.zh: 博物馆将在明年春天重新展出这些画作。

e.en: The patient may {reexhibit} symptoms under stress.
e.zh: 患者在压力下可能会再次表现出症状。

e.en: The company plans to {reexpand} into Asian markets.
e.zh: 公司计划重新扩展到亚洲市场。

e.en: The dried sponge will {reexpand} when it absorbs water.
e.zh: 干海绵吸水后会再次膨胀。

e.en: The firm's {reexpansion} created many new jobs.
e.zh: 这家公司的重新扩张创造了许多新岗位。

e.en: The lung's {reexpansion} was visible on the scan.
e.zh: 扫描图上可以看到肺部再次扩张。

e.en: The school may {reexpel} him if he breaks the rules again.
e.zh: 如果他再次违规，学校可能会重新开除他。

e.en: The mechanism can {reexpel} trapped air from the tube.
e.zh: 这个装置能再次排出管内滞留的空气。

e.en: The song made her {reexperience} that summer.
e.zh: 这首歌让她重新体验了那个夏天的感觉。

e.en: Veterans may {reexperience} trauma through sudden memories.
e.zh: 退伍军人可能会因突如其来的记忆再次经历创伤。

e.en: Could you {reexplain} the last step more slowly?
e.zh: 你能把最后一步更慢地再解释一遍吗？

e.en: The teacher {reexplained} the rule with examples.
e.zh: 老师用例子重新说明了这条规则。

e.en: Scientists will {reexplore} the cave with better equipment.
e.zh: 科学家将用更好的设备重新探索这个洞穴。

e.en: The essay {reexplores} old questions about memory.
e.zh: 这篇文章再次探讨了关于记忆的老问题。

e.en: The company will {reexport} the goods to Europe.
e.zh: 这家公司会把这些货物再出口到欧洲。

e.en: Some countries {reexport} imported oil after refining it.
e.zh: 一些国家会在炼制进口石油后再转口输出。

e.en: The law restricts {reexportation} of sensitive technology.
e.zh: 该法律限制敏感技术的再出口。

e.en: Customs recorded the {reexportation} of the machinery.
e.zh: 海关记录了这批机器的转口输出。

e.en: Engineers had to {refabricate} the damaged panel.
e.zh: 工程师不得不重新制造受损的面板。

e.en: The artist chose to {refabricate} the sculpture in steel.
e.zh: 艺术家选择用钢材重新制作这件雕塑。

e.en: The bridge required complete {refabrication} of several beams.
e.zh: 这座桥需要对几根梁进行完全重新制造。

e.en: Her project involved the {refabrication} of found materials.
e.zh: 她的项目涉及对拾得材料的改造重制。

e.en: They decided to {reface} the old kitchen cabinets.
e.zh: 他们决定给旧厨房橱柜换上新面板。

e.en: The mason will {reface} the wall with fresh stone.
e.zh: 石匠会用新石料重修这面墙的表面。

e.en: The {refaced} cabinets made the kitchen look new.
e.zh: 换过面板的橱柜让厨房看起来焕然一新。

e.en: A {refaced} wall still needs proper sealing.
e.zh: 重修过表面的墙仍然需要妥善密封。

e.en: A skilled {refacer} can save the old cabinets.
e.zh: 熟练的翻新师傅能救回这些旧橱柜。

e.en: The mechanic used a {refacer} on the worn part.
e.zh: 技工用换面工具处理了磨损的零件。

e.en: He {refaces} fireplaces for historic homes.
e.zh: 他为历史住宅重修壁炉表面。

e.en: The company {refaces} cabinets instead of replacing them.
e.zh: 这家公司给橱柜换面，而不是直接更换。

e.en: Cabinet {refacing} is cheaper than full replacement.
e.zh: 橱柜换面比全部更换更便宜。

e.en: The road needs {refacing} after years of heavy traffic.
e.zh: 多年繁忙车流过后，这条路需要重新铺面。

e.en: The novel shows the {refashionment} of an old myth.
e.zh: 这部小说展现了对古老神话的重新塑造。

e.en: Her {refashionment} of the dress surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她对这条裙子的改造翻新让所有人吃惊。

e.en: Please {refasten} your seat belt before landing.
e.zh: 降落前请重新系好安全带。

e.en: He stopped to {refasten} the loose strap.
e.zh: 他停下来把松了的带子重新固定好。

refastened.t: 重新系紧的；再次固定的

e.en: She {refastened} the clasp before leaving.
e.zh: 她离开前重新扣好了搭扣。

e.en: The panel was {refastened} with stronger screws.
e.zh: 这块面板用更牢的螺丝重新固定好了。

e.en: He was {refastening} his helmet after the break.
e.zh: 休息后他正在重新系紧头盔。

e.en: The repair required {refastening} several loose boards.
e.zh: 这次维修需要重新固定几块松动的木板。

e.en: She {refastens} the gate every evening.
e.zh: 她每天晚上都会重新闩好大门。

e.en: The clip {refastens} easily after cleaning.
e.zh: 这个夹子清洁后很容易重新扣上。

e.en: The travelers stopped to {refect} at the inn.
e.zh: 旅人们停在客栈进食休整。

e.en: A quiet hour can {refect} the weary mind.
e.zh: 安静的一小时能让疲惫的心神恢复。

e.en: The monks gathered for a simple {refection}.
e.zh: 修士们聚在一起吃一顿简单的餐食。

e.en: After the climb, they needed rest and {refection}.
e.zh: 登山之后，他们需要休息和进食恢复。

e.en: Each {refectioner} received bread and soup.
e.zh: 每位用餐者都分到了面包和汤。

e.en: The {refectioner} kept order in the dining hall.
e.zh: 餐厅管理者维持着饭厅里的秩序。

refectorian.t: 食堂的；餐厅人员的；用餐者的

e.en: The college kept a {refectorian} schedule during term.
e.zh: 学院在学期中保持食堂式的用餐安排。

e.en: Several {refectorians} complained about the cold soup.
e.zh: 几位在餐厅用餐的人抱怨汤已经凉了。

referend.t: 所指对象；被指称的事物

e.en: In this sentence, the pronoun's {referend} is unclear.
e.zh: 在这个句子里，代词所指的对象不清楚。

e.en: The symbol has no obvious {referend} outside the theory.
e.zh: 这个符号在该理论之外没有明显的指称对象。

referendary.t: 公投相关的；需提交公投的

e.en: The council rejected the {referendary} proposal.
e.zh: 委员会否决了这项需提交公投的提案。

e.en: A {referendary} vote was scheduled for June.
e.zh: 一次公投性质的投票被安排在六月举行。

referrable.t: 可归因于；可提交转介的

e.en: Her symptoms were {referrable} to stress.
e.zh: 她的症状可以归因于压力。

e.en: Minor cases are {referrable} to the local clinic.
e.zh: 轻微病例可以转介到当地诊所。

e.en: The report contains a misspelled {referrence} in the notes.
e.zh: 报告的注释里有一个拼错的“参考”一词。

e.en: Please change {referrence} to reference before printing.
e.zh: 打印前请把referrence改成reference。

e.en: The pain is {referrible} to a nerve injury.
e.zh: 这种疼痛可归因于神经损伤。

e.en: These patients are {referrible} to a specialist.
e.zh: 这些病人可以转诊给专科医生。

e.en: Farmers {refertilize} the field after each harvest.
e.zh: 农民每次收获后都会给田地重新施肥。

e.en: The project aims to {refertilize} exhausted soil.
e.zh: 这个项目旨在让耗竭的土壤重新变得肥沃。

e.en: He was called a {reffo} in the schoolyard.
e.zh: 他在校园里被人用俚语叫作难民。

e.en: The novel uses {reffo} as harsh wartime slang.
e.zh: 这部小说把reffo用作战时刺耳的俚语。

refight.t: 重新打；再次争论或较量

e.en: They refused to {refight} the old election.
e.zh: 他们拒绝重新争论那场旧选举。

e.en: The army had to {refight} the battle at dawn.
e.zh: 军队不得不在黎明时重新打这场仗。

e.en: We need to {refigure} the budget after the delay.
e.zh: 延期之后，我们需要重新计算预算。

e.en: The artist tried to {refigure} the myth for modern readers.
e.zh: 艺术家试图为现代读者重新构想这个神话。

e.en: The lab required {refiltration} of the cloudy sample.
e.zh: 实验室要求对浑浊样本再次过滤。

e.en: Slow {refiltration} improved the water's clarity.
e.zh: 缓慢的重新过滤提高了水的清澈度。

refire.t: 重新点火；再次烧制；重新激发

e.en: The technician tried to {refire} the engine.
e.zh: 技术员试图重新启动发动机点火。

e.en: Potters often {refire} pieces with weak glaze.
e.zh: 陶工常把釉色不佳的作品再次烧制。

refired.t: 重新点火的；再次烧制的

e.en: The kiln {refired} the cracked tiles overnight.
e.zh: 窑炉连夜把开裂的瓷砖再次烧制了一遍。

e.en: His speech {refired} their enthusiasm for reform.
e.zh: 他的演讲重新激发了他们对改革的热情。

e.en: The ship's {refitment} took three months.
e.zh: 这艘船的整修花了三个月。

e.en: Careful {refitment} made the old machine usable again.
e.zh: 细致的重新装配让旧机器又能使用了。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {refixation} of the loose implant.
e.zh: 外科医生建议重新固定松动的植入物。

e.en: Chemical {refixation} preserved the tissue for analysis.
e.zh: 化学再固定保存了组织以便分析。

reflag.t: 重新标记；更换船旗国登记

e.en: Please {reflag} the message as urgent.
e.zh: 请把这条消息重新标记为紧急。

e.en: The company decided to {reflag} the vessel overseas.
e.zh: 公司决定把这艘船改挂海外船旗。

e.en: The app supports {reflagging} tasks after review.
e.zh: 这个应用支持审核后重新标记任务。

e.en: The fleet's {reflagging} reduced its tax burden.
e.zh: 船队改挂旗登记降低了税负。

e.en: The government tried to {reflate} the economy.
e.zh: 政府试图刺激经济并让通胀回升。

e.en: We had to {reflate} the mattress after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后我们不得不给床垫重新充气。

reflated.t: 被再通胀的；重新充气的

e.en: The central bank {reflated} demand with cheap credit.
e.zh: 央行通过低息信贷重新刺激了需求。

e.en: The {reflated} tire held pressure all night.
e.zh: 重新充气的轮胎整晚都保持着气压。

e.en: That policy {reflates} asset prices quickly.
e.zh: 那项政策会迅速推高资产价格。

e.en: She {reflates} the ball before every practice.
e.zh: 她每次训练前都会给球重新充气。

e.en: Officials discussed {reflating} the weak economy.
e.zh: 官员们讨论了如何重新刺激疲弱的经济。

e.en: He was {reflating} the pool toys by hand.
e.zh: 他正在用手给泳池玩具重新充气。

reflationary.t: 促通胀的；刺激经济回升的

e.en: The budget included several {reflationary} measures.
e.zh: 预算中包含几项刺激通胀回升的措施。

e.en: Investors welcomed the government's {reflationary} policy.
e.zh: 投资者欢迎政府刺激经济回升的政策。

e.en: Only some wavelengths are {reflectible} by the coating.
e.zh: 只有部分波长能被这种涂层反射。

e.en: The error is {reflectible} in the final score.
e.zh: 这个错误会反映在最终得分中。

reflectional.t: 反射的；沉思的；反映性的

e.en: The diagram shows {reflectional} symmetry across the line.
e.zh: 这张图显示了沿这条线的镜像对称。

e.en: Her diary has a quiet {reflectional} tone.
e.zh: 她的日记带有安静沉思的语气。

e.en: The engineer checked the cable with a {reflectometer}.
e.zh: 工程师用反射计检查了电缆。

e.en: A {reflectometer} measured how much light returned.
e.zh: 反射率测量仪测出了有多少光被反射回来。

e.en: Engineers used {reflectometry} to locate the cable fault.
e.zh: 工程师用反射测量法定位电缆故障。

e.en: Optical {reflectometry} revealed tiny defects in the coating.
e.zh: 光学反射测量法发现了涂层中的细小缺陷。

e.en: The crew will {reflectorise} the road signs tonight.
e.zh: 施工队今晚会给路标装上反射材料。

e.en: Cyclists often {reflectorise} their helmets for safety.
e.zh: 骑行者常把头盔做成反光的以保安全。

reflectorized.t: 装有反射器的；反光化的

e.en: The {reflectorized} jacket was visible in the rain.
e.zh: 那件反光夹克在雨中也很显眼。

e.en: Workers installed {reflectorized} markers along the curve.
e.zh: 工人在弯道旁安装了反光标记。

e.en: The coating {reflectorizes} the surface without changing its color.
e.zh: 这种涂层能使表面反光而不改变颜色。

e.en: The city {reflectorizes} school crossings every autumn.
e.zh: 市政府每年秋天都会给学校路口加反光标识。

e.en: They are {reflectorizing} the barriers before winter storms arrive.
e.zh: 他们正在给护栏做反光处理，以备冬季风暴来临。

e.en: {Reflectorizing} a bicycle makes night riding safer.
e.zh: 给自行车加反光装置能让夜骑更安全。

e.en: The technician checked the lens with a {reflectoscope}.
e.zh: 技术员用反射检查仪检测镜片。

e.en: A {reflectoscope} can reveal flaws beneath a shiny surface.
e.zh: 反射检查仪能显示光亮表面下的缺陷。

e.en: The mirror uses a {reflexible} film instead of glass.
e.zh: 这面镜子使用可反射薄膜而不是玻璃。

e.en: The old grammar described the verb as {reflexible}.
e.zh: 旧语法书把这个动词描述为可反身使用。

e.en: The paper analyzes {reflexivization} in several Romance languages.
e.zh: 这篇论文分析了几种罗曼语中的反身化现象。

e.en: Children learn {reflexivization} later than simple pronoun use.
e.zh: 儿童掌握反身结构形成晚于普通代词用法。

e.en: She visited a {reflexologist} for foot pain.
e.zh: 她因脚痛去看了一位反射疗法师。

e.en: The {reflexologist} explained which pressure points he would use.
e.zh: 反射疗法师解释了他会按压哪些穴位。

e.en: The lab used a {reflexometer} to measure pupil response.
e.zh: 实验室用反应测量仪测量瞳孔反应。

e.en: A {reflexometer} recorded how quickly the driver reacted.
e.zh: 反应测量仪记录了司机反应的速度。

e.en: The garden showed a late {reflorescence} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后花园出现了一次晚来的再开花。

e.en: Critics noted a {reflorescence} of regional poetry.
e.zh: 评论家注意到地方诗歌出现了复兴。

e.en: The {reflorescent} shrubs brightened the autumn path.
e.zh: 再次开花的灌木照亮了秋日小径。

e.en: A {reflorescent} interest in folk music filled the clubs.
e.zh: 民间音乐复兴的兴趣让各家俱乐部热闹起来。

e.en: Local markets began to {reflourish} after the railway reopened.
e.zh: 铁路重开后，当地市场开始重新繁荣。

e.en: Old crafts can {reflourish} when young designers adopt them.
e.zh: 年轻设计师采用旧工艺时，它们可能再度兴盛。

e.en: The designer adjusted the text to {reflow} on small screens.
e.zh: 设计师调整文字，使其能在小屏幕上重新排版。

e.en: Hot solder will {reflow} and bond the component firmly.
e.zh: 受热的焊料会回流，并把元件牢固连接。

e.en: With careful pruning, the roses may {reflower} in September.
e.zh: 经过细心修剪，玫瑰可能在九月重新开花。

e.en: The gardener hoped to {reflower} the exhausted orchid.
e.zh: 园丁希望让那株疲弱的兰花再次开花。

e.en: The {reflowering} of the cherry tree surprised everyone.
e.zh: 樱桃树再次开花让大家都很惊讶。

e.en: They celebrated the {reflowering} of independent theater.
e.zh: 他们庆祝独立戏剧的再度繁荣。

e.en: The article is {reflowing} correctly on the phone.
e.zh: 这篇文章在手机上正在正确地重新排版。

e.en: The molten metal was {reflowing} into the narrow joint.
e.zh: 熔化的金属正回流进狭窄的接缝。

e.en: The {refluence} of the tide exposed black rocks.
e.zh: 潮水退去露出了黑色岩石。

e.en: Doctors discussed venous {refluence} after the scan.
e.zh: 扫描后医生讨论了静脉回流问题。

e.en: The {refluent} water left shells on the sand.
e.zh: 退去的海水把贝壳留在沙滩上。

e.en: A {refluent} current carried the dye back upstream.
e.zh: 一股回流的水流把染料带回上游。

e.en: A warm meal seemed to {refocillate} the weary travelers.
e.zh: 一顿热饭似乎让疲惫的旅人恢复了精神。

e.en: The old writer used humor to {refocillate} his readers.
e.zh: 那位老作家用幽默让读者重新振作。

e.en: The cobbler will {refoot} the worn boots tomorrow.
e.zh: 鞋匠明天会给那双旧靴子换底。

e.en: Workers had to {refoot} the ladder on firmer ground.
e.zh: 工人们不得不把梯脚重新安在更坚实的地面上。

e.en: The blacksmith will {reforge} the broken blade.
e.zh: 铁匠会重新锻造那把断刃。

e.en: The crisis forced them to {reforge} their alliance.
e.zh: 这场危机迫使他们重塑联盟。

e.en: The museum hired a skilled {reforger} for the sword.
e.zh: 博物馆雇了一名熟练的重锻匠修复那把剑。

e.en: She became a {reforger} of the party's public image.
e.zh: 她成了该党公众形象的重塑者。

e.en: The report questioned the {reformability} of the prison system.
e.zh: 报告质疑监狱制度的可改革性。

e.en: Engineers tested the plastic's {reformability} under heat.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种塑料受热后的可改造性。

e.en: The old tax code is {reformable} with enough political will.
e.zh: 只要有足够的政治意愿，旧税法是可以改革的。

e.en: The damaged material proved {reformable} under heat and pressure.
e.zh: 受损材料在加热和加压后证明可以重新成形。

e.en: The refinery blended {reformate} into the gasoline pool.
e.zh: 炼油厂把重整油调入汽油组分中。

e.en: This {reformate} contains a high proportion of aromatic compounds.
e.zh: 这种重整产物含有较高比例的芳香族化合物。

e.en: The article studies {reformational} movements in sixteenth-century Europe.
e.zh: 这篇文章研究十六世纪欧洲的宗教改革运动。

e.en: Her plan had a deeply {reformational} aim.
e.zh: 她的计划有很强的改革目的。

e.en: The party promoted a {reformationary} program for public schools.
e.zh: 该党推动了一套面向公立学校的改革性方案。

e.en: His {reformationary} speeches unsettled the old leadership.
e.zh: 他的变革派演说让旧领导层感到不安。

e.en: The judge favored a {reformative} sentence over a purely punitive one.
e.zh: 法官倾向于改造性的判决，而不是单纯惩罚。

e.en: Education can have a {reformative} effect on social habits.
e.zh: 教育能对社会习惯产生改造作用。

e.en: Engineers had to {refortify} the sea wall after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，工程师不得不重新加固海堤。

e.en: The army moved quickly to {refortify} the border posts.
e.zh: 军队迅速行动，再次加固边境哨所。

e.en: The lens material was tested for {refractability}.
e.zh: 这种镜片材料接受了折射能力测试。

e.en: High {refractability} makes the crystal useful in optical devices.
e.zh: 较高的可折射性使这种晶体适用于光学设备。

e.en: Only part of the beam was {refractable} through the prism.
e.zh: 只有部分光束能通过棱镜发生折射。

e.en: The substance is {refractable} at visible wavelengths.
e.zh: 这种物质在可见光波长下可以折射。

e.en: The microscope revealed tiny {refractile} granules inside the cell.
e.zh: 显微镜显示细胞内有细小的折光颗粒。

e.en: Her eyes had a bright, almost {refractile} shine.
e.zh: 她的眼睛明亮得几乎带着反光。

e.en: The scientist corrected a small {refractional} error in the measurements.
e.zh: 科学家修正了测量中的一个小折射误差。

e.en: The telescope design reduces {refractional} distortion near the edges.
e.zh: 这种望远镜设计减少了边缘附近的折射畸变。

e.en: Humidity changes the air's {refractivity} near the ground.
e.zh: 湿度会改变近地空气的折射率。

e.en: The gemstone's {refractivity} gives it unusual brilliance.
e.zh: 这颗宝石的折光性让它显得格外明亮。

e.en: The brewer used a {refractometer} to check the sugar level.
e.zh: 酿酒师用折射仪检查糖分含量。

e.en: A handheld {refractometer} can measure the salinity of seawater.
e.zh: 手持折光计可以测量海水盐度。

e.en: The lab reported {refractometric} data for each oil sample.
e.zh: 实验室报告了每个油样的折光法数据。

e.en: A {refractometric} test confirmed the solution's concentration.
e.zh: 折射测量测试确认了溶液浓度。

e.en: The technician used {refractometry} to identify the unknown liquid.
e.zh: 技术员用折光测定来识别未知液体。

e.en: In food analysis, {refractometry} often estimates sugar concentration.
e.zh: 在食品分析中，折射测量法常用于估算糖浓度。

e.en: The furnace lining was chosen for its {refractoriness}.
e.zh: 炉衬因其难熔性而被选用。

e.en: The child's {refractoriness} made every routine a struggle.
e.zh: 这个孩子的顽固让每个日常安排都变得费劲。

e.en: Molten metal was poured into a {refractory-lined} vessel.
e.zh: 熔融金属被倒入一个衬有耐火材料的容器。

e.en: The plant installed a new {refractory-lined} kiln.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一座新的耐火衬里窑炉。

e.en: The optician examined the lens with a {refractoscope}.
e.zh: 验光师用折射检查仪检查镜片。

e.en: An old {refractoscope} stood on the laboratory bench.
e.zh: 一台旧折光镜放在实验室工作台上。

e.en: The lawyer called the witness's claim clearly {refragable}.
e.zh: 律师称证人的说法显然可以反驳。

e.en: A {refragable} argument should not be treated as settled fact.
e.zh: 一个可驳倒的论点不应被当成定论。

e.en: Try to {reframe} the problem as an opportunity to learn.
e.zh: 试着把这个问题换个角度看成学习机会。

e.en: The carpenter had to {reframe} the damaged doorway.
e.zh: 木匠不得不重新装配受损的门框。

e.en: The therapist {reframes} failure as useful feedback.
e.zh: 治疗师把失败重新解释为有用的反馈。

e.en: The editor {reframes} the debate in simpler terms.
e.zh: 编辑用更简单的说法重新表述这场争论。

e.en: Newton studied the {refrangibility} of different colors of light.
e.zh: 牛顿研究了不同颜色光的可折射性。

e.en: The mineral's {refrangibility} helped identify it under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种矿物的折光性帮助人们在显微镜下识别它。

e.en: Blue light is more {refrangible} than red light.
e.zh: 蓝光比红光更容易折射。

e.en: The glass showed strongly {refrangible} properties.
e.zh: 这种玻璃表现出很强的折光特性。

e.en: The experiment compared the {refrangibleness} of several transparent media.
e.zh: 实验比较了几种透明介质的可折射性。

e.en: Its unusual {refrangibleness} made the crystal valuable to researchers.
e.zh: 它异常的折光程度使这种晶体对研究人员很有价值。

e.en: The lawyer submitted a {refutatory} brief before noon.
e.zh: 律师在中午前提交了一份驳斥性案情摘要。

e.en: Her tone was calm but clearly {refutatory}.
e.zh: 她语气平静，但明显带有反驳意味。

e.en: His essay offered a careful {refution} of the rumor.
e.zh: 他的文章对那则谣言作了细致的驳斥。

e.en: The old text uses {refution} where modern writers say refutation.
e.zh: 这篇旧文用refution一词，现代作者通常说refutation。

e.en: The guests enjoyed the lavish {regalement} after the ceremony.
e.zh: 典礼之后，宾客们享用了丰盛的款待。

e.en: For him, the quiet music was a rare {regalement}.
e.zh: 对他来说，那段安静的音乐是一种难得的享受。

e.en: The historian traced {regalism} in the king's legal reforms.
e.zh: 历史学家在国王的法律改革中追溯了王权主义的影响。

e.en: Critics said his theory sounded like old-fashioned {regalism}.
e.zh: 批评者说，他的理论听起来像过时的君权至上论。

e.en: A committed {regalist} defended the monarch's authority.
e.zh: 一名坚定的王权主义者为君主权威辩护。

e.en: The pamphlet took a strongly {regalist} position.
e.zh: 这本小册子采取了强烈的君权派立场。

e.en: The speech helped {regalvanize} the tired campaign team.
e.zh: 那场演讲帮助疲惫的竞选团队重新振作起来。

e.en: The workshop will {regalvanize} the metal parts before assembly.
e.zh: 车间会在组装前再次给这些金属零件镀锌。

e.en: The shield showed a lion {regardant} in gold.
e.zh: 盾徽上画着一只回首看的金色狮子。

e.en: She sat {regardant}, as if waiting for an answer.
e.zh: 她注视着坐在那里，仿佛在等一个回答。

e.en: He remained {regardful} of the family's privacy.
e.zh: 他始终很注意保护那家人的隐私。

e.en: A {regardful} host noticed every guest's needs.
e.zh: 体贴的主人留意到了每位客人的需要。

e.en: She listened {regardfully} to the elderly witness.
e.zh: 她很留心地听那位年长证人说话。

e.en: He spoke {regardfully}, avoiding anything too personal.
e.zh: 他说话很体贴，避开了过于私人的内容。

e.en: Her {regardfulness} made the difficult visit easier.
e.zh: 她的体贴周到让那次艰难的探访轻松了些。

e.en: The policy shows little {regardfulness} for local conditions.
e.zh: 这项政策几乎没有顾及当地情况。

e.en: The terminal handles LNG storage and {regasification}.
e.zh: 该接收站负责液化天然气的储存和再气化。

e.en: Engineers delayed {regasification} until the pressure stabilized.
e.zh: 工程师等压力稳定后才推迟结束再气化流程。

e.en: The plant can {regasify} imported liquefied natural gas.
e.zh: 这座工厂能将进口液化天然气再气化。

e.en: Operators must {regasify} the fuel at a controlled rate.
e.zh: 操作员必须按受控速率使燃料再气化。

e.en: The technician recommended {regassing} the old refrigerator.
e.zh: 技师建议给那台旧冰箱重新充注制冷气体。

e.en: After {regassing}, the air-conditioning system worked again.
e.zh: 重新充气后，空调系统又能运转了。

e.en: The coach told the players to {regather} near midfield.
e.zh: 教练让球员们在中场附近重新集合。

e.en: She paused to {regather} her thoughts before replying.
e.zh: 她停下来整理思绪后才回答。

e.en: The scattered crowd {regathered} outside the station.
e.zh: 散开的人群又在车站外重新聚集起来。

e.en: He {regathered} his notes after the wind blew them away.
e.zh: 风把笔记吹散后，他又把它们收拢起来。

e.en: The team is {regathering} after a difficult season.
e.zh: 经历艰难赛季后，这支队伍正在重新集结。

e.en: She spent the morning {regathering} evidence for the report.
e.zh: 她上午一直在为报告重新收集证据。

regelate.t: 复冰；压力融化后再冻结

e.en: Under pressure, the ice may {regelate} after melting.
e.zh: 在压力作用下，冰融化后可能会重新冻结。

e.en: The experiment showed how glaciers can {regelate} around rocks.
e.zh: 实验显示了冰川如何在岩石周围复冰。

e.en: Faraday studied {regelation} in blocks of ice.
e.zh: 法拉第研究过冰块中的复冰现象。

e.en: The lecturer used {regelation} to explain glacier movement.
e.zh: 讲师用复冰现象解释冰川运动。

e.en: They bought a {regency-style} mirror for the hall.
e.zh: 他们为大厅买了一面摄政时期风格的镜子。

e.en: The hotel serves tea in a {regency-style} drawing room.
e.zh: 酒店在一间摄政时期风格的客厅里供应茶点。

e.en: The sermon described spiritual {regeneracy} after repentance.
e.zh: 布道描述了悔改之后的灵性重生状态。

e.en: The poet saw spring as a sign of {regeneracy}.
e.zh: 诗人把春天看作万物更新的象征。

e.en: The court may {refree} the detainee after review.
e.zh: 复审后，法院可能会重新释放这名被拘留者。

e.en: They promised to {refree} the bird once it recovered.
e.zh: 他们承诺等这只鸟康复后会再次放归。

e.en: Do not {refreeze} meat after it has thawed.
e.zh: 肉解冻后不要再重新冷冻。

e.en: The lake can {refreeze} overnight in severe cold.
e.zh: 严寒时湖面可能一夜之间再次结冰。

e.en: She {refreezes} leftover soup in small containers.
e.zh: 她把剩下的汤分装到小盒里重新冷冻。

e.en: The road {refreezes} after sunset and becomes dangerous.
e.zh: 日落后路面会再次结冰，变得很危险。

e.en: The old recipe used mint as a {refreshant}.
e.zh: 这个老配方用薄荷作为提神清凉的成分。

e.en: Cold tea served as a simple {refreshant} after work.
e.zh: 下班后，凉茶成了一种简单的提神饮品。

e.en: A walk by the river can {refreshen} the mind.
e.zh: 在河边散步能让头脑重新清爽起来。

e.en: She opened the windows to {refreshen} the room.
e.zh: 她打开窗户，让房间重新变得清新。

e.en: The shower felt wonderfully {refreshful} after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后，这个淋浴让人觉得格外清爽。

e.en: He wrote in a calm and {refreshful} style.
e.zh: 他的文字风格平和而令人振作。

e.en: The wind blew {refreshfully} through the open door.
e.zh: 风从敞开的门口吹进来，令人清爽。

e.en: She spoke {refreshfully} honestly about the problem.
e.zh: 她谈到这个问题时坦率得令人耳目一新。

e.en: The machine uses a {refrigerative} cycle to cool air.
e.zh: 这台机器利用制冷循环来冷却空气。

e.en: The cream had a mildly {refrigerative} effect on the skin.
e.zh: 这种乳霜对皮肤有轻微的清凉作用。

e.en: We bought a new {refrigerator-freezer} for the kitchen.
e.zh: 我们给厨房买了一台新的冷藏冷冻两用冰箱。

e.en: This {refrigerator-freezer} has separate temperature controls.
e.zh: 这台冷藏冷冻两用冰箱有独立温控。

e.en: The samples were kept in a {refrigeratory} chamber.
e.zh: 样本被保存在一个冷藏室内。

e.en: Early ships used {refrigeratory} equipment for fresh food.
e.zh: 早期船只使用制冷设备来保存新鲜食物。

e.en: The mineral's {refringence} helped identify it under light.
e.zh: 这种矿物的折射性帮助人们在光照下识别它。

e.en: Glass varies in {refringence} depending on its composition.
e.zh: 玻璃的折光能力会随成分不同而变化。

e.en: A prism is a {refringent} optical object.
e.zh: 棱镜是一种具有折光性的光学物体。

e.en: The lens contains a highly {refringent} material.
e.zh: 这个镜片含有高折射性的材料。

refroze.t: 重新冷冻了；再次结冰了

e.en: The soup {refroze} after we put it back outside.
e.zh: 我们把汤放回室外后，它又冻住了。

e.en: Water on the steps {refroze} during the night.
e.zh: 台阶上的水夜里再次结冰了。

refrozen.t: 重新冷冻的；再次冻结的

e.en: The package warned against eating {refrozen} seafood.
e.zh: 包装上警告不要食用重新冷冻过的海鲜。

e.en: The pond was {refrozen} by morning.
e.zh: 到了早晨，池塘又结冰了。

e.en: He stood {reft} of all hope.
e.zh: 他站在那里，所有希望都被夺走了。

e.en: The village was {reft} of its young workers.
e.zh: 这个村庄失去了年轻劳动力。

e.en: The valley served as a {refugium} during the ice age.
e.zh: 冰河时期，这个山谷成了生物的避难所。

e.en: A small {refugium} in the aquarium shelters tiny creatures.
e.zh: 水族箱里的小型避难区保护着微小生物。

e.en: The sunset filled the room with golden {refulgence}.
e.zh: 夕阳让房间充满金色的灿烂光辉。

e.en: Critics praised the {refulgence} of her prose.
e.zh: 评论家称赞她散文中的华美光彩。

e.en: Check the ticket's {refundability} before you pay.
e.zh: 付款前先确认这张票是否可以退款。

e.en: The policy explains the {refundability} of each fee.
e.zh: 这项政策说明了每笔费用的可退还性。

e.en: The hotel's {refurnishment} took nearly three months.
e.zh: 这家酒店重新布置家具花了将近三个月。

e.en: The army arranged the {refurnishment} of the remote post.
e.zh: 军方安排了给偏远哨所重新供应物资。

e.en: The offer was generous but still {refusable}.
e.zh: 这个提议很慷慨，但仍然可以拒绝。

e.en: Some services are optional and {refusable} at booking.
e.zh: 有些服务是可选的，预订时可以谢绝。

refusnik.t: 拒绝服从者；拒绝移民者

e.en: He became a {refusnik} after opposing military service.
e.zh: 他反对服兵役后成了一名拒服者。

e.en: The Soviet {refusnik} waited years for permission to leave.
e.zh: 这名苏联拒绝获准移民者等了多年才得到离境许可。

e.en: Science depends partly on the {refutability} of claims.
e.zh: 科学在一定程度上依赖论断的可证伪性。

e.en: The theory's {refutability} made it open to testing.
e.zh: 这个理论具有可反驳性，因此可以接受检验。

e.en: His argument is weak but clearly {refutable}.
e.zh: 他的论点很薄弱，而且显然可以反驳。

e.en: A scientific claim should be {refutable} in principle.
e.zh: 科学主张原则上应当可以被证伪。

e.en: The hypothesis was stated {refutably} and precisely.
e.zh: 这个假说表述得精确，而且可以被证伪。

e.en: She framed the claim {refutably} for the debate.
e.zh: 她为辩论把这个主张表述成可反驳的形式。

e.en: His article offered a detailed {refutal} of the charge.
e.zh: 他的文章对这项指控作出了详细反驳。

e.en: The lawyer's {refutal} was brief but effective.
e.zh: 律师的驳斥很简短，但很有效。

e.en: The design was {registrable} as a trademark.
e.zh: 这个设计可以登记为商标。

e.en: Only {registrable} voters may sign the petition.
e.zh: 只有可登记的选民才能签署请愿书。

e.en: The clerk checked the {registral} records.
e.zh: 办事员核对了登记记录。

e.en: A {registral} error delayed the certificate.
e.zh: 一个登记错误耽误了证书办理。

registrarship.t: 注册主任职位；登记员任期

e.en: She accepted the {registrarship} at the college.
e.zh: 她接受了学院注册主任的职位。

e.en: His {registrarship} lasted only two years.
e.zh: 他的登记员任期只持续了两年。

e.en: The old {registrary} kept the parish books.
e.zh: 那位老登记官保管着教区簿册。

e.en: Documents were stored in the university {registrary}.
e.zh: 文件存放在大学登记处。

e.en: Applicants must {registrate} before the deadline.
e.zh: 申请人必须在截止日期前登记。

e.en: The device can {registrate} each pressure change.
e.zh: 这台设备能记录每次压力变化。

e.en: They decided to {reglaze} the cracked window.
e.zh: 他们决定给破裂的窗户重装玻璃。

e.en: The potter will {reglaze} the bowl tonight.
e.zh: 陶工今晚会给这个碗重新上釉。

reglazed.t: 重新上釉的；重装玻璃的

e.en: The {reglazed} windows kept the room warmer.
e.zh: 重装玻璃后的窗户让房间更暖和。

e.en: She sold the {reglazed} vase at the market.
e.zh: 她在集市上卖掉了重新上釉的花瓶。

e.en: He {reglazes} antique windows for a living.
e.zh: 他靠给古董窗户重装玻璃为生。

e.en: The artist {reglazes} the tiles after firing.
e.zh: 艺术家烧制后会给瓷砖重新上釉。

e.en: A thin {reglet} filled the gap in the wall.
e.zh: 一根窄木条填住了墙上的缝隙。

e.en: The printer inserted a {reglet} between the lines.
e.zh: 排字工在行间插入了一根隔条。

e.en: The embers were {reglowing} after the wind rose.
e.zh: 风起后余烬又重新发亮。

e.en: Her hope seemed {reglowing} after the good news.
e.zh: 听到好消息后，她的希望似乎又燃起来了。

e.en: Scientists studied {regmagenesis} on the meteorite surface.
e.zh: 科学家研究了陨石表面的熔蚀形成过程。

e.en: The grooves resulted from {regmagenesis} during atmospheric entry.
e.zh: 这些沟槽源于进入大气层时的熔蚀形成。

e.en: The stone showed a {regmatic} pattern.
e.zh: 这块石头呈现出陨石熔蚀坑状的纹理。

e.en: He described the {regmatic} marks on the sample.
e.zh: 他描述了样本上的陨石熔蚀坑痕迹。

e.en: Medieval maps divided the land into several {regna}.
e.zh: 中世纪地图把这片土地分成几个王国。

e.en: The textbook lists the biological {regna} separately.
e.zh: 这本教材把各个生物界分开列出。

e.en: The charter is dated by the king's {regnal} year.
e.zh: 这份宪章按国王在位年份注明日期。

e.en: Her {regnal} style changed after the coronation.
e.zh: 加冕后，她的王朝称号形式改变了。

e.en: The monk wrote about the northern {regnum}.
e.zh: 那位修士写到了北方王国。

e.en: In taxonomy, each {regnum} contains many groups.
e.zh: 在分类学中，每个生物界都包含许多类群。

e.en: My car {rego} expires next month.
e.zh: 我的汽车登记下个月到期。

e.en: She paid the {rego} before driving away.
e.zh: 她开车离开前先付了车辆注册费。

e.en: The blocked pipe began to {regorge} dirty water.
e.zh: 堵住的管道开始倒流脏水。

e.en: The bird may {regorge} food for its young.
e.zh: 这种鸟可能会把食物反刍给幼鸟。

e.en: The drain {regorged} water into the basement.
e.zh: 排水管把水倒流进地下室。

e.en: The mother bird {regorged} food for the chicks.
e.zh: 母鸟把食物反吐给雏鸟吃。

e.en: The sewer {regorges} waste after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨后下水道会倒流污物。

e.en: A pelican {regorges} fish to feed its chick.
e.zh: 鹈鹕会反吐鱼来喂幼鸟。

e.en: The sink was {regorging} foul water all night.
e.zh: 水槽整晚都在倒流臭水。

e.en: The parent bird was {regorging} food patiently.
e.zh: 亲鸟耐心地把食物反吐出来。

e.en: The survey identified {regosol} on the dry slope.
e.zh: 调查在干燥坡地上发现了弱发育土。

e.en: Crops struggle in shallow {regosol} without irrigation.
e.zh: 没有灌溉时，作物很难在浅层弱发育土中生长。

e.en: The engineer ordered a {regradation} of the road surface.
e.zh: 工程师要求重新调整路面的坡度。

e.en: The map shows the river's gradual {regradation} after flooding.
e.zh: 这张地图显示洪水后河道逐渐重新堆积成形。

e.en: The gardener will {regraft} the branch in spring.
e.zh: 园丁会在春天重新嫁接这根枝条。

e.en: Doctors may {regraft} skin if the first graft fails.
e.zh: 如果第一次植皮失败，医生可能会再次移植皮肤。

e.en: The board voted to {regrant} the license.
e.zh: 董事会投票决定重新授予许可证。

e.en: The court may {regrant} bail after reviewing new evidence.
e.zh: 法院审查新证据后可能再次准予保释。

e.en: Her research permit was {regranted} last week.
e.zh: 她的研究许可上周被重新批准了。

e.en: The land rights were {regranted} after the appeal.
e.zh: 上诉之后，土地权利被重新授予。

e.en: They plan to {regrass} the football field.
e.zh: 他们计划给足球场重新铺草皮。

e.en: Heavy use forced the park to {regrass} several bare areas.
e.zh: 频繁使用迫使公园给几处裸露地重新种草。

e.en: The mechanic had to {regrate} the old furnace.
e.zh: 技工不得不给那台旧炉子重新安装炉栅。

e.en: If the cheese clumps, {regrate} it before serving.
e.zh: 如果奶酪结块，上桌前再把它磨碎一次。

e.en: The furnace was {regrated} during the repair.
e.zh: 维修期间炉子被重新装上了炉栅。

e.en: She added {regrated} cheese to the sauce.
e.zh: 她把重新磨碎的奶酪加进酱汁里。

regrater.t: 再磨碎工具；重新装栅者

e.en: Use a {regrater} to refresh the dried cheese.
e.zh: 用再磨碎器把干硬的奶酪重新磨松。

e.en: The factory hired a skilled {regrater} for furnace repairs.
e.zh: 工厂雇了一名熟练工来重新安装炉栅。

e.en: The crew finished {regrating} the furnace before noon.
e.zh: 工人们中午前完成了炉子的重新装栅。

e.en: She kept {regrating} the cheese until it was fine.
e.zh: 她不断把奶酪重新磨碎，直到颗粒很细。

regrator.t: 重新分级器；再调节装置

e.en: The mill installed a {regrator} for finer sorting.
e.zh: 磨坊安装了一台重新分级器，以便更精细地筛选。

e.en: A faulty {regrator} changed the machine's output.
e.zh: 一个有故障的再调节装置改变了机器的产出。

e.en: Spring rains will {regreen} the hills.
e.zh: 春雨会让山坡重新变绿。

e.en: The city hopes to {regreen} abandoned industrial land.
e.zh: 这座城市希望把废弃工业用地重新绿化。

e.en: He paused to {regreet} each guest personally.
e.zh: 他停下来再次亲自问候每位客人。

e.en: After the interruption, she had to {regreet} the audience.
e.zh: 中断之后，她不得不重新向观众致意。

e.en: She {regreets} visitors after every short break.
e.zh: 每次短暂休息后，她都会重新问候来访者。

e.en: The host {regreets} old friends with formal warmth.
e.zh: 主持人以正式而热情的方式再次迎接老朋友。

e.en: Income was the {regressand} in the model.
e.zh: 在这个模型中，收入是回归分析的因变量。

e.en: Choose the {regressand} before selecting predictors.
e.zh: 先选择回归因变量，再选择预测变量。

e.en: Age was a strong {regressor} in the study.
e.zh: 年龄是这项研究中很强的回归变量。

e.en: Each {regressor} must be checked for correlation.
e.zh: 每个回归变量都必须检查其相关性。

e.en: The delay was a {regretable} mistake.
e.zh: 这次延误是一个令人遗憾的错误。

e.en: His spelling is old-fashioned but still {regretable}.
e.zh: 他的拼写虽属旧式，但意思仍是令人遗憾的。

e.en: The meeting was {regretably} postponed again.
e.zh: 会议令人遗憾地再次延期了。

e.en: She {regretably} declined the invitation.
e.zh: 她很遗憾地谢绝了邀请。

e.en: He remained {regretless} after the risky decision.
e.zh: 做出那个冒险决定后，他依然毫无悔意。

e.en: Her {regretless} tone surprised the interviewer.
e.zh: 她毫不后悔的语气让面试官很惊讶。

e.en: Please {regrind} the beans more finely.
e.zh: 请把这些豆子重新磨得更细一些。

e.en: The factory used {regrind} in the plastic mix.
e.zh: 工厂在塑料配料中使用了回收再磨料。

e.en: The mechanic used a {regroover} on the tire.
e.zh: 技工用重新开槽器处理了轮胎。

e.en: A heated {regroover} cuts new channels in rubber.
e.zh: 加热的再刻沟机能在橡胶上切出新沟槽。

e.en: The army ordered a {regroupment} before dawn.
e.zh: 军队命令在黎明前重新集结。

e.en: The merger led to a {regroupment} of departments.
e.zh: 这次合并导致各部门重新编组。

e.en: The shield shows a lion {reguardant}.
e.zh: 盾徽上有一头回首姿态的狮子。

e.en: Heralds described the bird as {reguardant} on the crest.
e.zh: 纹章官把冠饰上的鸟描述为回望姿态。

e.en: The monastery followed a strict {regula}.
e.zh: 这座修道院遵循严格的会规。

e.en: In architecture, a {regula} sits below the taenia.
e.zh: 在建筑学中，挂板位于带状饰下方。

e.en: The valve is {regulable} by a small screw.
e.zh: 这个阀门可以通过一个小螺丝调节。

e.en: Air pollution is a {regulable} public problem.
e.zh: 空气污染是可以通过制度管制的公共问题。

e.en: The agency proposed {regularisation} of informal workers.
e.zh: 该机构提议让非正规工人身份合法化。

e.en: The model uses {regularisation} to avoid overfitting.
e.zh: 这个模型使用正则化来避免过度拟合。

e.en: The lac {regulon} responds to lactose in the cell.
e.zh: 乳糖调节子会对细胞内的乳糖作出反应。

e.en: Researchers mapped a bacterial {regulon} under heat stress.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了细菌在热胁迫下的一个调节子。

e.en: The alchemist called the metallic lump a {regulus}.
e.zh: 炼金术士把那块金属小块称为金属渣块。

e.en: In old texts, a young prince might be styled a {regulus}.
e.zh: 在古老文本中，年轻王子有时会被称作小王。

e.en: Several {reguluses} formed at the bottom of the crucible.
e.zh: 几个金属渣块在坩埚底部形成了。

e.en: The chronicle mentions rival {reguluses} on the border.
e.zh: 编年史提到边境上几个相互竞争的小王。

e.en: The doctor noted a {regurgitative} sound during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时注意到一种反流性的杂音。

e.en: His essay had a {regurgitative} style, repeating facts without thought.
e.zh: 他的文章像机械复述，只重复事实而没有思考。

e.en: She {regusted} the soup after adding salt.
e.zh: 加盐之后，她重新尝了那碗汤。

e.en: After years away, he {regusted} the music of his youth.
e.zh: 离开多年后，他又喜欢上了年轻时听的音乐。

e.en: Each {rehabilitant} followed a personalized exercise plan.
e.zh: 每位康复者都遵循一套个性化训练计划。

e.en: The clinic treated the {rehabilitant} with patience and dignity.
e.zh: 诊所以耐心和尊严对待这名复健者。

e.en: The chemist observed {rehalogenization} during the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家在反应过程中观察到了再卤化。

e.en: Photographic film can undergo {rehalogenization} in some treatments.
e.zh: 胶片在某些处理过程中可能发生重新卤化。

e.en: The process can {rehalogenize} the silver compound.
e.zh: 这个过程可以使银化合物重新卤化。

e.en: Technicians tried to {rehalogenize} the treated photographic plate.
e.zh: 技术人员试图让处理过的照相底板再卤化。

e.en: Please {rehandle} the complaint with more care.
e.zh: 请更认真地重新处理这起投诉。

e.en: Workers had to {rehandle} the boxes after the label error.
e.zh: 标签出错后，工人不得不重新搬运这些箱子。

e.en: The company charged extra for {rehandling} returned goods.
e.zh: 公司对退回商品的重新处理收取额外费用。

e.en: Careful packaging reduces {rehandling} in the warehouse.
e.zh: 仔细包装可以减少仓库里的重复搬运。

e.en: We need to {rehang} the picture after painting the wall.
e.zh: 墙刷好后，我们需要把画重新挂上。

e.en: The curator decided to {rehang} the entire gallery.
e.zh: 策展人决定重新布置整个画廊的挂画。

e.en: Let the wax {reharden} before touching the candle.
e.zh: 碰蜡烛前先让蜡重新变硬。

e.en: The steel must {reharden} after the heat treatment.
e.zh: 钢材在热处理后必须重新硬化。

reheader.t: 改换标题者；重做页眉工具

e.en: A {reheader} script fixed the old email archive.
e.zh: 一个重做邮件头的脚本修复了旧邮件归档。

e.en: The editor acted as a {reheader} for every chapter.
e.zh: 编辑为每一章重新拟了标题。

e.zh: 锅炉使用再加热器来提高效率。

e.zh: 工程师在维护期间更换了损坏的复热装置。

e.zh: 他们在宴会上开了一瓶四点五升装的香槟。

e.en: The cellar kept one dusty {rehoboam} for special events.
e.zh: 酒窖里留着一瓶蒙尘的大酒瓶，供特殊场合使用。

e.en: The shelter helped {rehome} the abandoned dog.
e.zh: 收容所帮助这只被遗弃的狗找到新家。

e.en: They had to {rehome} several families after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，他们不得不为几户家庭重新安置住处。

e.en: Better follow-up care reduced {rehospitalization} after surgery.
e.zh: 更好的随访护理减少了术后的再次住院。

e.zh: 这项研究统计了三十天内的再入院情况。

e.zh: 病情复发后，医生决定让他再次住院。

e.zh: 诊所可能会重新收治出现严重并发症的患者。

e.zh: 她出院两周后又再次住院。

e.en: The report counted all {rehospitalized} patients separately.
e.zh: 报告把所有再入院患者单独统计。
