e.en: The novel describes a secret {residentura} in Vienna.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了维也纳的一个秘密苏联情报站。

e.en: Agents reported to the {residentura} through coded messages.
e.zh: 特工通过密码信息向驻外情报机构汇报。

e.en: The chemist analyzed the {residua} left after evaporation.
e.zh: 化学家分析了蒸发后留下的残余物。

e.en: Several cultural {residua} survived in the remote villages.
e.zh: 一些文化残余在偏远村庄中保留了下来。

e.en: The company thanked the {resignee} for years of service.
e.zh: 公司感谢这位辞职者多年来的服务。

e.en: As a legal {resignee}, she gave up the claim formally.
e.zh: 作为正式放弃权利的人，她以法律方式放弃了索赔。

e.en: The minister refused to {resile} from his earlier promise.
e.zh: 部长拒绝撤回他早先作出的承诺。

e.en: The elastic strip can {resile} after being stretched.
e.zh: 这条弹性带被拉伸后能够弹回。

e.en: The witness {resiled} from her original statement.
e.zh: 证人撤回了她最初的陈述。

e.en: The spring {resiled} as soon as the pressure was released.
e.zh: 压力一解除，弹簧就弹回去了。

e.en: He often {resiles} from agreements under political pressure.
e.zh: 他常在政治压力下退出协议。

e.en: The material {resiles} quickly after compression.
e.zh: 这种材料受压后会很快恢复原状。

e.en: Flea jumps depend partly on {resilin} in their legs.
e.zh: 跳蚤的跳跃部分依靠腿部的弹性蛋白。

e.en: Engineers study {resilin} to design better elastic materials.
e.zh: 工程师研究节肢动物弹性蛋白，以设计更好的弹性材料。

e.en: The party was accused of {resiling} from its pledge.
e.zh: 该党被指责背弃了自己的承诺。

e.en: The fabric kept {resiling} after each stretch.
e.zh: 这种织物每次拉伸后都会恢复原状。

e.en: The lab used a {resiliometer} to test the rubber sample.
e.zh: 实验室用回弹性测定仪测试这块橡胶样品。

e.en: A {resiliometer} can compare how quickly foams recover.
e.zh: 回弹性测定仪可以比较泡沫恢复原状的速度。

e.en: Workers {resinate} the wood to protect it from moisture.
e.zh: 工人给木材涂树脂，以防受潮。

e.en: The chemist prepared a metal {resinate} for the coating.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种用于涂层的金属树脂盐。

e.en: The {resinated} paper resisted water better than plain paper.
e.zh: 涂过树脂的纸比普通纸更防水。

e.en: The artist used {resinated} pigment in the varnish.
e.zh: 艺术家在清漆中使用了树脂化颜料。

e.en: They are {resinating} the panels before final assembly.
e.zh: 他们在最终组装前给板材做树脂处理。

e.en: The mixture began {resinating} as it cooled.
e.zh: 混合物冷却时开始树脂化。

e.en: The sample had a strong {resinic} odor.
e.zh: 这个样品有很浓的树脂气味。

e.en: A {resinic} layer formed on the old pine boards.
e.zh: 旧松木板上形成了一层树脂状的表层。

e.en: Pines are among the most familiar {resiniferous} trees.
e.zh: 松树是最常见的产树脂树木之一。

e.en: The botanist collected {resiniferous} bark for analysis.
e.zh: 植物学家采集含树脂的树皮进行分析。

e.en: Heat accelerated the {resinification} of the plant extract.
e.zh: 加热加快了植物提取物的树脂化。

e.en: The report describes {resinification} in ancient tree remains.
e.zh: 报告描述了古代树木遗骸中的树脂形成过程。

e.en: The manufacturer can {resinify} the surface for extra durability.
e.zh: 制造商可以使表面树脂化，以提高耐用性。

e.en: Over time, the sap may {resinify} into a hard mass.
e.zh: 随着时间推移，树液可能会变成坚硬的树脂块。

e.en: The coal seam contained small bands of {resinite}.
e.zh: 煤层中含有细小的化石树脂带。

e.en: Geologists identified the glossy fragment as {resinite}.
e.zh: 地质学家确认这块有光泽的碎片是树脂矿物。

e.en: A {resinlike} substance oozed from the cracked bark.
e.zh: 一种树脂状物质从裂开的树皮中渗出。

e.en: The coating dried to a hard, {resinlike} finish.
e.zh: 涂层干后形成了坚硬的树脂状表面。

resinography.t: 树脂成像法；树脂记录法

e.en: The conservator used {resinography} to examine the old panel.
e.zh: 文物修复师用树脂成像法检查这块旧板。

e.en: Few students had heard of {resinography} before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座前很少有学生听说过树脂成像法。

e.en: The perfume contains a warm {resinoid} from benzoin.
e.zh: 这款香水含有来自安息香的温暖树脂状提取物。

e.en: The adhesive formed a dark {resinoid} film.
e.zh: 这种黏合剂形成了一层深色树脂状薄膜。

e.en: The forester diagnosed {resinosis} in the damaged pines.
e.zh: 林务员诊断这些受损松树患有树脂病。

e.en: Excessive resin flow may indicate {resinosis}.
e.zh: 树脂过度流出可能表明存在树脂病。

e.en: The analysis detected {resinotannol} in the plant resin.
e.zh: 分析在植物树脂中检测到了树脂单宁醇。

e.en: Older chemistry texts discuss {resinotannol} as a resin component.
e.zh: 早期化学文献把树脂单宁醇作为树脂成分来讨论。

e.en: The old cabinet gave off a {resiny} smell.
e.zh: 旧橱柜散发出一股树脂味。

e.en: Her fingers felt sticky and {resiny} after touching the pine.
e.zh: 她摸过松树后，手指又黏又有树脂感。

e.en: His letter showed genuine {resipiscence} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，他的信表现出真诚的悔悟。

e.en: The essay treats {resipiscence} as a return to moral clarity.
e.zh: 这篇文章把悔悟视为重新获得道德上的清醒。

e.en: A {resipiscent} leader admitted the policy had failed.
e.zh: 一位悔悟的领导人承认该政策已经失败。

e.en: The novel ends with a {resipiscent} confession.
e.zh: 小说以一段悔悟的告白收尾。

e.en: Do not {resoil} the cleaned carpet with muddy shoes.
e.zh: 别穿着沾泥的鞋把清理过的地毯又弄脏。

e.en: The worker had to {resoil} the test cloth for another trial.
e.zh: 工人必须把测试布重新弄脏，以便再做一次试验。

e.en: The cobbler can {resole} these boots by Friday.
e.zh: 修鞋匠星期五前能给这双靴子换底。

e.en: It is cheaper to {resole} good shoes than replace them.
e.zh: 好鞋拿去换底比重新买一双更便宜。

e.en: He wore {resoled} boots on the long hike.
e.zh: 他穿着换过底的靴子去长途徒步。

e.en: The shop {resoled} my favorite leather shoes.
e.zh: 那家店给我最喜欢的皮鞋换了底。

e.en: She {resoles} old boots for local hikers.
e.zh: 她为当地徒步者的旧靴子换底。

e.en: The cobbler keeps rubber {resoles} in several sizes.
e.zh: 修鞋匠备有几种尺寸的橡胶替换鞋底。

e.en: {Resoling} these boots will extend their life.
e.zh: 给这双靴子换底能延长它们的使用寿命。

e.en: The shop specializes in {resoling} climbing shoes.
e.zh: 这家店专门给攀岩鞋换底。

e.en: The chemist tested the {resolubility} of the dried salt.
e.zh: 化学家测试了干燥盐类的再溶解性。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {resolubility} of the dispute.
e.zh: 律师质疑这场争端是否还能解决。

e.en: The powder remains {resoluble} after drying.
e.zh: 这种粉末干燥后仍然可以再次溶解。

e.en: They considered the conflict {resoluble} through negotiation.
e.zh: 他们认为这场冲突可以通过谈判解决。

resolutionist.t: 主张决议者；解决派人士

e.en: The committee's leading {resolutionist} drafted a compromise.
e.zh: 委员会中主要的决议倡导者起草了一份折中方案。

e.en: As a practical {resolutionist}, she preferred settlement to protest.
e.zh: 作为务实的解决派人士，她更倾向和解而不是抗议。

resolutive.t: 有解决作用的；消散性的

e.en: The mediator took a {resolutive} approach to the dispute.
e.zh: 调解员采取了有助于解决争端的办法。

e.en: The old text described the medicine as {resolutive}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种药描述为能消散肿块。

e.en: The team assessed the {resolvability} of each reported bug.
e.zh: 团队评估了每个已报告漏洞的可解决性。

e.en: The microscope improved the {resolvability} of fine details.
e.zh: 这台显微镜提高了细微结构的可分辨性。

resolvent.t: 起解决作用的；数学预解式

e.en: The analyst found a {resolvent} factor in the crisis.
e.zh: 分析师找到了危机中起解决作用的因素。

e.en: Students used the {resolvent} to simplify the equation.
e.zh: 学生们用预解式来简化这个方程。

e.en: The hall's {resonation} made every note linger.
e.zh: 大厅的共鸣让每个音符都久久回荡。

e.en: His speech gained {resonation} after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后，他的演讲更能引发共鸣。

e.en: The instrument has a deep {resonatory} tone.
e.zh: 这件乐器有一种深沉的共鸣音色。

e.en: A {resonatory} chamber amplified the singer's voice.
e.zh: 共鸣腔放大了歌手的声音。

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {resonatron} for stable output.
e.zh: 工程师调节共振电子管以获得稳定输出。

e.en: An old {resonatron} sat in the radio laboratory.
e.zh: 无线电实验室里放着一台旧的谐振装置。

resonoscope.t: 共振观察仪；共鸣检测器

e.en: The technician inspected the beam with a {resonoscope}.
e.zh: 技术员用共振观察仪检查那根梁。

e.en: A simple {resonoscope} showed where the panel vibrated.
e.zh: 一个简单的共鸣检测器显示了面板振动的位置。

e.en: The body can {resorb} small bone fragments over time.
e.zh: 身体会随着时间重吸收小块骨片。

e.en: Some roots {resorb} nutrients before the leaves fall.
e.zh: 有些根会在叶子脱落前重新吸收养分。

e.en: The scan showed that the cyst had {resorbed}.
e.zh: 扫描显示囊肿已经被吸收了。

e.en: {Resorbed} bone left a shallow mark on the jaw.
e.zh: 被重吸收的骨质在下颌上留下了浅痕。

e.en: The tissue is slowly {resorbing} the implant material.
e.zh: 组织正在慢慢吸收植入材料。

e.en: A {resorbing} tooth root may cause discomfort.
e.zh: 正在被吸收的牙根可能会引起不适。

e.en: The body {resorbs} the clot as healing progresses.
e.zh: 随着愈合推进，身体会重吸收血块。

e.en: This material {resorbs} safely after surgery.
e.zh: 这种材料会在手术后安全地被吸收。

e.en: The formula contained a small amount of {resorcin}.
e.zh: 该配方含有少量间苯二酚。

e.en: Old dermatology texts mention {resorcin} in acne treatments.
e.zh: 旧皮肤科文献提到雷琐辛可用于痤疮治疗。

e.en: The doctor suspected {resorcinism} after prolonged exposure.
e.zh: 长期接触后，医生怀疑是间苯二酚中毒。

e.en: Symptoms of {resorcinism} were noted in the case report.
e.zh: 病例报告中记录了间苯二酚中毒的症状。

e.en: {Resorcinol} is used in some antiseptic preparations.
e.zh: 间苯二酚用于一些消毒制剂中。

e.en: The lab stored {resorcinol} in a labeled brown bottle.
e.zh: 实验室把雷琐辛存放在贴有标签的棕色瓶中。

e.en: The chemist prepared {resorcinolphthalein} for the indicator test.
e.zh: 化学家为指示剂测试制备了间苯二酚酞。

e.en: {Resorcinolphthalein} changes color under certain conditions.
e.zh: 间苯二酚酞在特定条件下会变色。

e.en: The chemist identified {resorcitol} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出了间苯二酚醇。

e.en: Pure {resorcitol} was stored away from light.
e.zh: 纯净的间苯二酚醇被避光保存。

e.en: The molecule contains a {resorcyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个间苯二酚酰基。

e.en: Researchers compared several {resorcyl} derivatives.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种间苯二酚酰基衍生物。

e.en: The extract yielded traces of {resorcylagin}.
e.zh: 提取物中得到微量的间苯二酚类化合物。

e.en: They studied {resorcylagin} under laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 他们在实验室条件下研究这种间苯二酚类化合物。

resorcylate.t: 间苯二酚酸盐；使间苯二酚酰化

e.en: The solution formed a stable {resorcylate}.
e.zh: 该溶液形成了一种稳定的间苯二酚酸盐。

e.en: They tried to {resorcylate} the compound overnight.
e.zh: 他们尝试让该化合物过夜进行间苯二酚酰化。

e.en: The doctor noted increased {resorptive} activity in the bone.
e.zh: 医生注意到骨组织中的再吸收活动增强。

e.en: This membrane has strong {resorptive} properties.
e.zh: 这种膜具有很强的吸收特性。

e.en: The village seemed {resourceless} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，这个村庄似乎缺乏一切资源。

e.en: He felt {resourceless} in the unfamiliar city.
e.zh: 在陌生的城市里，他感到毫无办法。

e.en: Farmers will {resow} the field after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民会重新给这块地播种。

e.en: She had to {resow} the seeds in spring.
e.zh: 她不得不在春天重新播下种子。

e.en: The update {respecifies} the required file format.
e.zh: 这次更新重新指定了所需的文件格式。

e.en: The contract {respecifies} each party's duties.
e.zh: 合同重新说明了各方的职责。

e.en: Please {respecify} the date in the form.
e.zh: 请在表格中重新指定日期。

e.en: The engineer had to {respecify} the tolerances.
e.zh: 工程师不得不重新说明公差要求。

e.en: The reforms aimed to {respectabilize} the profession.
e.zh: 这些改革旨在让这个职业变得更体面。

e.en: Wealth helped {respectabilize} his questionable business.
e.zh: 财富帮助他那可疑的生意获得体面名声。

e.en: Her {respectant} tone softened the criticism.
e.zh: 她带着尊敬的语气，使批评缓和了些。

e.en: Each {respectant} waited quietly outside the hall.
e.zh: 每位表达敬意的人都安静地等在大厅外。

e.en: The editor asked him to {respell} the foreign name.
e.zh: 编辑要求他重新拼写那个外国名字。

e.en: Teachers sometimes {respell} words to show pronunciation.
e.zh: 老师有时会改写单词拼法来表示发音。

e.en: The dictionary gives a simple {respelling} for learners.
e.zh: 这本词典为学习者提供了简化的改写拼法。

e.en: Her {respelling} changed the word's pronunciation.
e.zh: 她的重新拼写改变了这个词的读音。

e.en: The mask's {respirability} mattered during long shifts.
e.zh: 长时间轮班时，口罩的透气性很重要。

e.en: Engineers tested the {respirability} of the fabric.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种织物的可呼吸性。

e.en: Cells {respirate} to release usable energy.
e.zh: 细胞通过呼吸作用释放可用能量。

e.en: The patient struggled to {respirate} without support.
e.zh: 没有辅助设备时，病人呼吸很困难。

e.en: The study measured {respirational} changes during sleep.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了睡眠中的呼吸变化。

e.en: Plants show different {respirational} rates at night.
e.zh: 植物在夜间表现出不同的呼吸作用速率。

e.en: The lab used a {respirometer} to measure oxygen use.
e.zh: 实验室使用呼吸计来测量氧气消耗量。

e.en: A portable {respirometer} recorded his breathing rate.
e.zh: 一台便携式呼吸测量仪记录了他的呼吸频率。

e.en: The team collected {respirometric} data overnight.
e.zh: 团队整夜收集呼吸测量数据。

e.en: They compared two {respirometric} testing methods.
e.zh: 他们比较了两种呼吸测量测试方法。

e.en: Doctors used {respirometry} to assess lung function.
e.zh: 医生使用呼吸测量法评估肺功能。

e.en: The experiment relied on {respirometry} in sealed chambers.
e.zh: 该实验依靠密闭舱内的呼吸测量法。

e.en: The workers faced a {respiteless} schedule all month.
e.zh: 工人们整个月都面对毫无喘息机会的日程。

e.en: A {respiteless} rain battered the coast.
e.zh: 一场不停歇的雨猛烈拍打着海岸。

e.en: The palace seemed to {resplend} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，宫殿似乎闪耀着光辉。

e.en: Her jewels {resplend} under the chandeliers.
e.zh: 她的珠宝在枝形吊灯下灿然发光。

e.en: The hall's {resplendence} impressed every guest.
e.zh: 大厅的辉煌气派给每位客人留下深刻印象。

e.en: Morning light restored the garden's {resplendence}.
e.zh: 晨光恢复了花园的灿烂光彩。

e.en: The crown's {resplendency} filled the room.
e.zh: 王冠的灿烂光彩照亮了整个房间。

e.en: Poets praised the {resplendency} of the dawn.
e.zh: 诗人赞美黎明的辉煌景象。

e.en: The engineer applied a {resist-etchant} before processing the wafer.
e.zh: 工程师在处理晶圆前涂上了抗蚀刻剂。

e.en: A weak {resist-etchant} can ruin fine circuit patterns.
e.zh: 抗蚀刻剂效果太弱会毁掉精细电路图案。

e.en: The temptation was barely {resistable} after a long fast.
e.zh: 长时间禁食后，这种诱惑几乎难以抗拒。

e.en: The material is {resistable} to mild chemical attack.
e.zh: 这种材料能抵抗轻微的化学侵蚀。

e.en: The circuit uses a {resistance-capacitance} network for timing.
e.zh: 该电路使用阻容网络来控制定时。

e.en: A {resistance-capacitance} filter can smooth small voltage changes.
e.zh: 阻容滤波器可以平滑小幅电压变化。

e.en: The lab calibrated the {resistance-thermometer} every month.
e.zh: 实验室每个月校准这支电阻温度计。

e.en: A platinum {resistance-thermometer} gives very stable readings.
e.zh: 铂电阻温度计能给出非常稳定的读数。

e.en: The old spelling {resistence} appears in some manuscripts.
e.zh: 旧拼法resistence出现在一些手稿中。

e.en: His {resistence} to pressure surprised the committee.
e.zh: 他对压力的抵抗让委员会感到意外。

e.en: The crop is {resistent} to several common diseases.
e.zh: 这种作物对几种常见病害有抗性。

e.en: She remained {resistent} to every sales pitch.
e.zh: 她对每一种推销说辞都保持抗拒。

e.en: The coating's {resistibility} improved after heat treatment.
e.zh: 涂层经过热处理后抗性提高了。

e.en: The dessert had little {resistibility} for hungry children.
e.zh: 对饥饿的孩子来说，这道甜点几乎难以抗拒。

e.en: The prototype used a {resisticon} to control current flow.
e.zh: 原型机使用阻变器来控制电流。

e.en: A faulty {resisticon} caused the signal to drift.
e.zh: 一个故障阻变器导致信号发生漂移。

e.en: Researchers measured {resistin} levels in the blood samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血样中的抵抗素水平。

e.en: High {resistin} may be linked to metabolic inflammation.
e.zh: 较高的抵抗素可能与代谢性炎症有关。

resistless.t: 无法抵挡的；不可抗拒的

e.en: The army advanced with {resistless} force.
e.zh: 军队以不可抵挡的力量向前推进。

e.en: She felt a {resistless} urge to laugh.
e.zh: 她感到一股无法抗拒的笑意。

resistlessly.t: 不可抗拒地；无法抵挡地

e.en: The flood moved {resistlessly} through the valley.
e.zh: 洪水不可阻挡地穿过山谷。

e.en: He was drawn {resistlessly} toward the music.
e.zh: 他被音乐无法抗拒地吸引过去。

e.en: The poem's {resistlessness} lies in its simple rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗的不可抗拒之处在于它简单的节奏。

e.en: They underestimated the {resistlessness} of the rising tide.
e.zh: 他们低估了涨潮不可阻挡的力量。

e.en: Workers brushed {resisto} onto the metal plate.
e.zh: 工人把抗蚀涂料刷在金属板上。

e.en: The artist used {resisto} before etching the design.
e.zh: 艺术家在蚀刻图案前使用了防护涂层。

e.en: The satellite used a {resistojet} for small orbit corrections.
e.zh: 这颗卫星用电阻加热喷气推进器进行小幅轨道修正。

e.en: A {resistojet} heats propellant before releasing it.
e.zh: 电阻加热喷气推进器会先加热推进剂再释放。

e.en: The paper describes {resistomycin} isolated from soil bacteria.
e.zh: 论文描述了从土壤细菌中分离出的抗霉素类抗生素。

e.en: They tested {resistomycin} against several resistant strains.
e.zh: 他们用抗霉素类抗生素测试了几种耐药菌株。

e.en: The old amplifier contained a rare {resistron}.
e.zh: 这台旧放大器里有一个罕见的电阻管。

e.en: A damaged {resistron} made the instrument unstable.
e.zh: 损坏的电阻控制元件使仪器不稳定。

e.en: The council voted to {resite} the playground.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定把游乐场迁到新址。

e.en: Engineers had to {resite} the antenna after complaints.
e.zh: 收到投诉后，工程师不得不重新安置天线。

e.en: The company will {reskill} workers for digital roles.
e.zh: 公司将为员工再培训，使其胜任数字岗位。

e.en: Many adults {reskill} after changing careers.
e.zh: 许多成年人转行后会学习新技能。

e.en: The mechanic had to {resleeve} the worn cylinder.
e.zh: 机修工不得不给磨损的气缸重新加套。

e.en: They will {resleeve} the cable before reinstalling it.
e.zh: 他们会先给电缆换套管再重新安装。

e.en: The crew will {reslush} the pipes before sealing them.
e.zh: 工人会在封管前重新冲洗管道。

e.en: Heavy rain can {reslush} the low road overnight.
e.zh: 大雨可能一夜之间让低洼道路再次泥泞。

e.en: The spray contained {resmethrin} as its active ingredient.
e.zh: 这种喷雾的有效成分是苄呋菊酯。

e.en: Regulators reviewed {resmethrin} use in household insecticides.
e.zh: 监管机构审查了家用杀虫剂中苄呋菊酯的使用。

e.en: The museum displayed a wartime {resnatron}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只战时使用的谐振腔电子管。

e.en: A {resnatron} was once used in high-power radio systems.
e.zh: 谐振腔电子管曾用于大功率无线电系统。

e.en: The editor valued the reader's {respondence} to each issue.
e.zh: 编辑重视读者对每一期的回应。

e.en: There was little {respondence} between the request and the answer.
e.zh: 请求和答复之间几乎没有对应关系。

e.en: The survey measured the group's {respondency} under pressure.
e.zh: 这项调查衡量了该群体在压力下的回应倾向。

e.en: Her calm {respondency} made difficult meetings easier.
e.zh: 她冷静的应答能力让艰难会议变得容易些。

e.en: The rabbi's {responsa} guided several communities.
e.zh: 这位拉比的答复集指导了几个社区。

e.en: Medieval {responsa} often addressed practical disputes.
e.zh: 中世纪的宗教答复常处理实际纠纷。

e.en: The room remained {responseless} after his question.
e.zh: 他提问之后，房间里仍无人回应。

e.en: She felt {responseless} to the sudden accusation.
e.zh: 面对突如其来的指责，她觉得无法作答。

e.en: His {responsion} was brief but precise.
e.zh: 他的回答简短却准确。

e.en: The chant used a formal {responsion} after each verse.
e.zh: 这段圣歌每节之后都有正式的应答。

e.en: The teacher collected the students' {responsions} after class.
e.zh: 老师课后收集了学生们的回答。

e.en: The choir's {responsions} echoed through the chapel.
e.zh: 唱诗班的应答声回荡在小教堂里。

e.en: Each {responsor} read a line from the service.
e.zh: 每位应答者都朗读了礼拜仪式中的一句。

e.en: The system logs the first {responsor} to every alert.
e.zh: 系统会记录每次警报的第一位响应者。

e.en: They sang a {responsorial} psalm during the service.
e.zh: 他们在礼拜中唱了一首应答式圣咏。

e.en: The poem has a {responsorial} structure of call and reply.
e.zh: 这首诗采用一呼一应的应答式结构。

e.en: The choir rehearsed three {responsories} before evening prayer.
e.zh: 唱诗班在晚祷前排练了三首应答圣歌。

e.en: Old manuscripts preserve several Latin {responsories}.
e.zh: 古手稿保存了几首拉丁应答圣歌。

e.en: A short {responsory} followed the reading.
e.zh: 诵读之后接着一段简短的应答圣歌。

e.en: The service used a {responsory} pattern throughout.
e.zh: 整场礼拜都采用了应答式模式。

e.en: The council issued a formal {responsum} on the dispute.
e.zh: 委员会就这场争议发布了正式答复。

e.en: A rabbinic {responsum} clarified the rule.
e.zh: 一份拉比裁答澄清了这条规则。

e.en: Please {respose} the vase on the shelf.
e.zh: 请把花瓶重新放到架子上。

e.en: The curator chose to {respose} the statue near the window.
e.zh: 策展人决定把雕像重新安放在窗边。

e.en: We need to {respray} the car door.
e.zh: 我们需要重新喷漆这扇车门。

e.en: The workers will {respray} the walls after repairs.
e.zh: 维修后工人会重新喷涂墙面。

e.en: The {resprayed} bumper matched the old paint perfectly.
e.zh: 重新喷漆的保险杠和旧漆完全一致。

e.en: She {resprayed} the chair in a bright green color.
e.zh: 她把椅子重新喷成了亮绿色。

e.en: Cicero wrote often about the {respublica}.
e.zh: 西塞罗经常论述共和国和公共事务。

e.en: The term {respublica} shaped later ideas of civic duty.
e.zh: respublica这个概念影响了后来的公民责任观念。

e.en: Nietzsche used {ressentiment} to describe moralized resentment.
e.zh: 尼采用ressentiment来描述道德化的怨恨。

e.en: Years of exclusion fed a deep {ressentiment}.
e.zh: 多年的排斥滋生了深重的积怨。

e.en: Her grandmother moved into a {rest-home} nearby.
e.zh: 她祖母搬进了附近一家养老院。

e.en: The village {rest-home} offers basic medical care.
e.zh: 村里的疗养院提供基本医疗照护。

e.en: They decided to {restain} the wooden deck.
e.zh: 他们决定给木质露台重新染色。

e.en: You can {restain} the table to hide the scratches.
e.zh: 你可以重新给桌子上色来遮住划痕。

e.en: The surveyor had to {restake} the property line.
e.zh: 测量员不得不重新给地界立桩。

e.en: After winning, he chose to {restake} half the money.
e.zh: 赢了之后，他选择把一半的钱再次押注。

e.en: The clerk had to {restamp} the passport form.
e.zh: 办事员不得不重新给护照表格盖章。

e.en: They {restamp} each coin with a new mark.
e.zh: 他们给每枚硬币重新压上新标记。

e.en: The installer is {restartable} after a power failure.
e.zh: 断电后，这个安装程序可以重新启动。

e.en: We designed a {restartable} workflow for long uploads.
e.zh: 我们为长时间上传设计了可重新启动的流程。

e.en: The {restauranteur} opened a small bistro downtown.
e.zh: 这位餐馆老板在市中心开了一家小餐馆。

e.en: Every successful {restauranteur} watches food costs carefully.
e.zh: 每个成功的餐饮经营者都会仔细控制食材成本。

restrictionary.t: 限制性的；限制派的字典式

e.en: The editor disliked the {restrictionary} tone of the style guide.
e.zh: 编辑不喜欢那本风格指南限制过多的语气。

e.en: His {restrictionary} approach left little room for new usage.
e.zh: 他的限制派做法几乎不给新用法留下空间。

e.en: Trade {restrictionism} can raise prices for consumers.
e.zh: 贸易限制主义可能会提高消费者的价格。

e.en: The party defended immigration {restrictionism} during the debate.
e.zh: 该党在辩论中为移民限制政策辩护。

restrictionist.t: 限制主义者；限制主义的

e.en: A {restrictionist} argued for tighter border controls.
e.zh: 一名限制主义者主张加强边境管控。

e.en: The committee rejected the {restrictionist} proposal.
e.zh: 委员会否决了那项限制主义提案。

e.en: The {restrictivist} reading of the law narrowed its effect.
e.zh: 对法律的限制派解读缩小了其效力。

e.en: Some grammarians take a {restrictivist} view of usage.
e.zh: 有些语法学家对用法持限制主义观点。

e.en: The mint planned to {restrike} the commemorative coin.
e.zh: 造币厂计划重新铸造那枚纪念币。

e.en: After missing the mark, he chose to {restrike} the chisel.
e.zh: 没打准后，他决定再敲一次凿子。

e.en: The museum displayed a {restriking} of an old medal.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚旧奖章的重新铸品。

e.en: His careful {restriking} corrected the bent metal edge.
e.zh: 他小心地再次敲击，修正了弯曲的金属边。

e.en: I need to {restring} my guitar before the show.
e.zh: 演出前我需要给吉他重新装弦。

e.en: She helped {restring} the beads after the necklace broke.
e.zh: 项链断了以后，她帮忙把珠子重新穿起来。

restringed.t: 已重新装弦；已重新穿线

e.en: The shop returned the {restringed} violin that afternoon.
e.zh: 店里那天下午把重新装好弦的小提琴还了回来。

e.en: Her {restringed} necklace looked almost new again.
e.zh: 她重新穿好的项链看起来几乎又像新的了。

restrung.t: 重新装弦的；重新穿好的

e.en: The guitarist played a {restrung} instrument on stage.
e.zh: 吉他手在台上弹奏一把重新装弦的乐器。

e.en: She wore the {restrung} pearls to dinner.
e.zh: 她戴着重新穿好的珍珠项链去吃晚餐。

e.en: You should {restudy} the chapter before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前你应该重新学习这一章。

e.en: The scientists decided to {restudy} the old samples.
e.zh: 科学家们决定再次研究那些旧样本。

e.en: We had to {restuff} the sofa cushions.
e.zh: 我们不得不给沙发垫重新填充。

e.en: Do not {restuff} the drawer until it jams again.
e.zh: 别又把抽屉塞满，弄到再次卡住。

e.en: He misspelled restaurant as {resturant} on the sign.
e.zh: 他在招牌上把restaurant误拼成了resturant。

e.en: The search engine corrected {resturant} to restaurant automatically.
e.zh: 搜索引擎自动把resturant更正为restaurant。

e.en: The ruling may {resubject} workers to unsafe conditions.
e.zh: 这项裁决可能使工人再次遭受不安全环境。

e.en: Editors can {resubject} the article under a broader category.
e.zh: 编辑可以把这篇文章重新归入更宽泛的类别。

e.en: The treaty led to the tribe's {resubjection} to foreign rule.
e.zh: 该条约导致这个部族再次受外国统治。

e.en: Critics feared the {resubjection} of courts to political pressure.
e.zh: 批评者担心法院会重新受制于政治压力。

e.en: The journal allowed {resubmission} after major revisions.
e.zh: 期刊允许在大幅修改后重新提交。

e.en: Late {resubmission} of the form may delay approval.
e.zh: 表格迟迟重新提交可能会耽误审批。

e.en: The company tried to {resue} after the case was dismissed.
e.zh: 案件被驳回后，公司试图再次起诉。

e.en: You cannot {resue} the same claim without new grounds.
e.zh: 没有新的理由，你不能就同一主张重新起诉。

e.en: Her lawyer warned against {resuing} too quickly.
e.zh: 她的律师警告不要过快再次起诉。

e.en: The court questioned the purpose of {resuing} the old dispute.
e.zh: 法院质疑重新起诉这桩旧纠纷的目的。

e.en: The process includes {resulfurization} of the treated alloy.
e.zh: 该工艺包括对处理后的合金重新硫化。

e.en: Engineers monitored {resulfurization} during fuel processing.
e.zh: 工程师在燃料加工过程中监测再加硫。

e.en: The lab had to {resulfurize} the compound under heat.
e.zh: 实验室必须在加热条件下使该化合物重新硫化。

e.en: Refiners may {resulfurize} fuel to meet a specification.
e.zh: 炼油商可能会给燃料再加硫以满足规格要求。

e.en: British reports spell the procedure as {resulphurize}.
e.zh: 英国报告把这一工序拼作resulphurize。

e.en: Technicians planned to {resulphurize} the sample overnight.
e.zh: 技术人员计划连夜对样品重新硫化。

result-oriented.t: 注重结果的；结果导向的

e.en: She prefers a {result-oriented} management style.
e.zh: 她偏好注重结果的管理风格。

e.en: The training is practical and {result-oriented}.
e.zh: 这项培训很实用，而且以结果为导向。

e.en: In grammar, broken can be a {resultative} adjective.
e.zh: 在语法中，broken可以是表示结果的形容词。

e.en: The phrase painted the wall red has a {resultative} meaning.
e.zh: 短语painted the wall red带有结果性意义。

e.en: Their talks became more {resultful} after mediation began.
e.zh: 调解开始后，他们的谈判变得更有成效。

e.en: A short but {resultful} meeting solved the issue.
e.zh: 一次简短但有成效的会议解决了问题。

e.en: After a {resultless} search, they returned home.
e.zh: 一番毫无结果的搜寻后，他们回家了。

e.en: The debate felt long and {resultless}.
e.zh: 这场辩论让人觉得漫长而没有结果。

restauration.t: 复辟；恢复旧制度；修复艺术品等的过程

e.en: The historian wrote about the {restauration} of the old monarchy.
e.zh: 这位历史学家写到了旧君主制的复辟。

e.en: The painting's {restauration} took nearly two years.
e.zh: 这幅画的修复过程花了将近两年。

e.en: The {restauratrice} welcomed every guest herself.
e.zh: 这位女餐馆老板亲自迎接每位客人。

e.en: A skilled {restauratrice} repaired the damaged fresco.
e.zh: 一位技艺娴熟的女修复师修好了受损的湿壁画。

restauratrices.t: 女餐馆老板们；女修复师们

e.en: Several {restauratrices} discussed rising food costs.
e.zh: 几位女餐馆老板讨论了不断上涨的食材成本。

e.en: The museum hired two {restauratrices} for the project.
e.zh: 博物馆为这个项目聘请了两名女修复师。

restbalk.t: 犁地时未耕的田埂或地带

e.en: The old plough left a narrow {restbalk} between the furrows.
e.zh: 那把旧犁在犁沟之间留下了一条狭窄的未耕地带。

e.en: Farmers sometimes used a {restbalk} as a rough boundary.
e.zh: 农民有时把未耕的田埂当作简易边界。

e.en: The nurse had to {resterilize} the surgical tools.
e.zh: 护士不得不重新给手术器械灭菌。

e.en: Do not reuse the bottle unless you {resterilize} it first.
e.zh: 除非先重新消毒，否则不要再次使用这个瓶子。

restharrow.t: 刺芒柄花，一种有刺野草

e.en: Pink {restharrow} grew along the dry roadside.
e.zh: 粉色的刺芒柄花长在干燥的路边。

e.en: The herbalist collected {restharrow} for an old remedy.
e.zh: 草药师采集刺芒柄花来配一种老药方。

restiff.t: 倔强难驯的；不肯前进的

e.en: The {restiff} horse refused to cross the bridge.
e.zh: 那匹倔强难驯的马不肯过桥。

e.en: He remained {restiff} despite repeated warnings.
e.zh: 尽管一再受到警告，他仍然固执不听。

e.en: The anatomist described the {restiform} body in detail.
e.zh: 解剖学家详细描述了绳状体。

e.en: A {restiform} structure connected the two sections.
e.zh: 一个索状结构连接着这两个部分。

e.en: We found a quiet {resting-place} under the trees.
e.zh: 我们在树下找到了一处安静的休息处。

e.en: The hill became his final {resting-place}.
e.zh: 那座山成了他最后的安息之地。

e.en: The court ordered him to {restite} the stolen goods.
e.zh: 法院命令他归还被盗物品。

e.en: The treatment aimed to {restite} normal movement.
e.zh: 这种治疗旨在恢复正常活动能力。

e.en: The museum agreed to {restitute} the looted artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆同意归还被掠夺的文物。

e.en: Doctors tried to {restitute} blood flow to the tissue.
e.zh: 医生试图恢复该组织的血流。

e.en: The {restituted} painting returned to its original owner.
e.zh: 这幅已归还的画回到了原主手中。

e.en: Normal rhythm was {restituted} after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后正常节律得以恢复。

e.en: The law {restitutes} property taken during the war.
e.zh: 这项法律归还战争期间被夺走的财产。

e.en: The procedure {restitutes} function in damaged nerves.
e.zh: 这种手术恢复受损神经的功能。

restituting.t: 正在归还；正在恢复原状

e.en: They are {restituting} land to displaced families.
e.zh: 他们正在把土地归还给流离失所的家庭。

e.en: The therapy focuses on {restituting} lost motor skills.
e.zh: 这种疗法着重恢复丧失的运动技能。

e.en: We tried a tiny {resto} near the station.
e.zh: 我们去车站附近一家小餐馆吃了饭。

e.en: That new {resto} serves excellent noodles.
e.zh: 那家新餐馆的面做得很好。

e.en: Engineers assessed the bridge's {restorability} after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后，工程师评估了这座桥的可修复性。

e.en: The painting's {restorability} depended on the pigment damage.
e.zh: 这幅画能否修复取决于颜料受损程度。

e.en: The damaged files were still {restorable}.
e.zh: 这些受损文件仍然可以恢复。

e.en: Experts said the old chair was {restorable}.
e.zh: 专家说这把旧椅子是可以修复的。

e.en: The town celebrated the {restoral} of clean water.
e.zh: 小镇庆祝清洁供水的恢复。

e.en: The {restoral} of the mural required careful work.
e.zh: 这幅壁画的修复需要细致的工作。

e.en: The dog was frightened but still {restrainable}.
e.zh: 那只狗受了惊，但仍能被控制住。

e.en: Such spending is {restrainable} with stricter rules.
e.zh: 通过更严格的规定，这类开支是可以抑制的。

restrictee.t: 受限制者；被约束的一方

e.en: The order named him as the {restrictee}.
e.zh: 该命令将他列为受限制者。

e.en: A {restrictee} must report any change of address.
e.zh: 受限制者必须报告任何地址变更。

e.zh: 这项法律影响了进口烈酒的零售。

e.en: Small shops depended on local {retailment} for steady income.
e.zh: 小店依靠本地零售获得稳定收入。

e.zh: 按照新政策，只有最有用的文件可以保留。

e.zh: 良好的睡眠有助于新记忆的保持。

e.en: The contract allowed the {retainment} of certain rights.
e.zh: 合同允许保留某些权利。

e.en: The minister warned against any {retaliative} strike.
e.zh: 部长警告不要发动任何报复性打击。

e.en: Her reply sounded sharp but not truly {retaliative}.
e.zh: 她的回答听起来尖锐，但并非真正出于报复。

e.zh: 委员会同意重新审查有争议的证据。

e.zh: 症状复发后，医生可能会再次检查病人。

e.en: The material showed strong flame {retardance} in testing.
e.zh: 这种材料在测试中表现出很强的阻燃性。

e.zh: 工程师测量了信号通过电缆时的延迟程度。

e.zh: 经过化学处理后，这种织物的阻燃性提高了。

e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种涂层的延缓特性。

e.zh: 寒冷天气会延缓幼苗的生长。

e.zh: 那份旧报告把retardate用作临床标签。

e.en: Stress may have a {retardative} influence on recovery.
e.zh: 压力可能会对康复产生阻滞影响。

e.zh: 法院驳回了这项拖延性的动议，认为只是无谓耽搁。

e.en: Heavy regulation had a {retardatory} effect on investment.
e.zh: 繁重的监管对投资产生了妨碍作用。

e.zh: 文件称这个孩子为发育迟缓者，这个词如今已避免使用。

e.en: In the experiment, each {retardee} received delayed reinforcement.
e.zh: 在实验中，每个受延缓对象都得到了延迟强化。

e.zh: 实验室测试了retardin作为植物生长抑制剂的效果。

e.en: A small dose of {retardin} slowed the reaction noticeably.
e.zh: 少量retardin明显减慢了反应速度。

e.en: The flood caused serious {retardment} of the rescue work.
e.zh: 洪水严重延缓了救援工作。

e.en: The drug may produce temporary {retardment} of reflexes.
e.zh: 这种药可能造成反射暂时减慢。

e.en: Scientists found {retene} in the river sediment.
e.zh: 科学家在河流沉积物中发现了retene这种芳香烃。

e.en: High {retene} levels can indicate pollution from wood smoke.
e.zh: retene含量高可能表明存在木烟污染。

e.en: The {retentate} contained proteins too large to pass through.
e.zh: 截留液中含有无法通过膜的大分子蛋白质。

e.zh: 技术人员在超滤后收集了截留物。

e.en: Children differ greatly in verbal {retentivity}.
e.zh: 儿童在语言记忆保持能力上差异很大。

e.en: The soil's water {retentivity} improved with compost.
e.zh: 加入堆肥后，土壤的保水能力提高了。

e.en: The stylist used heat to {retexture} her hair.
e.zh: 发型师用加热方式重新塑造她的发质。

e.en: Designers can {retexture} a 3D model in minutes.
e.zh: 设计师可以在几分钟内为三维模型重新贴纹理。

e.en: The museum label identified the green crystals as {retgersite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这些绿色晶体标为retgersite矿物。

e.en: Collectors value well-formed {retgersite} specimens.
e.zh: 收藏者看重形态良好的retgersite标本。

e.en: She had to {rethread} the needle after the thread snapped.
e.zh: 线断了以后，她不得不重新给针穿线。

e.en: The mechanic used a tool to {rethread} the damaged bolt hole.
e.zh: 技师用工具给受损的螺栓孔重新攻螺纹。

rethreaded.t: 重新穿好线的；重攻螺纹的

e.zh: 下水管线被重新穿过那根狭窄的管道。

e.en: The {rethreaded} fitting sealed tightly again.
e.zh: 重新攻好螺纹的接头又密封严实了。

e.en: The farmer bought a {rethreasher} for the damp grain.
e.zh: 农民买了一台复脱粒机来处理受潮谷物。

e.en: A skilled {rethreasher} could recover seed from the straw.
e.zh: 熟练的再脱粒工能从稻草中回收种子。

e.en: The download is {resumable} after a network failure.
e.zh: 网络故障后，下载仍可继续。

e.en: A {resumable} task saves its progress automatically.
e.zh: 可恢复的任务会自动保存进度。

e.en: The judge may {resummon} the witness tomorrow.
e.zh: 法官明天可能会重新传唤那名证人。

e.en: The spell can {resummon} a fallen spirit.
e.zh: 这个咒语能再次召唤逝去的灵魂。

e.en: The court {resummons} jurors when a trial is delayed.
e.zh: 审判延期时，法院会重新传唤陪审员。

e.en: The ritual {resummons} memories of the lost village.
e.zh: 这个仪式重新唤起了对那座消失村庄的记忆。

e.en: The chair made a {resumptive} motion after lunch.
e.zh: 午餐后，主席提出了恢复会议的动议。

e.en: A {resumptive} pronoun appears later in the sentence.
e.zh: 恢复性代词会出现在句子的后面。

e.en: The engineer inspected the {resuperheater} for leaks.
e.zh: 工程师检查再热器是否有泄漏。

e.en: Steam temperature rises inside the {resuperheater}.
e.zh: 蒸汽温度会在再热器内升高。

e.en: The plant uses {resuperheating} to improve efficiency.
e.zh: 这座电厂利用再热来提高效率。

e.en: Improper {resuperheating} can damage turbine blades.
e.zh: 不当的二次过热可能损坏涡轮叶片。

e.en: Some orchids have {resupinate} flowers after twisting.
e.zh: 有些兰花扭转后花朵呈倒置朝上状态。

e.en: The patient lay {resupinate} during the examination.
e.zh: 检查时，病人仰卧着。

e.en: The blossom became {resupinated} as it matured.
e.zh: 花朵成熟时变成了翻转朝上的形态。

e.en: The injured man was found {resupinated} on the floor.
e.zh: 伤者被发现仰面躺在地板上。

e.en: The figure was painted in a {resupine} pose.
e.zh: 画中人物被描绘成仰卧的姿势。

e.en: A {resupine} leaf shows its lower surface upward.
e.zh: 翻转的叶片会把下表面朝上露出。

e.en: The sermon focused on {resurrectional} hope.
e.zh: 布道集中讲述复活带来的希望。

e.en: Critics noted a {resurrectional} theme in the novel.
e.zh: 评论家注意到小说中的复兴主题。

e.en: Victorian newspapers condemned {resurrectionism} as immoral.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期的报纸谴责盗尸行为不道德。

e.en: The sect's {resurrectionism} shaped its burial customs.
e.zh: 该教派的复活信仰影响了其葬礼习俗。

e.en: A {resurrectionist} supplied bodies to medical schools.
e.zh: 盗尸者向医学院提供尸体。

e.en: The preacher was a committed {resurrectionist}.
e.zh: 那位传教士坚定相信复活。

e.en: The police watched the cemetery for {resurrectionists}.
e.zh: 警方在墓地守候，防范盗尸者。

e.en: Early {resurrectionists} argued about the final judgment.
e.zh: 早期信奉复活的人曾争论末日审判。

e.en: The director tried to {resurrectionize} a forgotten style.
e.zh: 导演试图让一种被遗忘的风格重新流行。

e.en: The myth says the god can {resurrectionize} the dead.
e.zh: 神话说那位神能使死者复活。

e.en: The ritual had a {resurrective} purpose.
e.zh: 这个仪式有使人复活的目的。

e.en: The policy had a {resurrective} effect on local trade.
e.zh: 这项政策对当地贸易产生了复兴作用。

e.en: Doctors judged the patient still {resuscitable}.
e.zh: 医生判断病人仍可抢救。

e.en: Some frozen tissues remain {resuscitable} after thawing.
e.zh: 有些冷冻组织解冻后仍可复苏。

e.en: The team began {resuscitative} treatment immediately.
e.zh: 团队立即开始复苏治疗。

e.en: Every ambulance carries {resuscitative} equipment.
e.zh: 每辆救护车都配有急救复苏设备。

e.en: The nurse attached the {resuscitator} quickly.
e.zh: 护士迅速接上了复苏器。

e.en: A portable {resuscitator} can save lives at sea.
e.zh: 便携式人工呼吸器能在海上救命。

e.en: The particles were {resuspended} in clean water.
e.zh: 这些颗粒被重新悬浮在清水中。

e.en: His license was {resuspended} after another violation.
e.zh: 他再次违规后，执照又被暂停。

retable.t: 祭坛屏饰；重新提交讨论

e.zh: 教堂修复了雕刻祭坛屏饰。

e.zh: 他们下个月会重新提交这项提案讨论。

e.en: The motion was {retabled} after new evidence emerged.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，该动议被重新提交讨论。

e.zh: 小礼拜堂的祭坛配有华丽的屏饰。

retables.t: 祭坛屏饰；重新提交讨论

e.zh: 中世纪祭坛屏饰常描绘圣经典故。

e.zh: 委员会很少把被否决的事项重新提交讨论。

e.zh: 古代作者描述了几种用于狩猎的网。

e.zh: 这名持网角斗士用网和三叉戟作战。

e.zh: 一幅马赛克画展示了持网角斗士面对全副武装的对手。

e.zh: 蜘蛛织出的网状图案覆盖了旧窗框。

e.zh: 罗马妇女有时把钱币装在装饰性小网袋里。

e.zh: 这片叶子的叶脉呈网状分布。

e.zh: 细小裂纹使干燥的黏土表面形成网状。

e.zh: 叶脉呈网状铺展在浅色叶片上。

e.zh: 釉面经过反复烧制后呈网状开裂。

e.zh: 水分使油漆形成细密分枝的网状线条。

e.zh: 工程师研究模型中的血管网状结构。

e.zh: 艺术家看着清漆在干燥时形成网状纹理。

e.zh: 一道正在扩展成网状的裂纹横贯旧漆面。

e.zh: 活检样本经过染色以显示网状纤维蛋白。

e.zh: 网状纤维蛋白过多可能提示骨髓瘢痕化。

e.zh: 这头牛吞下铁丝后因网胃炎接受治疗。

e.zh: 兽医因这只动物停止进食而怀疑它患有网胃炎。

e.zh: 突然失血后，网织红细胞计数可能升高。

e.zh: 实验室测量了血样中的每个网织红细胞。

e.zh: 脾脏是网状内皮系统的一部分。

e.zh: 感染影响了多个器官中的网状内皮细胞。

e.zh: 活检证实这个肿块是网状组织细胞瘤。

e.zh: 这种皮疹与多中心性网状组织细胞增生症有关。

e.en: Joint pain can occur in {reticulohistiocytosis}.
e.zh: 网状组织细胞增生症可能会引起关节疼痛。

e.zh: 研究人员注意到这种合成薄膜有似网状的质地。

e.zh: 病理学家将这种组织描述为含网状纤维且纤维化。

e.zh: 旧病历把这种疾病归为网状组织增生症。

e.zh: 现代检测取代了网状组织增生症这一含糊诊断。

e.zh: 外科医生在手术中检查了腕部支持带。

e.zh: 植物的系带可以帮助固定花粉块。

e.zh: 外科医生检查了肌腱周围的支持带组织。

e.zh: 早期治疗视网膜母细胞瘤可能保住视力。

e.zh: 这项研究追踪了发育中动物的视网膜脑部通路。

e.zh: 一种罕见的视网膜脑部疾病影响了视力和运动。

e.zh: 研究人员绘制了大脑中的视网膜顶盖连接。

e.en: The {retinotectal} pathway guides visual responses in many animals.
e.zh: 视网膜顶盖通路引导许多动物的视觉反应。

e.en: Each insect eye unit contains a {retinula} of sensory cells.
e.zh: 每个昆虫眼单元都含有一组感光细胞群。

e.en: The diagram labels the {retinula} beneath the lens.
e.zh: 图示在晶状体下方标出了小视网膜。

retinulae.t: 小视网膜复数；感光细胞群

e.en: The beetle's compound eye has many {retinulae}.
e.zh: 这种甲虫的复眼有许多感光细胞群。

e.en: Damaged {retinulae} reduced the insect's sensitivity to light.
e.zh: 受损的小视网膜降低了昆虫对光的敏感度。

e.en: The seed coat had a {retinulate} pattern under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后，种皮呈现细网状纹理。

e.en: A {retinulate} surface can help identify the pollen grain.
e.zh: 具细网纹的表面有助于识别花粉粒。

e.en: The note used {retionalise} where the writer meant rationalise.
e.zh: 那张便条把rationalise误写成了retionalise。

e.en: Editors usually correct {retionalise} in formal copy.
e.zh: 编辑通常会在正式文稿中改正retionalise这个拼写错误。

e.en: He described old age as a period of quiet {retiracy}.
e.zh: 他把晚年描述为一段安静的隐退生活。

e.en: The essay treats {retiracy} as freedom from public duties.
e.zh: 这篇文章把隐退状态视为摆脱公共职责后的自由。

e.en: The {retirant} moved to a small house by the sea.
e.zh: 那位退休者搬到海边的一所小房子里。

e.en: A wealthy {retirant} funded the village library.
e.zh: 一位富有的隐退者资助了村里的图书馆。

retitrate.t: 重新滴定；再次测定浓度

e.en: The chemist had to {retitrate} the solution after a spill.
e.zh: 溶液洒出后，化学家不得不重新滴定。

e.en: Please {retitrate} the sample to confirm the endpoint.
e.zh: 请再次滴定样品以确认终点。

e.en: The shell showed a faint {retiuline} marking.
e.zh: 贝壳上显出淡淡的细网状纹。

e.en: A {retiuline} texture covered the fossil leaf.
e.zh: 化石叶片表面覆盖着网状纹理。

e.en: The injury involved {retorsion} of the ankle joint.
e.zh: 这次损伤涉及踝关节的反扭。

e.en: The government answered tariffs with economic {retorsion}.
e.zh: 政府以经济反向报复回应关税。

e.en: Her sharp {retortion} ended the argument.
e.zh: 她尖锐的反驳结束了争论。

e.en: The policy was seen as a {retortion} against foreign sanctions.
e.zh: 这项政策被视为对外国制裁的报复性回应。

e.en: His {retortive} answer surprised the committee.
e.zh: 他带有反驳意味的回答让委员会吃了一惊。

e.en: She gave a {retortive} smile and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她回嘴似的一笑，然后换了话题。

e.en: The ticket allowed one {retour} journey within a month.
e.zh: 这张票允许一个月内进行一次回程。

e.en: In Scots law, {retour} referred to the return of an heir.
e.zh: 在苏格兰法律中，retour指继承人的确认返还。

e.en: The investigator {retracked} the suspect's route after new evidence appeared.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，调查员重新追踪了嫌疑人的路线。

e.en: She {retracked} the package through the courier's old records.
e.zh: 她通过快递公司的旧记录再次跟踪了那个包裹。

e.en: The engineer tested the {retractability} of the landing gear.
e.zh: 工程师测试了起落架的可收回性。

e.en: Lawyers questioned the {retractability} of his public statement.
e.zh: 律师们质疑他的公开声明是否可以撤回。

e.en: The journal published a formal {retractation} of the claim.
e.zh: 该期刊正式刊登了对这一说法的撤回声明。

e.en: His {retractation} came too late to repair the damage.
e.zh: 他的收回声明来得太晚，已无法弥补损害。

e.en: Designers improved the {retractibility} of the camera lens.
e.zh: 设计师改进了相机镜头的可缩回性。

e.en: The contract's {retractibility} depended on a narrow legal clause.
e.zh: 这份合同能否撤回取决于一条很窄的法律条款。

e.en: The device has a {retractible} cable for easy storage.
e.zh: 这个装置配有可缩回的电缆，便于收纳。

e.en: They argued that the offer was still {retractible}.
e.zh: 他们认为这项报价仍然可以收回。

e.en: A cat's claws are {retractile} and stay hidden while it walks.
e.zh: 猫的爪子能够缩回，走路时通常藏着。

e.en: The animal used a {retractile} tongue to catch insects.
e.zh: 这种动物用可伸缩的舌头捕捉昆虫。

e.en: The study measured the {retractility} of the muscle tissue.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了肌肉组织的收缩能力。

e.en: Cold temperatures reduced the material's {retractility}.
e.zh: 低温降低了这种材料的缩回性能。

e.en: The machine uses a {retractive} spring to pull the arm back.
e.zh: 这台机器用回缩弹簧把机械臂拉回。

e.en: His apology sounded {retractive}, not genuinely regretful.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来像是在收回前言，而不是真心懊悔。

e.en: They {retrad} the old stage for the evening performance.
e.zh: 他们为晚上的演出重新装饰了旧舞台。

e.en: The costume team {retrad} the actor in a simpler uniform.
e.zh: 服装组给那位演员重新换上了更朴素的制服。

e.en: Each {retrainee} must complete the safety course again.
e.zh: 每名再培训学员都必须重新完成安全课程。

e.en: The factory hired a {retrainee} after the old role changed.
e.zh: 岗位调整后，工厂雇用了一名重训人员。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {retral} shift in the small bone.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到那块小骨头向后移位。

e.en: The diagram shows the {retral} surface of the organ.
e.zh: 这张图显示了该器官的后侧表面。

e.en: The bank agreed to {retransfer} the money to her account.
e.zh: 银行同意把钱重新转回她的账户。

e.en: The license blocks any {retransfer} of the software rights.
e.zh: 该许可禁止再次转让软件权利。

e.en: The renovation will {retransform} the warehouse into apartments.
e.zh: 这次翻修会把仓库再次改造成公寓。

e.en: A single discovery can {retransform} an entire field of research.
e.zh: 一个发现就可能重新改变整个研究领域。

e.en: The city's {retransformation} began with the old harbor district.
e.zh: 这座城市的再次转型从旧港区开始。

e.en: Her {retransformation} into a confident speaker took years.
e.zh: 她重新成长为自信的演讲者花了多年时间。

e.en: The publisher asked her to {retranslate} the poem for modern readers.
e.zh: 出版社请她为现代读者重新翻译这首诗。

e.en: We had to {retranslate} the sentence after finding the original source.
e.zh: 找到原始出处后，我们不得不重新翻译这个句子。

e.en: The novel's {retranslation} restored several missing passages.
e.zh: 这部小说的新译本恢复了几段缺失的文字。

e.en: Automatic {retranslation} can distort technical terms.
e.zh: 自动重新翻译可能会扭曲专业术语。

e.en: She was {retransposing} the song into a lower key.
e.zh: 她正在把这首歌重新移到更低的调上。

e.en: The editor spent the afternoon {retransposing} two chapters.
e.zh: 编辑花了一下午重新调换两个章节的位置。

e.en: Each {retreatant} was given a small room for silent prayer.
e.zh: 每位静修者都分到一个小房间，用于默祷。

e.en: The guide met every {retreatant} before the weekend began.
e.zh: 周末活动开始前，导师会见了每一位退修参加者。

e.en: Critics called his policy {retreatism} in the face of pressure.
e.zh: 批评者称他的政策是在压力面前的逃避主义。

e.en: The novel portrays {retreatism} as a response to social failure.
e.zh: 这部小说把退缩逃避描写成对社会失败的回应。

e.en: Volunteers will {retree} the hillside after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后，志愿者将在山坡上重新植树。

e.en: The council funded a plan to {retree} several bare streets.
e.zh: 市政会资助了一项计划，为几条光秃的街道重新栽树。

e.en: Some leaders tried to {retribalize} politics after the civil war.
e.zh: 内战后，一些领导人试图让政治重新部族化。

e.en: The movement did not simply {retribalize} urban identity.
e.zh: 这场运动并不只是让城市身份重新回到部族归属。

e.en: Her essay defends {retributivism} against purely utilitarian theories of punishment.
e.zh: 她的论文为报应主义辩护，反对纯功利主义的惩罚理论。

e.en: Modern {retributivism} focuses on desert rather than revenge.
e.zh: 现代报应主义关注应得惩罚，而不是复仇。

e.en: The myth presents the king as a divine {retributor}.
e.zh: 这个神话把国王描绘成神圣的惩罚者。

e.en: He saw himself as a {retributor}, not a common criminal.
e.zh: 他把自己看作执行报应的人，而不是普通罪犯。

e.en: The judge rejected a purely {retributory} approach to sentencing.
e.zh: 法官拒绝采用纯粹报应性的量刑方式。

e.en: The speech had a harsh, {retributory} tone after the defeat.
e.zh: 失败之后，那篇讲话带着严厉的惩罚性口吻。

e.en: The {retrievement} of the lost files took all morning.
e.zh: 找回丢失文件花了整个上午。

e.en: His slow {retrievement} of confidence surprised his coach.
e.zh: 他慢慢恢复信心，让教练感到意外。

e.en: The gardener will {retrim} the hedge before winter.
e.zh: 园丁会在冬天前重新修剪树篱。

e.en: They decided to {retrim} the old curtains with blue ribbon.
e.zh: 他们决定用蓝丝带重新装饰旧窗帘。

e.en: Her apartment has a {retro-chic} look.
e.zh: 她的公寓有一种复古又时髦的风格。

e.en: The cafe sells itself with {retro-chic} furniture and old records.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆靠复古时髦的家具和老唱片吸引顾客。

e.en: Engineers will {retro-fit} the building with better insulation.
e.zh: 工程师会给这栋楼加装更好的隔热层。

e.en: The company offered a {retro-fit} kit for older machines.
e.zh: 公司为旧机器提供了一套改装组件。

e.en: A {retro-rocket} slowed the capsule before landing.
e.zh: 一个制动火箭在着陆前减慢了太空舱速度。

e.en: The old diagram showed each {retro-rocket} near the base.
e.zh: 那张旧图标出了底部附近的每个反推火箭。

e.en: The {retro-rockets} fired just before touchdown.
e.zh: 反推火箭在即将着陆前点火。

e.en: Technicians inspected the {retro-rockets} after the test.
e.zh: 测试结束后，技术人员检查了这些制动火箭。

e.en: The new rule does not {retroact} to last year's claims.
e.zh: 这项新规定不追溯适用于去年的索赔。

e.en: The pressure may {retroact} on the valve system.
e.zh: 这种压力可能会反作用于阀门系统。

e.en: The law's {retroaction} created confusion for employers.
e.zh: 这部法律的追溯效力让雇主们感到困惑。

e.en: The report described a subtle {retroaction} between the two forces.
e.zh: 报告描述了两种力量之间微妙的反作用。

e.en: The scan showed a {retrobronchial} mass near the airway.
e.zh: 扫描显示气道附近有一个位于支气管后方的肿块。

e.en: Doctors discussed the {retrobronchial} lymph nodes during surgery.
e.zh: 手术中医生讨论了支气管后方的淋巴结。

e.en: She received a {retrobulbar} injection before the eye surgery.
e.zh: 眼部手术前，她接受了眼球后方注射。

e.en: The patient complained of {retrobulbar} pain when moving his eye.
e.zh: 病人说转动眼睛时眼球后方疼痛。

e.en: The X-ray revealed a {retrocardiac} shadow.
e.zh: X光片显示出心脏后方有一片阴影。

e.en: Pneumonia can hide in the {retrocardiac} area.
e.zh: 肺炎有时会隐藏在心脏后方区域。

e.en: The treaty required the state to {retrocede} the territory.
e.zh: 条约要求该国归还这片领土。

e.en: In legal writing, rights may {retrocede} to the original owner.
e.zh: 在法律文书中，权利可能退回给原所有者。

e.en: The government is {retroceding} the land to local control.
e.zh: 政府正在把这片土地交还给地方管理。

e.en: The contract mentions {retroceding} certain rights after five years.
e.zh: 合同提到五年后归还某些权利。

e.en: The {retrocession} of the territory ended a long dispute.
e.zh: 领土归还结束了一场长期争端。

e.en: The insurer reduced risk through {retrocession}.
e.zh: 保险公司通过转分保降低风险。

e.en: Visitors walked quietly through the {retrochoir}.
e.zh: 游客安静地走过教堂唱诗席后部。

e.en: The cathedral's {retrochoir} contains several small chapels.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的唱诗席后部有几间小礼拜堂。

e.en: The novel treats {retrocognition} as a dangerous gift.
e.zh: 小说把超感知过去写成一种危险的天赋。

e.en: Researchers found no evidence supporting {retrocognition}.
e.zh: 研究人员没有发现支持追溯认知的证据。

e.en: The {retrodden} path was muddy after the rain.
e.zh: 那条被再次走过的小路雨后泥泞不堪。

e.en: His essay follows a {retrodden} argument about tradition.
e.zh: 他的文章沿用了一个关于传统的老论点。

e.en: The characters seemed to {retrode} into older habits.
e.zh: 这些人物似乎又退回到旧习惯里。

e.en: The poem uses {retrode} motion as an image of regret.
e.zh: 这首诗用退行的动作来表现悔意。

e.en: The model includes {retrodiffusion} of particles across the boundary.
e.zh: 该模型包含粒子穿过边界的反向扩散。

e.en: Chemists measured {retrodiffusion} during the membrane experiment.
e.zh: 化学家在膜实验中测量了回扩散。

e.en: The image showed {retrodisplacement} of the organ.
e.zh: 影像显示该器官向后移位。

e.en: The accident caused slight {retrodisplacement} of the joint.
e.zh: 事故造成关节轻微后移。

e.en: The probe used a {retroengine} to slow its descent.
e.zh: 探测器用反推发动机减缓下降。

e.en: Each {retroengine} was tested before launch.
e.zh: 每台制动引擎都在发射前接受了测试。

e.en: Mission control ordered the capsule to {retrofire}.
e.zh: 任务控制中心命令太空舱点燃反推火箭。

e.en: A failed {retrofire} could leave the spacecraft in orbit.
e.zh: 反推点火失败可能会让航天器留在轨道上。

e.en: In some languages, r is {retroflected}.
e.zh: 在有些语言中，r音是卷舌音。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {retroflected} uterus on the scan.
e.zh: 外科医生在扫描中注意到子宫向后弯曲。

e.en: The teacher explained {retroflection} in English pronunciation.
e.zh: 老师解释了英语发音中的卷舌现象。

e.en: The report described {retroflection} of the organ.
e.zh: 报告描述了该器官的向后弯曲。

e.en: The road sign used a {retroreflector} to shine back at drivers.
e.zh: 这个路标使用逆反射器把车灯反射回驾驶员眼中。

e.en: Engineers placed a {retroreflector} on the lunar surface.
e.zh: 工程师在月球表面放置了一个回射装置。

e.en: The capsule fired a {retrorocket} before reentry.
e.zh: 太空舱在重返大气层前点燃了制动火箭。

e.en: A small {retrorocket} slowed the probe near Mars.
e.zh: 一枚小型反推火箭让探测器在火星附近减速。

e.en: The plant has {retrorse} hairs along its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上长着向后倒生的细毛。

e.en: A {retrorse} spine made the hook hard to remove.
e.zh: 一根向后弯的刺让钩子很难取下。

e.en: The botanist noted the leaf's {retrorsine} bristles.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶片上倒向生长的刚毛。

e.en: Its {retrorsine} teeth helped the parasite cling tightly.
e.zh: 它向后弯曲的齿帮助寄生物牢牢附着。

e.en: The report opened with a brief {retrospectus} of the project.
e.zh: 报告开头对这个项目作了简短回顾。

e.en: Her lecture offered a {retrospectus} of early cinema.
e.zh: 她的讲座对早期电影作了追溯性概述。

e.en: He complained of {retrosternal} pain after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后说胸骨后方疼痛。

e.en: The scan showed a {retrosternal} mass pressing on the airway.
e.zh: 扫描显示胸骨后有肿块压迫气道。

e.en: She had a small {retrousse} nose and bright eyes.
e.zh: 她有一个小巧上翘的鼻子和明亮的眼睛。

e.en: The portrait exaggerates his {retrousse} features.
e.zh: 这幅肖像夸大了他鼻尖上翘的面部特征。

e.en: The condition can {retroverse} the uterus slightly.
e.zh: 这种情况可能使子宫轻微后倾。

e.en: Doctors described the organ as {retroverse} on the chart.
e.zh: 医生在病历上把这个器官描述为后倾。

e.en: The examination revealed {retroversion} of the uterus.
e.zh: 检查发现子宫后倾。

e.en: The device prevents {retroversion} during the procedure.
e.zh: 该装置可防止手术过程中发生向后翻转。

e.en: Tight ligaments may {retrovert} the uterus.
e.zh: 紧绷的韧带可能使子宫后倾。

e.en: The mechanism can {retrovert} the small mirror.
e.zh: 这个机械结构能把小镜子向后转。

e.en: She was told she had a {retroverted} uterus.
e.zh: 医生告诉她，她的子宫是后倾的。

e.en: The {retroverted} panel locked into place behind the frame.
e.zh: 向后转的面板在框架后方锁定到位。

e.en: The muscles were {retroverting} the joint during movement.
e.zh: 运动时这些肌肉使关节向后转动。

e.en: A growing mass may be {retroverting} the uterus.
e.zh: 不断增大的肿块可能正在使子宫后倾。

e.en: The dentist tried to {retrude} the lower jaw gently.
e.zh: 牙医试着轻轻让下颌后缩。

e.en: Some animals can {retrude} their mouthparts after feeding.
e.zh: 有些动物进食后能把口器缩回。

e.en: The patient had a {retruded} chin and crowded teeth.
e.zh: 这名患者下巴后缩，牙齿也很拥挤。

e.en: The {retruded} probe sat flush with the surface.
e.zh: 缩回的探针与表面齐平。

e.en: The appliance is {retruding} the lower teeth gradually.
e.zh: 这个矫治器正逐渐让下牙后缩。

e.en: The turtle was {retruding} its head into the shell.
e.zh: 那只龟正把头缩回壳里。

e.en: Jaw {retrusion} can affect a person's bite.
e.zh: 颌骨后缩会影响一个人的咬合。

e.en: The system measures {retrusion} after each test cycle.
e.zh: 系统会在每个测试周期后测量缩回量。

e.en: We ordered {retsina} with the grilled fish.
e.zh: 我们点了希腊松香葡萄酒配烤鱼。

e.en: The sharp pine flavor of {retsina} surprised her.
e.zh: 这种希腊松香葡萄酒浓烈的松香味让她很意外。

e.en: The old {rettery} stood beside the river.
e.zh: 旧浸麻场就建在河边。

e.en: Workers carried flax to the {rettery} in bundles.
e.zh: 工人们把亚麻一捆捆运到沤麻处。

e.en: The club will {returf} the pitch this summer.
e.zh: 俱乐部今年夏天会重新铺设球场草皮。

e.en: They hired gardeners to {returf} the damaged lawn.
e.zh: 他们雇了园丁给受损草坪重新铺草皮。

e.en: The store's policy depends on the item's {returnability}.
e.zh: 商店的政策取决于商品是否可以退货。

e.en: Engineers discussed the spacecraft's {returnability} after landing.
e.zh: 工程师讨论了航天器着陆后返回的可能性。

e.en: The fuel system uses a {returnless} design.
e.zh: 这个燃油系统采用无回油设计。

e.en: They feared a {returnless} journey into the desert.
e.zh: 他们担心这会是一趟无法返回的沙漠之旅。

e.en: The botanist drew the flower's {retuse} petal tip.
e.zh: 植物学家画出了花瓣顶端微凹的形状。

e.en: A {retuse} leaf is notched shallowly at the end.
e.zh: 顶端微凹的叶子末端有一个浅浅的缺口。

e.en: She was {retying} her shoelaces on the steps.
e.zh: 她正坐在台阶上重新系鞋带。

e.en: The workers spent hours {retying} the loose bundles.
e.zh: 工人们花了几个小时重新捆扎松散的包裹。

e.en: The waiter recommended {retzina} with the lamb.
e.zh: 服务员推荐用希腊松香葡萄酒搭配羊肉。

e.en: A glass of {retzina} smelled faintly of pine resin.
e.zh: 一杯希腊松香葡萄酒带着淡淡的松脂气味。

e.en: The treaty aimed to {reune} the divided provinces.
e.zh: 这项条约旨在使分裂的省份重新联合。

e.en: Their shared grief seemed to {reune} the family.
e.zh: 共同的悲痛似乎让这个家庭重新合在一起。

e.en: The {reunionist} argued for restoring the old federation.
e.zh: 这位主张重新统一者呼吁恢复旧联邦。

e.en: Local {reunionists} organized a march after the referendum.
e.zh: 当地的重新统一派在公投后组织了游行。

e.en: The party adopted a {reunionistic} platform before the election.
e.zh: 该党在选举前采纳了主张重新统一的纲领。

e.en: His speeches grew more {reunionistic} as tensions rose.
e.zh: 随着紧张加剧，他的演讲越来越倾向重新统一。

e.en: We decided to {reupholster} the old armchair.
e.zh: 我们决定给那把旧扶手椅重新装软垫。

e.en: The hotel will {reupholster} every sofa in the lobby.
e.zh: 酒店会把大厅里的每张沙发都重新包面换垫。

e.en: The doctor had to {reurge} him to rest.
e.zh: 医生不得不再次敦促他休息。

e.en: Campaigners will {reurge} lawmakers to change the rule.
e.zh: 活动人士将重新力劝立法者修改这项规定。

e.en: The policy encourages the {reusage} of office materials.
e.zh: 这项政策鼓励办公用品的重新使用。

e.en: Data {reusage} can save time in later research.
e.zh: 数据再利用可以为后续研究节省时间。

e.en: The plant focuses on the {reutilization} of waste heat.
e.zh: 这家工厂专注于废热的再利用。

e.en: Effective {reutilization} reduced the project's material costs.
e.zh: 有效的重新利用降低了项目的材料成本。

e.en: She refused to {reutter} the accusation in court.
e.zh: 她拒绝在法庭上再次说出那项指控。

e.en: The witness was asked to {reutter} his statement clearly.
e.zh: 证人被要求清楚地重复讲出自己的陈述。

e.en: The clinic advised parents to {revaccinate} their children.
e.zh: 诊所建议家长给孩子再次接种疫苗。

e.en: Travelers may need to be {revaccinated} before departure.
e.zh: 旅行者出发前可能需要重新接种疫苗。

e.en: The school scheduled {revaccination} for next Monday.
e.zh: 学校把再次接种疫苗安排在下周一。

e.en: Some adults require {revaccination} after several years.
e.zh: 有些成年人几年后需要重新接种疫苗。

e.en: You must {revalidate} your ticket before boarding.
e.zh: 登机前你必须重新确认票证有效。

e.en: The audit will {revalidate} the safety certificate.
e.zh: 这次审计将重新确认安全证书的有效性。

e.en: The system {revalidates} each login token hourly.
e.zh: 系统每小时重新验证一次登录令牌是否有效。

e.en: This review {revalidates} the earlier research findings.
e.zh: 这次审查重新确认了早先研究结果的有效性。

e.en: Passport {revalidation} can take several weeks.
e.zh: 护照重新确认有效可能需要数周。

e.en: The findings require independent {revalidation} by another team.
e.zh: 这些发现需要由另一个团队独立重新验证。

e.en: The reform led to the {revalorization} of farm labor.
e.zh: 这项改革促成了对农业劳动的价值重估。

e.en: Currency {revalorization} changed the cost of imports.
e.zh: 货币重新估值改变了进口商品的成本。

e.en: The committee will {revaluate} the proposal next month.
e.zh: 委员会下个月将重新评价这项提案。

e.en: They had to {revaluate} the property after the repairs.
e.zh: 修缮后他们不得不重新估价这处房产。

e.en: The team is {revaluating} its long-term strategy.
e.zh: 团队正在重新评价自己的长期战略。

e.en: Inspectors are {revaluating} the damaged building.
e.zh: 检查人员正在重新估价那栋受损建筑。

e.en: The mechanic had to {revalve} the old engine.
e.zh: 机械师不得不给那台旧发动机重新装阀。

e.en: Technicians will {revalve} the pipeline during shutdown.
e.zh: 技术人员将在停工期间给管道更换阀门。

e.en: The newspaper mocked him as a bitter {revanchard}.
e.zh: 报纸嘲讽他是一个满怀怨恨的复仇主义者。

e.en: A few {revanchards} demanded the lost territory back.
e.zh: 少数雪耻派要求收回失去的领土。

e.en: The defeated side dreamed of {revanche} for decades.
e.zh: 战败的一方几十年来都梦想复仇。

e.en: Saturday's match was billed as a {revanche} for last year.
e.zh: 周六的比赛被宣传成对去年失利的复仇战。

e.en: The treaty unintentionally encouraged political {revanchism}.
e.zh: 这项条约无意中助长了政治复仇主义。

e.en: Historians linked his rhetoric to nationalist {revanchism}.
e.zh: 历史学家把他的言辞与民族主义雪耻情绪联系起来。

e.en: The table needs {revarnishing} before it is sold.
e.zh: 这张桌子出售前需要重新上清漆。

e.en: He spent the weekend {revarnishing} the wooden doors.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在给木门重新刷清漆。

e.en: The patient underwent coronary {revascularization} yesterday.
e.zh: 患者昨天接受了冠状动脉血运重建手术。

e.en: Successful {revascularization} improved blood flow to the limb.
e.zh: 成功的再血管化改善了肢体的血流。

e.en: The surgeon {revascularized} the blocked artery.
e.zh: 外科医生对堵塞的动脉进行了血运重建。

e.en: The {revascularized} tissue began to heal quickly.
e.zh: 已恢复血供的组织开始迅速愈合。

retroflex.t: 舌尖卷起的；向后弯曲的

e.en: Hindi has several {retroflex} consonants.
e.zh: 印地语中有几个卷舌辅音。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {retroflex} bend in the organ.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到该器官有向后弯曲。

e.en: She pronounced the sound with a {retroflexed} tongue.
e.zh: 她用卷起的舌尖发出了这个音。

e.en: The image showed a {retroflexed} uterus.
e.zh: 影像显示子宫向后弯曲。

e.en: The teacher demonstrated {retroflexion} in Sanskrit sounds.
e.zh: 老师示范了梵语音中的卷舌发音。

e.en: The scan revealed {retroflexion} of the uterus.
e.zh: 扫描显示子宫出现向后弯曲。

e.en: The wide lens uses a {retrofocus} design.
e.zh: 这枚广角镜头采用反远距设计。

e.en: A {retrofocus} arrangement leaves room for the mirror.
e.zh: 反远距结构为反光镜留出了空间。

e.en: The country feared economic {retrogradation}.
e.zh: 这个国家担心经济倒退。

e.en: Astronomers recorded the planet's apparent {retrogradation}.
e.zh: 天文学家记录了这颗行星表观逆行。

e.en: The reforms moved {retrogradingly} after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机之后，改革以倒退的方式推进。

e.en: The planet seemed to travel {retrogradingly} across the sky.
e.zh: 这颗行星看似在天空中逆行移动。

e.en: Without funding, the program may {retrogress}.
e.zh: 如果没有资金，这个项目可能会倒退。

e.en: His health began to {retrogress} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他的健康状况开始恶化。

e.en: The debate {retrogressed} into personal attacks.
e.zh: 这场辩论倒退成了人身攻击。

e.en: Her condition had {retrogressed} by morning.
e.zh: 到早晨时，她的病情已经恶化。

e.en: The system {retrogresses} when maintenance is ignored.
e.zh: 忽视维护时，系统会退化。

e.en: He {retrogresses} under too much stress.
e.zh: 压力过大时，他的状态会倒退。

e.en: The talks are {retrogressing} rather than improving.
e.zh: 谈判不但没有改善，反而正在倒退。

e.en: Doctors worried that his recovery was {retrogressing}.
e.zh: 医生担心他的康复情况正在恶化。

e.en: The capsule used {retroignition} to slow descent.
e.zh: 太空舱用反向点火来减慢下降速度。

e.en: Engineers tested {retroignition} before the landing sequence.
e.zh: 工程师在着陆程序前测试了制动点火。

e.en: Historians should not {retroject} modern values onto the past.
e.zh: 历史学家不应把现代价值观追溯性地投射到过去。

e.en: The device can {retroject} the image behind the screen.
e.zh: 该装置能把图像向后投射到屏幕后方。

e.en: The essay criticizes the {retrojection} of nationalism into ancient history.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评把民族主义追溯性投射到古代史中。

e.en: The lens allowed {retrojection} of light into the chamber.
e.zh: 这枚透镜允许光线向后投射进腔室。

e.en: The team discussed {retrolaunching} probes from orbit.
e.zh: 团队讨论了从轨道上反向发射探测器。

e.en: The brand tried {retrolaunching} the old product online.
e.zh: 该品牌尝试在网上重新推出旧产品。

e.en: The doctor found {retrolental} tissue during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中发现了晶状体后的组织。

e.en: A {retrolental} opacity can affect vision.
e.zh: 晶状体后的混浊可能影响视力。

e.en: The report described a {retrolenticular} membrane.
e.zh: 报告描述了一层晶状体后的膜。

e.en: Surgeons monitored the {retrolenticular} space carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细监测晶状体后的空间。

e.en: The infection spread into the {retrolingual} area.
e.zh: 感染扩散到了舌后的区域。

e.en: A {retrolingual} obstruction may disturb breathing.
e.zh: 舌后阻塞可能影响呼吸。

e.en: The cereal returned in a bright {retropack}.
e.zh: 这款麦片换上鲜亮的复古包装重新上市。

e.en: The therapist used a {retropack} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后，治疗师采用了背部包扎。

e.en: The scan showed a {retroperitoneal} mass.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一个腹膜后肿块。

e.en: Surgeons entered the {retroperitoneal} space carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心进入腹膜后间隙。

e.en: The tumor had spread {retroperitoneally}.
e.zh: 肿瘤已经向腹膜后扩散。

e.en: The fluid collected {retroperitoneally} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后液体积聚在腹膜后。

e.en: Parkinson's disease can cause {retropulsion}.
e.zh: 帕金森病可能导致身体后倾后退。

e.en: The blast produced sudden {retropulsion} of the door.
e.zh: 爆炸使门突然向后弹开。

e.en: He showed a {retropulsive} gait during the test.
e.zh: 测试中他表现出向后倾倒的步态。

e.en: The mechanism creates a {retropulsive} force.
e.zh: 这个机构会产生向后推的力。

e.en: Road signs {retroreflect} headlights at night.
e.zh: 路标在夜间会逆向反射车灯。

e.en: The coating can {retroreflect} laser light.
e.zh: 这种涂层能逆向反射激光。

e.en: The tape relies on {retroreflection} for visibility.
e.zh: 这条胶带依靠逆向反射来提高可见度。

e.en: Scientists measured {retroreflection} from the lunar reflector.
e.zh: 科学家测量了月面反射器的逆向反射。

e.en: Cyclists should wear {retroreflective} strips at night.
e.zh: 骑车人夜间应佩戴逆向反射条。

e.en: The survey used {retroreflective} targets for accuracy.
e.zh: 测量中使用逆向反射靶标来提高精度。

e.en: The report assessed the {revealability} of confidential data.
e.zh: 这份报告评估了机密数据可被透露的程度。

e.en: Some facts have low {revealability} during an investigation.
e.zh: 调查期间，有些事实不太适合公开。

e.en: Only the final score is {revealable} to the public.
e.zh: 只有最终分数可以向公众透露。

e.en: The hidden image becomes {revealable} after the puzzle is solved.
e.zh: 谜题解开后，隐藏的图像就可以显现出来。

e.en: The ceremony ended with the {revealment} of the statue.
e.zh: 仪式以雕像的揭幕告终。

e.en: Her memoir traces the slow {revealment} of family secrets.
e.zh: 她的回忆录讲述了家族秘密逐渐显露的过程。

e.en: Volunteers helped {revegetate} the burned hillside.
e.zh: 志愿者帮助烧毁的山坡重新恢复植被。

e.en: The mine site will {revegetate} naturally over several years.
e.zh: 这处矿区将在几年内自然重新长出植被。

revegetating.t: 正在再植被化；再绿化的

e.en: Crews are {revegetating} the riverbank with native grasses.
e.zh: 施工队正在用本地草种让河岸重新绿化。

e.en: The {revegetating} field now attracts birds again.
e.zh: 这片正在恢复植被的田地现在又吸引了鸟类。

e.en: The project focuses on {revegetation} after severe erosion.
e.zh: 这个项目重点是在严重侵蚀后恢复植被。

e.en: Successful {revegetation} reduced dust from the old quarry.
e.zh: 成功的再绿化减少了旧采石场扬起的尘土。

revelationist.t: 启示论者；主张神启的人

e.en: The preacher wrote as a committed {revelationist}.
e.zh: 这位传道人以坚定启示论者的立场写作。

e.en: A {revelationist} may treat scripture as direct divine truth.
e.zh: 启示论者可能把经文视为直接来自神的真理。

e.en: The prophet is portrayed as a {revelator} of hidden truth.
e.zh: 这位先知被描绘成隐藏真理的启示者。

e.en: In the novel, the child becomes the {revelator} of the crime.
e.zh: 在小说中，那个孩子成了揭露罪行的人。

e.en: The streets filled with {revelment} after the victory.
e.zh: 胜利之后，街上充满了欢庆狂欢的气氛。

e.en: His poem describes nightlong {revelment} in the palace.
e.zh: 他的诗描写了宫中通宵达旦的欢宴。

e.en: A {revelrous} crowd spilled out of the tavern.
e.zh: 一群狂欢的人从酒馆里涌了出来。

e.en: The old song has a {revelrous} and slightly wild mood.
e.zh: 这首老歌带着欢宴般且略显放纵的情绪。

e.en: She gave him a {revengeless} look and walked away.
e.zh: 她毫无报复意味地看了他一眼，然后走开了。

e.en: The ending imagines a {revengeless} justice based on mercy.
e.zh: 结尾设想了一种不以复仇为基础、出于怜悯的正义。

e.en: The moonshiners hid when the {revenooer} rode up.
e.zh: 税务缉查员骑马赶来时，私酒贩子们躲了起来。

e.en: In old stories, a {revenooer} often chased illegal distillers.
e.zh: 在旧故事里，税务稽查员常常追捕非法酿酒者。

e.en: The hall gave her voice a {reverberative} quality.
e.zh: 大厅让她的声音带上了回响感。

e.en: His speech had a {reverberative} effect across the movement.
e.zh: 他的演讲在整个运动中产生了持久回响。

e.en: The studio used a vintage {reverberator} for the vocals.
e.zh: 录音室用了一台老式回响器处理人声。

e.en: The furnace worked as a {reverberator} in the smelting process.
e.zh: 这座炉在冶炼过程中起反射炉的作用。

e.en: The cave produced a deep {reverberatory} boom.
e.zh: 洞穴里发出低沉而回荡的轰鸣声。

e.en: Workers repaired the {reverberatory} furnace before smelting began.
e.zh: 冶炼开始前，工人们修好了反射炉。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {reverberometer} before testing the hall.
e.zh: 工程师在测试大厅前校准了混响测量仪。

e.en: A {reverberometer} can help measure how sound decays indoors.
e.zh: 混响测量仪可以帮助测量室内声音如何衰减。

e.en: She made a {reverse-charge} call from the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场打了一个由对方付费的电话。

e.en: The invoice uses a {reverse-charge} mechanism for VAT.
e.zh: 这张发票对增值税采用反向收费机制。

reverse-engineer.t: 逆向工程分析；反向推导

e.en: They tried to {reverse-engineer} the old software protocol.
e.zh: 他们试图对旧的软件协议进行逆向工程分析。

e.en: Researchers can {reverse-engineer} habits from purchase data.
e.zh: 研究人员可以从购买数据中反向推导出习惯。

e.en: We played {reversi} on a small board after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，我们在小棋盘上下黑白棋。

e.en: The app teaches {reversi} strategy with simple puzzles.
e.zh: 这个应用用简单谜题教授黑白棋策略。

e.en: The drug binds {reversibly} to the receptor.
e.zh: 这种药物会可逆地结合到受体上。

e.en: The screen folds {reversibly} without permanent damage.
e.zh: 这块屏幕可以折叠并恢复原状，不会造成永久损伤。

e.en: The contract included a {reversional} right to the land.
e.zh: 合同中包含对这块土地的复归权。

e.en: The plant showed a {reversional} trait from an earlier variety.
e.zh: 这株植物显现出早期品种的返祖性状。

e.en: The lab isolated a {revertant} after several generations.
e.zh: 实验室在数代之后分离出一个回复突变型。

e.en: A {revertant} may regain the original visible trait.
e.zh: 返祖体可能重新获得原先可见的性状。

e.en: The researcher measured {revertase} activity in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样本中的逆转酶活性。

e.en: This {revertase} helps drive the reaction backward.
e.zh: 这种还原酶有助于推动反应逆向进行。

e.en: The setting is {revertible} if the update fails.
e.zh: 如果更新失败，这项设置是可以恢复的。

e.en: Some mutations are {revertible} under selective pressure.
e.zh: 有些突变在选择压力下可以回复。

e.en: The chemist listed {revertose} among the minor sugars.
e.zh: 化学家把复归糖列入少量糖类之中。

e.en: Old papers sometimes mention {revertose} in carbohydrate studies.
e.zh: 旧论文有时会在碳水化合物研究中提到复归糖。

e.en: The court may {revest} the property in the owner.
e.zh: 法院可以将财产权重新授予原所有人。

e.en: The priest paused to {revest} before the ceremony.
e.zh: 神父在仪式前停下来重新穿上祭服。

e.en: The land was {revested} in the original family.
e.zh: 这块土地被重新授予原来的家族。

e.en: He {revested} himself in formal robes.
e.zh: 他又给自己穿上了正式长袍。

e.en: Engineers will {revet} the riverbank with stone.
e.zh: 工程师将用石头给河岸铺设护坡。

e.en: They {revet} the trench to stop it collapsing.
e.zh: 他们给壕沟砌上护壁，防止它塌陷。

e.en: The crew {revets} the slope before the rains arrive.
e.zh: 施工队在雨季到来前给斜坡铺护坡。

e.en: Stonework {revets} the old canal walls.
e.zh: 石砌结构护住了旧运河的墙面。

revetted.t: 已铺护坡的；已砌护墙的

e.en: The {revetted} bank survived the flood.
e.zh: 铺了护坡的河岸经受住了洪水。

e.en: Soldiers sheltered behind a {revetted} position.
e.zh: 士兵躲在有护壁加固的阵地后面。

e.en: The city began {revetting} the eroded shoreline.
e.zh: 市政府开始给被侵蚀的海岸线铺设护坡。

e.en: Proper {revetting} can protect a trench in wet soil.
e.zh: 适当的护壁工程能保护湿土中的壕沟。

e.en: The strings seemed to {revibrate} after the final chord.
e.zh: 最后一个和弦过后，琴弦似乎再次振动。

e.en: His words continued to {revibrate} in the hall.
e.zh: 他的话语仍在大厅里回响。

e.en: The {revibrating} glass made a faint musical sound.
e.zh: 再次振动的玻璃发出轻微的乐音。

e.en: She heard his warning {revibrating} in her mind.
e.zh: 她觉得他的警告仍在脑海中回响。

e.en: The instrument recorded a slight {revibration} in the beam.
e.zh: 仪器记录到横梁中轻微的再次振动。

e.en: The speech left a strange {revibration} in the crowd.
e.zh: 那场演讲在人群中留下了奇异的回响。

e.en: The ship stopped to {revictual} before crossing the ocean.
e.zh: 那艘船在横渡大洋前停靠以重新补给粮食。

e.en: Commanders had to {revictual} the fort before winter.
e.zh: 指挥官必须在冬天前为堡垒重新补给粮食。

e.en: The committee requested a formal {reviewal} of the decision.
e.zh: 委员会要求对该决定进行正式复核。

e.en: Her {reviewal} of the manuscript was unusually severe.
e.zh: 她对手稿的审查异常严格。

e.en: The article was filled with bitter {revilement}.
e.zh: 那篇文章充满了尖刻的辱骂。

e.en: Public {revilement} did not silence the witness.
e.zh: 公众的诋毁并没有让证人沉默。

e.en: The speaker ignored the {revilers} at the back.
e.zh: 演讲者没有理会后排那些辱骂者。

e.en: Even his {revilers} admitted the reform was useful.
e.zh: 即使诋毁他的人也承认这项改革有用。

e.en: The editor suggested a complete {revisal} of the chapter.
e.zh: 编辑建议对这一章进行全面修订。

e.en: A careful {revisal} removed several legal ambiguities.
e.zh: 一次仔细校订消除了几处法律上的含糊。

e.en: The old tale describes pirates {revishing} the treasure.
e.zh: 这个古老故事描写海盗夺走财宝。

e.en: She spoke of {revishing} beauty in archaic verse.
e.zh: 她在古风诗句中谈到摄人心魄的美。

e.en: The board issued a {revisional} report in March.
e.zh: 董事会在三月发布了一份修订报告。

e.en: The judge considered the court's {revisional} powers.
e.zh: 法官考虑了法院的复审权力。

e.en: Her {revisitation} of childhood memories shaped the novel.
e.zh: 她对童年记忆的重访塑造了这部小说。

e.en: The policy needs a serious {revisitation} next year.
e.zh: 这项政策明年需要认真重新审视。

e.en: The {revisor} corrected several errors in the text.
e.zh: 校订人纠正了文本中的几处错误。

e.en: A legal {revisor} checked the new statute.
e.zh: 一名法律修订者审查了这部新法规。

e.en: The committee has {revisory} authority over the code.
e.zh: 委员会对这部法规拥有修订权限。

e.en: A {revisory} note was added after the appeal.
e.zh: 上诉之后又添加了一条复审说明。

e.en: The tradition is still {revivable} with community support.
e.zh: 在社区支持下，这项传统仍可恢复。

e.en: Doctors hoped the patient was {revivable} after the accident.
e.zh: 医生希望事故后的病人仍有复苏可能。

revivalistic.t: 宗教复兴主义的；复兴派的

e.en: The preacher used a {revivalistic} style to stir the crowd.
e.zh: 那位传道人用宗教复兴派的风格鼓动人群。

e.en: Her speech had a {revivalistic} energy after years of decline.
e.zh: 多年低迷之后，她的演讲带着一种复兴式的活力。

e.en: The town saw a {revivement} of traditional crafts.
e.zh: 这个小镇见证了传统手工艺的复兴。

e.en: Doctors hoped for a sudden {revivement} of the patient.
e.zh: 医生希望病人能突然苏醒过来。

e.en: The grant funded the {revivification} of the old theater.
e.zh: 这笔资助用于让那座老剧院重新焕发生机。

e.en: The myth describes the {revivification} of a fallen hero.
e.zh: 这个神话讲述了一位倒下英雄的复活。

e.en: The essay traces the {reviviscence} of medieval ideas.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了中世纪观念的重新出现。

e.en: Warm water caused the plant's {reviviscence}.
e.zh: 温水促成了这株植物的复苏。

e.en: The {reviviscent} market attracted cautious investors.
e.zh: 这个正在复苏的市场吸引了谨慎的投资者。

e.en: A {reviviscent} memory returned when she heard the song.
e.zh: 她听到那首歌时，一段重新浮现的记忆回来了。

revivor.t: 使复活者；法律诉讼恢复

e.en: The lawyer filed a {revivor} after the claimant died.
e.zh: 索赔人去世后，律师申请恢复诉讼。

e.en: The old tonic was advertised as a {revivor} of strength.
e.zh: 这种老式补药被宣传为恢复体力的药剂。

e.en: The contract's {revocability} depended on local law.
e.zh: 这份合同是否可撤销取决于当地法律。

e.en: She questioned the {revocability} of the online consent.
e.zh: 她质疑网上同意声明的可撤销性。

e.en: The court issued a {revocative} order yesterday.
e.zh: 法院昨天发布了一项撤销性命令。

e.en: His letter had a clearly {revocative} purpose.
e.zh: 他的信显然是为了取消先前决定。

revocatory.t: 撤销性的；有取消效力的

e.en: The will contained a {revocatory} clause.
e.zh: 遗嘱中含有一项撤销条款。

e.en: A {revocatory} notice ended the license agreement.
e.zh: 一份撤销通知终止了许可协议。

revoice.t: 重新配音；用新方式表达

e.en: The studio will {revoice} the cartoon for foreign audiences.
e.zh: 工作室将为海外观众重新配音这部动画片。

e.en: The poet tried to {revoice} grief in simpler language.
e.zh: 诗人试图用更朴素的语言重新表达悲伤。

e.en: The {revoicing} of the film took three weeks.
e.zh: 这部电影的重新配音花了三周。

e.en: Her {revoicing} of the argument made it easier to accept.
e.zh: 她对论点的重新表述让人更容易接受。

e.en: The permit is {revokable} if the rules are broken.
e.zh: 如果违反规定，许可证可以被撤销。

e.en: They preferred a {revokable} offer to a final promise.
e.zh: 他们宁愿给出可取消的提议，而不是最终承诺。

e.en: The officer spoke {revokingly} about the expired license.
e.zh: 那名官员以撤销许可的口吻谈到过期执照。

e.en: The letter was worded {revokingly}, not as a warning.
e.zh: 这封信措辞是取消决定，而不是警告。

e.en: The pamphlet carried a {revoltive} tone against the monarchy.
e.zh: 这本小册子带有反对君主制的叛逆语气。

e.en: He found the smell strangely {revoltive}.
e.zh: 他觉得那股气味异常令人反感。

e.en: The printer split the word {revolu-tionary} across two lines.
e.zh: 排版时，印刷工把revolutionary这个词断开分在两行。

e.en: Her idea was truly {revolu-tionary} for its time.
e.zh: 她的想法在当时确实具有革命性。

revolute.t: 向后卷曲的；旋转成形的

e.en: The leaf has a {revolute} edge under magnification.
e.zh: 放大观察时，这片叶子的边缘向后卷曲。

e.en: The engineer designed a {revolute} joint for the arm.
e.zh: 工程师为机械臂设计了一个旋转关节。

e.en: Critics debated the {revolutionariness} of the new theory.
e.zh: 评论家争论这项新理论的革命性。

e.en: The product's {revolutionariness} was exaggerated in the ads.
e.zh: 广告夸大了这款产品的革新程度。

e.en: His essays defended {revolutionism} against gradual reform.
e.zh: 他的文章为革命主义辩护，反对渐进改革。

e.en: The course examines nineteenth-century {revolutionism}.
e.zh: 这门课研究十九世纪的革命思想。

e.en: The professor jokingly called his field {revolutionology}.
e.zh: 教授开玩笑地把自己的领域称为革命学。

e.en: Her book treats {revolutionology} as a serious discipline.
e.zh: 她的书把革命研究当作一门严肃学科。

e.en: The chair has a {revolvable} base for easier movement.
e.zh: 这把椅子有可旋转的底座，移动更方便。

e.en: The model includes a {revolvable} turret.
e.zh: 这个模型带有一个能转动的炮塔。

revolving-door.t: 旋转门；人员频繁流动的

e.en: The hotel lobby had a large {revolving-door} entrance.
e.zh: 酒店大堂有一个大型旋转门入口。

e.en: Critics attacked the {revolving-door} culture between government and industry.
e.zh: 批评者抨击政府与行业之间人员频繁流动的文化。

e.en: The note used {revovery}, but the writer clearly meant recovery.
e.zh: 便条里写了revovery，但作者显然想表达恢复。

e.en: In old records, {revovery} may appear as a mistaken spelling.
e.zh: 在旧记录中，revovery可能作为误拼出现。

e.en: The factory tested {revulcanization} on used rubber scraps.
e.zh: 工厂在废旧橡胶碎料上测试再硫化。

e.en: Proper {revulcanization} can restore some strength to rubber.
e.zh: 适当的再硫化可以恢复橡胶的一部分强度。

e.en: The doctor described the ointment as a mild {revulsant}.
e.zh: 医生把这种软膏描述为温和的引赤剂。

e.en: Historically, a {revulsant} was used to draw irritation away from deeper tissue.
e.zh: 过去人们用引赤剂把刺激从深层组织引到表面。

e.en: The cruelty of the scene seemed to {revulse} everyone present.
e.zh: 现场的残酷似乎让在场所有人都感到厌恶。

e.en: Old medical texts said the treatment could {revulse} blood from an inflamed organ.
e.zh: 旧医学文献称这种疗法可把血液从发炎器官引开。

e.en: She felt {revulsed} by the violent threats.
e.zh: 她对那些暴力威胁感到厌恶。

e.en: The skin looked red and {revulsed} after the treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后皮肤发红，呈现被引赤的状态。

e.en: The film contains a few deliberately {revulsive} images.
e.zh: 这部电影包含几处刻意令人反感的画面。

e.en: A {revulsive} lotion was once applied to redden the skin.
e.zh: 过去曾使用引赤洗剂使皮肤发红。

e.en: The baby began to {rewake} just after midnight.
e.zh: 婴儿刚过午夜又开始醒来。

e.en: The old song can {rewake} memories of home.
e.zh: 这首老歌能重新唤起对家的回忆。

e.en: The speech helped {rewaken} public interest in the case.
e.zh: 这次演讲重新激起了公众对此案的兴趣。

e.en: A sudden noise can {rewaken} a light sleeper.
e.zh: 突然的响声会再次吵醒睡眠很浅的人。

e.en: The app marks each completed task as {rewardable}.
e.zh: 这个应用把每个完成的任务都标为可奖励。

e.en: Honest effort is {rewardable} even when results are imperfect.
e.zh: 即使结果不完美，诚实的努力也值得奖赏。

e.en: Teaching can be a difficult but {rewardful} career.
e.zh: 教学可能艰难，但也是令人满足的职业。

e.en: He found the quiet work surprisingly {rewardful}.
e.zh: 他发现这份安静的工作出乎意料地有成就感。

e.en: They spent months on a {rewardless} search for funding.
e.zh: 他们花了几个月徒劳地寻找资金。

e.en: The job felt {rewardless} despite the long hours.
e.zh: 尽管工时很长，这份工作仍让人觉得没有回报。

e.en: The laundry hired a {rewasher} to handle stained sheets.
e.zh: 洗衣房雇了一名重洗工处理有污渍的床单。

e.en: A {rewasher} can clean parts that failed the first rinse.
e.zh: 再洗设备能清洗第一次漂洗未合格的零件。

e.en: Please {rewater} the seedlings before the soil dries out.
e.zh: 请在土壤干透前给幼苗重新浇水。

e.en: Engineers planned to {rewater} the canal after repairs.
e.zh: 工程师计划在维修后重新向运河供水。

e.en: The analyst will {reweight} the survey data by age.
e.zh: 分析师会按年龄重新加权调查数据。

e.en: We had to {reweight} each package after repacking it.
e.zh: 重新包装后，我们必须重新称量每个包裹。

e.en: The champion hopes to {rewin} the title next year.
e.zh: 这位冠军希望明年重新赢得头衔。

e.en: The party struggled to {rewin} voters after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻过后，该党努力重新赢回选民。

e.en: She {rewon} the seat after a close election.
e.zh: 经过一场胶着的选举，她重新赢得了席位。

e.en: The team {rewon} public trust with honest reforms.
e.zh: 球队通过诚实改革重新赢得了公众信任。

e.en: Please {rewrap} the gift after checking the label.
e.zh: 检查标签后请把礼物重新包装好。

e.en: The movers had to {rewrap} the fragile vase carefully.
e.zh: 搬运工必须小心地重新包裹那个易碎花瓶。

e.en: The old suitcase was covered in brown {rexine}.
e.zh: 那只旧手提箱外面包着棕色人造革。

e.en: Cheap chairs often used {rexine} instead of real leather.
e.zh: 便宜椅子常用人造革而不是真皮。

e.en: He grew up on the {rez} in northern Canada.
e.zh: 他在加拿大北部的原住民保留地长大。

e.en: Students used {rez} as a short form for residence.
e.zh: 学生们把rez用作宿舍的简称。

e.en: The novel follows a Soviet {rezident} in London.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一名苏联驻伦敦特工的故事。

e.en: A {rezident} coordinated the network from inside the embassy.
e.zh: 一名常驻特工从大使馆内部协调这个情报网。

e.en: The {rezidentsia} operated quietly under diplomatic cover.
e.zh: 这个驻外情报站在外交掩护下秘密运作。

e.en: Files later revealed the structure of the {rezidentsia}.
e.zh: 后来的档案揭示了该特工站的组织结构。

rhagade.t: 皮肤或黏膜裂口；皲裂创口

e.en: The nurse cleaned the painful {rhagade} near his lip.
e.zh: 护士清理了他唇边那道疼痛的皲裂口。

e.en: Cold weather left a small {rhagade} on her hand.
e.zh: 寒冷天气让她手上裂出一道小口。

rhamnaceous.t: 鼠李科植物的；似鼠李科的

e.en: The botanist described the shrub as {rhamnaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种灌木描述为鼠李科植物。

e.en: Its {rhamnaceous} traits helped identify the specimen.
e.zh: 它的鼠李科特征帮助确认了这个标本。

rhamnose.t: 鼠李糖；一种天然脱氧糖

e.en: The sample contained {rhamnose} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 样品中含有来自植物提取物的鼠李糖。

e.en: Chemists measured {rhamnose} during the sugar analysis.
e.zh: 化学家在糖类分析中测定了鼠李糖。

rhamnoside.t: 鼠李糖苷；含鼠李糖的苷

e.en: The flavonoid formed a {rhamnoside} in the fruit skin.
e.zh: 这种黄酮在果皮中形成了鼠李糖苷。

e.en: Researchers isolated a new {rhamnoside} from the leaves.
e.zh: 研究人员从叶片中分离出一种新的鼠李糖苷。

rhamnosterin.t: 鼠李甾醇；植物甾醇成分

e.en: The old paper mentioned {rhamnosterin} in buckthorn bark.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文提到鼠李树皮中有鼠李甾醇。

e.en: Few modern textbooks discuss {rhamnosterin} in detail.
e.zh: 现代教材很少详细讨论鼠李甾醇。

rhapidosome.t: 棒状病毒粒子；针状病毒体

e.en: The electron microscope revealed a {rhapidosome} inside the cell.
e.zh: 电子显微镜显示细胞内有一个棒状病毒粒子。

e.en: Virologists compared each {rhapidosome} with known viral forms.
e.zh: 病毒学家把每个棒状病毒体与已知病毒形态作比较。

rhapontigenin.t: 大黄素苷元；植物酚类化合物

e.en: The root extract yielded {rhapontigenin} after purification.
e.zh: 根部提取物经纯化后得到大黄素苷元。

e.en: Scientists studied {rhapontigenin} for its antioxidant activity.
e.zh: 科学家研究大黄素苷元的抗氧化活性。

e.en: A {rhapsode} recited Homer before the gathered crowd.
e.zh: 一位古希腊吟诵者在聚集的人群前朗诵荷马史诗。

e.en: The scholar compared the poet to a wandering {rhapsode}.
e.zh: 学者把这位诗人比作四处游历的史诗吟诵者。

rhapsoder.t: 狂热朗诵者；史诗吟诵者

e.en: The old {rhapsoder} performed verses with dramatic pauses.
e.zh: 那位老吟诵者带着戏剧性的停顿表演诗句。

e.en: Critics called him a {rhapsoder} of nationalist legends.
e.zh: 评论家称他是民族传说的狂热吟诵者。

rhapsodical.t: 狂热赞美的；狂想曲式的

e.en: She wrote a {rhapsodical} review of the concert.
e.zh: 她为那场音乐会写了一篇热烈赞美的评论。

e.en: The piece has a loose, {rhapsodical} structure.
e.zh: 这首曲子结构松散，带有狂想曲式的特点。

rhapsodically.t: 狂热赞美地；如狂想曲般

e.en: He spoke {rhapsodically} about the mountain sunrise.
e.zh: 他热情洋溢地谈起山间日出。

e.en: The piano line moved {rhapsodically} through shifting keys.
e.zh: 钢琴旋律在不断变换的调性中如狂想曲般流动。

e.en: Fans still {rhapsodise} about her final performance.
e.zh: 粉丝们至今仍热情赞美她的最后一次演出。

e.en: He would {rhapsodise} for hours about rare books.
e.zh: 他会一连几个小时狂热地谈论珍本书。

rhapsodised.t: 热情赞美过；狂热谈论过

e.en: The critic {rhapsodised} about the film's quiet ending.
e.zh: 那位评论家热情赞美了影片安静的结尾。

e.en: She {rhapsodised} over the garden in her letter.
e.zh: 她在信中对那座花园赞不绝口。

rhapsodist.t: 热情赞美者；史诗吟诵者

e.en: The lecturer sounded like a {rhapsodist} for lost empires.
e.zh: 那位讲师听起来像是在热情歌颂逝去帝国的人。

e.en: Ancient audiences listened closely to the traveling {rhapsodist}.
e.zh: 古代观众专注地聆听那位巡游史诗吟诵者。

rhatany.t: 拉坦尼根；收敛性药用根

e.en: The herbalist used {rhatany} in an astringent tincture.
e.zh: 草药师把拉坦尼根用于一种收敛酊剂。

e.en: Old dental powders sometimes contained powdered {rhatany}.
e.zh: 旧式牙粉有时含有粉末状拉坦尼根。

rhathymia.t: 无忧心境；轻松懒散状态

e.en: His {rhathymia} made deadlines seem unimportant.
e.zh: 他的轻松懒散让截止日期显得无关紧要。

e.en: The essay praises {rhathymia} as freedom from needless worry.
e.zh: 这篇文章称赞无忧心境是一种摆脱无谓焦虑的自由。

e.en: A {rhebok} stood on the rocky slope.
e.zh: 一只南非小羚羊站在岩石坡上。

e.en: The reserve protects {rhebok} and other mountain antelope.
e.zh: 保护区保护南非小羚羊和其他山地羚羊。

e.en: We spotted a {rhebuck} near the ridge at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时我们在山脊附近看见一只南非小羚羊。

e.en: The guide identified the animal as a grey {rhebuck}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只动物是灰羚。

e.en: The museum displayed a model of a Roman {rheda}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆古罗马四轮旅行车模型。

e.en: Travelers once crossed provinces in a heavy {rheda}.
e.zh: 过去旅人曾乘坐笨重的四轮旅行车穿越各省。

e.en: A grey {rheebok} grazed beyond the fence.
e.zh: 一只灰羚在篱笆外吃草。

e.en: Hunters historically valued the swift {rheebok}.
e.zh: 过去猎人很看重动作敏捷的南非小羚羊。

e.en: The {rheebuck} vanished into the misty grassland.
e.zh: 那只南非小羚羊消失在雾气弥漫的草地里。

e.en: Field notes recorded a lone {rheebuck} near the stream.
e.zh: 野外记录写到溪边有一只单独的灰羚。

rheid.t: 类流体的；长期受力会流动的

e.en: Salt can behave as a {rheid} material under pressure.
e.zh: 盐在压力下可以表现为类流体材料。

e.en: Geologists use {rheid} to describe slow deformation in rock.
e.zh: 地质学家用类流体一词描述岩石的缓慢变形。

rheidity.t: 类流体性；缓慢流变性质

e.en: The study measured the {rheidity} of deep crustal rocks.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了深部地壳岩石的类流体性。

e.en: High temperature increases {rheidity} in some geological materials.
e.zh: 高温会增强某些地质材料的缓慢流变性质。

e.en: In the sentence, the final phrase is the {rhema}.
e.zh: 在这个句子中，最后的短语是述位。

e.en: The lecturer contrasted theme with {rhema} in discourse analysis.
e.zh: 讲师在话语分析中对比了主位和述位。

rhematic.t: 述位的；表达核心信息的

e.en: The {rhematic} part carries the new information.
e.zh: 述位部分承载新的信息。

e.en: Her paper examines {rhematic} stress in spoken English.
e.zh: 她的论文研究英语口语中的述位重音。

rhematize.t: 使成述位；突出为新信息

e.en: Writers may {rhematize} a detail by moving it to the end.
e.zh: 作者可以把细节移到句末，使其成为述位。

e.en: The passive form can {rhematize} the agent in this clause.
e.zh: 被动形式可以在这个分句中突出施事者。

e.en: The old medical text described {rhembasmus} after the injury.
e.zh: 这本旧医学书描述了受伤后的斜视症状。

e.en: Doctors no longer use {rhembasmus} in ordinary clinical notes.
e.zh: 医生现在已不在普通临床记录中使用rhembasmus这个词。

e.en: The lab prepared a {rhenic} compound for testing.
e.zh: 实验室制备了一种含铼化合物用于测试。

e.en: A {rhenic} catalyst can withstand very high temperatures.
e.zh: 铼基催化剂能承受很高的温度。

e.en: {Rhenium} is used in some high-temperature alloys.
e.zh: 铼用于一些耐高温合金。

e.en: The mine produces only traces of {rhenium}.
e.zh: 这座矿只产出微量的铼。

e.en: The engineer used a {rheo} test to study the paste.
e.zh: 工程师用流变测试来研究这种浆料。

e.en: Several {rheo} terms appear in polymer science.
e.zh: 聚合物科学中会出现几个流变相关术语。

e.en: The experiment measured the nerve's {rheobase}.
e.zh: 实验测量了这条神经的基强度。

e.en: A lower {rheobase} suggests greater excitability.
e.zh: 较低的基强度说明兴奋性更高。

rheobiotic.t: 流水生境的；适应流水的

e.en: Some {rheobiotic} insects cling tightly to stones.
e.zh: 一些适应流水环境的昆虫会紧紧附着在石头上。

e.en: The survey focused on {rheobiotic} species in mountain streams.
e.zh: 这项调查关注山溪中的流水生境物种。

e.en: The factory adopted {rheocasting} for lighter aluminum parts.
e.zh: 工厂采用流变铸造来生产更轻的铝件。

e.en: {Rheocasting} can reduce defects in some metal components.
e.zh: 流变铸造能减少某些金属部件的缺陷。

rheochor.t: 水流传播植物；流水散布者

e.en: A {rheochor} spreads its seeds through running water.
e.zh: 水流传播植物借助流水散布种子。

e.en: The botanist classified the riverbank plant as a {rheochor}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种河岸植物归为流水散布者。

rheochord.t: 滑线变阻器；可变电阻器

e.en: The physicist adjusted the {rheochord} during the demonstration.
e.zh: 物理学家在演示中调节了滑线变阻器。

e.en: A {rheochord} varies resistance along a stretched wire.
e.zh: 滑线变阻器通过一根拉直的导线改变电阻。

e.en: The clinic once used {rheoencephalography} to assess cerebral blood flow.
e.zh: 这家诊所过去用脑血流阻抗描记法评估脑血流。

e.en: Modern imaging has largely replaced {rheoencephalography}.
e.zh: 现代影像技术已在很大程度上取代脑血流阻抗描记法。

rheogoniometer.t: 流变测角仪；流变角度仪

e.en: The technician calibrated the {rheogoniometer} before testing the gel.
e.zh: 技术员在测试凝胶前校准了流变测角仪。

e.en: A {rheogoniometer} records deformation under controlled shear.
e.zh: 流变测角仪记录受控剪切下的变形。

rheogoniometry.t: 流变测角法；流变角测量

e.en: The study used {rheogoniometry} to compare two polymers.
e.zh: 这项研究用流变测角法比较两种聚合物。

e.en: Accurate {rheogoniometry} requires careful temperature control.
e.zh: 准确的流变测角需要仔细控制温度。

rheograph.t: 流量记录仪；血流描记仪

e.en: The old {rheograph} traced changes in blood flow.
e.zh: 这台旧血流描记仪记录了血流变化。

e.en: Engineers used a {rheograph} to monitor the fluid stream.
e.zh: 工程师用流量记录仪监测液流。

e.en: The fish showed {rheokinesis} in the artificial stream.
e.zh: 这条鱼在人工水流中表现出对水流的运动反应。
