e.en: Geologists found {robinsonite} in the old mine.
e.zh: 地质学家在那座老矿井中发现了硫锑铅矿。

e.en: The cabinet was made from dense {roble}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用质地坚硬的栎木做成的。

e.en: A tall {roble} shaded the edge of the field.
e.zh: 一棵高大的中南美橡树遮住了田地边缘。

robo.t: 机器人相关的；自动化的

e.en: The kids joined a {robo} soccer contest.
e.zh: 孩子们参加了一场机器人足球比赛。

e.en: The company tested a {robo} adviser for small investors.
e.zh: 公司为小投资者测试了一款自动化投资顾问。

e.en: The comic villain built a {robomb} in his lab.
e.zh: 漫画里的反派在实验室里造了一个机器人炸弹。

e.en: Police treated the device as a possible {robomb}.
e.zh: 警方把这个装置当作可能的自动炸弹处理。

e.en: The old tonic was advertised as a {roborant}.
e.zh: 这种老式补药被宣传为强身剂。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {roborant} mixtures after illness.
e.zh: 医生过去会在病后开一些滋补混合药剂。

roboteer.t: 机器人操作者；机器人爱好者

e.en: The young {roboteer} repaired the damaged sensor.
e.zh: 那位年轻的机器人操作者修好了受损的传感器。

e.en: Every {roboteer} brought a homemade machine to the fair.
e.zh: 每位机器人爱好者都带了一台自制机器来展会。

roboticist.t: 机器人专家；机器人学家

e.en: A {roboticist} designed the arm for surgery.
e.zh: 一位机器人学家设计了用于手术的机械臂。

e.en: The {roboticist} studies how machines learn to walk.
e.zh: 这位机器人专家研究机器如何学会行走。

roboticized.t: 机器人化的；被自动化的

e.en: The factory became highly {roboticized} within five years.
e.zh: 这家工厂在五年内变得高度机器人化。

e.en: Workers disliked the {roboticized} style of customer service.
e.zh: 员工不喜欢那种机械化的客服方式。

e.en: Managers wanted to {robotise} the packing line.
e.zh: 管理层想把包装线自动化。

e.en: The film imagines a state that can {robotise} its citizens.
e.zh: 这部电影想象了一个能把公民机械化的国家。

e.en: Critics saw {robotism} in his stiff performance.
e.zh: 评论家从他僵硬的表演中看出了机械感。

e.en: The essay warned against {robotism} in modern work.
e.zh: 这篇文章警告现代工作中出现的机器人式状态。

robotistic.t: 像机器人的；机械呆板的

e.en: Her {robotistic} movements unsettled the audience.
e.zh: 她像机器人一样的动作让观众感到不安。

e.en: The memo criticized the team's {robotistic} answers.
e.zh: 备忘录批评团队的回答机械呆板。

e.en: {Robotization} reduced costs in the warehouse.
e.zh: 仓库的自动化改造降低了成本。

e.en: Some workers feared rapid {robotization} of the industry.
e.zh: 一些工人担心这个行业迅速机器人化。

e.en: The company plans to {robotize} routine inspections.
e.zh: 公司计划把例行检查机器人化。

e.en: Strict scripts can {robotize} a friendly conversation.
e.zh: 严格的话术会把友好的谈话变得机械。

e.en: A {robotized} cart carried tools across the shop.
e.zh: 一辆自动化推车把工具运过车间。

e.en: The office felt cold and {robotized} after the changes.
e.zh: 改动之后，办公室显得冷冰冰又机械化。

roadability.t: 道路适行性；适合行驶程度

e.en: The engineer tested the vehicle's {roadability} on rough tracks.
e.zh: 工程师在崎岖路面上测试了这辆车的道路适行性。

e.en: Poor drainage reduced the {roadability} of the mountain route.
e.zh: 排水不良降低了这条山路的通行适宜程度。

roadable.t: 可通车的；适合道路行驶的

e.en: After the storm, only one lane remained {roadable}.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，只有一条车道还能通行。

e.en: The prototype is barely {roadable} without further testing.
e.zh: 这辆原型车未经进一步测试几乎不适合上路。

e.en: She checked the {roadbook} before leaving the service area.
e.zh: 她离开服务区前查看了路线手册。

e.en: An old {roadbook} showed every ferry crossing in the county.
e.zh: 一本旧公路地图册标出了该县所有渡口。

e.en: The {roadbuilder} surveyed the valley before work began.
e.zh: 道路建设者在开工前勘测了山谷。

e.en: A skilled {roadbuilder} understands soil as well as machines.
e.zh: 熟练的筑路工既懂机械，也懂土质。

e.en: The {roadbuilders} widened the pass before winter.
e.zh: 筑路工在冬季前拓宽了山口道路。

e.en: Early {roadbuilders} often followed ancient trade paths.
e.zh: 早期的道路建设者常沿着古老商路修路。

roadeo.t: 驾驶技能竞赛；卡车驾驶赛

e.en: The city hosted a bus {roadeo} for professional drivers.
e.zh: 这座城市为职业司机举办了一场公交驾驶技能竞赛。

e.en: He won the safety award at the truck {roadeo}.
e.zh: 他在卡车驾驶赛上获得了安全奖。

e.en: We parked at the {roadhead} and hiked uphill.
e.zh: 我们把车停在道路尽头，然后徒步上山。

e.en: Supplies were unloaded at the remote {roadhead}.
e.zh: 补给品被卸在偏远的公路终点。

e.en: That {roadhog} blocked both lanes for miles.
e.zh: 那个霸道司机一路占着两条车道好几英里。

e.en: Don't be a {roadhog} when cyclists need space.
e.zh: 骑车人需要空间时，别当占路的司机。

roadholding.t: 车辆抓地性；道路操控稳定性

e.en: The sports car has excellent {roadholding} in wet weather.
e.zh: 这辆跑车在湿滑天气下抓地性很好。

e.en: Worn tires can seriously affect {roadholding}.
e.zh: 磨损的轮胎会严重影响车辆的道路操控稳定性。

e.en: The {roadman} repaired potholes after the frost.
e.zh: 霜冻过后，巡路工修补了路面的坑洞。

e.en: As a {roadman}, he knew every bend in the county.
e.zh: 作为筑路工，他熟悉县里每一个弯道。

roadmanship.t: 驾驶礼仪；良好用路技巧

e.en: Good {roadmanship} means giving nervous drivers room.
e.zh: 良好的驾驶礼仪意味着给紧张的司机留出空间。

e.en: The instructor praised her calm {roadmanship} in traffic.
e.zh: 教练称赞她在车流中的冷静驾驶技巧。

e.en: Several ships waited in the {roadstead} overnight.
e.zh: 几艘船夜里停在近岸锚地等待。

e.en: A storm made the open {roadstead} unsafe.
e.zh: 一场风暴使这个开敞停泊处变得不安全。

roadworthiness.t: 车辆适航性；上路安全状态

e.en: The inspector checked the van's {roadworthiness}.
e.zh: 检查员查看了这辆面包车的上路安全状态。

e.en: Rust can affect a car's {roadworthiness} over time.
e.zh: 锈蚀久了会影响汽车的适合上路程度。

e.en: The old bike felt {roady} but surprisingly comfortable.
e.zh: 那辆旧自行车很有公路车的感觉，却意外地舒服。

e.en: They wanted a gritty, {roady} sound for the album.
e.zh: 他们希望这张专辑有一种粗粝的巡演路上气息。

e.en: Cold {roaks} drifted above the marsh at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，寒冷的雾气在沼泽上方飘动。

e.en: The valley filled with pale {roaks} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后，山谷里弥漫着淡淡的水汽薄雾。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {robalo} with lime.
e.zh: 厨师用青柠烤了新鲜的尖吻鲈。

e.en: Local fishermen sell {robalo} at the morning market.
e.zh: 当地渔民在早市出售海鲈鱼。

e.en: The sailor tightened a loose {roband} before dawn.
e.zh: 水手在黎明前收紧了一根松动的系帆短绳。

e.en: Old canvas was fastened with each weathered {roband}.
e.zh: 旧帆布用一根根风化的帆索固定着。

e.en: The {rock-climbers} checked their ropes before sunrise.
e.zh: 那些攀岩者在日出前检查了绳索。

e.en: Experienced {rock-climbers} know when to turn back.
e.zh: 有经验的攀岩者知道什么时候该折返。

e.en: The crew used a {rock-drill} to cut the tunnel.
e.zh: 施工队用凿岩机开凿隧道。

e.en: A loud {rock-drill} shook the whole street.
e.zh: 一台轰鸣的凿岩机震得整条街都在抖。

e.en: Water ran down the steep {rock-face}.
e.zh: 水顺着陡峭的岩壁流下来。

e.en: They painted marks on the {rock-face} for the climbers.
e.zh: 他们在岩壁上画了标记给攀登者看。

e.en: Her promise felt {rock-firm} after years of loyalty.
e.zh: 多年忠诚之后，她的承诺显得坚如磐石。

e.en: The table stood {rock-firm} on the stone floor.
e.zh: 那张桌子稳稳地立在石地板上。

e.en: They slept in a {rock-hewn} chamber beneath the hill.
e.zh: 他们睡在山丘下一个岩石凿成的房间里。

e.en: The old monastery had {rock-hewn} steps and narrow doors.
e.zh: 那座古老修道院有凿岩而成的台阶和窄门。

e.en: The clay dried into a {rock-like} mass.
e.zh: 黏土干后变成一块像岩石一样硬的东西。

e.en: He kept a {rock-like} calm during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中他保持着磐石般的冷静。

e.en: The band will {rock-out} after the opening speech.
e.zh: 开场讲话之后，乐队会尽情摇滚起来。

e.en: We used to {rock-out} in the garage every Friday.
e.zh: 我们以前每周五都在车库里痛快演奏摇滚。

e.en: The {rock-ribbed} coast was hard to cross on foot.
e.zh: 那片岩脊突出的海岸很难步行穿越。

e.en: She held a {rock-ribbed} belief in public service.
e.zh: 她对公共服务抱有极其坚定的信念。

e.en: We need {rock-solid} evidence before making an accusation.
e.zh: 提出指控前，我们需要确凿可靠的证据。

e.en: Their marriage remained {rock-solid} through hard times.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻在艰难时期依然稳固可靠。

e.en: Keep the camera {rock-steady} while filming.
e.zh: 拍摄时要把相机拿得非常稳。

e.en: Her voice stayed {rock-steady} during the interview.
e.zh: 采访中她的声音一直很镇定。

e.en: The pianist played a fast {rockaboogie} for the dancers.
e.zh: 钢琴师为舞者弹了一首快速的摇滚布吉曲。

e.en: That old {rockaboogie} still fills the hall with energy.
e.zh: 那首老摇滚布吉乐曲仍让大厅充满活力。

rockabye.t: 摇啊摇哄睡；摇篮曲式的

e.en: She sang {rockabye} softly beside the crib.
e.zh: 她在婴儿床旁轻轻唱着摇篮曲。

e.en: The nursery had a gentle {rockabye} rhythm.
e.zh: 育婴室里有一种轻柔哄睡的节奏。

e.en: A small {rockbird} nested above the cliff path.
e.zh: 一只小岩鸟在悬崖小路上方筑巢。

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {rockbird} on the ledge.
e.zh: 向导指着岩架上一只罕见的岩鸟给大家看。

e.en: Prices hit {rockbottom} during the winter sale.
e.zh: 冬季促销期间价格跌到了最低点。

e.en: After losing his job, his confidence reached {rockbottom}.
e.zh: 失业之后，他的信心跌到了谷底。

e.en: The ship approached a {rockbound} island at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，船靠近了一座岩石环绕的岛。

e.en: They built cottages along the {rockbound} shore.
e.zh: 他们沿着多岩的海岸建了几间小屋。

e.en: The specimen contained dark grains of {rockbridgeite}.
e.zh: 这个标本含有深色的磷铁锰矿颗粒。

e.en: Geologists identified {rockbridgeite} in the phosphate deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在磷酸盐矿床中鉴定出磷铁锰矿。

e.en: Good {rockcraft} matters more than brute strength.
e.zh: 良好的攀岩技艺比蛮力更重要。

e.en: The museum displayed local {rockcraft} from the valley.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了山谷当地的岩石工艺品。

e.en: Purple {rockcress} bloomed between the stones.
e.zh: 紫色岩芥在石缝间开花。

e.en: Gardeners plant {rockcress} along dry walls.
e.zh: 园丁常把岩芥种在干砌墙边。

e.en: The pendant was carved from clear {rockcrystal}.
e.zh: 这个吊坠是用透明水晶雕成的。

e.en: Ancient healers valued {rockcrystal} for its clarity.
e.zh: 古代医者看重水晶的清澈质地。

e.en: The soldier carried a heavy {rocket-launcher}.
e.zh: 那名士兵扛着一具沉重的火箭筒。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {rocket-launcher} from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具战争时期的旧火箭发射器。

e.en: The unit stored several {rocket-launchers} in a guarded room.
e.zh: 该部队把几具火箭筒存放在有警卫的房间里。

e.en: Modern {rocket-launchers} can be mounted on vehicles.
e.zh: 现代火箭发射器可以安装在车辆上。

rocket-plane.t: 火箭飞机；火箭动力飞机

e.en: The experimental {rocket-plane} climbed faster than any jet.
e.zh: 这架实验性火箭飞机爬升速度超过任何喷气机。

e.en: Engineers tested the {rocket-plane} over the desert.
e.zh: 工程师在沙漠上空测试了这架火箭动力飞机。

e.en: Her thesis explored {robotology} in early science fiction.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了早期科幻作品中的机器人学。

e.en: The old magazine used {robotology} as a playful term for robotics.
e.zh: 那本老杂志把robotology当作机器人学的戏称。

e.en: The artist built a {robotomorphic} sculpture from scrap metal.
e.zh: 艺术家用废金属做了一座机器人形态的雕塑。

e.en: Critics described the character's stiff movements as {robotomorphic}.
e.zh: 评论家把这个角色僵硬的动作形容为机器人式的。

robotry.t: 机器人技术；机器人体系

e.en: The novel imagines a future ruled by advanced {robotry}.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了一个由先进机器人技术主导的未来。

e.en: He used {robotry} to describe the whole culture of machines.
e.zh: 他用robotry来描述整个机器文化。

e.en: The tiny {robug} crawled through the collapsed pipe.
e.zh: 那只微型昆虫形机器人爬过了倒塌的管道。

e.en: Engineers tested a {robug} designed to inspect crops.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一款用于检查农作物的昆虫机器人。

e.en: The miners once used {roburite} instead of ordinary dynamite.
e.zh: 矿工们曾经使用罗伯炸药来替代普通炸药。

e.en: Old safety manuals warned that {roburite} required careful storage.
e.zh: 旧安全手册警告说罗伯炸药需要谨慎储存。

e.en: The bridge's {robusticity} impressed the visiting engineers.
e.zh: 这座桥的坚固程度给来访工程师留下了深刻印象。

e.en: She questioned the {robusticity} of the new economic model.
e.zh: 她质疑这个新经济模型的稳健性。

robustious.t: 粗壮喧闹的；粗野有力的

e.en: The sailors sang in a {robustious} chorus.
e.zh: 水手们用粗犷有力的合唱声唱了起来。

e.en: His {robustious} humor shocked the polite dinner guests.
e.zh: 他粗野喧闹的幽默让彬彬有礼的晚宴客人吃了一惊。

e.en: The crowd cheered {robustiously} after the final goal.
e.zh: 最后一个进球后，人群喧闹有力地欢呼起来。

e.en: He laughed {robustiously} at his own ridiculous story.
e.zh: 他听着自己荒唐的故事，粗声大笑起来。

e.en: The play needs more {robustiousness} in its tavern scenes.
e.zh: 这出戏的酒馆场面需要更多粗犷喧闹的气氛。

e.en: Her speech had a surprising {robustiousness} that filled the hall.
e.zh: 她的演讲有一种出人意料的雄健气势，充满了大厅。

rocaille.t: 洛可可贝壳饰；假山石饰

e.en: The mirror was framed with gilded {rocaille} ornament.
e.zh: 这面镜子的边框装饰着镀金的洛可可贝壳纹。

e.en: Garden designers used {rocaille} to imitate natural rockwork.
e.zh: 园林设计师用假山石饰来模仿天然岩石景观。

e.en: The cook added chopped {rocambole} to the soup.
e.zh: 厨师把切碎的沙葱加进了汤里。

e.en: In old herbals, {rocambole} is described as a strong-flavored garlic.
e.zh: 在古老的草药书中，沙葱被描述为味道浓烈的蒜类植物。

e.en: The bishop wore a white {rochet} beneath his chimere.
e.zh: 主教在外袍里面穿着一件白色法衣。

e.en: A medieval inventory listed one linen {rochet} for the chapel.
e.zh: 一份中世纪清单列出小教堂有一件亚麻白色法衣。

e.en: The choir room stored several old {rochets} in cedar chests.
e.zh: 唱诗班房间把几件旧白色法衣存放在雪松木箱里。

e.en: The embroidered {rochets} were brought out for the ceremony.
e.zh: 那些绣花主教罩袍被拿出来用于仪式。

e.en: She grew up listening to {rock'n'roll} records.
e.zh: 她是听着摇滚唱片长大的。

e.en: The band's new album has a raw {rock'n'roll} energy.
e.zh: 这支乐队的新专辑有一种原始的摇滚活力。

e.en: Old {rock-and-roll} songs filled the diner.
e.zh: 老摇滚歌曲充满了那家小餐馆。

e.en: The movie captures the {rock-and-roll} spirit of the 1950s.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了20世纪50年代的摇滚精神。

e.en: Prices hit {rock-bottom} after the holiday season.
e.zh: 假期过后，价格跌到了最低点。

e.en: He reached {rock-bottom} before asking for help.
e.zh: 他跌到人生谷底后才开口求助。

rock-bound.t: 岩石环绕的；困于岩石的

e.en: They built a lighthouse on the {rock-bound} coast.
e.zh: 他们在岩石环绕的海岸上建了一座灯塔。

e.en: The ship was {rock-bound} until the tide rose.
e.zh: 那艘船被困在岩石间，直到潮水上涨才脱身。

rodingite.t: 钙硅酸盐变质岩；杆沸岩

e.en: The geologist identified the pale vein as {rodingite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那条浅色岩脉鉴定为钙硅酸盐变质岩。

e.en: Blocks of {rodingite} occur beside the serpentinite body.
e.zh: 蛇纹岩体旁边可见一些杆沸岩块。

rodingitize.t: 使变成杆沸岩；发生杆沸岩化

e.en: Fluids can {rodingitize} the surrounding mafic rock.
e.zh: 流体会使周围的镁铁质岩石发生杆沸岩化。

e.en: The altered dike was partly {rodingitized} near the fault.
e.zh: 那条受蚀变的岩脉在断层附近部分变成了杆沸岩。

e.en: A tiny {rodlet} kept the latch from closing.
e.zh: 一根小杆卡住了门闩，使它合不上。

e.en: The sample contained several dark {rodlets} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，样品里有几根深色短棒状物。

e.en: The {rodman} held the survey pole beside the road.
e.zh: 测量标尺员把测杆立在路边。

e.en: A good {rodman} keeps the staff steady in the wind.
e.zh: 熟练的持杆工能在风中把标尺扶稳。

e.en: The old soldier sounded like a {rodomont} at dinner.
e.zh: 那位老兵在晚餐时听起来像个吹牛的人。

e.en: No one trusted the {rodomont} after his wild claims.
e.zh: 他胡乱夸口之后，没人再相信这个吹牛者。

rodomontade.t: 夸夸其谈；虚张声势的话

e.en: His speech was full of empty {rodomontade}.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是空洞的夸夸其谈。

e.en: The general's {rodomontade} failed to impress the troops.
e.zh: 将军虚张声势的话没能打动士兵。

e.en: The old {rodster} repaired fishing rods for the village.
e.zh: 那位老制杆者为村里人修钓竿。

e.en: A patient {rodster} waited by the river all morning.
e.zh: 一名有耐心的钓竿客在河边等了整个上午。

e.en: She poured the white wine into a green {roemer}.
e.zh: 她把白葡萄酒倒进一只绿色高脚酒杯。

e.en: The old thermometer used the {Roemer} scale.
e.zh: 那支旧温度计使用罗默温标。

e.en: The chemist isolated {roemerine} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出罗默碱。

e.en: Studies suggest {roemerine} may affect certain nerve receptors.
e.zh: 研究表明罗默碱可能影响某些神经受体。

roentgendefectoscopy.t: 射线探伤；X射线缺陷检测

e.en: Engineers used {roentgendefectoscopy} to inspect the welds.
e.zh: 工程师用射线探伤检查焊缝。

e.en: The factory added {roentgendefectoscopy} for hidden metal flaws.
e.zh: 工厂增加了X射线缺陷检测，用来发现隐藏的金属缺陷。

e.en: The technician will {roentgenise} the damaged casting today.
e.zh: 技术员今天会用X射线照射那件受损铸件。

e.en: Doctors decided to {roentgenise} the patient's chest.
e.zh: 医生决定给病人的胸部作X光检查。

roentgenite.t: 伦琴石；含铈磷酸盐矿物

e.en: The rare mineral was later described as {roentgenite}.
e.zh: 这种稀有矿物后来被描述为伦琴石。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {roentgenite} appeared in the pegmatite sample.
e.zh: 伟晶岩样品中出现了细小的伦琴石晶体。

e.en: {Roentgenium} has the atomic number 111.
e.zh: 𬬭的原子序数是111。

e.en: Scientists create {roentgenium} only in particle accelerators.
e.zh: 科学家只能在粒子加速器中制造𬬭。

e.en: The dentist examined the {roentgenogram} before surgery.
e.zh: 牙医在手术前查看了那张X光片。

e.en: A chest {roentgenogram} showed a small shadow.
e.zh: 胸部X射线照片显示有一小片阴影。

e.en: The museum kept an early medical {roentgenograph}.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着一张早期医学X光照片。

e.en: They will {roentgenograph} the joint to check for cracks.
e.zh: 他们会给这个接头拍X光片，以检查裂纹。

e.en: The doctor requested a {roentgenographic} examination of the spine.
e.zh: 医生要求对脊柱进行X射线摄影检查。

e.en: The {roentgenographic} findings confirmed the fracture.
e.zh: X光片结果证实了骨折。

roentgenographically.t: 通过X射线摄影；在X光片上

e.en: The lesion was detected {roentgenographically} before symptoms appeared.
e.zh: 病灶在症状出现前就通过X射线摄影被发现了。

e.en: The fracture healed well {roentgenographically}.
e.zh: 从X光片上看，骨折愈合得很好。

e.en: Modern {roentgenography} made the diagnosis much clearer.
e.zh: 现代X射线摄影术让诊断清楚了许多。

e.en: Industrial {roentgenography} can reveal defects inside metal parts.
e.zh: 工业放射照相能显示金属零件内部的缺陷。

rockoon.t: 火箭气球探测器；气球火箭

e.en: The team launched a {rockoon} to study the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 团队发射了一枚火箭气球来研究高层大气。

e.en: A {rockoon} carries its rocket upward by balloon before ignition.
e.zh: 火箭气球先用气球把火箭带到高空再点火。

e.en: The pink {rockrose} bloomed beside the dry path.
e.zh: 粉色岩蔷薇在干燥小路旁开花。

e.en: Gardeners like {rockrose} because it tolerates poor soil.
e.zh: 园丁喜欢岩蔷薇，因为它耐贫瘠土壤。

e.en: Miners reinforced the {rockshaft} before going deeper underground.
e.zh: 矿工在继续深入地下前加固了岩石竖井。

e.en: Water echoed down the narrow {rockshaft} in the cave.
e.zh: 水声在洞穴狭窄的岩石竖井里回荡。

e.en: A {rockskipper} darted between pools at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，一条岩跳鱼在潮池之间飞快穿梭。

e.en: The {rockskipper} can cling to wet stones near the shore.
e.zh: 岩跳鱼能附着在岸边潮湿的石头上。

e.en: The climber leaned on a carved {rockstaff} during the ascent.
e.zh: 攀登者上山时靠着一根雕刻过的登山杖。

e.en: In the old tale, the hermit carried a heavy {rockstaff}.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，隐士拿着一根沉重的石杖。

e.en: The {rockstar} waved to fans outside the stadium.
e.zh: 那位摇滚明星向体育场外的歌迷挥手。

e.en: Our new designer is a {rockstar} at solving layout problems.
e.zh: 我们的新设计师在解决版面问题上非常出色。

rocksteady.t: 稳如磐石的；牙买加慢摇乐

e.en: Her voice stayed {rocksteady} throughout the tense interview.
e.zh: 在紧张的采访中，她的声音始终稳如磐石。

e.en: The band played old {rocksteady} records after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，乐队播放了老式牙买加慢摇乐唱片。

rockumentary.t: 摇滚纪录片；音乐纪录片

e.en: The {rockumentary} follows the band through its final tour.
e.zh: 这部摇滚纪录片记录了乐队最后一次巡演。

e.en: She watched a {rockumentary} about punk music in London.
e.zh: 她看了一部关于伦敦朋克音乐的摇滚纪录片。

e.en: Thick {rockweed} covered the stones after the tide fell.
e.zh: 退潮后，厚厚的岩藻覆盖着石头。

e.en: Fishermen used dried {rockweed} to pack the fresh shellfish.
e.zh: 渔民用晒干的岩藻来包装新鲜贝类。

e.en: The garden's {rockwork} made the small pond look natural.
e.zh: 花园里的假山石工让小池塘显得很自然。

e.en: Engineers inspected the old {rockwork} along the railway cutting.
e.zh: 工程师检查了铁路路堑旁的旧岩石结构。

e.en: The microscope revealed {rod-shaped} bacteria in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示样本中有杆状细菌。

e.en: They found a {rod-shaped} tool buried near the wall.
e.zh: 他们在墙边发现了一件棒形工具。

e.en: The {rodder} cleared the blocked drain in minutes.
e.zh: 通管工几分钟内就疏通了堵塞的排水管。

e.en: A veteran {rodder} showed us his rebuilt hot rod.
e.zh: 一位资深热杆车爱好者向我们展示了他改装的热杆车。

e.en: The fossil had small, {rodent-like} teeth at the front.
e.zh: 这块化石前部有像啮齿动物一样的小牙齿。

e.en: He heard a quick, {rodent-like} scratching inside the wall.
e.zh: 他听见墙里传来一种像啮齿动物般急促的抓挠声。

e.en: The lab recorded several {rodential} traits in the specimen.
e.zh: 实验室记录了该标本的几项啮齿动物特征。

e.en: Her paper compared {rodential} jaws with those of early mammals.
e.zh: 她的论文比较了啮齿动物的颌部和早期哺乳动物的颌部。

e.en: The skull shows a clearly {rodentian} pattern of teeth.
e.zh: 这个头骨显示出明显的啮齿类牙齿模式。

e.en: The museum keeps several {rodentian} specimens for teaching.
e.zh: 博物馆保存了几件啮齿动物标本用于教学。

e.en: The farmer stored the {rodenticide} away from the feed.
e.zh: 农民把灭鼠剂存放在远离饲料的地方。

e.en: Improper {rodenticide} use can poison pets and wildlife.
e.zh: 灭鼠剂使用不当可能毒害宠物和野生动物。

e.en: The old report mentioned a {roentgenograph} of the chest.
e.zh: 那份旧报告提到一张胸部X光照片。

e.en: A clear {roentgenograph} helped locate the fracture.
e.zh: 清晰的射线照片帮助确定了骨折位置。

e.en: The patient needed a {roentgenological} examination after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后，病人需要接受放射学检查。

e.en: The paper compared several {roentgenological} signs of lung disease.
e.zh: 论文比较了几种肺病的X线征象。

roentgenologically.t: 从放射学角度；经X线检查

e.en: The tumor was {roentgenologically} visible before surgery.
e.zh: 手术前，这个肿瘤在X线检查中已经可见。

e.en: The fracture healed {roentgenologically} before the pain disappeared.
e.zh: 从放射学角度看，骨折在疼痛消失前已经愈合。

e.en: She studied {roentgenology} at a medical institute.
e.zh: 她在一所医学院学习放射学。

e.en: Early {roentgenology} changed how doctors examined bones.
e.zh: 早期X线学改变了医生检查骨骼的方式。

e.en: The dentist noticed a {roentgenolucent} area near the root.
e.zh: 牙医注意到牙根附近有一个X线透亮区。

e.en: Air appears {roentgenolucent} on many medical images.
e.zh: 在许多医学影像上，空气呈现为射线可透。

e.en: The crystal showed {roentgenoluminescence} under X-ray exposure.
e.zh: 这种晶体在X射线照射下出现伦琴发光。

e.en: Researchers measured {roentgenoluminescence} in the new material.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种新材料的X射线致发光。

roentgenomateriology.t: X线材料学；射线材料研究

e.en: The laboratory specialized in {roentgenomateriology} for industrial testing.
e.zh: 该实验室专门从事工业检测中的X线材料学研究。

e.en: Advances in {roentgenomateriology} improved the analysis of metals.
e.zh: X线材料学的进展改进了金属分析。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {roentgenometer} before the scan.
e.zh: 技师在扫描前校准了X射线剂量计。

e.en: An old {roentgenometer} was displayed in the hospital museum.
e.zh: 医院博物馆里展出了一台旧式伦琴计。

e.en: The study used {roentgenometry} to estimate bone density.
e.zh: 这项研究用X射线测量来估算骨密度。

e.en: Early {roentgenometry} required careful control of exposure.
e.zh: 早期伦琴测定法需要严格控制照射量。

e.en: The swallowed coin looked {roentgenopaque} on the film.
e.zh: 吞下的硬币在片子上显得X线不透。

e.en: Doctors injected a {roentgenopaque} dye before the procedure.
e.zh: 医生在操作前注入了一种显影染料。

e.en: The plastic marker was {roentgenoparent} and hard to see.
e.zh: 这个塑料标记物X线透明，很难看见。

e.en: A {roentgenoparent} object may disappear on a standard radiograph.
e.zh: 射线可透的物体可能在普通X光片上看不出来。

roentgenoscope.t: X线透视镜；荧光屏检查器

e.en: The doctor used a {roentgenoscope} to view the moving joint.
e.zh: 医生用X线透视镜观察活动中的关节。

e.en: A historical {roentgenoscope} stood beside the exhibit case.
e.zh: 一台历史悠久的荧光屏检查器放在展柜旁。

e.en: The surgeon requested {roentgenoscopy} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生要求在手术过程中进行X线透视检查。

e.en: Early {roentgenoscopy} exposed patients to high radiation doses.
e.zh: 早期荧光透视会让病人受到较高剂量的辐射。

e.en: Some skin conditions were once treated with {roentgenotherapy}.
e.zh: 有些皮肤病过去曾用X线治疗。

e.en: Modern radiation oncology replaced much early {roentgenotherapy}.
e.zh: 现代放射肿瘤学取代了许多早期放射治疗做法。

roesti.t: 瑞士土豆饼；煎土豆丝饼

e.en: We ordered {roesti} with eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 我们早餐点了配鸡蛋的瑞士土豆饼。

e.en: The {roesti} was crisp outside and soft inside.
e.zh: 那份煎土豆丝饼外脆里软。

roestone.t: 鱼卵石；含鱼卵状颗粒的石灰岩

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {roestone}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为鱼卵石。

e.en: Layers of {roestone} appeared along the old quarry wall.
e.zh: 旧采石场的岩壁上出现了多层含鱼卵状颗粒的石灰岩。

e.en: The carpenter had to {roff} the surface before polishing it.
e.zh: 木匠在抛光前必须先把表面粗磨。

e.en: Do not {roff} the children when they make mistakes.
e.zh: 孩子犯错时，不要粗鲁地对待他们。

rogascope.t: 煤气检测镜；气体观察仪

e.en: The engineer checked the pipe with a {rogascope}.
e.zh: 工程师用煤气检测镜检查了管道。

e.en: A damaged {rogascope} made the inspection less reliable.
e.zh: 损坏的气体观察仪使检查不太可靠。

e.en: The village held a {rogation} before planting season.
e.zh: 村里在播种季前举行了祈求仪式。

e.en: Medieval records describe a long {rogation} through the fields.
e.zh: 中世纪记录描述了一场穿过田野的长长祈祷游行。

e.en: The court issued a {rogatory} letter to obtain evidence abroad.
e.zh: 法院发出司法委托书，以便在国外取得证据。

e.en: His tone was {rogatory} rather than commanding.
e.zh: 他的语气是在请求，而不是命令。

e.en: His smile suggested harmless {roguery}.
e.zh: 他的笑容透出一种无伤大雅的恶作剧意味。

e.en: The report exposed years of financial {roguery}.
e.zh: 报告揭露了多年的金融无赖行径。

e.en: The novel treats his {rogueship} with comic affection.
e.zh: 小说以喜剧式的亲切笔触描写他的无赖气派。

e.en: He wore his {rogueship} like a badge of honor.
e.zh: 他把自己的无赖身份当成荣誉徽章一样展示。

roid.t: 类固醇；像类固醇的东西

e.en: Some athletes abused {roids} to build muscle quickly.
e.zh: 一些运动员滥用类固醇来快速增肌。

e.en: The forum joked that the bug was a feature on {roids}.
e.zh: 论坛上有人开玩笑说这个漏洞像是强化版功能。

e.en: The {roisterous} crowd spilled out of the pub.
e.zh: 喧闹作乐的人群从酒吧里涌了出来。

e.en: His {roisterous} laugh filled the whole room.
e.zh: 他放纵的大笑声充满了整个房间。

e.en: They sang {roisterously} until midnight.
e.zh: 他们喧闹地唱歌一直唱到午夜。

e.en: The actors bowed {roisterously} after the comedy ended.
e.zh: 喜剧结束后，演员们热闹夸张地鞠躬致意。

e.en: We shared a plate of {rojak} at the market.
e.zh: 我们在市场里分吃了一盘罗惹。

e.en: The proposal was a {rojak} of old ideas.
e.zh: 那份提案只是旧想法拼凑成的大杂烩。

e.en: A cold {roke} hung over the fields.
e.zh: 一层寒冷的薄雾笼罩着田野。

e.en: The valley disappeared in morning {roke}.
e.zh: 山谷消失在清晨的雾气之中。

e.en: The engineer chose a {rolamite} for the sensor mount.
e.zh: 工程师为传感器支架选用了罗拉米特机构。

e.en: A {rolamite} can reduce friction in a compact device.
e.zh: 罗拉米特机构能减少小型装置中的摩擦。

e.en: The surveyor pushed a {rolandometer} along the road.
e.zh: 测量员沿着道路推动滚轮式测距仪。

e.en: A {rolandometer} measured the distance more quickly than a tape.
e.zh: 滚轮式测距仪比卷尺更快测出距离。

e.en: Her teacher became a {role-model} for many students.
e.zh: 她的老师成了许多学生效仿的榜样。

e.en: Parents are often a child's first {role-model}.
e.zh: 父母往往是孩子最早的榜样。

e.en: The class used {role-play} to practice interviews.
e.zh: 课堂用角色扮演来练习面试。

e.en: Therapists sometimes use {role-play} in counseling sessions.
e.zh: 治疗师有时会在咨询中使用模拟演练。

e.en: The children enjoyed {role-playing} as doctors and nurses.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢扮演医生和护士。

e.en: Online {role-playing} games can build long stories.
e.zh: 在线角色扮演游戏可以发展出很长的故事。

role-relationships.t: 角色关系；身份互动关系

e.en: The study examined {role-relationships} within the hospital team.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了医院团队内部的角色关系。

e.en: Clear {role-relationships} help a project avoid confusion.
e.zh: 清晰的角色关系有助于项目避免混乱。

e.en: They used {roleplay} to prepare for difficult conversations.
e.zh: 他们用角色扮演来准备艰难的谈话。

e.en: Fantasy {roleplay} lets players create imaginary lives.
e.zh: 奇幻角色扮演让玩家创造想象中的人生。

rolfer.t: 罗尔夫疗法师；筋膜整合治疗师

e.en: She visited a {rolfer} for chronic shoulder pain.
e.zh: 她因长期肩痛去看了一位罗尔夫疗法师。

e.en: A certified {rolfer} focuses on posture and connective tissue.
e.zh: 认证罗尔夫疗法师关注姿势和结缔组织。

e.en: The teacher took {roll-call} before the trip began.
e.zh: 出发前老师进行了点名。

e.en: The senator missed the evening {roll-call} vote.
e.zh: 那位参议员错过了晚间的唱名投票。

e.en: Morning {roll-calls} were strict at the camp.
e.zh: 营地早上的点名很严格。

e.en: Several {roll-calls} delayed the final vote.
e.zh: 几次唱名表决拖延了最终投票。

roll-crusher.t: 辊式破碎机；滚压破碎机

e.en: The quarry installed a new {roll-crusher} for softer stone.
e.zh: 采石场为较软的石料安装了一台新的辊式破碎机。

e.en: A {roll-crusher} breaks material between two rotating cylinders.
e.zh: 辊式破碎机通过两个旋转圆筒之间的挤压来破碎物料。

rocket-powered.t: 火箭驱动的；火箭动力的

e.en: The team tested a {rocket-powered} car on the salt flats.
e.zh: 团队在盐滩上测试了一辆火箭驱动的汽车。

e.en: A {rocket-powered} escape system can pull the capsule away quickly.
e.zh: 火箭动力逃生系统能迅速把太空舱拉离危险。

e.en: The soldiers carried {rocket-propelled} grenades across the ridge.
e.zh: 士兵们带着火箭推进榴弹越过山脊。

e.en: A {rocket-propelled} probe reached the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 一个火箭推进的探测器到达了高层大气。

e.en: The children called the stunt pilot a {rocketman}.
e.zh: 孩子们把那位特技飞行员叫作火箭人。

e.en: In the old comic, the {rocketman} saved the city.
e.zh: 在那本老漫画里，火箭人拯救了城市。

e.en: The station launched a {rocketsonde} before dawn.
e.zh: 观测站在黎明前发射了一枚火箭探空仪。

e.en: Data from the {rocketsonde} showed strong upper winds.
e.zh: 火箭探空仪的数据表明高空风很强。

e.en: Thousands camped near the field for the weekend {rockfest}.
e.zh: 数千人在场地附近露营，参加周末的摇滚音乐节。

e.en: The small town turns into a noisy {rockfest} every summer.
e.zh: 这个小镇每年夏天都会变成喧闹的摇滚音乐节现场。

e.en: Engineers used {rockfill} to strengthen the dam.
e.zh: 工程师使用堆石填料来加固大坝。

e.en: The slope was stabilized with layers of {rockfill}.
e.zh: 坡面用一层层堆石填料稳定下来。

e.en: The ground was {rockhard} after weeks without rain.
e.zh: 连续几周无雨后，地面硬得像石头。

e.en: She served bread that had gone {rockhard}.
e.zh: 她端上的面包已经硬得像石头了。

e.en: They spent the weekend {rockhounding} in the desert.
e.zh: 他们周末在沙漠里采集岩石矿物。

e.en: Her interest in {rockhounding} began with a shiny quartz crystal.
e.zh: 她对采集岩石矿物的兴趣始于一块发亮的石英晶体。

e.en: This is the {rockiest} part of the coastline.
e.zh: 这是这段海岸线上岩石最多的部分。

e.en: The first year was the {rockiest} period for the company.
e.zh: 第一年是公司最不稳定的时期。

e.en: The boat moved {rockily} through the rough water.
e.zh: 小船在汹涌的水面上摇摇晃晃地前进。

e.en: The talks began {rockily} but improved after lunch.
e.zh: 会谈一开始并不顺利，但午饭后有所改善。

e.en: The {rockiness} of the path slowed the hikers.
e.zh: 小路多岩石，拖慢了徒步者的速度。

e.en: The {rockiness} of their relationship worried their friends.
e.zh: 他们关系的不稳定让朋友们担心。

e.en: The child climbed onto the wooden {rocking-horse}.
e.zh: 孩子爬上了那匹木制摇木马。

e.en: An old {rocking-horse} stood beside the nursery window.
e.zh: 一匹旧摇木马放在儿童房窗边。

e.en: The skier practiced a {rocking-turn} on the gentle slope.
e.zh: 滑雪者在缓坡上练习摇摆转弯动作。

e.en: A smooth {rocking-turn} helps beginners control speed.
e.zh: 平稳的摇摆转弯有助于初学者控制速度。

e.en: The critic rejected {rockism} in modern music writing.
e.zh: 这位评论家反对现代音乐写作中的摇滚至上观念。

e.en: Arguments about {rockism} often ignore pop's own artistry.
e.zh: 关于摇滚至上观念的争论常常忽视流行音乐自身的艺术性。

e.en: The builder fastened {rocklath} before applying plaster.
e.zh: 建筑工人在抹灰前先固定石膏板条。

e.en: Old walls made with {rocklath} can crack near the seams.
e.zh: 用石膏板条做的旧墙可能会在接缝附近开裂。

e.en: We chose a {rockless} beach for swimming.
e.zh: 我们选择了一片没有岩石的海滩游泳。

e.en: The farmer preferred the {rockless} field for planting.
e.zh: 农民更喜欢在没有石头的田地里播种。

e.en: A dark {rocklet} rose above the shallow water.
e.zh: 一小块黑色礁石露出浅水面。

e.en: The geologist picked up a smooth {rocklet} from the stream.
e.zh: 地质学家从溪流里捡起一块光滑的小岩块。

e.en: The clay dried into a {rocklike} mass.
e.zh: 黏土干后变成了像岩石一样的硬块。

e.en: He showed a {rocklike} calm during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中他表现出岩石般的镇定。

e.en: The fisherman identified the small fish as a {rockling}.
e.zh: 渔夫认出这条小鱼是一种小鳕科鱼。

e.en: A {rockling} often hides among stones near the shore.
e.zh: 小鳕科鱼常躲在近岸的石块之间。

e.en: The old {rockman} knew every quarry in the valley.
e.zh: 那位老采石工熟悉山谷里的每一处采石场。

e.en: A skilled {rockman} can read cracks in the cliff.
e.zh: 熟练的岩石工人能看懂峭壁上的裂缝。

e.en: The chemist isolated {rockogenin} from a plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出了洛柯皂苷元。

e.en: Studies of {rockogenin} focus on its steroid structure.
e.zh: 关于洛柯皂苷元的研究集中在其甾体结构上。

e.en: The {romancist} compared medieval French and Occitan texts.
e.zh: 那位罗曼语学者比较了中古法语和奥克语文本。

e.en: As a careful {romancist}, she traced each sound change.
e.zh: 作为严谨的罗曼语研究者，她追踪了每一次音变。

e.en: The dictionary gives the {romanization} beside each Chinese character.
e.zh: 这本词典在每个汉字旁边给出罗马字母转写。

e.en: Different systems of {romanization} can spell the same name differently.
e.zh: 不同的罗马化系统可能把同一个名字拼写得不一样。

e.en: The sign showed the street name in {romanized} Korean.
e.zh: 路牌用罗马字母转写的韩语标出了街名。

e.en: She {romanized} the Japanese title for foreign readers.
e.zh: 她为外国读者把日文标题转写成罗马字母。

e.en: A good {romanizer} handles tones and apostrophes consistently.
e.zh: 好的罗马化工具会一致处理声调和撇号。

e.en: The {romanizer} revised several spellings in the glossary.
e.zh: 那位转写者修改了术语表中的几个拼写。

e.en: The software {romanizes} Cyrillic names automatically.
e.zh: 这款软件会自动把西里尔字母姓名转写成罗马字母。

e.en: She {romanizes} each place name before entering it into the database.
e.zh: 她先把每个地名罗马化，再录入数据库。

e.en: He is {romanizing} the old manuscript for an online archive.
e.zh: 他正在为线上档案把那份旧手稿罗马化转写。

e.en: {Romanizing} Chinese requires choosing a consistent system.
e.zh: 将中文罗马化需要选择一套一致的系统。

e.en: She learned {Romansh} while living in eastern Switzerland.
e.zh: 她住在瑞士东部时学会了罗曼什语。

e.en: The notice was printed in German, Italian, and {Romansh}.
e.zh: 通知用德语、意大利语和罗曼什语印制。

e.en: The poet preferred a {romantical} vision of the past.
e.zh: 这位诗人更喜欢对过去作浪漫化的想象。

e.en: His story had a {romantical} tone, full of knights and vows.
e.zh: 他的故事带有传奇色彩，充满骑士和誓言。

e.en: The painting shows a {romanticistic} taste for ruins and storms.
e.zh: 这幅画体现出偏爱废墟和风暴的浪漫主义趣味。

e.en: Her early poems were criticized as overly {romanticistic}.
e.zh: 她早期的诗被批评为过于浪漫主义化。

e.en: The essay links {romantism} with nationalist feeling in music.
e.zh: 这篇文章把音乐中的浪漫主义与民族情感联系起来。

e.en: There is a faded {romantism} in his letters from youth.
e.zh: 他年轻时的信里有一种淡去的浪漫情调。

e.en: The soprano sang a gentle {romanza} in the second act.
e.zh: 女高音在第二幕唱了一首柔和的浪漫曲。

e.en: He played the {romanza} slowly, with a warm tone.
e.zh: 他用温暖的音色缓慢演奏了那段抒情乐章。

e.en: The kitchen filled with a {romatic} smell of herbs.
e.zh: 厨房里充满了草本植物的芳香气味。

e.en: She chose a {romatic} oil for the evening bath.
e.zh: 她为晚上的沐浴选了一种芳香精油。

e.en: The old {romaunt} tells of a knight lost at sea.
e.zh: 那则古体传奇讲述了一名骑士在海上失踪的故事。

e.en: He read a medieval {romaunt} aloud by the fire.
e.zh: 他在火炉旁朗读了一篇中世纪传奇故事。

e.en: The children grew {rompish} after too much cake.
e.zh: 孩子们吃了太多蛋糕后变得嬉闹顽皮。

e.en: Her {rompish} humor made the formal dinner less stiff.
e.zh: 她顽皮的幽默让正式晚宴不那么拘谨。

e.en: Their {rompy} puppy knocked over the laundry basket.
e.zh: 他们那只爱嬉闹的小狗撞翻了洗衣篮。

e.en: The play has a {rompy} energy in its first scene.
e.zh: 这出戏第一场有一种活泼顽皮的劲头。

e.en: A {roll-cumulus} cloud stretched across the morning sky.
e.zh: 一条卷积云横贯清晨的天空。

e.en: Pilots watched the {roll-cumulus} forming ahead of the storm.
e.zh: 飞行员看着暴风雨前方形成的滚轴状积云。

e.en: She wore a black {roll-neck} under her jacket.
e.zh: 她在夹克里面穿了一件黑色高翻领毛衣。

e.en: The coat has a soft {roll-neck} for extra warmth.
e.zh: 这件外套有柔软的翻高领，更加保暖。

e.en: He appeared in a {roll-necked} sweater and dark jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一件高翻领毛衣和深色牛仔裤露面。

e.en: The {roll-necked} design keeps the wind off your throat.
e.zh: 这种高翻领设计能挡住吹向脖子的风。

e.en: She packed a small {roll-on} deodorant for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这次旅行带了一小瓶滚珠除臭剂。

e.en: Use the {roll-on} treatment directly on sore muscles.
e.zh: 把这种滚涂式药剂直接涂在酸痛的肌肉上。

e.en: The company delayed the {roll-out} of its new app.
e.zh: 公司推迟了新应用的发布。

e.en: The policy {roll-out} will begin in three cities.
e.zh: 这项政策的实施将从三个城市开始。

e.en: The car suffered a {roll-over} on the icy road.
e.zh: 那辆车在结冰的路上发生了翻车。

e.en: Ask the bank about a pension {roll-over}.
e.zh: 向银行咨询养老金账户结转事宜。

e.en: He carried a {roll-up} sleeping mat on his backpack.
e.zh: 他背包上挂着一张可卷起的睡垫。

e.en: The manager reviewed the weekly sales {roll-up}.
e.zh: 经理查看了每周销售汇总。

e.en: He prefers {roll-your-own} cigarettes to factory-made ones.
e.zh: 比起工厂生产的香烟，他更喜欢自己卷的烟。

e.en: The team built a {roll-your-own} tool for tracking bugs.
e.zh: 团队自制了一个工具来跟踪漏洞。

e.en: Engineers tested the {rollability} of the new tire material.
e.zh: 工程师测试了新轮胎材料的可滚动性。

e.en: The fabric's {rollability} makes it easy to pack.
e.zh: 这种面料容易卷起来，便于打包。

e.en: The map is printed on {rollable} plastic.
e.zh: 这张地图印在可卷起的塑料材料上。

e.en: Choose a {rollable} screen if storage space is limited.
e.zh: 如果储物空间有限，就选可卷起的屏幕。

e.en: The hotel provided a {rollaway} bed for the child.
e.zh: 酒店为孩子提供了一张可折叠推走的床。

e.en: We stored the {rollaway} table in the closet.
e.zh: 我们把可推走的折叠桌收进了壁橱。

e.en: The teacher began {rollcall} before the first lesson.
e.zh: 第一节课前，老师开始点名。

e.en: Several members were absent during the {rollcall} vote.
e.zh: 点名表决时有几名成员缺席。

e.en: He slept on a {rolled-up} blanket by the fire.
e.zh: 他靠着火堆，枕着卷起来的毯子睡觉。

e.en: The report shows {rolled-up} costs for all departments.
e.zh: 这份报告显示了所有部门的累计成本。

e.en: She pulled down the {roller-blind} to block the sun.
e.zh: 她拉下卷帘挡住阳光。

e.en: A white {roller-blind} gave the room a cleaner look.
e.zh: 一幅白色卷轴窗帘让房间显得更清爽。

e.en: The new {roller-coaster} drops almost straight down.
e.zh: 新的过山车几乎是垂直俯冲下去。

e.en: Their relationship was an emotional {roller-coaster}.
e.zh: 他们的关系像情绪过山车一样大起大落。

roller-coasters.t: 过山车；大起大落的经历

e.en: The park has three huge {roller-coasters}.
e.zh: 这座公园有三座大型过山车。

e.en: Financial markets can feel like {roller-coasters}.
e.zh: 金融市场有时会让人觉得像坐过山车。

e.en: Each {roller-skate} had bright red wheels.
e.zh: 每只四轮旱冰鞋都有鲜红的轮子。

e.en: Children {roller-skate} around the empty playground.
e.zh: 孩子们在空荡的操场上滑旱冰。

roller-skated.t: 滑过旱冰；穿旱冰鞋滑行

e.en: We {roller-skated} along the beach path at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，我们沿着海边小路滑旱冰。

e.en: She {roller-skated} carefully across the smooth floor.
e.zh: 她小心地穿着旱冰鞋滑过光滑的地面。

e.en: His old {roller-skates} still fit perfectly.
e.zh: 他的旧四轮旱冰鞋仍然非常合脚。

e.en: She {roller-skates} every weekend in the park.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在公园里滑旱冰。

e.en: They went {roller-skating} after school on Friday.
e.zh: 星期五放学后，他们去滑旱冰。

e.en: Indoor {roller-skating} is popular during winter.
e.zh: 冬天室内四轮溜冰很受欢迎。

e.en: The old washroom still had a cloth {roller-towel}.
e.zh: 那间旧洗手间里仍有一条布制滚筒毛巾。

e.en: A shared {roller-towel} is no longer considered hygienic.
e.zh: 共用循环手巾现在已被认为不卫生。

e.en: She signed the form with a blue {rollerball}.
e.zh: 她用一支蓝色走珠笔签了表格。

e.en: This {rollerball} perfume fits easily in a handbag.
e.zh: 这款滚珠式香水很容易放进手提包。

e.en: He bought a new {rollerblade} after breaking the old one.
e.zh: 旧的直排轮滑鞋坏了以后，他买了一只新的。

e.en: They {rollerblade} along the riverside every Sunday.
e.zh: 他们每个星期天都沿着河边滑直排轮。

e.en: The town's old {rollerdrome} reopened after repairs.
e.zh: 镇上的老轮滑场修缮后重新开放。

e.en: Teenagers met at the {rollerdrome} on Saturday nights.
e.zh: 青少年们周六晚上在旱冰场见面。

e.en: The family slept in a {rondavel} near the cattle kraal.
e.zh: 这家人睡在牛栏附近的一间非洲圆形茅屋里。

e.en: Tourists can book a stone {rondavel} inside the reserve.
e.zh: 游客可以在保护区里预订一间石砌圆形茅屋。

e.en: She wrote a {rondeau} for the poetry contest.
e.zh: 她为诗歌比赛写了一首回旋诗。

e.en: The pianist ended the recital with a lively {rondeau}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以一首轻快的回旋曲结束了独奏会。

e.en: The anthology includes several medieval {rondeaux}.
e.zh: 这本文集中收录了几首中世纪回旋诗。

e.en: His early piano {rondeaux} sound playful and bright.
e.zh: 他早期的几首钢琴回旋曲听起来活泼明亮。

e.en: The poet revised the {rondel} until every refrain felt natural.
e.zh: 诗人反复修改那首回旋诗，直到每段叠句都显得自然。

e.en: A {rondel} often depends on repeated lines for its music.
e.zh: 回旋诗常靠重复诗句形成韵律感。

e.en: Her {rondelet} used only a few repeated lines.
e.zh: 她那首短小回旋诗只用了几句重复诗行。

e.en: The class studied a French {rondelet} from the fifteenth century.
e.zh: 课堂研究了一首十五世纪的法语短回旋诗。

e.en: The chef placed a carrot {rondelle} on each spoon.
e.zh: 厨师在每只勺子上放了一片胡萝卜圆片。

e.en: A metal {rondelle} separated the two moving parts.
e.zh: 一个金属小圆盘隔开了两个活动部件。

e.en: The quartet played a cheerful {rondino} after the interval.
e.zh: 中场休息后，四重奏演奏了一首欢快的小回旋曲。

e.en: Mozart's {rondino} is often used in student concerts.
e.zh: 莫扎特的这首小回旋曲常用于学生音乐会。

e.en: The composer called the final movement a {rondoletto}.
e.zh: 作曲家把最后一个乐章称为短小回旋曲。

e.en: A light {rondoletto} closed the evening program.
e.zh: 一首轻快的短回旋曲结束了晚间节目。

e.en: The sculptor admired the {rondure} of the marble shoulder.
e.zh: 雕塑家欣赏大理石肩部的圆润弧度。

e.en: Old poets used {rondure} to suggest fullness and grace.
e.zh: 旧时诗人用rondure一词表达饱满与优雅。

e.en: The old glossary defined {rone} as a kind of deer.
e.zh: 那本旧词汇表把rone解释为一种鹿。

e.en: A {rone} pattern marked the worn leather cover.
e.zh: 磨旧的皮面上带着类似鹿皮的斑纹。

e.en: The dyer used {rongalite} to discharge color from the cloth.
e.zh: 染工用雕白粉去除布料上的颜色。

e.en: Handle {rongalite} carefully in a ventilated workspace.
e.zh: 在通风的工作区要小心处理雕白粉。

e.en: The surgeon removed small bone fragments with a {rongeur}.
e.zh: 外科医生用咬骨钳取出了小块骨片。

e.en: A dull {rongeur} can damage tissue during the procedure.
e.zh: 钝了的咬骨钳可能在手术过程中损伤组织。

e.en: The film follows a {ronin} seeking work after his lord dies.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一名浪人在主君死后寻找差事。

e.en: In tech slang, he called himself a {ronin} consultant.
e.zh: 按科技圈的说法，他自称是独来独往的顾问浪人。

e.en: The farm once used {ronnel} to control parasites in livestock.
e.zh: 这家农场曾用ronnel这种杀虫剂控制牲畜寄生虫。

e.en: Regulators restricted {ronnel} because of safety concerns.
e.zh: 由于安全方面的担忧，监管机构限制了ronnel的使用。

e.en: Children {rollerskate} around the park after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后在公园里穿旱冰鞋滑行。

e.en: She bought a new {rollerskate} for practice.
e.zh: 她买了一只新的旱冰鞋来练习。

e.en: We {rollerskated} along the beach path.
e.zh: 我们沿着海边小路穿旱冰鞋滑行。

e.en: He had {rollerskated} only once before.
e.zh: 他以前只滑过一次旱冰。

e.en: A skilled {rollerskater} spun in the rink.
e.zh: 一名熟练的轮滑者在溜冰场里旋转。

e.en: The {rollerskater} wore pads on both knees.
e.zh: 那个滑旱冰的人两只膝盖都戴着护具。

rollformer.t: 辊压成型机；滚压成型工

e.en: The factory installed a new {rollformer} for steel panels.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台新的辊压成型机来加工钢板。

e.en: A trained {rollformer} adjusted the machine settings.
e.zh: 一名受过培训的滚压成型工调整了机器设置。

e.en: The children {rollick} through the yard in summer.
e.zh: 夏天孩子们在院子里欢快地嬉闹。

e.en: The band made the crowd {rollick} all night.
e.zh: 乐队让人群整晚都欢腾起来。

e.en: They {rollicked} in the snow until dusk.
e.zh: 他们在雪地里嬉闹到黄昏。

e.en: The guests {rollicked} through old drinking songs.
e.zh: 宾客们唱着老酒歌，热闹地欢腾起来。

e.en: He {rollicks} with his cousins every holiday.
e.zh: 每个假期他都和表亲们嬉闹玩耍。

e.en: The comedy {rollicks} from one absurd scene to another.
e.zh: 这部喜剧从一个荒唐场景欢快地跳到另一个。

e.en: The tavern had a {rollicksome} crowd by midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时酒馆里聚着一群欢闹的人。

e.en: Her {rollicksome} story kept everyone laughing.
e.zh: 她那段兴高采烈的故事让大家一直笑个不停。

e.en: The {rolling-mill} shaped hot metal into sheets.
e.zh: 轧机把炽热的金属压成薄板。

e.en: My grandfather worked in a {rolling-mill}.
e.zh: 我祖父曾在一家轧钢厂工作。

e.en: She flattened the dough with a {rolling-pin}.
e.zh: 她用擀面杖把面团擀平。

e.en: The old wooden {rolling-pin} belonged to my grandmother.
e.zh: 那根旧木擀面杖是我祖母留下的。

e.en: The {rollman} checked the steel strip for defects.
e.zh: 轧机工检查钢带有没有缺陷。

e.en: A senior {rollman} trained new workers on the line.
e.zh: 一名资深卷材工人在生产线上培训新员工。

e.en: He served a {rollmop} with dark bread.
e.zh: 他把腌鲱鱼卷配黑面包端上来。

e.en: The sharp vinegar in the {rollmop} surprised me.
e.zh: 腌鲱鱼卷里的酸醋味让我有些意外。

e.en: The deli sells jars of {rollmops}.
e.zh: 那家熟食店出售罐装腌鲱鱼卷。

e.en: We ate {rollmops} as a cold appetizer.
e.zh: 我们把腌鲱鱼卷当冷盘开胃菜吃。

e.en: The oar slipped from the {rollock} during the race.
e.zh: 比赛中船桨从桨架上滑了出来。

e.en: He replaced a cracked {rollock} on the small boat.
e.zh: 他换掉了小船上裂开的桨叉。

e.en: The truck delivered a {rolloff} dumpster to the site.
e.zh: 卡车把一个滚卸式垃圾箱送到工地。

e.en: The speaker has a gentle high-frequency {rolloff}.
e.zh: 这只音箱的高频衰减比较平缓。

rollpast.t: 车队列队驶过；驶过展示

e.en: The veterans watched the parade {rollpast} in silence.
e.zh: 老兵们静静看着游行队伍列队驶过。

e.en: A {rollpast} of vintage cars filled the avenue.
e.zh: 老爷车的驶过展示占满了整条大道。

e.en: She packed a canvas {rollup} for the tools.
e.zh: 她装好一个帆布卷包来放工具。

e.en: The weekly {rollup} summarized every team's progress.
e.zh: 每周汇总概括了各团队的进展。

e.en: Logs moved down the {rollway} toward the river.
e.zh: 原木沿着滑木道滚向河边。

e.en: The bearing failed because the {rollway} was worn.
e.zh: 轴承失效是因为滚道已经磨损。

e.en: The puppy was too {rolly} to sit still.
e.zh: 小狗圆滚滚的，根本坐不住。

e.en: Keep the {rolly} balls away from the stairs.
e.zh: 把那些容易滚动的球放远离楼梯。

roly-poly.t: 圆胖的；圆滚滚的人或物

e.en: A {roly-poly} baby crawled across the blanket.
e.zh: 一个圆胖的宝宝爬过毯子。

e.en: The children laughed at the {roly-poly} toy.
e.zh: 孩子们看着那个圆滚滚的玩具笑了起来。

e.en: They learned the {romaika} at a village festival.
e.zh: 他们在乡村节庆上学了这种希腊民间舞。

e.en: The musicians played faster as the {romaika} began.
e.zh: 罗迈卡舞开始时，乐手们越奏越快。

e.en: The title was printed in {romain}, not italics.
e.zh: 标题用的是罗马正体字，而不是斜体。

e.en: The old printer kept a case of {romain} type.
e.zh: 那位老印刷工保留着一盒罗马字体铅字。

e.en: Write your name in {romaji} on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上用日语罗马字写你的名字。

e.en: Beginners often read Japanese through {romaji} first.
e.zh: 初学者常常先借助日语罗马字来读日语。

e.en: The old report measured exposure in {rontgens}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告用伦琴来计量照射量。

e.en: Few modern technicians still use the {rontgen}.
e.zh: 如今很少有技术人员还使用伦琴这个单位。

e.en: We strapped the skis to the {roof-rack}.
e.zh: 我们把滑雪板绑在车顶行李架上。

e.en: The van needs a stronger {roof-rack} for ladders.
e.zh: 这辆货车需要更结实的车顶架来放梯子。

e.en: The electrician checked the cables in the {roof-space}.
e.zh: 电工检查了屋顶下空间里的电缆。

e.en: They converted the {roof-space} into a small studio.
e.zh: 他们把阁楼空间改成了一间小工作室。

e.en: A {roof-spotter} watched for fires after the lightning storm.
e.zh: 雷暴过后，一名屋顶观察员留意是否起火。

e.en: The film crew used a {roof-spotter} to guide the camera drone.
e.zh: 摄制组安排屋顶观察员引导摄影无人机。

e.en: One {roof-tile} slipped during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中有一块屋瓦滑落了。

e.en: The builder matched each new {roof-tile} to the old clay ones.
e.zh: 建筑工把每块新瓦都配成旧陶瓦的样式。

e.en: The old cottage still had its original {roof-tree}.
e.zh: 那间老屋仍保留着原来的屋脊梁。

e.en: After years abroad, he returned to his father's {roof-tree}.
e.zh: 在海外多年后，他回到了父亲的家宅。

e.en: The estimate included timber, tiles, and {roofage}.
e.zh: 估价中包括木料、瓦片和屋顶材料。

e.en: The tax was calculated by the amount of {roofage}.
e.zh: 这项税按屋顶面积来计算。

e.en: The {roofie} repaired the leak before lunch.
e.zh: 那名屋顶工在午饭前修好了漏水处。

e.en: She posted a {roofie} from the hotel terrace.
e.zh: 她发了一张在酒店露台拍的屋顶自拍。

e.en: The bartender warned tourists about drinks spiked with {roofies}.
e.zh: 酒保提醒游客小心被下了迷奸药的饮料。

e.en: Two {roofies} arrived to replace the broken tiles.
e.zh: 两名屋顶工来更换破损的瓦片。

e.en: A tiny {rooflet} sheltered the garden gate.
e.zh: 一个小顶盖遮住了花园门。

e.en: The model church had a red {rooflet} above the porch.
e.zh: 教堂模型的门廊上方有个红色小屋顶。

e.en: The apartment overlooked a dense urban {roofscape}.
e.zh: 这套公寓俯瞰着密集的城市屋顶景观。

e.en: Solar panels have changed the village {roofscape}.
e.zh: 太阳能板改变了村庄的屋顶轮廓。

e.en: The hotel invested in {roofscaping} to cool the top floor.
e.zh: 酒店投入屋顶绿化，以降低顶层温度。

e.en: Good {roofscaping} can turn a flat roof into useful space.
e.zh: 好的屋顶景观设计能把平屋顶变成可用空间。

e.en: Smoke curled above the ancient {rooftree}.
e.zh: 炊烟在古老的屋脊梁上方袅袅升起。

e.en: She longed to sit again beneath her own {rooftree}.
e.zh: 她渴望再次坐在自己的家宅之下。

e.en: I ordered {rooibos} because it has no caffeine.
e.zh: 我点了路易波士茶，因为它不含咖啡因。

e.en: The dessert was flavored with honey and {rooibos}.
e.zh: 这道甜点用了蜂蜜和南非红茶调味。

e.en: He used {rooinek} as an insult in the old war story.
e.zh: 他在那个旧战争故事里把rooinek当作侮辱词。

e.en: The novel explains why {rooinek} sounded bitter to Afrikaners.
e.zh: 小说解释了为什么rooinek在阿非利卡人听来带着怨气。

e.en: A fallen {rooklet} chirped under the elm tree.
e.zh: 一只掉落的小白嘴鸦在榆树下啾啾叫。

e.en: The keeper fed the injured {rooklet} with a dropper.
e.zh: 看护人用滴管喂那只受伤的幼鸦。

e.en: The {rooky} wood was noisy at sunset.
e.zh: 那片白嘴鸦成群的树林在日落时很吵。

e.en: A {rooky} cry echoed over the churchyard.
e.zh: 一声像鸦叫的声音在教堂墓地上空回荡。

e.en: Please leave your {room-key} at reception.
e.zh: 请把房间钥匙留在前台。

e.en: My {room-key} stopped working after breakfast.
e.zh: 早餐后我的房卡不能用了。

e.en: My {room-mate} works night shifts at the hospital.
e.zh: 我的室友在医院上夜班。

e.en: She became his {room-mate} during the conference.
e.zh: 会议期间她成了和他同住一房的人。

e.en: The old inn charged extra {roomage} for servants.
e.zh: 那家老旅店为仆人的住宿额外收取房费。

e.en: The architect measured the available {roomage} carefully.
e.zh: 建筑师仔细测量了可用的房间空间。

e.en: The poet described the {roric} grass at dawn.
e.zh: 诗人描写黎明时沾着露水的青草。

e.en: A {roric} shine covered the garden leaves.
e.zh: 花园里的叶子覆着一层露水般的光泽。

e.en: The valley looked {roridous} after the cold night.
e.zh: 寒冷的一夜过后，山谷显得露水很重。

e.en: Her shoes were soaked by the {roridous} lawn.
e.zh: 她的鞋被湿漉漉的草坪弄透了。

e.en: The {rorqual} surfaced beside the research boat.
e.zh: 那头须鲸在科研船旁浮出水面。

e.en: A blue whale is a kind of {rorqual}.
e.zh: 蓝鲸是须鲸类的一种。

e.en: The audit exposed a {rort} in the travel claims.
e.zh: 审计揭露了差旅报销中的一桩诈骗勾当。

e.en: They tried to {rort} the system for extra payments.
e.zh: 他们试图钻制度空子来多拿钱。

e.en: The report accused officials of {rorting} public funds.
e.zh: 报告指控官员骗取公共资金。

e.en: He denied {rorting} the welfare system.
e.zh: 他否认自己钻福利制度的空子牟利。

e.en: The {rorulent} petals glittered in the morning sun.
e.zh: 沾满露水的花瓣在晨光中闪闪发亮。

e.en: He crossed the {rorulent} field before breakfast.
e.zh: 他早饭前穿过那片露水湿重的田地。

e.en: A carved {rosace} decorated the stone ceiling.
e.zh: 石质天花板上装饰着一朵雕刻的玫瑰花饰。

e.en: Light poured through the cathedral {rosace}.
e.zh: 光线从大教堂的蔷薇窗倾泻进来。

e.en: The sunset left a {rosaceous} glow on the clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳在云层上留下玫瑰色的光晕。

e.en: Apples belong to a {rosaceous} family of plants.
e.zh: 苹果属于蔷薇科植物的一类。

e.en: We ordered a chilled {rosado} with dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐时点了一瓶冰镇桃红葡萄酒。

e.en: This {rosado} tastes dry and lightly fruity.
e.zh: 这款桃红葡萄酒口感偏干，带有淡淡果香。

e.en: The chemist used {rosaniline} to prepare the stain.
e.zh: 化学师用玫瑰苯胺来配制染色剂。

e.en: Early magenta dyes often contained {rosaniline}.
e.zh: 早期的品红染料常含有玫瑰苯胺。

e.en: The {rosarian} pruned each bush with care.
e.zh: 那位玫瑰栽培者细心修剪每一丛玫瑰。

e.en: A skilled {rosarian} can identify many old varieties.
e.zh: 熟练的玫瑰栽培者能辨认许多老品种。

e.en: Visitors walked slowly through the monastery {rosarium}.
e.zh: 游客们慢慢走过修道院的玫瑰园。

e.en: The old manuscript was called a {rosarium}.
e.zh: 那部古手稿被称作一部念珠集。

e.en: The collector bought a small specimen of {rosasite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块水锌铜矿标本。

e.en: Blue-green {rosasite} coated the surface of the rock.
e.zh: 蓝绿色的水锌铜矿覆盖在岩石表面。

e.en: The {roscid} meadow sparkled at sunrise.
e.zh: 有露水的草地在日出时闪闪发亮。

e.en: She touched the {roscid} leaves with her fingertips.
e.zh: 她用指尖触碰那些湿润带露的叶子。

e.en: She booked a {roomette} for the overnight train.
e.zh: 她为夜班火车订了一间小卧铺单间。

e.en: The tiny {roomette} had a folding bed and sink.
e.zh: 这个小卧铺单间里有折叠床和洗手池。

e.en: The coat was cut {roomily} for layering.
e.zh: 这件外套剪裁宽松，方便里面叠穿。

e.en: The cabin was arranged {roomily} despite its size.
e.zh: 小木屋虽然不大，却布置得很宽敞。

e.en: The hospital encourages {rooming-in} after birth.
e.zh: 医院鼓励产后进行母婴同室照护。

e.en: During {rooming-in}, nurses help parents feed the baby.
e.zh: 母婴同室期间，护士会帮助父母给宝宝喂奶。

e.en: The old office felt {roomless} after the walls came down.
e.zh: 墙拆掉后，旧办公室感觉像没有房间划分。

e.en: Several students were left {roomless} when housing filled up.
e.zh: 宿舍满员后，几名学生没有住处。

e.en: The old hen began to {roop} in the cold shed.
e.zh: 那只老母鸡在寒冷的棚里开始发出嘶哑声。

e.en: A harsh {roop} came from the bird's throat.
e.zh: 鸟喉咙里传出一阵刺耳的嘶哑声。

e.en: The pamphlet was dismissed as a last-minute {roorbach}.
e.zh: 那本小册子被认为是选前最后一刻的谣言诽谤。

e.en: His opponents spread a {roorbach} before election day.
e.zh: 他的对手在投票日前散布了一则竞选谣言。

e.en: The senator called the story a cheap {roorback}.
e.zh: 参议员称这篇报道是低劣的竞选诽谤。

e.en: A sudden {roorback} can damage a close campaign.
e.zh: 突如其来的竞选谣言会伤害胶着的选战。

e.en: The villagers would {roose} the singer after every show.
e.zh: 每场演出后，村民们都会称赞那位歌手。

e.en: His speech was full of {roose} for the old king.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是对老国王的吹捧。

e.en: The frontier rule was {root-hog-or-die} for many families.
e.zh: 对许多家庭来说，边疆生活就是自力求生。

e.en: He took a {root-hog-or-die} attitude toward business.
e.zh: 他做生意抱着一种靠自己拼活路的态度。

e.en: The fungus sent {root-like} threads through the soil.
e.zh: 真菌把像根一样的细丝伸进土里。

e.en: A {root-like} pattern spread across the glass.
e.zh: 玻璃上蔓延出一种像根一样的纹路。

e.en: Good {rootage} helps the young tree survive drought.
e.zh: 良好的根系状态有助于小树熬过干旱。

e.en: The gardener checked the cutting for {rootage}.
e.zh: 园丁检查插枝是否已经生根。

e.en: The fern became {rootbound} in its small pot.
e.zh: 蕨类植物在小花盆里长得根缠盆了。

e.en: Repot the {rootbound} plant before growth slows.
e.zh: 在生长变慢前给这株根缠盆的植物换盆。

e.en: The sapling gained a firm {roothold} in the bank.
e.zh: 小树苗在河岸上扎下了稳固的根。

e.en: The idea found a {roothold} among young voters.
e.zh: 这个想法在年轻选民中找到了立足点。

rootkit.t: 隐藏控制系统的恶意程序

e.en: The scanner found a {rootkit} on the server.
e.zh: 扫描程序在服务器上发现了一个隐藏控制系统的恶意程序。

e.en: A {rootkit} can hide other malware from users.
e.zh: rootkit 可以向用户隐藏其他恶意软件。

e.en: The children began to {rootle} through the toy box.
e.zh: 孩子们开始在玩具箱里翻找。

e.en: The pig will {rootle} under leaves for food.
e.zh: 猪会在落叶下面拱来拱去找食物。

e.en: She {rootled} in her bag for the receipt.
e.zh: 她在包里翻找那张收据。

e.en: The pigs {rootled} around the wet field all morning.
e.zh: 那些猪整个上午都在湿地里拱土找东西。

e.en: He {rootles} through drawers when he is nervous.
e.zh: 他紧张时会在抽屉里乱翻找。

e.en: The sow {rootles} near the fence for acorns.
e.zh: 母猪在栅栏边拱土寻找橡子。

e.en: The cracks formed a {rootlike} network on the wall.
e.zh: 裂缝在墙上形成了像根一样的网状纹路。

e.en: Thin {rootlike} fibers held the plant in place.
e.zh: 细细的根状纤维把植物固定住。

e.en: A pale {rootling} appeared below the seed.
e.zh: 种子下面冒出了一条苍白的幼根。

e.en: The botanist measured each tiny {rootling} carefully.
e.zh: 植物学家仔细测量每一条小根。

e.en: New shoots rose from the buried {rootstalk}.
e.zh: 新的嫩芽从埋在土里的根茎上长出来。

e.en: Cut the {rootstalk} into sections before planting.
e.zh: 种植前把根茎切成几段。

e.en: Snow lay thick on the village {rooves}.
e.zh: 村里的屋顶上积着厚厚的雪。

e.en: The old poem mentions red {rooves} by the sea.
e.zh: 那首旧诗提到海边的红色屋顶。

e.en: The boxer used {rope-a-dope} in the later rounds.
e.zh: 拳击手在后几回合使用了诱敌疲惫战术。

e.en: Her debate style was pure {rope-a-dope}.
e.zh: 她的辩论风格完全是在先示弱耗尽对手。

e.en: The old {rope-maker} worked beside the harbor.
e.zh: 那位老制绳工在港口旁干活。

e.en: A small {rope-maker} twisted fibers into cord.
e.zh: 一台小型制绳机把纤维拧成绳索。

e.en: The geologist identified {roscoelite} in the greenish rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在那块发绿的岩石样本中鉴定出了铝硅酸钙镁矿物。

e.en: Small traces of {roscoelite} can give the ore a distinctive color.
e.zh: 少量铝硅酸钙镁矿物会让矿石呈现出独特的颜色。

e.en: A single {rose-bud} opened after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后，一朵玫瑰花蕾绽开了。

e.en: She pressed the dried {rose-bud} inside her diary.
e.zh: 她把那朵干玫瑰花蕾压在日记里。

e.en: The old {rose-bush} blooms every spring.
e.zh: 那丛老玫瑰灌木每年春天都会开花。

e.en: He scratched his hand on the {rose-bush}.
e.zh: 他的手被蔷薇丛划伤了。

e.en: The {rose-cheeked} child ran in from the cold.
e.zh: 那个脸颊红润的孩子从寒冷的室外跑了进来。

e.en: She looked {rose-cheeked} after the long walk.
e.zh: 长途步行之后，她看起来双颊红润。

e.en: She wore a {rose-colored} scarf to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一条玫瑰色的围巾去参加聚会。

e.en: His {rose-colored} view of the deal ignored the risks.
e.zh: 他对这笔交易过分乐观，忽视了其中的风险。

e.en: The sky had a soft {rose-colour} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，天空带着柔和的玫瑰色。

e.en: She added a little {rose-colour} to the painting.
e.zh: 她给那幅画添了一点粉红色调。

e.en: The room was lit by {rose-coloured} glass lamps.
e.zh: 房间被玫瑰色玻璃灯照亮。

e.en: He remembered school through {rose-coloured} memories.
e.zh: 他带着过分美化的回忆来看待学生时代。

e.en: The antique ring held a {rose-cut} diamond.
e.zh: 那枚古董戒指镶着一颗玫瑰式切割的钻石。

e.en: Collectors value {rose-cut} stones for their old-fashioned sparkle.
e.zh: 收藏者欣赏玫瑰式切割宝石那种复古的光泽。

e.en: She bought a paper bag of {rose-drop} sweets.
e.zh: 她买了一纸袋玫瑰香糖果。

e.en: The old shop still sold {rose-drop} candy by weight.
e.zh: 那家老店仍然按重量出售玫瑰香糖果。

e.en: They walked through the {rose-garden} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，他们穿过了玫瑰园。

e.en: The palace {rose-garden} attracts visitors in June.
e.zh: 宫殿的玫瑰园在六月吸引许多游客。

e.en: The soap had a gentle {rose-like} scent.
e.zh: 这块肥皂有一种淡淡的玫瑰般香味。

e.en: The shell opened in a {rose-like} shape.
e.zh: 贝壳张开时呈现出像玫瑰一样的形状。

e.en: She painted the door a deep {rose-red}.
e.zh: 她把门漆成了深玫瑰红色。

e.en: His face turned {rose-red} with embarrassment.
e.zh: 他尴尬得满脸通红。

e.en: She put on {rose-tinted} sunglasses at the beach.
e.zh: 她在海滩上戴上了玫瑰色太阳镜。

e.en: The report offers a {rose-tinted} picture of the economy.
e.zh: 这份报告对经济形势描绘得过于乐观。

e.en: The poet described the dawn as {roseal} and quiet.
e.zh: 诗人把黎明描写成玫瑰色而宁静。

e.en: A {roseal} glow spread across the clouds.
e.zh: 玫瑰色的光辉在云层间铺展开来。

e.en: The path was lined with pink {rosebay}.
e.zh: 小路两旁长满了粉色的柳兰。

e.en: Gardeners should handle {rosebay} with care because it can be poisonous.
e.zh: 园丁应小心处理夹竹桃，因为它可能有毒。

e.en: We planted lavender beside the {rosebed}.
e.zh: 我们在玫瑰花坛旁种了薰衣草。

e.en: The gardener weeded the {rosebed} before breakfast.
e.zh: 园丁在早餐前给玫瑰花坛除草。

e.en: The old photo had a {rosecolored} tint.
e.zh: 那张旧照片带着玫瑰色的色调。

e.en: Her {rosecolored} expectations made the failure harder to accept.
e.zh: 她过于乐观的期待让这次失败更难接受。

e.en: He offered me a small {rosedrop} from a tin.
e.zh: 他从铁盒里拿出一颗小玫瑰香糖果给我。

e.en: The children liked the sweet smell of each {rosedrop}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢每颗玫瑰香糖果的甜香味。

e.en: The diver spotted a {rosefish} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近发现了一条玫瑰鱼。

e.en: A fresh {rosefish} was displayed at the market.
e.zh: 市场上摆着一条新鲜的红色海鱼。

e.en: She removed the wilted {rosehead} from the stem.
e.zh: 她把枯萎的玫瑰花头从花茎上摘了下来。

e.en: The old nail had a decorative {rosehead}.
e.zh: 那枚旧钉子有一个玫瑰状的装饰头。

e.en: She made tea from dried {rosehip}.
e.zh: 她用干玫瑰果泡茶。

e.en: The jam contains apple and {rosehip}.
e.zh: 这款果酱里有苹果和玫瑰果。

e.en: A green {roseleaf} floated in the bowl.
e.zh: 一片绿色玫瑰叶漂在碗里。

e.en: The insect hid under a {roseleaf}.
e.zh: 那只昆虫藏在一片玫瑰叶下面。

e.en: The perfume has a soft {roselike} smell.
e.zh: 这款香水有柔和的玫瑰般气味。

e.en: The dessert was shaped into a {roselike} spiral.
e.zh: 那道甜点被做成了像玫瑰一样的螺旋形。

e.en: Dad was {ropeable} when he saw the broken window.
e.zh: 爸爸看到打碎的窗户时气得要命。

e.en: The coach looked {ropeable} after the late penalty.
e.zh: 那次迟来的点球之后，教练看起来暴怒不已。

e.en: The {ropedancer} crossed the square above the crowd.
e.zh: 走绳表演者在人群上方穿过广场。

e.en: A skilled {ropedancer} needs balance and nerve.
e.zh: 熟练的绳舞艺人需要平衡感和胆量。

e.en: The festival ended with dramatic {ropedancing} at sunset.
e.zh: 节日在日落时以精彩的走绳表演收尾。

e.en: She studied {ropedancing} in an old circus family.
e.zh: 她在一个老马戏世家学习绳舞。

e.en: The plant had thick, {ropelike} roots under the soil.
e.zh: 这种植物在土下有粗粗的绳状根。

e.en: A {ropelike} scar ran across his shoulder.
e.zh: 一道像绳子的疤痕横过他的肩膀。

e.en: The {ropemaker} twisted hemp into a strong cable.
e.zh: 制绳工把麻纤维拧成结实的缆绳。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {ropemaker} near the docks.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在码头附近当制绳匠。

e.en: Traditional {ropemaking} requires long, open workshops.
e.zh: 传统制绳需要很长的开放式作坊。

e.en: The museum demonstrates {ropemaking} for school groups.
e.zh: 博物馆向学生团体演示制绳工艺。

e.en: Good {ropemanship} can save time on a sailing boat.
e.zh: 良好的用绳技艺能在帆船上节省时间。

e.en: His {ropemanship} impressed everyone at the rescue drill.
e.zh: 他在救援演练中的绳索本领让所有人印象深刻。

e.en: He jokingly called his hobby {ropeology}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑把自己的爱好称作绳索学。

e.en: The guide's {ropeology} covered knots, fibers, and safety.
e.zh: 向导的绳索知识包括绳结、纤维和安全事项。

e.en: Several old {roperies} once lined the harbor road.
e.zh: 港口路旁曾经排列着几家老制绳厂。

e.en: The town converted its abandoned {roperies} into studios.
e.zh: 小镇把废弃的制绳作坊改成了工作室。

e.en: The {ropery} supplied cables for fishing boats.
e.zh: 这家制绳厂为渔船供应缆绳。

e.en: His family had worked in the {ropery} for generations.
e.zh: 他家几代人都从事制绳业。

e.en: The old {ropewalk} stretched behind the warehouses.
e.zh: 旧制绳长廊延伸在仓库后面。

e.en: Workers paced the {ropewalk} while twisting the fibers.
e.zh: 工人们一边拧纤维，一边在制绳场来回走动。

e.en: The {ropewalker} paused halfway above the street.
e.zh: 走绳者在街道上方走到一半时停了下来。

e.en: A calm {ropewalker} trusts each careful step.
e.zh: 沉着的走钢索者相信每一步的谨慎落脚。

e.en: {Ropewalking} drew a silent crowd to the square.
e.zh: 走绳表演把一群安静的观众吸引到广场上。

e.en: She began {ropewalking} as part of circus training.
e.zh: 她把走钢索作为马戏训练的一部分开始学习。

e.en: The mountain {ropeway} closes during strong winds.
e.zh: 山上的索道在强风天气会关闭。

e.en: Tourists took the {ropeway} over the valley.
e.zh: 游客乘坐空中缆车线路越过山谷。

e.en: The sailor fixed the jammed {ropewinder} before departure.
e.zh: 水手在出发前修好了卡住的卷绳器。

e.en: A tired {ropewinder} worked beside the long shed.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的绕绳工在长棚旁干活。

e.en: The apprentice separated the {ropeyarn} by hand.
e.zh: 学徒用手把制绳纱分开。

e.en: Old sailors used {ropeyarn} for quick repairs.
e.zh: 老水手会用绳股纱线做临时修补。

e.en: This was the {ropiest} syrup in the batch.
e.zh: 这是这一批里最黏稠的糖浆。

e.en: The oldest vine had the {ropiest} stems.
e.zh: 最老的藤有最像绳子的茎。

e.en: The melted cheese stretched {ropily} from the spoon.
e.zh: 融化的奶酪从勺子上黏稠地拉开。

e.en: The roots twisted {ropily} around the stone.
e.zh: 树根绳状地缠绕在石头周围。

e.en: The jam's {ropiness} showed it had cooked too long.
e.zh: 果酱的黏稠感说明它煮得太久了。

e.en: The sculptor liked the {ropiness} of the twisted clay.
e.zh: 雕塑家喜欢那团扭曲黏土的绳状特征。

e.en: They played {roque} on a smooth clay court.
e.zh: 他们在平整的黏土球场上打硬地槌球。

e.en: {Roque} resembles croquet but uses a walled court.
e.zh: 硬地槌球类似槌球，但使用有围边的球场。

e.en: She crumbled {Roquefort} over the green salad.
e.zh: 她把罗克福蓝纹奶酪捏碎撒在绿沙拉上。

e.en: The sauce tasted sharp because of the {Roquefort}.
e.zh: 这道酱汁因为罗克福蓝纹奶酪而味道浓烈。

e.en: The actor wore a dark {roquelaure} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在舞台上穿着一件深色旧式及膝斗篷。

e.en: A {roquelaure} appears in several eighteenth-century portraits.
e.zh: 几幅十八世纪肖像画中都出现了旧式及膝斗篷。

roquesite.t: 罗克赛特矿；稀有铜铟矿

e.en: The sample contained tiny grains of {roquesite}.
e.zh: 样本中含有细小的罗克赛特矿颗粒。

e.en: Geologists identified {roquesite} in the copper deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在铜矿床中鉴定出了稀有铜铟矿。

e.en: Her ball made a clean {roquet} near the hoop.
e.zh: 她的球在铁环附近干净利落地击中了他球。

e.en: He tried to {roquet} the opponent's ball across the court.
e.zh: 他试图在球场上击中对手的球。

e.en: The collector labeled the pink mineral as {roselite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块粉色矿物标为玫瑰石。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {roselite} lined the old specimen box.
e.zh: 旧标本盒里排列着细小的玫瑰石晶体。

e.en: She brewed dried {roselle} into a bright red tea.
e.zh: 她用干洛神花泡出一杯鲜红的茶。

e.en: The farmer planted {roselle} for its edible calyces.
e.zh: 农民种植玫瑰茄，是为了收获可食用的花萼。

e.en: A {rosemaled} chest stood beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉旁放着一只饰有挪威玫瑰彩绘的箱子。

e.en: The museum displayed several {rosemaled} wooden bowls.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几个带挪威玫瑰彩绘的木碗。

e.en: The {rosemaler} painted curling flowers on the cupboard door.
e.zh: 那位玫瑰彩绘画师在橱门上画了卷曲的花纹。

e.en: She trained as a {rosemaler} after studying folk art.
e.zh: 她学习民间艺术后，受训成为挪威玫瑰彩绘画师。

e.en: Traditional {rosemaling} often uses flowing floral patterns.
e.zh: 传统的挪威玫瑰彩绘常使用流动感很强的花卉图案。

e.en: He learned {rosemaling} from his grandmother in Wisconsin.
e.zh: 他在威斯康星向祖母学习挪威玫瑰彩绘。

rosemalt.t: 带玫瑰彩绘的；彩绘过的

e.en: The {rosemalt} box was kept on the mantel.
e.zh: 那个带玫瑰彩绘的盒子被放在壁炉架上。

e.en: They restored a faded {rosemalt} chair from Norway.
e.zh: 他们修复了一把来自挪威、彩绘已经褪色的椅子。

rosenhahnite.t: 罗森汉石，一种稀有矿物

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {rosenhahnite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这份样品鉴定为罗森汉石。

e.en: Crystals of {rosenhahnite} are rarely seen outside mineral collections.
e.zh: 罗森汉石晶体在矿物收藏之外很少见。

e.en: The baby developed a fever before the {roseola} rash appeared.
e.zh: 宝宝在玫瑰疹皮疹出现前先发了烧。

e.en: Most cases of {roseola} clear up without special treatment.
e.zh: 大多数幼儿急疹无需特殊治疗就会好转。

e.en: The doctor noted a {roseolar} rash on the child's chest.
e.zh: 医生注意到孩子胸口有玫瑰疹样皮疹。

e.en: A faint {roseolar} eruption followed the fever.
e.zh: 发烧之后出现了淡淡的玫瑰疹状疹子。

e.en: The shell had a {roseolate} shine in the morning light.
e.zh: 贝壳在晨光中泛着玫瑰色的光泽。

e.en: A {roseolate} tint spread across the clouds at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，云层染上了一层粉红色。

e.en: The old poem praised her {roseous} cheeks.
e.zh: 那首旧诗赞美她玫瑰般的双颊。

e.en: A {roseous} glow filled the room at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，房间里充满了玫瑰色的光。

e.en: Her wedding veil was edged with {rosepoint} lace.
e.zh: 她的婚纱面纱边缘镶着玫瑰花针法花边。

e.en: The antique dealer specialized in Venetian {rosepoint}.
e.zh: 这位古董商专营威尼斯玫瑰花针法花边。

e.en: Hikers found {roseroot} growing on the rocky slope.
e.zh: 徒步者发现红景天长在多石的山坡上。

e.en: Some herbal shops sell dried {roseroot} as a supplement.
e.zh: 一些草药店把干红景天作为补充剂出售。

e.en: The estate's {rosery} was famous for old climbing roses.
e.zh: 庄园的玫瑰园以古老的藤本玫瑰闻名。

e.en: She spent the afternoon pruning plants in the {rosery}.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在玫瑰园里修剪花木。

e.en: The dyer mixed {roset} with a little madder.
e.zh: 染匠把玫瑰色染料和少量茜草染料混在一起。

e.en: A pale {roset} marked the edge of the fabric.
e.zh: 布料边缘带着一抹淡玫瑰色。

e.en: The old inventory listed several jars of {rosets}.
e.zh: 旧库存清单列出了几罐玫瑰色染料。

e.en: Different {rosets} produced slightly different shades on silk.
e.zh: 不同的玫瑰色染料在丝绸上会呈现略有差别的色调。

e.en: Add a teaspoon of {rosewater} to the pudding.
e.zh: 在布丁里加入一茶匙玫瑰水。

e.en: She dabbed {rosewater} on her wrists before dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐前，她在手腕上轻拍了一点玫瑰香水。

e.en: Her cheeks looked {rosey} after the long walk.
e.zh: 长途散步后，她的脸颊显得红润。

e.en: His forecast was too {rosey} for such a weak market.
e.zh: 面对这么疲软的市场，他的预测过于乐观。

e.en: The students bowed when the {roshi} entered the hall.
e.zh: 老禅师走进大厅时，学生们鞠躬致意。

e.en: A {roshi} may guide meditation through silence rather than speeches.
e.zh: 禅宗老师有时用沉默而不是讲话来引导禅修。

rosied.t: 使变得玫瑰色的；染红的

e.en: The sunset {rosied} the windows of the old house.
e.zh: 夕阳把老房子的窗户染成玫瑰色。

e.en: Cold air had {rosied} the children's faces.
e.zh: 冷空气把孩子们的脸冻得红润起来。

e.en: She spoke {rosily} about the company's future.
e.zh: 她乐观地谈起公司的未来。

e.en: The sunset glowed {rosily} through the clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳透过云层泛出玫瑰色的光。

e.en: The chemist tested a metal {rosinate} in solution.
e.zh: 化学家检测了溶液中的一种金属松香酸盐。

e.en: Workers {rosinate} the surface to improve its grip.
e.zh: 工人用松香处理表面以增强抓握力。

e.en: The violinist rubbed {rosine} on the bow.
e.zh: 小提琴手在琴弓上擦了松香。

e.en: A smell of {rosine} filled the old workshop.
e.zh: 旧作坊里弥漫着松香的气味。

e.en: Her report exaggerated the {rosiness} of the market.
e.zh: 她的报告夸大了市场的乐观前景。

e.en: The cold brought a natural {rosiness} to his face.
e.zh: 寒冷让他的脸自然泛起红润。

e.en: The old pine gave off a {rosinous} smell.
e.zh: 那棵老松树散发出树脂般的气味。

e.en: A {rosinous} residue stuck to the blade.
e.zh: 刀刃上粘着一层松香状残留物。

e.en: {Rosinweed} grew along the dry roadside.
e.zh: 干燥的路边长着松脂草。

e.en: The botanist collected {rosinweed} for her survey.
e.zh: 植物学家为调查采集了松脂草。

e.en: The workshop had a sharp {rosiny} odor.
e.zh: 作坊里有一股刺鼻的松香味。

e.en: His fingers felt {rosiny} after tuning the bow.
e.zh: 调过琴弓后，他的手指摸起来带着松香感。

rosolate.t: 玫瑰酸盐；玫瑰色化合物

e.en: The sample formed a red {rosolate} under heat.
e.zh: 样品受热后形成了红色玫瑰酸盐。

e.en: A faint {rosolate} stain remained on the paper.
e.zh: 纸上残留着淡淡的玫瑰色污迹。

e.en: They served {rosolio} after the meal.
e.zh: 饭后他们端上了玫瑰香甜酒。

e.en: The old recipe flavored {rosolio} with citrus peel.
e.zh: 这份老配方用柑橘皮给玫瑰香甜酒调味。

e.en: The collector bought a small piece of {rosolite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块蔷薇辉石。

e.en: Under the lamp, the {rosolite} looked softly pink.
e.zh: 在灯光下，那块玫瑰色矿物显得柔和粉嫩。

e.en: A carved {rosone} decorated the church facade.
e.zh: 教堂正面装饰着一枚雕刻的玫瑰窗。

e.en: The architect sketched a stone {rosone} above the door.
e.zh: 建筑师在门上方勾画了一个石制圆花饰。

e.en: The farmer spent the morning {rossing} the young cattle.
e.zh: 农夫整个上午都在给小牛戴铃。

e.en: Old manuals mention {rossing} as a way to track grazing animals.
e.zh: 旧手册提到给牲畜戴铃可用来追踪放牧的动物。

e.en: A {rossy} glow spread across the evening clouds.
e.zh: 晚霞在云层上铺开一片玫瑰色的光。

e.en: Her cheeks looked {rossy} after the long walk.
e.zh: 走了很久以后，她的脸颊显得红润。

e.en: The botanist pointed to the tiny {rostella} on the flower.
e.zh: 植物学家指着花上的小喙状突起。

e.en: Several {rostella} were visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到几个小喙状突起。

e.en: The seed capsule has a {rostellate} tip.
e.zh: 这个蒴果顶端有小喙状结构。

e.en: She sketched the {rostellate} form of the insect mouthpart.
e.zh: 她画下了昆虫口器的小喙状形态。

e.en: The orchid's {rostellum} separates the pollen from the stigma.
e.zh: 兰花的小喙把花粉和柱头隔开。

e.en: A tapeworm uses its {rostellum} to attach to tissue.
e.zh: 绦虫用喙状突起附着在组织上。

e.en: Speakers once addressed the crowd from the Roman {rostra}.
e.zh: 演说者曾在罗马讲坛上向人群讲话。

e.en: The fossil showed several broken {rostra} from ancient shellfish.
e.zh: 化石显示出古代贝类的几段断裂喙状部。

e.en: The scan showed activity in a {rostral} brain region.
e.zh: 扫描显示大脑头端区域有活动。

e.en: The fish has a narrow {rostral} projection.
e.zh: 这条鱼有一个狭窄的喙部突起。

e.en: The nerve fibers extend {rostrally} toward the forebrain.
e.zh: 神经纤维向头端延伸到前脑。

e.en: The cartilage curves {rostrally} near the snout.
e.zh: 软骨在靠近吻部处向喙部弯曲。

e.en: The beetle has a distinctly {rostrate} head.
e.zh: 这种甲虫的头部明显呈喙状。

e.en: A {rostrate} fruit narrows sharply at the end.
e.zh: 喙状果实在末端急剧变窄。

e.en: The specimen was labeled as a {rostrated} shell.
e.zh: 这个标本被标为有喙状突起的贝壳。

e.en: Its {rostrated} beak helps it probe soft mud.
e.zh: 它带喙状突起的嘴有助于探入软泥。

e.en: The guide describes a {rostriferous} insect with a long snout.
e.zh: 指南描述了一种带长吻喙的昆虫。

e.en: A {rostriferous} structure projects from the front of the shell.
e.zh: 一个带喙的结构从贝壳前端伸出。

e.en: The bone ends in a {rostriform} point.
e.zh: 这块骨头末端呈喙形尖端。

e.en: The artist copied the vessel's {rostriform} prow.
e.zh: 艺术家临摹了船只喙形的船首。

e.en: A compact {rosula} of leaves formed near the soil.
e.zh: 贴近土壤处形成了一簇紧密的小叶丛。

e.en: The lichen grew in a pale green {rosula}.
e.zh: 地衣长成淡绿色的小玫瑰状。

e.en: The plant has {rosulate} leaves at its base.
e.zh: 这种植物基部有莲座状叶片。

e.en: A {rosulate} pattern makes the succulent look neat.
e.zh: 莲座状排列让这株多肉显得很整齐。

e.en: Homer calls dawn {rosyfingered} in the old translation.
e.zh: 荷马在旧译本中称黎明为玫瑰指的。

e.en: The poet borrowed {rosyfingered} to describe the morning sky.
e.zh: 诗人借用玫瑰指的一词来描写清晨的天空。

e.en: The engineer tested a {rotachute} for emergency landings.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于紧急着陆的旋翼降落伞。

e.en: A {rotachute} slows descent by using spinning blades.
e.zh: 旋翼降落伞通过旋转叶片减缓下降。

e.en: This molecule has more than one stable {rotamer}.
e.zh: 这个分子有不止一种稳定的旋转异构体。

e.en: The software predicts the preferred {rotamer} for each side chain.
e.zh: 软件会预测每条侧链偏好的旋转异构体。

e.en: The lecture introduced {rotamerism} in simple organic molecules.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了简单有机分子中的旋转异构现象。

e.en: Protein models must account for side-chain {rotamerism}.
e.zh: 蛋白质模型必须考虑侧链的旋转异构现象。

e.en: The technician read the gas flow on the {rotameter}.
e.zh: 技术员从转子流量计上读取气体流量。

e.en: A clean {rotameter} gives a steadier measurement.
e.zh: 干净的转子流量计能给出更稳定的测量值。

e.en: The inventor proposed a small {rotaplane} for short flights.
e.zh: 发明者提出了一种用于短途飞行的小型旋翼飞机。

e.en: A {rotaplane} combines features of a plane and a rotorcraft.
e.zh: 旋翼飞机结合了飞机和旋翼航空器的特点。

rotaprint.t: 轮转印刷法；轮转印刷机

e.en: The workshop still uses {rotaprint} for small notices.
e.zh: 这家工坊仍用轮转印刷法印制小通知。

e.en: Old {rotaprint} copies faded after years in storage.
e.zh: 旧的轮转印刷品存放多年后褪色了。

e.en: The engineer described the {rotarian} motion of the valve.
e.zh: 工程师描述了阀门的旋转运动。

e.en: A {rotarian} schedule gave each team equal time.
e.zh: 轮换日程让每个团队都有相同时间。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {rotascope} before the demonstration.
e.zh: 技术员在演示前调好了旋转观测仪。

e.en: A dusty {rotascope} stood beside the old projector.
e.zh: 一台落满灰的旋转观测仪放在旧投影机旁。

rotatably.t: 可旋转地；以能转动方式

e.en: The handle is {rotatably} mounted on the frame.
e.zh: 这个把手以可旋转方式安装在框架上。

e.en: Each mirror was {rotatably} fixed to a small bracket.
e.zh: 每面镜子都可转动地固定在小支架上。

e.en: The new {rotatee} joined the sales team on Monday.
e.zh: 新的轮岗员工周一加入了销售团队。

e.en: Each {rotatee} writes a report before leaving the department.
e.zh: 每名轮岗者离开部门前都要写一份报告。

e.en: The machine depends on a {rotative} cutting head.
e.zh: 这台机器依靠一个旋转切割头工作。

e.en: They used a {rotative} system for weekend duties.
e.zh: 他们用轮流制度安排周末值班。

e.en: The gears moved {rotatively} around the central shaft.
e.zh: 齿轮围绕中心轴旋转运动。

e.en: The chairmanship passed {rotatively} among senior members.
e.zh: 主席职位在资深成员之间轮流交接。

e.en: The drill creates a strong {rotatory} force.
e.zh: 钻头会产生很强的旋转力。

e.en: Patients may feel a {rotatory} dizziness after the test.
e.zh: 患者在测试后可能会感到旋转性眩晕。

e.en: The scan showed slight {rotaversion} of the tooth.
e.zh: 扫描显示这颗牙有轻微旋转偏位。

e.en: Doctors measured the eye's {rotaversion} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中测量了眼球的旋转偏位。

e.en: The cabinet door rolled on a tiny {rotella}.
e.zh: 柜门靠一个小轮子滑动。

e.en: Archaeologists found a bronze {rotella} in the ruins.
e.zh: 考古人员在遗址中发现了一个青铜小轮状物。

e.en: Water splashed through the worn {rothole}.
e.zh: 水从磨损的船桨孔溅了进来。

e.en: He repaired the {rothole} before launching the boat.
e.zh: 他在下水前修好了船上的桨架孔。

e.en: She served hot {roti} with lentil curry.
e.zh: 她端上热印度薄饼配扁豆咖喱。

e.en: The street stall sells {roti} every morning.
e.zh: 这家路边摊每天早上卖印度薄饼。

e.en: The flower has a {rotiform} arrangement of petals.
e.zh: 这朵花的花瓣呈轮状排列。

e.en: A {rotiform} pattern decorated the ancient shield.
e.zh: 古盾牌上装饰着轮形图案。

e.en: Boil the {rotini} until it is just tender.
e.zh: 把螺旋意面煮到刚刚变软。

e.en: Cold {rotini} works well in a summer pasta salad.
e.zh: 冷螺旋意面很适合做夏日意面沙拉。

e.en: The merchant weighed the dates by the {rotl}.
e.zh: 商人按罗特尔这种旧重量单位称椰枣。

e.en: A {rotl} varied from one market to another.
e.zh: 一罗特尔的重量在不同市场并不相同。

roto.t: 轮转凹版印刷；轮转印刷

e.en: The magazine used {roto} for its color pages.
e.zh: 这本杂志用轮转凹版印刷制作彩页。

e.en: Old {roto} presses filled the factory floor.
e.zh: 旧轮转印刷机占满了厂房。

e.en: The farmer repaired the {rotobaler} before harvest.
e.zh: 农民在收割前修好了圆捆打包机。

e.en: A noisy {rotobaler} worked across the hay field.
e.zh: 一台吵闹的圆捆打包机在干草地里作业。

rotobeater.t: 旋转打浆器；转子搅打器

e.en: The mixer uses a {rotobeater} to blend thick batter.
e.zh: 这台搅拌机用旋转打浆器混合浓面糊。

e.en: A damaged {rotobeater} made the machine vibrate.
e.zh: 损坏的转子搅打器让机器震动起来。

e.en: The crew used {rotoblast} to clean the metal panels.
e.zh: 工人用旋转喷砂清理金属板。

e.en: A {rotoblast} finish removed rust from the old frame.
e.zh: 旋转喷砂处理去除了旧框架上的铁锈。

e.en: Grain dropped through the {rotochute} into the bin.
e.zh: 谷物通过旋转滑槽落进仓箱。

e.en: The operator aimed the {rotochute} toward the truck.
e.zh: 操作员把转动溜槽对准卡车。

rotocleaner.t: 旋转清洁机；转子清理器

e.en: The mill installed a {rotocleaner} for dusty grain.
e.zh: 磨坊安装了一台旋转清洁机来处理带尘谷物。

e.en: A clogged {rotocleaner} slowed the whole production line.
e.zh: 堵塞的转子清理器拖慢了整条生产线。

e.en: The inventor tested a small {rotocycle} in the yard.
e.zh: 发明者在院子里测试了一辆小型旋翼车。

e.en: The diagram shows the {rotocycle} inside the separator.
e.zh: 图示显示了分离器内部的旋转循环装置。

rotundine.t: 罗通定；左旋延胡索乙素

e.en: The study measured how {rotundine} affected sleep quality.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了罗通定对睡眠质量的影响。

e.en: Some herbal preparations contain {rotundine} as an active compound.
e.zh: 一些草药制剂含有罗通定这种活性化合物。

e.en: His gentle {rotundity} made him look cheerful.
e.zh: 他温和的圆胖身形让他显得很开朗。

e.en: The critic admired the {rotundity} of the vase.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏那只花瓶圆润饱满的形态。

e.en: The duke refused to marry a {roturier}.
e.zh: 公爵拒绝娶一位平民为妻。

e.en: In old France, a {roturier} lacked noble rank.
e.zh: 在旧时法国，平民没有贵族身份。

e.en: The cloth was colored with {roucou}.
e.zh: 这块布是用胭脂树染料染色的。

e.en: Traders once valued {roucou} for its bright red pigment.
e.zh: 商人曾因胭脂树鲜红的颜料而重视它。

e.en: The old {roue} boasted about his scandals.
e.zh: 那个老浪荡子吹嘘自己的丑闻。

e.en: She dismissed him as a charming {roue}.
e.zh: 她把他看作一个有魅力的放荡男子。

e.en: We made a {rough-and-ready} estimate before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前我们先做了一个粗略但可用的估算。

e.en: The cabin offered {rough-and-ready} shelter from the storm.
e.zh: 那间小屋提供了简陋但能避风雨的住处。

e.en: Politics is often a {rough-and-tumble} business.
e.zh: 政治常常是一桩混乱而激烈的事情。

e.en: The children enjoyed a little {rough-and-tumble} in the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在院子里稍微打闹一番。

e.en: The coach stopped the boys' {rough-and-tumbles} after practice.
e.zh: 训练结束后，教练制止了男孩们的打闹。

e.en: Their arguments became noisy {rough-and-tumbles}.
e.zh: 他们的争论变成了吵闹的混战。

e.en: The director showed us a {rough-cut} of the film.
e.zh: 导演给我们看了这部电影的粗剪版。

e.en: They sold {rough-cut} timber to local builders.
e.zh: 他们把粗加工木材卖给当地建筑商。

e.en: Please {rough-dry} the shirts before ironing them.
e.zh: 熨衬衫前请先把它们粗略烘干。

e.en: The laundry offered a cheap {rough-dry} service.
e.zh: 这家洗衣店提供便宜的初步烘干服务。

rough-footed.t: 足部粗糙的；腿足有羽的

e.en: The {rough-footed} bird perched on the fence.
e.zh: 那只有羽足的鸟停在篱笆上。

e.en: A {rough-footed} horse struggled on the icy road.
e.zh: 一匹蹄足粗糙的马在结冰的路上艰难前行。

e.en: The table was made from {rough-hewn} oak.
e.zh: 这张桌子是用粗凿的橡木做成的。

e.en: He had a {rough-hewn} charm that suited the role.
e.zh: 他有一种质朴粗犷的魅力，很适合这个角色。

e.en: The kids began to {rough-house} in the living room.
e.zh: 孩子们开始在客厅里嬉闹打斗。

e.en: Too much {rough-house} can lead to injuries.
e.zh: 过度粗暴玩闹可能会造成受伤。

rough-housed.t: 嬉闹打斗过；粗暴对待过

e.en: The brothers {rough-housed} until their mother shouted.
e.zh: 兄弟俩一直嬉闹打斗，直到母亲喊停。

e.en: The guards {rough-housed} the prisoner during the arrest.
e.zh: 警卫在逮捕时粗暴对待了那名囚犯。

e.en: He often {rough-houses} with his cousins after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后常和表兄弟们嬉闹打斗。

e.en: The camp bans {rough-houses} near the swimming area.
e.zh: 营地禁止在游泳区附近粗暴玩闹。

e.en: A {rough-legged} hawk circled above the field.
e.zh: 一只毛腿鹰在田野上空盘旋。

e.en: The guide pointed out the bird's {rough-legged} appearance.
e.zh: 向导指出了那只鸟腿部有羽的外观。

rough-spoken.t: 说话粗鲁的；言辞生硬的

e.en: The {rough-spoken} foreman still cared about his crew.
e.zh: 那位说话粗鲁的工头其实仍关心他的工人。

e.en: Her {rough-spoken} advice was useful but hard to hear.
e.zh: 她言辞生硬的建议很有用，但听起来刺耳。

e.en: The gang threatened to {rough-up} the witness.
e.zh: 那伙人威胁要殴打那名证人。

e.en: Don't {rough-up} the old suitcase too much.
e.zh: 别太粗暴地对待那个旧手提箱。

e.en: The gate was built from {rough-wrought} iron.
e.zh: 那扇大门是用粗加工的铁做成的。

e.en: His poem had a {rough-wrought} power.
e.zh: 他的诗有一种粗粝而有力的美感。

e.en: His {ramstam} plan ignored every warning from the crew.
e.zh: 他那个莽撞的计划无视了船员们的所有警告。

e.en: She grew tired of his {ramstam} refusal to compromise.
e.zh: 他固执莽撞地拒绝妥协，让她感到厌烦。

e.en: The report listed {resourrces} instead of resources by mistake.
e.zh: 报告里误把resources拼成了resourrces。

e.en: Search results may include {resourrces} when the word is misspelled.
e.zh: 单词拼错时，搜索结果可能会出现resourrces。

e.en: He typed {resourse} when he meant resource.
e.zh: 他本来想输入resource，却打成了resourse。

e.en: The teacher marked {resourse} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 老师把resourse标成了拼写错误。

e.en: The enzyme {rhodanase} helps detoxify cyanide in some tissues.
e.zh: 硫氰酸酶有助于在某些组织中解毒氰化物。

e.en: Researchers measured {rhodanase} activity in the liver samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了肝脏样本中的硫氰酸酶活性。

e.en: The solution contained a small amount of {rhodanate}.
e.zh: 这种溶液中含有少量硫氰酸盐。

e.en: Chemists once used {rhodanate} as another name for thiocyanate.
e.zh: 化学家过去曾用rhodanate来指硫氰酸盐。

e.en: The old text refers to potassium {rhodanide}.
e.zh: 那本旧书提到了硫氰化钾。

e.en: A {rhodanide} compound appeared in the nineteenth-century formula.
e.zh: 一个硫氰化物出现在十九世纪的配方中。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {rhodanine} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的罗丹宁衍生物。

e.en: Some screening libraries include {rhodanine} compounds.
e.zh: 一些筛选化合物库包含罗丹宁类化合物。

e.en: The process can {rhodanize} the metal surface under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 该工艺能在受控条件下使金属表面形成硫氰酸盐。

e.en: They tried to {rhodanize} the sample before analysis.
e.zh: 他们在分析前试图对样品进行硫氰酸盐化处理。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {rhodanizing} bath temperature.
e.zh: 技术员调整了硫氰酸盐化处理槽的温度。

e.en: {Rhodanizing} the sample changed its surface chemistry.
e.zh: 对样品进行硫氰酸盐化处理改变了其表面化学性质。

e.en: The lab used {rhodanometry} to estimate the silver content.
e.zh: 实验室用硫氰酸盐滴定法估算银含量。

e.en: Older manuals describe {rhodanometry} in detail.
e.zh: 较早的手册详细介绍了硫氰酸盐滴定法。

e.en: The alloy showed unusual {rhodic} properties at high temperature.
e.zh: 这种合金在高温下表现出异常的含铑特性。

e.en: A {rhodic} compound was isolated from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 研究人员从反应混合物中分离出一种铑化合物。

e.en: The perfume formula included a trace of {rhodinal}.
e.zh: 这款香水配方中含有微量玫瑰醛。

e.en: Fresh leaves released a scent rich in {rhodinal}.
e.zh: 新鲜叶片释放出富含香茅醛的气味。

e.en: The oil contains {rhodinol} and other fragrant alcohols.
e.zh: 这种精油含有玫瑰醇和其他芳香醇。

e.en: Perfumers value {rhodinol} for its soft floral note.
e.zh: 调香师看重玫瑰醇柔和的花香气息。

e.en: The mineral name begins with {rhodo}, meaning rose-colored.
e.zh: 这个矿物名称以rhodo开头，意思是玫瑰色。

e.en: Collectors sometimes shorten rhodochrosite to {rhodo}.
e.zh: 收藏者有时把菱锰矿简称为rhodo。

e.en: The museum displayed a pink {rhodochrosite} crystal.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块粉红色的菱锰矿晶体。

e.en: Jewelers cut {rhodochrosite} into cabochons for rings.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把菱锰矿切磨成弧面宝石用于戒指。

e.en: The paper identified {rhodojaponin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 论文在植物提取物中鉴定出了杜鹃花毒素。

e.en: Poisoning symptoms were linked to {rhodojaponin} exposure.
e.zh: 中毒症状被认为与接触杜鹃花毒素有关。

e.en: She chose a ring set with {rhodolite}.
e.zh: 她选了一枚镶有玫瑰榴石的戒指。

e.en: The {rhodolite} glowed purple-red under the light.
e.zh: 那颗玫瑰榴石在灯光下泛出紫红色光泽。

e.en: His speech was full of {rhodomontade} and empty promises.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满大话和空洞的承诺。

e.en: The critic dismissed the manifesto as political {rhodomontade}.
e.zh: 评论家把这份宣言斥为政治吹牛。

e.en: Everyone knew him as a cheerful {rhodomontader}.
e.zh: 大家都知道他是个爱吹牛但性格开朗的人。

e.en: The novel mocks the {rhodomontader} who boasts before every battle.
e.zh: 小说嘲讽了那个每次战斗前都夸口的人。

e.en: The culture produced {rhodomycetin} under specific conditions.
e.zh: 这种培养物在特定条件下产生玫红霉素。

e.en: Scientists tested {rhodomycetin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 科学家测试了玫红霉素对几种细菌菌株的作用。

e.en: The pendant was carved from polished {rhodonite}.
e.zh: 这个吊坠是用抛光的蔷薇辉石雕成的。

e.en: Miners found {rhodonite} veins near the old quarry.
e.zh: 矿工在旧采石场附近发现了蔷薇辉石矿脉。

e.en: A {rhodophyte} can live in deep coastal water.
e.zh: 红藻类植物可以生活在较深的沿海水域。

e.en: The biologist identified the specimen as a {rhodophyte}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这个标本鉴定为红藻。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {rhodopin}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量红藻色素。

e.en: Researchers measured {rhodopin} during the pigment analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员在色素分析中测量了红藻色素。

e.en: The extract yielded a small amount of {rhodopinol}.
e.zh: 提取物中得到少量红藻醇。

e.en: They compared {rhodopinol} with related carotenoid alcohols.
e.zh: 他们把红藻醇与相关的类胡萝卜素醇作了比较。

rhodoplast.t: 红藻色素体；红藻叶绿体

e.en: Each {rhodoplast} contains pigments used in photosynthesis.
e.zh: 每个红藻色素体都含有用于光合作用的色素。

e.en: The microscope image showed a damaged {rhodoplast}.
e.zh: 显微镜图像显示出一个受损的红藻叶绿体。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {rhodoporphyrin} for the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家为实验合成了玫红卟啉。

e.en: Light changed the color of the {rhodoporphyrin} solution.
e.zh: 光照改变了红色卟啉溶液的颜色。

e.en: The old dye recipe mentioned {rhodopurpurin}.
e.zh: 这份旧染料配方提到了红紫素。

e.en: A stain of {rhodopurpurin} marked the fabric.
e.zh: 布料上留下了一处红紫色染料的痕迹。

e.en: The {rhodora} bloomed beside the marsh in spring.
e.zh: 春天，北美杜鹃在沼泽旁开花。

e.en: She wrote a poem about a wild {rhodora}.
e.zh: 她写了一首关于野生紫花杜鹃的诗。

e.en: American English is usually {rhotic} in most regions.
e.zh: 美国英语在大多数地区通常会发r音。

e.en: The teacher explained the {rhotic} accent carefully.
e.zh: 老师仔细解释了这种带卷舌音的口音。

e.en: The pie had a sharp, {rhubarby} taste.
e.zh: 这个派有一种像大黄一样尖酸的味道。

e.en: Her perfume carried a strange {rhubarby} note.
e.zh: 她的香水带着一种奇特的酸涩气味。

e.en: The navigator plotted a {rhumb} across the chart.
e.zh: 领航员在海图上画出一条恒向线。

e.en: Sailors followed the {rhumb} to keep a steady bearing.
e.zh: 水手们沿着罗盘方位线航行，以保持稳定航向。

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {rhumbatron} inside the transmitter.
e.zh: 工程师调整了发射机里的谐振腔。

e.en: A damaged {rhumbatron} reduced the microwave signal.
e.zh: 受损的微波谐振器削弱了微波信号。

e.en: The poem follows an ABAB {rhyme-scheme}.
e.zh: 这首诗采用ABAB的押韵格式。

e.en: Changing the {rhyme-scheme} made the song feel lighter.
e.zh: 改变韵脚安排后，这首歌听起来更轻快。

e.en: He wrote a {rhymeless} poem about winter streets.
e.zh: 他写了一首关于冬日街道的无韵诗。

e.en: The final line felt deliberately {rhymeless}.
e.zh: 最后一行显得是有意不押韵的。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a mere {rhymester}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为一个蹩脚诗人。
